conversation.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.

Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.

The shape tapers in every view.

 The stance is set up
 ith just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.

The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.
]
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。

仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。

前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。

此外，这辆'2还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言g
这台引擎rE其x然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

conversation.en:
It was nice talking to you, too. Now go and take another
good look at your beloved car!

趁此机会再回去欣赏下你的车吧，也许你会发现一个全新的角度！

collection.en:
If you're looking for a car that will really give you a
taste of traditional American hot rod culture...

Then the 1932 Ford Model B, or ‘Deuce’, as it is
affectionately called, is a great place to start.

The name ‘Deuce’ comes from its two-door
configuration.

Popular as a base for customisation...

It is a prime example of a custom hot rod.
collection.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆能够真正体验美国传统改装车文化
的汽车……

那么又被大家昵称为“Deuce”的1932年Ford Model B
或许会是个不错的开始。

“Deuce”这个名称来源于车型的双门配置。

它是广受欢迎的改装车基础车型，

你可以将之当做美国定制改装车的一个典型范例。!

catch.en: This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.
catch.zh: 在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.

The car’s spirit is deeply rooted in American custom car and hot rod culture, a tradition that traces back to the 1930s. Model T and Model B Fords were often boldly modified, with exterior customizations and engine swaps for more powerful units. The V-3883, displayed in the Henry Ford Museum, features a Chrysler 331 Hemi engine producing 177.5 HP. A relatively simple yet striking example, its exposed engine cover serves as a key visual accent, capturing the essence of early American hot rod craftsmanship.

long.en: The car’s spirit is deeply rooted in American custom car and hot rod culture, a tradition that traces back to the 1930s. Model T and Model B Fords were often boldly modified, with exterior customizations and engine swaps for more powerful units. The V-3883, displayed in the Henry Ford Museum, features a Chrysler 331 Hemi engine producing 177.5 HP. A relatively simple yet striking example, its exposed engine cover serves as a key visual accent, capturing the essence of early American hot rod craftsmanship.
long.zh: 这台车的根源可追溯至20世纪30年代美国的定制车与高性能改装车文化。在当时，Ford的Model T与Model B常被玩家进行大胆的外观改造，并换上更强力的引擎。Henry Ford博物馆展出的“V-3883”换装了180 PS Chrysler 331 Hemi引擎。此车是简约美学的典范，引擎盖本身就足以成为外观上的亮点。

brandCentral.en:
AFEELA is set on redefining mobility itself, and that vision
comes into sharp focus with the groundbreaking AFEELA 1.

Its exterior was minimalist and purposeful, free of unnecessary
elements—even the door handles followed this philosophy.

Looking inside, the AFEELA 1 truly set itself apart. A full-width
large display stretched across the dashboard.

It came paired with an Active Noise Cancelling audio system
that created a refined, immersive environment.

There was also an intelliget personal agent, which could learn
your preferences and habits through natural conversation.

Powering these features was an ECU with 800 TOPS of processing
power, enabling advanced driver assistance technologies.

Offered in both Origin and Signatre trims, the AFEELA 1 changed
everyday driving into something truly extradinary.
brandCentral.zh:
艾菲拉品牌致力于革新“移动出行”概念，
而这一切在艾菲拉1身上体现得淋漓尽致。

你会发现它拥有简约纯净的外观设计，摒弃了一切浮华
装饰，连门把手都做了隐藏式处理。

事实上，艾菲拉1真正的亮点在于其内饰，
配备了横跨整个仪表台的大尺寸显示屏……

搭配主动降噪音响系统，
共同打造出移动空间的终极体验。

该车还配备了智能个人助理来为驾乘人员提z支持，
它能通过对话学习用户的偏好和习惯。

这一设计以及其他先进驾驶辅助功能之所以得以实现，
全靠一颗拥有800万亿次计算次数/秒算力的强大电子控制器单元。

艾菲拉1提供“Origi”和“Signature”两个版本，
这是一台能够化平凡为“非lE”的座驾hp

catch.en: A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.
catch.zh: 全新“移动出行”座驾，颠覆传统交通理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.

The AFEELA 1 was unveiled at CES® 2025. This production model was offered in two distinct trims—Origin and Signature. The cabin was envisioned as a Creative Entertainment Space that challenged traditional notions of what travel could be. Advanced technologies were embedded throughout the BEV, including an array of external sensing devices and an intelligent personal agent capable of holding natural, conversational dialogue.

long.en: The AFEELA 1 was unveiled at CES® 2025. This production model was offered in two distinct trims—Origin and Signature. The cabin was envisioned as a Creative Entertainment Space that challenged traditional notions of what travel could be. Advanced technologies were embedded throughout the BEV, including an array of external sensing devices and an intelligent personal agent capable of holding natural, conversational dialogue.
long.zh: AFEELA 1在CES® 2025展会上正式亮相。这款量产车型根据装饰级别共有两个配置版本可选：Origin版和Signature版。这款纯电动汽车以“创意娱乐空间”为设计理念打造豪华内饰，颠覆了传统的出行体验。它搭载了众多先进技术，包括集成在车身外部的感知设备，以及支持自然语言对话的智能助理。

brandCentral.en:
AFEELA is Sony and Honda’s vision
of 'the future of mobility.'

A prototype of the car was unveiled in early 2024 at CES®,
the world’s biggest tech trade show.

Dubbed the 'AFEELA Prototype 2024'...

It employs the latest sensing technology and AI to expand
the possibilities of movement.

This includes features that optimise a natural
driving experience...

And a personal mobility agent that communicates
intelligently with the driver and their passengers.

The media bar on the front works as an external
communication device...

While the large dashboard display enlivens the cabin
with all kinds of entertainment.

The future of mobility, AFEELA marks a revolution in
the act of movement itself.
brandCentral.zh:
艾菲拉是索尼和本田对于“移动性的未来”
这一主题的愿景。

其原型于2024年初在全世界最大的国际消费类电子产品展览会®上惊艳亮相。

这款车被命名为“艾菲拉Prototype 2024”……

采用了最新的传感技术和人工智能，极大拓展了
交通出行的可能性。

这些创新功能中包含了对自然驾驶体验的优化……

以及可以与司机和乘客进行智能交流的个人出行代理。

位于车头处的媒体栏可以起到外部交流设备的作用……

而车内的大型仪表板也能够以各种娱乐方式
活跃客舱内的氛围。

艾菲拉不仅昭示了汽车的未来，也标志着移动出行
方式本身的革新。<

conversation.en:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the B.A.T. 1.

But when I consider its round body section
and dual front air intakes...

...its design links to B.A.Ts 5, 7 and 9 become
all the more obvious.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that run down
the center of the car are another case in point.

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,
joined Bertone as its hief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.

As the first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
我之前不知道Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。

柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼
也体现了这一点。

设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

这款车就是他奇思妙想的产物。

作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。

conversation.en:
Thank you for that insightful piece of history!

collection.en:
Franco Scaglione was a designer who applied the principles of
aeronautical engineering to car design during his career.

He is perhaps best known for his B.A.T. design concept cars.

B.A.T. stands for "Berlina Aerodinamica Tecnica," and these were
experimental vehicles designed for aerodynamic testing.

This car predates B.A.T. 5, which is usually considered
the first of the B.A.T series.

But the owner Chris Drake and many historians believe
that this car spawned the B.A.T. series...</>
...and should be considered to be B.A.T.1.

First presented at the 1952 Turin Motor Show, it was later
owned by the Packard Motor Car Company.

Lovingly restored over a period of seven years,
Drake's hard work paid off in 2010...

...when, a the famous Pebble Beach Concours
d'Elegance...

...it won the Gran Tismo Trophy!
collection.zh:
弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在他的整个职业生涯中都致力于
把航空工程的理念应用到汽车设计当中。

他最著名的作品当属B.A.T.概念赛车。

B.A.T.是“车辆空气动力学技术”的缩写，
这批实验车也确实被用于空气动力学测试。

尽管编号存疑，但这辆B.A.T.5通常被视作B.A.T.车系中的第一辆……

但车主克里斯·德雷克以及许多历史研究者相信
正是它启发了B.A.T.系列……

所以它才1真正的B.A.T.1。

这台车在1952年的都灵车展首次亮相，
随后归属于帕卡德汽车公司。

经过历时七年的精心修复。德雷克的辛勤工作
终于在2010年得到了回报……

这辆车出席了圆石滩经典展，

并为他赢得了一座超级跑车奖杯。

catch.en: A futuristic-looking design featuring a large central headlight, this Abarth was first shown at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.
catch.zh: 个性化兼具精密计算的美，标志着汽车设计中融入空气动力学研究的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A futuristic-looking design featuring a large central headlight, this Abarth was first shown at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

Another Maserati highlight, an aerodynamic test vehicle, was unveiled at the 1952 Turin Motor Show. Based on a FIAT platform, the car showcased strikingly original styling by Franco Scaglione and was powered by a 1.5-liter engine tuned by Abarth to deliver 73 HP. The only example ever built was later shown at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in recent years, where it earned the prestigious Gran Turismo trophy.

long.en: Another Maserati highlight, an aerodynamic test vehicle, was unveiled at the 1952 Turin Motor Show. Based on a FIAT platform, the car showcased strikingly original styling by Franco Scaglione and was powered by a 1.5-liter engine tuned by Abarth to deliver 73 HP. The only example ever built was later shown at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in recent years, where it earned the prestigious Gran Turismo trophy.
long.zh: 这是1952年在都灵车展上展出过的空气动力学测试车。这台基于FIAT车型打造的测试车采用了弗朗哥·斯凯荣内魅力独具的造型风格，搭载的1.5升引擎经Abarth调校后可输出75 PS。唯一的样车在近年来参加了圆石滩经典车展，荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。

This is an Abarth car—you can tell straightaway
from the ‘scorpion’ emblem.

Abarth is one of the most storied brands
in motorsport history.

It was established by Carlo Abarth...

Who began his career as a racer and engineer of

The Italian company Abarth is a prestigious name in the

usedCar.en:
Abarth is an Italian race car builder that rose to
global prominence in the 1950s and 1960s.

The brand was resurrected in 2007, and a little later,
it introduced the Abarth 500 you see here.

It's a hot hatch, and it has a front-engine/front-wheel-drive
layout that we in the industry refer to as "FF."

Abarth really injected its DNA into the 500, which is evident
everywhere, from its styling to the powered-up engine.
usedCar.zh:
意大利赛车制造商阿巴斯于20世纪50年代和60年代在
全球范围内声名鹊起。

此品牌在2007年获得了重生。很快，这家新公司
就推出了这款阿巴斯500。

这是一款采用前置前驱布局的
高性能掀背车。

从它的引擎到悬挂，这辆车上的一切都承袭了
阿巴斯的风格！

catch.en: The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."

vehicleCollection.en:
The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."

This was a factory-tuned version of the FIAT 500, developed by the iconic Italian performance brand Abarth, which returned to the scene in 2007. Powered by a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC engine delivering 133.1 HP and 151.9 ft-lb of torque. Tipping the scales at just 2447 lbs, the car accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 7.9 seconds and reached a top speed of 127.4 mph. The design carried the unmistakable presence of an Abarth, with aggressive bumpers, flared side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler.

Tipping the scales at just 2447 lbs, the car accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 7.9 seconds and reached a top speed of 127.4 mph. The design carried the unmistakable presence of an Abarth, with aggressive bumpers, flared side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler.

collection.en:
This is one of the most recognisable cars from the 1990s
German touring car championship known as the DTM.

After entry criteria were loosened in 1993, the DTM became a
platform for developing some very powerful cars.

One of these was the Alfa 155 2.5 V6 TI, the car fielded
by the Alfa Romeo works team.

Winning 12 out of 20 races in 1993...

It secured a championship title for both the
driver Nicola Larini and the manufacturer.

The DTM was later absorbed into an international
competition before being discontinued in 1996.

This meant that Alfa Romeo would go down in history as the
only non-German manufacturer to win the series.

One of the most significant DTM cars, it is more unique
because it’s not German.
collection.zh:
这是1990年代的德国房车大师赛中最为人熟知的几款赛车
之一。

在1993年降低了准入标准后，德国房车大师赛成为了开发测试马力强大
的车款的舞台。

阿尔法罗密欧厂队的155 2.5 V6 TI便是其中之一。

它在1993年的20场德国房车大师赛比赛中取得12胜，

拿到了车手（尼古拉·拉里尼）与制造商双料冠军。

德国房车大师赛后来正式并入一项国际性赛事，并在1996年停办。

这意味着阿尔法罗密欧是在德国房车大师赛历史上唯一获得冠军的非德国制造商。

顶着这样的光环，让这台德国房车大师赛冠军车显得更加出类拔萃。

vehicleCollection.en:
This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.

The 155 2.5 V6 TI was Alfa Romeo’s answer to the increasingly advanced Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM), which, by 1993, allowed significant car modifications. Based on the 1992 155 sedan, it featured a 60-degree 2.5-liter V-6 powerplant producing 414.2 HP and a full-time 4-wheel-drive system. The car won 12 of 20 rounds and secured the championship.

The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.

First and foremost, it's impressively light,
weighing a mere <895kg>!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design
trends of the 2010s.

Its innovative carbon-fiber body really
paid off in this respect.

Although powered by a small turbocharged 1.8-liter engine, the
car's lightweight nature made it accelerate like a super car.

Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions
made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic
Tipo 33 Stradale.

The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

Alfa Romeo’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car, the 4C made its debut in 2013. Its design paid tribute to the timeless lines of the Tipo 33/2 Stradale. The 1742 cc 4-cylinder engine, producing 236.7 HP and 253.2 ft-lb of torque, was paired with an exceptionally lightweight body, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of 160.3 mph. A special "Launch Edition" was also released, limited to just 1,000 units worldwide.

A special "Launch Edition" was also released, limited to just 1,000 units worldwide.

conversation.en:
Classical yet elegantly refined,
this car is truly a stunning work of art.

Carrozzeria Touring, were experimenting with an
advanced design called the "pontoon,"

where the front and rear fenders were connected.

However, this 8C 2900 has...

...a classic design where
the large fenders are enhanced.

Of course, other Alfa Romeos had this design element.

Undoubtedly a very beautiful car that caught people's
eye even more so than Ferraris of today.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。

然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。

当然，这一设计元素也被其他阿尔法罗密欧车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多法拉利还要吸睛。

抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。

然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。

当然，这一设计元素也被其他阿尔法罗密欧车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多法拉利还要吸睛。

collection.en:
The 8C name refers to the engine's eight cylinders, and
these cars are the iconic pre-war Alfa Romeos.

The inline-8 was designed by the genius Italian
engineer Vittorio Jano.

The “Berlinetta” body was made by famed coachbuilder
Touring.

There were only five Berlinettas made in total.

This particular one, from 1937, appeared in many motor
shows and catalogues.

It also won "Best of Show" at the Pebble Beach
Concours d'Elegance in 2018.

It then won the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este
the following year...

...before winning the Louis Vuitton Classic Concours Award.

I doubt many other cars have won prizes at three of the
world's biggest concours.

Needless to say, its current value is nothing short of
astronmialű
collection.zh:
8C的名号不仅对应了引擎的8个气缸，也致敬了Alfa Romeo
战前生产的标志性车型。

直列八缸引擎由意大利天才工程师维托里奥·亚诺设计完成，

“Berlinetta”车身则由著名车身制造商Touring打造，

而且，Berlinetta只生产了五辆。

这辆1937年下线的8C在圈内声名远播，曾在许多车展和拍
卖目录中现身。

它还在2018年的圆石滩经典车展中赢得了“最佳巡展”
的名号，

并在第二年的埃斯特别墅车展中再次斩获殊荣。

它还赢得过路易·维登经典车展奖。

我怀疑有多少其他车型能包圆世界三大展会的奖项！

毋庸置疑，它现在的售价已经是个天文数字了。~

catch.en: Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.
catch.zh: 这款精致的双门跑车配备了双顶置凸轮轴8缸引擎，由Alfa Romeo在战前时期生产。

vehicleCollection.en:
Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.

As its name suggested, the Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta was a stunning coupe, its body hand-shaped by Carrozzeria Touring using the lightweight superleggera method. The "8C" badge referred to the car’s 8-cylinder engine. Designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano, the water-cooled inline-8 delivered performance that placed the machine firmly in race-car territory. It's believed that only five examples were ever produced.

long.en: As its name suggested, the Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta was a stunning coupe, its body hand-shaped by Carrozzeria Touring using the lightweight superleggera method. The "8C" badge referred to the car’s 8-cylinder engine. Designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano, the water-cooled inline-8 delivered performance that placed the machine firmly in race-car territory. It's believed that only five examples were ever produced.
long.zh: 顾名思义，Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta是由Carrozzeria Touring用超轻结构技术打造的精致双门轿跑。“8C”指的是引擎的8个气缸。液冷直列式8缸引擎出自天才设计师维托瑞·加诺之手，性能表现直逼赛车。据说这台车总共仅生产了5台。

conversation.en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.

Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.

What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.

From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.

Although it employs a FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.

The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.

While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the heel and drive it!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
这款车是Alfa Romeo史上最富传奇色彩的作品之一。

Alfa Romeo曾专注于制造赛车和高级GT车型。

这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。

这款车从称谓到款式，无一不唤起人们对
Alfa Romemo在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。

虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……

采用跨轴布局，目的是改善重量分布。

不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！

conversation.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honour
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic vintage
car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
U

conversation.en:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design.

The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!

While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.
'
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。

其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！

Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。

conversation.en: Wow, that was fascinating! Thanks!
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
哇，好精彩的解说！感谢感谢！
R

My pleasure! I hope we can discuss car design
again sometime.
U

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:

brandCentral.en:
This is Alfa Romeo's supercar, the 8C Competizione.

It sports a mighty V8 engine that was actually built
at a Ferrari factory.

Not only does it feel powerful—it sounds powerful, too!

An FR car with a transaxle gearbox mounted in the rear...

You'll find it handles like a dream thanks to its excellent
weight distribution.

Also of note: its beautiful proportions were inspired by the
classic racing Alfa Romeos of the thirties and forties.;
brandCentral.zh:
8C Competizione是Alfa Romeo推出的超级跑车。

这台车上搭载的强劲V8引擎实际上是在Ferrari工厂制造的。

不仅动力十足，声音也非常威猛！

这是一辆跨轴变速箱安装在后部的前置后驱车……

您会发现，由于其出色的重量分布，这辆车操控起来如
梦幻般流畅。

另外值得一提的是：其曼妙的车身比例深受30和40年代
的Alfa Romeo经典赛车的启发。;

usedCar.en:
Of all Alfa Romeo cars in the past few decades, I would
rate this 8C Competizione at the top of the list.

Race car manufacturer Dallara collaborated with Alfa Romeo
in this car's design and development...

...with the assembly of the precious few units overseen
by none other than Maserati.

And the constructor of the V-8 engine? Ferrari.

Also, its front-engine/rear-drive layout included a transaxle.

With such a dream team working behind the scenes, this car
was destined to be the quintessential Italian exotic.<
usedCar.zh:
8C Competizione绝对算得上Alfa Romeo跑车
中的佼佼者。

赛车车厂Dallara与Alfa Romeo合作设计、
打造出了这辆车。

它的有限生产是交给Maserati
负责的……

而搭载的V8引擎是Ferrari打造的。

光听起来就非同凡响！

此外，它的跨轴前置后驱布局还赋予了它
梦幻般的操控性。

catch.en: This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of 180.2 mph plus.
catch.zh: Alfa Romeo后轮驱动双门轿车回归，最高速度超过290 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of 180.2 mph plus.

The original 8C took its name from the 8-cylinder engine designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano. Beneath its timeless bodywork lay a 4.7-liter V-8, tuned by Alfa Romeo to deliver 443.8 HP. With a top speed of 180.2 mph and a 0–62.1 mph sprint time of under 4.2 seconds, it rivaled—and in some cases surpassed—contemporary supercars. Limited to just 500 units worldwide, the car sold out almost immediately upon its release.

long.en: The original 8C took its name from the 8-cylinder engine designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano. Beneath its timeless bodywork lay a 4.7-liter V-8, tuned by Alfa Romeo to deliver 443.8 HP. With a top speed of 180.2 mph and a 0–62.1 mph sprint time of under 4.2 seconds, it rivaled—and in some cases surpassed—contemporary supercars. Limited to just 500 units worldwide, the car sold out almost immediately upon its release.
long.zh: 初代8C得名于维托瑞·加诺设计的8缸引擎。在其经典造型下，隐藏着Alfa Romeo调校的4.7升V8引擎，动力输出达450 PS，最高时速可达290 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间不到4.2秒，让不少同期的超级跑车都相形见绌。这台车全球限量仅500台，发售的一瞬间便被抢购一空。

vehicleCollection.zh:

初代8C得名于维托瑞·加诺设计的8缸引擎。在其经典造型下，隐藏着Alfa Romeo调校的4.7升V8引擎，动力输出达450 PS，最高时速可达290 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间不到4.2秒，让不少同期的超级跑车都相形见绌。这台车全球限量仅500台，发售的一瞬间便被抢购一空。

cars.nameEn: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
cars.nameZh: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65

collection.en:
You'd be hard pressed to find a wilder, more bewitching
street-legal car than the Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ.

It's also incredibly rare, with only around
12 ever built.

And what’s truly noteworthy is that this race car...

...has no history of crashes and has never undergone
any restoration work.

You can see why it has become a collector's item.

It should come as no surprise that this TZ2 won the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the 2009 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
您很难找到哪辆车能像Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ这般狂野、迷人，
同时还能在路上合法行驶。

不仅如此，它也非常的稀有，
总共只制造了12辆左右！

它的存在简直就是一个奇迹……

像这样一辆纯粹的赛车，居然从来没有发生过碰撞，
也从未接受过修复。

这样的无伤历史，想要不出名也难！

锦上添花的是，TZ2还在2009年的圆石滩经典车展获得了
Gran Turismo奖杯。

catch.en: Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.
catch.zh: 来自60年代的优美经典车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.

This racing machine was the result of a collaborative effort between Alfa Romeo and Carrozzeria Zagato. Based on the TZ, its body shell was replaced with lightweight FRP, while the nose and roof were lowered to enhance aerodynamic performance. Under the hood, it featured the twin-ignition cylinder head from the Giulia GTA, allowing it to produce 162.7 HP and reach a top speed of 152.2 mph.

long.en: This racing machine was the result of a collaborative effort between Alfa Romeo and Carrozzeria Zagato. Based on the TZ, its body shell was replaced with lightweight FRP, while the nose and roof were lowered to enhance aerodynamic performance. Under the hood, it featured the twin-ignition cylinder head from the Giulia GTA, allowing it to produce 162.7 HP and reach a top speed of 152.2 mph.
long.zh: 这辆赛道机器是Alfa Romeo和Carrozzeria Zagato联手打造的产物。它的车身设计借鉴了经典车型TZ，但外壳换用了纤维强化塑料，为了优化空气动力学性能，还降低了车头和车顶的高度。在动力方面，它采用了一部由Giulia GTA打造的双火花塞点火引擎，能够输出165 PS的动力，最高时速更是达到了245 公里/小时。

conversation.en:
GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.

It dominated the Touring Car championships
in Italy and Europe.

This limited, "mean" version of the new Giulia sedan fully
captures its original spirit and exuberant performance.

The design also shows its sportiness with a big front grille,
wide fenders and carbon-fiber aerodynamic elements.

Even the Alfa shield is made of carbon-fiber!

And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut,
like on real race cars.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:

GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.

It dominated the Touring Car championships

And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut,
like on real race cars.

brandCentral.en:
The Giulia GTA and modified GTAm are the highest-performing
Alfa Romeo four-door sedans of all time.

This model has its origin in the Giulia Sprint GTA,
a legendary racer from 1965.

‘GTA’, by the way, is short for ‘Gran Turismo Alleggerita’.

Italian for ‘lightened’, ‘Alleggerita’ is an apt descriptor
for the GTA, which traded in brawn for speed.

In addition to sporting an upgraded engine,
capable of <540ps>, this new Giulia GTA...

Makes use of lightweight carbon panels across its roof,
bonnet, fenders and bumpers.

The GTAm is the modified version of the GTA.

The addition of a massive carbon-fibre wing, and the lack
of rear seating, push its lightness to the limit.
brandCentral.zh:
Giulia GTA和其官方改装车型GTAm是
Alfa Romeo史上性能最强的4门轿车。

其研发原型为Giulia Sprint GTA，生产于1965年的
传奇跑车。

顺便一提，“GTA”是“Gran Turismo Alleggerita”的缩写。

“Alleggerita”是意大利语的“轻量化”的意思，用来描述这辆
牺牲重量、换取速度的GTA再合适不过。

除了装载一台马力高达<540ps>的升级版引擎外，
这辆新的Giulia GTA……

将车顶、引擎盖、挡泥板和保险杠都换成了
轻质碳纤维板。

GTAm则是GTA的官方改装车型。

不仅加装了巨大的碳纤维尾翼，还彻底拆除了后座，
将轻量化推向了极致。

catch.en: The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.
catch.zh: 这款车是Giulia系列的巅峰之作，也是对Alfa Romeo 110年历史的纪念。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.

In 2020, Alfa Romeo marked their 110th anniversary with the release of the special Giulia GTA and GTAm models. The twin-turbo 2.9-liter V-6 saw its output raised to 532.5 HP, accompanied by weight reduction and a wider track for enhanced performance. The GTAm, built with circuit driving in mind, featured a large front splitter, carbon fiber rear wing, and integrated roll bars—delivering a truly hardcore setup.

long.en: In 2020, Alfa Romeo marked their 110th anniversary with the release of the special Giulia GTA and GTAm models. The twin-turbo 2.9-liter V-6 saw its output raised to 532.5 HP, accompanied by weight reduction and a wider track for enhanced performance. The GTAm, built with circuit driving in mind, featured a large front splitter, carbon fiber rear wing, and integrated roll bars—delivering a truly hardcore setup.
long.zh: 2020年，Alfa Romeo为庆祝品牌成立110周年，特别推出了Giulia的“GTA”和“GTAm”特别版车型。2.9升V6双涡轮增压引擎的功率提升至540 PS，同时通过减重和加宽轮距进一步强化性能表现。GTAm车型专为赛道使用而设计，配备了大型前定风翼、碳纤维尾翼和防滚架等极致的硬核配置。

conversation.en:
The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that
Alfa Romeo ever produced.

Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars
to compete in grand prix races.

So, they’ve long had the technical know-how
to bild high-performance engines.

This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered
by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.

Combined with a rear-wheel-drive layout, it’s an absolute
thrill to ride.

And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight
TA model, too.֚ scmd"GTCafe_Top" />I

conversation.zh:
朱丽叶竞速是阿尔法罗密欧旗下的最受欢迎的汽车之一。

由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以
它也被称为“朱丽叶轿跑”。

这是一辆世界闻名的跑车，由天才汽车设计师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀设计。

阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。

因此长期积累了制造5性能引擎所需的技术知识。

这辆朱丽叶竞速虽然个头不大，但它由一台强大的
直列四缸双凸轮轴引擎驱动。

加上后轮驱动的加持，绝对能够带来刺激的驾驶体验

而且这辆车也是超轻量级GTAM的开发基
K车w之一。

usedCar.en:
If you're in the market for an Alfa, may I suggest
something from the 1960s Giulia series?

The Giulia Sprint GTs in particular have long been
coveted as masterpieces of the compact-coupe genre.

They combine a lightweight body with Alfa Romeo’s
sporty DOHC engine.

When it comes to design, they are genuine works of art.

They were penned by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was then
working for the legendary Italian studio Bertone.

The Veloce is a slightly powered-up version
of its GT siblings.#
usedCar.sourceName: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
usedCar.zh:
如果你想买一辆Alfa，要不要考虑下1960年代
的Giulia系列？

特别是Giulia Sprint GT系列，它们是人们长期以来
一直梦寐以求的小型双门跑车杰作。

它的设计结合了轻巧紧凑的车身和Alfa Romeo的
双凸轮轴跑车引擎。

毫不例外，它们也是由乔盖托·乔治亚罗设计的，当时他正在为
传奇的意大利Bertone工作室工作。

从设计上讲，绝对是真正的艺术作品。

Veloce是其众多GT系列兄弟姐妹中的动力进阶版本。

catch.en: An iconic 1960s high-performance coupe from Alfa Romeo
catch.zh: Alfa Romeo在1960年代推出的标志性高性能双门跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An iconic 1960s high-performance coupe from Alfa Romeo

Introduced in 1962, Alfa Romeo’s first Giulia series began as a 4-door sedan, with the Sprint GT coupe joining the lineup in 1963. Designed by Giugiaro, the body featured elegant lines and subtly curved surfaces. The Sprint GT quickly gained popularity as a high-performance sports coupe and remained in production until 1977.

Designed by Giugiaro, the body featured elegant lines and subtly curved surfaces. The Sprint GT quickly gained popularity as a high-performance sports coupe and remained in production until 1977.
long.zh: Alfa Romeo首代Giulia系列于1962年问世，最初为四门轿车，1963年增加了Sprint GT双门轿跑版本。车身由乔治亚罗设计，线条流畅，表面弧度柔美。Sprint GT凭借出色的高性能跑车表现深受喜爱，生产周期持续至1977年。

It certainly provided quite a thrill when you revved
that engine into the meat of its power band!

它搭载的1.4升涡轮增压发动机出力快，

只要你一脚踩下油门，你就会知道这车

vehicleCollection.en:
Alfa Romeo's MiTo hatchback brings a dash of Italian flair to the compact car segment.

This 3-door hatchback was released in the B-segment as a replacement for Alfa Romeo’s previous entry-level model, the 147. Its name was inspired by Milan and Torino—two cities central to Alfa Romeo’s history. The standard powerplant was a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC, with the 1.4 Sport variant producing 152.9 HP and 166.4 ft-lb of torque, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With a top speed of 133.6 mph and a zero-62.1 mph time of 8.0 seconds, it delivered more than respectable performance for its class.

He also designed the Isuzu 4200R concept car.

见到您真是太荣幸了！

史郎先生曾经致力于日产Z系和GT-R的设计工作

conversation.en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.

The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.

The ridge that runs down the hood...

...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.

It's so very French.

But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...

...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.

These details that sugges it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.

In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.

In fact, it's those things that ive this car visual impact.

This type of visual allure,
you can't aceve in today'sʉars.</>
This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collectio.
t
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。

从正前方看时尤其如此，

因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。

我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。

不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……

以及精心布置的进气口。

这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精的特征。

从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，

甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。

它的许多设计在现今的汽O中确实已经不多见了。

这是一项真正的大师之作，我Z想把它纳oO我m收藏。

conversation.en: Are you familiar with the WRC? It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally races that take place on a variety of road surfaces. It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in various countries were unified. The new international race series was christened the World Rally Championship, and the rest is history. This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first WRC series. Its compact body came with an <1800cc> engine mounted at the rear, ensuring excellent traction. The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in Monte Carlo. In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places, defeating entries orm Porsche and Lancia. The car now occups a page in thhistoy books as the car that won the first WRC race and series.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
你对WRC熟悉吗？

它是“世界拉力锦标赛”的缩写，在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。

它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。

这就是WRC的开端，并延续至今。

这一辆Alpine A110正是第一届WRC的冠军。

它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力。

它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。

事实上，Alpine A110一路上击败了Porsche和Lancia，
包揽了领奖台！

A110就此踏上了赢得WRC首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成AOo轰动效应！
V

usedCar.en:
Although Alpine isn't well known in the U.S., this French
company has built some great cars, notably the A110.

This vehicle was one of the great rally cars of the 1970s.

Its RR layout made it an instant rival of the Porsche 911,
which it beat on multiple occasions.

Its fiber-glass construction made it extremely lightweight,
which was the secret to its speed and handling.

And it was instantly recognizable by its unique face.

Take the time to study its cockpit and the exquisitely
arranged five gauges mounted on its dashboard.
usedCar.zh:
这款雷诺Alpine A110跑车是汽车史上最闪耀的明星之一。

它的名气很大程度上归功于其在拉力赛中的表现。

更具体地说，它曾多次击败另一款备受
赞誉的后置后驱跑车——保时捷911。

由纤维强化塑料制成的轻量化车身结构
可以说是它最大的优势之一。

而它在弯道上的表现也首屈一指。

它的驾驶舱和仪表盘上精致排列的五个仪
表也非常值得花些时间去研究。

catch.en: The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.
catch.zh: Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

vehicleCollection.en:
The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.

The Alpine A110 was a classic French sports car with a celebrated heritage in rally racing. With its rear-engine layout and lightweight construction, it delivered superb traction and quickly rose to prominence in international rally events, claiming numerous victories. First introduced in 1963 with a 1.1-liter engine, the A110 saw gradual increases in displacement to remain competitive over time. The pinnacle of the lineup was arguably the 1600S, which came equipped with a 1.6-liter engine.

long.en: The Alpine A110 was a classic French sports car with a celebrated heritage in rally racing. With its rear-engine layout and lightweight construction, it delivered superb traction and quickly rose to prominence in international rally events, claiming numerous victories. First introduced in 1963 with a 1.1-liter engine, the A110 saw gradual increases in displacement to remain competitive over time. The pinnacle of the lineup was arguably the 1600S, which came equipped with a 1.6-liter engine.
long.zh: Alpine A110这台经典法国跑车在拉力赛领域拥有辉煌的历史传承。凭借后置式引擎布局带来的卓越牵引力与超轻车身，它席卷国际拉力赛事，斩获无数胜利。A110在1963年首次出战时搭载的是1.1升引擎，此后为应对竞争，引擎排量逐年提升。终极型号当属采用1.6升引擎的1600S。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

Alpine A110这台经典法国跑车在拉力赛领域拥有辉煌的历史传承。凭借后置式引擎布局带来的卓越牵引力与超轻车身，它席卷国际拉力赛事，斩获无数胜利。A110在1963年首次出战时搭载的是1.1升引擎，此后为应对竞争，引擎排量逐年提升。终极型号当属采用1.6升引擎的1600S。

brandCentral.en:
If you consider yourself a connoisseur, then this car
is for you.

It's the legendary Alpine A110, reborn for the modern age.

Power is supplied by a mid-mounted inline-4 that pumps
out an impressive <250ps>.

Thanks to its aluminum chassis, it weighs in at a
lean <1100kg>, making it agile and quick.

All in all, this car is worthy of the A110 name.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一件专为鉴赏家打造的艺术品！

这辆传奇的Alpine A110在现代得以重生。

其动力由一台中置直列四缸引擎提供，可以输出<250ps>的马力。

因为采用了全铝合金底盘，它的车重惊人的轻，精简到
了只有<1100kg>。

其杰出的操控性绝对配得上A110的盛名。

catch.en: This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.
catch.zh: Alpine品牌复活后出品的轻型跑车杰作，兼具优雅的外观和高超的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.

The original Alpine A110 proved itself across the globe, performing admirably in rally competition. In 2017, Renault revived the Alpine name to carry the torch forward, revealing the modern Alpine A110. This new version, clad in an aluminum body echoing the original, featured a mid-mounted turbocharged 1.8-liter 4-cylinder engine producing 248.5 HP and 231.5 ft-lb of torque. A special Première Édition was created, with production limited to 1,955 units worldwide.

long.en: The original Alpine A110 proved itself across the globe, performing admirably in rally competition. In 2017, Renault revived the Alpine name to carry the torch forward, revealing the modern Alpine A110. This new version, clad in an aluminum body echoing the original, featured a mid-mounted turbocharged 1.8-liter 4-cylinder engine producing 248.5 HP and 231.5 ft-lb of torque. A special Première Édition was created, with production limited to 1,955 units worldwide.
long.zh: 经典的Alpine A110在全球拉力赛中表现出色。2017年，Renault重振Alpine品牌，推出新一代Alpine A110，延续这一传奇。这款新车型采用的铝制车身让人联想到经典的A110，中置1.8升4缸涡轮增压引擎可输出252 PS/32.0 公斤力米。特别版“Première Édition”全球限量1955台。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展

U

conversation.en:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come
to mind are the rally-bred A110...

...and the long-tailed M Series
of Le Mans fame.

The Alpine A220 was built to comply
with Group 6 regulations...

...introduced by FIA in 1968.

However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory
results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.

This model is the rally version, instantly recognizable by
its truncated tail.
\
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
说到Renault-Alpine赛车时，我脑海中浮现的两款车
分别是拉力赛出身的A110……

以及剑指勒芒耐力赛的长尾M系列。

Alpine A220是为了符合1968年
FIA引入的Group 6规则

而制造的。

然而，由于未能在勒芒取得令人满意的成绩，
它很快退出了争夺。

我们眼前的这款是拉力赛版本，从它被截短的尾部
就可以看出。

collection.en:
It's hard to believe that a Le Mans prototype
also competed in rallies.

Well, it really did happen.

Let me introduce you to the Alpine A220.

It's a successor to the Alpine M Series, which performed well
at Le Mans in the 1960s.

It features a mid-mounted 3L V8 engine designed by Gordini...

but unfortunately it never made much of a mark at Le Mans.

However it would go on to compete in the world of rallying
which was a fairly unique challenge for such a car.

This specific car has a dramatically shortened tail for rallying
which makes it especially rare.
collection.zh:
一辆勒芒原型车也能参加拉力赛，是不是很难以置信？

其实，这事确实发生过。

让我向您隆重介绍Alpine A220吧！

Alpine A220是1960年代在勒芒比赛中表现极其出色的
Alpine M Series的继任者，

它采用了由Gordini设计的中置3L V8引擎……

遗憾的是。它从未在勒芒赛场上取得过什么值得大书特
书的成绩。

但它接下来又出现在拉力赛场上，不得不说，这也是一
个相当独特的成就。

这辆A220因为要投入拉力赛，车尾明显被缩短，这也使它
成为了绝无仅有的存在。

catch.en: Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.
catch.zh: Alpine的另一面：搭载3升V8引擎的LeMans赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.

While Alpine earned fame through rallying success with the A110, the 1960s also saw the marque build competitive prototype racers that achieved results on the track. Among them, the A220 stood as Alpine’s strongest contender for overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, making its debut in 1968. Although the car was beset by mechanical issues and failed to deliver the expected result, it remained a fan favorite and a cherished part of Alpine’s legacy.

long.en: While Alpine earned fame through rallying success with the A110, the 1960s also saw the marque build competitive prototype racers that achieved results on the track. Although the car was beset by mechanical issues and failed to deliver the expected result, it remained a fan favorite and a cherished part of Alpine’s legacy.
long.zh: 得益于A110的卓越表现，Alpine作为拉力赛品牌广为人知。而到了20世纪60年代，Alpine还研发过原型赛车，这些车型在赛道上同样战绩斐然。其中，1968年首秀的A220最具问鼎勒芒24小时耐力赛总冠军的潜力。尽管正赛中该车故障频发，成绩未达预期，但至今仍被车迷视为Alpine经典车型之一。

Many of Alpine's creations were successful race cars,
most notably in the WRC or at Le Mans.

The design of the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo was inspired
by some of those cars, including the A210 and A442B.

As you can see, it features an unusual single-seater design...

It also has side air brakes and other cool features

以此实现了轻量化和异常灵敏的操控！

brandCentral.en:
Cars tuned by Amuse are known for their easy-to-drive nature
and being very, very quick.

And this model exemplified both those qualities.

This car was based on a special version of the Nissan 350Z
called the NISMO 380RS.

The output of the 3.8-liter naturally-aspirated engine was
increased from <350ps> to <386ps>.

"Superleggera" means “super light” in Italian, and indeed, the
weight of the car was reduced by an amazing <140kg>!
brandCentral.zh:
由Amuse改装调校的车都是出了名的易于驾驶且速度奇快。

这款车就将这些优点展现的淋漓尽致。

它是在Nissan 350Z的一个特殊版本，NISMO 380RS上进行的改装，

搭载有一台3.8L自然进气引擎，并将马力从<350ps>提升到了<386ps>。

“Superleggera”这个单词在意大利语里的意思是“超轻”，而这
款车的也确实做到了这一点，整整消去了<140kg>的重量！

catch.en: Modified by Amuse, this Z car not only looked great, but also underwent a major weight reduction.
catch.zh: 一辆由Amuse改装的380RS。Z系列中的杰作，经过了大幅的减重。

vehicleCollection.en:
Modified by Amuse, this Z car not only looked great, but also underwent a major weight reduction.

The Version NISMO Type 380RS was a fully tuned Z33 Fairlady Z developed by NISMO. Power House Amuse took it a step further, crafting the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera. The standout upgrade was its weight reduction of 309 lbs, a nod to the Super Leggera name—Italian for "super light."

long.en: The Version NISMO Type 380RS was a fully tuned Z33 Fairlady Z developed by NISMO. Power House Amuse took it a step further, crafting the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera. The standout upgrade was its weight reduction of 309 lbs, a nod to the Super Leggera name—Italian for "super light."
long.zh: Version NISMO Type 380RS是NISMO基于Z33 Fairlady Z打造的改装完成车。Power House Amuse进一步调校出了Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera。正如它名字中的“Super Leggera”标签（意大利语中“超轻”的意思）所说，最显著的改进是高达140 公斤的减重。

conversation.en:
Well, this is most impressive!

Thanks to some powerful tuning, this GT1 Turbo spec is
almost unrecognisable from its base model.

Clearly, the design of the original automobile has been
consumed by an almost violent addition of parts.

Although the S2000 was originally designed to reduce

long-nose proportions possible!

Although there is admittedly room for detailing
and other design elements…

Its oddly charming lack of design makes it quite the
lovable monster.

brandCentral.en:
This tuned Honda S2000 was produced by Powerhouse Amuse,
some of the best Honda tuners in the business!

They turbo-charged the S2000's 2L F20C straight-four engine
and enlarged it to 2.3L—producing <626ps> of power!

The body kit was developed in collaboration with the
developers of Gran Turismo.

Its longer nose and added diffuser make this model as
aerodynamic as any fully-fledged racing car.

You won't know how smooth a ride can be until you take
one of these for a spin!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆经过改装的Honda S2000是由Powerhouse Amuse公司打造的，
他们是业界最好的Honda改装工坊之一！

他们为S2000的2L F20C直列四缸引擎加装了涡轮，并将排量扩
大到2.3L，可产生<626ps>的动力！

车身套件是与跑车浪漫旅的开发者合作开发的。

长车头和额外增加的扩散器使这一车型在空气动力学表
现方面与成熟的赛车不相上下。

等您试驾过这些车之后，才会明白什么叫酣畅淋漓！-

catch.en: Development engineers of Gran Turismo contributed with Amuse to build this ultimate S2000.
catch.zh: 跑车浪漫旅的开发工程师参与了Amuse的终极S2000开发。

vehicleCollection.en:
Development engineers of Gran Turismo contributed with Amuse to build this ultimate S2000.

While Power House Amuse was well known for tuning the S2000, its most refined build was the S2000 GT1. Its body kit was constructed with carbon fiber developed in collaboration with Polyphony Digital. Despite an increase in width to 72.0 inches, the car’s overall weight dropped to around 2469 lbs. Performance was further enhanced with engine upgrades, resulting in a remarkable power-to-weight ratio of just 4 lbs per 1 horsepower.

long.en: While Power House Amuse was well known for tuning the S2000, its most refined build was the S2000 GT1. Its body kit was constructed with carbon fiber developed in collaboration with Polyphony Digital. Despite an increase in width to 72.0 inches, the car’s overall weight dropped to around 2469 lbs. Performance was further enhanced with engine upgrades, resulting in a remarkable power-to-weight ratio of just 4 lbs per 1 horsepower.
long.zh: Power House Amuse以丰富的S2000调校经验而著称，其终极成就便是S2000 GT1。这套碳纤维车身套件是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。尽管车身宽度增加至1,829毫米，但整车的重量降低到大约1,120 公斤。引擎也得到了优化，马力重量比实现了每1 PS仅1.79 公斤。

vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车浪漫旅的开发工程师参与了Amuse的终极S2000开发。

Power House Amuse以丰富的S2000调校经验而著称，其终极成就便是S2000 GT1。这套碳纤维车身套件是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。尽管车身宽度增加至1,829毫米，但整车的重量降低到大约1,120 公斤。引擎也得到了优化，马力重量比实现了每1 PS仅1.79 公斤。

brandCentral.en:
The DB11, successor to the DB9, is Aston Martin's current
flagship model.

Needless to say, design is the buzzword here.

And it's not just beautiful—every line and curve is designed
to be perfectly aerodynamic.

The engine is a newly developed 5.2L V12 twin-turbo.

Capable of 0-<100km/h> in 3.9 seconds, and a top speed of
<322km/h>, this is a serious GT contender.
brandCentral.zh:
DB11是DB9的后继车型，也是Aston Martin目前的旗舰型号。

不用我多说，这辆车的设计就是它的最大亮点：

炫酷车身上的每一根线条、每一条弧度的设计都是为了
实现优异的空气动力学性能而存在的。

车上搭载有一台全新开发的5.2L V12双涡轮增压引擎。

可以在3.9秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，并实现<322km/h>的最高时速。这
是一辆实力非常强劲的GT竞争者。

catch.en: Aston Martin's successor to the DB9 featured a new futuristic design theme.
catch.zh: 阿斯顿·马丁的下一代DB9，外观新颖，未来感十足。

vehicleCollection.en:
Aston Martin's successor to the DB9 featured a new futuristic design theme.

Unveiled at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represented the quintessential Aston Martin. While retaining the brand’s signature silhouette, it distinguished itself from its predecessors with modern design cues. At its heart was a newly developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12 producing 599.6 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, allowing the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of 206.3 mph.

long.en: Unveiled at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represented the quintessential Aston Martin. While retaining the brand’s signature silhouette, it distinguished itself from its predecessors with modern design cues. At its heart was a newly developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12 producing 599.6 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, allowing the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of 206.3 mph.
long.zh: 在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的这台车便是最典型的Aston Martin。在延续品牌标志性轮廓的同时，这台车新颖的现代设计细节与过往车型形成鲜明对比。搭载一台新开发的5.2升V12双涡轮增压引擎，输出可达608 PS/71.0 公斤力米，搭配ZF 8速自动变速箱，DB11能够实现超级跑车级别的速度，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.9秒，最高时速可达332 公里/小时。

conversation.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.

Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

It performed well at Silverstone and many other races.

See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
,
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。

虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。

你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。

collection.en:
I know what you're thinking: a DB3 road car doesn't exist.

The DB2 was followed by the DB2/4, the DB2/4 Mk II,
the Mark III, and then the DB4.

If that's what you're thinking, then you certainly know
your Aston Martins!

There was, however, a DB3 race car.

It was introduced in 1951, and, unfortunately,
saw limited success.

This DB3S is an upgraded version
that was released in 1953.

It's well known as a true masterpiece.

Its beefed-up inline-6 engine powered it to numerous
victories in some of the UK's most famous races.

This particular example, chassis number 1...

...is the car that took home the Gran Turismo Trophy
at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2013.
collection.zh:
我知道您是怎么想的：DB3公路版并不存在。

紧随DB2之后推出的是DB2/4、DB2/4 Mk II、
Mark III，然后是DB4。

如果您这么想，我得承认您确实够了解Aston Martins！

但事实上，曾经有过一辆DB3的赛道版。

该车型于1951年首次亮相，但遗憾地
没有激起太大的反响。

而这台DB3S则是1953年发布的升级版。

它被公认为是真正的杰作！

它由一台强化后的直列六缸引擎提供动力，
在英国最有名的赛事当中屡屡夺魁。

没错，这辆底盘编号为1的DB3S……

正是2013年在圆石滩经典车展捧起Gran Turismo奖杯的那一辆。

catch.en: This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.
catch.zh: 来自1950年的赛车，曾荣获圆石滩车展的Gran Turismo奖项。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.

This car was a staple of the 1950s race scene. Starting with the base DB3, this car underwent extensive modifications, including a shortened wheelbase, reduced body weight, and refined aerodynamics. Its inline-6 engine, which originally produced 224.9 HP, was later tuned to deliver up to 239.6 HP. It was awarded the Gran Turismo Trophy at Pebble Beach in 2013.

collection.en:
The Aston Martin DB5 is truly a rare gem, both in terms
of price and its head-turning allure.

And we all know who's responsible for that, don’t we?

That's right, Bond. James Bond—from the hugely popular
British-born 007 movie series.

The DB5 which appeared in 'Goldfinger' in 1964 was probably
the most famous car in the world at the time.

Aston Martin recently responded to huge public demand for
these 'Bond Edition' DB5s by producing 25 replicas.

These replicas built in late 2020 and 2021 sold for
a huge sum upwards of $3.75M each.

I can't begin to imagine what the original car
would fetch...

Although one of two cars built in 1965 to promote
the film sold for $6.4 million in 2019!
collection.zh:
Aston Martin DB5是真正的极品，无论就价格，还是其无与伦比的
吸引力而言，都是如此。

我们都知道这要归功于谁，不是吗？

没错，就是邦德，詹姆斯·邦德，广受欢迎的英国007电
影主角。

1964年登场于《金手指》电影中的DB5可能是当时全球最知
名的汽车。

最近，为了响应了大众对“邦德版”DB5的巨大需求，
Aston Martin特别生产了25辆复刻版。

这些复刻版制造于2020年底至2021年，每辆都卖出了375万美元的天价。

我实在想象不出，如果是原版车的话，能卖到多少钱！

不过可以参考的是，1965年生产的两台电影推广样车之一
于2019年被卖到了640万美元。

catch.en: This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.

vehicleCollection.en:
This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.

The DB5 was a sports car introduced by Aston Martin in 1963. Designed by Italy’s Carrozzeria Touring, it featured superleggera construction that helped reduce overall weight. The standard model’s engine produced 282 horsepower (281.1 HP), while the Vantage variant delivered 314 horsepower (313.6 HP). It was praised as one of the standout sports cars of the early 1960s. It also gained iconic status as one of the original “Bond cars,” famously appearing in the James Bond 007 film series.

long.en: The DB5 was a sports car introduced by Aston Martin in 1963. Designed by Italy’s Carrozzeria Touring, it featured superleggera construction that helped reduce overall weight. The standard model’s engine produced 282 horsepower (281.1 HP), while the Vantage variant delivered 314 horsepower (313.6 HP). It was praised as one of the standout sports cars of the early 1960s. It also gained iconic status as one of the original “Bond cars,” famously appearing in the James Bond 007 film series.
long.zh: Aston Martin DB5于1963年问世。这台跑车由意大利Carrozzeria Touring设计，采用Superleggera超轻结构技术降低车身重量。标准车型引擎能输出285英制马力（285.9 PS），而Vantage版的动力更是高达314英制马力（318.4 PS）。它被誉为60年代初超级跑车的代表作之一。该车还因多次成为詹姆斯·邦德系列电影中的“邦德座驾”而声名鹊起。

brandCentral.en:
As evidenced by its class win at the 2008 24 Hours of
Le Mans...

The DBR9 GT1 is a true masterpiece of British racing
car design.

It also performed impressively on numerous other occasions
until the GT1 category was discontinued in 2011.

After all these years, the 5.9L V12 engine under the bonnet
is more than capable of delivering the power you need!
brandCentral.zh:
DBR9 GT1在2008年勒芒24小时耐力赛中赢得了该级别的冠军……

足以证明其英国赛车设计真正杰作的身份。

在2011年GT1组别停止举办前，它在各类场合里都有令人印
象深刻的表现。

经过这么多年，引擎盖下的这台5.9L V12引擎仍然能够轻松
提供您所需要的动力！

catch.en: This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.
catch.zh: Aston Martin回归国际赛车运动，带来一辆基于DB9改装的GT1赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.

The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1 was developed by Aston Martin Racing in 2005 for competition in the GT1 category, based on the road-going DB9. Its body was significantly lightened using carbon-fiber construction, and it was powered by a 5.9-liter V-12 engine paired with a 6-speed sequential transmission. The DBR9 made an immediate impact, winning its debut race at the 12 Hours of Sebring. It went on to secure GT1 class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 2007 and 2008.

long.en: The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1 was developed by Aston Martin Racing in 2005 for competition in the GT1 category, based on the road-going DB9. Its body was significantly lightened using carbon-fiber construction, and it was powered by a 5.9-liter V-12 engine paired with a 6-speed sequential transmission. The DBR9 made an immediate impact, winning its debut race at the 12 Hours of Sebring. It went on to secure GT1 class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 2007 and 2008.
long.zh: Aston Martin DBR9 GT1由Aston Martin Racing专为GT1组别打造，以DB9为基础，于2005年投入生产。车身采用碳纤维结构实现轻量化，与之搭配的是一台5.9升V12引擎以及6速序列式变速箱。初战即在赛百灵12小时耐力赛夺冠，并在2007至2008年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛GT1组冠军。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Aston Martin回归国际赛车运动，带来一辆基于DB9改装的GT1赛车。

Aston Martin DBR9 GT1由Aston Martin Racing专为GT1组别打造，以DB9为基础，于2005年投入生产。车身采用碳纤维结构实现轻量化，与之搭配的是一台5.9升V12引擎以及6速序列式变速箱。初战即在赛百灵12小时耐力赛夺冠，并在2007至2008年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛GT1组冠军。

cars.nameEn: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
The Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo is a product of
the Aston Martin design team, led by Marek Reichman.

A mesmerising blend of the brand’s past and future, it is,
as the 'DP' in its name suggest, a 'design prototype'.

Sporting, a midship twin-turbo V12 engine, the DP-100
is capable of delivering up to <811ps>.

The fact that it's one of the few midship cars Aston Martin
has ever produced only adds to its appeal!
brandCentral.sourceName: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo是由
马雷克·莱克曼领导的Aston Martin设计团队的作品，

精妙地融合了品牌的过去和未来。正如其名称中的“DP”
所示，这只是一台“设计原型”……

DP-100采用了中置的双涡轮增压V12引擎，能够提供高达<811ps>的
动力。

作为Aston Martin有史以来的少数几辆中置引擎车型之一，令它
的收藏魅力大增！

catch.en: A glimpse of the ultimate British sports car of the future.
catch.zh: 真正的高性能跑车，让人一窥Aston Martin未来的方向。

vehicleCollection.en:
A glimpse of the ultimate British sports car of the future.

The Vision Gran Turismo model was conceived by Marek Reichman’s design team at Aston Martin. It was developed using the same processes as Aston Martin’s production models, at the company’s Gaydon facility in Warwickshire. Power came from a twin-turbo V-12 producing 800 BHP (799.8 HP). The DP-100 also functioned as a testbed for Aston Martin’s future design language and advanced technologies.

long.en: The Vision Gran Turismo model was conceived by Marek Reichman’s design team at Aston Martin. It was developed using the same processes as Aston Martin’s production models, at the company’s Gaydon facility in Warwickshire. Power came from a twin-turbo V-12 producing 800 BHP (799.8 HP). The DP-100 also functioned as a testbed for Aston Martin’s future design language and advanced technologies.
long.zh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo由Aston Martin的马雷克·瑞克曼带领的设计团队亲手完成。该车在沃里克郡盖登的Aston Martin总部以与量产车相同的流程进行开发。它的动力单元是一台800BHP（811 PS）V12双涡轮增压引擎。DP-100还被用作Aston Martin未来技术和设计的先行探索车型。

brandCentral.en:
This formidable machine may be one of the most exquisite
road cars Aston Martin has ever produced.

Called the One-77, it remains one of the company's
most exclusive models.

It possesses a full carbon-fiber monocoque chassis.

It also has a pushrod suspension system,
usually reserved for race cars.

Under the hood is a naturally-aspirated V-12 engine
that pumps out <760ps>!

As its name suggests, production of the car was limited to
77 units, making it a highly sought collector's item.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆漂亮的车可能是Aston Martin有史以来生产的最精致的公路
车之一！

One-77因其大胆和美丽的比例……

全碳纤维单壳底盘……

以及推杆悬挂等典型的赛车配置而备受车迷的喜爱。

最后还有不能不提的……可产生<760ps>动力的自然进气V12引擎！

One-77仅限量生产77辆，是真正的收藏逸品。[

catch.en: This handsome supercar was limited to 77 units, and could very well be the most desirable British car ever.
catch.zh: Aston Martin仅有77辆的限量版车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This handsome supercar was limited to 77 units, and could very well be the most desirable British car ever.

This was Aston Martin’s new flagship model, unveiled in 2009. Although it shared visual cues with the DB9 and DBS, it was, in fact, a bespoke creation developed almost entirely from the ground up. At its heart lay a 7.3-liter V-12 engine, co-developed with Cosworth, producing 749.5 HP and 549.7 ft-lb of torque, making it the most powerful naturally aspirated engine ever fitted to a production car. Initially priced at £1,200,000 in the UK, all 77 units were spoken for within a year of deliveries commencing in early 2011.

long.en: This was Aston Martin’s new flagship model, unveiled in 2009. Although it shared visual cues with the DB9 and DBS, it was, in fact, a bespoke creation developed almost entirely from the ground up. At its heart lay a 7.3-liter V-12 engine, co-developed with Cosworth, producing 749.5 HP and 549.7 ft-lb of torque, making it the most powerful naturally aspirated engine ever fitted to a production car. Initially priced at £1,200,000 in the UK, all 77 units were spoken for within a year of deliveries commencing in early 2011.
long.zh: 这是Aston Martin在2009年推出的全新旗舰车型。虽然外观上与DB9和DBS非常近似，但其实它是一款从头开始设计的特殊车型。其动力单元采用了一部与Cosworth联合开发的7.3升V12引擎，动力输出达到了760 PS/76.0 公斤力米，是有史以来量产车中性能最强大的自然进气引擎。这款车起初在英国官方公布的售价为120万英镑。但在2011年初开始交车后，全部77台车在一年时间内便被抢购一空。

conversation.en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012, at the British GT Championships.

Now, how do you think it performed
on its home turf?

Well, over 67 races, across seven seasons,
it had a podium finish nearly every time!

And what’s more, in over 30% of its races,
it came in first place!

Needless to say, it will be remembered as a legendary
production racing car in the annals of GT3 history.

Indeed, up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V8-mounted successor...

This incredible car enjoyed a long career at the forefront
of GT racing.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。

你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？

在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。

更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！

毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。

事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……

这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。

catch.en: A well-balanced, high-performance car that immediately became a familiar presence on race podiums.
catch.zh: 平衡性良好的高性能车型，立即就成为了领奖台上的常客。

vehicleCollection.en:
A well-balanced, high-performance car that immediately became a familiar presence on race podiums.

This was a purpose-built racing machine that began competing in GT events in 2012, continuing the proud legacy established by its predecessors, the DBR9 and DBRS9. Based on the V8 Vantage platform, it featured widened fenders and a prominent rear wing, while its weight was reduced to just 2756 lbs. The V-12 engine was tuned to deliver 591.7 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with an XTrac sequential transmission with paddle shifters. The car would go on to deliver exceptional performances at circuits across the globe.

vehicleCollection.en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

The "Baby Aston" was developed with the goal of delivering top-tier performance. This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car first appeared in 2005, powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 engine. In 2008, displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, resulting in improved performance across the board. The Vantage S was a special high-performance variant introduced in 2011. In addition to its uprated engine, it featured a stiffer suspension setup and a quicker steering ratio, delivering a sharper driving experience.

In addition to its uprated engine, it featured a stiffer suspension setup and a quicker steering ratio, delivering a sharper driving experience.

From the moment of its birth, this Aston Martin Valkyrie
was already the stuff of legend.

It is the child of a British sports car brand with over
a century of history and Red Bull Racing.

The aerodynamic elements were penned by one of the greatest
designers in F1 history—Adrian Newey.

But wait till you hear about its 6.5L naturally-aspirated
V12 engine...

Which is capable of outputting 1000ps at <10500rpm>!
It’s an otherworldly engine deserving of an F1 machine.

And yet, believe it or not, this car is street-legal!

It is the greatest sports car currently conceivable by
an F1 partnership made in heaven.
]

brandCentral.en:
Designed like an F1 machine, this road-going car
is certainly deserving of its hypercar status.

It is the result of a technological partnership between
Aston Martin and Red Bull Racing.

Its body features the latest aerodynamic know-how
and weight-reducing materials.

The car's styling was penned by Adrian Newey, a designer
responsible for countless F1 race machines.

The striking exterior is meant to maximize downforce
and harness the air that flows around its body.

Its power unit is unbelievably fierce.

Combining a 6.5-liter V-12 that revs past the 10,000-rpm mark and
an electric motor, it produces a hearty <1155ps>."
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆按照F1赛车思路设计的公路车，
更是一款名副其实的“终极跑车”。

它是由Aston Martin和红牛车队
进行技术合作所诞生的产物。

它的车身运用了最新的空气动力学技术知识
和应用了最新的减重材料。

不出所料的是，这款车是由打造了多款传奇F1车型
的设计师阿德里安·纽维所设计。

其引人注目的外观其实功能兼备，可以最大化下压力
以及利用车身周围流动的空气。

它的动力单元也拥有令人难以置信的凶猛性能。

它结合了一款转速可超过<10000rpm>的6.5升V12引擎
以及一部高性能电机，可以输出<1155ps>的动力。

catch.en: A uniquely shaped hypercar with F1-derived aerodynamics.
catch.zh: 造型独特的、采用F1空气动力学理念的终极跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A uniquely shaped hypercar with F1-derived aerodynamics.

The Valkyrie hypercar was the result of a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Aston Martin. Its front wing was suspended beneath a high-nose front section, while the entire underbody functioned as an aerodynamic tunnel, generating immense downforce. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 paired with a KERS hybrid system. With a total system output of 1139 HP, the Valkyrie delivered performance on par with top-tier racing machines.

long.en: The Valkyrie hypercar was the result of a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Aston Martin. Its front wing was suspended beneath a high-nose front section, while the entire underbody functioned as an aerodynamic tunnel, generating immense downforce. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 paired with a KERS hybrid system. With a total system output of 1139 HP, the Valkyrie delivered performance on par with top-tier racing machines.
long.zh: Valkyrie超级跑车由红牛车队和Aston Martin联合开发。前翼悬挂在高车鼻前部下方，整个车身底板设计成风道结构，可产生巨大下压力。这款车搭载6.5升自然进气V12引擎，配备KERS（动能回收系统）混合动力配置。总系统输出达到1,155 PS，在性能上接近顶级赛车水准。

The Aston Martin Vantage is what British super sports cars
are all about.

This particular version is the fourth-generation model,
introduced in 2017.

The basic formula changed with this model, getting a twin-turbo
V-8 instead of a naturally-aspirated engine.

Power was rated at more than <500ps>,
allowing the car to easily reach <300km/h>.

双涡轮增压引擎。

新引擎可以输出超过<500ps>的动力，并且能够轻松地跑到
<300km/h>的极速。

catch.en: This lightweight cornering machine has been hailed as the finest Aston Martin ever.
catch.zh: 这款轻量化的弯道之王被誉为史上最出色的Aston Martin。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight cornering machine has been hailed as the finest Aston Martin ever.

The Vantage proved to be a success as a performance-focused, rear-wheel-drive sports car. The model introduced in 2017 shared much of its construction with the DB11 V8, but featured a shorter wheelbase and was approximately 265 lbs lighter. These changes earned it widespread acclaim, with many praising it as the best-handling Aston Martin to date. The engine was a Mercedes-AMG–derived twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, capable of reaching a top speed of 195.1 mph (195 mph).

long.en: The Vantage proved to be a success as a performance-focused, rear-wheel-drive sports car. The model introduced in 2017 shared much of its construction with the DB11 V8, but featured a shorter wheelbase and was approximately 265 lbs lighter. These changes earned it widespread acclaim, with many praising it as the best-handling Aston Martin to date. The engine was a Mercedes-AMG–derived twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, capable of reaching a top speed of 195.1 mph (195 mph).
long.zh: Vantage作为高性能后驱跑车取得了巨大成功。2017年推出的车型在结构上与DB11 V8几乎相同，但轴距更短且减重约120 公斤，因此获得好评，被誉为Aston Martin历史上过弯操控最佳的车型。引擎采用源自Mercedes-AMG的4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，最高时速可达195英里（314 公里/小时）。

Under the hood was a sweet-sounding V-8 that was as responsive
as it was powerful, making it a delight to drive on the track.

conversation.en:
This is originally a machine meant for the track,
so it's not street legal.

But the design has not been compromised one bit.

It conveys an expression of violent performance combined
with the classic beauty that defines Aston Martin.

Having these attributes simultaneously gives
this car a Jekyll-and-Hyde design quality.

From a nose that looks like it's about to eat the car ahead
to the low kirts and the underside of the rear diffuser...

A strange power resonates from the tissues and internal
organs that make up this carbon-fiber machine.

They speak plainly about the origins and intent
of this car.

The British-style understatement of the DB sers is
somethi thattranscends eccentricity.

It is the glorious madness that defines today's
Aton Mati.
e

brandCentral.en:
The Vulcan was developed with the aim of breaking down the
barriers between road cars and race-eligible cars.

It boasts a full carbon fibre body on par with the highest
quality racers.

The front-mounted, naturally aspirated 7L V12 engine can
produce an astounding <811ps> of horsepower!

The rear transaxle-mounted gearbox balances the weight of
the engine—ensuring an optimal weight distribution.]
brandCentral.zh:
Vulcan的设计思路旨在打破公路车和赛车之间的界线。

它采用了符合最高品质赛车标准的全碳纤维车身。

前置的自然进气7L V12引擎可以输出惊人的<811ps>马力！

后部的跨轴变速箱刚好平衡了引擎的重量，确保了最优
配重比。

catch.en: With a mere 24 units produced, this hypercar shined on the track and became an instant collector's item.
catch.zh: 这款纯粹的终极跑车总共只生产了24辆，只为主宰赛道而生。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a mere 24 units produced, this hypercar shined on the track and became an instant collector's item.

A special circuit-only model limited to 24 units, this car was developed using the knowledge and experience gained from the One-77 project. Its front mid-mounted 7.0-liter V-12 produced 799.8 HP, delivered through a transaxle for optimal weight distribution. Damping, ABS, and traction control could all be fine-tuned to suit the driver’s preferences. Each fortunate owner received full technical support from Aston Martin, along with access to a dedicated circuit driving program.

Its front mid-mounted 7.0-liter V-12 produced 799.8 HP, delivered through a transaxle for optimal weight distribution. Damping, ABS, and traction control could all be fine-tuned to suit the driver’s preferences. Each fortunate owner received full technical support from Aston Martin, along with access to a dedicated circuit driving program.
long.zh: 这是一款赛道专用的特别版限量车型，总共只生产了24辆，汇聚了One-77项目中积累来的经验。它采用了一台前中置布局的7升V12引擎，动力输出高达811 PS，并通过一套驱动桥式传动系统得到传输。驾驶者还能够按照自己的喜好对减震器、ABS和TCS进行调整。每一名有幸购入它的车主都能够获得Aston Martin的全面技术支持，甚至还能接受专门的赛道驾驶课程。

conversation.en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.

Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!

But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.

People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of poium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.

This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimatey, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Ma the followingʓear.< scmd="GTCafe_Top" />
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
奥迪在1999年首次亮相勒芒。

一直到2016年，奥迪在勒芒原型车1级级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。

事实上，奥迪已经连续18年登上领奖台了！

但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。

大家都觉得奥迪今年登台无望了。

然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的.田出现了机械故障！

这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。

最终，由于奥迪宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录v就此终结。
j

brandCentral.en:
This was the car Audi turned to when it sought to take the
top prize at the 2016 FIA World Endurance Championship.

This particular iteration of the R18 is a hybrid racer.

It features a mid-mounted 4L turbo diesel engine
and high-powered electric motors at the front.

The version we see here was raced by Audi Sport Team Joest.

It achieved second place in the Manufacturers' Championship
in the 2016 season.
brandCentral.zh:
为了在2016年的FIA世界耐力锦标赛冲击冠军，Audi派出了这
辆车参赛。

这辆R18的迭代作品是一辆混动赛车，

使用一台中置4L涡轮增压柴油引擎和前置的高性能电机
驱动。

这台赛车的驾驶者是Audi Sport Team Joest车队。

后者最终在2016赛季的车厂冠军争夺中取得了亚军的好成绩。

catch.en: Audi's history-making LMP1 car dominated the World Endurance Championship in the 2010s.
catch.zh: 具有划时代意义的奥迪LMP1车型，曾在21世纪初的世界耐力锦标赛中称霸赛场。

vehicleCollection.en:
Audi's history-making LMP1 car dominated the World Endurance Championship in the 2010s.

The Audi R18 was engineered to compete in the 2016 World Endurance Championship (WEC). Its aerodynamics underwent a complete redesign, adopting a F1-inspired narrow nose with integrated wing, while the hybrid system’s regenerative energy capacity was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. Although Audi secured 2nd place in the Constructors’ Championship, the brand made the difficult decision to withdraw from the WEC at year’s end.

long.en: The Audi R18 was engineered to compete in the 2016 World Endurance Championship (WEC). Its aerodynamics underwent a complete redesign, adopting a F1-inspired narrow nose with integrated wing, while the hybrid system’s regenerative energy capacity was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. Although Audi secured 2nd place in the Constructors’ Championship, the brand made the difficult decision to withdraw from the WEC at year’s end.
long.zh: Audi R18是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）所开发的车型。它的空气动力学外形得到了全面重塑，改为了F1样式的带前翼长车头，而它的再生动能释放量由4兆焦耳提高到了6兆焦耳。尽管在车厂冠军的争夺中锁定了第二的好成绩，但Audi仍在赛季临近收官时决定从WEC退赛，令人扼腕。

The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a closed-coupe
body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

This, to me, is when design, engineering, and motorsport
came to the perfect intersection for Audi!

Seeing these ‘Star Wars’ coupes in the rain at night,
with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...

Is exciting to watch!

I see them as advanced concepts for the road
that I can relate to.

They are truly a tour de force of technology!

对我来说，这款车是奥迪的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！

在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！

conversation.en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.

Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...

A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.

Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!

Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.

Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.

So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.

But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
看着这辆Audi，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……

只领先了第二名的Peugeot13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。

在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！

虽然Audi在速度上胜过了Peugeot一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。

Peugeot充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。

所以，单圈时间极其优秀的Audi始终没能将Peugeot甩开。

但最终，还是Audi的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。

奥迪再次引入封闭式双门跑车车身。

对我来说，这款车是奥迪的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！

在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！

我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！
O

brandCentral.en:
You're looking at the Audi's prototype race car called
the R18 TDI.

Built in 2011, the R18 TDI was primarily used in endurance
races such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

It was raced by Team Joest, which worked closely with Audi
in many of its race efforts.

Providing the power was a turbocharged 3.7-liter V6
diesel engine that produced <540ps>!

In the Le Mans race in 2011, it famously battled with
Peugeot, where it proved victorious.
brandCentral.zh:
这款车是Audi的原型赛车R18 TDI的2011款车型。

R18 TDI主要被用于参加各项耐力赛，如勒芒24小时耐力赛……

在勒芒比赛中驾驶此车的车队是与Audi紧密合作的乔斯特
车队。

R18 TDI的核心是一台3.7L V6柴油涡轮增压引擎，可以产生<540ps>
的动力！

在2011年的勒芒比赛中，此车在与Peugeot的激烈角逐中最终胜
出，继而名声大噪。$

catch.en: This diesel-powered R18 TDI scored yet another victory for Audi at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2011.
catch.zh: 设计充满先锋精神。2011年勒芒24小时耐力赛的总冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
This diesel-powered R18 TDI scored yet another victory for Audi at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2011.

This prototype race car was developed by Audi. While it shared lineage with the diesel-powered R10 and R15, the R18 was Audi’s first closed-cockpit design since the R8C of 1999. Its engine produced a modest 532.5 HP—less than its recent predecessors—but compensated with aggressive weight reduction and the aerodynamic efficiency afforded by its enclosed bodywork. In 2011, the R18 claimed overall victory at Le Mans.

long.en: This prototype race car was developed by Audi. While it shared lineage with the diesel-powered R10 and R15, the R18 was Audi’s first closed-cockpit design since the R8C of 1999. Its engine produced a modest 532.5 HP—less than its recent predecessors—but compensated with aggressive weight reduction and the aerodynamic efficiency afforded by its enclosed bodywork. In 2011, the R18 claimed overall victory at Le Mans.
long.zh: 这是由Audi开发的一款原型赛车。虽然与采用柴油动力的R10和R15非常类似，但R18的不同之处在于它是Audi自1999年的R8C之后推出的首款封闭式车身。它的引擎与其他最近推出的车型相比动力稍逊，仅有540 PS，但全方位的减重处理和封闭式车身带来的空气动力学优势已足以弥补。2011年，这辆车在勒芒跑出了全胜的优异战绩。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
If you're a fan of racing, then you should be familiar with
the Audi R8, which dominated Le Mans in the early 2000s?

Well, that's where this particular version gets its name!

This first-generation R8 is an absolute must-buy
for supercar lovers.

It's a mid-engine car with a 4.2-liter V-8
that pumps out <420ps>.

In addition to employing Audi's quattro
all-wheel drive technology...

...it was noted for its uniquely lightweight aluminum
body structure called the Audi Space Frame.
brandCentral.zh:
您肯定熟悉Audi R8——那是一辆21世纪初不断在勒芒比赛
中夺冠的冠军车。

嗯，它就是这个车型的名字由来！

这款第一代R8绝对是超跑爱好者的必购之物。

它配备了4.2L V8中置引擎，能够产生<420ps>的动力。

除了采用Audi的quattro全轮驱动技术外……

其独特的轻质铝制车身——Audi空间车架也颇引人注目。[

usedCar.en:
The first-generation Audi R8 is a powerful-yet-highly refined
mid-engine sports car, but you probably knew that already.

Its quattro 4WD system gives it amazing traction and
grip on all kinds of driving surfaces.

Wet roads are nothing to fear when driving this car.

Step on the throttle, and you'll be jolted in the back of your
seat, but once you get to speed, it's surprisingly smooth.

This is indeed the consummate gentleman's sport car.
usedCar.zh:
初代Audi R8是一款中置引擎跑车，
拥有无出其右的操控性。

它搭载的“Quaddro”四驱系统给它带来了出众的
稳定性。

潮湿的路面对于这辆车来说也只是小菜一碟。

这款车灵敏的油门和顺畅的操控性保证了
愉悦的驾驶体验。

这是辆里程碑式的跑车，为超跑操控性
立下了新的标杆。

catch.en: Engineered to the finest detail, this Audi supercar features welds measured in microns.
catch.zh: Aud超跑的焊点据称已达到微米级别，堪称完美无瑕。

vehicleCollection.en:
Engineered to the finest detail, this Audi supercar features welds measured in microns.

Although derived from the "Le Mans quattro" concept, the production version of this sports car took its name from Audi’s R8 race cars, which had earned a solid reputation with dominant performances at Le Mans. Built around Audi’s ultra-lightweight aluminum space frame, the car featured a 4.2-liter V-8 producing 414.2 HP, delivering power to all four wheels via the quattro system, which employed viscous couplings. In 2009, the lineup was expanded with the addition of the 5.2 FSI model, powered by a 5.2-liter V-10 generating 517.7 HP.

long.en: Although derived from the "Le Mans quattro" concept, the production version of this sports car took its name from Audi’s R8 race cars, which had earned a solid reputation with dominant performances at Le Mans. Built around Audi’s ultra-lightweight aluminum space frame, the car featured a 4.2-liter V-8 producing 414.2 HP, delivering power to all four wheels via the quattro system, which employed viscous couplings. In 2009, the lineup was expanded with the addition of the 5.2 FSI model, powered by a 5.2-liter V-10 generating 517.7 HP.
long.zh: 尽管是基于“Le Mans Quattro”概念车开发而来，这辆量产版本跑车在命名时却投向了在勒芒表现亮眼的Audi R8赛车。这款车型使用了Audi的超轻量空间车架技术，装备了一部420 PS的4.2升V8引擎，并通过采用了粘性耦合器的Quattro系统将动力输送到全部四个车轮。2009年，产品线中又增添了5.2 FSI版本，换用了能够输出525 PS动力的5.2升V10引擎。

catch.en: Audi's second-generation sports car based on the Le Mans-conquering R8.
catch.zh: Audi的第二代公路跑车，与勒芒耐力赛冠军车型R8同名。

vehicleCollection.en:
Audi's second-generation sports car based on the Le Mans-conquering R8.

The second-generation model of Audi’s road car, bearing the name of its renowned Le Mans prototype, continued the legacy of performance and innovation. While preserving the silhouette of its predecessor, the new model introduced a revised Audi Space Frame for improved rigidity and reduced weight, alongside an updated quattro all-wheel-drive system. The V10 Plus represented the high-performance model, with its 5.2-liter V-10 engine further refined to deliver an impressive 601.6 HP. It came equipped with a fixed rear wing and a mechanical LSD as standard.

long.en: The second-generation model of Audi’s road car, bearing the name of its renowned Le Mans prototype, continued the legacy of performance and innovation. While preserving the silhouette of its predecessor, the new model introduced a revised Audi Space Frame for improved rigidity and reduced weight, alongside an updated quattro all-wheel-drive system. The V10 Plus represented the high-performance model, with its 5.2-liter V-10 engine further refined to deliver an impressive 601.6 HP. It came equipped with a fixed rear wing and a mechanical LSD as standard.
long.zh: 这是Audi公路跑车的第二代车型，继承了征战勒芒24小时耐力赛的原型赛车的传奇名号。这款新车型延续了前代的设计精髓，同时升级了Audi空间车架结构和"quattro"四驱系统。这款V10 Plus是高性能版本，将5.2升V10引擎的动力进一步调校至610 PS。还配置了固定式尾翼和机械限滑差速器。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Audi的第二代公路跑车，与勒芒耐力赛冠军车型R8同名。
