conversation.en:
This R8-based GT3 machine was unveiled at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2015.

Honestly, who doesn’t know of its
illustrious history?

Why, only two months after its debut, it competed
at the Nürburgring 24-hour race.

This was its first competition, mind you,
and it went straight for the top!

In the end, the Audi R8 LMS managed to clinch
an impressive debut win...

With the BMW Z4 trailing behind it by a mere 40 seconds!
It was a real nail-biter!

And it proved that races are not just won by performance,
but by stability and reliability also.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh: 这台基于R8打造的GT3赛车在2015年3月的 日内瓦车展上首次亮相。 说实话，还有谁没听说过它的辉煌事迹吗？ 在亮相后仅两个月，它就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛。 我提醒一句，这可是它的第一场比赛！它的首秀就直奔 冠军而去！ 不用猜，奥迪R8 LMS最终成功地取得了令人印象深刻的首 场胜利…… 而第二名的BMW Z4落后它足足40秒之多！ 这样的胜利简直令人瞠目结舌！ 这也证明了一点——想要赢下比赛不仅仅要依靠性能， 也要靠稳定性和可靠性。

brandCentral.en:
The Audi R8 LMS was developed in accordance with
FIA GT3 regulations.

This second-generation model made its debut in 2015.

Shortly after its release, it ran in the Nürburgring
24 Hours, where it surprisingly won the race.

The downforce generated by its body, which provided stability
at high speed, was arguably its greatest strength.
brandCentral.zh:

这款第二代车型于2015年初次亮相，

不久之后就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛，并出人意料
地赢得了冠军。

强大的下压力毫无疑问是它的最大优势，为高速赛道的
行驶提供可靠的操控性能。:

catch.en: This updated version of a champion race car won the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race immediately after its debut.
catch.zh: 亮相之后立刻赢得纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的强劲GT3。

vehicleCollection.en:
This updated version of a champion race car won the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race immediately after its debut.

In 2015, the production Audi R8 underwent a full model change, and with it came the debut of the updated R8 LMS, built to FIA GT3 specifications. This new generation brought significant advancements in both safety and aerodynamics, while the transmission and traction control systems were replaced with newly developed, race-focused components. Mere moments after its unveiling, the R8 LMS proved its capabilities by taking overall victory in its debut outing at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

long.en: In 2015, the production Audi R8 underwent a full model change, and with it came the debut of the updated R8 LMS, built to FIA GT3 specifications. This new generation brought significant advancements in both safety and aerodynamics, while the transmission and traction control systems were replaced with newly developed, race-focused components. Mere moments after its unveiling, the R8 LMS proved its capabilities by taking overall victory in its debut outing at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
long.zh: Audi R8量产车型在2015年迎来了全面改款，公司也随之推出了升级版的R8 LMS FIA-GT3规格赛车。除了在安全性和空气动力学性能方面进了重大提升之外，其传动系统和牵引力控制也更换为了最新开发的系统。在公布后不久，R8 LMS就在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，并拿下了全面碾压式的胜利。

There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.

The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!

The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
]

Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...

dialogues.en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.

The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!

The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
]

brandCentral.en:
The R8 LMS is a GT3-class race car.

And the Evo, as you might expect, is an updated model.

It features significant cooling and aerodynamic improvements
over the original 2019 version.

The hood vents are bigger and new air intakes have
been added next to the headlights.

The front/rear weight balance was also tweaked,
improving handling as a result.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆R8 LMS是一辆GT3组别赛车。

顾名思义，名字中的Evo指代它是一款升级版车型。

相比2019车款，它的冷却器性能更好，空气动力学表现也
更出众。

引擎盖上的通风口变得愈发宽大，而且在头灯旁追加了新的进气口。

其前后配重平衡也进行了重新调整，进而优化了操控性能。`

catch.en: This evolved version of Audi's R8 LMS competed in various GT3 events across the globe.
catch.zh: Audi R8 LMS的进化车型，在全球各地接受各种GT3赛事的考验。

vehicleCollection.en:
This evolved version of Audi's R8 LMS competed in various GT3 events across the globe.

This was the evolution model of the R8 LMS. Cooling efficiency and aerodynamic performance saw notable improvements over its predecessor, while the entire drivetrain was upgraded to boost reliability under the demands of endurance racing. Although engine output remained unchanged, a 55 lbs reduction in body weight allowed greater flexibility in weight distribution through ballast adjustment. Making its debut in the autumn of 2018, the car demonstrated its potential with a victory at the Gulf 12 Hours later that year.

long.en: This was the evolution model of the R8 LMS. Cooling efficiency and aerodynamic performance saw notable improvements over its predecessor, while the entire drivetrain was upgraded to boost reliability under the demands of endurance racing. Although engine output remained unchanged, a 55 lbs reduction in body weight allowed greater flexibility in weight distribution through ballast adjustment. Making its debut in the autumn of 2018, the car demonstrated its potential with a victory at the Gulf 12 Hours later that year.
long.zh: R8 LMS的进化版本。相比R8 LMS，散热和空气动力学性能得到改善，整套传动系统也经过升级，以提升赛事可靠性。引擎动力保持不变，但车身减重25 公斤，为添加压舱配重时的重量平衡调校提供了更大灵活性。2018年秋季首次亮相，年底便在海湾12小时耐力赛中夺冠，迅速证明了自身实力。

brandCentral.en:
The Audi RS5 Turbo DTM had an incredible showing at
the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) in 2019.

A regular participant at DTM events, Audi had been
competing with RS5 variants since 2013.

But this 2019-spec Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was quite different from
its predecessors, notably its chassis and engine.

Built to meet the 2019 DTM’s Class 1 regulations...

...it combined a carbon-composite chassis with
a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

The driver of car No. 33 was none other than
René Rast of Audi Sport Team Rosberg.

His impressive seven victories over eighteen races
won him the drivers’ title that season.

Finishing at the top of the team rankings as well, this
double-title car is certainly one for the historyboksű
brandCentral.zh:
奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM在2019年的德国房车大师赛
上奉献了令人惊叹的演出。

作为德国房车大师赛赛事的常客，奥迪自2013年后
便一直派出RS5的不同型号参赛。

不过这辆2019款奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM却与其前代车型
的底盘和引擎截然不同。

这辆车按照2019年德国房车大师赛的“级别1”规格设计……

结合了碳复合材料底盘和一部2升4缸涡轮增压引擎。

然后，执掌这辆“33号”赛车的是别人，
正是奥迪运动Rosberg车队的雷内·拉斯特。

他在当年的18场比赛中拿下了惊人的七胜，
并成功加冕年度车手冠军。

与此同时，车队也以排行榜头名之姿结束了赛季，
将这辆双料I军赛车书写在了赛车运动史上。*

vehicleCollection.en:
A DTM machine with two victories in the Class 1 era.

This was a 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) machine. In line with the series’ engine downsizing rules, the previous 4.0-liter V-8 was replaced with a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4. Remarkably, the new engine produced more power than its predecessor, while also weighing less, with improved weight distribution. In the 2019 season, Audi’s ace driver René Rast captured the championship title, alongside securing the team championship.

conversation.en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.

Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.

Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.

And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.

With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.

But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
conversation.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。

它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。

其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。

它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。

conversation.en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.

It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.

The course measures <20km>, climbing <1440m> to the finish
at <4302m>—higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!

This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.

Based on a WRC mahine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.

But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"

Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!< scmd="GTCafe_Top" />

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。

这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。

这条赛道长达<20km>，海拔始于<1440m>，终于<4302m>——比日本的富士山还要高！

这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。

基于一辆世y拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。

那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？

这个人正是界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！

dialogues.en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.

Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.

Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.

And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.

With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.

But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.zh:
Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。

它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。

其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。

它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。
F

cars.nameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
cars.nameZh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87

collection.en:
The 4WD Sport quattro S1 revolutionized the automotive
industry in the 1980s.

You only have to look at its achievements in the
World Rally Championship for proof of that!

The Sport quattro S1 was developed
for homologation in Group B rallying.

As a result, only 200 were ever built.

But that's not the whole story to this particular
Sport quattro S1.

This is an S1-E2, a further evolved version of the S1.

It won the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1987,
with Walter Röhrl at the wheel.

This victory would prove to be the last hurrah for the
Sport quattro, as Audi pulled out of Group B rallying in 1986.

Without a doubt, this is one of the greatest among greats.
collection.zh:
Audi 4WD Sport quattro S1在1980年代彻底革新了汽车工业。

它在世界拉力锦标赛上的成绩就已经足以证明这一点。

Sport quattro S1是为满足B组别拉力赛事认证规范而进行开发的
原型车，

因此只生产了200辆。

但关于这一台车的故事到这还没结束！

这辆S1-E2实际上是原版S1的改进版本。

在1987年，Walter Röhrl驾驶这台车赢得了派克峰国际爬坡赛。

这也是Sport quattro最后一次赢得冠军。
因为在1986年，Audi就退出了B组别。

毋庸置疑，这款车是传奇中的传奇。

catch.en: The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.
catch.zh: 1987年派克峰国际爬坡赛的冠军，并在同一年创下了当时的赛事纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.

Audi shook the rallying world in 1981 with the debut of its full-time 4-wheel-drive system in the World Rally Championship. This particular variant, a modified version of the Sport quattro S1, was tailored specifically for hill climb competitions, equipped with radical ground effects that pushed the limits of aerodynamics. In 1987, Walter Röhrl piloted this machine to a record-breaking triumph at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.

conversation.en:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is
very close to my heart.

My intent was to be
"absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.

My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with
Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...

...into th belt-line with the fender arches repeating
the motion.

The upper spear-line served to shave
the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that als communicates
"quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!

brandCentral.en:
Even after several generations, the original Audi TT
still manages to look and feel fresh.

It shared its chassis with the Audi A3, although the
wheelbase was shortened by <90mm>.

Its compact nature made it incredibly agile.

Here is the 3.2 quattro, which was added to the lineup
in 2003.

Its smooth 3.2-liter V-6 engine sent <250ps> to
all four wheels.
brandCentral.zh:
即使经历了数代的更迭，原版Audi TT的地位并未受到影响。

TT的底盘来自于Audi A3，但轴距缩短了<90mm>……

从而获得了出类拔萃的操控性能！

这里展示的是2003年加入产品线的3.2 quattro，

其强大的3.2L V6引擎能够提供<250ps>的动力。

usedCar.en:
For those who wanted to drive a sporty German car, but didn't
want a sedan or boxy coupe, Audi created the TT.

The round compact body made it stand out in a crowd,
blending sportiness with elegance.

And when you stepped into its cabin, you were
greeted with a stylish interior.

Under the car's hood was a smooth-revving 3.2-liter V-6
that produced <250ps>.

The torquey engine sent power to either the front wheels
or all four tires via Audi's signature quattro system.

This version is one of the most popular of the first-gen TTs.
usedCar.zh:
初代奥迪TT是奥迪历史上厥功至伟的杰作。

它是奥迪第一款真正的跑车，车厂在它的
研发中倾注了大量的心血。

一言以蔽之，他们研发出的这款双门跑车
是一台绝对的上品...

而奥迪在工艺上的极致追求也在这其中
得到了充分体现。

搭载的3.2L V6 quattro是一款令人
生畏的引擎，能够产生高达<250ps>的马力。

这是初代TT中最受欢迎的版本之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its ground-breaking exterior design, this agile coupe took the sports car world by storm.

The Audi TT was a sports coupe introduced in 1998. The base model came equipped with the same 177.5 HP turbocharged 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 found in the Audi A3 and A4, while higher trims featured more powerful versions of the same powerplant. In 2003, the 3.2 quattro variant joined the lineup, powered by a 3.2-liter V-6 engine producing 246.5 HP. It was paired with Audi’s next-generation two-pedal manual, the DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox), offering lightning-fast gear changes.

long.en: The Audi TT was a sports coupe introduced in 1998. The base model came equipped with the same 177.5 HP turbocharged 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 found in the Audi A3 and A4, while higher trims featured more powerful versions of the same powerplant. In 2003, the 3.2 quattro variant joined the lineup, powered by a 3.2-liter V-6 engine producing 246.5 HP. It was paired with Audi’s next-generation two-pedal manual, the DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox), offering lightning-fast gear changes.
long.zh: Audi TT是1998年发布的运动型轿跑车。基础版搭载与Audi A3和A4相同的180 PS 1.8升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，高级版本则采用同款引擎的高调校版本。2003年，3.2 quattro加入车系，搭载输出250 PS的3.2升V6引擎。匹配新一代双踏板手动“DSG”（直接换挡变速箱）变速箱。

conversation.en:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's
an extremely well-proportioned racecar...

...when compared to the production-based street version.

I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT,
but these are bolder and wider.

The graphics are pure Audi Sport
with the red, gray and silver.

I also like the black wheels brought out
to the maximum track width.

It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!

因为和量产的街车版本相比……

……它更加的“匀称”。

我喜欢这辆车的挡泥板设计，
有点原版TT的味道，不过做得更大也更宽。

红灰银涂装是Audi Sport的官方风格。

漆黑的轮毂我也觉得不错，
而且他们将轮距加宽到了极致，

让整车造型看上去更加坚定和动态。
这台车的设计语言非常大胆，也非常引人注目！

brandCentral.en:
This race car, based on the third-generation Audi TT, was
designed to compete in a one-make race.

Called Audi Sport TT Cup, it began as a support series for
the German Touring Car Masters in 2015.

As for the car, it was a bit different from the road car,
thanks to a few improvements.

For example, while the engine was the same turbocharged inline-4
as the TTS, it came with more power, rated at <300ps>.

It also featured a large adjustable rear wing.~
brandCentral.zh:

catch.en: These TTs were produced specifically for the "Audi Sport TT Cup" one-make race.
catch.zh: 这些TT跑车是专为“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的。

vehicleCollection.en:
These TTs were produced specifically for the "Audi Sport TT Cup" one-make race.

This racing machine was based on the Audi TT and developed specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup one-make series. Sections of the body shell were replaced with carbon fiber, and all driver comforts were stripped away, reducing the car’s weight to just 2480 lbs. It was powered by a 305.7 HP 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, the same unit found in the standard TTS, but enhanced with a "push to pass" system that temporarily boosted output by an additional 29.6 HP.

long.en: This racing machine was based on the Audi TT and developed specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup one-make series. Sections of the body shell were replaced with carbon fiber, and all driver comforts were stripped away, reducing the car’s weight to just 2480 lbs. It was powered by a 305.7 HP 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, the same unit found in the standard TTS, but enhanced with a "push to pass" system that temporarily boosted output by an additional 29.6 HP.
long.zh: 这是一款基于Audi TT，专为参加“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的赛车。其车身材料部分换用了碳纤维，所有的舒适性内饰也都被拆除，从而将车重降低到了1,125 公斤。其动力系统与常规版本的TTS相同，采用了一部310 PS的2升4缸引擎，但加入了一个“按键超车”功能，可以让其在短时间内将动力输出再提升30 PS。

brandCentral.en:
Making its debut with the second-gen Audi TT, the TTS is the
sportiest model in the TT lineup.

The "S" stands for "Sport," a letter placed on the company's
highest performing cars.

The TTS was the first "S" model in the TT’s long
and storied history.

The turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder delivers <70ps> more
power than the base model.

And the suspension and steering settings
are totally unique.

As for the drive system, well, it’s what Audi is known for:
quattro all-wheel drive!
brandCentral.zh:
TTS作为第二代Audi TT首次亮相，
是该系列中最运动的一款车型。

S车型向来是Audi旗下最佳性能车款的代名词，
其中的“S”代表“跑车”。

TTS是TT悠久而丰硕的历史中的第一款S车型。

其2L 4缸涡轮引擎的出力比基础车型高出<70ps>。

悬挂和转向设置也是完全独立设计的。

至于驱动系统——当然是Audi的看家产品：
quattro全轮驱动！

usedCar.en:
The Audi TT is a well-known model that proved to be
a hit from the get-go.

This second-gen TTS is the "sports" variant,
an absolute fan favorite!

A stylish 4WD sports coupe, its turbocharged 2.0-liter engine
really packs a punch!
usedCar.zh:
Audi TT是一款从初代便一举成名的热门车型。

这辆第二代TTS“跑车”车型也非常有人气！

身为一辆时尚的4轮驱动双门跑车，2L涡轮引擎的
出力绝对让人喜出望外！

catch.en: A high-performance model, aggressively evolved from the TT.
catch.zh: 代表更高性能的车型，相比师出同门的TT，性能突飞猛进。

vehicleCollection.en:
A high-performance model, aggressively evolved from the TT.

The TTS was the high-performance variant of the TT series, introduced in 2008. Its powertrain featured a 2.0-liter direct-injection turbocharged engine paired with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed S-Tronic transmission. The engine block, pistons, and connecting rods were uniquely developed for the TTS, and the turbocharger was upgraded to handle the increased output. Power was delivered through Audi’s proprietary full-time 4-wheel-drive system, enabling a zero-62.1 mph acceleration time of 5.2 seconds with the S-Tronic model, and 5.4 seconds with the manual.

long.en: The TTS was the high-performance variant of the TT series, introduced in 2008. Its powertrain featured a 2.0-liter direct-injection turbocharged engine paired with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed S-Tronic transmission. The engine block, pistons, and connecting rods were uniquely developed for the TTS, and the turbocharger was upgraded to handle the increased output. Power was delivered through Audi’s proprietary full-time 4-wheel-drive system, enabling a zero-62.1 mph acceleration time of 5.2 seconds with the S-Tronic model, and 5.4 seconds with the manual.
long.zh: TTS是2008年首次亮相的TT系列中的高性能版本。动力系统采用2升直喷涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动或6速S-Tronic变速箱。引擎缸体、活塞和连杆均为TTS专用设计，涡轮增压器也经过升级以承受更大动力输出。传动系统采用Audi专有的全时四驱系统，S-Tronic版本0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.2秒，手动版本为5.4秒。

vehicleCollection.zh:
代表更高性能的车型，相比师出同门的TT，性能突飞猛进。

brandCentral.en:
The third generation TT sports model—designated TTS—
is a rock-solid four-wheel drive sports car.

In addition to being <50kg> lighter than its base model...

It features a quattro 4WD system that is both stable
and incredibly responsive...

As well as a specialised sports suspension.<
brandCentral.zh:
编号为TTS的第三代TT跑车车型是一款稳如磐石的四轮驱
动跑车。

除了比基础车型减重<50kg>之外……

它还搭载了一套稳定性与响应度双佳的quattro四轮驱动系统……

以及特制的跑车型悬挂。

catch.en: With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.
catch.zh: 简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.

The third-generation TT made its debut in 2014. While it retained the core design philosophy of its predecessors, it adopted a more aggressive look, highlighted by a larger single-frame grille and headlights inspired by the R8. At the top of the range sat the TTS, the flagship sports variant, equipped with a 2.0 TFSI turbocharged 4-cylinder engine tuned to produce 309.7 HP and 274.9 ft-lb of torque in the German domestic model. Paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and Audi’s quattro all-wheel-drive system, it delivered a truly exhilarating driving experience.

long.en: The third-generation TT made its debut in 2014. While it retained the core design philosophy of its predecessors, it adopted a more aggressive look, highlighted by a larger single-frame grille and headlights inspired by the R8. At the top of the range sat the TTS, the flagship sports variant, equipped with a 2.0 TFSI turbocharged 4-cylinder engine tuned to produce 309.7 HP and 274.9 ft-lb of torque in the German domestic model. Paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and Audi’s quattro all-wheel-drive system, it delivered a truly exhilarating driving experience.
long.zh: 第三代TT于2014年公布。尽管其整体设计概念与前两代并无不同，但这款新车的外观采用了更大尺寸的单体框架格栅和R8风格的头灯，呈现出更凶猛的面貌。TTS是整个产品线中最高档的跑车型号，配备了一部4缸涡轮增压2.0 TFSI引擎，而德国本土型号还进行了精细调校，将动力输出提升到了314 PS/38.0 公斤力米。再加上连接到Quattro系统的6速手动变速箱，提供令人不可置信的驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.zh:
简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

brandCentral.en:
Audi was the first auto manufacturer to race a hybrid
at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The cutting-edge technology of that revolutionary machine
was implemented on the Audi Vision Gran Turismo.

A rear-mounted turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 teams with electric
motors that power the front wheels.

Combined, the total output is rated at an astounding <1295ps>.

With that much power on tap, it'll not just keep up with LMP1
race cars, it might just leave them in the dust. m
brandCentral.zh:
Audi是第一家使用混动车型参加勒芒比赛的制造商。

他们为此赛事专门开发的技术在Audi Vision Gran Turismo
身上得到了充分的彰显。

它的后置3.4L V6涡轮增压引擎可以与电机完美配合，为前
轮提供驱动力。

引擎和电机总共可以输出让人望而生畏的<1295ps>动力。

这套组合的实力足可以与任何LMP1赛车匹敌。

catch.en: Taking cues from its IMSA race cars, this Vision Gran Turismo machine represents the future of Audi.
catch.zh: 这辆Vision Gran Turismo继承了IMSA赛事车辆的精髓，代表着奥迪的未来。

vehicleCollection.en:
Taking cues from its IMSA race cars, this Vision Gran Turismo machine represents the future of Audi.

A Vision Gran Turismo model was developed by Audi Design. Two versions were conceived: one hybrid, the other fully electric. In the hybrid, a turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 drove the rear wheels, while the front wheels were powered by an electric motor/generator unit, together delivering an impressive 950kW (1274.2 HP). The design of the car paid tribute to the iconic Audi 90 IMSA GTO race machine.

long.en: A Vision Gran Turismo model was developed by Audi Design. Two versions were conceived: one hybrid, the other fully electric. In the hybrid, a turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 drove the rear wheels, while the front wheels were powered by an electric motor/generator unit, together delivering an impressive 950kW (1274.2 HP). The design of the car paid tribute to the iconic Audi 90 IMSA GTO race machine.
long.zh: Audi Design打造的一台Vision Gran Turismo。设计师设想了两个版本：混合动力版和纯电动版。混合动力版本中，后轮由3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎驱动，而前轮则连接到动能电机上，两者结合可产生惊人的950千瓦（1,292 PS）。这台车的外观来自于经典的Audi 90 IMSA GTO赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo继承了IMSA赛事车辆的精髓，代表着奥迪的未来。

Audi Design打造的一台Vision Gran Turismo。设计师设想了两个版本：混合动力版和纯电动版。混合动力版本中，后轮由3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎驱动，而前轮则连接到动能电机上，两者结合可产生惊人的950千瓦（1,292 PS）。这台车的外观来自于经典的Audi 90 IMSA GTO赛车。

brandCentral.en:
The Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo is a fully electric
version of the original Audi VGT.

Its unique styling is the work of Audi Design, the company's
in-house design department.

The body graphics are inspired by those from the classic
Audi 90 IMSA GTO.

With one motor at the front axle and two at the rear,
it was AWD with a total power output of <815ps>.

The Audi race team loved this design study so much, they even
went as far as to build one in real life!%
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo是Audi VGT的纯电动版本。

它那独特的外观设计来自公司内部设计团队Audi Design。

其车身图案的灵感来源于经典的Audi 90 IMSA GTO。

这辆车在前轴安装有一台电机，后轴另有两台，总功率
输出可以达到<815ps>。

因为对这台车爱不释手，Audi的赛车部门甚至在现实里将
这辆车制造了出来。

catch.en: This Vision Gran Turismo is a thrilling embodiment of Audi's electric mobility initiative.
catch.zh: 这辆Vision Gran Turismo完美呈现了奥迪在电动汽车领域的创新性。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo is a thrilling embodiment of Audi's electric mobility initiative.

Audi Design created an all-electric Vision Gran Turismo concept. Throughout its body, design cues from the legendary 90 IMSA GTO are prominently featured. The vehicle employed a 4-wheel-drive layout powered by three electric motors—one at the front and two at the rear—delivering a total system output of 600kW (803.7 HP). Audi Sport developed a fully functional e-tron prototype, which went on to demonstrate its formidable performance at tracks worldwide.

long.en: Audi Design created an all-electric Vision Gran Turismo concept. Throughout its body, design cues from the legendary 90 IMSA GTO are prominently featured. The vehicle employed a 4-wheel-drive layout powered by three electric motors—one at the front and two at the rear—delivering a total system output of 600kW (803.7 HP). Audi Sport developed a fully functional e-tron prototype, which went on to demonstrate its formidable performance at tracks worldwide.
long.zh: Audi Design设计的电动Vision Gran Turismo。纵观全车，到处都能找到Audi赛道传奇90 IMSA GTO的元素。该车的四轮驱动系统由3台电机驱动，1台在前，2台在后，系统总功率输出为600千瓦（815 PS）。Audi Sport打造的一台功能齐全的e-tron，它将在世界各地的赛道上大显身手。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo完美呈现了奥迪在电动汽车领域的创新性。

Audi Design设计的电动Vision Gran Turismo。纵观全车，到处都能找到Audi赛道传奇90 IMSA GTO的元素。该车的四轮驱动系统由3台电机驱动，1台在前，2台在后，系统总功率输出为600千瓦（815 PS）。Audi Sport打造的一台功能齐全的e-tron，它将在世界各地的赛道上大显身手。

usedCar.en:
The A112 Abarth may be small, but it has a proven
reputation as being one exciting car to drive.

What everyone loves about it is the feel of its engine.

You might think at first that the OHV 4-cylinder is a bit tame.

But once you get behind the wheel, you'll be impressed.

The final model pumped out <70ps>, which is quite adequate
when you consider the car weighs only <700kg>.

It just goes to show that the Italians are capable of producing
fun compacts and not just glorious high-priced exotics. 6
usedCar.zh:
A112 Abarth可能比较娇小，
但以驾驶体验刺激而闻名。

尤其是引擎感经常受到表扬。

以顶置阀门四缸引擎车来说，
可能设计上有些复古。

但性能却是无可匹敌。

最终车型具备高达<70ps>的马力，这对
一辆重量只有<700kg>的车来说完全足够。

绝对是意大利汽车工艺的优秀典范。

catch.en: The original hot hatch, with excellent power and agile handling, paved the way for a new genre.
catch.zh: 这款以高动力操控性而著称的车型是所有小钢炮的先驱。

vehicleCollection.en:
The original hot hatch, with excellent power and agile handling, paved the way for a new genre.

The A112 Abarth, introduced in 1971, was widely regarded as one of the original hot hatches. Based on the Autobianchi A112, the car was tuned by Abarth. Continuously refined throughout its production run, the car's engine displacement was increased in 1975, raising output to 70 HP, and in 1979, a 5-speed transmission was added. Although production ended in 1985, the A112 Abarth maintained a loyal following among enthusiasts drawn to its lively character.

long.en: The A112 Abarth, introduced in 1971, was widely regarded as one of the original hot hatches. Based on the Autobianchi A112, the car was tuned by Abarth. Continuously refined throughout its production run, the car's engine displacement was increased in 1975, raising output to 70 HP, and in 1979, a 5-speed transmission was added. Although production ended in 1985, the A112 Abarth maintained a loyal following among enthusiasts drawn to its lively character.
long.zh: 1971年问世的A112 Abarth通常被视为最初的高性能掀背车之一。该车基于Autobianchi A112打造，并经Abarth之手调校。此后历经多次升级，1975年引擎排量增大，动力提升至71 PS，1979年更换为5速变速箱。虽然该车在1985年停产，但其凭借充满激情的驾驶特性赢得了车迷们的长久喜爱。

采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，

这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。

严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈y在眼前。

以车身为例，

车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。

它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。

它配备了推杆式前悬挂震……

而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。

brandCentral.en:
BAC is a newcomer to the sports car manufacturing scene, but
this British car maker has already developed a following.

The car that shot it to prominence was the single-seat Mono,
which has the look of a race car, but was totally street-legal.

It came powered by a naturally-aspirated 2.3-liter inline-4
that produced about <300ps>.

With a curb weight of only <580kg>, it had the power-to-weight
ratio that was comparable to a formula racer.

In fact, the lucky people who've driven say it
it feels like an F3 car!
brandCentral.zh:
BAC是跑车制造领域中的新人，不过这家英国车厂已经在
全世界范围内聚拢了大量粉丝。

这辆单座的Mono是一部无比杰出的机器，帮助这家车厂进
一步巩固了他们的地位。

是的，它看上去仿佛是专为比赛所设计的，但出人意料
的是，它完全符合道路行驶的法规。

它结合了<580kg>的极低重量和<300ps>的超强动力输出。

懂行的人都说，它的驾驶感受非常类似Formula 3赛车！

catch.en: Simple yet effective, this single-seat sports car is reminiscent of formula cars from a bygone era.
catch.zh: 这款单座跑车在简洁中蕴藏着吸引力，让人想起上一个时代的方程式赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Simple yet effective, this single-seat sports car is reminiscent of formula cars from a bygone era.

Built by Britain’s Briggs Automotive Company, this car was designed to deliver “the most authentic and pure driving experience” on the road. Its single-seat layout is built around a tubular chassis wrapped in a carbon-fiber shell, and it’s powered by a Cosworth-tuned 2.5-liter Ford Duratec engine. Weighing just 1279 lbs, the car rockets from 0-60 mph in a blistering 2.8 seconds, and reaches a top speed of 170.3 mph—performance figures on par with a Formula 3 car.

long.en: Built by Britain’s Briggs Automotive Company, this car was designed to deliver “the most authentic and pure driving experience” on the road. Its single-seat layout is built around a tubular chassis wrapped in a carbon-fiber shell, and it’s powered by a Cosworth-tuned 2.5-liter Ford Duratec engine. Weighing just 1279 lbs, the car rockets from 0-60 mph in a blistering 2.8 seconds, and reaches a top speed of 170.3 mph—performance figures on par with a Formula 3 car.
long.zh: 这款车型由英国Briggs Automotive Company打造，目标是创造“提供最纯正驾驶体验的公路车辆”。单座底盘采用管状框架配碳纤维车身，搭载经Cosworth调校的2.5升Ford Duratec引擎。车重仅580 公斤，达到了极致轻量化。0-60英里/小时加速仅需2.8秒，最高时速274 公里/小时，性能足以媲美F3赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款单座跑车在简洁中蕴藏着吸引力，让人想起上一个时代的方程式赛车。

这款车型由英国Briggs Automotive Company打造，目标是创造“提供最纯正驾驶体验的公路车辆”。单座底盘采用管状框架配碳纤维车身，搭载经Cosworth调校的2.5升Ford Duratec引擎。车重仅580 公斤，达到了极致轻量化。0-60英里/小时加速仅需2.8秒，最高时速274 公里/小时，性能足以媲美F3赛车。

usedCar.en:
Also known as the E9, this fabulous BMW coupe was introduced
in the 1960s.

This CSL version was based on the 3.0 CS. And as the letter "L"
suggests, it was lighter, by <200kg>.

The change was made to homologate the car for
the European Touring Championship.

While it might not look all that different from a 3.0 CS at
first glance, the doors and hood are actually aluminum.{
usedCar.zh:
这款神话般的宝马库佩也被称为E9，
于1960年代首度亮相。

这辆轻量化运动轿跑衍生版基于3.0 CS，
但是比它还轻<200kg>。

这对于欧洲房车锦标赛的赛事认证
来说是必需品质。

一眼看去可能在外形上和3.0 CS没有
差异，但车门和引擎盖实际上是铝制的。

catch.en: This lightweight model of the 3.0 CS was stripped of all creature comforts to maximize performance.
catch.zh: 3.0 CS运动型轿跑车的轻量化版本，去除了所有多余的配置，以最大限度地提高赛道性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight model of the 3.0 CS was stripped of all creature comforts to maximize performance.

In 1968, BMW introduced the 2800 CS sports coupe, powered by a robust 2.8-liter inline-6 engine. By 1971, the 3.0 CS arrived, an updated version with a larger engine. To compete in motorsport, BMW created a lightweight homologation model based on the 3.0 CS, naming it the 3.0 CSL. The "L" in CSL stood for “light,” reflecting the car’s reduced weight for racing.

long.en: In 1968, BMW introduced the 2800 CS sports coupe, powered by a robust 2.8-liter inline-6 engine. By 1971, the 3.0 CS arrived, an updated version with a larger engine. To compete in motorsport, BMW created a lightweight homologation model based on the 3.0 CS, naming it the 3.0 CSL. The "L" in CSL stood for “light,” reflecting the car’s reduced weight for racing.
long.zh: BMW在1968年推出搭载了强劲2.8升直列6缸引擎的2800 CS双门运动轿跑。而后在1971年发布排量更大的升级版3.0 CS。为满足赛事认证需求，BMW开发出轻量车型3.0 CSL。名称中的“L”代表“轻量”。

vehicleCollection.zh:
3.0 CS运动型轿跑车的轻量化版本，去除了所有多余的配置，以最大限度地提高赛道性能。

BMW在1968年推出搭载了强劲2.8升直列6缸引擎的2800 CS双门运动轿跑。而后在1971年发布排量更大的升级版3.0 CS。为满足赛事认证需求，BMW开发出轻量车型3.0 CSL。名称中的“L”代表“轻量”。

usedCar.en:
This magnificent BMW continued the company's long tradition
as a great maker of fantastic race cars.

Based on the 3.0 CS, the CSL was significantly lighter.

So you can probably guess what that extra letter stands for, right?

Yep, the "L" stands for "light," or "leicht" as they say in German.

This later version features a powerful 3.2-liter engine,
with wider fenders and a large wing.

The prominent aerodynamic parts made an impact on the car's
appearance, prompting some to call it the "Batmobile."`
usedCar.zh:
这辆华丽的BMW把公司的形象定位为
高级赛车车厂。

这款基于3.0 CS的车型非常轻盈。

L的名号即为了强调这个事实。

实际上，L确实是表示“轻量型”。

之后的版本搭载了强大的3.2L引擎、宽阔
的挡泥板和庞大的尾翼。

出色的空气动力学零部件赋予了它
“蝙蝠战车”的名号。

catch.en: This lightweight model of the BMW 3.0 CS was developed to compete in touring car racing.
catch.zh: 这款3.0 CS的轻量级车型是为了参加房车赛而开发的。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight model of the BMW 3.0 CS was developed to compete in touring car racing.

Unveiled in 1971, the 3.0 CSL served as the homologation version of the BMW 3.0 CS, featuring a powerful 3.0-liter inline-6 engine. Engine displacement grew from 2985 cc to 3003 cc in 1972, and to 3155 cc in 1973 for the evolution models, which achieved remarkable success on the European touring car stage.

long.en: Unveiled in 1971, the 3.0 CSL served as the homologation version of the BMW 3.0 CS, featuring a powerful 3.0-liter inline-6 engine. Engine displacement grew from 2985 cc to 3003 cc in 1972, and to 3155 cc in 1973 for the evolution models, which achieved remarkable success on the European touring car stage.
long.zh: 3.0 CSL于1971年作为BMW 3.0 CS（一台搭载强大的3升直列6缸引擎的双门运动轿跑）的赛事认证车型推出。这台车的引擎排量在1972年从2,985 立方厘米增至3,003 立方厘米，并在1973年的升级车型上再次扩容至3,155 立方厘米，随后在欧洲房车赛场上取得了惊人成功。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款3.0 CS的轻量级车型是为了参加房车赛而开发的。

3.0 CSL于1971年作为BMW 3.0 CS（一台搭载强大的3升直列6缸引擎的双门运动轿跑）的赛事认证车型推出。这台车的引擎排量在1972年从2,985 立方厘米增至3,003 立方厘米，并在1973年的升级车型上再次扩容至3,155 立方厘米，随后在欧洲房车赛场上取得了惊人成功。

brandCentral.en:
Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) regulations were introduced in 2023
to reduce racing costs for sports car prototypes.

BMW responded by introducing the M Hybrid V8, a successor
to the V12 LMR that won Le Mans in 1999.

It has the wide kidney-shaped grilles of a BMW road car, but
the laser-lit headlight outlines feel pretty futuristic.

BMW chose a chassis built by Dallara, with a 4-litre V8 twin
turbo engine, based on one used in the DTM.

The M Hybrid V8 debuted at the IMSA Championship in 2023,
and the World Endurance Championships the following year.

In 2025 it secured a 1-2 finish at the eighth IMSA race and
second place at Imola, in the World Endurance Championships.

It has also served as the base for BMW art cars, but there's
a lt or to come from it on the track!
brandCentral.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）规则于2023年引入，
旨在降低原型跑车的赛事成本。

根据该规则，BMW推出了M Hybrid V8，期望它
能成为1999年勒芒冠军车型V12 LMR的继任者。

宽大的双肾形格栅赋予了它BMW公路车的神韵，
而激光光纤照明技术勾勒的头灯轮廓则充满未来感。

BMW选择了Dallara制造的底盘，并配备了一台
4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，基于DTM赛事所使用的动力单元。

M Hybrid V8于2023年在IMSA锦标赛中首次亮相，
次年便征战世界耐力锦标赛。

2025年，M Hybrid V8在赛季第八场IMSA比赛中包揽冠亚军，
并在世界耐力锦标赛第二站伊莫拉站中夺得第二名。

它还被选为了BMRD车项目的创作载体。
不n，它在赛道上的传奇才刚b~开始Y

catch.en: A new category sports prototype that carries the lineage of the celebrated V12 LMR.
catch.zh: 参与全新组别的原型跑车，继承传奇车型V12 LMR血脉。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new category sports prototype that carries the lineage of the celebrated V12 LMR.

This cutting-edge Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) prototype used a Dallara-built carbon-fiber monocoque and a hybrid system built around the DTM-derived P66/3, a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine. During the 2025 season, the car competed in both the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship and the FIA World Endurance Championship, highlighted by a 1-2 finish at Road America in the eighth round of IMSA In the WEC, it also showed strong pace at rounds such as Imola, proving itself at the highest level of endurance racing.

long.en: This cutting-edge Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) prototype used a Dallara-built carbon-fiber monocoque and a hybrid system built around the DTM-derived P66/3, a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine. During the 2025 season, the car competed in both the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship and the FIA World Endurance Championship, highlighted by a 1-2 finish at Road America in the eighth round of IMSA In the WEC, it also showed strong pace at rounds such as Imola, proving itself at the highest level of endurance racing.
long.zh: 这款前沿的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）原型车，采用了Dallara制造的碳纤维单体车身，并搭载混合动力系统，整合源自DTM的“P66/3”4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。该车在2025赛季参加了IMSA跑车锦标赛和国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛，并在IMSA第八轮美国之路站的比赛中，以精彩的表现包揽了冠亚军。在世界耐力锦标赛中，这款车在伊莫拉等分站赛上同样表现出色，驰骋于耐力赛事的巅峰舞台。

vehicleCollection.zh:
参与全新组别的原型跑车，继承传奇车型V12 LMR血脉。

这款前沿的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）原型车，采用了Dallara制造的碳纤维单体车身，并搭载混合动力系统，整合源自DTM的“P66/3”4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。该车在2025赛季参加了IMSA跑车锦标赛和国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛，并在IMSA第八轮美国之路站的比赛中，以精彩的表现包揽了冠亚军。在世界耐力锦标赛中，这款车在伊莫拉等分站赛上同样表现出色，驰骋于耐力赛事的巅峰舞台。

brandCentral.en:
This is the M2 Competition, an upgraded variant of the
compact, powerful rear-wheel drive M2.

BMW's M models are considered very special by racing
fans all over the world.

This is because they're developed by BMW M, BMW's dedicated
motorsport subsidiary.

Their cars trace their ancestry back to legendary sports
cars of the 1970s, such as the BMW 3.0 CSL and BMW M1.

The M2 Competition features a straight-six twin turbo S55B
engine, developed by BMW M.

The car's cooling systems, brakes and body rigidity are
also a step up on the base M2.

Of all the M2 series retail models, this is the one that'll
provide the best experience on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一台M2 Competition，是基于动力强劲的
紧凑型后驱车M2升级而来的改款车型。

BMW的M系列在全世界车迷的心目中有着十分特别的地位。

因为它们都是由BMW专门从事
赛车运动的子公司BMW M公司所开发的。

他们所制造的赛车的血统可以追溯到二十世纪七十年代的
传奇赛车身上，例如BMW 3.0 CSL和BMW M1。

M2 Competition采用由BMW M开发的直列六缸双涡轮增压S55B引擎。

此车的冷却系统、刹车和车身刚度
也是基于原版M2升级而来。

在所有M2系列零售车型中，这一款在赛道上的体验是最出色的。

catch.en: A hardboiled FR that hides the power of a demon in its compact body.
catch.zh: 一辆在紧凑车身下隐藏着恶魔般动力的彪悍前置后驱车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hardboiled FR that hides the power of a demon in its compact body.

This ferocious beast housed the S55 twin-turbo 3.0-liter inline-6 from the M3 and M4 within the compact body of the 2 Series coupe. Its flared fenders hinted at the performance lurking beneath, and a brief press of the throttle was all it took to unleash the full force as the turbochargers came alive. The suspension incorporated aluminum components to reduce unsprung weight. Meanwhile, the torque-vectoring Active M Differential allowed it to tackle any corner with confidence and precision.

long.en: This ferocious beast housed the S55 twin-turbo 3.0-liter inline-6 from the M3 and M4 within the compact body of the 2 Series coupe. Its flared fenders hinted at the performance lurking beneath, and a brief press of the throttle was all it took to unleash the full force as the turbochargers came alive. The suspension incorporated aluminum components to reduce unsprung weight. Meanwhile, the torque-vectoring Active M Differential allowed it to tackle any corner with confidence and precision.
long.zh: 这台性能猛兽将来自M3/M4的S55 3升直列六缸双涡轮引擎移植到2系双门轿跑的紧凑车身中。外扩的轮拱暗示着澎湃的内在动力，只需短暂加速，涡轮增压器即可完全释放这股狂暴力量。悬挂系统采用铝合金部件，有效降低簧下质量。扭矩矢量分配主动M差速器让这台车能够游刃有余地应对各种弯道挑战。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆在紧凑车身下隐藏着恶魔般动力的彪悍前置后驱车。

这台性能猛兽将来自M3/M4的S55 3升直列六缸双涡轮引擎移植到2系双门轿跑的紧凑车身中。外扩的轮拱暗示着澎湃的内在动力，只需短暂加速，涡轮增压器即可完全释放这股狂暴力量。悬挂系统采用铝合金部件，有效降低簧下质量。扭矩矢量分配主动M差速器让这台车能够游刃有余地应对各种弯道挑战。

usedCar.en:
The BMW M3 has represented the ultimate sports sedan/coupe
in the marketplace since it was created in 1989.

This car here started it all, the first-gen M3 dubbed the E30.

BMW's motorsports division fine-tuned every inch of this car—
engine, suspension, body—to make it perform better.

This homologation model was born out of a desire to triumph
in Gr.A category racing.

Though its design might seem simple, you'll realize its
potent nature once you get behind the steering wheel.
usedCar.zh:
毫无疑问，BMW M3被认为是世界上最好的
RWD跑车之一。

这款车型是第一代E30 M3。

室内赛车专家BMW M精细调整了每个细节：
引擎、悬挂系统和车身，同时也没有忘记性能。

这款赛事认证车型的诞生就是为了在
Gr.A类赛车中取得胜利。

虽然设计看上去比较简单，挑剃的爱车人士
却可以立即识别而出，也喜欢它带来的感受。

catch.en: A virtual race car for the street, this homologation model once claimed victory in the DTM.

vehicleCollection.en:
A virtual race car for the street, this homologation model once claimed victory in the DTM.

This homologation model was developed from the 3 Series platform of its time, specifically to compete in touring car racing. Built on the 2-door sedan, it featured a widened track and aerodynamic enhancements, including an adjustable rear wing to improve performance. It initially came with a 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 engine, with continuous yearly refinements leading to the 2.5-liter Sport Evolution model.

long.en: This homologation model was developed from the 3 Series platform of its time, specifically to compete in touring car racing. Built on the 2-door sedan, it featured a widened track and aerodynamic enhancements, including an adjustable rear wing to improve performance. It initially came with a 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 engine, with continuous yearly refinements leading to the 2.5-liter Sport Evolution model.
long.zh: 这款符合赛事认证要求的车型基于当时的3系开发，专为征战房车锦标赛而生。以双门轿车为基础，加宽轮距并进行空气动力学优化，包括精心调整尾翼的开启角度。最初搭载2.3升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，经过逐年改进升级，最终推出了2.5升“Sport Evolution”终极版本。

usedCar.en:
Whether you're looking to cruise around town or refine your track
skills, the M3 E36 was the ideal car for driving enthusiasts.

The M3 legacy began with the iconic first-generation E30,
designed for Group A homologation.

But it's the second-gen E36 that truly cemented the model's
reputation for performance.

This iteration introduced BMW's now-legendary inline-6 engine.

Even more enticing, this particular model came from
a later release after a series of refinements.

The combination of the 3.2-liter inline-6 mated to a 6-speed
manual gearbox made it a favorite among sports-car fans.

After all, it offered power and precision at the low revs,
and exceptional notes at the high.
usedCar.zh:
无论是市内道路驾驶还是提升赛道技艺，M3 E36都是
您的理想之选。

M3系列以其传奇的首代E30车型而闻名，那是一款为满
足A组别赛事规则而生产的认证车型。

而这里介绍的是第二代E36车型。

正是从这一代起，M3开启了搭载BMW引以为傲的直列6缸
引擎的先河。

值得一提的是，它属于该系列的后期产品，经过了小幅
改款后推出。

它配备了经过扩容的3.2L直列6缸引擎，搭配6速手动变
速箱，因此广受欢迎。

这样的组合在低转速区间就能提供充沛动力和精准控制，
而在高转速时更能呈现出令人陶醉的引擎咆哮声。@

catch.en: From race car to luxury grand tourer, the second-generation M3.
catch.zh: 3.2L的第二代M3：从赛车到豪华旅行车。

vehicleCollection.en:
From race car to luxury grand tourer, the second-generation M3.

The second-generation M3 was based on the E36 3 Series. It marked a shift from pure motorsport focus to a more refined grand tourer. This model offered a broader appeal with multiple body styles, including a 2-door coupe, 4-door sedan, and cabriolet. Originally equipped with a 3.0-liter engine, the M3 received an upgrade in 1995 to a 3.2-liter unit, along with the introduction of a 6-speed manual and an optional 2-pedal SMG (Sequential Manual Gearbox).

long.en: The second-generation M3 was based on the E36 3 Series. It marked a shift from pure motorsport focus to a more refined grand tourer. This model offered a broader appeal with multiple body styles, including a 2-door coupe, 4-door sedan, and cabriolet. Originally equipped with a 3.0-liter engine, the M3 received an upgrade in 1995 to a 3.2-liter unit, along with the introduction of a 6-speed manual and an optional 2-pedal SMG (Sequential Manual Gearbox).

conversation.en:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car
can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!

This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was
simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.

The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选BMW M3系列肯定没错！

这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……

产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。

这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。

E46也展现出了BMW跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。

可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。
B

conversation.en:
Among the many 3-series cars to follow the 2002, this was
the last to use BMW's traditional design language.

Despite the conventionality in theme and execution,
this car looks really great.

One particularly effective design element...

Is the short front overhang when viewed
from the rear quarters.

It's almost non-existent.
You can hardly see it.

The engineers and designers clearly understood that
proportions have to be planned early on.

It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished
on a mass-production scale.
.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
这款车延续了2002款的风格，
在宝马的传统设计语言下竭力展现最新一代3系的风貌。

我感觉，设计师们最初就定下了张扬肆意的调子，
在呈现时更是不遗余力，最终的效果也非常出彩。

比如说，它有个非常精妙的设计……

……如果你从斜后方角度观察车头前悬部分，

你会发现几乎看不到，
仿佛它不存在一样。

这代表宝马的工程师和设计师们对车身比例研究得很透彻。

要实现这一点，必须在开发前期就将之纳入规划。

这是一件知易行难的事，在打造一款量产车时，
能实现这样的成果确实难能可\j
.

brandCentral.en:
Like its predecessors, the third generation BMW M3
is a quintessential example of a FR sports car.

Its naturally aspirated straight-six engine is highly tuned,
producing more than <100ps> per litre of displacement.

A truly exceptional piece of machinery, it's hailed as the
fastest, most powerful straight-six engine in the world.

With a compact, stylish body and a very fine engine indeed,
this car has only grown more magnificent with age.
brandCentral.zh:
与其前辈一样，第三代BMW M3是前置后驱跑车的典型代表。

其自然进气的直列六缸引擎经过高度调校，每升排量的
动力输出超过了<100ps>。

这是一台真正出类拔萃的机器，被誉为世界上最快、最
强大的直列六缸引擎。

通过紧凑、时尚的车身和极其优秀的发动机，BMW造就出
了一台历久弥新的好车。

usedCar.en:
This third generation E46 M3 is one of the most coveted
vehicles on the used car market.

It boasts a custom straight-six engine produced by BMW M,
the company's in-house motorsport division.

This triumph of engineering roars with unbridled power,
producing an engine note that truly raises the spirits.

Its compact body is also rather in vogue these days.
usedCar.zh:
第三代E46 M3是二手车市场上最炙手可热
的车型。

它所搭载的定制直列六缸引擎由BMW M
生产，属于该公司的室内赛车系列。

这次工程技术上的胜利爆发出大鸣大放的马力，
产生出的引擎声使人精神为之一振。

其紧凑的车身在当时也相当时尚。

catch.en: Featuring BMW's high-revving engine technology, this sports car represented the epitome of the E46 3 Series.
catch.zh: 这款跑车采用了BMW的高转速引擎技术，堪称E46 3系的巅峰之作。

vehicleCollection.en:
Featuring BMW's high-revving engine technology, this sports car represented the epitome of the E46 3 Series.

The third-generation M3 was introduced with the E46 3 Series. Its 3.2-liter S54 Inline-6 delivered more than 98.6 HP per liter, peaking at 338.3 HP at 7900 rpm. In 2003, the high-performance CSL variant was launched. It featured a carbon-fiber roof to reduce weight and a retuned engine pushing output to 355 HP. This model went on to achieve significant success in touring car racing and various other motorsport events.

long.en: The third-generation M3 was introduced with the E46 3 Series. Its 3.2-liter S54 Inline-6 delivered more than 98.6 HP per liter, peaking at 338.3 HP at 7900 rpm. In 2003, the high-performance CSL variant was launched. It featured a carbon-fiber roof to reduce weight and a retuned engine pushing output to 355 HP. This model went on to achieve significant success in touring car racing and various other motorsport events.
long.zh: 第三代M3基于3系E46车型打造。3.2升S54直列六缸引擎的单升功率超过100 PS，在7,900 转每分转速下输出最大343 PS功率。2003年推出了高性能CSL版本。除采用碳纤维车顶实现轻量化外，引擎也经过深度调校，最大功率提升至360 PS。这款车日后在房车锦标赛及各项赛事中取得了辉煌战绩。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款跑车采用了BMW的高转速引擎技术，堪称E46 3系的巅峰之作。

第三代M3基于3系E46车型打造。3.2升S54直列六缸引擎的单升功率超过100 PS，在7,900 转每分转速下输出最大343 PS功率。2003年推出了高性能CSL版本。除采用碳纤维车顶实现轻量化外，引擎也经过深度调校，最大功率提升至360 PS。这款车日后在房车锦标赛及各项赛事中取得了辉煌战绩。

conversation.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.

Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.

At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.

What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。

这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。

在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。

更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

the change in flow of BMW design.

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.

At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.

What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。

这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。

在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。

更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

dialogues.en:
This is a design that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.

The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...

Were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.

This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.

However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.

This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.

这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱BMW之前的设计语言，带来革新。

catch.en: Based on the E92 3 Series coupe, this 4th-gen M3 featured a 414.2 HP V8.

vehicleCollection.en:
Based on the E92 3 Series coupe, this 4th-gen M3 featured a 414.2 HP V8.

Across multiple generations of the 3 Series, the M3 has consistently been positioned as a high-performance variant with a deep motorsports heritage. The E92 M3 paired a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission (DCT) with a high-revving 4.0-liter V-8 delivering 414.2 HP. Despite its larger body, extensive weight-saving measures kept the road car’s weight down to just 3593 lbs. It could sprint from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.8 seconds.

Despite its larger body, extensive weight-saving measures kept the road car’s weight down to just 3593 lbs. It could sprint from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.8 seconds.

冕了总冠军……

vehicleCollection.en:
BMW's M3 GT2 raced in premier endurance contests including the ALMS and ILMC series as well as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

The GT version, developed from this high-performance base, was extensively modified for racing. Many body panels were replaced with carbon fiber, cutting weight down to 2745 lbs, while the fenders were flared, widening the body by 4.3 inches. Even with a restrictor in place, the 4.0-liter V-8 still produced an impressive 493.1 HP.

conversation.en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...

...was surely at its peak.

Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.

This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.

The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.

But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.

And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。

这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。

这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。

多边形车身非常抽象、简约。

虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。

粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。
~

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly modified homologation version of the E30 3 Series served as a small hint of what was to come from BMW.

This coupe was designed for touring car racing and developed by BMW M, based on the E30 3 Series. It featured blistered fenders, front and rear spoilers, and distinctive side skirts, giving it a bold, aggressive appearance. The Sport Evolution was the final version of this M3 generation. Its enlarged 2.5-liter engine produced 234.7 HP and 173.6 ft-lb of torque, making it a formidable force on the circuit.

Its enlarged 2.5-liter engine produced 234.7 HP and 173.6 ft-lb of torque, making it a formidable force on the circuit.

and the M3 became M4.

conversation.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。

现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。

dialogues.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.

Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.

This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.

It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.

It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。

现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。

它是目的性最明确的BMW……

其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。

细节上的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……

以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。

仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。<ex i=2100506 type=9>

brandCentral.en:
In 2013, the BMW 4 Series was created to serve as the coupe
version of the company's popular 3 Series sedan.

Therefore, the M4 represented the top-of-the-line performance
version, taking the place of the M3 coupe.

Released in 2014, the M4 had rear-wheel drive...

...and came powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This powerful front-mounted engine cranked out <431ps>
and <56.1kgm> of torque!
brandCentral.zh:
在2013年，BMW 4系作为3系双门车型的迭代品牌而诞生。

M4则是4系车型中的高性能版本，同时也是M3的继任者。

此车于2014年发布，是一款后轮驱动的跑车……

该车配备了3L涡轮增压直列六缸引擎，

这台强力机器可以产生高达<431ps>的动力和<56.1kgm>的扭矩！

catch.en: The BMW M4 becomes the 2-door version of the daunting M3.
catch.zh: 从起步加速到100 公里/小时仅需4.1秒。传奇M系列的高性能车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The BMW M4 becomes the 2-door version of the daunting M3.

The 3 Series coupe and cabriolet models were split off to form the new 4 Series lineup, with this car serving as the flagship. While its sleek 2-door coupe proportions made it visually striking, its true emphasis was on performance. Under the hood was a twin-turbocharged inline-6 producing 425 HP and 405.8 ft-lb of torque. Paired with an active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and M-specific DSC, it delivered a driving experience worthy of the M badge.

long.en: The 3 Series coupe and cabriolet models were split off to form the new 4 Series lineup, with this car serving as the flagship. While its sleek 2-door coupe proportions made it visually striking, its true emphasis was on performance. Under the hood was a twin-turbocharged inline-6 producing 425 HP and 405.8 ft-lb of torque. Paired with an active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and M-specific DSC, it delivered a driving experience worthy of the M badge.
long.zh: 3系的双门轿跑与敞篷型号从车系中独立出来，成为了4系，而这辆车就是其中的旗舰型号。只看它匀称的双门轿跑车身比例，就已吸引到众多目光，然而这辆车真正的魅力却在于它的性能。它安装了一台直列六缸双涡轮引擎，动力输出达到431 PS/56.1 公斤力米。再搭配主动式M差速器、自适应M悬挂和M系专用动态稳定控制系统，共同打造出了终极的驾乘体验。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
The BMW M4 served as the base model for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

While the M4 was already a great handling car to begin with,
we made it even better by tuning the suspension system.

That said, we retained the predictability of the original car,
which makes it an enjoyable ride for drivers of all levels.
brandCentral.zh:
BMW M4是这辆跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别原创赛车的基础车型。

和大部分BMW一样，它非常擅长过弯，原本就非常出色的
稳定性更是得到了进一步提升。

无论驾驶水平高低，所有车手都会觉得这款前置后驱赛
车易于上手。

catch.en: This Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car maximizes the performance of the M4.
catch.zh: 这辆跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4跑车将M4的性能发挥到了极致。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car maximizes the performance of the M4.

This Gran Turismo Original reimagines BMW’s new-generation high-performance M4 coupe as a Gr.4-spec machine. Although styled like a touring car, it retains the precise cornering ability and rock-solid stability that define BMW’s performance legacy. Its well-balanced handling and approachable dynamics make it an ideal choice even for novice drivers.

long.en: This Gran Turismo Original reimagines BMW’s new-generation high-performance M4 coupe as a Gr.4-spec machine. Although styled like a touring car, it retains the precise cornering ability and rock-solid stability that define BMW’s performance legacy. Its well-balanced handling and approachable dynamics make it an ideal choice even for novice drivers.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型基于BMW的新一代高性能M4轿跑打造，并针对Gr.4规格进行了改装。尽管采用了房车风格的外观，它依然保留了BMW众所称道的过弯能力和稳定性，其表现久经考验。它拥有极其可靠的驾驶性能，意味着即便是新手司机也能毫不费力地在赛道上行驶。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4跑车将M4的性能发挥到了极致。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型基于BMW的新一代高性能M4轿跑打造，并针对Gr.4规格进行了改装。尽管采用了房车风格的外观，它依然保留了BMW众所称道的过弯能力和稳定性，其表现久经考验。它拥有极其可靠的驾驶性能，意味着即便是新手司机也能毫不费力地在赛道上行驶。

This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racing car is based on
the BMW M4.

Outwardly, it looks like an M Performance Edition, but comes
with spoilers, a bonnet pin, and other modifications.

Its design is reminiscent of the safety cars that can be
seen at any number of races today.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车以BMW M4为基础。

从外观上看，它更像是一辆装上了扰流板、引擎盖销和
其他调校件的M Performance Edition。

其设计让人联想到如今在任何一场比赛中都能看到的安
全车。

catch.zh: 用作安全车的特殊M4车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A special safety-car version of the BMW M4.

This Gran Turismo Original safety car is based on BMW’s latest-generation high-performance M4 coupe. Building on the M Performance Edition, it features a range of specially designed components, including a front lip spoiler, hood pins, grille garnishes, a rear spoiler, and a rear diffuser.

long.en: This Gran Turismo Original safety car is based on BMW’s latest-generation high-performance M4 coupe. Building on the M Performance Edition, it features a range of specially designed components, including a front lip spoiler, hood pins, grille garnishes, a rear spoiler, and a rear diffuser.
long.zh: 这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的安全车基于BMW的最新一代高性能M4轿跑打造。它采用了“M Performance Edition”的外观，并为其加入了若干特别设计的部件，包括前唇扰流板、引擎盖销、格栅饰条、后扰流翼和扩散器。

vehicleCollection.zh:
用作安全车的特殊M4车型。

这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的安全车基于BMW的最新一代高性能M4轿跑打造。它采用了“M Performance Edition”的外观，并为其加入了若干特别设计的部件，包括前唇扰流板、引擎盖销、格栅饰条、后扰流翼和扩散器。

brandCentral.en:
This race car used the BMW M6 as a base.

It was raced by Walkenhorst Motorsport.

Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi personally
tested the car out at the Nürburgring.

The long wheelbase of the M6 base model was retained to
preserve its exceptional aerodynamics.

That's why the car was as stable as a rock at high speeds.

Under its hood was a custom-tuned turbocharged 4.4-liter V-8.[
brandCentral.zh:
这辆赛车以BMW M6作为改装的基础车型……

并由Walkenhorst Motorsport车队驾驶参赛。

跑车浪漫旅系列的制作人山内一典曾有幸亲自驾驶
它在纽博格林赛道上试车。

这辆车保留了原有车型的大尺寸车身和长轴距……

因而具有极高的稳定性和空气动力学性能。

一台定制调校过的4.4L V8涡轮增压引擎是它的强大核心。

catch.en: The car driven by Kazunori Yamauchi in the 2016 24 Hours of Nürburgring.
catch.zh: 山内一典在2016年纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛中驾驶的赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The car driven by Kazunori Yamauchi in the 2016 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

BMW announced its entry into the FIA GT3 category with the M6 GT3, beginning in the 2016 season. At 16.4 ft long and 6.6 ft wide, it presented a noticeably larger footprint compared to its predecessor, the compact Z4 GT3. Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi competed in the Nürburgring 24 Hours behind the wheel of the Walkenhorst Motorsport M6 GT3, finishing the race and placing 22nd overall.

conversation.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mould—with a total length that is
<5cm> longer than that of its production model!

As for its wheel base—well, it’s also long!

Really, it’s enough to make one fear for its ability
to take corners.

However, its drivers tell a different story...

Praising it for its precise handling and
smooth turning.

Don’t believe them?

The truth is, it pulled off a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018…

Where it was driven by Japanese touring-car
master, Seiji Ara.

It wa tul incredible race to behold!

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。

但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出<5cm>！

它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！

这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。

然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……

他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。

你还是不相信？

那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它

于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……

这是一场令人s以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！
A

The car became known as an exceptional handling machine,
with excellent stability.

Under its hood was a custom-tuned turbocharged 4.4-liter V-8.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆GT3规格的BMW M6，首次亮相于2015年法兰克福车展。

它以最顶级的稳定性和优越的操控性傲视群雄，

并配备了一台定制调校的4.4升 V8涡轮增压引擎。

catch.en: A powerful GT3 race machine with a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8.
catch.zh: 配备4.4升双涡轮增压的新一代BMW GT3。

vehicleCollection.en:
A powerful GT3 race machine with a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8.

This car succeeded the Z4 GT3, which had been BMW’s flagship GT3 racer since 2010. In stark contrast to the compact Z4, it featured a commanding presence, measuring nearly 16.4 ft long and more than 6.6 ft wide. Under the hood, a twin-turbo 4.4-liter V-8 delivered 576.9 HP in its stock configuration. Built primarily from carbon fiber, the car also featured a completely redesigned frame and suspension, setting it far apart from the production M6.

long.en: This car succeeded the Z4 GT3, which had been BMW’s flagship GT3 racer since 2010. In stark contrast to the compact Z4, it featured a commanding presence, measuring nearly 16.4 ft long and more than 6.6 ft wide. Under the hood, a twin-turbo 4.4-liter V-8 delivered 576.9 HP in its stock configuration. Built primarily from carbon fiber, the car also featured a completely redesigned frame and suspension, setting it far apart from the production M6.
long.zh: 自从2010年起，Z4 GT3一直是BMW GT3赛车的中流砥柱，而这款车正是其后继车型。与紧凑的Z4不同，这款车拥有更具威慑力的外观，车身长度约为5 米，宽2 米。它的内核是一台4.4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，在原厂设置下能够输出585 PS的动力。其车身大多采用了碳纤维材料打造，其框架和悬挂也得到了彻底改造，让它与消费级M6车型天差地别。

conversation.en:
Ah, this is the "long nose/long tail" McLaren F1 GTR,
which made its debut in 1997.

Its engine was built by BMW Motorsport.

While the McLaren F1 won the overall title
at the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hours…

...the Porsche 911 GT1 took the win
the following year.

Desperate to reclaim its title, McLaren set to work
on this 1997 F1 GTR race car.

Its effective aerodynamic design suggests that this car was
designed to blast down te long straights of Le Mans.

Alas, it fell just shy of accomplishing its goal in 1997,
finishing in 2nd place behind the Porsche.

Two years later, BMW settled the score in a way
with its own Le Mans victory.

But tat’s a story for another day.
y
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
啊，这就是1997年首次亮相的“长鼻”+“长尾”
迈凯伦F1 GTR，

它的发动机来自宝马赛车运动。

虽然迈凯伦F1在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中
取得了胜利……

但第二年就被保时捷911 GT1抢走了冠军宝座。

不愿服输的迈凯伦开始着手打造这辆1997款F1 GTR赛车。

通过其高度特化的空气动力学设计不难看出，
它是为了在勒芒的大直道z跑出最高速度而生的。

令人遗憾的是，它在1997年的比赛中并没能跟上
保时捷的速度，最终屈居第二……

两年后，宝马亲手拿下了勒芒冠军，某种程度上算是报
了Q箭之仇！

关于这个故事，我们就留到下次再讲了。

cars.nameEn: BMW McLaren F1 GTR Race Car '97
cars.nameZh: BMW McLaren F1 GTR Race Car '97

collection.en:
McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted to get
into the road car business.

In 1969, his company had plans for road cars which were
essentially slightly modified Can-Am racing cars.

These were the M6GT and M12GT.

vehicleCollection.en:
This F1 GTR race car took many racing titles around the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Masterminded by Gordon Murray, this car is the racing evolution of the high-performance road-going McLaren F1. After its debut in 1995, the car underwent continuous development, culminating in the introduction of this aerodynamically enhanced Long Tail version in 1997. The F1 GTR enjoyed a long racing career, remaining at the forefront of GT competition under privateer teams all the way through to 2003.

brandCentral.en:
Inspired by the BMWs that made waves in the touring car
championships of the ‘70s...

The BMW Vision Gran Turismo is sure to remind you
of the classic touring cars of yesteryear.

Naturally, BMW's very own design team was responsible
for bringing this vision to life.

Under the bonnet, you’ll find a 3L straight-six
turbo engine.

And as you might expect, this FR model has
a perfect 50:50 axle load distribution.

Believe it or not, this road racer weighs a mere
<1180kg>!
brandCentral.zh:
BMW Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感来自于那些在70年代的
房车锦标赛中大包大揽的BMW……

看到它，您会不由得想起昔日的经典房车。

在意料之内，这一愿景很快就在BMW自己的设计团队的手
下化为了现实。

在它的引擎盖下，装载着一个3L直列六缸涡轮增压引擎。

您可以想见，这款前置后驱车型同样拥有完美的50:50轴负
荷分配。

还有，这款公路赛车的重量仅有<1180kg>！是不是很难以置信？

catch.en: The ultimate road racer that draws its heritage from the glorious touring cars of the '70s.
catch.zh: 终极公路赛车，汲取了70年代著名房车的传承。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate road racer that draws its heritage from the glorious touring cars of the '70s.

This modern road racer was developed by BMW’s design team. Its exterior was sculpted to convey a striking sense of speed, even at a standstill. Power came from a 3.0-liter inline-6 delivering 404kW and 680Nm of torque (541.4 HP/499.1 ft-lb). Remarkably lightweight at just 2601 lbs, the car also achieved ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution. This Vision Gran Turismo represents a striking blend of BMW’s racing heritage and advanced technology.

long.en: This modern road racer was developed by BMW’s design team. Its exterior was sculpted to convey a striking sense of speed, even at a standstill. Power came from a 3.0-liter inline-6 delivering 404kW and 680Nm of torque (541.4 HP/499.1 ft-lb). Remarkably lightweight at just 2601 lbs, the car also achieved ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution. This Vision Gran Turismo represents a striking blend of BMW’s racing heritage and advanced technology.
long.zh: 由BMW设计团队打造的现代公路赛车。其外观设计让车辆即使在静止时也能给人带来难以置信的速度感。强劲的3升直列六缸引擎可输出404千瓦/680牛米（549 PS/69.0 公斤力米）。整车仅重1,180 公斤，并实现了完美的50:50前后重量分配。这台Vision Gran Turismo是BMW赛车传统与最新技术的惊人融合。

brandCentral.en:
The long nose and short deck proportions have long been
a benchmark of sports-car design.

If you were to ask enthusiasts to name a recent BMW that embodies
this ideal, many would point to the 2003 Z4, a true masterpiece.

The successor to the Z3, it came powered by only an inline-6,
making it feel somewhat more prestigious in comparison.

Its elegant body was penned by American designer Chris Bangle,
and it is distinguished by the Z-shaped curve on its sides.

Despite being a convertible, the Z4 stays true to BMW’s values,
with 50/50 weight distribution and triple the rigidity of the Z3.

A race version competed at the Nürburgring 24h,
making it one of those rare cars that looks as good as it goes.
brandCentral.zh:
“长车鼻短车身”比例一直是理想的跑车设计。

如果要在宝马近年来推出的杰作中找出一个最佳案例，
最众望所归的答案就是2003年推出的敞篷车型Z4。

作为Z3的后继车型，它仅推出直列6缸引擎版本，相比
之下，更加彰显尊崇和信仰。

它优雅的车身出自美国设计师克里斯·班戈之手，
车身侧面的Z字线条尤为别致吸睛。

尽管是一款敞篷车，但Z4拥有纯正的宝马血统，其车重
分配比例接近50/50，车身刚度可达Z3的三倍。

不仅如此，它的赛车规格版本参与过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。
毫无疑问，这是一辆外观与驾驶性能并重的稀有车型。

usedCar.en:
Looking for an open-top with both elegance and control?
Then, the first-gen BMW Z4 is the car for you!

The successor model to the Z3, it only carried an inline-6,
doing away with former’s 4-cylinder variant.

Its long bonnet is itself a picture of grace—what those in
the know refer to as 'long nose/short deck' proportions.

Needless to say, it bears all the hallmarks of BMW tradition,
with attention paid to weight distribution and rigidity.

The Z4’s suspension is based on a design honed in the E46,
and its <231ps> engine offers the flow of a 6 banger.

Having competed at the Nürburgring 24h, the Z4 can be called
'top-of-the-line' by every metric!
usedCar.zh:
想要寻找一款优雅与操控性并重的敞篷车吗？那么这辆
第一代宝马Z4就是你梦寐以求的车型！

作为Z3的后继车型，它摒弃了前任的4缸引擎，改用
更强大的直列6缸。

它的长引擎盖本身便是一件美轮美奂的设计精品，
懂行的人都称其为“长车鼻短车身”比例。

身为一台宝马，它拥有品牌一脉相承的所有标志性特点，
并在车重分配和车身刚度上更进一步。

Z4的悬挂基于一款已在E46车型上久经考验的设计，
6汽缸做功时带来顺畅丝滑的体验，输出可达<231ps>。

Z4还曾参加过纽博格林24小时耐力赛，从各个维度来说
都堪称是“精妙绝伦”。

catch.en: An elegant convertible with an inline-6 engine lurking under its elongated hood.
catch.zh: 一款优雅的敞篷车。前部的长引擎盖下安装了一部直列六缸引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
An elegant convertible with an inline-6 engine lurking under its elongated hood.

The Z4 was a convertible sports car that made its debut in 2002 as the successor to the Z3. Its design was distinguished by clean fender lines and a signature Z-shaped press line just ahead of the door. Torsional rigidity was improved by nearly threefold compared to the Z3, while overall weight was reduced by 55 lbs. It also introduced several new technologies, becoming the first BMW to feature electric power steering.

long.en: The Z4 was a convertible sports car that made its debut in 2002 as the successor to the Z3. Its design was distinguished by clean fender lines and a signature Z-shaped press line just ahead of the door. Torsional rigidity was improved by nearly threefold compared to the Z3, while overall weight was reduced by 55 lbs. It also introduced several new technologies, becoming the first BMW to feature electric power steering.

conversation.en:
One thing that racing enthusiasts love about BMW...

Is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer racing cars like this one here.

When a new production car is released, a race-ready
model can be expected to follow soon after.

This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...

At endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours...

Where it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.

Part of what makes BMW so cool is that they can be
assertive without coming off as conceited.

They exude that sort of confidence that just lets
the facts speak for themselves.
Z

brandCentral.en:
The BMW Z4 GT3 is a FIA GT3 racing car.

This 2011 model comes with a 4.4L V8 engine capable of
generating <515ps>.

It also has a sequential six-speed manual transmission
with paddle shifters.

Not only has the car scored two wins in the FIA GT3
European Championship...

It's also been a star performer at the Nürburgring and
Spa 24-hour endurance races...

Where, on both occasions, it managed to claim
an impressive second place!
brandCentral.zh:
宝马Z4 GT3是一款国际汽联GT3规格的赛车。

这款2011年的车型配备了4.4升V8引擎，能够产生<515ps>的动力，

以及一套带拨片换挡装置的序列式六速手动变速箱。

这辆车不仅在国际汽联GT3欧洲锦标赛中斩获两胜……

同时也是纽博格林和斯帕24小时耐力赛的明星选手……

在当年的赛事中，它都成功地取得了第二名的好成绩，
给人留下深刻的印象！

catch.zh: 纽博格林赛道和斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道24小时耐力赛亚军。赛车典范，从最艰巨的战斗中脱颖而出。

vehicleCollection.en:
Starting the 2011 24 Hours of Spa from the 49th position on the grid, this BMW Z4 GT3 crossed the finish line in a remarkable 2nd place.

Based on the E89-generation Z4, BMW’s GT3 race machine began competition in 2010. Weight was reduced by 661 lbs through extensive modifications, including the replacement of the retractable roof with a fixed panel. The engine was also changed to a 4.0-liter V-8. In 2011, the car was further refined with wider fenders and a larger 4.4-liter engine producing 507.9 HP. Paired with an upgraded paddle-shift transmission, this Z4 achieved a series of remarkable results in some of the world’s most fiercely contested GT races.

long.en: Based on the E89-generation Z4, BMW’s GT3 race machine began competition in 2010. Weight was reduced by 661 lbs through extensive modifications, including the replacement of the retractable roof with a fixed panel. The engine was also changed to a 4.0-liter V-8. In 2011, the car was further refined with wider fenders and a larger 4.4-liter engine producing 507.9 HP. Paired with an upgraded paddle-shift transmission, this Z4 achieved a series of remarkable results in some of the world’s most fiercely contested GT races.
long.zh: 这辆BMW的GT3赛车基于E89型号Z4打造，从2010年起开始参加比赛。通过将伸缩式顶篷更换为固定板件等改良，车重成功削减了300 公斤。而动力上也换用了一台4升V8引擎。到了2011年，新版本添加了更宽的挡泥板，还换用了更大排量的4.4升引擎，能够输出515 PS。再搭配升级版拨片换挡变速箱，这辆Z4在一系列竞争最为激烈的赛事中均取得了优秀的成绩。

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

embraces imperfections as character!

And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!

It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!

And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.

BMW's contemporary Z8 roadster has the distinction of being one of James Bond's rare non-British vehicles.

This luxury convertible sports car drew inspiration from the iconic BMW 507 of the 1950s. Its aluminum space frame housed the same 5.0-liter V-8 and 6-speed manual transmission found in the E39 M5, producing 394.5 HP and capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.7 seconds. It also earned cinematic fame as the featured Bond car in a 007 movie.

vehicleCollection.en:
BMW’s first mass-produced production vehicle has a sports-car heart.

This electric vehicle was unveiled by BMW in 2013. Its distinctive, boxy 4-door body featured small, pillarless rear doors, and weighed just 2634 lbs, thanks to an aluminum alloy chassis paired with a carbon-fiber cabin. The electric motor produced 167.7 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 37.3 mph in 3.7 seconds, and to 62.1 mph in 7.2 seconds. With a top speed exceeding 93.2 mph, it proved it can compete with its internal combustion-powered counterparts.

long.en: This electric vehicle was unveiled by BMW in 2013. Its distinctive, boxy 4-door body featured small, pillarless rear doors, and weighed just 2634 lbs, thanks to an aluminum alloy chassis paired with a carbon-fiber cabin. The electric motor produced 167.7 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 37.3 mph in 3.7 seconds, and to 62.1 mph in 7.2 seconds. With a top speed exceeding 93.2 mph, it proved it can compete with its internal combustion-powered counterparts.
long.zh: 2013年，BMW公布了一款电动车。方正的四门车身采用了小尺寸无柱后门设计，底盘使用铝合金材质，而驾驶舱则使用碳纤维，使得全车仅重1,195 公斤。它的电机能够输出170 PS/25.0 公斤力米的性能，从静止状态加速到60 公里/小时仅需3.7秒，加速到100 公里/小时也仅需7.2秒。再加上超过150 公里/小时的最高时速，这款车在其他采用内燃引擎的竞争车型面前也丝毫不落下风。

Its design remains timeless and distinctive, reflecting a bold, conceptual approach while staying true to BVLGARI’s design DNA, rising above fleeting trends and fashion cycles.

vehicleCollection.en:
The successor to the ultra-high-performance Veyron.

The Chiron is a super sports car by Bugatti, introduced in 2016. Limited to a global production run of just 500 units, it serves as the spiritual successor to the groundbreaking Veyron. Built around a carbon-fiber chassis with rigidity comparable to that of an LMP1 race car, the Chiron is powered by the Veyron’s quad-turbo 8.0-liter W16, tuned to produce 1479.3 HP and 1179.7 ft-lb of torque. It can accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 2.5 seconds, and a prototype version recorded a top speed of 304.8 mph.

Built around a carbon-fiber chassis with rigidity comparable to that of an LMP1 race car, the Chiron is powered by the Veyron’s quad-turbo 8.0-liter W16, tuned to produce 1479.3 HP and 1179.7 ft-lb of torque. It can accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 2.5 seconds, and a prototype version recorded a top speed of 304.8 mph.

conversation.en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.

Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...

Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.

However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.

Even te Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.

The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...

While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
armony, flowing down to the rear of the car.

The car's elegant lines e uninterrupte runnng smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.

The stlin expesaeuphoric artnouveau expression
t makes me reect Jea Bugatti all he moreY

conversation.zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前

以及对传统美学的接纳。

这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与

它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……

从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。

从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺x地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。

brandCentral.en:
The 2005 Veyron was many car enthusiasts' introduction to
the Bugatti brand.

It was the first commercially available car produced by the
company since its revival in 1998!

The elegant proportions of its design are complemented by
the car's 8L midship W16 engine.

This engine can generate more than <1000ps> of power,
allowing the car to reach speeds of over <400km/h>!

Only 400 of these cars were ever made, with production
ceasing in 2015.
brandCentral.zh:
2005布加迪Veryron或许是许多汽车爱好者接触到布加迪品牌的契机。

这是该公司自1998年重生以来生产出的第一款商业化车型！

颀长且优雅的车身比例与8升的W16中置引擎配合无间。

这款引擎可以产生超过<1000ps>的动力，将汽车的时速推到<400km/h>！

在2015年停产之前，布加迪Veryron总共只生产了400辆。|

catch.en: With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over 233 mph.
catch.zh: 利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到375 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over 233 mph.

This car was the ultimate expression of a modern super sports machine. First unveiled at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show, it delivered figures rarely seen even among elite supercars: 987.2 HP, a top speed of 252.9 mph, and a price tag of one million euros. Its engine was an 8.0-liter W-16 equipped with four turbochargers, paired with a 7-speed DSG transmission. To access its maximum velocity, a special key was required to activate top-speed mode, allowing the car to exceed 233 mph.

long.en: This car was the ultimate expression of a modern super sports machine. First unveiled at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show, it delivered figures rarely seen even among elite supercars: 987.2 HP, a top speed of 252.9 mph, and a price tag of one million euros. Its engine was an 8.0-liter W-16 equipped with four turbochargers, paired with a 7-speed DSG transmission. To access its maximum velocity, a special key was required to activate top-speed mode, allowing the car to exceed 233 mph.
long.zh: 这是一台终极超跑。这辆车于2005年东京车展上首次亮相，采用了即便在超级跑车中也极其罕见的规格数值：1,001 PS的动力输出，407 公里/小时的极速性能，还有高达一百万欧元的单价。它安装了一台包含4部涡轮增压器的8升W16引擎，并连接到一部7档双离合变速箱。驾驶者还能使用一把特殊钥匙来解锁极速模式，让这辆车的最高时速来到375 公里/小时。

Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car.

Although the engine was detuned to meet Gr.4 regulations,
this 4WD vehicle went plenty fast in a straight line.

级别赛车的基础车型。

尽管为了符合Gr.4规范，我们不得不削弱它的动力，但这
辆四轮驱动机器依然可以跑出惊人的顶级车速。
