vehicleCollection.en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over 233 mph.

Bugatti’s Veyron supercar has been reimagined to meet Gr.4 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. Although its power output was reduced from that of the standard model to comply with class rules, it can still hold its own against rivals with impressive straight-line speed. Its 4-wheel-drive system also provides a distinct advantage in cornering, offering exceptional stability through turns.

Although its power output was reduced from that of the standard model to comply with class rules, it can still hold its own against rivals with impressive straight-line speed. Its 4-wheel-drive system also provides a distinct advantage in cornering, offering exceptional stability through turns.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Bugatti Veyron超级跑车针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。尽管为了符合Gr.4规则而对基础车型的动力输出进行了削弱，但它在直线加速中依然拥有不输任何对手的实力。得益于四轮驱动布局提供的稳定性，它在弯道中也占据一定优势。

brandCentral.en:
Bugatti has always been a company that drew inspiration
from its racing history.

The case is no different with this model that embodied
the very soul of the marque.

It was partly based on the company's classic race car,
the Type 57 Tank....

...which took the overall title at the 24 Hours of Le Mans
race twice in the 1930s.

The mid-mounted W-16 engine was tuned to produce up to <1673ps>.%
brandCentral.zh:
这款引人注目的车型是Bugatti美学的体现。

Bugatti惯于从公司的赛车历史中汲取灵感。

此车的设计就部分参考了经典赛车：Type 57 Tank，

一辆在20世纪30年代两次赢得勒芒赛事的传奇赛车。

中置安装的W16引擎经过精心调校，可产生高达<1673ps>的动力。

catch.en: This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays homage to the Type 57 Tank, one of the glorious cars that define Bugatti's history.
catch.zh: 这辆致敬Type 57 Tank的Vision Gran Turismo象征着Bugatti的光辉历史。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays homage to the Type 57 Tank, one of the glorious cars that define Bugatti's history.

This machine was conceived as a tribute to Bugatti’s storied racing heritage. Designers and engineers collaborated to craft the vehicle using cutting-edge technologies and advanced aerodynamic theory. Powered by a W16 engine with four turbochargers, it produced an astonishing 1230kW and 1580Nm of torque (1649.9 HP/1165.2 ft-lb), enabling it to exceed 248.5 mph in four sections of Circuit de la Sarthe, home of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. This immense power allowed the car to achieve a top speed of 278.1 mph.

long.en: This machine was conceived as a tribute to Bugatti’s storied racing heritage. Designers and engineers collaborated to craft the vehicle using cutting-edge technologies and advanced aerodynamic theory. Powered by a W16 engine with four turbochargers, it produced an astonishing 1230kW and 1580Nm of torque (1649.9 HP/1165.2 ft-lb), enabling it to exceed 248.5 mph in four sections of Circuit de la Sarthe, home of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. This immense power allowed the car to achieve a top speed of 278.1 mph.
long.zh: 这台车是对Bugatti历史赛车车型的致敬。设计师和工程师携手合作，利用最新技术和空气动力学理论打造了这台车。配备足足4个涡轮增压器的W16引擎可输出难以置信的1230千瓦/1580牛米（1,673 PS/161.1 公斤力米），让它得以在勒芒24小时耐力赛的主场萨森赛车场的四个计时点中，速度可超过400 公里/小时（250英里/小时）。强劲且充裕的动力使其能够达到447.6 公里/小时（278英里/小时）的最高时速。

A dream machine made to be the pinnacle of race cars and a true Bugatti.

A version of the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo concept car has been developed in collaboration with Gran Turismo and adapted to meet Gr.1 regulations. Thanks to its wide track and 4-wheel-drive system, the base platform delivers excellent stability, resulting in a surprisingly approachable race car.

Thanks to its wide track and 4-wheel-drive system, the base platform delivers excellent stability, resulting in a surprisingly approachable race car.

conversation.en:
The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.

Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.

Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.

This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine
with a featherweight <500kg> body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.

For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match t Superlight R5.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。

这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。

虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……

但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。

这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的<500kg>车身中，
搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。

其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。

它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。

毫无疑问，对于追X赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。ה scmd="GTCafe_

brandCentral.en:
Carving through a corner with absolute precision
is a joy that captures the very essence of racing.

If there's one brand dedicated to chasing that joy,
it's Caterham, most notably with its iconic 'Seven' series.

This Superlight R500 from 1999 is the ultimate model,
balancing aerodynamics and power in a single package.

The lightest of the Sevens, the R500 weighs in at
a feathery <500kg>.

In 2008, it was refitted with a 2L Ford Duratec engine with
<266ps> of power and ample torque at low-to-mid speeds.

Named for its 500-horsepower-per-tonne power-to-weight ratio,
the R500 can sprint from 0 to <100km/h> in 2.88 seconds.

Rejecting modern driver aids and comforts, it serves as

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate version of the extremely lightweight Caterham.

This car was produced by Caterham in 1996, more than two decades after the company inherited production rights to the Seven from Lotus in 1973. As the Superlight name implied, weight was trimmed throughout the car, making it between 77 lbs and 110 lbs lighter than the standard Seven, depending on trim. The later models from 2008 and after, were powered by a 2.0-liter Ford engine producing 262.3 HP, giving it 0-to-62.1 mph acceleration of 2.88 seconds and performance that could rival supercars.

Have you ever considered who had the most influence over
modern racing car technology?

For me, that would be either Colin Chapman or Jim Hall.

Chapman, of course, was the founder of Lotus.
But do you know Jim Hall?

Not only is he the founder of Chaparral Cars...

But he is also a Formula 1 driver and a brilliant
engineer.

The most innovative of all the Chaparral cars was
this 1970 2J, or 'sucker' car.

It featured two fans at the rear of the chassis, which were
part of a suction system that produced downforce.

Other innovations included an adjustable spoiler and a
two-pedal semi-automatic transmission...

All in all, it’s one of the most outlandish and imaginative
race cars ever produced.

The 2J was undoubtedlyChparal's greatest achievement,
and lves on in motorsport legend to thiday.
collection.zh:
您有没有思考过，谁才是对现代赛车技术影响最大的人物？

我会提名Colin Chapman和Jim Hall。

众所周知，Chapman是
Lotus的创始人，但您知道Jim Hall吗？

他是Chaparral Cars的创始人，

也是一位F1车手，还是一位才华横溢的工程师。

Chaparral最具创新意义的作品是这款1970年的2J，也被称作“吸
尘器”。

它的底盘尾部安装了两个风扇，通过吸力来产生下压力。

它的其他创新设计还包括可调节的扰流板和双踏板半自
动变速箱……

总而言之，这是史上最奇特和最有想象力的赛车之一。

2J毫无疑问是Chaparral最伟大的成就，至今也是赛车运动的一
项传奇。

catch.en: Dubbed by some as "the vacuum cleaner," this car became an American racing icon.
catch.zh: 这款车被戏称为“吸尘器”，曾让整个运动赛车界大吃一惊，成为竞速史上的一个标志。

vehicleCollection.en:
Dubbed by some as "the vacuum cleaner," this car became an American racing icon.

The Chaparral 2J was a highly unconventional race car that competed in the 1970 SCCA Can-Am series. Nicknamed the “vacuum cleaner,” it featured a groundbreaking design with two fans mounted at the rear of the car. Powered by a separate secondary engine, these fans created powerful suction by extracting air from beneath the chassis. In effect, it became the world’s first active ground-effect race car. However, for the 1971 season, a change in SCCA regulations banned the use of auxiliary engines, leading to the retirement of the 2J.

long.en: The Chaparral 2J was a highly unconventional race car that competed in the 1970 SCCA Can-Am series. Nicknamed the “vacuum cleaner,” it featured a groundbreaking design with two fans mounted at the rear of the car. Powered by a separate secondary engine, these fans created powerful suction by extracting air from beneath the chassis. In effect, it became the world’s first active ground-effect race car. However, for the 1971 season, a change in SCCA regulations banned the use of auxiliary engines, leading to the retirement of the 2J.
long.zh: Chaparral 2J是一款独特的赛车，曾参加1970年SCCA Can-Am（加拿大-美国挑战杯）系列赛。此车因其在车身后部安装两个风扇的独特构造而被戏称为“吸尘器”。这两个风扇由辅助引擎驱动，能够强力吸出车底空气。实际上，这是世界上首款主动式地面效应赛车。然而1971年SCCA规则的修改禁止使用任何辅助引擎，迫使这款赛车退出历史舞台。

and thoroughly modern beneath the skin.

properly executed restomod.

with a center-exit exhaust.

This example is a restomod, pairing the spirit of the original
with modern high-performance upgrades.

In terms of presence, this is an intimidating machine. Built low
to the ground, it wears aggressive aero components.

The wide-mouth front bumper enhances cooling, while
chrome trim is blacked out and carbon-clad.

Under the hood sits a supercharged V-8 producing
667ps> of power, making it a formidable hot rod.

Its roll-cage interior houses a sequential gearbox
and Alcantara bucket seats with a refined edge.

With its blend of classic style and cutting-edge tech, this
is a special Camaro built to compete inany era.

巧妙融合了原版车型的复古氛围感和现代高性能改装。

外观上，这台车显露出威慑力十足的强大气场。
低趴的车身姿态咄咄逼人，展现精良的空气动力学套件。

宽体前杠有效提升了散热效能，原本的镀铬件

引擎盖下，一台机械增压的V8引擎迸发出

防滚架座舱内，序列式变速箱与欧缔兰麂皮
桶椅相得益彰，透出精致品d。

经典外观与前沿科技的完美交融，
造就了这台足PA在任何时I视雄的非凡科迈罗。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a restomod of the classic Trans-Am hero Camaro Z28.

The Chevrolet Camaro 1968 Race-Mod was Gran Turismo’s modern interpretation of the Camaro Z28, a car originally developed for homologation in the SCCA’s Trans-Am Series. Adorned with carbon black trim, the exterior featured a wide-mouth bumper, a large ducktail spoiler, and a center-exit exhaust. The interior featured a sequential shifter and roll cage, along with Alcantara bucket seats.

vehicleCollection.en:
The sports grade model of the 6th generation Camaro with the 6.2-liter LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Camaro made its debut in 2015. While the exterior continued the retro-modern theme of its predecessor, the underlying structure featured an entirely new design. Built on the new Alpha platform, the car employed aluminum extensively, resulting in 28 percent more rigidity and a weight reduction of 198 lbs. The SS performance model came equipped with a 6.2-liter V-8 engine, and included 20-inch wheels and Brembo brakes as standard.

conversation.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
engines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
covetedfor generations.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。

第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。

不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。

这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.

conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。

这么说吧，1969 Camaro是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。

其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……

艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。

如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。

比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。

这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。

相信我，我知道自己在说什么。

collection.en:
The 1969 Z28 was the last of the first-generation Camaros
and is considered one of the greatest of them all.

After only three years of production, 700,000 units were sold.

The lineup included 12 different engines,
including inline-6- and V-8-powered variants.

This Z28 represented the top-of-the-line version of
that first-generation model.

It came with a high-revving 5.0-liter V-8,
a 4-speed manual gearbox and power disc brakes.

And the car was distinguished as a Z28 by two wid stripes
that ran the length of its body.

There's an interesting backstory to the Z28's engine, too.

It was actually based on a race engine. The 5.0-liter V-8
was essentially a de-tuned version of the engine...

...originally developed for thePenske Camaro
that competed in the SCCA Trans Am Series.

The Penske Caro was drivenʈy thelegendary American
race driver Mark Donahue.

He won the Trans Am series in oth 198 nd 169.%
collection.zh:
1969 Z28是第一代科迈罗的末期型号，
也被认为是产品线里最出色的车型。

第一代科迈罗仅仅只生产了3年……

它的12种不同引擎配置车型，包括直列6缸
与V8引擎版本，仍销售出了70万辆。

这辆Z28是第一代科迈罗中最典型的代表。

它配备了高转速的5升V8引擎，四速手动变速箱
和效果出众的碟刹……

vehicleCollection.en:
The Z28 is one of the most popular muscle cars ever, thanks to its good looks and high performance.

The original Ford Mustang was an unprecedented success upon its debut as a compact sports coupe. In response, Chevrolet set out to surpass Ford’s achievement, unveiling the Camaro as a direct competitor in the autumn of 1966. The Z28 represented the Camaro at its performance peak. This special variant featured a larger-displacement engine and an enhanced chassis, developed to meet the regulations of the Trans-Am production-based race category.

catch.en: This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its 649.9 HP LT1 engine.

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its 649.9 HP LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro made its debut in 2015. At the top of the lineup stood the ZL1, powered by the same supercharged 5.7-liter LT4 V-8 engine found in the Corvette Z06. It delivered an impressive 649.9 HP and 649.5 ft-lb of torque. In 2018, a version equipped with the 1LE performance package—which included upgrades to the suspension and drivetrain—recorded a Nürburgring lap time of 7:16.04, outperforming a number of supercars.

long.en: The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro made its debut in 2015. At the top of the lineup stood the ZL1, powered by the same supercharged 5.7-liter LT4 V-8 engine found in the Corvette Z06. It delivered an impressive 649.9 HP and 649.5 ft-lb of torque. In 2018, a version equipped with the 1LE performance package—which included upgrades to the suspension and drivetrain—recorded a Nürburgring lap time of 7:16.04, outperforming a number of supercars.
long.zh: 第六代Chevrolet Camaro于2015年发布。车系中最强劲的车型是ZL1，搭载与Corvette Z06相同的5.7升V8机械增压LT4引擎。可输出659 PS最大动力和89.8 公斤力米峰值扭矩。此外，搭载1LE性能套件的2018款车型还通过升级悬挂和传动系统组件，在纽博格林北环赛道创下了7分16秒04的佳绩，超越了众多超级跑车。

conversation.en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral
2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration,
the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts
throughout.

All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention
to detail are truly stunning.
conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.speaker: Ed Welburn
conversation.zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。

毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……

但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。

以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……

并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。

所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。

即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。

另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。

brandCentral.en:
Chaparral was a maverick company that shook the racing world
in the 1960s.

Time and time again, they pulled off unique feats of
engineering, producing some truly unique race cars.

The Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo is a tribute
to the Chaparral of decades past.

It doesn't just have an unusual body—everything about this
car defies convention!

For starters, it's powered by an innovative laser-based
propulsion system.

And its unusual configuration, which places the driver in a
face-down position, was inspired by the MotoGP experience.

The spirit of Jim Hall, founder of Chaparral, is truly
embodied in this audacious masterpiece!
brandCentral.zh:
Chaparral是一家特立独行的公司，曾在20世纪60年代震撼整个
赛车界。

他们一次又一次地完成了绝无仅有的工程壮举，生产出一
批真正独特的赛车。

Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo是对
Chaparral过去数十年历史的致敬之作。

不止是车身不同寻常——此车的一切都在打破惯例！

首先，此车由创新的激光推进系统提供动力，

而其将驾驶员置于面朝下位置的非常规布局则受到MotoGP的
启发。

Chaparral创始人Jim Hall的创新精神在这件大胆的杰作中得到了真
正的体现。

vehicleCollection.en:
Experience rocket-like speed produced by laser pulse shock waves!

Chaparral is a legendary name in motorsport, known for producing unique race cars, and the 2X is unlike anything that came before it. The driver is enclosed within a carbon fiber body, positioned headfirst in a prone posture, as if hovering just centimeters above the track. Power comes from a radical laser pulse propulsion system, which generates thrust and downforce through the rapid expansion of air.

collection.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS was Chevrolet's mid-size
muscle car.

The optional LS6 engine provided plenty of performance,
even for a car as big as this.

The 7.4-liter 454 engine was given increased compression,
high-lift cams and special cylinder heads.

Its power rating of 450 HP was likely the highest
catalogued output for any American car at the time.

It was an incredible street machine that could easily surpass
500 HP with very little tuning.
collection.zh:
1970年问世的Chevrolet Chevelle SS是Chevrolet的一款
中型肌肉车，

可选装的大排量LS6引擎提供充沛的动力。

Chevrolet将7.4升的排量发动机的压缩，
与高升程凸轮和特制气缸盖配合，

给出了高达<456ps>的官方数据。这或许是所有美国车中纸面
动力最高的车了。

这是一辆令人难以置信的公路车，只需稍许调校，就能
让功率输出轻松超越<500ps>。

catch.zh: 直线加速赛的宠儿——巨大的引擎提供难以置信的动力。

vehicleCollection.en:
A massive engine that produced plenty of power made this car a favorite for drag racing.

The Chevelle was introduced in 1964 as Chevrolet’s first intermediate-size model. The Chevelle also offered the "SS" performance trim, which reached its peak with the introduction of the 1970 model. That year saw the debut of the SS 454, powered by the LS6 engine, the most powerful production engine listed in any American car catalog at the time. It's no wonder that the SS 454 quickly became one of the most formidable and dependable contenders on the drag racing circuit.

The Chevelle also offered the "SS" performance trim, which reached its peak with the introduction of the 1970 model. That year saw the debut of the SS 454, powered by the LS6 engine, the most powerful production engine listed in any American car catalog at the time. It's no wonder that the SS 454 quickly became one of the most formidable and dependable contenders on the drag racing circuit.

collection.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette is undoubtedly one of the world’s
most famous sports cars.

When it made its debut in 1953...

...it quickly became known as "America's sport car"
because no other car like it existed in the U.S.

The car was noted for its attractive body style
and powerful engine.

The original 1953 were built mostly by hand,
and only a 300 units were produced.

Still, they were incredibly popular, and the next year,
General Motors increased production of the car.

This 1958 model exhibits a thoroughly new design
with four headlights.
collection.zh:
Chevrolet Corvette无疑是世界上最久负盛名的跑车之一。

在1953年首次亮相时，

当时的美国并没有真正意义上的跑车，

所以它就被大家叫成了“美国的跑车”。

53 年的Chevrolet 大多是手工制造的。
而且，只生产了300个。

尽管如此，它们还是非常受欢迎，第二年，
通用汽车改进了其生产系统。

这个 1958 年的模型配置了四个车头灯，
展示了一个全新的设计。

catch.en: The origin of the American sports car: the glorious first-generation Corvette.
catch.zh: 美国跑车的起源，光荣的第一代Corvette。

vehicleCollection.en:
The origin of the American sports car: the glorious first-generation Corvette.

In the early 1950s, the American sports car market was largely ruled by European imports. It was during this time that Chevrolet introduced the original Corvette. The first models featured a forward-thinking design, combining a steel frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels. Power came from a 3.8-liter inline-6 producing 149.9 HP. Initially built as a limited run of just 300 units, the Corvette quickly captured public interest, leading to full-scale production beginning in 1954. That year, output was increased slightly to 152.9 HP, and by 1958, the Corvette gained distinctive quad headlights.

long.en: In the early 1950s, the American sports car market was largely ruled by European imports. It was during this time that Chevrolet introduced the original Corvette. The first models featured a forward-thinking design, combining a steel frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels. Power came from a 3.8-liter inline-6 producing 149.9 HP. Initially built as a limited run of just 300 units, the Corvette quickly captured public interest, leading to full-scale production beginning in 1954. That year, output was increased slightly to 152.9 HP, and by 1958, the Corvette gained distinctive quad headlights.
long.zh: 1950年代初，美国跑车市场多由欧洲车型所占据。Chevrolet便是在那一时期推出初代Corvette。首批车型采用了钢制车架搭配玻璃纤维板材的先进车身设计，搭载一台动力输出达152 PS的3.8升直列6缸引擎。这台车最初仅限量生产了300台，但却大获成功，最终于1954年开启大规模量产。动力输出提升至155 PS，1958款车款还新升级为4盏大灯。

conversation.en:
You ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?

It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers,
one amateur and one pro.

For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet
entered a Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.

The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.

This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.

Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
is quite something.

catch.en: The daunting Stingray moniker was resurrected with the seventh-generation Chevrolet Corvette.
catch.zh: 第7代Corvette，传奇魔鬼鱼的徽标名不虚传。

vehicleCollection.en:
The daunting Stingray moniker was resurrected with the seventh-generation Chevrolet Corvette.

This Gran Turismo Original took the final front-engine Corvette—the C7—and transformed it to meet Gr.3 regulations. Its exterior has been purpose-built for endurance racing, featuring prominent fog lamps and a distinctively shaped rear wing. Underneath, the raw acceleration of the large-displacement V-8 combined with the sharp, balanced handling of a front-mid-engine layout showcases what a front-engine/rear-drive race car should be.

Its exterior has been purpose-built for endurance racing, featuring prominent fog lamps and a distinctively shaped rear wing. Underneath, the raw acceleration of the large-displacement V-8 combined with the sharp, balanced handling of a front-mid-engine layout showcases what a front-engine/rear-drive race car should be.

conversation.en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.

If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.

And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…

...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.

Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.

You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.

If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

conversation.zh:
这是一台第七代Corvette——
简称“C7”。

如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。

1953年是初代Corvette诞生的年份……

这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。

C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。

用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。

要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！

The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history

?

vehicleCollection.en:
The seventh-generation Corvette is the first to wear the "Stingray" badge since the 1976 third-generation model.

The Stingray name returned with the launch of the seventh-generation Corvette. Built using lightweight materials, the car maintained a nearly perfect 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution, even with its powerful 6.2-liter LT1 V-8, matching the benchmark set by the world’s finest sports cars. \r
Equipped with the Z51 performance package, with features such as an electronic LSD, dry sump lubrication, and high-performance brakes, the car was able to accelerate from zero to 60 mph in just 3.8 seconds.

long.en:

Equipped with the Z51 performance package, with features such as an electronic LSD, dry sump lubrication, and high-performance brakes, the car was able to accelerate from zero to 60 mph in just 3.8 seconds.
long.zh: “Stingray”之名随着第7代Corvette再度登场。车身采用了轻量化材料，因此即便搭载了6.2升V8 LT1引擎，也能实现所有世界最佳车型具备的接近50:50前后重量比的黄金标准。Z51性能套件增加了电子防滑差速器、干油底壳润滑系统、一体式制动器等功能，让这台车能够在3.8秒内完成0-60英里/小时（0-100 公里/小时）的加速。

catch.en: One of the last of the C7 Corvettes and also the most powerful.
catch.zh: C7 Corvette的最后一批车型之一，也是性能最强大的车款。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the last of the C7 Corvettes and also the most powerful.

The ZR1 was introduced near the end of the C7 Corvette’s production run, becoming the most powerful version of the generation. Under the hood, the supercharged 6.2-liter LT5 V-8 delivered 754.4 HP and 969 Nm (714.6 ft-lb) of torque. Its aerodynamic components were developed in collaboration with Pratt & Miller Engineering, which campaigned the C7 in GT racing. Buyers could choose between a model focused on lap times, or one maximizing top speed. A ZR1 equipped with the high-speed package was capable of reaching an impressive 214.9 mph.

long.en: The ZR1 was introduced near the end of the C7 Corvette’s production run, becoming the most powerful version of the generation. Under the hood, the supercharged 6.2-liter LT5 V-8 delivered 754.4 HP and 969 Nm (714.6 ft-lb) of torque. Its aerodynamic components were developed in collaboration with Pratt & Miller Engineering, which campaigned the C7 in GT racing. Buyers could choose between a model focused on lap times, or one maximizing top speed. A ZR1 equipped with the high-speed package was capable of reaching an impressive 214.9 mph.
long.zh: 在C7 Corvette生命周期尾声推出的ZR1是该系列的最强版本。6.2升V8机械增压“LT5”引擎现能够输出765 PS/969牛米（98.8 公斤力米）。该车的空气动力学部件是与Pratt & Miller Engineering（设计制造了用于参加GT比赛的C7）共同开发的，总共有两款套件，一款是为了实现最快的单圈速度，另一款专为达到最高时速设计。采用最高时速套件的车辆速度可达345.8 公里/小时。

On the 100th anniversary of the Le Mans 24 Hours in 2023...

This mid-engine race car won a marvellous victory
in the GT AM class...

That greatly changed the history of 'America’s sports car',
the Chevrolet Corvette.

Its name—the 'C8', a reference to its status as the eighth
generation of the iconic car.

This was the first production Corvette to forgo a traditional
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout...

In favour of placing the engine in the middle of the car!

A smart move, it would seem, as mid-engine Corvettes have
since become a force to reckon with in many GT races.

conversation.zh:
在2023年勒芒24小时耐力赛百年庆典之际……

这款中置引擎赛车在GT AM组别
取得了辉煌胜利……

极大地改变了“美国跑车”——Chevrolet Corvette的
历史进程。

“C8”彰显了它作为这款标志性车型
第八代产品的身份。

这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动
布局的量产Corvette……

它转而将引擎置于车身中部！

这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为众多GT赛事中不可小觑的力量。

dialogues.en:
On the 100th anniversary of the Le Mans 24 Hours in 2023...

This mid-engine race car won a marvellous victory
in the GT AM class...

That greatly changed the history of 'America’s sports car',
the Chevrolet Corvette.

Its name—the 'C8', a reference to its status as the eighth
generation of the iconic car.

This was the first production Corvette to forgo a traditional
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout...

In favour of placing the engine in the middle of the car!

A smart move, it would seem, as mid-engine Corvettes have
since become a force to reckon with in many GT races.

这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动
布局的量产Corvette……

它转而将引擎置于车身中部！

这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为众多GT赛事中不可小觑的力量。

brandCentral.en:
This eighth-generation C8 certainly took the world by surprise
as the first Corvette to come with a mid-engine layout.

Since the birth of the Vette in 1953, the famed model
had always taken the form as a FR sports car.

While engineers toyed with the possibility of a mid-engine
Corvette since the 1960s...

...it wasn’t until this C8 that they were able to make
this dream a reality.

Combining a naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 engine
and an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission...

...the new Vette continues tradition with a fire-breathing
traditional OHV powerplant.
brandCentral.zh:
第八代C8做出了出人意料的选择，
带来科尔维特系列首款采用中置布局的车型。

自1953年首辆科尔维特诞生以来，这一声名斐然的
美国跑车品牌一直保持着前置后驱布局。

虽然工程师们自二十世纪六十年代以来一直不温不火地
尝试打造中置引擎科尔维特……

但这一梦想直到C8问世后才变为现实。

此车装备了一台6.2升自然吸气V8引擎，
搭配8速双离合变速箱……

沿用传统的顶置气门底置凸轮轴，使得C8的声浪和气势
感觉都与原本的科尔维特一般纯粹。

catch.en: A new generation mid-engine Corvette.
catch.zh: 全新一代中置布局Corvette。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new generation mid-engine Corvette.

Released in 2019, the eighth-generation Corvette became the first in the lineup to adopt a mid-engine layout—a major departure from the traditional front-engine design. At its core was the new 6.2-liter LT2 V-8, producing 495.1 HP and 470.1 ft-lb of torque, paired with an 8-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Although it left behind the Corvette’s signature long-nose silhouette, the C8 delivered outstanding performance, particularly in GT racing.

long.en: Released in 2019, the eighth-generation Corvette became the first in the lineup to adopt a mid-engine layout—a major departure from the traditional front-engine design. At its core was the new 6.2-liter LT2 V-8, producing 495.1 HP and 470.1 ft-lb of torque, paired with an 8-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Although it left behind the Corvette’s signature long-nose silhouette, the C8 delivered outstanding performance, particularly in GT racing.
long.zh: 2019年发布的第8代Corvette在动力总成上迎来重大变革，成为该系列首款采用中置布局的车型。全新6.2升V8“LT2”引擎输出可达502 PS/65.0 公斤力米，搭配8速双离合变速箱。虽然标志性的长车鼻不复存在，但凭借现代化的性能特质，它在GT赛事的核心组别里表现尤为惊艳。

vehicleCollection.zh:
全新一代中置布局Corvette。

2019年发布的第8代Corvette在动力总成上迎来重大变革，成为该系列首款采用中置布局的车型。全新6.2升V8“LT2”引擎输出可达502 PS/65.0 公斤力米，搭配8速双离合变速箱。虽然标志性的长车鼻不复存在，但凭借现代化的性能特质，它在GT赛事的核心组别里表现尤为惊艳。

brandCentral.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette is, without a doubt, an icon
of American sports car design.

And driving the legendary ‘Vette into the future is
this electrically-powered hypercar, the CX Concept.

Look at its Coke-bottle body, or the slope of its roof...
Doesn’t it remind you of the great Corvettes of old?

Naturally, its styling is rooted in aerodynamic principles,
resulting in marvellous performance on road and track.

But the best part is its novel fan-powered downforce system,
which ensures optimal aerodynamic balance across the car.

An all-wheel-drive electrified car, its 2,000 horsepower
are provided by four electric motors.

Big and bold, it’s a car that’s sure to carry the Corvette
spirit into a new era!
brandCentral.zh:
Chevrolet Corvette毫无疑问是
美国跑车设计的经典象征。

而引领传奇的Corvette驶入未来的正是这款
电动终极跑车——CX Concept。

面对那可乐瓶造型的车身，还有车顶的流线倾斜角度……
你是否会回想起那些经典的老Corvette？

它的造型自然地融入了空气动力学设计理念，
无论在公路还是赛道上都能展现卓越性能。

最精彩的是它的创新风扇下压力系统，
确保了整车的最佳空气动力学平衡。

作为全轮驱动的电力跑车，其四台电机提供了
2000马力的澎湃动力。

大气磅礴、大胆创新，这绝对是一款能将Corvette
精神传承到新时代的汽车！

catch.en: An electric hypercar that offered a glimpse into the future of the Corvette.
catch.zh: 令人窥见Corvette未来的电动终极跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An electric hypercar that offered a glimpse into the future of the Corvette.

The Corvette CX Concept was an all-wheel drive electric hypercar. At its core was a fan-powered downforce system, using fighter jet–style thrust vectoring to precisely balance aerodynamic forces between the front and rear.  This advanced setup allowed for more than 2,000 horsepower generated by four electric motors. Engineered to feel equally at home on both road and track, the CX Concept represented a bold new vision for the Corvette legacy.

long.en: The Corvette CX Concept was an all-wheel drive electric hypercar. At its core was a fan-powered downforce system, using fighter jet–style thrust vectoring to precisely balance aerodynamic forces between the front and rear.  This advanced setup allowed for more than 2,000 horsepower generated by four electric motors. Engineered to feel equally at home on both road and track, the CX Concept represented a bold new vision for the Corvette legacy.
long.zh: Corvette CX Concept是一款采用全轮驱动的电动终极跑车。该车配备风扇驱动下压力系统，通过类似战斗机的推力矢量控制技术，实现前后下压力的精确平衡。这一系统可以有效控制四台电机输出的超过2000马力的强劲动力。这款车既能轻松应对公路驾驶又适合赛道竞技，代表了美国跑车的未来发展方向。

cars.nameEn: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
cars.nameZh: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept

brandCentral.en:
The CX Concept is an electric hypercar that is meant
to carry the legendary Corvette line into the future.

Among its variants is the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo,
a beast that was built to defy the rules of the road.

Developed specifically for track use, it's lighter and more
aerodynamic than its sibling.

Powering its heart are three motors and a twin-turbo V8
that runs on e-fuel, perfect for range and endurance racing.

The car’s interior has been primed for competition, with
minute considerations made for cornering and steering.

Seen from the outside, its yellow and black coat harken
back to its GT racing pedigree.

The ultimate high-performance model, the CX.R is sure
to mark a new era of racing glory for the legendary ‘Vet
brandCentral.sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
brandCentral.zh:
CX Concept是一款电动终极跑车，承载着
将传奇Corvette产品线延续到未来的使命。

CX.R Vision Gran Turismo是其变体车型中的一员，
这是一款为打破道路常规而生的猛兽。

专为赛道驾驶而开发，相比同门车型更轻盈、
空气动力学优势更明显。

其动力核心由三台电机和一台双涡轮V8引擎组成，
采用电子燃料，非常适合长距离和耐力赛事。

车辆内饰完全按竞赛标准打造，
过弯和转向操控都经过精心考量。

从外观来看，黄黑相间的涂装彰显了
其GT赛车的纯正血统。

作为终极高性能车型，CX.R必将
为传奇的Corvette开启赛车荣耀的崭新篇章。

catch.en: A futuristic GT racer born from the Corvette lineage.
catch.zh: 诞生自Corvette车系的未来主义GT赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A futuristic GT racer born from the Corvette lineage.

The Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept is a track-only model based on the Corvette CX Concept. With enhanced aerodynamics and a dramatically lower ride height, it offers even greater performance capability. Under the skin, a hybrid powertrain combines electric motors with an e-fuel–driven engine, delivering the speed, endurance, and efficiency demanded by endurance racing.

long.en: The Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept is a track-only model based on the Corvette CX Concept. With enhanced aerodynamics and a dramatically lower ride height, it offers even greater performance capability. Under the skin, a hybrid powertrain combines electric motors with an e-fuel–driven engine, delivering the speed, endurance, and efficiency demanded by endurance racing.
long.zh: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept是基于Corvette CX Concept打造的纯赛道版本。相比其原型CX Concept，这款车拥有更出色的空气动力学性能和更小的离地间隙。该车搭载混合动力系统，电子燃料与电力驱动的组合，满足了耐力赛对高性能和长续航的双重要求。

conversation.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.speaker: Ed Welburn
conversation.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。

“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。

这辆车z头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。

每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。

cars.nameEn: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
cars.nameZh: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63

collection.en:
No sports car says 'America' quite like
the Chevrolet Corvette!

This second-generation model, also known as the Sting Ray
was especially popular.

Later versions featuring the L88 racing engine are very
collectable, and regularly sell for over $1 million.

This 1963 coupé is perhaps best known for its split
rear window.

It's a design feature that was only used in the first-year
models because it limited rear visibility.

The one-year 'split window' Sting Rays are hugely popular,
and are among the most collectable Corvettes.
collection.zh:
没有哪款跑车能比Chevrolet Corvette更能体现美国味！

其中，被称为Sting Ray的第二代Corvette车型特别受欢迎。

搭载L88赛车引擎的后期版本非常值得收藏，其售价经常
超过100万美元。

这款1963年的双门硬顶跑车车型最为人称道的是其分体式
后窗。

受限于狭窄的后窗视线，这一设计特征仅仅出现在首发
版车型上，随后就被取消了。

总而言之，搭载了分体式车窗的首发年Sting Ray极其受欢迎，
也是最有收藏价值的Corvette之一。

catch.en: This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.
catch.zh: 第2代Corvette，基于Stingray Racer打造的一款跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.

This generation played a pivotal role in cementing the Corvette’s reputation as the king of American sports cars. Its futuristic yet refined design captivated audiences worldwide. Its performance was equally impressive, thanks to a 5.4-liter OHV V-8 engine producing more than 295.9 HP, combined with 4-wheel independent suspension and a short wheelbase.

long.en: This generation played a pivotal role in cementing the Corvette’s reputation as the king of American sports cars. Its futuristic yet refined design captivated audiences worldwide. Its performance was equally impressive, thanks to a 5.4-liter OHV V-8 engine producing more than 295.9 HP, combined with 4-wheel independent suspension and a short wheelbase.
long.zh: 正是这款车让Corvette成为了美国跑车之王。由Stingray启发，兼具未来感和优雅的车身让全世界为之着迷。性能方面也非常出色：搭载的5.4升顶置阀门V8引擎输出超过300 PS，配备四轮独立悬挂和短轴距。

catch.en: Taking design cues from the Mako Shark II concept, this 3rd-gen Corvette was known for its distinctive character.
catch.zh: 第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
Taking design cues from the Mako Shark II concept, this 3rd-gen Corvette was known for its distinctive character.

The third-generation Corvette made its debut in the fall of 1967. Heavily inspired by Chevrolet’s 1965 show car, the Mako Shark II, it introduced a bold new coupe design, characterized by its curvaceous “coke bottle” silhouette, which instantly turned heads. Initially launched simply as the Corvette, the model brought back the Stingray name in 1969, along with a larger engine that added greater versatility and performance.

long.en: The third-generation Corvette made its debut in the fall of 1967. Initially launched simply as the Corvette, the model brought back the Stingray name in 1969, along with a larger engine that added greater versatility and performance.

usedCar.en:
The third-generation Corvette, also known as the C3, is one
of the most recognizable American cars in history.

One look and you know immediately that it's a 'Vette, right?

Inspired by the Mako Shark II concept vehicle designed by
Larry Shinoda, the C3 epitomized 1960s and 1970s style.

Under its hood was a no-nonsense V-8, whose displacement
was dependent on the model you chose.

In the 1970s, engine power was reduced to comply with
environmental regulations that resulted from the oil crisis.

But those changes predated this 1969 model, allowing drivers
to enjoy the Corvette C3 the way it was meant to be enjoyed.

variants.en:
This third-generation Corvette went by the designation of C3.

Back in the 1960s and 1970s, American V-8 engines
were categorized by their size.

Those with a displacement of 5.7 liters and less were called
"small block" V-8s.

Those with larger displacements were aptly called "big block"
V-8s. In fact, some people still use these terms.

The L46 in this 1969 Corvette C3 was one of the more
famous cars with a "small block" V-8.

It was a high-output engine, which packed around 50 HP
more than standard models.

If you want to really go old school, you can refer to the
engine's size in cubic inches.

In this case, 5.7 liters works out to 350 cubic inches.

Now you know where the "350" in its name comes from!
variants.zh:
这款第三代Chevrolet Corvette也称C3。

美产V8引擎倾向于根据排气量来分类。

排气量5.7L左右的引擎为
“小缸体引擎”...

排气量更大的则称为“大缸体引擎”。

这款1969年的Corvette C3中搭载的L46
引擎是最有名的“小缸体”引擎之一。

属于高马力引擎，比标准车型的马力
高50HP。

顺便一说，引擎排量在美国是用
立方英尺度量的。

5.7L等同于350立方英尺...

这也是车型名称350的出处。

usedCar.zh:
第三代Corvette，又称“C3”，是该系列
迄今为止最受欢迎的一款车型。

它的车身采用玻璃纤维增强塑料制成...

克尔维特充分利用这种柔性材料的优势
创造出了绝妙的设计，一经推出便即刻走红。

人们曾将其独特的轮廓比作一个可乐瓶！

在20世纪70年代石油危机期间，为了遵守
环境法规，C3的动力性能遭到了削减。

这款1969年的车型生产于削减之前，因此
鉴赏家们能够尽情享受到这个“美人”全速下的速度与激情。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Stingray version of the alluring 3rd-gen Corvette translated to more performance all around.

The 1968 Corvette Stingray drew its design inspiration from the Mako Shark II concept, which reimagined the Corvette as a sleek grand tourer. In 1969, the base engine displacement was increased from 327 to 350 cubic inches, although output remained at 295.9 HP. The following year, Chevrolet introduced the LT1 engine, producing 364.9 HP. This version earned praise for being the best handling C3 Corvette.

collection.en:
Let me introduce you to one of the most important cars in
the long history of the Corvette: the Sting Ray Racer.

Corvettes have been raced enthusiastically,
ever since their debut in 1954.

In 1957, Zora Arkus-Duntov, an engineer and keen
racing driver who worked for GM...

Produced the Corvette SS, the first Corvette built
specifically for racing.

This Sting Ray Racer is essentially a Corvette SS
with an open-top body.

It is based on drawings by Peter Brock, a renowned
designer of GM.

The development of the Sting Ray Racer was led by
Bill Mitchell, then the new GM design chief.

The design of the Sting Ray Racer is known for having had
a significant influence on the history of the Corvette.

Later, another GM desiger Lrry Shinoda, refined it
into the 2 Corvette.
collection.zh:
请允许我向您介绍Corvette的悠久历史中最重要的车型之一：
Sting Ray Racer。

自1954年首次亮相以来，Corvette就受到了赛车界的广泛欢迎。

当时为GM工作的工程师兼车手Zora Arkus-Duntov
特别热衷于驾驶它参赛。

1957年，他创造了Corvette SS，
是第一辆专门设计为竞赛用途的Corvette。

这台Stingray Racer本质上是一台采用了敞篷车身的SS。

它的车身设计由GM的著名工程师Peter Brock操刀，

赛道版则是在新任GM设计部主管Bill Mitchell监督下研发而来。

Sting Ray Racer的设计显著地影响了Corvette车系的发展史，

再后来，另一位GM的设计师Larry Shinoda又对这一设计
做出了改进，创ioQ经典的Corvette C2。*

catch.en: The '59 concept embodied a styling that swept the world and remains a part of Corvette history.
catch.zh: 席卷全球的先进设计风格持续数年，也未见衰减。

vehicleCollection.en:
The '59 concept embodied a styling that swept the world and remains a part of Corvette history.

The original Chevrolet Corvette earned numerous race victories. The Corvette SS, a purpose-built race car developed under the direction of GM engineer Zora Arkus-Duntov, featured a 364.9 HP fuel-injected 283 cubic inch engine, and was capable of reaching a top speed of 181.4 mph. However, following a major incident in NASCAR, the AMA imposed a ban on factory-backed race programs. The Stingray Racer was introduced as the successor to the Corvette SS and went on to win the SCCA Class C Modified title in 1959 and 1960.

long.en: The original Chevrolet Corvette earned numerous race victories. The Corvette SS, a purpose-built race car developed under the direction of GM engineer Zora Arkus-Duntov, featured a 364.9 HP fuel-injected 283 cubic inch engine, and was capable of reaching a top speed of 181.4 mph. However, following a major incident in NASCAR, the AMA imposed a ban on factory-backed race programs. The Stingray Racer was introduced as the successor to the Corvette SS and went on to win the SCCA Class C Modified title in 1959 and 1960.
long.zh: 初代Chevrolet Corvette获奖无数。由GM工程师佐拉·邓托夫主导设计的Corvette SS搭载370 PS的燃油助喷283引擎，最高速度达292 公里/小时。然而，在NASCAR发生的一起重大事故后，美国汽车制造商协会开始禁止汽车制造商参与比赛，该项目也被迫中止。Stingray Racer接替SS，在1959和1960年蝉联SCCA Class C改装车比赛的冠军。

brandCentral.en:
Ask someone to name the greatest American sports car,
and chances are, the answer will be the Corvette.

The model before you is the fifth-generation iteration—known
as the C5—a modern marvel of sports-car engineering.

This particular version revives a storied name: "Z06," a nod to
the second-generation Corvette’s renowned race package.

At its heart lies the LS6 engine—a compact yet formidable
<390ps> V-8 derived from the legendary LS1.

Naturally, the chassis has been refined, complemented by
competition-grade suspension and brakes.

A close relative of the C5-R race car, this Corvette masterfully
blends heritage with high-performance capability./
brandCentral.zh:
要问最伟大的美国跑车是哪一台，大部分人
都会回答“Corvette”。

在你眼前的就是被称为“C5”的第五代Corvette，
一辆堪称杰作的现代跑车。

更值得一提的是，因为它的型号名称“Z06”来源于第二代
赛车套件，所以还被赋予了“传奇重生”的意义。

其最为人称道的特性无疑是它的LS6动力单元。这款引擎基于
名声赫赫的LS1打造，体积虽小，却有<390ps>的强大动力。

不消说，它的底盘也得到了强化升级，并配备了
竞赛级悬挂和刹车。

作为“C5-R”的姐妹车型，这款第五代Corvette兼顾了
传统和性能，实在不可多得。

Unveiled in 2001, this reincarnated Z06 builds on the C5 platform
with enhanced suspension and upgraded brakes, and more.

Under the hood is a 5.7-liter V-8 producing <390ps>, paired with
weight-reduction measures to sharpen its edge.

Its notchback body sets it apart visually from the base model.
So, are you ready to find out what she’s really made of?

这款重生的Z06在2001年首次公开，是一款采用了
升级版悬挂和增强刹车的C5车型。

它由一台<390ps>马力的5.7升V8引擎提供动力，并辅以

掀背车身外形也是这款Z06的显著特征之一。

catch.zh: 第五代Corvette产品线中的巅峰之作，让Z06这个经典名字重新问世。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line variant of the fifth-generation Corvette revives the classic Z06 moniker.

The Corvette C5 lineup expanded in 1999 with the addition of a hardtop model, which increased body rigidity and improved performance. Even more appealing to enthusiasts was its lower price point compared to the standard model, which helped it gain strong support. In 2001, Chevrolet pushed the C5 platform even further with the Z06. Inspired by the spirit of the C2, it delivered outstanding performance and held the highest top speed of any production Corvette of its time.

long.en: The Corvette C5 lineup expanded in 1999 with the addition of a hardtop model, which increased body rigidity and improved performance. Even more appealing to enthusiasts was its lower price point compared to the standard model, which helped it gain strong support. In 2001, Chevrolet pushed the C5 platform even further with the Z06. Inspired by the spirit of the C2, it delivered outstanding performance and held the highest top speed of any production Corvette of its time.
long.zh: 1999年增列的Corvette C5硬顶车型利用新增的车体刚度优化了驾驶性能。更重要的是，新车型的售价低于标准车型，这也为它赢得了爱好者的广泛支持。2001年性能再度升级后的进化车型Z06让人联想到C2，并跻身全球量产车时速巅峰。

conversation.en:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations,
both on its inside and outside.

It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedge-shaped.

This is evident in the clamshell bonnet
and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

The ZR-1 made use of much wider rear tyres and fenders.

The interior was very much inspired by aircraft design.

Some people say that the C4 Corvette lacks
the ‘soul’ of a Corvette.

But I happen to like it plenty.

The Chevrolet Corvette really came into its own with the C4

Its 32-valve V-8 pumped out an impressive <380ps>...

...making it as powerful as many V-12-powered supercars of
its day, including the incredible Ferrari Testarossa!

Interestingly, the car was designed by Lotus, which was part of
General Motors at the time, and here's another fun fact:

The C4 ZR-1 was the first Corvette to be equipped with a 6-speed
manual transmission.

现今最强劲的Corvette都发源于这款

它搭载了一台32阀V8 DOHC引擎，马力高达<380ps>。

这台引擎的马力能与当时名声显赫的

有趣的是，这台引擎是由当时仍是General Motors子公司的
Lotus所设计的。

C4 ZR-1也是第一款配备了
六速手动变速箱的Corvette。

catch.en: The daunting ZR1 badge on the 4th-gen Corvette assured world-beating performance.
catch.zh: 这款C4 Corvette种类繁多的加配选项正好与他的特殊名号不谋而合。

vehicleCollection.en:
The daunting ZR1 badge on the 4th-gen Corvette assured world-beating performance.

The ZR-1 name first appeared in 1990 as a special high-performance package for the Corvette. At its heart was the LT5 engine, which featured an aluminum alloy block and a DOHC 4-valve head co-developed by Chevrolet and Lotus. While the standard Corvette engine produced 246.5 HP, the LT5 delivered 374.8 HP. Despite its price tag—twice that of a base Corvette—it’s said that Chevrolet made very little profit from the model, underscoring its role as a halo car rather than a volume seller.

long.en: The ZR-1 name first appeared in 1990 as a special high-performance package for the Corvette. At its heart was the LT5 engine, which featured an aluminum alloy block and a DOHC 4-valve head co-developed by Chevrolet and Lotus. While the standard Corvette engine produced 246.5 HP, the LT5 delivered 374.8 HP. Despite its price tag—twice that of a base Corvette—it’s said that Chevrolet made very little profit from the model, underscoring its role as a halo car rather than a volume seller.
long.zh: 1990年，ZR-1作为Corvette的特殊性能套件首次亮相。其核心是Chevrolet与Lotus联合开发的“LT5”引擎，该引擎采用铝制缸体配4气门双顶置凸轮轴气缸盖。标准引擎动力输出只有250 PS，而新引擎单元高达380 PS。其售价也是标准版Corvette的两倍，成为当时极为昂贵的车型。但即便如此，坊间传闻Chevrolet并未从该车型中获取多少利润。

brandCentral.en:
This ZR1 is the most potent version of the sixth-generation
Corvette.

It came with a hand-built and supercharged
V-8 engine that...

...pumped out an impressive <647ps> and <80kgm> of torque.

This is one flexible engine, with gobs of power coming
throughout the rpm spectrum.

It made waves when it first appeared by beating the
Nissan GT-R's time on the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

And what's really cool about this American sports car
is that it handles as good as it goes straight.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆ZR1是第六代科尔维特中最令人惊艳的一款。

此车拥有一台精心手工打造的机械增压V8引擎。

拥有<647ps>最高功率输出，以及<80kgm>扭矩，

在转速范围内产生的动力令人心动！

它的首次亮相就伴随着在纽博格林北侧赛道上击败日产GT-R
的大新闻，掀起了阵阵波澜……

ZR1证明了自己不只有动力，操控性也如梦如幻！

usedCar.en:
When it comes to sheer performance, the Corvette C6 ZR1
belongs among the elite supercars in the world.

Not only is the OHV V-8 powerful enough on its own, Chevy
raised the stakes by bolting a supercharger to it!

With power output of <646ps>, combined with a lightweight body,
you can imagine how this car went in a straight line.

The suspension system was also upgraded, so its handling
was on par with the supercars of its day.

There's a small window on the hood, providing a view of the
supercharger in all its glory.

Yes, this ZR1 proved that America could still build supercars.
usedCar.zh:
Corvette C6 ZR1的速度至今都称得上是
世界顶级。

给OHV V8引擎安装机械增压器是美国人提升
马力的传统方法。

作为一款在当时鲜见的轻量车，
ZR1依然能输出<647ps>的马力。

就连经验丰富的车手都对它的加速性能
大吃一惊！

另外，设计师在引擎盖上开小窗口就是为了让你能
瞥见涡轮增压器。

这小细节挺有意思的，你不觉得么？

catch.en: The 6th-gen Corvette ZR1 set one of the fastest lap times ever for a production car at the Nürburgring.

vehicleCollection.en:
The 6th-gen Corvette ZR1 set one of the fastest lap times ever for a production car at the Nürburgring.

From the debut of the C6 Z06 in 2005, the Chevrolet Corvette began to show not only the styling but also the performance credentials of a true supercar. By 2008, the ZR1 had taken things even further, matching its high-end rivals from Ferrari and Lamborghini in raw performance. Its supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 produced 638.1 HP, and with a curb weight of just 3325 lbs, it posted a Nürburgring lap time faster than that of the Nissan GT-R.

Its supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 produced 638.1 HP, and with a curb weight of just 3325 lbs, it posted a Nürburgring lap time faster than that of the Nissan GT-R.
long.zh: 自2005年C6 Z06问世以后，Chevrolet Corvette便展现出超级跑车级的性能与风范。2008款ZR1在性能上比肩Ferrari与Lamborghini的同级别车型。这台车搭载的6.2升V8机械增压引擎能迸发出647 PS强劲动力，整车重量更是只有1,508 公斤，在纽博格林赛道上一举刷新了Nissan GT-R创下的圈速纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
This monster Nova was a 2013 GT Award winner, equipped with the highest quality performance parts available.

It's an imaginative custom hot rod that made its debut at SEMA 2013. Based on a 1967 Chevrolet Nova body, it was outfitted with the supercharged 6.2-liter LS9 engine from the Corvette, paired with racing-grade components across the braking and suspension systems. It took home the prestigious GT Award that year.

When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.

Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!

From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,

staying in production for over a decade.

All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!

conversation.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of rces following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!

usedCar.en:
Hi there! Looking to buy a car? Might I suggest something
French, maybe with a lot of character?

If that sounds appealing to you, then you can’t go wrong
with this Citroën BX, a mega-hit family car of the 1980s.

The BX is packed with everything the French maker does best.
Why, even its styling recalls that of the storied GS and CX!

But the cherry on top is its hydropneumatic suspension,
offering rides so smooth it is likened to a 'magic carpet.'

Built to carry full loads on long drives, the 19 TRS is a grand
tourer model with a 1.9L engine.

The enduring popularity of the BX resulted in a 12-year run
of remarkable sales, making it one of the great French cars.
usedCar.zh:
你好！想买车吗？要不要考虑一款法国车，很有个性的那种？

如果这种说法听起来对你有吸引力，那么这辆Citroën BX
绝对不会让你失望，它可是80年代的家用车爆款。

BX集合了这家法国车厂的所有精华。
瞧，它的造型甚至让人想起传奇的GS和CX！

但最美妙的是它的液压气动悬挂系统，
平顺的行驶就像坐在“魔毯”上一样。

19 TRS是为满座长途旅行而生的豪华旅行版本，
搭载1.9升引擎。

BX经久不衰的人气让它连续热销12年，成就了法国汽车
的经典之作。

catch.en: Citroën’s versatile tourer receives a modern makeover.

vehicleCollection.en:
Citroën’s versatile tourer receives a modern makeover.

The BX made its debut at the 1982 Paris Salon. It carried forward the spirit of Citroën’s iconic GS and CX models while introducing a modern, geometric design language. The styling was penned by Marcello Gandini during his tenure at Bertone. True to Citroën tradition, the car featured the brand’s signature hydropneumatic suspension system. The 19 TRS model featured here was a grand tourer-style variant powered by a 1.9-liter gasoline engine.

This creative passion will forever be engraved into

profoundly shaped the automotive world.

catch.en: A historic vision of the future from France.
catch.zh: 畅想未来的法国历史车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A historic vision of the future from France.

The Citroën DS made its debut at the 1955 Paris Salon, introduced as a groundbreaking front-wheel-drive vehicle that combined a sleek aerodynamic profile with advanced hydropneumatic suspension. It quickly earned the nickname “flying saucer” for its appearance. Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the striking body was the work of designer Flaminio Bertoni. In 1964, Citroën introduced the upscale Pallas trim, followed by the addition of quad headlights in 1967. The DS 21 Pallas delivered refined performance from its 2.1-liter engine and remained in production for two decades.

long.en: The Citroën DS made its debut at the 1955 Paris Salon, introduced as a groundbreaking front-wheel-drive vehicle that combined a sleek aerodynamic profile with advanced hydropneumatic suspension. It quickly earned the nickname “flying saucer” for its appearance. Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the striking body was the work of designer Flaminio Bertoni. In 1964, Citroën introduced the upscale Pallas trim, followed by the addition of quad headlights in 1967. The DS 21 Pallas delivered refined performance from its 2.1-liter engine and remained in production for two decades.
long.zh: Citroën DS前驱车在1955年巴黎车展上首次亮相，革命性地集空气动力学车身与液压气动悬挂系统于一身。被用户昵称为“飞碟”。这台车的开发由安德雷·勒菲弗主导，而车身则由弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼设计。1964年这款车推出“Pallas”级车型，并在1967年升级为4盏大灯。2.1升的引擎让DS 21 Pallas在性能上优雅从容，这台车也持续生产了足足20年。

brandCentral.en:
The Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo was built to
comply with Japan's "kei car" specifications.

The engine is set at <660cc>, it can produce <150ps>,
almost 2.5 times as much as the standard Copen.

The "RJ" in the name stands for Racing Jacket.

You really feel like you are wearing the car

brandCentral.sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo是一款
按照日本的“轻型车”规格打造的跑车车型。

虽然引擎排量被限制在<660cc>，但仍能产生<150ps>的动力——

名称中的“RJ”代表赛车夹克。

这辆车的与众不同不仅在于激进的调校，时尚外观设计
也是加分项。

catch.en: A Vision Gran Turismo that represents the potential of kei cars.
catch.zh: 代表微型车潜力的Vision Gran Turismo。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Vision Gran Turismo that represents the potential of kei cars.

The Daihatsu Copen is a compact convertible that delivers a full sports car experience while staying within Japan’s kei-car regulations. The Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo is based on the second-generation model, which debuted in 2014. While it retains the kei-standard 660 cc engine, boost efficiency has been significantly improved, allowing it to produce 146.9 HP and 149.0 ft-lb of torque. Further weight reduction brings the car down to just 1323 lbs, enabling it to perform on par with larger-displacement sports cars. This bold, aspirational machine carried forward Daihatsu’s fighting spirit.

long.en: The Daihatsu Copen is a compact convertible that delivers a full sports car experience while staying within Japan’s kei-car regulations. The Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo is based on the second-generation model, which debuted in 2014. While it retains the kei-standard 660 cc engine, boost efficiency has been significantly improved, allowing it to produce 146.9 HP and 149.0 ft-lb of torque. Further weight reduction brings the car down to just 1323 lbs, enabling it to perform on par with larger-displacement sports cars. This bold, aspirational machine carried forward Daihatsu’s fighting spirit.
long.zh: Daihatsu Copen是一台符合“轻型车”标准的敞篷汽车，提供完整的跑车体验。Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo基于2014年发布的第2代车型打造。在满足660 立方厘米“轻型车”排量规范下，涡轮增压效率得到了提升，带来149 PS/20.6 公斤力米的动力输出。车身进一步减重至600 公斤，从而具备与大排量跑车一较高下的能力。这台车是一部延续Daihatsu战斗精神的雄心勃勃之作。

Daihatsu Copen是一台符合“轻型车”标准的敞篷汽车，提供完整的跑车体验。Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo基于2014年发布的第2代车型打造。在满足660 立方厘米“轻型车”排量规范下，涡轮增压效率得到了提升，带来149 PS/20.6 公斤力米的动力输出。车身进一步减重至600 公斤，从而具备与大排量跑车一较高下的能力。这台车是一部延续Daihatsu战斗精神的雄心勃勃之作。

brandCentral.en:
The DeLorean first exploded into the public consciousness
when it featured in the movie Back to the Future.

DMC, the company that built it, was founded by John Z.
DeLorean, a former vice president of General Motors.

Their first and only production model was the DMC-12, and
DeLorean himself oversaw the entire creation process.

DMC lasted less than two years after production began, but
the brand was subsequently acquired by another company.

The DeLorean seen here is the 'Series 2', a remake proposed
by the new DMC.

Its key feature is an improved <200ps> engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这款DeLorean凭借电影《回到未来》而为大众熟识，在当时红
极一时。

打造这辆车的DMC公司由前General Motors的副总裁
John Z. DeLorean创立。

DMC-12是他们的第一款，也是唯一一款量产型号，由DeLorean亲自
参与并领导了整个开发过程。

DMC在投产后只存在了短短不到两年的时间。好在品牌之
后被另一家公司收购，才得以存续下来。

这里的这辆DeLorean是“Series 2”，是由新DMC公司提议开发的重
制版，

主打强化动力的<200ps>引擎。

usedCar.en:
The DeLorean DMC-12 became world famous after it appeared
in the movie "Back to the Future."

This niche car's futuristic look made it the perfect choice
to be converted into a time machine

The car employed an RR layout, similar to that of the Porsche
911, but power from the V-6 was rated at only <130ps>.

Later versions would get an improved engine that delivered
up to <200ps>.

While the production run of this sports car was short, it
remains one of the most recognized American cars ever.
usedCar.zh:
DeLorean是永恒的经典，
备受世人推崇。

它在电影《回到未来》中强势出镜，
令许多电影发烧友一见倾心。

采用与Porsche 911相同的后置后驱布局，
V6引擎在发售时原本马力只有<130ps>。

“Series 2”车型采用经过改良的引擎，
将马力升至高达<200ps>。

绝对能让你的驾驶体验乐趣无穷！{

vehicleCollection.en:
At the request of DeLorean owners, the tuned-up Series 2 was created.

Formerly a vice president at GM, John Z. DeLorean struck out on his own to establish DeLorean Motor Company (DMC). The company’s first and only production model, the DMC-12, stood out with its bold stainless-steel body. Its signature gullwing doors quickly made it an icon, but despite its distinctive styling, the company went bankrupt in 1983. The owner of the newly reformed DMC, now dedicated to servicing and restoring original DeLoreans, answered the call from fans by releasing the Series 2 DeLorean, equipped with a 197.2 HP powerplant.

The owner of the newly reformed DMC, now dedicated to servicing and restoring original DeLoreans, answered the call from fans by releasing the Series 2 DeLorean, equipped with a 197.2 HP powerplant.

conversation.en:
The DS brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.

However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.

Aiming instead at a French "chic" imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.

And the "shark fin" of the central pillar represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
“DS”是由PSA集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的Citroën DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。

然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。

专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。

我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。

brandCentral.en:
The DS3 received its name from a line of luxury cars from Citroën
that were marketed from 1955 to 1975.

But the DS3, produced in 2009 to 2016, had very little
in common with those original models.

This car placed performance first, eventually becoming
one of the Continent's most popular hot hatches.

The DS3 Racing version was used as the foundation for the
French company's entry in the World Rally Championship.

A number of engine options were available, but the turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 was the most powerful at <200ps>.

Development of the car was overseen by Citroën Racing.&
brandCentral.zh:
DS是Citroën设立的豪华品牌，Citroën将其最优质的车型都归于该
品牌名下。

借助这个品牌，这家法国汽车制造商得以以清晰、充分
地展现品牌卓乎不群的设计感。

DS成立于2009年，DS3是其推出的第一款车。

DS3的赛车版本更是成为了世界拉力锦标赛参赛车的基础
车型。

这款前置前驱高性能掀背车的开发工作由Citroën Racing负责。
他当然没有懈怠，这款引擎可以产生超过<200ps>的动力。

vehicleCollection.en:
A performance car that boasted exceptional quality and a high level of uniqueness.

This premium compact was introduced in 2009. Although it shared its platform with the Citroën C3, it carried the DS badge and stood out with distinctive styling and a notably higher level of quality. The DS 3 Racing was a special edition released to commemorate the brand’s entry into the WRC in 2011. Developed by Citroën Racing, it featured a boost in engine output along with chassis enhancements.

Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"

 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!

 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.

This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!

设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！

brandCentral.en:
Designed to meet Japan's 'kei car' standards, the Copen
is a two-seater convertible with an FF layout.

While it may only sport a <660cc> engine, you'd do well to
not underestimate it!

A perfect car for those who like a bit of power, the Copen
also boasts a rigid chassis and precise handling.

Its electrically operated metal roof is also quite the
crowd-pleaser!
brandCentral.zh:
Copen是一款采用前置前驱布局的双座敞篷车，设计上非常
契合日本的“轻型车”标准。

虽然只采用了<660cc>的引擎，但您最好不要小瞧它！

对于那些对动力稍有追求的人来说，Copen也是一款完美的汽车，
拥有坚固的底盘和精准的操控，

还有电控的金属顶篷，也十分符合大众的审美！

usedCar.en:
The Copen is prized among Japanese 'kei' sports cars
for its performance and quality craftsmanship.

Its metal roof can be electronically extended or retracted
at the push of a button.

A four-cylinder engine sets it apart from other 'kei cars'
in its class.

Indeed, the Copen promises a smooth and satisfying ride.

The clean hum of its engine will make your heart sing on
the circuit.
usedCar.zh:
由于Copen优良的性能和制造工艺，
它成为了最受人喜爱的日本“Kei”轻型车之一。

这款车还配备了能一键收展的
电动金属车顶。

不同于其他“Kei”型跑车，
它还搭载了一台四缸发动机。

这辆车保准能为你提供既平稳又令人满足的驾驶体验。

在赛道上，
它清脆的引擎声能令你心花怒放。

catch.en: A kei car with a sports car heart, this little convertible was at home on the racetrack.

vehicleCollection.en:
A kei car with a sports car heart, this little convertible was at home on the racetrack.

First unveiled as the Kopen at the 1999 Tokyo Motor Show, this model entered production in 2002 as the Daihatsu Copen, becoming the company’s first fully convertible kei-class car. With a rigid yet lightweight body and a specially tuned suspension, the Copen delivered sharp and responsive handling. It also drew significant attention for being the first kei-car in the world to feature a power-operated retractable hardtop. Its unique charm led to exports to markets such as the UK and Australia.

long.en: First unveiled as the Kopen at the 1999 Tokyo Motor Show, this model entered production in 2002 as the Daihatsu Copen, becoming the company’s first fully convertible kei-class car. With a rigid yet lightweight body and a specially tuned suspension, the Copen delivered sharp and responsive handling. It also drew significant attention for being the first kei-car in the world to feature a power-operated retractable hardtop. Its unique charm led to exports to markets such as the UK and Australia.
long.zh: 这款车最初在1999年东京车展上以“Kopen”之名推出后，2002年作为Daihatsu首款全敞篷“轻型”车换以“Copen”之名发布。高强度轻量化的车身和特别调校的悬挂为这台车带来令人艳羡的操控性。作为世界上首台配备电动伸缩顶棚的“轻型”车，这台车备受关注，后续将出口到英国和澳大利亚等国家。

conversation.en: The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous Japanese formula race series. The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said to date back to the 1960s. The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963. Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars, or "touring cars" to be precise. Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own formula race scene. For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers had to study abroad... ...at famous race schools in England, where they learned the ins and outs of formula racing. After that, they teamed up with apanese automotive engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。

据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。

在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式车领域。

为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。

学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出^日本的第Rj款P程式赛车。

brandCentral.en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Honda-made engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Dallara SF23 Super Formula是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由Toyota和Honda
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由Honda制造的引擎。

catch.en: The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports
catch.zh: 全新进化的超级方程式赛车旨在为赛车运动提供更高的可持续性。

The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

The Dallara SF23 Super Formula made its debut in the spring of 2023 as the latest machine for the Super Formula series. Developed under the “SUPER FORMULA NEXT50” initiative, the car aimed to promote sustainability in motorsports. It incorporated biocomposite materials, while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. Engines were supplied by Toyota and Honda.

brandCentral.en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Toyota-made engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆达拉拉SF23超级方程式是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由丰田和本田
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由丰田制造的引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

The Dallara SF23 Super Formula made its debut in the spring of 2023 as the latest machine for the Super Formula series. Developed under the “SUPER FORMULA NEXT50” initiative, the car aimed to promote sustainability in motorsports. It incorporated biocomposite materials, while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. Engines were supplied by Toyota and Honda.

collection.en:
Giorgetto Giugiaro is a legend in the world of car design.

He's worked on so many great cars, it would be hard to pick
just one to define him.

But if I had to choose...

...I'd go for the De Tomaso Mangusta, a car he designed
while working for Carrozzeria Ghia.

The Mangusta looks more striking than many of Giugiaro's
later designs.

There's something elegant about its sleek lines. It’s a simple
design, and yet it's glamorous and muscular, too.

The Mangusta bowed in 1966, and only 400 were produced.
It's powered by a Ford overhead valve V-8.

These days they're highly sought-after as early examples
of Giugiaro's genius.
collection.zh:
Giorgetto Giugiaro是汽车设计界的传奇人物。

他曾参与过许多伟大汽车的设计，因此很难只用一款车
来定义他的设计风格。

但如果一定要选的话……

我会选择这台De Tomaso Mangusta，
这是他在为Carrozzeria Ghia工作时设计的车。

与Giugiaro后来的诸多设计相比，Mangusta感觉更抓人眼球。

其流畅顺滑的线条带着几分优雅……设计虽简单，但却
魅力四射，充满力量感。

Mangusta在1966年首次亮相，搭载Ford顶置气门V8引擎，
总共只生产了400辆。

如今，这一车型作为Giugiaro天才设计的早期范例而备受收藏
者追捧。

catch.en: This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.
catch.zh: 这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. Weighing approximately 1.3 tons, the car could reach a top speed of 155.3 mph, thanks to its lightweight construction. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.

long.en: This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.

collection.en:
The De Tomaso Mangusta is an iconic 1960s sports car.

It is one of car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro's
most legendary creations,

and its value has risen quite a bit in recent years.

Now we have a very interesting chapter
added to the history of the Mangusta.

Introducing a Gran Turismo original, the Mangusta
"Christian Dior."

This car was created in collaboration with
the famous French couture house Christian Dior.

The aim of Dior here was to infuse the sports car
with ts elegant brand essence.

The designer who worked on this project is Kim Jones,
Dior Men's Artistic Director

The Mangusta he customized is characterized by its chic body
color and stripe, and the "Dior" signature on its side.

The racing numbr 47 on the body is also strongly tied
to the history of the Dior Brand.<>
Last but noleast a special racing suit and helmet
have been designed specifically to accompany his Maguta!
collection.zh:
De Tomaso Mangusta是一辆标志性的1960年代跑车。

它是设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗最传奇的杰作之一，

其收藏价值也在近年来大幅飙升。

如今，我们又为Mangusta的辉煌历史添加了一段非常有趣的篇章，

为大家带来一款跑车浪漫旅原创车型：
Mangusta "Christian Dior"。

这辆车是和知名法国高定时装品牌
Christian Dior联手打造的。

由Dior为这辆跑车注入品牌的优雅血统。

参与本项目开发的设计师是金·琼斯，
他同时也是Dior男装部门的艺术总监。

这款由他亲手打造的Mangusta拥有雅致的奶油/暗金配色和
条纹图案。当然，车身侧面也不忘打上“Dior”的标记。

车47号赛车号码也与
Dior的牌历史有着密切的联系h

catch.en: This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.
catch.zh: 这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. Weighing approximately 1.3 tons, the car could reach a top speed of 155.3 mph, thanks to its lightweight construction. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.

The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.

conversation.en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.

This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."

This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.

However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...

...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.

Power is provided by a HEMI engin.

On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."

When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.

If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger /T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
A
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。

这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。

这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。

不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……

无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。

此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。

引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”

这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。

如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Chalenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。

collection.en:
This is a 1970 model, first-generation Dodge Challenger.

And it happens to be an R/T series, powered by a 426 Hemi
engine, which features hemispherical combustion chambers.

The 1970 models debuted in 1969, and customers had a choice
between the basic straight-six model and this R/T.

The basic model was classified as a "pony car," while the R/T
was considered a true muscle car.

Relatively few Dodge Challenger R/Ts were produced,
so today they are worth quite a lot.

In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this Hemi R/T is a true
collector's item.
collection.zh:
这是第一代的Dodge Challenger，推出于1970年，

而且它恰好是台R/T版本，由一台426 Hemi引擎驱动。
这是一台使用半球形燃烧室的引擎。

1970年车款在1969年亮相，消费者可在两款车型中进行选择：
基础款的直列6缸版本和这款R/T版本。

基础款的定位是一辆“小马车”，而R/T才是真正的肌肉车。

Dodge Challenger R/T的产量相对较少，
因此它们今天的售价也非常高昂。

实事求是地说，这辆配备了Hemi引擎的R/T敞篷车是一辆真
正值得收藏的珍品！

catch.en: The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.
catch.zh: 顶级Challenger，用设计抓住了大量用户的心。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.

This Dodge sports coupe was introduced in 1970, built on the same E-body chassis as the Plymouth Barracuda. Targeting the booming pony car segment favored by younger drivers, it was offered in both hardtop and convertible variants. The high-performance R/T (Road/Track) trim sat at the top of the range, positioned above the standard inline-6 and V-8 models.
