dialogues.en:
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is a beast!

A ‘well-executed beast’, with a bold and purposeful design
that emphasised functionality!

The SRT Demon is a very intimidating
modern day muscle car...

With bold fender flares and bonnet scoops...

as well as deep-offset wheels that say power—
lots of power!
E
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.zh:
这辆Dodge Challenger SRT Demon绝对是最凶猛的野兽！

SRT Demon是一辆开发得当的性能机器，
采用了激进但目的明确，强调功能性的设计，

是一辆令人望而生畏的现代肌肉车。

它的挡泥板和引擎盖进气口相当粗犷……

缩小偏距使得轮毂外凸，传递出令人无法抗拒的力量感，
而它也确实拥有与外观匹配的性能！

brandCentral.en:
The Challenger SRT Demon is Dodge’s most menacing
muscle car, no doubt about it.

Inspired by drag racing machines, its specially-tuned
V-8 was capable of pumping out more than 800 hp.

Combine that with its hearty torque figures, this car
accelerated with the best of them.

It reached the quarter-mile mark in just 9.65 seconds!

In fact, this car was so quick that it was banned from
drag racing in North America.

What’s more, Dodge sold performance kits for the Demon
the likes of which you won’t find anywhere else.

It was a modern American muscle car that was truly
in a league of its own.[
brandCentral.zh:
毋庸置疑，Challenger SRT Demon是
Dodge旗下性能最极致的肌肉车。

这款车的设计思路偏重于打造一款直线加速赛车，并采用
一部特殊调校的V8引擎，可以输出超过800 hp的动力。

无论是起步速度还是加速性能，都足以
跻身全球的最前列……

毕竟，它能在9.65秒内跑完400米的距离！

而更令人大跌眼镜的是，因为这辆车的速度实在太快，
以至于在北美被禁止参加直线加速赛。

此外，Dodge还不失时机地推出了Demon性能套件，
而且只此一家，别无分号。

这是一辆现代化的美式肌肉车，
拥有独树一帜的特点和性能。

catch.en: A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.
catch.zh: 这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.

In 2008, Dodge revived the Challenger nameplate for a new third generation, honoring the legacy of the original muscle car icon. Since its return, several high-performance variants have been introduced, but the standout came in 2018. The SRT Demon was an uncompromising machine built for drag racing dominance. Tuned to deliver 840.2 HP on 100-octane or higher fuel, the Demon could storm through the quarter mile in a jaw-dropping 9.65 seconds.

long.en: In 2008, Dodge revived the Challenger nameplate for a new third generation, honoring the legacy of the original muscle car icon. Since its return, several high-performance variants have been introduced, but the standout came in 2018. The SRT Demon was an uncompromising machine built for drag racing dominance. Tuned to deliver 840.2 HP on 100-octane or higher fuel, the Demon could storm through the quarter mile in a jaw-dropping 9.65 seconds.
long.zh: 第三代Dodge Challenger于2008年推出，旨在传承初代Challenger这一经典肌肉车的传奇。此车自问世以来推出了众多高性能车型，但真正的巅峰之作诞生于2018年。这就是SRT Demon，一台专为统治直线加速赛而生的怪兽级赛车。使用100或更高辛烷值燃油时可输出852 PS，四分之一英里加速仅需惊人的9.65秒。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

第三代Dodge Challenger于2008年推出，旨在传承初代Challenger这一经典肌肉车的传奇。此车自问世以来推出了众多高性能车型，但真正的巅峰之作诞生于2018年。这就是SRT Demon，一台专为统治直线加速赛而生的怪兽级赛车。使用100或更高辛烷值燃油时可输出852 PS，四分之一英里加速仅需惊人的9.65秒。

collection.en:
Even if you weren't around to experience the muscle car boom
that dominated the American automotive scene in the 1960s...

...I'll bet that your heart skipped a beat whenever
you saw one of them in action in a movie or on the TV.

The 1968 Dodge Charger is one of the great
masterpieces of the American muscle car genre.

The body style alone is enough to turn heads.

The "twin diamond" shape of the profile
is one of the trademarks of the 1968 model.

And of course, you can't have a mscle car
without the muscle.

This Charger is the sportier R/T grade, but it also...

...comes with the 426 Hemi,
Mopar's most powerful engine option available at the time.

If you're building a muscle car collection,
this is one car you can'tafford to miss.
collection.zh:
即便没有亲身经历过1960年代震撼了
整个美国汽车行业的肌肉车黄金时代……

但我敢打赌，只要你在影视作品里看到一辆
这样风驰电掣的车，你的心跳也一定会随之而加速。

这辆1968款Dodge Charger堪称
美国肌肉车中最伟大的杰作之一。

双菱形的轮廓是1968款的标志性特征之一，

仅凭车身就足以吸引到所有人的注目。

当然了，如果没有强大的“肌肉”，
那怎么能算是一辆肌肉车呢？

这辆Charger R/T强调运动性，

安装了当时Mopar’能提供的最强大的引擎——426 Hemi动力单元。

如果你有心打造一套肌肉车收藏，那么这辆车绝对不容错过。

catch.en: This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.
catch.zh: 一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

vehicleCollection.en:
This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.

Introduced in 1966, the Dodge Charger was Chrysler’s response to the muscle car wave that swept across the United States during the 1960s. It quickly gained popularity for its laid-back styling and the widespread availability of powerful, large-displacement V-8s across the lineup. In 1968, the high-performance R/T (Road/Track) variant was introduced, featuring upgraded suspension and brakes, along with the option of the legendary 426 Hemi engine.

long.en: Introduced in 1966, the Dodge Charger was Chrysler’s response to the muscle car wave that swept across the United States during the 1960s. It quickly gained popularity for its laid-back styling and the widespread availability of powerful, large-displacement V-8s across the lineup. In 1968, the high-performance R/T (Road/Track) variant was introduced, featuring upgraded suspension and brakes, along with the option of the legendary 426 Hemi engine.
long.zh: Dodge Charger于1966年问世，是Chrysler对1960年代席卷美国的肌肉车热潮的回应。这款车凭借其从容的造型以及全系搭载大排量V8引擎而广受欢迎。1968款车型推出了高性能的R/T（公路/赛道）版本，配备升级版悬挂和制动系统，并可选装426 Hemi引擎。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

Dodge Charger于1966年问世，是Chrysler对1960年代席卷美国的肌肉车热潮的回应。这款车凭借其从容的造型以及全系搭载大排量V8引擎而广受欢迎。1968款车型推出了高性能的R/T（公路/赛道）版本，配备升级版悬挂和制动系统，并可选装426 Hemi引擎。

conversation.en:
Does this Dodge Charger SRT belong to you,
by any chance?
f
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh: 这台是你的道奇Charger SRT吗？

conversation.en:
Wait a minute! Aren’t you… Tom Matano? The famous
designer who worked for GM, BMW, and Mazda?
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
等一等，您……您是不是……俣野汤姆先生？
在通用汽车、宝马和马自达担任要职的著名设计师？
N

conversation.en: That's right. Nice to meet you both.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh: 是的。很高兴见到你们。

conversation.en:
Wow, Mr. Matano, it's truly an honour to meet you!

Mr. Tsutomu Matano is known for his work on
the Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster.

He's worked in Europe and America for quite a while now
and is widely known as Tom Matano.
!
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
哇，俣野努先生，能见到您实在是我们的荣幸！

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster
而被人们所熟知。

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，
而他的绰号“俣野汤姆”也因此闻名于世。

conversation.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.

A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

It’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.

This car is a celebration of American ‘inclusive design’...

Offering supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.

I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。

作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，

从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。

我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆克莱斯勒300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

conversation.en:
Thank you for sharing that with us!
W
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh: 感谢您与我们分享这些知识！

conversation.en:
I look forward to discussing car design in more depth
the next time we get the chance!
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh: 很期待跟你们详细聊车辆设计的事，等下次有机会吧。

brandCentral.en:
The Dodge Charger SRT is among the world's most
powerful sedans.

With more than <700ps> on tap, it can reach speeds
of approximately <330km/h>.

In case you didn't know, the "SRT" in its name stands for
Street and Racing Technology.

It's made up of a group of engineers within Dodge who specialize
in developing high-performance vehicles.

This means that if you see a car with an SRT badge on it, you
might want to think twice before challenging it to a race.
brandCentral.zh:
道奇Charger SRT是世界上最快的四门轿车之一。

其马力超过了<700ps>，最高时速可达到近<330km/h>。

您可能不知道，“SRT”代表了“街道和赛车技术”
。

这个研发团队专门从事高性能汽车的开发。

不消说，任何名字中带有SRT的车都不容小觑。

catch.en: Dodge pulls no punches with the Charger SRT Hellcat, one of the most potent sedans in the world.
catch.zh: 顶级性能的Charger，速度创下世界纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
Dodge pulls no punches with the Charger SRT Hellcat, one of the most potent sedans in the world.

The car shown here represents the most extreme performance version of the third-generation Charger, which originally launched in 2005. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the Charger SRT Hellcat adds a supercharger to the 6.2-liter Hemi V-8, resulting in 707.1 HP and 585.9 ft-lb of torque. Capable of accelerating from zero to 60 mph in just 3.7 seconds and reaching a top speed of 203.8 mph, it briefly held the title of the world’s fastest 4-door sedan.

long.en: The car shown here represents the most extreme performance version of the third-generation Charger, which originally launched in 2005. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the Charger SRT Hellcat adds a supercharger to the 6.2-liter Hemi V-8, resulting in 707.1 HP and 585.9 ft-lb of torque. Capable of accelerating from zero to 60 mph in just 3.7 seconds and reaching a top speed of 203.8 mph, it briefly held the title of the world’s fastest 4-door sedan.
long.zh: 这款车是2005年首次亮相的第三代Charger系列中性能最极致的车型。Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT开发的Hellcat为6.2升V8 Hemi引擎加装了机械增压器，从而得以输出天文数字般的717 PS/81.0 公斤力米。能够在3.7秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达328 公里/小时，Hellcat曾一度是世界上最快的4门轿车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
顶级性能的Charger，速度创下世界纪录。

这款车是2005年首次亮相的第三代Charger系列中性能最极致的车型。Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT开发的Hellcat为6.2升V8 Hemi引擎加装了机械增压器，从而得以输出天文数字般的717 PS/81.0 公斤力米。能够在3.7秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达328 公里/小时，Hellcat曾一度是世界上最快的4门轿车。

cars.nameEn: Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Safety Car
cars.nameZh: Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Safety Car

brandCentral.en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

It features a light bar on the roof, and spotlight-equipped
wing mirrors.

It's also equipped with other specialist equipment, such
as bullbars.

The Charger is actually used as a patrol car by some US
police departments.>
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat开发。

它的车顶上安装了一组灯条，后视镜上安装了聚光灯，

车身上还添加了一些特种装备，如专用防撞保险杠等。

顺带一提，Charger本身就是许多美国城市警察局的警用巡逻车。:

catch.en: This ultra high performance Charger set a world speed record, going 222 mph on the Bonneville Salt Flats.
catch.zh: 这款超高性能的Charger创下了全球最高速度纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra high performance Charger set a world speed record, going 222 mph on the Bonneville Salt Flats.

Introduced in 2014, the Charger SRT Hellcat stands as one of the most powerful and extreme models in the Charger’s long-running legacy, which dates back to 1966. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the car produces 707.1 HP and reaches a top speed of 204 mph. This safety car version is a Gran Turismo Original model.

long.en: Introduced in 2014, the Charger SRT Hellcat stands as one of the most powerful and extreme models in the Charger’s long-running legacy, which dates back to 1966. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the car produces 707.1 HP and reaches a top speed of 204 mph. This safety car version is a Gran Turismo Original model.
long.zh: 2014年推出的Charger SRT Hellcat或许是自1966年延续至今的Dodge Charger历史上最强劲的车型。由Chrysler高性能开发团队SRT开发，可输出717 PS，最高时速达328.3 公里/小时。这款安全车版本是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款超高性能的Charger创下了全球最高速度纪录。

2014年推出的Charger SRT Hellcat或许是自1966年延续至今的Dodge Charger历史上最强劲的车型。由Chrysler高性能开发团队SRT开发，可输出717 PS，最高时速达328.3 公里/小时。这款安全车版本是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

cars.nameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Dodge SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT was specially designed for the
racing circuit.

Its V10 engine and pneumatic system are able to produce a
whopping <1500ps>!

And did I mention the car only weighs <663kg>?

It's so fast the car even comes with a specially designed
G-suit to protect the driver!
brandCentral.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT是专门为赛车场设计的车款。

其V10引擎和气动系统能够产生令人震撼的<1500ps>动力！

更值得一提的是这辆车的重量仅仅只有<663kg>！

鉴于这辆车的速度过快，它甚至配备了专门设计的重力加速度
防护服来保护车手！

catch.en: A lightweight racing version of the visionary near-future single-seater concept.
catch.zh: 一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
A lightweight racing version of the visionary near-future single-seater concept.

This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. This mid-engine, all-wheel-drive single-seater featured a body constructed from advanced composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The GTS-R was the dedicated racing variant of the Tomahawk. Drivers were equipped with a specialized racing suit designed to cope with the extraordinary G-forces this machine can generate.

long.en: This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. This mid-engine, all-wheel-drive single-seater featured a body constructed from advanced composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The GTS-R was the dedicated racing variant of the Tomahawk. Drivers were equipped with a specialized racing suit designed to cope with the extraordinary G-forces this machine can generate.
long.zh: 这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。这辆GTS-R是来自Tomahawk的赛车版本。为了帮助车手应对驾驶这辆车时可能承受的强大重力加速度，甚至还附带了专用比赛服。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。这辆GTS-R是来自Tomahawk的赛车版本。为了帮助车手应对驾驶这辆车时可能承受的强大重力加速度，甚至还附带了专用比赛服。

cars.nameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Dodge SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk S VGT is considered the entry-level model.

Cutting-edge materials like carbon and graphene bring its
weight down to a mere <900kg>.

And despite the 'entry-level' tag, the engine is capable of
delivering more than <1000ps>!

I'd recommend trying to master this model before moving on
to the two more advanced ones!
brandCentral.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk S VGT是3台车中的入门级车型。

得益于碳纤维和石墨烯等尖端制造材料的应用，其重量
降至仅<900kg>。

尽管挂着“入门级”的标签，但它的引擎能够提供超过
<1000ps>的动力！

catch.en: Featuring more than 1000 horsepower from a V-10 and compressed air unit with near-future technology.
catch.zh: 凭借近未来技术控制超过1000马力的V10引擎和压缩空气设备。

vehicleCollection.en:
Featuring more than 1000 horsepower from a V-10 and compressed air unit with near-future technology.

This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. A mid-engine, 4-wheel-drive single-seater, its body was crafted from cutting-edge composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The "S" variant represented a more grounded interpretation of the Tomahawk, designed with considerations for open-road drivability. However, unlocking its full potential demanded near-superhuman reflexes from the driver.

The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The "S" variant represented a more grounded interpretation of the Tomahawk, designed with considerations for open-road drivability. However, unlocking its full potential demanded near-superhuman reflexes from the driver.
long.zh: 这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。“S”是Tomahawk的一款更贴近现实的车款，其设计着重考虑了公路行驶的场景。不过要将这辆车推向性能极限，需要驾驶者具备近乎超人般的反应速度。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.1 race car was based on
the Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT.

The compressed air system was removed so it conformed to
Gr.1 racing regulations.

Also, a fixed wing and shark fin were added to enhance
the car's aerodynamics.

But the biggest change of all was converting the once-all-wheel
drive car layout to rear-wheel drive.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆基于Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT所打造的Gr.1赛车。

为了符合Gr.1赛事规范，它的空气压缩系统被移除。

另外还加上了固定式尾翼和鲨鱼鳍，以增加空气阻力。

最后，它的传动系统也从四轮驱动更换为后轮驱动。

catch.en: A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.
catch.zh: 一款专用于Gr.1竞赛，配备中置引擎及后轮驱动的Tomahawk。

vehicleCollection.en:
A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1-spec version of the Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo was the result of a collaboration between Gran Turismo and Dodge. To ensure that its 700 horsepower-plus was effectively translated to the ground, the car was outfitted with aerodynamic enhancements. These included an extended front splitter, a prominent rear wing, and four canards.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1-spec version of the Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo was the result of a collaboration between Gran Turismo and Dodge. To ensure that its 700 horsepower-plus was effectively translated to the ground, the car was outfitted with aerodynamic enhancements. cars.nameZh: Dodge SRT Tomahawk X Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

And the SRT Tomahawk X VGT is the most advanced
of the three.

Its design was inspired by the concept of challenging
human boundaries.

That should explain why the engine was designed
to produce <2500ps>!

The creators imagined that the car would reach speeds
that would push the limits of human reflexes.

Movable aerodynamic panels, like those found on a fighter
jet, are affixed to its body to provide maximum downforce.

All this and more allow you to take corners in this car at
speeds of <500km/h>!;

Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后

这款SRT Tomahawk X VGT是3台车中最先进的一款！

其设计理念追求的是对人类极限的挑战。

这可能就是为什么此车的引擎最大输出功率能够达到<2500ps>
的原因！

在设计师的预想中，这台车的运行速度将挑战人类反应
速度的极限。

另外，车身上还装载了战斗机同款的可动空气动力学翼片，

这项技术奇迹将帮助您以高达<500km/h>的速度过弯。

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for something that'll give you a sense of what
a muscle car was, then give the Dodge Super Bee a look.

The size of the car was modest compared to its rivals,
billed back then as an "intermediate sedan."

But there was nothing intermediate about its power.
It came with a massive 6.0-liter V-8!

The thing rumbled like thunder when provoked, making the car
one of the fastest of its day.
usedCar.zh:
如果你要寻求纯粹的肌肉车体验，
那么道奇Super Bee无疑可以满足你。

这款车身稍偏小的
所谓“中型”轿车之下...

隐藏着一个巨大的V8引擎，
排气量高达6升以上！

毋庸赘言，其动力之充足，
不会让车手有丝毫怨言。.

catch.en: A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.
catch.zh: 搭载了一台7升的V8 Hemi引擎的Coronet，这辆“Super”车型创下了肌肉车历史。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.

The Dodge Super Bee was introduced in 1968 as a performance-focused yet affordable muscle car. It offered a range of powerful engine options, with the 7.0-liter V-8 producing 425 HP at the top of the lineup. True to its purpose, the car came with minimal comfort features. A facelifted version appeared in 1970, followed by the second-generation model in 1971, which was based on the Charger.

conversation.en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.

In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.

And t shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.

It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.

The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fders.

Thiis ho an American Sports car should be!
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。

但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。

不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强:的牵引力。

这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。

Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂e

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

brandCentral.en:
The first generation Dodge Viper made a splash in the
sports car world when it made its debut.

It was a stylish FR sports car with a potent V-10 engine.

Some were so awed by its prowess that they began calling it
the Corvette killer.

Did you know that Lamborghini was involved in developing
the Viper's engine and suspension?

That's because back then, Dodge and Lamborghini
were both owned by Chrysler.

Released in 1996, the Viper GTS had even more torque and
power than the original.
brandCentral.zh:
第一代Dodge Viper首次亮相即在美国的跑车行业引起了轰动。

这款强劲的前置后驱跑车配备了性能爆炸的V10引擎……

这款新秀很快就被人拿来与Corvette相提并论。

顺便问句，您知道Lamborghini参与了Viper的引擎和悬挂的开发吗？

那是因为Dodge和Lamborghini在当时都是Chrysler的子公司。

1996年，此车的GTS型号发布，扭矩和功率均有所改进。

usedCar.en:
Do you know who Bob Lutz is? He was one of the top auto
execs in the U.S. that many considered a real "car guy."

He worked for each of America's "Big Three" car companies, but
his claim to fame was the Corvette-conquering Dodge Viper.

It had a front-mounted 8.0-liter V-10, sourced from
a pickup truck no less!

The Viper saw plenty of action in endurance races at Le Mans
and the Nürburgring. The thing was a monster!
usedCar.zh:
你听说过Bob Lutz这个人吗？
他是美国顶尖的汽车行业高管——外号“汽车狂人”。

他不仅在汽车制造业三大厂中都任过职，
他还是大名鼎鼎的Dodge Viper——绰号“科尔维特杀手”的缔造者。

Viper GTS不仅搭载了前置8升V10引擎，
还换装了刚性底盘。

这款车的竞赛款参加过勒芒
和纽博格林的赛事——它不快才怪呢！

catch.en: With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.
catch.zh: 打破束缚的车型，推动Viper跑车进入超跑领域。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.

This coupe was developed to fully exploit the Viper’s performance potential. While its basic structure, suspension, and V-10 engine remained largely unchanged from the RT/10 roadster, power output was increased to 449.7 HP. The addition of a fixed roof allowed the car to reach a top speed of 185 mph—approximately 183.9 mph—surpassing the roadster’s 165-mph limit. Introduced alongside it, the GTS-R race version appeared in endurance events across the globe, where it consistently demonstrated its superior capabilities.

long.en: This coupe was developed to fully exploit the Viper’s performance potential. While its basic structure, suspension, and V-10 engine remained largely unchanged from the RT/10 roadster, power output was increased to 449.7 HP. The addition of a fixed roof allowed the car to reach a top speed of 185 mph—approximately 183.9 mph—surpassing the roadster’s 165-mph limit. Introduced alongside it, the GTS-R race version appeared in endurance events across the globe, where it consistently demonstrated its superior capabilities.
long.zh: 这款双门轿跑的设计宗旨是为了发挥出Viper的全部潜力。它原封不动地沿用了RT/10敞篷跑车的基础架构、悬挂和V10引擎，但动力输出增强到了456 PS。但因为改为了硬顶，这款车能够跑出185英里/小时（约296 公里/小时）的最高时速，较敞篷版的165英里/小时有了较大提升。于同一时间亮相的GTS-R版本参与了全球范围内的多项耐力赛，展示了其优越的性能。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
The third-generation Dodge Viper was definitely
in a class of its own.

The secret to its enhanced performance was a stronger
chassis with 50 percent more torsional rigidity.

This made it more stable through corners, so it handled better
than its predecessor, which is quite scary if you ask me.
brandCentral.zh:
第三代Dodge Viper的外观设计和驾驶体验自成一派！

它的性能提高秘诀在于更牢固的底盘，将抗扭刚性提升
了足足50%……

这意味着其能为驾驶者提供充足的动力以及精确的操控。

catch.en: This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.
catch.zh: 第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.

The third-generation Viper made its debut in 2012. A key highlight of this new model was that it was released under SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance brand. Although the V-10 engine retained its 8.4-liter displacement, numerous internal upgrades boosted output to 640 HP and 600.3 ft-lb of torque. As with previous generations, the chassis featured a steel tube frame, though torsional rigidity was improved by 50 percent. At the top of the range, the GTS offered an active suspension system.

long.en: The third-generation Viper made its debut in 2012. A key highlight of this new model was that it was released under SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance brand. Although the V-10 engine retained its 8.4-liter displacement, numerous internal upgrades boosted output to 640 HP and 600.3 ft-lb of torque. As with previous generations, the chassis featured a steel tube frame, though torsional rigidity was improved by 50 percent. At the top of the range, the GTS offered an active suspension system.
long.zh: 第三代Viper于2012年公布。这款新车型的主要亮点在于它将由Chrysler的高性能品牌SRT打造。尽管它的V10引擎依然保持8.4升的排量不变，但SRT对其内部进行了多项改良，让这部引擎能够输出649 PS/83.0 公斤力米。和前代车型相同，它采用了一套钢管空间车架，但刚性提升了50%。最高档的车型GTS还换用了主动式悬挂。

vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

Modifications include a front splitter, canards, and a
large rear wing.

The substantial increase in downforce ensures that the car

车身改装包括前定风翼、前翼，以及大尺寸尾翼。

这些改动大幅增加了下压力，确保这辆车可以轻松过弯。

catch.en: The third-generation Viper boasted extreme performance that was developed by the SRT division.
catch.zh: 第3代Viper，继承了SRT品牌的极致优越性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Viper boasted extreme performance that was developed by the SRT division.

This Gran Turismo Original took Dodge’s high-performance Viper and modified it to comply with Gr.4 regulations. Its exterior features an aggressive front splitter, aerodynamic canards, and a prominent rear wing to generate substantial downforce. The result is a machine that delivered impressive straight-line speed while offering significant potential through the corners as well.

long.en: This Gran Turismo Original took Dodge’s high-performance Viper and modified it to comply with Gr.4 regulations. Its exterior features an aggressive front splitter, aerodynamic canards, and a prominent rear wing to generate substantial downforce. The result is a machine that delivered impressive straight-line speed while offering significant potential through the corners as well.

2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，

brandCentral.en:
The Viper SRT GTS-R served as the starting point for this
FIA GT3 class vehicle.

The car is the product of a collaboration between two of the
leading experts at the top of their respective fields:

Chrysler's high-performance automobile division, SRT, and Riley
Technologies. Together they created a real track monster.

They reduced the car's weight to a mere <1200kg> and enhanced
aerodynamics to provide more downforce.

It's a formula that'll always produce results, and this Viper
did not disappoint, running at the top in numerous GT races.
brandCentral.zh:
Viper SRT GTS-R是这辆FIA GT3组别赛车的基础车型。

这台车由两个各自领域内顶尖的专家团队：

Chrysler的高性能汽车部门SRT
以及Riley Technologies携手打造。

总体车重被控制在<1200kg>以下，空气动力学性能也得到了进
一步加强。

这些改装取得了极大的成功，这辆车在GT赛事中的优异
表现就足以证明！

catch.en: A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.
catch.zh: 为私人赛车手打造的赛车，延续了GTS-R的血统。

vehicleCollection.en:
A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.

When the third-generation Viper appeared in 2012, it was accompanied by the announcement of a racing variant—the GTS-R. From that foundation, the GT3-R was developed as a customer-focused race machine for private teams. Created through a collaboration between SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, and Riley Technologies, it featured significant weight reduction and a host of aerodynamic upgrades. It quickly demonstrated its competitiveness, proving its racing potential in GT events across America and around the world.

long.en: When the third-generation Viper appeared in 2012, it was accompanied by the announcement of a racing variant—the GTS-R. From that foundation, the GT3-R was developed as a customer-focused race machine for private teams. Created through a collaboration between SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, and Riley Technologies, it featured significant weight reduction and a host of aerodynamic upgrades. It quickly demonstrated its competitiveness, proving its racing potential in GT events across America and around the world.
long.zh: 当第三代Viper于2012年首次亮相时，官方还公布会推出一款赛车车型，GTS-R。而GT3-R则是基于GTS-R，专为私人车队开发的一款GT3赛车。这个车型由Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT和Riley Technologies联合打造，他们对车重进行了大幅削减，还添加了许多空气动力学性能强化件。这辆车在北美和全球其他地区的GT比赛中证明了自己的竞速潜力。

brandCentral.en:
This second generation Viper was released in 2002.

Its 8.4L V10 engine offers <400cc> more displacement
than the first generation model...

And packs more than <600ps> of power!

What's more, it weighs <50kg> less than
its predecessor!

Put through its paces during extensive testing
at the Nürburgring...

This model has been successful in many European races!
brandCentral.zh:
这款第二代Viper于2002年发布。

其8.4升V10引擎比第一代车型的排量还要大<400cc>……

而且动力超过了<600ps>！

更重要的是，其重量比前一代车型还轻<50kg>！

此车在纽博格林赛道进行了广泛的测试，充分展现了自
身的实力……

随后，此车在许多欧洲举办的比赛中都取得了成功！

usedCar.en:
The SRT10 Coupe boasts a V10 engine that vastly improves
upon its predecessors.

With more displacement and over <600ps> of power,
it provides the strength expected of a Viper.

But that's not all—the SRT10 has undergone
all-round improvements.

The engine runs smoother than ever...

The handling is more stable and reliable...

And the clutch and transmission are more responsive
than ever before!
usedCar.zh:
SRT10 Coupe搭载了一台性能大幅优于
前代引擎的V10引擎。

这台引擎的排量更大，且马力超过了<600ps>，
使得Viper的名号实至名归。

除此之外，
SRT10还得到了全方位的改进。

它的引擎现在顺畅无比……

操控性更加稳定可靠……

连离合和传动也的响应
也变得更加迅速了！

With its lightweight body and an 8.3-liter V-10 producing 509.9 HP, the car possessed the performance to compete against its international rivals.

conversation.en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragmentsof my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.

The ach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。

我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得x加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！

代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我v变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，以至于我n脏
得不重新找地方安置。

“Mach 40”h…Ea，Z就D我Zuerh

If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragmentsof my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.

The ach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。

我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得x加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！

代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我v变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，以至于我n脏
得不重新找地方安置。

brandCentral.en:
Are you familiar with the Ford Mustang Mach 1 and GT40?

As the name suggests, the Mach 40 pays tribute to both of
these classic American race cars.

Produced by Eckert's Rod and Custom based in Oregon...

...this company specializes in custom restorations,
even creating original models from other cars.

This car has a fully customized body style of a
1969 Ford Mustang.

And it comes powered by the Ford GT's 5.4-liter V-8 engine,
mounted amidships.

This mesmerizing blend of two classics took home
the 2012 SEMA Gran Turismo Award!

其车身是对1969 Ford Mustang的完全定制，

内里是Ford出品一台GT 5.4L V8引擎，采用中置布局……

This Mustang, a 2012 GT Award Winner, possessed the heart of a Ford GT.

Unveiled at SEMA 2012, the car took home the prestigious GT Award.

The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.

Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.

Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blockscreated space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.

At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F43
and other subsequent Ferraris.
*

This Enzo Ferrari is a very special model made

Released in 2002 as a successor to the F40 and F50...

The Enzo is a mid-engine car with a 6L naturally aspirated
V12 engine capable of <660ps>.

Designed by Ken Okuyama, who worked for
Pininfarina at the time...

Its nose resembles that of a Formula One car.

And if you're wondering about its name,
Enzo Ferrari was the founder of the company!

如果您是问车型命名的缘由，那当然是因为恩佐·法拉利

catch.en: Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

vehicleCollection.en:
Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

This limited-production supercar, with only 399 units built, was launched in 2002 to commemorate Ferrari’s 55th anniversary. Its sharp-nosed, Formula 1-inspired design was the work of Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, then a designer at Pininfarina. The car was constructed with extensive use of carbon composites for both the body panels and much of the framework. At its heart was a specially developed 6.0-liter V-12 producing 650.9 HP and 484.6 ft-lb of torque, allowing the car to reach a top speed of more than 217.5 mph.

long.en: This limited-production supercar, with only 399 units built, was launched in 2002 to commemorate Ferrari’s 55th anniversary. Its sharp-nosed, Formula 1-inspired design was the work of Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, then a designer at Pininfarina. The car was constructed with extensive use of carbon composites for both the body panels and much of the framework. At its heart was a specially developed 6.0-liter V-12 producing 650.9 HP and 484.6 ft-lb of torque, allowing the car to reach a top speed of more than 217.5 mph.

I love the 2008 FIAT 500! It's so
whimsical and fun.

Really, it does a masterful job of improving upon
its forebear.

Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.

But here's an example that truly inspires!

The face is friendly, with its round eyes.

You could have a parking lot full of them, all in the same

Given its retro design, the retro colouring suits it

vehicleCollection.en:
The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.

Thanks to its affordable pricing and endearing styling, the original FIAT 500 sold more than four million units over its 20-year production run starting in 1957. Half a century after the second-generation model, the third-generation FIAT 500 arrived. Making its debut at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the new Fiat 500 launched to widespread acclaim in the summer of 2007. It was affectionately known around the world as the Cinquecento—Italian for “500."

long.en: Thanks to its affordable pricing and endearing styling, the original FIAT 500 sold more than four million units over its 20-year production run starting in 1957. Half a century after the second-generation model, the third-generation FIAT 500 arrived. Making its debut at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the new Fiat 500 launched to widespread acclaim in the summer of 2007. It was affectionately known around the world as the Cinquecento—Italian for “500."

Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini,
This Italian FIAT 500…

Is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.

It may be the smallest of its rivals...

But it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little motor
is capable of thrilling speeds.

Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed
FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa...

As is its underlying design.

Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure
you'll come across them in time!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
与德国的Beetle和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的FIAT 500……

是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。

和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……

但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。

它华丽的外观由著名的FIAT工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，

他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。

吉奥科萨为FIAT创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。

conversation.en:
This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.

The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer
Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy
of FIAT for many, many years.

At under <3m> in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly
fit four people thanks to a space-saving rear-engine.

It is celebrated to this day for its undeniable charm.

You can see where the modern FIAT 500
got its good looks from!
S
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
这款稀世珍品诠释了意大利汽车制造业的外在之美。

FIAT 500于1957年问世。

被认为是极富传奇色彩的FIAT汽车设计大师但特·吉奥科萨的
代表作之一，这款车型久盛不衰，是永恒的经典。

吉奥科萨为FIAT设计多年，留下许多非凡的作品。

这款车总长不到<3m>，是紧凑型汽车，但由于
配置了省空间的后置引擎，因此可以容纳4人。

这款车的魅力毋庸置疑，因而久负盛名……

我们一眼就能看出具备现代感的
FIAT 500外观有多吸睛！

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic

Q
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。

conversation.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packagedcar.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also qite appealing,
not to mention functional.
4
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。

菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款x加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。

在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感i

它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一Li慵懒闲适n引，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

conversation.en:
Thank you for the deeply insightful explanation.
Q

My pleasure! I hope we can discuss car design
again sometime.

conversation.zh: 不必客气，我们有机会再多聊一聊汽车设计吧。

usedCar.en:
The FIAT 500 F is one of the most recognisable Italian cars
in history.

It has a rear-engine, rear-wheel drive layout,
and hauls an air-cooled two-cylinder engine.

In this respect, it resembles no less a car than
the Porsche 911!

This later model features conventional front-hinged doors.

Despite having debuted half a century ago, the legacy of this
iconic car lives on in the modern FIAT 500.]
usedCar.zh:
FIAT 500 F是历史上最著名的
意大利车之一。

它采用了后置后驱布局，
并搭载了一台风冷双气缸引擎。

从这个角度上看，这辆车其实和
Porsche 911差不多！

此款后期的型号安装了便捷地前开式车门。

虽已是年过半百的老车，
这款标志性车型的设计精神在现代的FIAT 500中得以延续。

catch.en: Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.
catch.zh: 功能全面，价格合理，还能用于竞速。一款充满乐趣的极简原创车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.

The car symbolized FIAT’s original mission of delivering accessible, everyday mobility. The first 500, born in 1957, featured an extremely compact body housing a 497 cc engine with just 14.8 HP, mounted at the rear. Despite its modest power, the car offered surprising practicality and affordability, quickly gaining popularity and spawning numerous Abarth-tuned variants. The F model introduced front-hinged doors for the first time.

long.en: The car symbolized FIAT’s original mission of delivering accessible, everyday mobility. The first 500, born in 1957, featured an extremely compact body housing a 497 cc engine with just 14.8 HP, mounted at the rear. Despite its modest power, the car offered surprising practicality and affordability, quickly gaining popularity and spawning numerous Abarth-tuned variants. The F model introduced front-hinged doors for the first time.
long.zh: 这款车标志着FIAT公司实现了为大众市场制造汽车这一目标。诞生于1957年，这款车以极其紧凑的车身在尾部搭载了15 PS的497 立方厘米引擎。这台车虽然小巧，但非常实用，且凭借低廉的价格广受欢迎，甚至催生了众多Abarth的改装版本。F车型首次采用前铰链式车门。

vehicleCollection.zh:

conversation.en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.

The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.
+
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
我认为这辆小巧的FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。

特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。

这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……

特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。

usedCar.en:
Many consider the early 1960s as Abarth's golden era.

A big part of the reason is because of the 500 Esseesse.

Although it only produces a mere <32ps>, which might
lead you to think it's underpowered...

...but in fact, its small, light construction gave it
a surprising amount of pep.

In fact, its performance is nothing short of incredible.

Esseesse, incidentally, is the Italian pronunciation
of SS, which stands for Super Sport.
usedCar.zh:
许多人认为1960年代是Abarth的
黄金年代。

500 Esseesse就是该时期的标志。

只能输出<32ps>，这可能会让人觉得
马力不足。

然而，这样小型而轻量的构造却会产生
惊人的速度。

实际上，它的性能非常魔幻。

顺便说一句，Esseesse是意大利语

vehicleCollection.en:
A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.

The FIAT Abarth 595 made its debut in 1963. It was derived from the second-generation FIAT 500 tuned by Abarth. An even more potent variant of the 595 later emerged as the 595 Esseesse. While it retained the same engine displacement, engineers raised compression to boost output to 31.6 HP. Thanks to this added performance, the 595 lineup made its mark in European racing, dominating the under 600 cc category.

usedCar.en:
Perfect timing! I just received this little Italian gem—
a first-generation 1985 FIAT Panda.

This car debuted in 1980, during the global oil crisis,
when small, economical cars were in high demand.

Intended as a replacement for the 126, it was penned by
none other than master designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

To keep costs low, Giugiaro opted for a simple, boxy shape
that still managed to get across a modern sense of luxury.

The Panda came in a choice of <652cc> and <903cc> engines.
This is powered by the former, making it light and zippy.

Giugiaro’s self-proclaimed masterpiece, the Panda is one car
you can’t do without!'
usedCar.zh:
你来得正好！我刚收到这台意大利宝藏小车——
1985年的第一代FIAT Panda。

这款车于1980年问世，当时正值全球石油危机时期，
小巧省油的车型备受青睐。

作为126的换代车型，它由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗
亲自操刀设计。

为控制成本，乔治亚罗采用了简洁的方正造型，
却依然营造出精致的现代感。

Panda提供<652cc>和<903cc>两种引擎。
这辆搭载的是前者，因此车身轻巧、动力灵敏。

被乔治亚罗自称为得意之作的Panda，
绝对是一款让人爱不释手的经典车型！

vehicleCollection.en:
This jewel of a compact car is the one designer Giugiaro called his greatest work.

The FIAT Panda is a front-wheel-drive hatchback introduced in 1980, born amid the compact-car boom that followed the oil crises. Its design was penned by the master stylist Giorgetto Giugiaro. To keep costs low, the body was crafted with straight lines and flat panels, achieving a look that was both practical and modern. At launch, buyers could choose between an air-cooled 652 cc 2-cylinder engine or a water-cooled 903 cc 4-cylinder unit. The model featured in Gran Turismo is the former.

long.en: The FIAT Panda is a front-wheel-drive hatchback introduced in 1980, born amid the compact-car boom that followed the oil crises. Its design was penned by the master stylist Giorgetto Giugiaro. To keep costs low, the body was crafted with straight lines and flat panels, achieving a look that was both practical and modern. At launch, buyers could choose between an air-cooled 652 cc 2-cylinder engine or a water-cooled 903 cc 4-cylinder unit. The model featured in Gran Turismo is the former.
long.zh: FIAT Panda是一款前轮驱动掀背车，于1980年第二次石油危机后的小型车热潮中推出。其外观设计由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀完成。为控制成本，车身采用直线线条和平整面板设计，呈现出简洁、现代且实用的外观。该车首发时提供两种引擎选项：风冷652 立方厘米双缸引擎或水冷903 立方厘米四缸引擎。这款在《跑车浪漫旅》游戏中登场的车型采用的是前者。

The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.

This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion
that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces

All into one concentrated ensemble.

It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture
by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptioal level
of perfection and timeless beauty.

collection.en:
Ferrari's 250 GT series owes much of its renown to this car,
the 250 GT Berlinetta.

The model was announced by Ferrari in 1959, and marked a
decisive shift away from previous 250s.

One of the most notable differences was the <2400mm> wheelbase,
which was <200mm> shorter than its predecessors.

This gave the car better handling, and led to the name
"SWB," which stands for "short wheelbase."

The V12 engine was also more powerful,

and driven by great drivers including Stirling Moss Graham Hill,
and Carroll Shelby,

 the model proved to be an outstanding success.

The total production of the Ferrari 250 Berlinetta was
around 160 cars in total.

Some of these featured an aluminum body for racing, while
others like this onehad steel bodies for street use.
collection.zh:
Ferrari的250 GT系列所拥有的知名度很大程度上来自于这款车，
即250 GT Berlinetta。

这款车由Ferrari在1959年宣布推出，标志着与以前的250车型风
格的彻底转变。

最明显的差异之一是长为2400毫米的轴距，比前代车型缩
短了近200毫米。

这让该车获得了更好的操控性，并获得了“SWB”这个代表
“短轴距”的名号。

它搭载的V12引擎的功率也更加强大。

当时的大部分伟大车手，例如Stirling Moss、Graham Hill，
以及Carroll Shelby都驾驶过它。

这款出类拔萃的车型在当时取得了巨大成功。

250 Berlinetta大约生产了160辆。

其中一些采用赛车的铝制车身，而另一些则采用l_V
型的钢制车身。*

vehicleCollection.en:
A predecessor to the 250 GTO, this car racked up numerous wins in the world of endurance racing.

Ferrari shortened the wheelbase of the 250 GT Berlinetta for sharper track handling. That change bore fruit with numerous race victories starting in 1960, including wins at the Tour de France and Nürburgring 621.4 miles. Just 162 units were built before its successor, the iconic 250 GTO, took over in 1962.

long.en: Ferrari shortened the wheelbase of the 250 GT Berlinetta for sharper track handling. That change bore fruit with numerous race victories starting in 1960, including wins at the Tour de France and Nürburgring 621.4 miles. Just 162 units were built before its successor, the iconic 250 GTO, took over in 1962.

and a ‘coda tronca’ rear.

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-popular car was built to win the GT Class International Championship title.

Back then, the line between road and race cars was thin, and the 250 GT Berlinetta embodied both worlds. The "GTO" name marked its homologation for GT racing. A tubular steel chassis supported the aluminum bodywork, optimizing both weight and rigidity. Its 3.0-liter V-12, fed by six carburetors, produced 295.9 HP. The right-hand-drive model developed for the UK performed admirably, often finishing on the podium.

A tubular steel chassis supported the aluminum bodywork, optimizing both weight and rigidity. Its 3.0-liter V-12, fed by six carburetors, produced 295.9 HP. The right-hand-drive model developed for the UK performed admirably, often finishing on the podium.

The year was 2023.

Ferrari claimed its first-ever overall victory at the
Nürburgring 24 Hours!

The machine that achieved this remarkable feat was none other
than the Ferrari 296 GT3.

It was a historic race, completed in a record 162 laps.

But the 296 GT3 didn’t just secure the overall win.

All three of the team’s entries finished the race,
a testament to their outstanding reliability.

In the months that followed, the 296 GT3 continued to dominate,
earning victories in endurance races across the globe!

brandCentral.en:
Making its debut in 2022, the mid-engine 296 GTB
was Ferrari’s first V-6 plug-in hybrid.

Praised for its compact dimensions and featherweight
agility, it was a road car built for the track.

The 296 GTB would go on to serve as the foundation for the
296 GT3, successor to the storied 488 GT3.

To meet GT3 regulations, Ferrari replaced the hybrid system
with a pure twin-turbo V-6, producing 591.7 bhp.

Assembly was entrusted to the legendary French outfit Oreca,
which also provided maintenance and after-sales support.

Since its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, the 296 GT3
quickly proved itself as a relentless competitor.

By the end of 2024, with 100 victories to its name,
it had become the undisputed star of GT3 racing.
brandCentral.zh:
2022年推出的中置引擎296 GTB是
Ferrari首款V6插电混动跑车。

它以紧凑尺寸与极致轻量化著称，
堪称为赛道而生的公路猛兽。

事实上，296 GTB正是296 GT3的研发基础，
后者接替488 GT3成为新一代战驹。

为使该车符合GT3赛事规范，Ferrari将其混动系统更换为
纯双涡轮V6引擎，输出动力达591.7 BHP。

组装由传奇法国赛车制造商Oreca操刀，
并提供后续维护和售后支持。

自2023年戴通纳24小时赛首秀以来，
296 GT3不断证明其纯正血统，展现出不可撼动的实力。

截至2024年底就已豪取100胜，
当之无愧地成为了GT3赛事的耀眼明星。

vehicleCollection.en:
This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen."

Derived from the 296 GTB, the 296 GT3 was a purebred race machine that shed the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbocharged V-6 engine. Built by world-renowned constructor Oreca, the car was crafted with meticulous precision—from chassis construction and assembly to customer support. After its debut at the 24 Hours of Spa in July 2022, it quickly demonstrated its exceptional racing prowess, achieving 100 victories in less than two years.

long.en: Derived from the 296 GTB, the 296 GT3 was a purebred race machine that shed the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbocharged V-6 engine. Built by world-renowned constructor Oreca, the car was crafted with meticulous precision—from chassis construction and assembly to customer support. After its debut at the 24 Hours of Spa in July 2022, it quickly demonstrated its exceptional racing prowess, achieving 100 victories in less than two years.

conversation.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.

Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."

I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
G

Ferrari was an early adopter of hybrid technology, as
evidenced by the LaFerrari and the SF90 Stradale.

The 296 GTB was also a plug-in hybrid, but it was powered
by a V6, which Ferrari first adopted for the Dino.

This 3L twin-turbo V6, when combined with an electric motor,
boasts an output of <830ps>.

Not only does this hybrid technology reduce CO2 emissions,
but it also offers drivers a high output.

The car’s exterior, with its low nose, is another big draw,
making nods to the classical forms of the legendary 250 LM.

Measuring <4565mm> in length, it’s surprisingly compact, and
its light V6 only adds to its advantages on the track.

Without a doubt, this is one car that shows Ferrari’s desire
to make electrification hene secret weapon in motorsport.
brandCentral.zh:

LaFerrari和SF90 Stradale便是例证。

296 GTB也是一款插电混动车型，不同的是它

这款3升双涡轮增压V6引擎结合电机，
综合输出功率可达<830ps>。

混动技术不仅有助于降低二氧化碳排放，

车辆外观的另一大亮点是其低鼻锥设计，

车身长度仅<4565mm>，极为紧凑，

毫无疑问，这款车彰显了Ferrari
将电气化作为赛车运动新型秘密武器的决心。

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.

The 296 GTB itself was a plug-in hybrid and the first Ferrari to feature a V-6 engine since the iconic Dino series. The smallest member of Ferrari’s current lineup, its beautifully sculpted body paid homage to the 250 LM of the 1960s. Power came from a mid-mounted twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine paired with a 123 kW electric motor, producing a combined output of 830 horsepower. Capable of accelerating from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.9 seconds and reaching 205.1 mph at full stride, the 296 GTB delivered the breathtaking performance worthy of the Ferrari name.

long.en: The 296 GTB itself was a plug-in hybrid and the first Ferrari to feature a V-6 engine since the iconic Dino series. The smallest member of Ferrari’s current lineup, its beautifully sculpted body paid homage to the 250 LM of the 1960s. Power came from a mid-mounted twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine paired with a 123 kW electric motor, producing a combined output of 830 horsepower. Capable of accelerating from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.9 seconds and reaching 205.1 mph at full stride, the 296 GTB delivered the breathtaking performance worthy of the Ferrari name.
long.zh: 296 GTB是一款插电式混合动力跑车，同时配备了自Dino系列以来首款V6引擎。经典风格的车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前Ferrari产品线中最小的车型。该车采用中置布局搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，结合123千瓦电机，系统综合输出功率达830马力。该车仅需2.9秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到330 公里/小时，性能当之无愧于Ferrari之名。

conversation.en:
Not only is the 308 the forebear of all modern 8-cylinder
Ferraris, it is undoubtedly the most popular of them all.

It may also be the longest-lasting.

If one includes the 328 variant, its production run
spanned from 1975 to 1989.

The car's success is due to its pure and timeless design.

It is also said to be very well balanced...

And serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s
design philosophy.

It even revives classic themes from the Dino 246,
such as the flared wheel arches...

The iconic side air intake, the dynamic rear pillars...

And the truncated tail with four round taillights.

Indeed, all of these elemnt wre transformed to express
a very odern form for its day.<next id=22509 typ=9
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。

它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……

标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……

还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。

当然，所有p些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。

usedCar.en:
The tradition of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 began with
the 308.

The car's elegant wedge-shaped design, penned
by Pininfarina, made it instantly popular.

And its basic proportions were inherited by later V-8 models.

Thanks to its head-turning looks, the 308 also appeared
in many movies and TV series.

Its compact body made it lightweight and agile, while
the V-8 let out a truly melodic roar.

This 1975 model came equipped with both fuel injectors and
carburetors.

The wonderful engine and the responsive chassis
made this car as fun to drive as it was to look at.
usedCar.zh:
传统的法拉利中置引擎V8车型始于
308系列。

确实，这一车型无疑具有真正的
历史价值。

它的设计正是出自Pininfarina之手。

随后的V8车型继承了其
时尚的比例。

它的紧凑型车身轻盈而敏捷，
性感的引擎音非常悦耳。

这款1975年的车型同时采用燃油喷射和
化油器。

灵敏的油门使得这款车型更趋完美，
让你真正享受引擎的咆哮。;

vehicleCollection.en:
This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships.

Introduced in 1975, the 308 GTB replaced the Dino 246 GT and launched Ferrari’s long-running series of V-8-powered two-seaters. Its elegant body, laid over a steel-tube frame, was designed by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, the mind behind many of Ferrari’s most celebrated shapes from the 1960s through the early 1990s.

conversation.en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.

It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.

In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.

After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。

尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。

从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。

在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了JBp车也可以很美的时代。

collection.en:
The Ferrari 330 P4 is, without a doubt, one of the
most beautiful race cars in the world.

And one of the rarest also.

The Ferrari P series are sports cars with a mid-mounted
V-12 engine.

First developed in 1963, they have an amazing track record,
with many historic wins over the years.

The development of the P series was stepped up
to challenge Ford at Le Mans...

...and it reached its pinnacle with the P4 in 1967.

At the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, two 330 P4s and one 412P
pulled off a spectacular 1-2-3 finish.

Even if you include the P3 modified to P4 specifications,
only four 330 P4s were ever produced.
collection.zh:
Ferrari 330 P4无疑是世界上最美、

也是最稀有的赛车之一。

Ferrari P系列是搭载中置V12引擎的跑车，

首次开发于1963年，并在当时的许多比赛中书写了辉煌的
历史。

为了在勒芒24小时耐力赛中与Ford对抗，P系列的开发力量
得到了补强，

并在1967年的“P4”中达到了巅峰。

在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，两辆330 P4和一辆412P技
惊四座，包揽了前三。

即使算上改装成P4规格的P3，330 P4总共也只生产了4辆。

catch.en: This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."
catch.zh: 采用V12引擎的P系列车型中最美丽的一款。

vehicleCollection.en:
This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."

The 330 P4 was Ferrari’s answer to the dominance of the Ford GT. Although only four units were ever made, a berlinetta version for high-speed tracks and a roofless spider for reduced weight were produced. It won its debut race at the 24 Hours of Daytona. While Ford ultimately triumphed at Le Mans, Ferrari secured the World Sportscar Championship title.

long.en: The 330 P4 was Ferrari’s answer to the dominance of the Ford GT. Although only four units were ever made, a berlinetta version for high-speed tracks and a roofless spider for reduced weight were produced. It won its debut race at the 24 Hours of Daytona. While Ford ultimately triumphed at Le Mans, Ferrari secured the World Sportscar Championship title.
long.zh: 330 P4诞生的目的是为了击败当时风头正盛的Ford GT。尽管总共仅生产了4台，但依旧分出了针对高速赛道的berlinetta版本和为减重而移除车顶的spider版本。它在戴通纳24小时耐力赛中首秀即夺冠。虽然Ford在勒芒获胜，但Ferrari随后就还以颜色，赢得了世界跑车锦标赛。

conversation.en:
Known as the “Daytona," it is the epitome of
the front-engine Prancing Horse GT...

...and probably that of the entire
“Gran Turismo” category, as well.

The car was designed by Pininfarina.

It has a very clean and incisive style.

It is based on extreme proportions...

...with a huge sloping hood and a set-back cockpit
ending in a compact “Kamm tail."

Some styling elements are particularly iconic,
such as the plexiglass headlights.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这款被命名为“Daytona”的跃马是
Ferrari前置引擎车款的集大成者。

不夸张地说，它其实可以算作
整个GT类车型的集大成者。

它的车身由Pininfarina打造，

conversation.en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.

Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.

Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.
?

没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像

于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。

collection.en:
The 365 GTB4 remains one of the most memorable Ferraris.

It made its debut in 1968...

...as the successor to iconic 1960s Ferraris
like the 250 GT Lusso and the 275 GTB.

It is a front engine/rear-wheel-drive model,
powered by a 4-cam <4390cc> V-12.

Like all Ferraris of the period, the first number indicated
the displacement per cylinder.

The "GT" stood for "Gran Turismo."

The "B" designated it as a "Berlinetta,"
meaning that it was a coupe.

And the "4" represented th 4-cam engine with
double overhead cams on each cylinder bank.

Most people know this car as the
Ferrari Daytona.

A name inspired by the company's historic 1-2-3 finish at
the Daytona 24 Hours in '67, a year prior to its release.

A major acievement indeed!
collection.zh:
365 GTB4是真正的旗舰车型。

它于1968年首次亮相，

是1960年代法拉利指标性车款
250 GT Lusso和275 GTB的后继者。

这款前置引擎、后轮驱动的车型由一台前置的<4390cc>4凸轮V12
引擎驱动。

像那个时期的所有Ferrari一样，名字中的数字表示每个气缸
的排量，

“GT”则代表“gran turismo”。

B代表“Berlinetta”，
表明这是一台双门跑车。

最后的“4”则代表每个气缸组都装有双顶置凸轮的四
凸轮引擎。

此外，法拉利365 GTB4又普遍被称为
“法拉利戴通纳”，

因为在其发布的前一年，Ferrari在1967年戴通纳24小时耐力赛
中取得了独占前三的历史性战绩。

这GvD一项一重大成就。*

catch.en: The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.

The 365 GTB/4—aka Daytona—was the last Ferrari to have a front-mounted V-12 and made its debut at the 1968 Paris Motor Show. It wore sleek bodywork penned by Leonardo Fioravanti, with a 4390 cc DOHC V-12 powerplant residing underneath. With a top speed of 174 mph, it matched the Lamborghini Miura as the fastest production car of its time.

long.en: The 365 GTB/4—aka Daytona—was the last Ferrari to have a front-mounted V-12 and made its debut at the 1968 Paris Motor Show. It wore sleek bodywork penned by Leonardo Fioravanti, with a 4390 cc DOHC V-12 powerplant residing underneath. With a top speed of 174 mph, it matched the Lamborghini Miura as the fastest production car of its time.
long.zh: 作为Ferrari最后一款搭载前置12缸引擎的车型，365 GTB/4（又名“Daytona”）于1968年巴黎车展首次亮相。列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的流线性车身下，隐藏着一台4,390 立方厘米的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎。其最高时速可达280 公里/小时，与竞争对手Lamborghini Miura并列成为当时最快的车。

brandCentral.en:
The 430 Scuderia is one of the best cars out there
for tearing up the track.

Building on the formidable foundation of the F430 series...

...this variant was both more powerful and lighter,
benefiting from an engine upgrade and a stripped-down interior.

Adding to its prowess was an advanced electronic suspension system,
designed to allow drivers to push the car to its limits.

Its performance was so exceptional that it recorded lap times
rivaling those of the V-12-powered Enzo Ferrari!
brandCentral.zh:
430 Scuderia堪称征服赛道的顶级利器。

这款车型以臻于至善的法拉利F430系列为基础……

通过引擎升级和精简内饰设计，实现了更高的动力输出
和更轻的车身重量。

此外，430 Scuderia还配备了电子控制悬挂系统，使驾
驶者能够在赛道上充分发挥车辆的极限性能。

其惊人的速度令人瞠目结舌——它在赛道上创下的单圈
记录甚至能与搭载V12引擎的顶级超跑Enzo Ferrari比肩！!

usedCar.en:
The Ferrari 430 Scuderia represented the epitome
of driving exhilaration...

...whether it was tasked with a scenic coastal road
or attacking a racetrack.

Building on the performance of the F430 series, the Scuderia offered
a better experience with reduced weight and improved dynamics.

This incredible sports machine is an advanced evolution of the
F430's electronic stability system, tuned for track performance.

The 430 Scuderia was a genuine road-going racer
that really took its special concept to heart.
usedCar.zh:
430 Scuderia是追求驾驶乐趣或渴望征服赛道的车迷们
的理想之选。

这款车型基于超高性能的Ferrari F430系列打造，在大幅
减轻车重的同时提供了更强劲的动力输出。

此外，它还搭载了专为赛道优化的F430电子稳定系统
的升级版。

值得一提的是，在430 Scuderia之前，360系列就曾推
出过Challenge Stradale，单一品牌赛事用车的公路版本……

而430 Scuderia则是一款真正意义上的公路赛车，它将
这一特殊理念贯彻到了极致。

catch.en: A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.
catch.zh: 对F430的性能进行大幅改进的合法上路车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.

Revealed at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show in September, the Ferrari 430 Scuderia reflected the brand’s Formula 1 expertise. Compared to the base F430, it featured enhanced aerodynamics, weight reduction, and more power. The result was a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.6 seconds and a top speed of 198.8 mph.

vehicleCollection.en:
With an astonishing 562.1 HP under the hood, this V8 mid-engine machine took its heritage from the F430.

The 458 Italia, introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeded the F430. Built on a new aluminum space frame, it housed a 4499 cc V-8 producing 562.1 HP and 398.5 ft-lb of torque. The upgraded Manettino system allowed seamless control of engine, transmission, and suspension settings. With F1-derived aero design, it hit 0–62.1 mph in 3.4 seconds and topped out at 201.9 mph.

The 458 Italia GT3 was a regulation-compliant race version of the road-going 458. It featured a lower front bumper functioning as an air dam and a prominent rear wing. Although the engine remained the same, a restrictor limited output to 542.4 HP. Making its debut in 2011, it immediately made its mark by winning the FIA GT3 European Championship.

brandCentral.en:
The Le Mans Daytona h regulations reduced the cost of racing
prototypes, but also introduced restrictions on components...

So Ferrari decided to return to the top class of the WEC
after 50 years with a car designed for Le Mans regulations.

This was the 499P, built in the tradition of the 312 P.
An AWD with a 3-litre V6 twin turbo and a hybrid motor.

The 499P took pole position in its debut race in 2023,
and stunned the world by finishing in third place.

The climax of its season was the 4th race, however, where Ferrari
won at Le Mans for the first time since the 250 LM in 1965.

This race also marked Le Mans 100th anniversary, and the 499P
became the car that won that historic race.
brandCentral.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则降低了
原型跑车的赛事成本，但也对部件施加了诸多限制……

于是，法拉利在阔别50年后决定重返世界耐力锦标赛
顶级组别，其出战的赛车正是针对勒芒规则而专门设计。

这款车便是499P，沿袭312 P基因的全轮驱动车型，
搭载一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与一台混动电机。

2023年，499P在首场比赛中便夺得杆位，
并最终荣获第三名，令世界为之震惊。

该赛季的高潮出现在第四场比赛中，
499P帮助法拉利自1965年以250 LM夺冠后首次问鼎勒芒。

这场比赛见证了勒芒赛事成立一百周年，
也见证了499P拿下历史性的一冠。

vehicleCollection.en:
The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.

The Ferrari 499P was a prototype developed for the Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) category. Its advanced hybrid all-wheel-drive system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine with a front-mounted MGU to produce a total output of 500kW. Upon Ferrari’s return to Le Mans in 2023, the car went up against a field of its strongest rivals and came out on top, securing overall victory. This would mark Ferrari’s first victory at Le Mans in 58 years.

collection.en:
The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe was one of the great
Ferraris of the 1950s.

There are a few different types of the Ferrari Mondial.

This is one of two coupés that were built to race
the 1954 Tour de France!

Unfortunately, it retired out of the race.

But this may have been best, given how well it was
taken care of throughout the years.

The car was bought by a French collector and safely stored
away in a chateau for several decades.

So when John Shirley acquired the car in 2002...

Everything from the engine to the paint finish
was in perfect condition!

After only minor work was he able to enter it in
the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2012.

Unsurprisingly, it went home with the Gran Turismo
Trophy.<
collection.zh:
500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe是50年代最伟大的Ferrari之一。

Ferrari Mondial有几种不同的型号，

而这辆是为1954年的环法汽车赛而制造仅有的两辆之一！

遗憾地是它并未完赛，

但因祸得福，这辆车随后得到了完善的养护并保管多年。

这辆车被一位法国收藏家买下，并安全地存放在一座城
堡里数十年之久。

因此，当John Shirley在2002年获得这辆车时，

它从引擎到油漆都处于完美的状态！

在稍加保养之后，他就带着这辆车参加了2012年的圆石滩
经典车展。

不出意料，它将当年的Gran Turismo奖杯捧回了家！

catch.en: A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner.

vehicleCollection.en:
A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner.

The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe, a car built for the 1954 Tour de France, featured a chassis and engine developed by Ferrari and bodywork by Pininfarina. Although it never competed in the Tour as intended, an unrestored example later won the prestigious Gran Turismo Award at the 2012 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance.

conversation.en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

The 512 BB has achieved a near-mythical status.

Its design was inspired by...

The 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this.

You may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
The 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.

But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...

The large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
bonnet grille, the small NACA side air vents...p/
nd the lower bodywork painted matt black.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……

他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。

这辆车的设计灵感来源于……

1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。

这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。

另外，你还可以从中看到

1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：
例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。

不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。

不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……

车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转y灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……

usedCar.en:
Ferrari's BB series were its first production models
to utilise a midship twelve-cylinder engine.

These two-door coupés combine the beautiful body of
a berlinetta with the power of a flat-twelve.

Hence the 'BB' nickname—short for 'Berlinetta Boxer'.

With a top speed of <302km/h>, it was the fastest car
in the world when first introduced.

Its Pininfarina-designed body continues to serve as
an inspiration for Ferrari creations.
usedCar.zh:
Ferrari的BB系列是首次采用中置12缸引擎
的量产车型。

这些双门跑车将berlinetta线条优美的车身
和水平对卧十二缸的动力结合在了一起。

“BB”即为“Berlinetta Boxer”的缩写。

凭借高达<302km/h>的最高时速，
这辆车一经问世便成为了世界上最快的车。

它那由Pininfarina设计的车体仍然是Ferarri设计的灵感来源。[

catch.en: One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.
catch.zh: 引领20世纪70年代超跑潮流的标杆之一，与Countach争夺最高时速的桂冠。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.

This modified version of Ferrari’s 365 GT4/BB was notable for being the brand’s first mid-engine 12-cylinder road car. The most significant revision was the enlargement of the engine to 5.0 liters; however, due to emissions regulations, power output was reduced by 19.7 HP, bringing the total to 355 HP. Torque was increased by 28.9 ft-lb, resulting in a formidable 332.7 ft-lb. One of Ferrari’s most iconic creations, this car—along with Lamborghini’s Countach—came to symbolize the exotic Italian supercars of the 1970s.

long.en: This modified version of Ferrari’s 365 GT4/BB was notable for being the brand’s first mid-engine 12-cylinder road car. The most significant revision was the enlargement of the engine to 5.0 liters; however, due to emissions regulations, power output was reduced by 19.7 HP, bringing the total to 355 HP. Torque was increased by 28.9 ft-lb, resulting in a formidable 332.7 ft-lb. One of Ferrari’s most iconic creations, this car—along with Lamborghini’s Countach—came to symbolize the exotic Italian supercars of the 1970s.
long.zh: 这是365GT4/BB的改装版，是Ferrari的12缸公路车，也是品牌首款采用中置引擎布局的车型。此次升级的主要亮点是将12缸引擎排量扩容至5升，不过为符合排放法规所做的改动导致动力输出减少20 PS至360 PS。但扭矩还是增加了4.0 公斤力米至46.0 公斤力米。作为Ferrari最令人难忘的经典车型之一，这款车与Lamborghini Countach一起，成为20世纪70年代意大利超级跑车的象征。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari’s front-mounted V12 models pay tribute to a tradition
as enduring as the marque itself.

Building on the legacy of icons like the 250 series, the Daytona,
and the Maranello, the 812 Superfast made its debut in 2017.

While its design echoes classic Ferrari elegance, its
aerodynamic form is thoroughly modern.

The V12 engine has been enlarged to 6.5 liters, producing 800-horsepower,
hence the car’s numerical designation.

With a generous <2720mm> wheelbase typical of grand tourers, the
812 Superfast also offers practical trunk space behind the seats.

And thanks to its 4-wheel steering system, this car has remarkably
agile handling, making it shine on winding roads.@
brandCentral.zh:
Ferrari的前置V12引擎拥有悠久的历史，几乎和
这家传奇的意大利公司本身一样经典。

在250系列、Daytona和Maranello取得巨大成功后，
这款812 Superfast在2017年盛大亮相。

尽管外观采用经典风格，但它运用了
最现代的空气动力学设计。

其V12引擎扩容到了6.5升，再加上产出的800马力，
这便是812这个名字的由来。

除了GT车型常见的<2720mm>轴距之外，812 Superfast
还在座椅后方提供了充足的后备箱空间。

此外，由于采用了4轮转向系统，它也拥有水银泻地般
的操控，特别是在蜿蜒崎岖的道路上。

catch.en: Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.
catch.zh: 这款Ferrari采用了经典的V12前置后驱布局，在实现闪电般速度的同时保持实用性。

vehicleCollection.en:
Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast, introduced in 2017, carried on the company's tradition of front-engined V-12 grand tourers. It marked Ferrari’s first use of electric power steering and adopted an evolved version of the 4-wheel steering system from the F12berlinetta. Despite its substantial 107.1 inches wheelbase, the car remained impressively agile through tight corners.

long.en: The Ferrari 812 Superfast, introduced in 2017, carried on the company's tradition of front-engined V-12 grand tourers. It marked Ferrari’s first use of electric power steering and adopted an evolved version of the 4-wheel steering system from the F12berlinetta. Despite its substantial 107.1 inches wheelbase, the car remained impressively agile through tight corners.

The Dino 246 GT was one of the finest Ferrari vehicles

vehicleCollection.en:
This collector's car took the nickname of Enzo Ferrari's son, Alfredo "Dino," who passed away at the age of 24.

An evolution of the Dino 206GT introduced in 1968, the Dino 246GT was named in honor of Enzo Ferrari’s late son. The aluminum body was replaced with a steel construction, and the wheelbase was extended to enhance control and high-speed stability. The cast-iron block V-6 was enlarged to 2.4 liters, producing 192.3 HP and 166.4 ft-lb of torque.

conversation.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.

As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."

The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...

...while the back is recogized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...

Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodyamic efficiency.
3
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。

如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。

它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。

前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，

而后部则v清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。

但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……

它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气力学效率。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari is known for making the sweetest-sounding V-12s ever.

In fact, the company's very first production car in 1947
came equipped with a V-12.

This F12berlinetta continued the trend with its 12-cylinder
powerplant mounted up front.

It boasted more than <700ps> sending power to the rear wheels,
and its exterior design was stunning indeed.

The design was a collaboration between Ferrari's internal
design department and Pininfarina.

They're efforts led to the car winning the prestigious
Compasso d'Oro international design award in 2014.
brandCentral.zh:
法拉利以其激动人心的V12引擎而闻名于世。

事实上，该公司在1947年推出的首款零售车型的引擎盖下
就装载了一台V12引擎。

将V12引擎安装在车前部的F12berlinetta是款大热车型，

拥有超过<700ps>的动力和经典的前置后驱传动系统，十分引
人注目！

该设计来自法拉利内部设计部门和宾尼法利纳的合作。

显然，这是一次富有成效的合作——F12berlinetta在2014年赢得了著
名的金圆规奖！=

catch.zh: 采用了F1技术的Ferrari旗舰车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The flagship model of Ferrari wasn't just fast, it was a technological marvel.

The F12berlinetta was introduced in 2012 as Ferrari’s new flagship grand tourer, succeeding the 599 GTB Fiorano. Built around an all-new aluminum space frame and body shell, it featured a front-mid-mounted V-12 engine. With its optimized layout, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.1 seconds and reaching a top speed of 211.3 mph. It also claimed the lap record at Ferrari’s Fiorano test track.

long.en: The F12berlinetta was introduced in 2012 as Ferrari’s new flagship grand tourer, succeeding the 599 GTB Fiorano. Built around an all-new aluminum space frame and body shell, it featured a front-mid-mounted V-12 engine. With its optimized layout, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.1 seconds and reaching a top speed of 211.3 mph. It also claimed the lap record at Ferrari’s Fiorano test track.
long.zh: F12berlinetta是Ferrari于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。该车采用新型铝制空间车架与车壳，配备一台前中置式V12引擎。优化后布局带来性能上的提升：0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.1秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时。这台车还一举刷新Fiorano试车赛道的圈速纪录。

collection.en:
The F40 was the last Ferrari to have been personally
approved by the company's founder, Enzo Ferrari.

The development codename for the F40 was 'LM',
standing for 'Le Mans'.

This goes to show that it was designed as a road car
with the look of a race car.

There's a widely held impression that the F40 suffers
from turbo lag and a peaky engine.

But I consider it to be a very refined example
of Ferrari engineering.

Many a professional driver has assured that the peakiness
is not an issue if the turbo is properly controlled.

So if you have the driving skill, I'm sure
you’ll be able to handle it./
collection.zh:
F40是最后一辆由公司创始人Enzo Ferrari亲自批准生产的Ferrari。

F40的开发代号是“LM”，勒芒的英文缩写。

它是一辆按照公路车来设计，但具有赛车外观的车。

外界有一种普遍的说法，认为F40的涡轮迟滞明显，引擎
的输出曲线也偏高。

但我个人认为这是一款代表着法拉利车辆工程技术水平
的车型。

多位职业车手证实，只要对涡轮的控制得当，
引擎的转速曲线就不是问题。

所以如果您的驾驶技术不错的话，我相信您一定可以驾驭它。

catch.en: This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.
catch.zh: Ferrari创始人Enzo Ferrari参与设计的最后一款公路车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.

This special model was created to commemorate the 40th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed using the same construction techniques as the race cars of its era, it featured a steel tubular frame combined with composite materials, including carbon-Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb structures. Its powerplant was derived from the twin-turbocharged V-8 used in the 288 GTO, tuned to produce 478.3 HP and 419.5 ft-lb of torque. This car would become the final road-going project overseen by Enzo Ferrari, and it continues to enjoy enduring admiration around the world.
