Its powerplant was derived from the twin-turbocharged V-8 used in the 288 GTO, tuned to produce 478.3 HP and 419.5 ft-lb of torque. This car would become the final road-going project overseen by Enzo Ferrari, and it continues to enjoy enduring admiration around the world.

The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...

Starting with the new V8 engine.

It is also an evolution from a ‘style’ perspective.

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,

The large double-oval front air intakes...

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.

And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights
add to its aggressive look.

灵感来源于1961年的Ferrari 156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。

四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。

brandCentral.en:
If you're looking for a mid-engined V8 Ferrari, you can't go
wrong with the F430.

This successor to the 360 Modena boasts an additional <90ps>
of power...

And its V8 engine is the first of its kind!

Other exciting innovations include the addition of carbon
brakes and a computer-controlled LSD called the E-Diff.

To this day, few cars can match the F430's performance on
the circuit!
brandCentral.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆中置引擎的V8 Ferrari，选F430准没错。

这款360 Modena的继任者将动力提升了<90ps>……

而且装载的一款全新的V8引擎！

此外，F430还有更多令人激动的创新点，包括加装的碳纤
维刹车系统和一个被称为E-Diff的电控限滑差速器。

时至今日，仍然鲜少有赛道表现能与F430相提并论的车型
出现！

usedCar.en:
The F430 represented a turning point for Ferrari.

For one, its mid-mounted V-8 engine had a complete makeover
and generated more power.

It churned out <90ps> more than its predecessor,
the 360's engine.

The styling was inspired by both the 250 TR and the Enzo,
which accounts for its jaw-dropping good looks.

Owning this car is the ideal way to experience the long
and storied history of Ferrari on a daily basis!
usedCar.zh:
F430标志了Ferrari设计理念的一个转折点。

最值得注意的是，它搭载的中置V8引擎是
完全重新设计的。

这台引擎让这辆车的马力
比前代360 Modena高了<90ps>。

F430还吸收了250 TR和Enzo的
设计元素。

总而言之，这辆车承载着Ferrari
悠久且传奇的历史！

catch.en: The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of 195.7 mph.
catch.zh: 顶级的中置引擎跑车，最高速度可达315 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.en:
The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of 195.7 mph.

The Ferrari F430 was a mid-engine V-8 supercar that made its debut in 2004. The newly developed 4.3-liter V-8 engine produced 483.2 HP. The chassis was developed from the 360 Modena, with key improvements in stability and aerodynamic downforce, constructed using Extra Super Duralumin aluminum alloy. This top-tier sports car reached a top speed of 195.7 mph and was available with carbon-ceramic brakes.

long.en: The Ferrari F430 was a mid-engine V-8 supercar that made its debut in 2004. The newly developed 4.3-liter V-8 engine produced 483.2 HP. The chassis was developed from the 360 Modena, with key improvements in stability and aerodynamic downforce, constructed using Extra Super Duralumin aluminum alloy. This top-tier sports car reached a top speed of 195.7 mph and was available with carbon-ceramic brakes.
long.zh: Ferrari F430是一台2004年亮相的中置引擎V8超级跑车。新开发的4.3升引擎动力输出达490 PS。底盘基于360 Modena开发，由超高强度钢铝制成，在稳定性与下压力方面均有提升。这款顶级超级跑车最高时速可达315 公里/小时，并选配碳化陶瓷刹车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
顶级的中置引擎跑车，最高速度可达315 公里/小时。

Ferrari F430是一台2004年亮相的中置引擎V8超级跑车。新开发的4.3升引擎动力输出达490 PS。底盘基于360 Modena开发，由超高强度钢铝制成，在稳定性与下压力方面均有提升。这款顶级超级跑车最高时速可达315 公里/小时，并选配碳化陶瓷刹车。

collection.en:
The F50 was the successor to the F40, and was one of
the most Spartan cars Ferrari ever produced.

The idea came from Enzo Ferrari's son, Piero,

who wanted to create a road car similar to an F1 race car
for the company's 50th anniversary.

This is reflected in things like the F50's V12 engine being
mounted in the same structure as the Ferrari F1 machine.

The V12 engine in-house is also based on the V12 used in
the Ferrari F1 racers.

So if you're in the mood to drive a Ferrari F1 around town,
the F50 is the car for you!
collection.zh:
F50是F40的继任者，也是法拉利制造过的最“朴素”的汽车之一。

它的设计理念来自于恩佐·法拉利的儿子皮耶罗，

后者希望打造一款接近一级方程式赛车的公路车来庆祝
公司成立50周年。

这一理念反映在了F50的V12引擎上。这台V12引擎是基于法拉利
的一级方程式赛车设计的，

然后安装在同款一级方程式赛车结构打造的车架上。

如果您有兴趣想要开着法拉利的“F1”赛车招摇过市，F50就
是您的不二之选！~

catch.en: This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.
catch.zh: 装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.

This special model was created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed under the concept of a “road-going F1 car,” it featured an engine derived from the V-12 in Ferrari’s 1990 "641" F1 machine, enlarged to 4.7 liters and mounted directly to the chassis. With an output of 512.8 HP and 347.2 ft-lb of torque, the car could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.87 seconds and reach a top speed of 201.9 mph.

long.en: This special model was created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed under the concept of a “road-going F1 car,” it featured an engine derived from the V-12 in Ferrari’s 1990 "641" F1 machine, enlarged to 4.7 liters and mounted directly to the chassis. With an output of 512.8 HP and 347.2 ft-lb of torque, the car could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.87 seconds and reach a top speed of 201.9 mph.
long.zh: 这是为纪念Ferrari成立50周年推出的特别版车型。打造一台“公路版F1赛车”便是这台车的开发理念，它选择了1990年“641” F1赛车的V12引擎，扩容至4.7升后直接安装在底盘上。在520 PS/48.0 公斤力米的动力驱动下，该车能够在3.87秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达325 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.zh:
装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari's long history of producing cars with midship
V8 engines began in the 1970s with the 308 GTB.

This Ferrari F8 Tributo is a modern version of that classic.

As you would expect, its 3.9L V8 engine is mounted
midship.

This is an improved version of the engine used in its
predecessor, the 488 GTB, packing 710 BHP of power.

What's more, the response time is excellent for a turbo
engine, with no discernible lag at all.

This is down to the fact that the Tributo uses an electronic
turbo system first seen in Ferrari race cars.
brandCentral.zh:
以1970年推出的308 GTB为开端，Ferrari开启了使用中置V8引擎的
悠久历史。

这款Ferrari F8 Tributo就是那款经典车型的现代版本。

毫无意外，它的3.9L V8引擎也采用了中置布局。

作为前一代车型488 GTB所采用的引擎的升级版，它可以输
出<720ps>的动力。

以一款涡轮增压引擎而言，它的响应速度非常出色，几
乎感觉不到任何延迟。

这都要归功于为Tributo引入的电子涡轮增压系统，这是从Ferrari
赛车上下放的技术。

catch.en: At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.
catch.zh: Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

vehicleCollection.en:
At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.

The Ferrari F8 Tributo was unveiled in 2019 as the successor to the 488 GTB. While it retained a shape similar to its predecessor, significant changes to the aerodynamic elements gave it a refreshed, aggressive character. Its twin-turbo 3.9-liter V-8 produced 710.1 HP, resulting in a zero-to-62.1 mph of 2.9 seconds and a top speed of 211.3 mph—making it the fastest V-8-powered road car Ferrari had ever produced. Equipped with the latest in body control systems, the F8 Tributo also offered remarkable ease of drivability.

The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression

The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit
of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.

The front wing/splitter, all of the intakes
and air exits are impressive.

I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward

As you walk around to the rear,

车身塑造得非常有进攻性，几乎每一个部件

Are you familiar with Ferrari's XX Programs?

It's a where Ferrari asks its car owners to test drive its
various models to help develop new technologies.

The FXX-K was developed from this unique program.

The car was developed for track use and came equipped with a
<1000ps>-plus hybrid propulsion unit.

Testing from the XX Programs provided valuable data that
also helped the company's race car development.
brandCentral.zh:
您了解法拉利的XX计划吗？

在这项计划中，法拉利车主可以参与试驾活动，为新的技术
研发提供帮助。

FXX-K就是专为XX计划的试驾活动而制造的。

这辆以赛道驾驶为目的的车型安装有超过<1000ps>的混动
动力单元。

通过FXX-K试驾活动取得的数据甚至在赛车开发中都起到了
巨大的作用。

vehicleCollection.en:
The production run of this Ferrari was limited to only 32 units.

The FXX K, a track-only evolution of the LaFerrari, was produced in a limited run of just 32 units in 2014. It pairs the LaFerrari’s 6.3-liter V12 with a 187.4 HP electric motor, delivering a combined output of 1035.5 HP. With enhanced aerodynamics—further amplified by the optional EVO kit, which adds 75 percent more downforce. Free from the constraints of racing regulations, this car delivers pure, uncompromised driving performance at its highest level.

long.en: The FXX K, a track-only evolution of the LaFerrari, was produced in a limited run of just 32 units in 2014. It pairs the LaFerrari’s 6.3-liter V12 with a 187.4 HP electric motor, delivering a combined output of 1035.5 HP. With enhanced aerodynamics—further amplified by the optional EVO kit, which adds 75 percent more downforce. Free from the constraints of racing regulations, this car delivers pure, uncompromised driving performance at its highest level.
long.zh: FXX K是基于LaFerrari开发的一款赛道专用车型，在2014年限量生产了32台。该车采用LaFerrari的6.3升V12引擎以及可产生190 PS的电机，综合动力输出达1,050 PS。车辆的空气动力学也同步得到了升级，加装EVO套件后下压力提升75%。这台车摆脱了赛事规则的限制，带来终极驾驶体验。

conversation.en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.

Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.

Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectanguar daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.

The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recallig the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behinthe rear wheel
and he enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。

尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

但实际上它采用了当时最受欢迎的308 GTB的设计，
不过稍微拉长了车身，以适应更长的轴距。

它的主要特征包括大面积的前导流板和四颗矩形日间行车灯……

以及盖住硕大轮毂的宽大轮拱。

挂在保险杠下方的变速箱被左右四根圆形排气管夹在中间。

每每看到，都让人觉得惊艳。

唯一能让人回想起那款经典GTO的细节i…

是后轮后方的三道标志性斜向通风口，和车尾部
R大号的“RG尾t扰流板。

collection.en:
To me, when Leonardo Fioravanti was at Pininfarina
and designing for Ferrari...

..remains one of the greatest periods in the company's history.

Starting with the Dino 246 and culminating with this 288 GTO,
most cars featured mid-mounted V-8 engines.

Although its styling may appear sleek and feminine, the rear
fenders are an indication of its mighty power.

Only Fioravanti could craft such a beautiful mid-engine car!
Some would say that the GTO is the epitome of his genius.

The 288 GTO’s model name is derived from its twin-turbocharged
2.8-liter V-8 powerplant.

Only 270 were ever made, so they're not that easy to find.
Still, it's a must-have for any serious Ferrari collection.
collection.zh:
我的个人意见是，列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂在Pininfarina
操刀设计的时期是Ferrari历史上最伟大的时期之一。

从Dino 246开始萌芽，直到这款288 GTO臻于巅峰，大多都配
备了一台V8中置引擎。

虽然此车的造型可能看起来比较阴柔纤细，但宽厚的后
挡泥板表明了它所蕴含的强大功率。

也只有菲奥拉万蒂才能设计出如此曼妙的中置引擎汽车！

事实上，还有人说他的天才智慧都浓缩体现在了这台GTO
当中。

此车的名称288 GTO取自其装载的2.8L V8双涡轮增压引擎。

这款车只生产了270辆，所以现在一车难求。但只要您收
藏Ferrari，就绝对不能缺少它！

catch.en: At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower.
catch.zh: 乍一看仿佛偏离了原旨，实则100%精心打造。一台怪物级的车，马力达到400 PS。

vehicleCollection.en:
At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower.

To qualify for Group B, Ferrari built 200 examples of this homologation special. Although it looked like the 308, it featured a longer wheelbase by 4.3 inches and a longitudinally mounted engine, making it mechanically distinct. The twin-turbocharged 2.8-liter V-8 delivered 394.5 HP, making it the fastest road-going Ferrari at the time.

long.en: To qualify for Group B, Ferrari built 200 examples of this homologation special. Although it looked like the 308, it featured a longer wheelbase by 4.3 inches and a longitudinally mounted engine, making it mechanically distinct. The twin-turbocharged 2.8-liter V-8 delivered 394.5 HP, making it the fastest road-going Ferrari at the time.
long.zh: 为了满足B组别赛事规则，这款认证车型一共生产了200台。它的造型与308GTB几乎别无二致，但轴距实际上增加了110毫米，引擎改为纵向安装，意味着内部构造完全不同。2.8升双涡轮增压引擎带来高达400 PS的马力，让其成为当时最快的Ferrari。

conversation.en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.

And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."

The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.

Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.

It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
Ferrari和Pininfarina都秉承了同一设计理念：

每一辆Ferrari都必须“美观而独特”。

这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。

和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，

摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，

在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。

It's also the first commercially available hybrid car
Ferrari has ever made.

The HY-KERS hybrid system it employs was adapted from
F1 machines...

And its 6.3L V12 engine is accompanied by two motors,
allowing it to produce up to <963ps>.

catch.en: Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.
catch.zh: Ferrari的第一款混动车型，完全使用F1赛车的材料和工艺打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.

This was one of Ferrari’s flagship special models—continuing the legacy of the F40, F50, and Enzo Ferrari. It was built using the same materials and techniques found in Ferrari’s Formula 1 program, with a carbon monocoque chassis and a specially tuned version of the 6.3-liter V-12 engine from the F12berlinetta, producing 788 HP, enhanced further by the HY-KERS hybrid system. Performance was nothing short of astounding: 0–62.1 mph in under 3 seconds, 0–124.3 mph in under 7 seconds, and a top speed exceeding 217.5 mph.

long.en: This was one of Ferrari’s flagship special models—continuing the legacy of the F40, F50, and Enzo Ferrari. It was built using the same materials and techniques found in Ferrari’s Formula 1 program, with a carbon monocoque chassis and a specially tuned version of the 6.3-liter V-12 engine from the F12berlinetta, producing 788 HP, enhanced further by the HY-KERS hybrid system. Performance was nothing short of astounding: 0–62.1 mph in under 3 seconds, 0–124.3 mph in under 7 seconds, and a top speed exceeding 217.5 mph.
long.zh: Ferrari历史上生产过无数特殊车型，譬如F40、F50以及Enzo Ferrari，这款车也是其中之一。该车的材料与制作工艺与Ferrari F1赛车相同，采用了碳纤维单体车壳设计，并配备了调校后可输出800 PS的6.3升V12 F12berlinetta引擎，此外还辅以一套HY-KERS混合动力系统。这辆车的加速从0-100 公里/小时仅需不到3秒，0-200 公里/小时也只要不到7秒，而极速则可以达到令人咂舌的350 公里/小时。

conversation.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.

First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.

This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflcted in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!

Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillghts of previous Ferraris.

Another memorae oddity...<p/
...ws the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was presen in th vry frst vesios.<nid201809 type=9
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。

它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。

首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。

其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。

这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制w商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，

成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！

特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……

dialogues.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.

First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.

This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflcted in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!

Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillghts of previous Ferraris.

Another memorae oddity...<p/
...ws the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was presen in th vry frst vesios.<nid201809 type=9

Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——

首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。

这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制w商纷纷效仿

成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！

usedCar.en:
The Ferrari Testarossa was a V-12-powered exotic that was
introduced in 1984.

It's considered one of the company's great creations, along
with its contemporaries, the GTO and the F40.

The Testarossa inherited its basic layout from Ferrari's
512BB.

This included the engine, dubbed a 'flat-12' because the pistons
are horizontally opposed, but technically it's a V-12.

The Testarossa name, which means "red head" in Italian,
came from Ferrari's legendary 250 Testa Rossa race car.

The car's styling was penned by none other than Pininfarina.

The distinctive strakes on the body sides made this car
instantly recognizable on both the road and track.
usedCar.zh:
Ferrari Testarossa是一款高端车型，
首次问世于1984年。

被认为是公司最伟大的杰作之一，与之其名的
还有其80年代同期车型、GTO和F40。

Testarossa继承了Ferrari的BB 512系列的
基本布局。

最重要的是搭载了V12中置引擎。

此款车根据公司的传奇性跑车
250 Testa Rossa而命名。

由最具盛名的意大利公司
Pininfarina所设计。

Testarossa车门两侧独特的边条翼
是法拉利V8车型所继承的设计特色。

catch.en: This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.
catch.zh: 这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.

Unveiled in 1984, the Testarossa stood as Ferrari’s flagship mid-engine masterpiece. Its heart was a 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12, delivering a maximum output of 384.6 HP and torque of 361.6 ft-lb. Acceleration from zero to 62.1 mph took just 5.8 seconds, with the car ultimately achieving a top speed of 180.2 mph. With its sculpted form—defined by signature 5-fin strakes and rear fenders that flared boldly from the tight cockpit—the Testarossa captivated a new generation of enthusiasts.

long.en: Unveiled in 1984, the Testarossa stood as Ferrari’s flagship mid-engine masterpiece. Its heart was a 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12, delivering a maximum output of 384.6 HP and torque of 361.6 ft-lb. Acceleration from zero to 62.1 mph took just 5.8 seconds, with the car ultimately achieving a top speed of 180.2 mph. With its sculpted form—defined by signature 5-fin strakes and rear fenders that flared boldly from the tight cockpit—the Testarossa captivated a new generation of enthusiasts.
long.zh: 1984年亮相的Testarossa是Ferrari的旗舰中置引擎车型。引擎为平卧放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力高达390 PS，峰值扭矩50.0 公斤力米。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.8秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。这款车拥有艺术化的优雅车身设计，采用标志性的5片式侧边条翼和从紧凑座舱异军突起的后挡泥板，赢得了全新一代车迷的青睐。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

brandCentral.en:
This is the Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a single-seat concept car with a futuristic design—
Ferrari's first foray into the virtual motorsports world.

This model is inspired by sports prototypes from the
1960s and 1970s...

...and it shares some of its DNA with legendary race cars,
such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S.

This is a car that builds on Ferrari's racing pedigree to
make its mark in the endurance races of the future.

The Ferrari VGT's body construction...

It stands to reason, therefore, that its aerodynamic
properties are cutting-edge.

Its powertrain is a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 hybrid, just like
the one used in Ferrar's LMH.

Because the FIA's regulations don't actually apply to the
VGTit is in fact re poerful than the LMH!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆车叫做法拉利Vision Gran Turismo。

它是一辆采用未来主义设计的单座概念赛车
——是法拉利对虚拟赛车领域的首次尝试。

它的灵感来自于二十世纪六十年代和七十年代的原型跑车……

并融入与法拉利330 P3和512S等传奇赛车相同的DNA。

这是一辆传承法拉利赛车血统，并渴望在未来的耐力赛中
留下印记的车。法拉利VGT的车身结构……

从国际汽联的勒芒超级跑车规则&汲取灵感，

无怪乎能将空气动力学的效应实现至巅峰水平。

它的动力系统来自一台3升涡轮增压V6混合动力引擎，
和法拉利LMH上使用的引擎完全相同。

由于国际汽联的规则并不适用于VT，
因此，它事实上比LMH还要动力强劲！

catch.en: A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.
catch.zh: 一辆突破终极跑车界限的单座概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo marks Ferrari’s first-ever virtual-only single-seater concept, drawing design cues from the marque’s legendary sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. Its turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 hybrid powertrain, working in concert with three electric motors, delivers a total system output of 1015.8 HP. Blending the DNA of Ferrari’s past icons with a bold vision of endurance racing’s future, the design is both a tribute and a statement.

long.en: The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo marks Ferrari’s first-ever virtual-only single-seater concept, drawing design cues from the marque’s legendary sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. Its turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 hybrid powertrain, working in concert with three electric motors, delivers a total system output of 1015.8 HP. Blending the DNA of Ferrari’s past icons with a bold vision of endurance racing’s future, the design is both a tribute and a statement.
long.zh: Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo是Ferrari首款纯虚拟单座概念车，设计灵感来自于60年代和70年代的一众赛车原型车。3升涡轮增压V6混动引擎与3台电机配合，综合动力输出达1,030 PS。这台车的设计传承了经典赛车的基因，并昭示了耐力赛在未来的重磅发展方向。

brandCentral.en:
Emerson Fittipaldi is one of the true legends of motorsports.
His credentials include...

...two-time Formula 1 champion...

...two-time Indy 500 winner...

...and now, car designer. This Vision Gran Turismo model is
his take on the perfect race car.

Its official name is the Fittipaldi EF7 VGT by Pininfarina.

The concept was to create a car that anyone could drive,
but one that could also be a serious racing contender.

And as anyone taking the wheel will see, that concept
has become reality.=
brandCentral.sourceName: Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo by Pininfarina

Emerson Fittipaldi是一位赛车运动领域的传奇人物。

拥有两个一级方程式冠军头衔……

两届印地500冠军得主……

而现在，他又成为了一名汽车设计师。这辆Vision Gran Turismo
让他的赛车梦想成为现实。

这辆车的全称是Fittipaldi EF7 VGT，由Pininfarina负责打造。

其设计理念是打造一辆任何人都能驾驶，但同时又具备
强大的赛事竞争力的车。

握住它方向盘的人想来都会认同，这个理念已经实现了。

usedCar.en:
You seem like a rally car enthusiast. If so, then this
is definitely the car for you!

The Ford Escort RS Cosworth was the successor
to the legendary Sierra Cosworth 4x4.

While the Escort had its heyday in the late 1960s and 1970s,
this car adopted the engine and 4WD layout from the Sierra.

The two-tier rear wing made quite the impression!

Needless to say, this car was fast, claiming five of 13 wins
at the 1993 World Rally Championship.

It certainly played a major role in restoring Ford to its
former rally glory.
usedCar.zh:
看来你是位拉力赛车爱好者。那么这款车
一定会让你心动！

福特福睿斯RS Cosworth继承了
传奇车型Sierra Cosworth 4x4的衣钵。

福睿斯在上世纪60年代末和70年代就曾登上巅峰，
而这款车又继承了塞拉的引擎与四驱系统。

其标志性的双层尾翼更是令人印象深刻！

这款性能出众的车型在1993年世界拉力锦标赛上
创下了13战5胜的骄人战绩。

它无疑为福特重返拉力赛车之巅立下了汗马功劳。`

catch.en: A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.
catch.zh: 一款装有独特双层尾翼的世界汽车拉力锦标赛赛事认证车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.

Introduced in 1992, the Escort RS Cosworth was a homologation model built to support Ford’s campaign in the WRC. It inherited the 2.0-liter twin-cam engine from the Sierra, producing 223.9 HP, and featured a 4-wheel-drive system that delivered exceptional rally performance. The car proved its capability with a 1-2 finish at the Rally de Portugal, followed by back-to-back victories in the Tour de Corse and Acropolis Rally, firmly reestablishing Ford as a force in the world of rallying.

long.en: Introduced in 1992, the Escort RS Cosworth was a homologation model built to support Ford’s campaign in the WRC. It inherited the 2.0-liter twin-cam engine from the Sierra, producing 223.9 HP, and featured a 4-wheel-drive system that delivered exceptional rally performance. The car proved its capability with a 1-2 finish at the Rally de Portugal, followed by back-to-back victories in the Tour de Corse and Acropolis Rally, firmly reestablishing Ford as a force in the world of rallying.
long.zh: 1992年推出的Escort RS Cosworth是Ford为征战世界拉力锦标赛而打造的认证车型。承袭自Sierra的双凸轮轴2升引擎（227 PS）搭配上四驱系统，让这台车在拉力赛场展现出惊人性能。这台车在葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二带回的成绩，并在科西嘉岛拉力赛与雅典卫城拉力赛中连续获胜，重振了Ford的拉力赛豪门地位。

conversation.en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.

The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than <400ps>.

Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Ford的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。

Raptor是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。

它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。

Raptor不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出<400ps>以上的6.2升V8引擎。

只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。
J

The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!

It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.

The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.

Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.

This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.
=
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
Raptor的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！

它不仅拥有Ford血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。

它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。

极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。

另外，这辆初代Raptor搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

brandCentral.en:
The Ford F-Series is one of the American brand's
best-selling offerings.

This model, the SVT Raptor, was added to the line-up
in 2010.

It was built for off-road use, with specially designed
dampers and an engine capable of more than <400ps>.

Its interior rivals that of a typical sports car.

By the way, the 'SVT' in its name stands for
'Special Vehicle Team'.

This is the team responsible for developing Ford's
highest-performance vehicles!<
brandCentral.zh:
Ford的F系列是美国车品牌中最畅销的产品之一。

这款SVT Raptor是在2010年加入F系列产品线阵容的。

这是一台专为越野而生的卡车，拥有专门设计的避震器
和超过<400ps>动力的引擎。

其豪华的内饰也足可以与典型的跑车相媲美。

顺便解释一下，其名称中的“SVT”代表了“特殊车辆团
队”（Special Vehicle Team）。

这是一个负责为Ford开发最高性能车辆的团队！

catch.en: With 411.2 HP on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.
catch.zh: 这款出自Ford的Special Vehicle团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417 PS的超强马力。

vehicleCollection.en:
With 411.2 HP on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.

The F-Series is Ford’s line of full-size pickup trucks, introduced in 1948. Over the decades, it became a staple of American roads and has held the title of the best-selling vehicle in the U.S. for more than 30 years. The F-150 SVT Raptor, developed by Ford’s Special Vehicle Team (SVT), was a purpose-built off-road variant of the F-150, using the same 4-wheel-drive system as its base model, for high-speed desert racing.

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Ford Focus ST.

The drivetrain has been converted from powering only the
front wheels to 4WD.

Various changes have also been made to alter the weight
distribution, such as moving the radiator to the rear.

The handling is considerably sharper as a result.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Ford Focus ST开发。

其传动系统从标准的前置前驱改为了四轮驱动。

为了调整配重比，这台车经历了翻天覆地的改装，例如
将散热器挪到了车身后部。

这辆车的操控性也因此得到了大幅强化，容错率更高。

catch.en: The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.
catch.zh: 这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

vehicleCollection.en:
The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.

A Gran Turismo Original, Ford’s Focus global hatchback has been reimagined to meet the demands of Gr.B regulations. To accommodate the changes, air intakes have been added just ahead of the rear fenders, channeling airflow to a rear-mounted radiator. Relocating the radiator to the trunk improved weight distribution, making it one of the most easy-to-drive machines in the Gr.B category.

The torque distribution was adjustable from full FWD

This allows you to even drift the car if you wanted to. [

catch.en: The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.

vehicleCollection.en:
The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.

Introduced in 2018, the fourth-generation Ford Focus included a high-performance RS variant in its lineup. This iteration marked the first time the RS featured 4-wheel drive, complete with adjustable torque distribution for enhanced handling. New selectable drive modes, such as "Track" and "Drift," were introduced, complementing an improved chassis and damping system. At its core was a 2.3-liter inline-4 EcoBoost engine producing 345.2 HP. With a zero–62.1 mph time of 4.7 seconds and a top speed of 165.3 mph, the car delivered remarkable performance in a compact package.

long.en: Introduced in 2018, the fourth-generation Ford Focus included a high-performance RS variant in its lineup. This iteration marked the first time the RS featured 4-wheel drive, complete with adjustable torque distribution for enhanced handling. New selectable drive modes, such as "Track" and "Drift," were introduced, complementing an improved chassis and damping system. At its core was a 2.3-liter inline-4 EcoBoost engine producing 345.2 HP. With a zero–62.1 mph time of 4.7 seconds and a top speed of 165.3 mph, the car delivered remarkable performance in a compact package.
long.zh: 2018年推出的第4代Ford Focus系列包含高性能“RS”车型。这台第4代RS首次配备四驱系统并支持扭矩分配调节。该车新增“赛道”与“漂移”等驾驶模式，底盘与避震器也得到了同步优化。其搭载的是一台2.3升直列4缸“EcoBoost”引擎（350 PS）。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为4.7秒，最高速度达266 公里/小时，性能极其卓越。

catch.en: Ford's Sport Technology was on full display in this late-model, compact performance car.
catch.zh: 这款新型高性能紧凑车型充分展示了Ford的跑车技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
Ford's Sport Technology was on full display in this late-model, compact performance car.

Since its debut in 1998, the Focus ST—the performance model in the Focus lineup—has remained a favorite among driving enthusiasts. The “ST” designation stands for “Sports Technology." In its third generation, the ST adopted a smaller engine than its predecessor, yet output was increased by 24.7 HP, bringing the total to 246.5 HP. Aimed squarely at purists, it retained a 6-speed manual transmission, a rare offering in a market increasingly dominated by two-pedal alternatives.

Aimed squarely at purists, it retained a 6-speed manual transmission, a rare offering in a market increasingly dominated by two-pedal alternatives.
long.zh: Focus ST作为Focus系列的运动车型，自1998年首次亮相以来一直备受喜爱。ST代表“Sports Technology”。尽管第3代ST的引擎比前代更小，但动力输出反而增加了25 PS，达到250 PS。当市场很多车型开始采用双离合变速器时，这款车型坚持以全六速手动变速箱等特点迎合硬核车迷。

Now, this is a true icon! A modern take
on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.

In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful

conversation.en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!

 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.

The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.

This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！

将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。

而实际上，GT40要小上一号。

在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。

“大号”的新Ford GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。

这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有Ford的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。

无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。

这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 type=9׾

vehicleCollection.en:
The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.

Built to commemorate Ford’s 100th anniversary, the Ford GT drew both its silhouette and spirit from the iconic GT40—a legend born from its sweep of the top three positions at the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, and its unprecedented four-year winning streak that followed through 1969. With a 0–60 mph time of just 3.3 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph, the GT delivered performance worthy of its heritage. A total of 4,038 units were produced over a three-year span, concluding in 2006.

With a 0–60 mph time of just 3.3 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph, the GT delivered performance worthy of its heritage. A total of 4,038 units were produced over a three-year span, concluding in 2006.

conversation.en:
The Mini, Beetle and Cinquecento of today...

Are more than just products of their manufacturers.
They have become unique brands unto themselves.

Well, the Ford GT that appeared in 2005 is
a sports car example of this phenomenon.

Nine years later, a slew of hypercars
would appear, stirring fierce rivalry.

This 2017 Ford GT returned to its origins while,
at the same time, adopting innovation.

Viewed from a low angle, it bears traces of
the 1960s car that raced at Le Mans.

And from a higher angle, one can clearly make out
its innovative three-dimensional design.
g

conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
极具标志性特色的Mini、Beetle和Cinquecento……

……不仅只是一款产品……

……更成为了各自品牌独一无二的名片。

这款2005年亮相的Ford GT
则是Ford的超跑“门面”。

但在那之后的九年间，随着大量超级跑车相继问世，
市场竞争日趋激烈。

这款2017 Ford GT采用了传承经典的设计理念，
同时引入了多项革新。

俯下身来观察，你会发现它甚至保留了
1960年代勒芒赛车时的部分特征。

而通过俯瞰视角，则可以清晰地见证革新性的3D建模设计车壳。

brandCentral.en:
This third generation Ford GT continues the legacy
begun so many years ago by the famed GT40.

Equipped with a 3.6L V6 twin-turbo engine, it boasts an
output of <656ps>, with maximum torque of <76kgm>.

These supreme specs make it the highest-powered road car
Ford has ever put into production.

The race version was earning plaudits as early as 2016,
finishing top in its class at Le Mans.

This was no insignificant victory, coming as it did exactly
50 years after a GT first won the very same race.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆第三代Ford GT继承了传奇车款GT40在许多年之前开创的
优良传统。

它搭载有一台3.6L V6双涡轮增压引擎，可以输出<656ps>的动力，
最大扭矩为<76kgm>。

这些超乎想象的参数也让它成为了Ford的量产公路车中动
力最强劲的型号。

其赛车版本更是早在2016年就在勒芒捧起了所属组别的冠
军奖杯，赢得了无尽的赞扬。

而在50年前，同样是一辆GT赢得了同一项赛事。这绝对
是不可小觑的伟大成就。

catch.en: The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics.
catch.zh: Ford GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics.

Between 2005 and 2006, Ford produced the GT, a modern homage to the legendary GT40. A decade later, in 2015, a second-generation model was unveiled. While retaining the unmistakable lineage of the GT40, it introduced an aggressively aerodynamic form and cutting-edge engineering. Built around a carbon-fiber monocoque with aluminum subframes, it was significantly lighter and delivered a top speed of 216.2 mph.

long.en: Between 2005 and 2006, Ford produced the GT, a modern homage to the legendary GT40. A decade later, in 2015, a second-generation model was unveiled. While retaining the unmistakable lineage of the GT40, it introduced an aggressively aerodynamic form and cutting-edge engineering. Built around a carbon-fiber monocoque with aluminum subframes, it was significantly lighter and delivered a top speed of 216.2 mph.
long.zh: Ford在2005和2006年间复刻了GT40，推出Ford GT，并在2015年宣布推出第2代车型。该第2代车型延续了GT40神韵的同时，在空气动力学设计上做到了极致。碳纤维单体车壳配合铝制副车架减轻车重，让最高时速来到了348 公里/小时。

Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT

was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.

About 1,500 units of this reproduction model

Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!
?

cars.nameEn: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
cars.nameZh: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II

brandCentral.en:
Ford's achievements at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s
are some of the most impressive in the company's history.

Their newly developed GT40 allowed them to beat the Ferrari
team, and become champions for the first time.

This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 race car is a modern version
of that classic motor.

It is based on the Ford GT that was released in 2004.

Its supercharged midship V8 engine is capable of a
massive <600ps>.

What's more, both the suspension and transmission have been
designed specially with racing in mind.
brandCentral.sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
brandCentral.zh:
Ford在1960年代的勒芒24小时耐力赛中取得的辉煌战绩是这
家公司历史上最激动人心的成就之一。

由他们自行研发的新车GT40击败了Ferrari车队，第一次拿下勒
芒赛事的冠军。

这辆跑车浪漫旅原创的Gr.3级别赛车就是那辆经典赛
车的现代版本。

它基于2004年推出的Ford GT开发。

车上搭载的中置机械增压V8引擎可以输出惊人的<600ps>马力，

包括悬挂系统和变速箱都针对比赛而进行了重新设计。

catch.en: Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

vehicleCollection.en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

This LM-spec machine represented a Le Mans–style reinterpretation of the Ford GT—an evolution of the 1960s GT40 legacy, infused with modern technology. Under the rear deck sat a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V-8 producing 591.7 HP. It also featured a double wishbone suspension and a race-ready 6-speed gearbox.

long.en: This LM-spec machine represented a Le Mans–style reinterpretation of the Ford GT—an evolution of the 1960s GT40 legacy, infused with modern technology. Under the rear deck sat a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V-8 producing 591.7 HP. It also featured a double wishbone suspension and a race-ready 6-speed gearbox.
long.zh: 这台LM GT赛车是Ford GT按照符合勒芒赛事规格打造的重制版，而Ford GT本身则是运用现代技术对上世纪60年代经典GT40的重新诠释。这台车延续了GT40在勒芒24小时耐力赛的传奇征程，并同样搭载了5.4升机械增压V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，动力输出达到了600 PS。并且也配备了双叉臂悬挂及赛车规格的6速变速箱。

Gran Turismo打造的梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

This LM-spec race car took the 2004 Ford GT and reengineered it for the rigors of Le Mans competition. Power output was raised from the street version’s 550.3 HP to 591.7 HP, while the body—faithful in size and shape to the production GT—was reconstructed entirely in carbon fiber, bringing curb weight down to just 2535 lbs.

GT赛车一直以来都是Ford Motor Company历史上王牌中的王牌。

This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with thesame result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.

It was an overwhelmin show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Ms title for Fo,
fnally putting an end to Ferrari's run.

collection.en:
When most people think of the Ford GT40, they think of
Carroll Shelby, and they wouldn't be wrong.

But it's worth mentioning that Shelby wasn't actually
involved with the first GT40 Mark I, debuted in 1964.

The Mark I was a car with a fantastic concept.

I think the way it retains the look of a classic GT car
makes it especially beautiful.

The only thing the Mark I was missing was the reliability
required for endurance racing.

That's why Ford decided to hand a large part of its
racing programme over to Carroll Shelby.

The rest of GT40's glorious story is, of course, history.

But the GT40 Mark I is where it all began, and obviously
it's considered a prized collector's item.
collection.zh:
大多数人听到Ford GT40时，都会想到卡罗尔·谢尔比，
他们这样想没有错。

但值得一提的是，谢尔比本人其实与1964年登场的首款GT40 Mark I
并无关系。

GT40 Mark I是一款有着杰出概念设计的跑车。

因为它保留了传统GT赛车的外形，我认为这一点令其
尤为惊艳。

Mark I唯一缺少的是耐力赛所需的可靠性。

所以Ford才将他们的赛车项目中相当大的一部分事务交给
了卡罗尔·谢尔比掌管。

此后GT40的光辉事迹，史册上早有公论。

但GT40 Mark I才是传奇的开端，而其作为稀有的汽车收藏品，
自然也是实至名归。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.

In a bold move to leave its mark on the racing world, Ford partnered with Lola Cars to develop the Mark I, which was completed in 1964. Based on the Lola-designed Mk6, the car was introduced as the Ford GT. The name "GT40" was coined by a reporter, amazed by the car’s height—just 40 inches from the ground. At the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, the improved Mark II version achieved a legendary 1-2-3 finish.

At the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, the improved Mark II version achieved a legendary 1-2-3 finish.

The Ford Mark IV dominated the 1967 Le Mans 24 hour race,

and it was a momentous achievement for Ford,
which had also won the prior year.

The car was powered by the 7L V8 engine that Carroll Shelby
had chosen for the Mark II,

But its chassis was completely different.

This chassis was based on the J-car that was under development
to meet new regulations…

incorporating cutting edge aerodynamic innovations.

As a result, the Mark IV was incredibly quick.

So quick in fct, that it finished a full four laps ahead of
the second-placed Ferrari 330 P4 at Le Mans in 1967.

It's also worth noting that the drivers Dan Gurney and
A.J. Foyt were both American,

making this the first victory for an all-American team
in te history of the 24 hours of Le Mans.

And it's because of these facts at the Ford Ma IV
as a special place in motorsport history. j

该底盘来自研发中的J-car，后者的研发旨在满足新发布的
比赛规则……

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.

Following this triumph, Ford responded to updated FIA regulations by developing the Mark IV—a new test car with a highly aerodynamic body. This redesign pushed the top speed to 215.6 mph and significantly improved high-speed stability, crucial to its success in the 1967 Le Mans. There, the Mark IV outpaced its rival by five laps, securing a second consecutive victory for Ford at the famed endurance race.

used by Ford in the 1960s.

It's what powered classic models like the GT40 and the
Shelby 427 Cobra.

Well, the 429 engine is the successor to that 427 unit.

Historically speaking, it was developed as part of Ford's
push into NASCAR racing.

While the street-legal Boss 429 produced a conservative
<380ps>, its racing version boasted around <560ps>.

NASCAR entry regulations required 500 of these engines to
be mass-produced.

After the Mustang Boss 429 fulfilled the homologation
requirement, it ended production in a short two years.
collection.zh:
这是一辆装有Boss 429 Ford赛车引擎的传奇Mustang。

您可能听说过Ford在20世纪60年代使用的427“侧油器”引擎。

它是为GT40和Shelby 427 Cobra等经典车型提供动力的核心。

在历史上，429引擎作为427的后继型号，

是Ford为了进入NASCAR赛车运动而专门开发的。

虽然合法上路版BOSS 429的动力输出相对保守，仅有<380ps>，
而其赛车版本的动力则高达<560ps>。

NASCAR参赛条件规定这些引擎必须生产至少500台。

也因此，Mustang BOSS 429在满足认证要求后，
在短短两年内就结束了生产。

This enhanced variant was exclusively offered on the 1969 and 1970 model years of Ford’s original Mustang. Easily identified by its prominent hood scoop, it is often hailed as the most powerful Mustang in the model’s storied history.

brandCentral.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang represented a big step
in the model's evolutionary process.

For the first time, it utilized a 4-wheel independent
suspension system.

This dramatically improved the handling of the car, allowing
it to corner like a true well-balanced sports car.

Base models were equipped with a peppy turbocharged
inline-4 engine.

However, the GT had Ford's legendary V-8, which produced
<441ps> and <40kgm> of torque.
brandCentral.zh:
第六代Mustang的演变也许是此车传奇历史上最引人注目的一页：

四轮独立悬挂的首次引入

显著改善了稳定性和操控性。

基础车型搭载的是简配后的直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，

GT版则采用了Ford传奇的V8引擎，可以产生<441ps>的动力和<40kgm>
的扭矩。

catch.en: The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.
catch.zh: 在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

In 2014, marking the 50th anniversary of the Mustang’s debut and amid unprecedented global demand, Ford unveiled the sixth-generation model after an intensive development effort. This new iteration featured more aggressive styling and introduced 4-wheel independent suspension for the first time in the car’s lineage. Among many variants in the lineup, it is the Mustang GT that captures the hearts of true enthusiasts, thanks to its iconic V-8 powerplant.

long.en: In 2014, marking the 50th anniversary of the Mustang’s debut and amid unprecedented global demand, Ford unveiled the sixth-generation model after an intensive development effort. This new iteration featured more aggressive styling and introduced 4-wheel independent suspension for the first time in the car’s lineage. Among many variants in the lineup, it is the Mustang GT that captures the hearts of true enthusiasts, thanks to its iconic V-8 powerplant.
long.zh: 在经过漫长而艰巨的开发周期之后，2014年，Ford推出了第六代Ford Mustang。这款经典车型不仅迎来了50周年纪念，在全球市场上的销量也攀至顶峰。这辆车采用了更具侵略性的外观风格，还配备了一套四轮独立悬挂系统。这一代的产品谱系中包含了多个版本，而采用了标志性V8引擎的Mustang GT是最受关注的一款。

vehicleCollection.zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

This road car was designed as a homologated
Ford Mustang Gr.3.

There is absolutely nothing standard about its acceleration
or cornering capabilities.

It's a powerful FR, making it a great choice for anyone
who wants to do some drifting.
brandCentral.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
Ford Mustang Gr.3级别赛车。

它的加速性或者过弯能力都远高于标准。

这是一辆性能强大的前置后驱车，也是所有漂移爱好者
的上上之选。

catch.en: The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.
catch.zh: 诞生于该车型第50周年的第6代Mustang，Ford的这款杰作广销至全球120多个国家。

vehicleCollection.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.

This particular version serves as a homologation model of the Mustang Gr.3—a Gran Turismo Original that reimagines Ford’s legendary coupe to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. With its roots in motorsport, the car’s performance has been finely tuned, placing particular emphasis on cornering prowess. A true all-rounder, it excels equally in circuit time attacks and controlled drifting alike.

long.en: This particular version serves as a homologation model of the Mustang Gr.3—a Gran Turismo Original that reimagines Ford’s legendary coupe to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. With its roots in motorsport, the car’s performance has been finely tuned, placing particular emphasis on cornering prowess. A true all-rounder, it excels equally in circuit time attacks and controlled drifting alike.
long.zh: Mustang Gr.3是为了符合Gr.3组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，而这辆车则是它的赛事认证车型。这一车型本身就是基于赛车打造，所以这次主要围绕过弯能力对其性能指标进行了优化。它在赛道上非常均衡、全面，不论是计时挑战还是漂移赛，都能做到游刃有余。

The sixth-generation Mustang served as the foundation
for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

One of the Mustang's great attributes was its speed.

That said, its improved handling made it a well-rounded
race car.

这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用第六代Mustang
作为其基础车型。

令人难以置信的最高时速是其最突出的优势，

而长轴距则提供了卓越的稳定性。

vehicleCollection.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.

The Mustang Gr.3 is a Gran Turismo Original creation, transforming Ford’s legendary Mustang coupe into a machine built to meet Gr.3 race regulations. Its fenders have been dramatically widened to accommodate broader tires, while large rear air outlets were integrated to efficiently channel airflow. This modern muscle car excels through the stability offered by its long wheelbase and boasts an exceptional top speed that’s hard to match.

Its fenders have been dramatically widened to accommodate broader tires, while large rear air outlets were integrated to efficiently channel airflow. This modern muscle car excels through the stability offered by its long wheelbase and boasts an exceptional top speed that’s hard to match.

Mustang那无以伦比的稳定性在这个改装版本中也得到了保留。

理所当然的，车身涂装中也加入了Ford的传统赛车条纹。

conversation.en:
The Mustang Mach 1 is one of America's most historic
sports cars.

Its distinctively flowing 'SportsRoof' fastback body style...

would prove to have a major impact on
future sports car design.

A legendary presence in the history of muscle cars,
it offers much more than even its price suggests.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Mustang Mach 1是美国最具历史意义的跑车之一。

那显眼的“运动车顶”式溜背车身风格……

对此后的跑车设计产生重大影响。

作为肌肉车史上的一个传奇，
光看标价无法完全反映出其真正的价值。
`

usedCar.en:
You can't have a discussion about great American sports cars
without mentioning the Mustang Mach 1.

Its fastback body, where the roof slopes towards the rear
of the car, is one of the Mach 1's signature elements.

Originally introduced in 1968, it featured a front-engine,
rear-wheel-drive layout that we call "FR."

Its performance was awesome, especially in a straight line.

The 1971 model had a 7.0-liter V-8 429 Cobra Jet engine, still
one of the most powerful engines Ford has ever produced!

And the wide tires ensured that the car had plenty of traction
when you stomped on the throttle. &
usedCar.zh:
在讨论最出色的美国跑车时，
你不可能不提到Mustang Mach 1。

有谁能忘记那极度倾斜的斜背式“Fastback”车身呢？

Mach 1被认为是这种设计的
范例车型。

自然，它的性能也
非常出众。

1971年版的Mach 1搭载了一台7升V8 429 Cobra Jet引擎
——这款引擎至今仍是Ford生产过的最强大的引擎之一！

宽大的轮胎进一步强化了这辆车优秀的
加速性能。<

catch.en: With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.
catch.zh: 全球的跑车都追随着这款车型掀起的激进风格潮流。

vehicleCollection.en:
With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.

Following its debut in 1964, the original Ford Mustang underwent a transformation in 1969, adopting a larger and more muscular body design. Among the updated lineup, the Mach 1, distinguished by its bold SportsRoof fastback, stood out for its aggressive appearance. Its styling left a lasting impression, influencing sports car design across the globe for years to come.

long.en: Following its debut in 1964, the original Ford Mustang underwent a transformation in 1969, adopting a larger and more muscular body design. Among the updated lineup, the Mach 1, distinguished by its bold SportsRoof fastback, stood out for its aggressive appearance. Its styling left a lasting impression, influencing sports car design across the globe for years to come.
long.zh: 在1964年首次亮相以来，初代Ford Mustang在1969年迎来了重大改款，采用了尺寸更大的全新车身设计。这款Mach 1型号拥有被称为“运动车顶”的斜背车身，而这种威武霸气的形象也让它在整个产品家族中人气特别高。它的风格甚至对全世界的跑车外观设计都产生了深远的影响。

catch.en: This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.
catch.zh: 这款7代Mustang的高性能车型被赋予了一位传奇的名字。

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.

The original GT350R was developed for race competition in 1965, based on the original Mustang. The 2016 Shelby GT350R was similarly based on the seventh generation Mustang, with the engine tuned to 525.6 HP. The chassis components supporting the engine performance were also upgraded, resulting in a car that was fit to go to the circuit straight from the factory.

long.en: The original GT350R was developed for race competition in 1965, based on the original Mustang. The 2016 Shelby GT350R was similarly based on the seventh generation Mustang, with the engine tuned to 525.6 HP. The chassis components supporting the engine performance were also upgraded, resulting in a car that was fit to go to the circuit straight from the factory.

usedCar.en:
The Ford Sierra RS 500 Cosworth is a truly legendary car,
one that all race fans especially like.

It's a special model, built with the globally popular Gr.A
races in mind, which are for cars based on production models.

The original Sierra is a rear-wheel-drive car,
developed by Ford's European operation.

The RS Cosworth was then created to compete in
1985's Gr.A races.

The car was notable for its 2.0-liter front-mounted turbo
engine, created by the esteemed English company Cosworth

Its suspension and body were specially tuned.

An even more powerful evolution model based on the
RS Cosworth was released in 1987.

That is this car, the Sierra RS 500 Cosworth.
Everything has been upgraded, including the engine.

Its expoits in the Gr.A races of the late 1980s and early
1990s are still talked out to this da˳
usedCar.zh:
福特Sierra RS 500 Cosworth是一辆货真价实的传奇汽车，
是许多赛车车迷的心头好。

眼前的这台特殊车型在设计时就考虑参加全球高人气的
组别A比赛——一项基于零售车型的改装赛车参加的比赛。

原版的Sierra是后轮驱动的车型，由福特的欧洲部门开发。

而RS Cosworth的诞生则是专门为了1985年的组别A比赛。

它的亮点包括一台2升的前置涡轮增压引擎，
由备受推崇的英国公司v斯沃斯设计打造。

悬挂和车身也经过了特别调试。

1987年，一个基于RS Cosworth开发，性能更强的
进化车型发布。

也就是我们现在看到的这辆Sierra RS 500 Cosworth！
它接受了包括引擎在内全面升级。

在二十世纪八十年代晚期到九十年代早w{的组别A比_q中e
它的出色表现至今令人津津乐道！`

catch.zh: 一辆称霸房车赛的Cosworth杰作。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Cosworth tuned masterpiece that dominated touring car racing.

The Sierra RS Cosworth was created in 1995 by the masters at Cosworth. Originally a family car, the Sierra’s 2L inline-4 engine was fully tuned, adding a DOHC head and turbocharger, along with other chassis upgrades. The Sierra RS500 Cosworth was introduced a year later. Between 1988 and 1990, it competed in Group A category races around the world, winning several championship titles.

long.en: The Sierra RS Cosworth was created in 1995 by the masters at Cosworth. Originally a family car, the Sierra’s 2L inline-4 engine was fully tuned, adding a DOHC head and turbocharger, along with other chassis upgrades. The Sierra RS500 Cosworth was introduced a year later. Between 1988 and 1990, it competed in Group A category races around the world, winning several championship titles.

conversation.en:
The Fugu Z is a very fine car indeed.

I especially like the intentionally spartan interior, which
uses few added parts for nearly double the power.

The original 240Z was simple, with beautiful proportions,
and this car has respected that.

Take the original fender mirrors—they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White colour.

It’s as if a young Californian came upon a Z
that was a bit rough around the edges...

And polished it with the admiration he had
for the car of his memories.

Now the raw spirit of the 1973 Z shines brightly
in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!

brandCentral.en:
The Fugu Z stemmed from the imagination of actor Sung Kang, who's
best known for his role in the "Fast and Furious" series.

The car is based on a 1973 Datsun 240Z.

The body kit was supplied by popular custom manufacturer
Rocket Bunny.

Under its hood is the RB26DETT from the GT-R sans turbos.

The combination of its stylish exterior and high-tech engine
makes the Fugu worthy of being in the next FF movie.

It certainly impressed us. It won the Gran Turismo's
Best in Show Award at the 2015 SEMA show.
brandCentral.zh:
Fugu Z是《速度与激情》演员姜成镐（Sung Kang）心中的梦幻
车款。

它的改装原型是一台1973年的Datsun 240Z。

车身套件则来自于人气很高的外观定制商Rocket Bunny。

就连它的引擎都是一款独一无二的工程产物。

那是一台Skyline GT-R引以为傲的著名引擎RB26DETT，不过改造成了
自然进气模式。

难怪这辆小宝贝在2015年的美国汽车用品改装协会大展上
赢得了Gran Turismo的最佳巡展奖。>

catch.en: This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.
catch.zh: 2015年GT大奖获胜者，这款“有毒的”240Z使用的是自然进气的RB26引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.

This car was the winner of the GT Award at SEMA 2015. Built by actor Sung Kang, it started with a 1973 Nissan 240Z as its foundation. It was powered by an RB26DETT engine sourced from a GT-R, which was converted to natural aspiration and tuned to produce 216 HP. The car’s aggressive styling was enhanced with wide over-fenders and front and rear spoilers crafted by Rocket Bunny.

long.en: This car was the winner of the GT Award at SEMA 2015. Built by actor Sung Kang, it started with a 1973 Nissan 240Z as its foundation. It was powered by an RB26DETT engine sourced from a GT-R, which was converted to natural aspiration and tuned to produce 216 HP. The car’s aggressive styling was enhanced with wide over-fenders and front and rear spoilers crafted by Rocket Bunny.
long.zh: 2015年SEMA展“GT大奖”得主。这台基于1973款Nissan 240Z的定制车由演员姜成镐一手打造而成。动力单元来自GT-R的RB26DETT引擎，改为自然进气后仍然能输出220 PS的动力。宽挡泥板和前后扰流板来自Rocket Bunny。

conversation.en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its center fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.

This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windshield and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.speaker: Ed Welburn
conversation.zh:
这辆GT by Citroën概念车带来了令人惊诧的设计。

它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。

这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。

挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by Citroën呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。

conversation.en: Wow, that was fascinating! Thanks!
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

哇，好精彩的解说！感谢感谢！
R

conversation.en:
Don’t mention it. I’d love to talk to you again sometime.
Well, until then!
conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president

conversation.speaker: Ed Welburn

不用谢。我希望下次还有机会和你们聊聊。
那么，回见了！

The GT by Citroën, unveiled in 2008, was a collaboration
between Citroën and Gran Turismo.

The car you see here is the road-going version of
the concept.

While the original study was powered by electricity, this one
came equipped with a mid-mounted gasoline V-8.

The body was penned by Takumi Yamamoto, a designer
at Citroën.

The lines of the car suggest the intricacies
of Japanese samurai armor.
brandCentral.zh:
Citroën GT来自于Citroën和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目，于2008年
首次亮相。

原概念车是一台电动车，这款公路车则采用了中置V8引
擎，仍以汽油为燃料。

它是由Citroën的设计师山本卓一设计的。

山本的独特设计从日本的盔甲中汲取了大量的灵感。/

catch.en: From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.
catch.zh: 化作公路赛车的梦幻概念车型，采用中置V8引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.

Based on the GT by Citroën, first shown at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, this model has been reimagined as the ultimate road-going version. The most significant change lay in the powertrain, transformed from a high-performance EV into a V-8-powered, mid-engine sports car. Its distinctive, armor-like styling was preserved, creating a uniquely striking and high-performance machine built for the road.

long.en: Based on the GT by Citroën, first shown at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, this model has been reimagined as the ultimate road-going version. The most significant change lay in the powertrain, transformed from a high-performance EV into a V-8-powered, mid-engine sports car. Its distinctive, armor-like styling was preserved, creating a uniquely striking and high-performance machine built for the road.
long.zh: 该车以2008年巴黎车展上展出的“GT by Citroën”为基础，致力于打造极致的公路驾驶体验。最大的变化在于动力系统，从一台高性能电动车变身为一台由中置V8引擎驱动的跑车。独特的盔甲式造型得以保留，成就了这台魅力独具的高性能跑车。

brandCentral.en:
This Garage RCR Civic is a finely-tuned mod of the EG Civic,
a popular Japanese hot hatch from the 1990s.

Garage RCR is a body shop located in Phoenix, Arizona.

They specialise in fitting PANDEM widebody kits and
other Japanese tuning parts to cars.

This car is, without a doubt, a JDM custom hero.

Powered by a swapped-in 2.4L K-series engine with turbo,
it can push 400 horsepower, and drives like a dream.

In 2017, it was crowned with the Gran Turismo Award at SEMA,
the world’s largest custom-car show.
brandCentral.zh:
EG Civic是一款20世纪90年代流行的日本高性能掀背车，
这辆Garage RCR Civic就是对该车型精心改装后的产物。

Garage RCR是一家位于亚利桑那州凤凰城的车身工厂。

他们擅长安装PANDEM宽体套件以及
其他日产改装部件。

毫无疑问，这辆车是JDM改装车中的精品。

它搭载了一台带涡轮增压的2.4L K系列引擎，
最大功率可达400马力，驾驶起来更是如梦如幻。

2017年，它在全球最大的改装车展SEMA展会上
荣获Gran Turismo大奖。

catch.en: A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.
catch.zh: 以经典JDM风格改装的计时赛专用Civic。

vehicleCollection.en:
A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.

This striking machine was the winner of the 2017 Gran Turismo Award. Based on a 1992 EG Honda Civic, it features a PANDEM wide-body kit and a carbon-fiber hood inspired by a design from J's Racing. The interior has been fully stripped to reduce weight, and the original engine has been replaced with a K24 inline-4. This car stood as a striking symbol of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) scene.

long.en: This striking machine was the winner of the 2017 Gran Turismo Award. Based on a 1992 EG Honda Civic, it features a PANDEM wide-body kit and a carbon-fiber hood inspired by a design from J's Racing. The interior has been fully stripped to reduce weight, and the original engine has been replaced with a K24 inline-4. This car stood as a striking symbol of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) scene.
long.zh: 2017年“Gran Turismo大奖”得主。以1992年的Civic EG为基础，配备PANDEM宽体套件和采用J's Racing设计的碳纤维引擎盖。拆除内饰以进行轻量化处理，引擎换装为K24直列四缸引擎。这款车是JDM（日本国内市场）改装文化的典型代表。

vehicleCollection.zh:

2017年“Gran Turismo大奖”得主。以1992年的Civic EG为基础，配备PANDEM宽体套件和采用J's Racing设计的碳纤维引擎盖。拆除内饰以进行轻量化处理，引擎换装为K24直列四缸引擎。这款车是JDM（日本国内市场）改装文化的典型代表。

brandCentral.en:
In 2015, the South Korean manufacturer Hyundai established
its 'Genesis' premium brand.

The G70 is the third model produced by the brand since its
inception.

It's the entry-level model of the Genesis sedan range.

Since debuting in 2017, the G70 has been widely praised for
its design...

Though that design was overhauled in 2020, adding an extra
layer of refinement to the car's striking appearance.

This 3.3T is the highest grade model in the G70 range.

It has a 3.3L V6 twin turbo engine, capable of a massive
<370ps>.
brandCentral.zh:
2015年，韩国车厂现代成立了名为“捷尼赛思”的高级旗下品牌。

G70是该品牌诞生后生产的第三个车型。

它也是捷尼赛思轿车系列的入门级车型。

自从G70于2017年公布以来，它的设计大受各方好评……

该车的设计在2020年进行了大幅修改，
使得这辆车本已新颖的外形变得更加精致了。

这辆3.3T是G70车型中的最高端版本。

它搭载了一台3.3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎，能输出
<370ps>的澎湃动力。

catch.en: An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.
catch.zh: 一辆Genesis运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

vehicleCollection.en:
An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

Introduced in 2017, the Genesis G70 sports sedan marked the brand’s entry-level offering. It came with three powertrain options: a 3.3-liter twin-turbo V-6 producing 364.9 HP, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline, and a 2.2-liter turbodiesel. A major facelift followed in 2020, incorporating design cues from Genesis’ flagship models. In 2021, a shooting brake variant—offered exclusively in Europe—further elevated the G70’s appeal.

long.en: Introduced in 2017, the Genesis G70 sports sedan marked the brand’s entry-level offering. It came with three powertrain options: a 3.3-liter twin-turbo V-6 producing 364.9 HP, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline, and a 2.2-liter turbodiesel. A major facelift followed in 2020, incorporating design cues from Genesis’ flagship models. In 2021, a shooting brake variant—offered exclusively in Europe—further elevated the G70’s appeal.
long.zh: Genesis G70运动轿车在2017年作为入门级的Genesis车型推出。该车提供三种动力单元：3.3升V6双涡轮增压引擎、2升汽油涡轮增压引擎与2.2升柴油涡轮增压引擎，其中V6引擎动力输出达370 PS。2020年的重大改款引入了诸多豪华车型的设计元素。2021年，专供欧洲市场的猎装车型再度引发关注。

An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

As the entry point to the Genesis lineup, the G70 plays a key role in introducing drivers to the brand’s appeal. Its design was refreshed in 2020 with styling cues from flagship models, and in 2021, a sleek shooting brake variant was launched exclusively for the European market. The Genesis G70 GR4 is a Gran Turismo-spec machine, finely tuned for Gr.4 competition.

long.en: As the entry point to the Genesis lineup, the G70 plays a key role in introducing drivers to the brand’s appeal. Its design was refreshed in 2020 with styling cues from flagship models, and in 2021, a sleek shooting brake variant was launched exclusively for the European market. The Genesis G70 GR4 is a Gran Turismo-spec machine, finely tuned for Gr.4 competition.
long.zh: 作为入门级车型，G70肩负着让驾驶者感受Genesis品牌魅力的使命。该车型在2020年进行了设计更新，采用了高端车型的美学理念，并于2021年专为欧洲市场推出了猎装版。这款Genesis G70 GR4是专为Gr.4组别比赛调校的《跑车浪漫旅》版本。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆Genesis运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.4 racing car is a Gran Turismo original, based on
the Genesis X Concept.

The Genesis X Concept is a concept model, released in 2020.

It incorporates a futuristic design vision, based around the
signature Two Lines theme.

This car takes that model as a base...

And turns it into an all-new Genesis racing machine!
brandCentral.zh:
这台Gr.4赛车是Gran Turismo的原创赛车，
原型为Genesis X Concept。

Genesis X Concept是一辆于2020年亮相的概念车。

它的外形设计以标志性的双线为基准，
采用了未来的设计理念。

这辆车以那款车为基础……

将它改造成了一款全新的Genesis赛车！_

catch.en: A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.
catch.zh: 一台将奢华气质与竞赛级性能结合在一起的Gr.3赛道机器。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.

In April 2021, Genesis revealed its vision for the future of grand touring with the Genesis X Concept. Showcasing the brand’s "Athletic Elegance" design language, it featured the signature crest grille and clean, straight body lines. The Genesis X GR3 carries this design philosophy into the world of motorsports. This innovative Gr.3 machine embodies the fusion of luxury and racing prowess.

long.en: In April 2021, Genesis revealed its vision for the future of grand touring with the Genesis X Concept. Showcasing the brand’s "Athletic Elegance" design language, it featured the signature crest grille and clean, straight body lines. The Genesis X GR3 carries this design philosophy into the world of motorsports. This innovative Gr.3 machine embodies the fusion of luxury and racing prowess.
long.zh: Genesis在2021年4月发布未来GT跑车愿景之作——Genesis X概念车。该车采用的徽章格栅与笔直车身线条诠释了Genesis“运动优雅”的设计语言。Genesis X GR3则是传承了这一设计精髓的竞速机器。这款创新之作专为Gr.3组别打造，实现了豪华质感与竞技性能的融合。

vehicleCollection.zh:

cars.nameEn: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
cars.nameZh: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept

brandCentral.en:
Unveiled at the Gran Turismo World Series 2023 World Finals,
this first-generation Genesis Vision Gran Turismo...

Is distinguished by an iconic two lines’ brand identifier
that links its quad lights and crest grille.

Its cab-back design, which positions the driver
further back from the front...

Is based on proportions common to the entire Genesis
model line-up.

Such factors make it a VGT that emotionally applies Genesis’
Athletic Elegance design philosophy.(
brandCentral.sourceName: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
brandCentral.zh:
第一代Genesis Vision Gran Turismo于
Gran Turismo系列赛2023世界总决赛现场公布。

它最亮眼的设计便是以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条
元素将四盏条状大灯和盾徽形格栅进行了有机衔接。

此外它还采用了驾驶舱后移设计，
让驾驶员的位置更远离车头……

这款车型也同样延续了Genesis整个产品线
普遍采用的车身比例。

这些因素让这款VGT车型以充沛的感情
体现了Genesis的“运动优雅”设计理念。

catch.en: A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.
catch.zh: 体现出Genesis所追求的运动优雅理念的运动型双门跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.

The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodies the pinnacle of the brand’s design philosophy. It features Genesis’ signature anti-wedge profile, introducing fresh design ideas for future sports models. Powered by the Lambda II V-6 with electric assist, it produces 1,071 hp (1071 HP). It represents a perfect balance of sculpted beauty and raw performance.

long.en: The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodies the pinnacle of the brand’s design philosophy. It features Genesis’ signature anti-wedge profile, introducing fresh design ideas for future sports models. Powered by the Lambda II V-6 with electric assist, it produces 1,071 hp (1071 HP). It represents a perfect balance of sculpted beauty and raw performance.
long.zh: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept概念车是Genesis品牌“运动优雅”设计理念的终极诠释。设计采用了Genesis标志性的反楔形造型，展现了Genesis跑车系列的全新设计思路。动力系统结合Lambda II V6引擎和电动助力，输出功率达1071英制马力（1,086 PS）。最终呈现出一款外观与性能完美平衡的杰作。

cars.nameEn: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
cars.nameZh: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept

brandCentral.en:
This is the racing version of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta
Vision Gran Turismo Concept.

While the car is still a Berlinetta at heart...

New aerodynamic parts, such as a striking wing and a flat
underbody, provide much additional downforce.!
brandCentral.sourceName: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
brandCentral.zh:
这是Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
的赛车版本。

保留Berlinetta的核心设计理念的同时……

在空气动力学方面进行了升级，包括造型激进的大尺寸
尾翼和平滑的底板，额外提升了车辆的下压力。

catch.en: The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.
catch.zh: 加入各种空气动力学部件的Gran Berlinetta赛车版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.

The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the ultimate expression of Genesis’ "Athletic Elegance." This Racer version dramatically increases downforce to enhance lap times. Its hybrid powertrain paired a V-6 engine with electric assists to deliver a staggering 1518.7 HP and 1,015 ft-lb (1014.8 ft-lb) of torque.

long.en: The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the ultimate expression of Genesis’ "Athletic Elegance." This Racer version dramatically increases downforce to enhance lap times. Its hybrid powertrain paired a V-6 engine with electric assists to deliver a staggering 1518.7 HP and 1,015 ft-lb (1014.8 ft-lb) of torque.
long.zh: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept概念车完美诠释了Genesis品牌“运动优雅”的设计理念。赛车版本显著增强了下压力，有效提升了圈速表现。动力系统采用V6引擎配合电动助力的混合动力架构，综合输出功率达1,540 PS，扭矩为140.3 公斤力米。
