Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept概念车完美诠释了Genesis品牌“运动优雅”的设计理念。赛车版本显著增强了下压力，有效提升了圈速表现。动力系统采用V6引擎配合电动助力的混合动力架构，综合输出功率达1,540 PS，扭矩为140.3 公斤力米。

brandCentral.en:
There's nothing quite like a 1980s Formula 1 car.

They were stylish, powerful and downright raw, with
gobs of power and incredible sound.

Gran Turismo thought of bringing back the mystique
of that golden era with this car.

Powering this machine is a turbocharged 1.6-liter V-6
that recalls the classic engines of the day.

And it packs some serious Formula 1 heat, too.
How's <1000ps> at <11000rpm>?

If you want to feel a pure Formula 1 race car,
give this one a try.
brandCentral.zh:
俗话说，英雄所见略同……

如果您对外观设计略有心得，您一定也同意80年代的一
级方程式赛车是最美的！

这辆车就是跑车浪漫旅尝试将那个黄金年代再现的
产物。

它使用一台1.6L V6涡轮增压引擎，能让您再次体验到那个
时代的经典动力。

这款F1赛车能够输出非常强大的动力，在<11000rpm>的转速时能
够输出<1000ps>马力。

在我看来，没有一款车比它更值得推荐了。

catch.en: This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.
catch.zh: 一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.

The Gran Turismo F1500T-A was a modern tribute to the mid-1980s era of Formula 1, widely regarded as the golden age of F1 design. Its carbon-fiber chassis measured 166.7 inches in length, 84.5 inches in width, with a wheelbase of 107.0 inches. Power came from a turbocharged 1.5-liter V-6, a hallmark of 1980s F1, producing a staggering 986.2 HP at 11,000 rpm.

long.en: The Gran Turismo F1500T-A was a modern tribute to the mid-1980s era of Formula 1, widely regarded as the golden age of F1 design. Its carbon-fiber chassis measured 166.7 inches in length, 84.5 inches in width, with a wheelbase of 107.0 inches. Power came from a turbocharged 1.5-liter V-6, a hallmark of 1980s F1, producing a staggering 986.2 HP at 11,000 rpm.
long.zh: Gran Turismo F1500T-A是对20世纪80年代中期F1赛车设计的现代诠释，该时期常被称为F1造型的黄金时期。碳纤维制成的底盘长4,235毫米，宽2,146毫米，轴距为2,718毫米。来自20世纪80年代F1赛车经典的1.5升V6引擎在11000转/分时可输出1,000 PS。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

Gran Turismo F1500T-A是对20世纪80年代中期F1赛车设计的现代诠释，该时期常被称为F1造型的黄金时期。碳纤维制成的底盘长4,235毫米，宽2,146毫米，轴距为2,718毫米。来自20世纪80年代F1赛车经典的1.5升V6引擎在11000转/分时可输出1,000 PS。

brandCentral.en:
F1 machines of the early 1990s were technologically simple
yet remarkably elegant.

Gran Turismo’s very own formula machine, the F3500-A
was born from a deep admiration of this bygone era.

Like actual F1 race cars of the time, the chassis
is made from negative molded carbon fiber.

The car's naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12, with pneumatic
valves, is capable of reaching up to 15,000 revs.

It's got a 6-speed semi-automatic gearbox with paddle shifters
and a pushrod suspension, jus like the classic cars of yesteryear.

The body features a distinctive high-nose design, with front wings
from the nose rather than being underslung.

Proving there's no end to the evolution of F1 machines,
the F3500-A serves as a benchmark for whatis possible.
brandCentral.zh:
1990年代初的F1赛车虽然技术上相对简单，却是
极具优雅和艺术感的经典之作。

Gran Turismo中的F3500-A
脱胎于团队对这一时代赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

它模仿了当时的F1赛车，采用负压模成型的碳纤维材料
打造车架。

搭载一台使用气动气门的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，
最高转速可达15000转。

与换档拨片结合的是一款6速半自动变速箱，
悬挂方面采用了当时的经典推杆式悬挂系统。

单体车壳采用高鼻设计，前鼻翼并非下悬挂式，
而是直接与鼻锥相连，向两侧展开。

F3500-A可以视作是这一领域发展的模板，
展现了F1赛车不断进化的可能性。

catch.en: An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.
catch.zh: 一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.

The F3500-A, a Gran Turismo original, was born from a deep admiration for early 1990s Formula 1 machines. It was built around a carbon-fiber chassis and equipped with pushrod suspension. Its naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12 screamed to 15,000 rpm and was paired with a 6-speed semiautomatic transmission. Formula cars continue to evolve. The F3500-A stands as a benchmark—an idealized representation of just how far performance and design had advanced during that era.

long.en: The F3500-A, a Gran Turismo original, was born from a deep admiration for early 1990s Formula 1 machines. It was built around a carbon-fiber chassis and equipped with pushrod suspension. Its naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12 screamed to 15,000 rpm and was paired with a 6-speed semiautomatic transmission. Formula cars continue to evolve. The F3500-A stands as a benchmark—an idealized representation of just how far performance and design had advanced during that era.
long.zh: F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。车辆采用碳纤维底盘与推杆悬挂。3.5升自然进气V12引擎能够达到15,000 转每分的转速，搭配6速半自动变速箱。方程式赛车始终在不断进化。F3500-A完全可以被视为衡量方程式赛车发展的标杆。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。车辆采用碳纤维底盘与推杆悬挂。3.5升自然进气V12引擎能够达到15,000 转每分的转速，搭配6速半自动变速箱。方程式赛车始终在不断进化。F3500-A完全可以被视为衡量方程式赛车发展的标杆。

brandCentral.en:
Gran Turismo players may already have been familiar with
the special formula machine known as the F3500-A.

The F3500-B was its variant, although both cars were
born of the same admiration for 1990s F1 racing.

The key difference lay in their power units. Where the F3500-A
employed a V-12, the B model carried a V-8.

Although less powerful, the V-8 delivered an output of <710ps>.
Light and compact, it carried advantages of its own.

Note the newly added front wing, crafted specifically or the
car’s high nose and offered in three unique designs.

Beyond showcasing an evolution of the hanging wing concept,
it was a visual delight.

Setting the benchmark for formula machines, the F3500-B
delivered an experience that only a V-8 coud provide.
brandCentral.zh:
《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家或许早已对
名为F3500-A的特殊方程式赛车耳熟能详。

这款F3500-B是其衍生型号，两款车均
源于对90年代一级方程式赛车的致敬。

二者的主要区别在于动力单元：
F3500-A采用V12引擎，而B型则搭载V8引擎。

V8的动力虽稍逊，但最大输出仍达<710ps>，
紧凑且轻量化的引擎结构更增独特优势。

注意观察新增的前翼，专为匹配该车的高鼻锥设计，
并提供了三种独特款式。

它不仅展现了悬吊式前翼设计的演进，
更带来视觉上的享受。

作为方程式赛车的标杆之作，F3500-B
带来了独属于V8引擎的驾驭体验。

catch.en: Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.
catch.zh: GT系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.

The F3500-A was conceived as a tribute to the early 1990s Formula 1 race cars, and the F3500-B proudly carries that legacy forward. Its most significant evolution lies in the powertrain. While the F3500-A was powered by a V-12, the F3500-B adopts a compact, lightweight V-8. Although smaller in displacement, this engine revs to an astonishing 13,800 rpm, generating more than 700.2 HP in the process. The F3500-B also offers three distinct front wing configurations for its high-nose layout.

long.en: The F3500-A was conceived as a tribute to the early 1990s Formula 1 race cars, and the F3500-B proudly carries that legacy forward. Its most significant evolution lies in the powertrain. While the F3500-A was powered by a V-12, the F3500-B adopts a compact, lightweight V-8. Although smaller in displacement, this engine revs to an astonishing 13,800 rpm, generating more than 700.2 HP in the process. The F3500-B also offers three distinct front wing configurations for its high-nose layout.
long.zh: F3500-A是一款向90年代初期的F1赛事致敬的原创赛车，F3500-B则为其继任者。两者最大的变化在于动力总成。与F3500-A搭载的V12引擎不同，F-3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。虽然V8引擎通常功率较低，但这台引擎的转速最高可达13,800 转每分，从而实现超过710 PS的动力输出。F3500-B还为高鼻锥提供了三种不同的前翼选择。

vehicleCollection.zh:
GT系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

F3500-A是一款向90年代初期的F1赛事致敬的原创赛车，F3500-B则为其继任者。两者最大的变化在于动力总成。与F3500-A搭载的V12引擎不同，F-3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。虽然V8引擎通常功率较低，但这台引擎的转速最高可达13,800 转每分，从而实现超过710 PS的动力输出。F3500-B还为高鼻锥提供了三种不同的前翼选择。

brandCentral.en:
This go-kart-style vehicle is a Gran Turismo original!

Equipped with a sequential six-speed manual transmission
and front brakes...

It feels a lot like a formula car to drive!

In fact, it can even reach speeds of up to <200km/h>,
depending on its gear ratio.

So don't let its appearance fool you—this is one zippy ride!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆卡丁车模样的赛车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型！

搭载序列式六速手动变速箱和前轮刹车……

事实上，此车的驾驶感觉更像一辆方程式赛车！

在进行齿轮比设置后，其时速甚至可以达到<200km/h>。

因此，不要被这辆车的外表迷惑了——这是一辆活力四
射、灵活迅捷的车！

catch.en: With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.
catch.zh: 拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.

While racing karts are typically viewed as the gateway to motorsports, the Shifter Kart is more akin to a sub-formula race car. Equipped with a 125 cc water-cooled two-stroke engine mated to a 6-speed gearbox and featuring front-only braking, it is capable of reaching speeds up to 124.3 mph. This is a racing machine that hones the skills of race drivers.

long.en: While racing karts are typically viewed as the gateway to motorsports, the Shifter Kart is more akin to a sub-formula race car. Equipped with a 125 cc water-cooled two-stroke engine mated to a 6-speed gearbox and featuring front-only braking, it is capable of reaching speeds up to 124.3 mph. This is a racing machine that hones the skills of race drivers.
long.zh: 尽管卡丁车通常会被视作是赛车竞技领域的入门级车辆，但这款Shifter Kart更该被称为是一辆“迷你版”方程式赛车。它采用了一台125 立方厘米水冷2冲程引擎，连接到一套6速变速箱，而且仅配备了前轮刹车，可以达到时速200 公里的惊人极速。这是一部真正的比赛机器，通常被用于训练顶级车手。

vehicleCollection.zh:
拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

尽管卡丁车通常会被视作是赛车竞技领域的入门级车辆，但这款Shifter Kart更该被称为是一辆“迷你版”方程式赛车。它采用了一台125 立方厘米水冷2冲程引擎，连接到一套6速变速箱，而且仅配备了前轮刹车，可以达到时速200 公里的惊人极速。这是一部真正的比赛机器，通常被用于训练顶级车手。

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior
cars.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior

brandCentral.en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

Considered an entry-level model, as opposed to the
higher-performing X2014 Standard...

Its highly aerodynamic body makes it a great choice for
anyone looking to learn how to drive a formula car.

It comes equipped with a <250ps> 2L straight-four engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

相对于性能更高的X2014 Standard而言，这是一台入门车……

其车身在空气动力学方面进行了高度优化，是任何想学
习驾驶方程式赛车的人的最佳选择。

安装在这台车上的是一台<250ps>的2L直列四缸引擎。

catch.en: A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.
catch.zh: 入门级车型，用于熟悉方程式赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.

The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The entry-level X2014 Junior model combined a compact body with a similarly compact engine producing approximately 246.5 HP, making it the ideal platform for learning the fundamentals of formula driving.

long.en: The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The entry-level X2014 Junior model combined a compact body with a similarly compact engine producing approximately 246.5 HP, making it the ideal platform for learning the fundamentals of formula driving.
long.zh: X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。入门级的X2014 Junior采用了紧凑型车身设计，安装了一台同样较为收敛的引擎，动力输出仅为大约250 PS，使其成为了学习方程式驾驶基础的完美平台。

vehicleCollection.zh:
入门级车型，用于熟悉方程式赛车。

X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。入门级的X2014 Junior采用了紧凑型车身设计，安装了一台同样较为收敛的引擎，动力输出仅为大约250 PS，使其成为了学习方程式驾驶基础的完美平台。

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard
cars.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

brandCentral.en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

But don’t let name 'Standard' fool you—it's actually
the higher-performing sibling of the X2014 Junior.

Under its bonnet is a 2L straight-four turbo engine
that can generate <810ps> of power.

Employing a Venturi car design, the Standard boasts
increased downforce...

Which essentially means that air pressure on the car
adapts to changes in its speed.

It’s fascinating! In fact, you might learn a thing or two
about aerodynamics just driving this beauty!
brandCentral.zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

但不要被名称中的“Standard”字样所迷惑了，它可是红牛
X2014 Junior的兄弟车，而且是高性能版本。

其引擎盖下安装着一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以
产生<810ps>的动力。

这辆Standard还安装了文丘里管扩散器，以提供更大的下压力……

这意味着车身所受的空气下压力会因为速度而发生变化，

是相当惊人的设计！事实上，试着驾驶一下这台美丽的
车，您或许能对空气动力学有所体会！

catch.en: A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.
catch.zh: 继承Venturi传统的车型，但加装了X2014的轴流风机和包围。

vehicleCollection.en:
A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.

The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The mid-tier X2014 Standard followed as a more advanced model, developed as a conventional Venturi car. Its design minimized aerodynamic drag through front and rear wheel covers and a glass canopy, while simultaneously increasing downforce.

long.en: The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The mid-tier X2014 Standard followed as a more advanced model, developed as a conventional Venturi car. Its design minimized aerodynamic drag through front and rear wheel covers and a glass canopy, while simultaneously increasing downforce.
long.zh: X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。X2014 Standard是系列中的中档型号，被开发成一款常规的文丘里效应车型。它采用了前后轮罩和玻璃顶篷，既可以降低风阻，又产生了更大的下压力。

vehicleCollection.zh:
继承Venturi传统的车型，但加装了X2014的轴流风机和包围。

X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。X2014 Standard是系列中的中档型号，被开发成一款常规的文丘里效应车型。它采用了前后轮罩和玻璃顶篷，既可以降低风阻，又产生了更大的下压力。

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 25th Anniversary
cars.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 25th Anniversary

brandCentral.en:
The X2019 Competition is a virtual racer created
specifically for Gran Turismo.

It represents the pinnacle of race car design.

Development began with the X2014 Standard serving as
the base model.

Downforce was reduced slightly, and the original engine
swapped out for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter V-12.

It was designed to test the skills of the best drivers in
the world, not to mention provide thrilling racing action.
brandCentral.variantOf: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition
brandCentral.zh:
这辆X2019 Competition是一款专为跑车浪漫旅打造
的顶级赛车，

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

它以X2014 Standard为基础原型进行开发，

稍稍降低了下压力，并将原版引擎换成了一台自然进气
的3升V12引擎。

它的设计旨在以近距离的位置争夺考验车手的技术，并
且鼓励车手进行紧张刺激的竞技性表演。

vehicleCollection.carNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 25th Anniversary

catch.en: This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.
catch.zh: X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

The X2019 Competition was developed at the inception of the Gran Turismo Championship, with the goal of creating a race car that was as thrilling to watch as it was to drive. Based on the X2014 Standard, it featured revised design elements, including new front wheel styling, a reworked rear body structure, and reshaped rear wheel covers. Also, the powertrain was updated from a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine to a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter unit, and the throttle system was replaced with a more conventional mechanical setup.

long.en: The X2019 Competition was developed at the inception of the Gran Turismo Championship, with the goal of creating a race car that was as thrilling to watch as it was to drive. Based on the X2014 Standard, it featured revised design elements, including new front wheel styling, a reworked rear body structure, and reshaped rear wheel covers. Also, the powertrain was updated from a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine to a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter unit, and the throttle system was replaced with a more conventional mechanical setup.
long.zh: X2019 Competition是在Gran Turismo锦标赛创立之初开发的，旨在打造一款视觉享受和驾驶体验同等出色的赛车。它基于X2014 Standard打造，但前轮、后车身结构和后轮罩的设计美学均有所改变。此外，引擎从2升涡轮增压改为3升自然进气型，油门系统也改为传统配置。

X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

X2019 Competition是在Gran Turismo锦标赛创立之初开发的，旨在打造一款视觉享受和驾驶体验同等出色的赛车。它基于X2014 Standard打造，但前轮、后车身结构和后轮罩的设计美学均有所改变。此外，引擎从2升涡轮增压改为3升自然进气型，油门系统也改为传统配置。

Oh man, I mean, I can't help myself when there's

conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

conversation.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate racing car.

Inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

Raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the explosive energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3L NA engine is incredible...

And its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
~
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。

首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。

我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！

3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。

如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一畅通！
4

brandCentral.en:
This 1971 Ford Maverick was built by Greening Auto Company
(GAC), a custom car builder in the U.S.

It made history when it took the GT Award...

...at the 2018 SEMA Show, the world’s largest event for
automotive aftermarket products.

The original Ford Maverick was an affordable and practical
compact coupe.

But for this custom job, the chassis was rebuilt
with genuine racing architecture.

The car's 7.0-liter Windsor V-8, widely considered
to be a Ford masterpiece...

...has been tuned to deliver an unbelievable
1,200 horsepower!

In 2019, this GAC Maverick registered a top speed
of <326km/h>.?
brandCentral.zh:
这辆1971福特翼虎是由美国定制汽车制造商
Greening Auto Company（“GAC”）制造的。

这是一台创造了历史的车……

它在2018年的世界顶级定制汽车年度盛会
——美国汽车用品改装车展览会上获得了跑车浪漫旅大奖。

福特翼虎原本只是一款经济实用的紧凑型双门轿车。

但这辆改装车就不一样了，它的底盘按照
真正的赛车结构重新打造……

并安装了一台经过调校的7升Windsor V8引擎，
后者是公认的福特引擎杰作。

我可不是信口雌黄，要知道它可以输出
高达1200马力的动力！

在2019年，这辆GAC Maverick跑出了
令人折服的<326km/h>最高速度记录。?

catch.en: A vicious hot rod with 1200HP and a nostalgic body
catch.zh: 在怀旧车身中塞进1200BHP马力引擎的改装神车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A vicious hot rod with 1200HP and a nostalgic body

The 1971 Ford Maverick, winner of the 2018 SEMA “Best of Show,” was crafted by Greening Auto Company into a striking custom build. Its ride height was dropped to the limit for maximum visual impact. The 7.0-liter Windsor V-8 was equipped with twin turbochargers to generate 1199.2 HP, yet it also offered flexibility—its engine control logic could be adjusted for a more relaxed, street-friendly cruise.

long.en: The 1971 Ford Maverick, winner of the 2018 SEMA “Best of Show,” was crafted by Greening Auto Company into a striking custom build. Its ride height was dropped to the limit for maximum visual impact. The 7.0-liter Windsor V-8 was equipped with twin turbochargers to generate 1199.2 HP, yet it also offered flexibility—its engine control logic could be adjusted for a more relaxed, street-friendly cruise.
long.zh: 这辆荣获2018年SEMA车展“最佳巡展”奖项的1971年Ford Maverick由Greening Auto Company精心打造。车身高度被降至极限，营造出极具视觉冲击力的外观效果。7升Windsor V8引擎搭载双涡轮增压系统，输出功率达1,216 PS，同时保留了一定的灵活性，可调节引擎控制逻辑，适应城市悠闲驾驶。

vehicleCollection.zh:
在怀旧车身中塞进1200BHP马力引擎的改装神车。

这辆荣获2018年SEMA车展“最佳巡展”奖项的1971年Ford Maverick由Greening Auto Company精心打造。车身高度被降至极限，营造出极具视觉冲击力的外观效果。7升Windsor V8引擎搭载双涡轮增压系统，输出功率达1,216 PS，同时保留了一定的灵活性，可调节引擎控制逻辑，适应城市悠闲驾驶。

brandCentral.en:
The Hyundai N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo was created to celebrate
the South Korean manufacturer's 50th anniversary.

The "N" in its name is reserved for cars that possess
the highest performance in the company's lineup.

It is the power unit in particular that sets this car apart.

This model is powered by hub motors, utilizing fuel-cell
technology developed by Hyundai.

Weighing in at just north of one ton, the N 25 Gran Turismo
is lightweight and quite nice to look at.[
brandCentral.zh:
Hyundai N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo是为纪念
这家韩国制造商成立50周年而设计的。

“N”是Hyundai专门为高性能车型保留的编号。

这辆车的动力装置尤为与众不同：

由多台轮毂电机提供动力，并应用了Hyundai公司
自行开发和大规模生产的燃料电池技术。

它的设计既兼顾了轻量化，整车重量刚好为一吨出头，
又展现出无与伦比的动态感。

catch.en: An extreme monster machine that embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N".
catch.zh: 这款奔逸绝尘的赛车代表着Hyundai的N系列赛车的热忱与未来。

vehicleCollection.en:
An extreme monster machine that embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N".

Created to commemorate Hyundai’s 50th anniversary, this model also embodied the spirit and ambition of the company's high-performance "N" division. It was powered by hydrogen fuel cells paired with supercapacitors that stored energy recovered through regenerative braking, delivering a combined output of 650 kW (871.8 HP) via electric motors at each wheel. Thanks to compact, lightweight fuel-cell stacks and a CFRP monocoque chassis, the car tipped the scales at just 2143 lbs.

long.en: Created to commemorate Hyundai’s 50th anniversary, this model also embodied the spirit and ambition of the company's high-performance "N" division. It was powered by hydrogen fuel cells paired with supercapacitors that stored energy recovered through regenerative braking, delivering a combined output of 650 kW (871.8 HP) via electric motors at each wheel. Thanks to compact, lightweight fuel-cell stacks and a CFRP monocoque chassis, the car tipped the scales at just 2143 lbs.
long.zh: 这款车是专为Hyundai的50周年纪念所打造，也代表了Hyundai高性能部门“N”对汽车研发倾注的热情。它采用了氢燃料电池供能，还配备了超级电容，能够储存由再生制动系统产生的能量，四个车轮上的电机能够输出总计650千瓦（884 PS）的动力。此外，得益于它的紧凑车身和轻量化燃料电池组，以及碳纤维复合材料单体车壳框架，这辆车仅重972 公斤。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo original is a Gr.1 race car based on the
Hyundai N 2025 VGT.

It has been fitted with a special rear wing and a naturally-
aspirated engine to comply with Gr.1 regulations.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.1级别赛车基于
Hyundai N 2025 VGT开发。

The Honda Beat’s darling design...

Is the result of a historic collaboration between
Honda and Pininfarina.

It remains a symbol of the Japanese two-seater convertible
kei-car of the 1990s.

Note how its clean and simple design perfectly envelops
the super compact mid-engine package.

In addition to side air inlets, it features
a ‘clamshell’ bonnet...

And aerodynamic side mirrors.

The perforated steel rims and motorcycle-like gauges
work to reinforce the sporty spirit of the car.

And a special mention goes to the zebra-print
seats!

They were all the rage i h9s Japan.
j

usedCar.en:
Those in the market for a reasonable mid-engine sports car
won't be disappointed with this one.

The Honda Beat was built in accordance with Japanese "kei
car" specifications.

It features a naturally-aspirated inline-3 engine, with
individual throttle-bodies on all three cylinders.

There's some motorcycle technology in this unit because
it can rev to <8000rpm>.

Because of its sporty nature and mid-engine layout,
it was often referred to as a baby NSX.

Although it was marketed only in Japan, the car
developed a following around the world.
usedCar.zh:
如果想在市场上寻觅价格合理的中置引擎
跑车，那么这款车必定不会让你失望。

Honda Beat按照日本轻型车标准制造。

它采用自然进气三缸引擎，且三个气缸
全部带有独立节流阀。

这款惊艳的车型能够在日常使用中将转速
提高到超过<8000rpm>。

这样的轻型跑车在20世纪90年的日本
格外受欢迎...

而Beat则因身处这一潮流的最前沿而闻名。

catch.en: This wonderful kei sports car offered style and driving excitement never before seen in Japan.

vehicleCollection.en:
This wonderful kei sports car offered style and driving excitement never before seen in Japan.

Launched in 1991, the Honda Beat helped spark the boom in lightweight two-seat sports cars. Tipping the scales at just 1675 lbs, it also delivered near-perfect balance with a 43:57 front-to-rear weight ratio. Its engine, infused with F1-derived technology and paired with a short-stroke transmission, delivered a driving experience like no other. And you didn’t need mountain roads to enjoy it—the Beat brought pure sports car fun to your everyday drive.

long.en: Launched in 1991, the Honda Beat helped spark the boom in lightweight two-seat sports cars. Tipping the scales at just 1675 lbs, it also delivered near-perfect balance with a 43:57 front-to-rear weight ratio. Its engine, infused with F1-derived technology and paired with a short-stroke transmission, delivered a driving experience like no other. And you didn’t need mountain roads to enjoy it—the Beat brought pure sports car fun to your everyday drive.
long.zh: 1991年推出的Honda Beat开创了轻量型两座跑车的风潮。整车重量仅有760 公斤，并拥有理想的43:57前后重量分配。这台车凭借搭载了F1技术的引擎和短行程变速箱带来独一无二的驾驶体验。不必远赴蜿蜒颠簸的路段才能享受到Beat的乐趣，日常驾驶中同样能充分感受到这款跑车的魅力。

brandCentral.en:
Everyone appreciates a sport utility vehicle that combines
commanding visibility with dependable off-road capability.

Enter the Honda CR-V, which was introduced in 1995. Featured
here is the fifth-generation model, launched in 2016.

Measuring <4.6m> in length and <1.85m> wide, it shares its
underpinnings with the tenth-generation Civic.

Notably, this was the first CR-V to offer a hybrid powertrain,
delivering impressive fuel efficiency even at highway speeds.

Spacious and comfortable—particularly in the back—it provides
more than 1,100 liters of cargo space with the rear seats folded.

Equipped with advanced driving assists tailored to modern needs,
the fifth-generation CR-V is a car for town and country.
brandCentral.sourceName: CR-V  e HEV EX BLACK EDITION  ’21
brandCentral.zh:
有谁会不爱一款既能提供良好视野，又拥有可靠
越野性能的运动型多功能车呢？

1995年首次面世的本田CR-V就是一辆这样的车。
这里介绍的是2016年推出的第5代车型。

它沿用了第10代思域的平台，车身长度和宽度
分别为<4.6m>和<1.85m>。

这辆车最值得一提的特点是首次在车系中采用了
混动单元，以及在高速下拥有十分优秀的油耗。

这款车空间大，乘坐舒适，特别是后排。如果把
后排座椅放倒，还能够提供超过1100升的货运空间。

为了满足现代驾乘需求，第5代CR-V还配备了先进的
驾驶辅助技术，城市通勤和远程出行都能轻松应对。

catch.zh: 这款高人气SUV的第五代车型是系列中的首款混动车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The fifth-generation model of this popular SUV is the first to feature a hybrid system.

In the 1990s, Honda introduced the “Creative Mover” category, launching the original CR-V in 1995 as part of that vision. By 2021, the fifth-generation CR-V had evolved significantly, with this model becoming the first in the series to feature a hybrid powertrain. A 4-wheel-drive option remained popular, offering added versatility. Its larger body improved interior space and expanded cargo capacity to over 1,100 liters. A 3-row, 7-seat configuration further enhanced practicality. Equipped with a wide range of safety features and advanced driver assistance systems, it proved to be an ideal vehicle for daily use.

usedCar.en:
Good timing! I just received a stylish hot hatch—a 4th-gen
EF Civic Si, also known as the 'Grand Civic'.

Civics are often associated with VTEC systems, but this
Si is powered by an older ZC engine.

This was Honda’s first DOHC engine since the S800, which
debuted fourteen years prior.

Though its 130 horsepower isn’t all too astounding,
its long-stroke design provides torque at low speeds.

Its body is light and compact, and its double-wishbone
suspension is sheer perfection.

A major-player in touring car races, the Civic was one
of the most iconic hot hatches of the 1980s.{
usedCar.zh:
你来的真巧！我刚刚收了一辆风采依旧的高性能掀背车
——第4代EF Civic Si，又被称作“Grand Civic”。

Civic虽以VTEC技术闻名，但这辆Si搭载的却是
老款的ZC引擎。

它是Honda自S800以来的首款DOHC引擎。
而S800，已经是十四年前的车了。

130马力看似平平，但其长行程设计能在低速时
提供充沛的扭矩。

车身轻巧紧凑，双叉臂悬架近乎完美。

作为房车赛场上的主力军，Civic俨然是80年代
最具标志性的性能掀背车。

catch.en: A dominating force on the touring car circuit, this fourth-generation Civic features the famous ZC engine.
catch.zh: 这款称霸房车赛场的第四代Civic搭载了久负盛名的ZC发动机。

vehicleCollection.en:
A dominating force on the touring car circuit, this fourth-generation Civic features the famous ZC engine.

In 1987, Honda introduced the all-new fourth-generation Civic. It was known as the Grand Civic, with the model code EF. Its most significant advancement was a complete platform overhaul, bringing double wishbone suspension to all four corners. The sporty Si model and the more luxurious Si Extra both featured the 1.6-liter DOHC ZC inline-4 engine. These models also found success on the track, competing in the Japan Touring Car Championship and securing championship titles.

conversation.en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.

The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.

What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

Fo example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.

But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its ror is simply unforgettable!

不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。

终生难忘！

usedCar.en:
Compact, lightweight and low to the ground, with an
aggressive yet attractive body style...

...the fifth-generation Civic, introduced in 1991, is the
quintessential compact performance car.

Many consider this model to be one of the best handling FF
(front engine/front-wheel drive) cars on the planet.

The top-of-the-line SiR･II came equipped with a naturally
aspirated 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine.

It featured a double-wishbone suspension and quick-ratio steering
system that made the car efficient through corners.

It was, and remains, the pride of Japan. The Civic is still popular
today, thanks to predecessors like this 1991 model.

那么这辆思域运动版就是首选！

1991年推出的第5代思域
是一款前置引擎、前轮驱动（或简称前置前驱）运动型轿车。

产品线中的顶配版本SiR･II装备了
一部1.6升双顶置凸轮轴可变气门正时和升程电子控制系统引擎……

并采用了双叉臂设计，在悬挂和转向性能之间取得了精确的平衡。

这辆紧凑型运动车款是日本的骄傲，更得到了广大车迷的青睐。
放到如今这个时代，可谓独步天下。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line fifth-generation Civic balances speed with comfort.

The Civic is Honda’s longest-running model line. The fifth-generation EG Civic, introduced in September 1991, was promoted as the “sports Civic.” At the top of the range sat the SiR grade, equipped with a 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine. Building on the success of the previous SiR, which had already achieved the benchmark of 100 horsepower per liter, this model delivered an additional 9.9 HP, bringing total output to 167.7 HP.

vehicleCollection.en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

First introduced in 1972, the Civic is Honda’s longest-running model. In 1997, the first Civic Type R made its debut, based on the sixth-generation Civic. At its heart was the B16B—a 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4 DOHC engine that delivered an impressive 182.4 HP. True to the Type R philosophy, the car featured extensive weight reduction and upgraded suspension components. The result was a car that found success across the spectrum of motorsport, from professional racing series to grassroots competition.

vehicleCollection.en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

In Honda’s lineup, the "Type R" designation signified production models specifically tuned for high performance. The Civic Type R first appeared in August 1997. Based on the sixth-generation EK Civic, it was powered by the B16B 1.6-liter inline-4 DOHC 16-valve engine. Thanks to Honda’s VTEC system, it produced 182.4 HP at 8200 rpm without any forced induction. The model quickly earned a reputation in motorsports, becoming a favorite among amateur racers.

Thanks to Honda’s VTEC system, it produced 182.4 HP at 8200 rpm without any forced induction. The model quickly earned a reputation in motorsports, becoming a favorite among amateur racers.

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model tuned by Gran Turismo.

First introduced in 1972, the Civic is Honda’s longest-running model. In 1997, the first Civic Type R made its debut, based on the sixth-generation Civic. At its heart was the B16B—a 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4 DOHC engine that delivered an impressive 182.4 HP. This version is an original Gran Turismo-tuned model based on the 1997 Civic Type R (EK).

brandCentral.en:
If you like sports cars at all, you can’t help but get
excited at the unveiling on a new Honda Type R.

I actually got to test-drive the predecessor to this model—
the FK8 Civic Type R.

The track was a high-speed winding road, with sharp
corners that seemed to distort my field of vision.

But in spite of the strong vertical and lateral Gs, I was
able to brake hard into each corner with ease.

I remember thinking to myself, ‘Wow! The Honda Civic Type R
is really next-level stuff!’

But just when I thought the Civic Type R had hit its peak...

Out came this FL5, which far surpassed the FK8, both
technically and in terms of driving experience.
brandCentral.zh:
如果你喜欢跑车，肯定会情不自禁地为
新款Civic Type R的亮相而振奋。

我实际试驾过这款车型的前身——FK8 Civic Type R。

测试赛道是一条蜿蜒的高速路，有不少
视野十分受限的急弯道。

尽管垂直和横向的G力都很大，我还是能够完成大力刹车，
顺畅地转过每个弯道。

我记得自己当时在想：“哇！
这款Honda Civic Type R的性能真是一流！”

结果就在我以为Civic Type R已经站在巅峰时……
这辆FL5闪亮登场。

无论是在技术规格上还是在驾驶体验上，
它都远远超越了FK8。

vehicleCollection.en:
Driving feel comes first. The legendary R badge returns for the 11th generation Civic.

The sixth-generation Honda Civic Type R was unveiled in September 2022. It was based on the FL 5-door hatchback variant of the 11th-generation Civic. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C engine, delivering 325.4 HP and 309.6 ft-lb of torque, surpassing the previous generation in both output and response. Updates to the 4-wheel independent active damper system further enhanced chassis performance, sharpening the car’s dynamic capability on both road and track.

Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C engine, delivering 325.4 HP and 309.6 ft-lb of torque, surpassing the previous generation in both output and response. Updates to the 4-wheel independent active damper system further enhanced chassis performance, sharpening the car’s dynamic capability on both road and track.

The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.

This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.

...then the aggressive front flares.

behind the glossy black wheels.

vehicleCollection.en:
What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.

The fifth-generation Civic Type R made its debut in 2017. While previous models focused on enhancing the base Civic’s performance, the fifth-generation Type R was developed in parallel with the standard model from the ground up. In 2020, the lineup was further refined with the introduction of the Limited Edition model. Weight was reduced by 44 lbs through the removal of soundproofing materials and the adoption of specially forged wheels. Subtle suspension tweaks were also made to sharpen handling. With only 1,000 units produced worldwide, the Limited Edition sold out almost immediately.

long.en: The fifth-generation Civic Type R made its debut in 2017. While previous models focused on enhancing the base Civic’s performance, the fifth-generation Type R was developed in parallel with the standard model from the ground up. In 2020, the lineup was further refined with the introduction of the Limited Edition model. Weight was reduced by 44 lbs through the removal of soundproofing materials and the adoption of specially forged wheels. Subtle suspension tweaks were also made to sharpen handling. With only 1,000 units produced worldwide, the Limited Edition sold out almost immediately.
long.zh: 第五代Honda Civic Type R于2017年发布。以往车型只是单纯提升基础版Civic的性能，但第五代Type R是与基础车型同步从零开发的。2020年发布的“限量版”车型在性能上得到了进一步提升。通过拆除隔音材料并采用特殊锻造轮毂，整车减重20 公斤。悬挂系统也经过了细微调校。全球限量生产的1000台车几乎瞬间售罄。

a more powerful engine.

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation hybrid Fit utilized i-DCD to maximize energy efficiency.

The original Fit Hybrid debuted in 2010, drawing considerable attention as the first hybrid offering in the B-segment. In 2013, the second-generation Fit Hybrid arrived, built upon the third-generation Fit platform. This updated model featured the Sport Hybrid i-DCD system, paired with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine to deliver a combined 137.1 HP. In Japan’s JC08 fuel efficiency cycle, it achieved an impressive rating of 85.7 MPG.

long.en: The original Fit Hybrid debuted in 2010, drawing considerable attention as the first hybrid offering in the B-segment. In 2013, the second-generation Fit Hybrid arrived, built upon the third-generation Fit platform. This updated model featured the Sport Hybrid i-DCD system, paired with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine to deliver a combined 137.1 HP. In Japan’s JC08 fuel efficiency cycle, it achieved an impressive rating of 85.7 MPG.
long.zh: 2010年推出的初代Fit Hybrid作为B级车中首款混动车型而备受关注。2013年基于第3代Fit打造的第2代混动版上市推出。搭载Sport Hybrid i-DCD系统，配合1.5升i-VTEC引擎能输出139.5 PS的动力。在日本JC08模式燃油经济性测试下，其油耗低至2.8 升/百公里。

catch.en: The first Type R model of the Integra, this car was built to be the ultimate front-wheel drive sports car.

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model of the Integra, this car was built to be the ultimate front-wheel drive sports car.

This high-performance version of the Integra was introduced in 1995. Its B18C engine, derived from the Si model, was enhanced with high-compression pistons, reinforced connecting rods, and dual valve springs, all assembled by hand for maximum precision. The body saw increased rigidity alongside weight reduction, while the suspension was completely reworked to deliver sharp, balanced handling with virtually no understeer. It earned the nickname “the road-going race car.”

long.en: This high-performance version of the Integra was introduced in 1995. Its B18C engine, derived from the Si model, was enhanced with high-compression pistons, reinforced connecting rods, and dual valve springs, all assembled by hand for maximum precision. The body saw increased rigidity alongside weight reduction, while the suspension was completely reworked to deliver sharp, balanced handling with virtually no understeer. It earned the nickname “the road-going race car.”
long.zh: 1995年推出的Integra高性能车型。Si版本的B18C引擎经过全面升级，采用高压缩比活塞、强化连杆以及双气门弹簧，所有部件均为纯手工精密装配。在减轻车身重量的同时大幅提升车身刚性，悬挂系统经过彻底改造，实现了稳健精准的操控表现，完全消除了转向不足的倾向。此车也作为可上路的赛车而广为人知。

conversation.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version usedin the base model...

...producing <20ps> more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than <40kg> in weight reduction.

It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanse automotive
engineering.

conversation.zh: 不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。 完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。 第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说 并非不可接受…… 因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型， 用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。 其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型 更加强劲有力。 因此在功率上提升了<20ps>。 形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了<40kg>以上的整体车重上。 这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。

to ever appear after the incredible NSX Type R.

Under its hood is a 1.8-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4,
that revs all the way up to an incredible <8500rpm>!

Did you know the technology that went into this engine trickled
down from Honda's participation in Formula 1 racing?

It possesses a special undercarriage too, making the car
super stable at high speeds.

Thanks to its power and razor-sharp handling, this 1998 Spec R
is totally at home at the race track.;

Integra Type R是一款相当有名的
前驱跑车。

第二款Type R车型。

它搭载了一台性能优异的1.8升自然吸气
直列四缸引擎。

这台引擎的红线达到了<8500rpm>，能在高转速区间
产出强大的动力。

得益于其轻量的车体和坚硬的悬挂，
这辆车有能力攻克任何急弯。

这款车型是98年Spec R，该晚期车款的底盘得到了改进，
稳定性更佳。

catch.en: This third-gen Integra Type R received more power and hand-crafted tuning.
catch.zh: 经过人工调校，第3代Integra Type R的性能升级。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-gen Integra Type R received more power and hand-crafted tuning.

This car introduced the concept of the Type R, a road-going race car. At its heart was the 1.8-liter VTEC B18C engine, hand-built with a high-compression head and carefully matched connecting rods to produce 197.2 HP. While performance parts like the helical LSD added weight, it was offset by stripping out comfort features, resulting in pure speed.

long.en: This car introduced the concept of the Type R, a road-going race car. At its heart was the 1.8-liter VTEC B18C engine, hand-built with a high-compression head and carefully matched connecting rods to produce 197.2 HP. While performance parts like the helical LSD added weight, it was offset by stripping out comfort features, resulting in pure speed.
long.zh: 这台车将“Type-R”公路赛车的概念普及给了全世界。首先，它配备了一部手工打造的1.8升VTEC B18C引擎，并采用了高压缩活塞头和高强度连杆，能够输出200 PS的动力。尽管增加了螺旋限滑差速器等分量较重的零件，但还是通过去除舒适性内饰等方式大幅减轻了车重，进而实现难以置信的速度性能。

brandCentral.en:
The spirit of Honda’s first kei-car, the 1967 N360,
lives on in the modern N-ONE.

And nowhere was that more evident than in the second-generation
RS model from 2022.

Wearing the legendary RS badge, this version came with
a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual gearbox.

A close-ratio gearbox and reinforced clutch gave
the RS a rugged, driver-focused character.

With traits like the aggressive black trim and a purposeful stance,
the N-ONE RS was designed to project speed and intensity.

Compact and lightweight, it was a small car that punched well
above its weight—and surpassed expectations in every corner.\
brandCentral.zh:
Honda首款轻型车N360在1967年展现的卓越工程技术，
如今在出色的N-ONE车型中得以传承。

你眼前看到的是N-ONE第二代RS版本，于2022年推出。

秉承Honda运动车型的传奇命名传统，这款RS
凭借涡轮引擎和6速手动变速器脱颖而出。

搭载密齿比变速箱和重载离合器，这是一台
专为带来纯粹运动驾驶体验而生的座驾。

从内到外，N-ONE RS的设计都在诠释速度与激情，
尤其是那些黑色边饰，更为其增添了几分战斗气息。

小巧轻盈的它，是一台能够超越所有预期的动感小车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This performance-focused model is a first kei-car with front-wheel drive, a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual transmission.

Honda’s N-ONE was a retro-inspired kei-car that paid homage to the company's first entry into the segment, the classic N360. The second-generation model retained the charming silhouette of the original, but rode on a completely new chassis that brought modern refinement to its compact dimensions. Among the highlights of the lineup was the RS trim, a sporty variant that borrowed close-ratio gearing from the S660 sports car. It featured reinforced synchronizers for second and third gear, and a heavy-duty clutch to handle spirited driving. While the RS badge had been offered on the first-gen N-ONE, the new RS stood out as the first kei-car to pair a turbocharged, front-wheel-drive layout with a 6-speed manual transmission — a groundbreaking move in the world of Japan’s smallest cars.

The powertrain of this second generation NSX is a sports
hybrid SH-AWD system.

It utilises a midship 3.5L turbocharged V6 in conjunction
with three additional motors to drive all four wheels.

Two of these motors allow the front wheels to be
independently operated.

The driver can therefore make minute adjustments when
cornering without having to compromise speed.

这辆第二代NSX的传动系统采用了跑车型混动超级控制全
轮驱动系统。

它通过一台中置3.5升涡轮增压V6引擎搭配三台额外的电机
来驱动全部四个车轮。

其中两台电机负责支持前轮独立运作，

车手可以在过弯时进行微调，而无需牺牲速度。

catch.en: Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.
catch.zh: 自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

vehicleCollection.en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

Making its official debut 25 years after the original, the second-generation NSX emerged as a true supercar, equipped with an advanced electric all-wheel-drive system called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, which employed independent electric motors on the front wheels. By enhancing both acceleration and deceleration, it enabled torque vectoring that provided exceptional stability through corners across the entire speed range.

long.zh: 在初代上市的25年之后，第二代NSX也千呼万唤始出来。这款超级跑车采用了一套被称为“运动混动SH-AWD”的电动四驱系统，左右前轮也分别安装了独立的电机。这次更新换代的提升不仅在于加速和刹车性能，这套系统还提供了扭矩矢量控制功能，能够在各种不同的速度范围下确保稳定过弯。

conversation.en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?

It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.

There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...

...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.

And, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.

In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.

Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.

This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT iJapan.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh: 这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。 听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？ 毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。 实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。 这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车…… 那辆车是在Honda于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。 然而，继承GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！ 2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。 因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。 作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型， 这款车AMGSuper GT第五轮比赛中获得o第三名。

This race machine claimed the Super GT championship in 2016 equipped with a conventional gasoline engine.

The NSX CONCEPT-GT was a purpose-built racing machine developed by Honda, based on the 2012 next-generation NSX concept, to compete in the GT500 class of the Super GT series. At its debut, the car featured a hybrid powertrain, however, by the 2016 season, the hybrid system was removed due to supply challenges from the battery manufacturer. It concluded the season with a 12th-place finish overall.

conversation.en:
The NSX is a Japanese GT race car.
It waged battle in the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.

Despite putting up a good fight...

...it was unable to overcome the era's powerhouses,
such as the Nissan Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, in 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.

 team of five NSXs won four of seven races that year.

Ryo Michigami in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX took home the driver’s title.

This was the first time an NSX won the JGTC championshp.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。

尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。

在这个赛季，总共五 NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……

而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。

这也是NSX在全日EGT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。

The Castrol MUGEN NSX competed
in the 2000 JGTC season

Where it became the first Honda NSX
to win a top level Japanese GT championship

The GT500 class was the highest category
in the Japanese GT Car Championship

And was a hot bed of rivalry between
works teams from Nissan, Toyota and Honda

Honda began competing full scale competition
with their 1997 NSX GT model

But at the outset, JGTC tuning regulations had
created hurdles in developing the NSX GT further

And their race results suffered as a consequence

Further tuning of the aerodynamics and weight balance
led to steady improvements each year though

And in the 2000 season, the Castrol MUGEN NSX
was finally able to score a championship victory

Nowadays, the oigna NSX is considered to be
an icon f Japanese automobiles

And th car inpatar
i a true monument toits legacy as a racingcar

众望，拿到了冠军
如今，原版NSX已经成为了日本汽车史上的传奇偶像。<>
而这款q车更是留下了光辉灿烂的遗产，成为了真

catch.zh: 重心更低的全新设计成为了JGTC夺冠路上的基石。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new design with a lower center of gravity was the key to victory for this JGTC champion.

The 2000 All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) GT500 class saw fierce competition among Japan’s top three automakers: Honda, Toyota, and Nissan. That year, five teams fielded the NSX. They included the Castrol MUGEN NSX and Takata Dome NSX, running as official factory entries. While the Takata Dome NSX demonstrated remarkable potential, it was the Castrol MUGEN NSX, featured here, that claimed the championship. Its success came through strategic management of the weight handicaps, showcasing speed and discipline over the course of the season.

The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

...so you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races

that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

conversation.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japnese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in ound 8 race.

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

全日本GT赛事。

这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出
第二名的好成绩。

of the original NSX...

designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races

that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

brandCentral.en:
The Super GT is Japan's most prestigious GT car racing
series, and it wouldn't be the same without the NSX.

This particular model is the EPSON NSX, which was raced
by Nakajima Racing in the 2008 season.

Production of first generation NSXs ceased in 2002...

But versions produced for the Super GT continued
to be developed independently.

This model was the only one of the NSXs of its time to be
equipped with Dunlop tyres...

Meaning it couldn't benefit from data-sharing with other NSX
teams—but that didn’t stop it from dominating the track!
brandCentral.zh:
GT是日本最负盛名的GT车型赛事，而如果没有NSX的参
与，这项锦标赛就不会如此成功。

这款特殊的车型是EPSON NSX，曾由中岛车队驾驶在2008赛季出赛。

第一代NSX的生产虽然早在2002年就停止了……

但为超级跑车生产的赛车版本仍在继续独立开发。

这款车型是当时的NSX中唯一使用邓禄普轮胎的车型……

这意味着此车无法从与其他NSX车队的数据共享中获益，
但这并没有妨碍其在赛道上占据主导优势。

catch.en: The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka.
catch.zh: 看到这台车，就让人联想起Loic Duval和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

vehicleCollection.en:
The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka.

This is a version of the NSX that competed in the 2008 Super GT championship. Despite facing disadvantages that season—including running with the previous year’s chassis, weight handicaps, and a restricted air intake—the car remained competitive thanks to significant improvements in both engine performance and aerodynamics. In Round 8 at Autopolis, the EPSON NSX secured a 2nd-place finish.

long.en: This is a version of the NSX that competed in the 2008 Super GT championship. Despite facing disadvantages that season—including running with the previous year’s chassis, weight handicaps, and a restricted air intake—the car remained competitive thanks to significant improvements in both engine performance and aerodynamics. In Round 8 at Autopolis, the EPSON NSX secured a 2nd-place finish.
long.zh: 这台车是参加过2008年Super GT锦标赛的NSX的一个版本。在那个赛季，NSX需要面对重重不利条件，除了连续两年使用相同的主车架，还要安装配重和更小的引擎限制器，但引擎和空气动力学上的改进让其依旧保持竞争力。Epson NSX在第8轮的AUTOPOLIS/奥托波里斯赛道中斩获第2名。

vehicleCollection.zh:
看到这台车，就让人联想起Loic Duval和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

这台车是参加过2008年Super GT锦标赛的NSX的一个版本。在那个赛季，NSX需要面对重重不利条件，除了连续两年使用相同的主车架，还要安装配重和更小的引擎限制器，但引擎和空气动力学上的改进让其依旧保持竞争力。Epson NSX在第8轮的AUTOPOLIS/奥托波里斯赛道中斩获第2名。

brandCentral.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.3 vehicle was built using the
second generation NSX as its base.

The large front splitter and swan-neck rear wing are just
two of many new additions.

These custom components are designed to improve the car's
aerodynamic profile, and grant it a clear advantage.

The base model's 4WD system has been converted to a rear-
wheel drive one in accordance with Gr.3 regulations.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车使用第二代NSX作为
基础车型。

并加入了若干项新部件，比如大尺寸的前定风翼和天鹅颈
尾翼。

这些定制化组件可以有效提升车辆的空气动力学性能，
为其赋予了极大的优势。

为了符合组别3规范，基础车型的四驱系统也被更改成一套
后驱系统。

catch.en: Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.
catch.zh: 自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

vehicleCollection.en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been reengineered to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. It features a range of aerodynamic enhancements, including a large front splitter with precision cutouts to manage airflow, and a swan-neck rear wing.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been reengineered to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. It features a range of aerodynamic enhancements, including a large front splitter with precision cutouts to manage airflow, and a swan-neck rear wing.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.3规则进行改装而来。这款车为了提升空气动力学性能而加装了若干部件，例如大尺寸前定风翼和天鹅颈尾翼，其中前者还为了平稳气流而刻有沟槽。

vehicleCollection.zh:
自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.3规则进行改装而来。这款车为了提升空气动力学性能而加装了若干部件，例如大尺寸前定风翼和天鹅颈尾翼，其中前者还为了平稳气流而刻有沟槽。

brandCentral.en:
The second generation NSX was the base model for this
Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racing car.

The replacement of the rear bulkhead has dramatically
improved the rigidity of its frame...

And a rear-wheel drive layout has been used
to meet Gr.4 regulations.
brandCentral.zh:
第二代NSX是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基础
车型。

它的后隔板进行了整体更换，以大幅增加车身框架的刚性……

另外为了符合组别4规则，改成了使用后轮驱动。

catch.en: This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.
catch.zh: 一款专为Gr.4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

vehicleCollection.en:
This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations. This design prioritizes preserving the character of the base car, adding only a subtle front splitter, compact canards, and a rear wing. To enhance structural rigidity, a rear bulkhead has been added, accompanied by a rear camera.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations. This design prioritizes preserving the character of the base car, adding only a subtle front splitter, compact canards, and a rear wing. To enhance structural rigidity, a rear bulkhead has been added, accompanied by a rear camera.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.4规则进行改装而来。它的设计注重于利用基础车型的优势，只加装了小尺寸定风翼、前翼和尾翼。为了提升刚性，车身上还加装了后隔板，以及一部后方摄像头。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一款专为Gr.4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.4规则进行改装而来。它的设计注重于利用基础车型的优势，只加装了小尺寸定风翼、前翼和尾翼。为了提升刚性，车身上还加装了后隔板，以及一部后方摄像头。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is an original
based on the Honda NSX.

It has unique custom suspension, ensuring plenty of ground
clearance and an ability to handle the harshest terrain.

Because of its mid-engine/AWD layout, the car's weight
distribution is biased towards the rear.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Honda NSX开发。

它采用独特的定制悬挂系统，以保持稳定的离地间隙，
其他针对泥地赛道的必要改装也不曾缺席。

尽管采用中置引擎布局和四轮驱动传动系统，但它的车
重配比明显地向车身后部倾斜。

catch.en: The NSX was revived with SH-AWD 25 years after the debut of the original model.
catch.zh: 在初版NSX首次亮相的25年后，新一代的SH-AWD四驱系统跑车终于问世。

vehicleCollection.en:
The NSX was revived with SH-AWD 25 years after the debut of the original model.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX has been reimagined to conform to Gr.B rally regulations. While sporting a rugged rally-cross exterior, it retains the NSX’s signature mid-engine layout, now paired with a 4-wheel-drive system. The original rear-biased weight distribution has been preserved, promising thrilling tail-out dynamics on loose surfaces.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX has been reimagined to conform to Gr.B rally regulations. While sporting a rugged rally-cross exterior, it retains the NSX’s signature mid-engine layout, now paired with a 4-wheel-drive system. The original rear-biased weight distribution has been preserved, promising thrilling tail-out dynamics on loose surfaces.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.B规则进行改装而来。这款车整体呈现出拉力跨界风格外观，但也保留了NSX标志性的中置布局，只是改为了四轮驱动。原版车的前轻后重重量分配比例也保持不变，而这样的配重比可以让它上演非常精彩的车尾漂移。

vehicleCollection.zh:
在初版NSX首次亮相的25年后，新一代的SH-AWD四驱系统跑车终于问世。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.B规则进行改装而来。这款车整体呈现出拉力跨界风格外观，但也保留了NSX标志性的中置布局，只是改为了四轮驱动。原版车的前轻后重重量分配比例也保持不变，而这样的配重比可以让它上演非常精彩的车尾漂移。

brandCentral.en:
This improved Honda NSX Type R, also known as the 02R,
was released in 2002.

Its lightweight body and sport-tuned suspension made it
a monster on the track.

Part of the reason was an excellent aerodynamic shape
that allowed the car to generate gobs of downforce.

You'll be hard-pressed to find a car that feels as good to
drive as this one.
brandCentral.zh:
这款改进后的NSX Type R也被称为02R，于2002年发布。

其轻巧的车身和坚硬的悬挂大大提升了其在赛道上的表现。

此车还拥有出色的空气动力学设计，可产生强大的下压力。

您很难找到像这款车一样易于驾驶的车了！

usedCar.en:
Released in 2002, this baby is an updated version of the
first-generation NSX Type R.

It uses the NA2 model NSX as a base, which means that it
came powered by a 3.2-liter V-6.

One of this car's charms was its refined aerodynamic profile.

Modifications were made to its underside to improve air flow,
and several major aerodynamic components were added.

So you can bet that its handling and stability at high speeds
were impressive, to say the least.

The naturally-aspirated V-6 revs like a dream — and its power
will have you comfortable attacking any circuit.
usedCar.zh:
该车型为初代NSX Type R的改进版，
于2002年上市。

它以NA2型NSX为基础，
搭载了3.2升V6引擎。

它的主要卖点是经过优化的空气动力设计。

经过改造的底盘获得了更优秀的空气流动性，
并装上了数个轻量化组件。

这些改进使此型号的高速操控性和稳定性达到了
优越的水准。

大马力自然吸气V6引擎
有着令人满意的动力，并赋予了这辆车足以攻克任何赛道的性能。

catch.en: Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.
catch.zh: 2代NSX改进了空气动力学设计，增加了车辆的下压力。

vehicleCollection.en:
Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.

The second-wave NSX Type R made its debut in 2002. In addition to the original Type R’s weight-saving measures and increased rigidity, this model underwent a full aerodynamic redesign, generating remarkable levels of downforce rarely seen in a road car. Carbon fiber was employed extensively, including for key components such as the hood and rear wing. During a time attack at the Nürburgring Nordschleife, the car shattered expectations by breaking the eight-minute barrier, a feat once thought unattainable for a road car.

long.en: The second-wave NSX Type R made its debut in 2002. In addition to the original Type R’s weight-saving measures and increased rigidity, this model underwent a full aerodynamic redesign, generating remarkable levels of downforce rarely seen in a road car. Carbon fiber was employed extensively, including for key components such as the hood and rear wing. During a time attack at the Nürburgring Nordschleife, the car shattered expectations by breaking the eight-minute barrier, a feat once thought unattainable for a road car.

vehicleCollection.zh:
2代NSX改进了空气动力学设计，增加了车辆的下压力。

后来的“Type R”版本虽然在ad术上做出M的进……

usedCar.en:
Nowadays, when you see "Type R," it means that you're looking
at a Honda sports car with over-the-top performance.

And, the first to wear this badge was the first-gen NSX,
considered the company's premiere super sports car.

With the Acura NSX Type R, Honda created something that was
virtually race ready, brimming with Formula 1 technology.

One of the more notable aspects of the NSX Type R is its curb
weight, which is <120kg> lighter than the base model.

The special Acura exotic also possesses a custom-tuned
suspension system, as well as special sports tires.
usedCar.zh:
这款NSX Type R是Honda Type R车系中的第一款车型，
同时也是最传奇的车型之一。

初代NSX就已经是性能极为
强悍的跑车了。

而这辆Type R更是专门针对赛道性能而
做出优化的衍生车型。

具体来讲，这辆车的重量被尽可能地削减了，
比基础车型还轻了<120kg>。

其配备的悬挂和轮胎也为
Type R进行了量身定制。[

vehicleCollection.en:
The first of the Honda Type R series, only 500 cars of this rare model were produced.

A high-performance variant of the NSX was introduced in November 1992. Weight was reduced by 265 lbs through the elimination of luxury amenities and the use of lighter functional components. Each engine was carefully balanced to deliver a refined and exhilarating experience at high rpm. It remains a legendary model, one whose significance in the evolution of the NSX cannot be overstated.

brandCentral.en:
This ultra-lightweight pure sports car concept was born from
the collaboration between Honda and Gran Turismo.

The design theme drew inspiration from Honda's first
Formula 1 race cars in the 1960s.

Its power unit incorporates technologies developed
for superbikes.

The engine is normally used in the Honda RC213V-S,
which is a MotoGP class motorcycle.

The car demonstrates the company's ability to compete in
all manner of races, be it on two wheels or four.
brandCentral.zh:
这款超轻量级的纯正跑车的概念设计来自于
Honda和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目。

其设计主题源自Honda 60年代的第一批F1赛车。

动力单元部分采用的是为超级摩托车特别开发的技术。

确切地说，它的车身上安装了一台MotoGP摩托车的专用引擎
——Honda RC213V-S。

它也是Honda纵横两轮及四轮赛事的实战能力的充分体现。

catch.en: A new species with the openness of a motorcycle and the handling of an automobile.
catch.zh: 既有摩托车的开放感，又有4轮车的横向重力加速度，带来全新的驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new species with the openness of a motorcycle and the handling of an automobile.

The "Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V" was the result of a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It combined the 212 HP engine from the Honda RC213V-S with an ultra-lightweight 893 lbs body, creating a unique form of mobility that offered the open-air freedom and agility of a motorcycle, combined with the handling precision and lateral G-forces of a 4-wheeled vehicle.

long.en: The "Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V" was the result of a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. collection.en:
One of the most iconic cars in Honda's history
is this Formula 1 machine, the Honda RA272.

Honda was the first Japanese automaker to
compete in F1 racing.

In 1965, this car earned Honda its first F1 win at the
Mexican Grand Prix in the final round of the season.

With an aluminum monocoque chassis up front
and a space-frame towards the rear...

...it was powered by a horizontal 1.5-liter V-12 mounted amidships.

The RA272 was developed and driven by Richie
Ginther, an American racer of the 1960s.

Honda has since earned many victories as an engine
supplier, and it all began with the RA272.
collection.zh:
本田是第一家参加F1赛事的日本制造商。

其历史上最具有标志性的车型就是
这款F1赛车——本田RA272。

这辆赛车在1965年的最后一站比赛——墨西哥大奖赛
上夺魁，为本田赢得了第一座F1分站赛冠军奖杯。

它的前半部分采用铝制单体车壳底盘，
而后部则采用了空间框架……

并由一部横中置1.5升V12引擎提供动力。

这辆RA272由活跃于1960年代的美国车手
里奇·金瑟尔参与开发以及驾驶。

自那之后，本田作为一家引擎供应商赢得了无数F1胜利，
但一切辉煌都始于这辆RA272。

catch.en: The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.
catch.zh: 为Honda斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.

In 1965, this legendary machine delivered Honda its first-ever F1 victory. Building upon the foundation of the RA271—Honda’s first F1 challenger—this car achieved greater performance through weight reduction across its components, the adoption of outboard rear suspension, and refined tuning of its 1.5-liter V-12. Although early in the season it grappled with stability issues, significant improvements were introduced midway through the campaign. These efforts culminated in a hard-fought and celebrated triumph at Round 10, the Mexican Grand Prix.

long.en: In 1965, this legendary machine delivered Honda its first-ever F1 victory. Building upon the foundation of the RA271—Honda’s first F1 challenger—this car achieved greater performance through weight reduction across its components, the adoption of outboard rear suspension, and refined tuning of its 1.5-liter V-12. Although early in the season it grappled with stability issues, significant improvements were introduced midway through the campaign. These efforts culminated in a hard-fought and celebrated triumph at Round 10, the Mexican Grand Prix.
long.zh: 1965年，这台传奇赛车为Honda带来了F1历史上的首场胜利。这款赛车沿用了Honda首款F1赛车RA271的基本框架，但通过全方位轻量化、改用外置后悬挂系统，以及对“如钟表般精准”的1.5升V12引擎进行了精密调校，使得性能得以提升。虽然赛季初期饱受稳定性问题困扰，但经过中期的重大改进，最终在第10轮墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了来之不易的胜利。

vehicleCollection.zh:
为Honda斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

1965年，这台传奇赛车为Honda带来了F1历史上的首场胜利。这款赛车沿用了Honda首款F1赛车RA271的基本框架，但通过全方位轻量化、改用外置后悬挂系统，以及对“如钟表般精准”的1.5升V12引擎进行了精密调校，使得性能得以提升。虽然赛季初期饱受稳定性问题困扰，但经过中期的重大改进，最终在第10轮墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了来之不易的胜利。

usedCar.en:
Honda was nice enough to celebrate its 50th birthday
by giving us the S2000 sports car.

It was the company's first front-engine/rear-drive roadster, or
FR as we say in the biz, since the S800 we last saw in 1970.

Born from the company's Formula 1 experience was the car's
amazing 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

It is naturally aspirated and revved to an incredible <9000rpm>,
but some complained that it lacked low-end torque.

That wasn't enough to deter fans from owning this wonderful
convertible, because Honda sold the car for 10 years.

Another cool tidbit about the S2000 is that it was one of the
first production cars to feature an "Engine Start" button.
usedCar.zh:
S2000车型发布于Honda公司50周年庆之际。

它是该公司自S800以来推出的第一台前置后驱双座敞篷跑车，
堪称呕心沥血之作。

该车采用顶级的自然进气直列四缸引擎。

它的专属定制配置使其转速能在眨眼间
达到惊人的<9000rpm>之高。

在当时，这款早期版本的汽车引擎曾一度
被一些人批评为“太过极端”...

但在其停产后的数年里，S2000标志性的
灵敏反应性让它收获了很多粉丝。

catch.en: The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda.
catch.zh: Honda推出的50周年款S2000，这辆前置后驱敞篷跑车很好地融入了公司的设计哲学。

vehicleCollection.en:
The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda.

Honda's beloved 'S' series of the 1960s made a return in 1999. Every element of the S2000 was engineered from the ground up to deliver pure, focused driving performance. True to its name, it was powered by a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 engine. Its 6-speed manual transmission was a purpose-built unit, incorporating a secondary reduction gear to optimize shift feel while minimizing weight. Details like these offered a clear window into the passion and precision that defined the S2000's development.

True to its name, it was powered by a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 engine. Its 6-speed manual transmission was a purpose-built unit, incorporating a secondary reduction gear to optimize shift feel while minimizing weight. Details like these offered a clear window into the passion and precision that defined the S2000's development.

brandCentral.en:
The Honda S660 was a mid-engine sports car that was
classified as a "kei car" in Japan.

Its compact nature and low price made it one of the most
affordable MR sports cars in the world.

Thanks to its mid-engine layout, the S660 boasted a
front/rear weight distribution ratio of 45/55.

Its suspension system was also tuned to
provide a MR sporty feel.

Despite its diminutive size, I would challenge you to find
a more fun to car to drive than this one.
brandCentral.zh:
Honda S660是一辆中置引擎的跑车，其设计完全符合日式“轻
型车”的规范。

这款车的设计思路是打造一辆更易于驾驶的跑车。

其中置引擎布局使得前后重量分布比例达到了优秀的45/55。

其侧倾中心和重心也进行了调优……

让这辆车的驾驶体验非常顺滑、稳定，操控性也数一数二。

catch.en: The spiritual successor to the Beat was this small-yet-unadulterated mid-engine kei sports car.
catch.zh: Beat的精神续作，一辆符合日本轻型车标准的纯正中置引擎迷你跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The spiritual successor to the Beat was this small-yet-unadulterated mid-engine kei sports car.

The S660 marked Honda’s return to the convertible ultralight kei-sports-car segment 19 years after the end of production of the Beat in 1996. Its all-new body design delivered exceptional rigidity while maintaining a featherweight curb mass in the low 1764 lbs range. Adding to its dynamic prowess, the S660 featured a torque vectoring system that enabled cornering performance previously unimaginable for a kei-car, offering neutral, engaging handling.

Adding to its dynamic prowess, the S660 featured a torque vectoring system that enabled cornering performance previously unimaginable for a kei-car, offering neutral, engaging handling.
long.zh: 继1996年Beat车型停产之后，S660是Honda 19年来推出的第一款超轻量“日式轻型”敞篷跑车。其全新设计的车身刚度极高，同时还能将车重控制在800 公斤级别上。更厉害的是，这辆车配备了扭矩矢量分配系统，让它能够以对“日式轻型车”来说不可想象的高速通过弯道，同时还能确保适度且充满乐趣的操控性能。

usedCar.en:
Not many people know that Honda has been in the sports car
business for a long time, since the 1960s actually.

Back then, the company produced the S600, which evolved
to become the S800, a compact open-top sports car.

Under its hood is a DOHC 4-cylinder engine that sends power
to the rear wheels, meaning that it has an FR layout.

Beginning with the S600, the size of the engine grew over time,
from the prototype's <360cc> to <500cc>, then to <600cc>.

As you might guess from the S800's name, this one came with
a <791cc> engine that produced <70ps>.
usedCar.zh:
S系列跑车是Honda跑车的起源。

它是一款后轮驱动的敞篷双座跑车，
配备了直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。

随着时间的推移，S车系的引擎排量逐渐
增加，从原型车的<360cc>到<500cc>再到<600cc>。

S800的排量还要更大一些，达到了<791cc>，
使其能够拥有<70ps>马力。

显然，它是S2000车型的灵感来源，
且在本质上一脉相承。

catch.en: With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.
catch.zh: Honda S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.

Honda’s lineage of sports cars began in 1963 with the ultra-compact, two-seat S500. It was followed by the S600, which delivered more power through a larger engine, and then by the S800, which featured 4-wheel independent suspension. Equipped with a more robust engine than the S600 and a short-throw shift lever positioned within easy reach of its low-slung seats, the S800 earned international praise.

long.en: Honda’s lineage of sports cars began in 1963 with the ultra-compact, two-seat S500. It was followed by the S600, which delivered more power through a larger engine, and then by the S800, which featured 4-wheel independent suspension. Equipped with a more robust engine than the S600 and a short-throw shift lever positioned within easy reach of its low-slung seats, the S800 earned international praise.
long.zh: Honda跑车系列始于1963年推出的超紧凑双座S500。随后推出了搭载更大引擎、动力更强的S600，接着是主打四轮独立悬挂的S800。S800相比S600引擎排量更大，短小的换挡杆在低矮座椅上轻松可及，赢得了全球赞誉。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Honda S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

Honda跑车系列始于1963年推出的超紧凑双座S500。随后推出了搭载更大引擎、动力更强的S600，接着是主打四轮独立悬挂的S800。S800相比S600引擎排量更大，短小的换挡杆在低矮座椅上轻松可及，赢得了全球赞誉。

brandCentral.en:
The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a compact
mid-engined sports car.

Everything about it has been designed with the driver in
mind, an approach for which Honda is well-known.

The design team put this model through real-life tests when
developing its aerodynamic features.

Under its bonnet is a <410ps> 2L
straight-four turbo engine...

Accompanied by a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.

Amazingly, the whole thing only weighs <899kg>!
brandCentral.zh:
Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo是一款中置引擎的紧凑型跑车。

在这辆车上，所有的设计都以驾驶者为中心，这也是Honda
赖以成名的设计理念。

设计团队在进行该车的空气动力学特性研发时，直接进
行了实车测试。

其引擎盖下装载了一台<410ps>的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎……

搭配8速双离合器变速箱。

最令人称道的是，整部车的重量仅有<899kg>！

catch.en: This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.
catch.zh: 这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着Honda“极致马力”的理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.

The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a two-seater coupe born from a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It embodies Honda’s "Human Centered Design" philosophy, featuring a driver-focused package that prioritized engagement and usability. With bold, athletic proportions, the car delivers the striking presence and excitement expected of a true sports car.

long.en: The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a two-seater coupe born from a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It embodies Honda’s "Human Centered Design" philosophy, featuring a driver-focused package that prioritized engagement and usability. With bold, athletic proportions, the car delivers the striking presence and excitement expected of a true sports car.
long.zh: “Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo”是一款Honda设计团队与《跑车浪漫旅》合作开发的双座轿跑。这款车采用了以驾驶者为中心的整体设计，让Honda“以人为本”的设计理念得到了清晰的体现。设计师还力图打造出带来强烈视觉冲击、令人兴奋不已的车身比例，呈现地道的跑车外观。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着Honda“极致马力”的理念。

“Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo”是一款Honda设计团队与《跑车浪漫旅》合作开发的双座轿跑。这款车采用了以驾驶者为中心的整体设计，让Honda“以人为本”的设计理念得到了清晰的体现。设计师还力图打造出带来强烈视觉冲击、令人兴奋不已的车身比例，呈现地道的跑车外观。

brandCentral.en:
The letter 'N' is a special marking for Hyundai cars,
designating the company’s know-how and passion.

The ELANTRA N is one such car—the ultimate high-performance
FF sports sedan.

Encased in its sleek body is a 2L turbo boasting <280ps>
of power, and capable of going 0-<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds.

The car is offered in 6-speed MT and 8-speed DCT, the latter
of which is equipped with an N Grin Shift overboost feature.

The suspension uses electronically controlled dampers
and an eLSD that allows for next-level high-speed cornering.

But the cherry on top is an N Sound Equaliser that lets
the driver enjoy their ideal exhaust sound while driving.

A sporty yet practical 4-door sedan, the ELANTRA N makes
everyday life exciting!
brandCentral.zh:
字母“N”是Hyundai为旗下汽车打造的特殊标识，
象征着品牌的技术实力与激情。

ELANTRA N也是如此——这是一台终极高性能前驱运动轿车。

流畅的车身内搭载了一台2升涡轮增压引擎，
输出功率达<280ps>，0-<100km/h>加速仅需5.3秒。

该车提供6速手动与8速双离合变速箱两项选择，
后者更支持N Grin Shift超增压功能。

悬挂采用电子控制减震器与eLSD电子限滑差速器配合，
能实现前所未有的高速过弯。

而点睛之笔在于N Sound Equalizer，让驾驶者
能按个人喜好定制排气声浪。

这台兼具运动性与实用性的四门轿车ELANTRA N
让日常生活也充满激情！

catch.en: This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N."
catch.zh: 以“N”为名的ELANTRA，专为赛道而生。

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N."

Introduced as the high-performance model of the seventh-generation ELANTRA, the ELANTRA N was developed to embody the N brand philosophy of “making cornering fun.” Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing 276.1 HP and 289.3 ft-lb of torque, it accelerated from 0-62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds, despite its front-wheel-drive layout. It was offered with either a 6-speed manual transmission or an 8-speed DCT. Its running gear featured electronically controlled dampers and an eLSD, complemented by a robust braking system.

long.en: Introduced as the high-performance model of the seventh-generation ELANTRA, the ELANTRA N was developed to embody the N brand philosophy of “making cornering fun.” Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing 276.1 HP and 289.3 ft-lb of torque, it accelerated from 0-62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds, despite its front-wheel-drive layout. It was offered with either a 6-speed manual transmission or an 8-speed DCT. Its running gear featured electronically controlled dampers and an eLSD, complemented by a robust braking system.
long.zh: 作为第七代ELANTRA的高性能车型，ELANTRA N的开发理念秉承N品牌“弯道顽童”的精神。该车搭载可输出280 PS动力与40.0 公斤力米扭矩的2升涡轮增压引擎，尽管为前驱布局，其0-100 公里/小时加速仅需5.3秒。车型提供6速手动和8速双离合两种变速箱选择。此外，其底盘配备电子控制减震器和eLSD电子限滑差速器，并搭载了高性能刹车系统。

conversation.en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...

...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.

Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.

And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?

That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!

Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……

ELANTRA N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。

直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！

谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？

在那场比赛中，ELANTRA N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！

此外，这也是Hyundai在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。
\

brandCentral.en:
Ever heard of the “TCR” racing category? It’s where
2.0-liter FF touring cars battle it out on the track.

Ever since this perennially popular category began, Hyundai
has been actively developing cars to compete in it.

This ELANTRA N TC is the third-generation successor to
the i30 N and Veloster N.

Exploiting the full potential of the ELANTRA N, it becomes
the ultimate lightweight, aerodynamic machine.

Although its power and torque remain within regulation limits,
its advanced chassis settings deliver superior handling.

Already carrying several victories from around the globe, it has
earned a stellar reputation among racing privateers.

Thanks to its unique design, this is one car that truly
stands out on the track!<
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过“TCR”赛事吗？这是专为2升级别前置前驱房车
而设的比赛。

自从这项经久不衰的赛事诞生以来，
Hyundai一直积极打造赛车来参与其中。

眼前这台ELANTRA N TC是i30 N和
Veloster N的第三代继任车型。

它深度释放了ELANTRA N的潜能，化身为一台追求
极致轻量化和空气动力学性能的终极竞速机器。

在动力和扭矩均符合赛事规则限制的前提下，
通过精密的底盘调校，实现了卓越的操控表现。

此车目前已揽获全球多项赛事桂冠，在私人车队中
赢得了极高的声誉。

凭借独到的设计，这无疑是一台能在赛道上
尽显锋芒的实力派跑车！

catch.en: This track-oriented Elantra was meticulously crafted to achieve victory.
catch.zh: 这台为赛道而生的ELANTRA，每一处细节都经过细心雕琢，只为决胜于赛场。

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-oriented Elantra was meticulously crafted to achieve victory.

The Hyundai ELANTRA N TC was a special model built for racing. Based on the ELANTRA N, which could accelerate from 0–62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds despite using a front-wheel-drive layout, the TC model was specially outfitted according to touring-car race regulations. The wide body was equipped with a carbon-fiber splitter and a large rear wing to greatly improve high-speed cornering stability. This model was also fitted with a 6-speed sequential gearbox, with the braking and cooling parts upgraded to endurance-racing standards.

long.en: The Hyundai ELANTRA N TC was a special model built for racing. Based on the ELANTRA N, which could accelerate from 0–62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds despite using a front-wheel-drive layout, the TC model was specially outfitted according to touring-car race regulations. The wide body was equipped with a carbon-fiber splitter and a large rear wing to greatly improve high-speed cornering stability. This model was also fitted with a 6-speed sequential gearbox, with the braking and cooling parts upgraded to endurance-racing standards.
long.zh: Hyundai ELANTRA N TC是一款专为赛道竞速而打造的特殊定制车型。其基础车型ELANTRA N虽然使用了前驱布局，仍能在5.3秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。TC版本则按照房车赛规则进行了特殊定制改装。其宽体车身配备了碳纤维分流板和大型尾翼，以显著提升高速过弯稳定性。此车型还换装了6速序列式变速箱，并对刹车和冷却部件进行了升级，以满足耐力赛标准。

conversation.en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a <343ps> 3.8-liter V-6.

The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.

The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.

This proces started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.

In a way, this was an extension of the clssical theme
of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the ush strokes
tcreat unexpected graphics.
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出<343ps>的3.8升V6引擎。

外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。

其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。

在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。

在某种程度上，它是素描这Q经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、d不到的视M效w。
n

The Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track is an FR sports car,
equipped with a <350ps> 3.8-liter V-6.

Sharing its basic platform with the Genesis, Hyundai's
luxury sedan...

...the Track model of the Coupe 3.8 has been tuned for
increased performance.

Its specially designed suspension system and upgraded brakes
make it a beast on twisty roads.
brandCentral.zh:
Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track是一款前置后驱的跑车，配备了<350ps>动力的
3.8升 V6引擎。

此车与Hyundai的豪华轿车品牌Genesis采用相同的平台……

这款Track车型接受过调校以提升驾驶性能……
