catch.en: Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.
catch.zh: 配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

This sports coupe used the same platform as the Genesis luxury sedan. It was 13.6 inches shorter overall, with a wheelbase 4.5 inches shorter. Combined with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout and 4-wheel independent suspension, the car possessed sharp handling dynamics. In 2012, the model received updates that increased engine output. With its 3.8-liter V-6 producing around 345.2 HP, it achieved performance approaching supercar territory.

long.en: This sports coupe used the same platform as the Genesis luxury sedan. It was 13.6 inches shorter overall, with a wheelbase 4.5 inches shorter. Combined with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout and 4-wheel independent suspension, the car possessed sharp handling dynamics. In 2012, the model received updates that increased engine output. With its 3.8-liter V-6 producing around 345.2 HP, it achieved performance approaching supercar territory.
long.zh: 这款运动轿跑与Genesis豪华轿车共享平台，其车身比轿车车型短345毫米，轴距缩短了115毫米，搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局和四轮独立悬挂，实现了卓越的敏捷性。在2012年，这台车进行了小幅改款，引擎动力输出得到增强。凭借动力输出接近350 PS的3.8升V6引擎，该车的性能直逼超级跑车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这款运动轿跑与Genesis豪华轿车共享平台，其车身比轿车车型短345毫米，轴距缩短了115毫米，搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局和四轮独立悬挂，实现了卓越的敏捷性。在2012年，这台车进行了小幅改款，引擎动力输出得到增强。凭借动力输出接近350 PS的3.8升V6引擎，该车的性能直逼超级跑车。

brandCentral.en:
The Genesis Coupe served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

And what a well-balanced machine it is, because the car already
possessed many race car attributes.

The most notable thing about the original was its handling,
which was both stable and predictable.

Its long wheelbase allowed for a spacious interior, while its
profile provided excellent downforce at high speed.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车以Genesis Coupe
为基础车型。

此车保留了Genesis关键的长轴距优势。

作为一款全面的赛车，其稳定性和操控性都极其出色。

庞大的车身除了能提供宽敞的内部空间外，也保障了车
辆行驶中的下压力。>

catch.en: Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.
catch.zh: 配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been modified to meet Gr.3 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. With a wheelbase exceeding 110.2 inches, it delivers excellent stability and strong downforce thanks to its expansive floor surface. The naturally-aspirated V-6 produces more than 493.1 HP, offering impressive performance without forced induction. It was a well-balanced machine, capable of excelling through both corners and straights.

long.en: Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been modified to meet Gr.3 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. With a wheelbase exceeding 110.2 inches, it delivers excellent stability and strong downforce thanks to its expansive floor surface. The naturally-aspirated V-6 produces more than 493.1 HP, offering impressive performance without forced induction. It was a well-balanced machine, capable of excelling through both corners and straights.
long.zh: 这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.3组别规则进行了改装。超过2,800毫米的长轴距为这台车带来高稳定性，巨大的底板提供了强劲的下压力。自然进气V6引擎仍可输出超过500 PS。这台各方面性能均衡的赛车能够兼顾弯道和直道。

vehicleCollection.zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.3组别规则进行了改装。超过2,800毫米的长轴距为这台车带来高稳定性，巨大的底板提供了强劲的下压力。自然进气V6引擎仍可输出超过500 PS。这台各方面性能均衡的赛车能够兼顾弯道和直道。

brandCentral.en:
Based on the Genesis Coupe, this is a Gran Turismo Gr.4
racing car original.

Its long wheelbase and traditional FR layout have won it
praise for achieving balanced and responsive handling.

Extensive tuning, including weight reduction and paddle
shifters, have put it on par with Gr.3 standards.
brandCentral.zh:
此车以捷尼赛思Coupe为基础改装，是一款原创的跑车浪漫旅
组别4级别赛车。

长轴距和传统的前置后驱布局带来均衡且灵敏的响应，
赢得了口碑。

在进行更重度的改装，包括减重和加装换挡拨片后，此
车基本达到了组别3标准。

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. Although it appears externally as a touring car, features like its paddle-shift transmission brought it closer in spirit to a Gr.3 machine. In the real world, this car earned a strong reputation in the drifting scene, and this Gr.4 version proves just as capable for racing as it was for sliding sideways.

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.B rally car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Hyundai Genesis Coupe.

It's been adapted for dirt-driving perfection, with the FR
drivetrain being replaced by a 4WD system.

The wheel treads have been enlarged to a whopping <2050mm>.

Despite a relatively long wheelbase, it makes no
compromises at all about manoeuvrability.

The organic undulations of its front bumper and rally-
ready aerodynamics make it a cutting-edge contender.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于
Hyundai Genesis Coupe开发，

针对泥地赛道驾驶进行了完备的改装：将前置后驱传动
系统替换为一套四轮驱动系统，

轮距也拓宽到了惊人的<2050mm>。

尽管轴距较长，但它在操控性方面没有做出任何妥协。

前保险杠那流畅起伏的外廓和适合拉力赛的空气动力学
外形让它一跃成为赛场上当仁不让的竞争者。<

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been reengineered to meet Gr.B regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. A 4-wheel-drive conversion has been added, along with design elements inspired by modern rally machines. The front fenders feature smooth, organic curves to maximize downforce, while the wide track, measuring more than 80.7 inches, enhanced maneuverability, complementing the car’s long wheelbase.

brandCentral.en:
EVs might not have the most exciting image, but there is
one example that shatters all preconceptions.

I’m talking about the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N.

The "N" at the end of its name refers to Hyundai’s two
testing grounds, Namyang and the Nürburgring.

The IONIQ 5 N is a true embodiment of driving pleasure.

In addition to a total output of 478 kW (<650ps>), it has
fully variable front and rear torque distribution.

When set to rear-bias, this car can drift, and its sound delivers
the excitement of a naturally-aspirated engine.

No doubt, the IONIQ 5 N will change your mind about EVs.
It’s a beast that has raised the bar for electric cars!
brandCentral.zh:
虽然电动汽车通常给人以缺乏激情的印象，
但有一款电动汽车彻底颠覆了这种偏见。

它就是现代艾尼氪5 N。

名称中的“N”代表现代汽车的
两个测试基地——南阳和纽博格林。

艾尼氪5 N完美诠释了驾驶的乐趣。

前后轴均配备电机，其四轮驱动系统的总动力输出达到478千瓦（<650ps>）。

其模拟的排气声浪也能带来媲美自吸发动机的振奋感。

毫无疑问，艾尼氪5 N将颠覆你对电动汽车的陈旧看法——
它是一款为电动汽车设立了新标杆的猛兽！

catch.en: A fearsome driving machine that challenges the preconceptions of BEVs.
catch.zh: 一款颠覆纯电动车型传统认知的性能怪兽。

vehicleCollection.en:
A fearsome driving machine that challenges the preconceptions of BEVs.

This performance model was introduced two years after the original launch of the IONIQ 5. It featured a 4-wheel-drive system powered by electric motors on the front and rear axles, allowing for freely adjustable torque distribution. When set to a rear-wheel bias, the system enabled the over two-ton SUV to be drifted with ease. In an effort to preserve the excitement of traditional combustion-engine cars, this unique electric SUV also offered a simulated 8-speed dual-clutch transmission and synthetic exhaust sounds.

long.en: This performance model was introduced two years after the original launch of the IONIQ 5. It featured a 4-wheel-drive system powered by electric motors on the front and rear axles, allowing for freely adjustable torque distribution. When set to a rear-wheel bias, the system enabled the over two-ton SUV to be drifted with ease. In an effort to preserve the excitement of traditional combustion-engine cars, this unique electric SUV also offered a simulated 8-speed dual-clutch transmission and synthetic exhaust sounds.
long.zh: 这款IONIQ 5的高性能版本在其首发两年后正式推出。四驱系统采用前后轴双电机布局，可实现扭矩的自由调节和分配。当调节为偏向后驱时，即便是这台超过2吨的车也能轻松实现漂移驾驶。这款独特的电动SUV力图保持传统燃油车的驾驶激情，特别配备了模拟8速双离合变速箱以及仿真排气声效。

brandCentral.en:
There is a question looming over the modern age: Is the
sports car destined to go the way of the dodo?

The IONIQ 6 N is Hyundai N’s answer to that question,
redefining the sports car for the EV era.

Its sleek streamliner silhouette boasts a Cd of 0.27, blending
aerodynamic efficiency with striking design.

Beneath that shape is <609ps> and 740 Nm of torque.
But there is more here than mere brute force.

When N Grin Boost is activated, the IONIQ 6 N’s
0-<100km/h> sprint drops to just 3.2 seconds.

Its N e-Shift simulates a physical gearbox, backed
by the roar of its N Active Sound+ system.

Crowned 2026 World Performance Car, this machine
proves the electric sports car’s future has arrived.
brandCentral.zh:
我们这个时代面临着一个严峻的问题：
跑车是否会像渡渡鸟一样走向灭绝？

IONIQ 6 N是Hyundai N品牌给出的答案，
它重新定义了电动车时代的跑车本质。

其流线型车身拥有0.27的风阻系数，
将空气动力学效率与惊艳设计融为一体。

外壳之下蕴藏着<609ps>动力和740 Nm的扭矩。
但等等！它的实力远不止蛮力。

启动N Grin Boost后，IONIQ 6 N的
0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。

同时，N e-Shift系统模拟了传统变速箱的换挡感受，
配合N Active Sound+系统的引擎轰鸣，体验更加沉浸。

这款车荣获2026世界性能车称号，
标志着电动跑车的未来已经到来。

catch.en: A new paradigm for high-performance EV.
catch.zh: 高性能电动车的全新标杆。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new paradigm for high-performance EV.

This was the second high-performance EV from Hyundai N. Equipped with a power unit with 770 Nm of torque and 641 HP of total system output, in a body tuned for aerodynamic performance, it accelerates from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.2 seconds. Features such as N Active Sound+ and N e-Shift, which gave the feeling of gear shifts in an EV, showed Hyundai N’s dedication to preserving the fun of driving.

Equipped with a power unit with 770 Nm of torque and 641 HP of total system output, in a body tuned for aerodynamic performance, it accelerates from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.2 seconds. Features such as N Active Sound+ and N e-Shift, which gave the feeling of gear shifts in an EV, showed Hyundai N’s dedication to preserving the fun of driving.
long.zh: 这是Hyundai N的第二款高性能电动车。最大扭矩达到770 Nm，总动力输出更是高达650 PS，车身经空气动力学优化至极致，从0加速到100 公里/小时仅需3.2秒。“N Active Sound+”声浪和“N e-Shift”换挡模拟等功能的加入，充分体现了Hyundai对驾驶乐趣的执着追求。

conversation.en:
When Yamauchi-san approached us about the Vision Gran
Turismo project, we were working on our next-gen Infiniti.

This design came from our recently-established
Beijing studio.

A team of young designers took the initiative
and completed the task in no time.

While admittedly simple, the design is
quite alluring.

For example, the floating A Pillar and overall form
are very expressive.

And because of its improvisational nature,
it has a strong sense of design.

Of course, this car was built to incorporate
the Infiniti's form language.

Therefore, it effectively connects to the production cars
that came after it.
t
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
当山内一典先生找我聊跑车浪漫旅愿景项目时……

……我们正在思考下一代车型应当采用什么样的设计策略。

这款设计来自于刚成立不久的英菲尼迪北京工作室。

团队的一名年轻设计师自告奋勇，
在很短时间内就完成了设计。

它的设计大繁至简，反而为这台车平添了一份魅力。

比如，A柱看上去像是游离在车厢z上，
整车造型更是传递出了强烈的冲动与激情。

因为本质上是即兴创作，所以给人以强烈的设计感，

但它在造型设计语言方面与品牌的血统一脉相承，

更为后推出的英菲尼迪量产车型留下了许多启发。

This concept car was the result of a collaboration between
Infiniti's design team and Gran Turismo.

While it has a very unique look, it clearly exhibits key
elements of Infiniti's design language.

Powered by an impressive 4.5-liter V-8 combined with
an electric motor...

...its hybrid system was based on those found
in Formula 1 race cars.

A front mid-engine transaxle gives it a sporty 45:55 front/rear
weight distribution, making it virtually race ready.
brandCentral.zh:
这款概念车是INFINITI的设计团队与跑车浪漫旅携手合作
的成果。

其独特的造型外观清晰地表达出了INFINITI设计语言中的关键
元素！

此车拥有由4.5L V8引擎和一台电机组成的动力单元，

还搭载了通常用于F1赛车的混合动力技术。

前轮中置跨轴传动布局将前后配重比确定为45：55。

catch.en: High performance made possible with a V8 engine and electrical motor. A GT machine packed with the motorsport passion of Asia.
catch.zh: 依托于V8引擎和电机的高性能。洋溢着亚洲赛车激情的GT车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
High performance made possible with a V8 engine and electrical motor. A GT machine packed with the motorsport passion of Asia.

conversation.en:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.

Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditioal beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.

The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.

And, the tillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.׊ext id=2001506ʞype=9
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。

尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现$了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。

注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。

另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛o色鸟居。քext i=2001506 type=9>R

brandCentral.en:
The coachbuilding company Zagato is a legendary name
in the sports car world.

It should come as no surprise that Gran Turismo
decided to collaborate with the famed Italian company.

The design of this car was inspired by the Iso Rivolta,
an iconic tourer from the 1960s.

It was created as a vehicle that could compete
in the world's top racing events.

Underneath its very Zagato-esque body was a Callaway
4.5-liter V-8.

This powerplant pumped out a crazy <567ps>!
brandCentral.zh:
车身制造公司Zagato对于车迷而言是一个传奇的招牌……

而这辆车就是Zagato和跑车浪漫旅合作的结果！

其设计灵感来自60年代的标志性豪华旅行车Iso Rivolta。

由于车辆的设计师希望此车能够参加世界顶级的赛车比赛，

所以为非常具有Zagato风格的车身搭配了一台Callaway 4.5L V8
发动机……

能够输出不可思议的<567ps>动力！

cars.nameZh: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Off-road Mode

brandCentral.en:
This car is a Vision Gran Turismo model created by
the world renowned Italian design house Italdesign.

Since their founding in 1968 in Turin, they've had a hand in
either the development or design of over 300 production cars.

The Italdesign Exeneo Vision Gran Turismo takes cues from
their 2013 extreme 'Parcour' concept car.

It's designed to be a versatile all-round GT car,
equally capable both on and off road.

The V10 engine sits in the midship position,
while the front wheels are riven by 2 electric motors.

The most interesting feature though is the carbon fibre and
aluminium fascia that envelopes the cockpit and engine unit.

The name 'Exeneo' comes from the Latin 'Exenium',
meaning a gift for the guest.

And you can dfinitely see the cockpit and engine are
all wrapped up like a wonderful prent!

The ͥff-rod Mode' spec is outfitted to handle the toughest
terrain, with extra ride heightand ovrszed ires.
brandCentral.sourceName: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Off-road Mode
brandCentral.zh:
这是由举世闻名的意大利设计公司Italdesign
所打造的一辆跑车浪漫旅愿景。

这家公司于1968年在都灵成立，曾参与开发或设计过
超过300款量产车。

这款Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo参考了
2013年的“Parcour”概念赛车的激进设计。

它的设计出发点是成为一辆多功能的GT汽车，
提供同等优秀的公路和越野性能。

它的V10引擎位于车身中部，前轮由两部电机所驱动。

全车利落的特征就是包裹整个座舱和引擎舱
的碳纤维与铝合金线条。

“EXENEO”这个名字来源于拉丁文的“xenium”，
意思是“送给客人的礼物”。

这辆车的座舱和引擎都被包装成一份华丽的U物，
用这个名字可谓非常贴切！

这款“Off-road Mode”Y型调高了WL身q度，加大了轮胎尺寸，
专为应对最颠簸的地形所设计。

catch.en: A high-performance luxury car prepared as a "beautifully wrapped gift."
catch.zh: 一辆按照“包装精美的礼物”思路设计的高性能豪华跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A high-performance luxury car prepared as a "beautifully wrapped gift."

This Vision Gran Turismo came from a renowned Italian design house. Its name was derived from the Latin word xenium, meaning “gift for the guest.” Its design encases both driver and engine in layered carbon fiber and aluminum, resulting in a distinctive wrapped appearance. A V-10 engine has been mounted behind the cockpit, while two electric motors powered the front wheels. To adapt to various terrain conditions, the chassis can be adjusted into four different configurations.

long.en: This Vision Gran Turismo came from a renowned Italian design house. Its name was derived from the Latin word xenium, meaning “gift for the guest.” Its design encases both driver and engine in layered carbon fiber and aluminum, resulting in a distinctive wrapped appearance. A V-10 engine has been mounted behind the cockpit, while two electric motors powered the front wheels. To adapt to various terrain conditions, the chassis can be adjusted into four different configurations.
long.zh: 出自著名意大利设计工作室的Vision Gran Turismo概念车型。车名源自拉丁语“xenium”，意为“赠予宾客的礼物”，其设计理念是用碳纤维和铝材将驾驶员与引擎完美“包裹”其中。驾驶舱后方搭载V10引擎，前部则配置了双电机系统。底盘可调节为4种不同配置模式，以适应各种路况和地形。

conversation.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.
~
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆捷豹D-Type……

与过去的捷豹截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。

从XK120到XK150，捷豹一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。

在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但655年和56年却大获全胜，
在捷豹的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。

这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。

conversation.en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 an 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynmic principles to increase performance.
o
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是1954年出厂的Jaguar D-Type。
作为C-Type的继任者，它得到了全面进化。

与它的前辈一样，D-Type是专门为在勒芒比赛中获胜而制造的。

尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。

dialogues.en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 an 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynmic principles to increase performance.
o

尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。

dialogues.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.
~

得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆捷豹D-Type……

与过去的捷豹截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。

从XK120到XK150，捷豹一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。

在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但655年和56年却大获全胜，
在捷豹的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。

这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。

collection.en:
The D-Type is one of the most important cars in the history
of Jaguar motorsport.

It is also one of my favourite driving cars of the 1950s.

While it shares components with the double
Le Mans-winning C-Type...

Its all-aluminium monocoque body was a radical departure
from that model.

Its straight-six engine was also significantly tuned for
both power and reliability.

C-Type designer Malcolm Sayer also worked his magic
on the D-Type...

Fitting a fin to factory team cars to enhance stability
at high speeds.

The D-Type retired on its Le Mans debut in 1954, but
returned in 1955 to win three consecutive races.

Just 68 of this legendary racing car were produced,
with the works cars being the most desirable.

D-Type是Jaguar汽车运动史上最重磅的车型之一，

但全铝单体车壳带来了全新的巨变。

其直列六缸引擎也针对功率和耐用性进行了显著调校。

D-Type的外观设计由曾参与过C-Type设计的Malcolm Sayer完成，

并在车厂车队的赛车上专门安装了鲨鱼鳍翼片，以强化

With three consecutive victories at Le Mans, this racing Jaguar featured a large fin that helped lateral stability at high speed.

The Jaguar D-Type was a racing sports car introduced in 1954 as the successor to the C-Type, with just 64 units produced in total. It's built on a tubular frame with monocoque construction. Its sleek bodywork, penned by Malcolm Sayer, was instantly recognizable by the aerodynamic fin positioned behind the driver’s seat. It made its debut at the 1954 24 Hours of Le Mans and went on to dominate the event, securing victory three years in a row through 1957.

The E-type Coupé, which made its debut in 1961, had a huge
influence on sports car design.

The engine in the car's nose was based on the straight-six
that won Le Mans five times in the C- and D-types.

Although known to the world as the 'E-type', in
North America it is often called the 'XK-E'.

The beautiful body, which evolved from the D-Type sports
racer, was designed by Malcolm Sayer...

Who is known as an early proponent of
aerodynamic design for automobiles.

The E-Type remained in production for 14 years, evolving
to comply with later safety and emission laws.

Still, it remained instantly recognisable to everyone.

Although Jaguar didn’t have a factory race programme
for the E-Type in motorsports...

It did buid  'ow-drag' coupé and 12 lightweight
E-Types that raced on both sides  the Atani֚/>

a eriously fast sportscar.

赛冠军的C-Type和D-Type所使用的引擎打造。

“XK-E”。

E-type美丽的车身曲线，从D-Type赛车演变而来，
其设计者是马尔科姆·塞耶，

他也被视为是汽车空气动力学设计的早期倡导者。

E-type持续生产z14年，尽管不断改进以符合后来的安全和
排放法律，

但经典的外观设计依然让人一望便知。

虽然捷豹没有为E-Type设立厂队参加比赛，

但他们确实制造了一辆“低阻力”双门跑车和12o轻量
型号E-Type，用于在大西洋两岸参加比赛。

的跑车。

The masterpiece 2-seater sports car continues to inspire car designers around the world.

A 2-seater sports car released in 1961. Its refined stylings had a profound impact on sports car design all over the world. The 3.6L inline-6 DOHC engine produces 265.3 HP, propelling the lightweight 2687 lbs body to speeds of up to 130.5 mph. 7820 Series I models were produced, with most of them carried over to the United States.

Every lesson learned from Jaguar's Formula E and I-PACE
eTROPHY history has been worked into the car.

The beautiful interior and exterior draws inspiration
from the marque's rich motorsports history.

The past, the present and future;
they're all are here in this one exquisite vehicle.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo Coupé是捷豹那完美血统和技术魔力的
终极展现。

其驾驶体验主要围绕一套纯电动力系统打造。

所有从捷豹的电动方程式锦标赛和I-PACE eTROPHY杯纯电动车锦标赛赛事经验中积累的
宝贵知识都得到了充分利用。

充满美感的内饰和外观设计从整个赛车运动的历史中汲
取了灵感，

让赛车的过去和未来的精华，都凝结在了这一辆精美的
赛车上。

catch.en: This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.
catch.zh: 全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Jaguar Advanced Design. A fully electric model, it carries forward the legacy of Jaguar’s legendary race cars like the C-type, D-type, and E-type, not only in elegance, but also in engineering, with a low center of mass and near-perfect weight distribution. Inside the cockpit, all essential driving information has been seamlessly projected ahead of the driver, delivering a thrilling racing experience through advanced digital integration.

long.en: This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Jaguar Advanced Design. A fully electric model, it carries forward the legacy of Jaguar’s legendary race cars like the C-type, D-type, and E-type, not only in elegance, but also in engineering, with a low center of mass and near-perfect weight distribution. Inside the cockpit, all essential driving information has been seamlessly projected ahead of the driver, delivering a thrilling racing experience through advanced digital integration.
long.zh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar Advanced Design设计部门打造。这款纯电动车型传承了Jaguar经典赛车C-Type、D-Type和E-Type的设计血统，不仅外观优雅，更具备低重心和完美的前后配重。坐进驾驶舱，所有必要的驾驶信息都会无缝投射在前方路面上，通过数字化技术营造出身临其境的赛车体验。

vehicleCollection.zh:
全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

这款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar Advanced Design设计部门打造。这款纯电动车型传承了Jaguar经典赛车C-Type、D-Type和E-Type的设计血统，不仅外观优雅，更具备低重心和完美的前后配重。坐进驾驶舱，所有必要的驾驶信息都会无缝投射在前方路面上，通过数字化技术营造出身临其境的赛车体验。

brandCentral.en:
This 'Roadster' is Jaguar's third Vision Gran Turismo car.

A fully electric vehicle, it follows the lead of
Jaguar's two previous VGT cars.

Its three electric motors are capable of outputting
over <1000ps>.

Indeed, it provides the pure driving experience racers
have come to expect from Jaguar.

The body design was inspired by Jaguar's iconic D-Type
racing car.

The D-Type competed in the 1950s, winning the 24 Hours
of Le Mans an impressive three times!

In terms of styling, it was best known for the huge
fin at the rear of the car.

Well, the VGT Roadster brings that rear fin back to life
for the modern day!

Now an active fin, it deftly responds to the speed
at which the car is travelling.
brandCentral.zh:
这款“Roadster”便是Jaguar的第三款Vision Gran Turismo跑车。

它沿袭了Jaguar前两辆VGT车的理念，是一辆纯电动汽车。

它由三个电动马达驱动，能够输出超过<1000ps>的动力。

它满足了车手们对Jaguar跑车纯粹驾驶体验的期待。

车身设计的灵感来自Jaguar标志性的D-Type赛车。

D-Type是曾在20世纪50年代出场的经典赛车，
曾三次夺下勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！

从外观上讲，它最为人熟知的特色便是那位于车尾的巨大尾鳍……

这款VGT敞篷跑车令它的尾鳍设计在当下再次焕发出了生命力！

在新车上，尾鳍变成了活动式的，
并且会根据车速自动作出相应调整。

catch.en: A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.
catch.zh: 一辆源于传奇D-type的跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.

Jaguar’s third Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to the iconic Jaguar D-type. This futuristic electric open single-seater with an aero screen is powered by three electric motors generating more than 986.2 HP. Behind the seat is a modern take on the D-type’s signature fin, while the focused, minimalist cockpit controls reflected Jaguar’s storied racing legacy.

long.en: Jaguar’s third Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to the iconic Jaguar D-type. This futuristic electric open single-seater with an aero screen is powered by three electric motors generating more than 986.2 HP. Behind the seat is a modern take on the D-type’s signature fin, while the focused, minimalist cockpit controls reflected Jaguar’s storied racing legacy.
long.zh: Jaguar第三款Vision Gran Turismo概念车的设计灵感源自经典的Jaguar D-Type赛车。这款配备导流风挡的开放式电动单座赛车采用三电机驱动，最大功率超过1,000 PS。座椅后方采用了经典D-Type标志性尾鳍的现代化演绎，简洁专业的座舱控制系统也充分体现了Jaguar的历史底蕴与传统。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆源于传奇D-type的跑车。

Jaguar第三款Vision Gran Turismo概念车的设计灵感源自经典的Jaguar D-Type赛车。这款配备导流风挡的开放式电动单座赛车采用三电机驱动，最大功率超过1,000 PS。座椅后方采用了经典D-Type标志性尾鳍的现代化演绎，简洁专业的座舱控制系统也充分体现了Jaguar的历史底蕴与传统。

brandCentral.en:
Launched in 2020, the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV is the
racing version of the VGT Coupé.

With its wealth of experience in the pure EV-racing scene,
Jaguar's aim was to create a 24-hour race contender.

The power unit was the work of the race team, and its four
motors produce a whopping <1903ps>.

The top speed? Just north of <400km/h>.

Liquid-nitrogen cooling systems ensure hyper-accurate
battery temperature management.

All of which adds up to a car whose fearsome speed can be
brought to bear on every inch of the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV是VGT Coupé的赛车版本，
于2020年正式推出。

Jaguar运用自己在纯电动赛车领域的丰富经验，倾力打造了
一辆24小时耐力赛的冲冠赛车。

动力单元直接来自车队，四部电机总共可以输出令人咋
舌的<1903ps>动力。

想知道它的极限速度吗？只是将将超过<400km/h>……而已！

通过液氮冷却系统，实现了对电池温度的超精确管理。

所有这些特性集中到同一辆车上，令它在赛道上彻底发
挥出令人生畏的速度优势。

catch.en: This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.
catch.zh: 这辆虚拟电动赛车是对Jaguar未来的一瞥。

vehicleCollection.en:
This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.

Jaguar’s second Vision Gran Turismo was developed with engineering input from Jaguar Special Vehicles (SV). While retaining its elegant silhouette, the car received a complete aerodynamic overhaul to maximize downforce. The powertrain features four electric motors, drawing from Jaguar’s Formula E expertise. The battery system utilizes state-of-the-art liquid nitrogen cooling.

conversation.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.

This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...

...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.

The result? A rfined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.

The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...

...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the nw legendary E-Type.
u
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，Jaguar继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。

这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。

在Ford推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的Lola GT……

以及Ferrari推出了LM的同时……

Jaguar依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。

其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥有优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——

XJ13。

XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……

尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
为E-Typlk发提供了大量的思路。

collection.en:
Jaguar played a huge part in the history of the
24 Hours of Le Mans,

winning this famous race five times in the 1950s with the
C-Type and D-Type.

However Jaguar withdrew from competition at Le Mans after 1956,
and didn't show interest in racing again until the 1960s.

But development of a sports car to succeed the D-Type
had been secretly underway.

That successor of the D-Type, is the car you see before you,
the XJ13 with a midship mounted V12.

But unfortunately, this XJ13 never made it to Le Mans.

By the time the car was ready, management's priorities
had changed again.

We can only imagine what might have happened,

had Jaguar been part of the legendary Ford-Ferrari tussle
at the '67 Le Mans.
collection.zh:
捷豹在勒芒24小时耐力赛的历史上曾经极为活跃，

在20世纪50年代凭借C-Type和D-Type五次赢得这一著名赛事。

然而，这家公司于1956年后退出勒芒赛事，直到20世纪60
年代才重新表现出对比赛的兴趣。

不过，D-Type的后继者的设计开发一直在秘密进行。

它便是您眼前看到的这台配备中置V12引擎的XJ13。

不幸的是，这辆XJ13从未如愿踏上勒芒的征途。

当这辆赛车准备完毕的时候，管理层的优先战略目标又
发生了变化。

我们只能幻想，如果捷豹参与了1967年勒芒耐力赛
福特与法拉利那场堪称传奇的战斗，

最后会是什么样的结果。

catch.en: A dream car that never came to be, this beautiful V12 mid-engine race car disappeared.
catch.zh: 从未实现的幻想，美丽的V12中置引擎赛车，已经消失在车迷的视野中。

vehicleCollection.en:
A dream car that never came to be, this beautiful V12 mid-engine race car disappeared.

Completed in 1966, this was Jaguar’s first mid-engine racing sports car. Its low, aerodynamic body—reminiscent of the E-type—housed a 495.1 HP 5.0-liter DOHC V-12. Although it showed great promise as a competitive circuit machine, Jaguar’s management at the time had little interest in motorsport, and the project was ultimately cancelled. Often regarded as Jaguar’s most beautiful race car, it faded into history without ever turning a wheel in competition.

long.en: Completed in 1966, this was Jaguar’s first mid-engine racing sports car. Its low, aerodynamic body—reminiscent of the E-type—housed a 495.1 HP 5.0-liter DOHC V-12. Although it showed great promise as a competitive circuit machine, Jaguar’s management at the time had little interest in motorsport, and the project was ultimately cancelled. Often regarded as Jaguar’s most beautiful race car, it faded into history without ever turning a wheel in competition.
long.zh: 这辆1966年推出的车型是Jaguar的一款中置引擎运动型赛车。其低矮的流线型车身与E-Type非常类似，并安装了一部502 PS动力的5升V12双顶置凸轮轴引擎。虽然这款车理应在赛道上驰骋纵横，但当时的管理层对赛车运动并不感兴趣，于是这个项目最终惨遭下马。它被称为Jaguar最美的赛车，但还没机会参与任何一场比赛便湮没在了历史的滚滚浪潮中。

conversation.en:
The Jaguar XJ220 is celebrated the world over as one of
the most unique supercars of the ‘90s.

It began as a pet project for several Jaguar engineers
and designers...

Who came together to work off the clock.

It is for this reason that the team behind the XJ220
came to be known as 'The Saturday Club.'

You might say that this car represents the free expression
of certain ideals held by Jaguar employees.

Once a prototype was unveiled, it attracted worldwide buzz,
leading to official development and production.

Combining the beauty of Jaguar’s legendary ‘60s racers...

Th prfrmance of its ‘90s racers...

And e experis ʯnglan’s storied luxurycar builder,
it is a ewel that i like no other.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
捷豹XJ220被全世界车迷誉为
二十世纪九十年代最独具魅力的超级跑车。

这款车最初只是几名捷豹工程师和设计师的私人项目……

在工作之余进行研发。

正因如此，打造XJ220的团队也后人被称为“星期六俱乐部”。

可以说，这辆车充分地代表了捷豹员工
对于自己理念的自由表达。

这台原型车甫一亮相，便立刻在全世界范围内造成了轰动，
也让公司下定决心，开启正式研发并投产。

这台车结合了品牌六十年代传奇赛车的优雅造型……

以九十年代赛车的超强性能……

有英格兰h历f悠久的豪华车制造专业知识，
可以称得上是绝无仅有的珍宝
t

catch.en: A road-going Group C car with breath-taking bodywork
catch.zh: 一辆车身设计令人惊艳的C组别公路车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going Group C car with breath-taking bodywork

The XJ220 was named for its record-breaking top speed, reaching 220 mph (220 mph), making it the fastest road car of its time. Production was managed by Jaguar Sport, a joint venture between Jaguar and Tom Walkinshaw Racing. It was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6 derived from the XJR-11 Group C race car, mounted to a chassis constructed from aluminum honeycomb and carbon Kevlar composites. Beginning in 1993, the XJ220 also saw competition in GT racing, including entries at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

It was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6 derived from the XJR-11 Group C race car, mounted to a chassis constructed from aluminum honeycomb and carbon Kevlar composites. Beginning in 1993, the XJ220 also saw competition in GT racing, including entries at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British racing car

conversation.en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.

This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.

It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of Britsh fans.

But they first had to endure a stressful race.

It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends  chill down my spine.
V

1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。

那年，大批来自英国的Jaguar车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！

而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……

他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。

萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！

那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

collection.en:
Despite their early success in the 1950s, Jaguar didn't enter
a works team at Le Mans again for almost 30 years.

In fact, they wouldn't return to the race until 1986,
when they entered the XJR-6.

The XJR-6 was designed by Tony Southgate,
who had made his name in Formula 1,

and it was powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine.

It was the heyday of turbocharged cars, and the XJR-6's uniquely
high-pitched exhaust note was instantly recognizable.

The sight and sound of a Jaguartearing around the track
once more certainly got the fans excited!

Two years later, Jaguar entered the XJR-9
and finally won at Le Mans,

 for their first new victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans since an
Ecurie Ecose D-Type won in 1957.

It ha been more than thirty years since their last win!

That alone is enougto secure thisʃconiccar's
place in the annals of racing history!

尽管捷豹在20世纪50年代

但在之后的将近30年时间里，
捷豹都再没有以厂队的身份参加过勒芒耐力赛。

一直等到1986年，他们才带着XJR-6重返赛场。

XJR-6由当时在F1声名遐迩的托尼·索思盖特设计，

配备了自然进气V12引擎。

当时涡轮增压车型的声势日渐浩大，而XJR-6爆裂清脆的排
气声夹在其中，获得了很高的辨识度。

一辆捷豹赛车在赛
上飞驰的景象和巨大的轰鸣声都能让
车迷兴奋不已！

两年后，捷豹带着XJR-9在勒芒重新登上领奖台。

这是自1957年Ecurie Ecose D-Type获胜以来，
他们在勒芒24小时耐力赛中的首次胜利。

距他们上次夺冠已经过去了30多年！

仅仅这一条，就X确保这款J志i汽车被载入赛车运
动的史册里！

catch.en: This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.
catch.zh: Jaguar标志性的勒芒参赛车，打败了涡轮增压赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.

Following its string of successes at Le Mans during the 1950s, Jaguar made a return to endurance racing in 1986 with a Group C prototype. Jaguar reached its peak in 1988 with the XJR-9. Thanks to its exceptional aerodynamics and durability, it claimed victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. That triumph secured its place in motorsports history, as Jaguar dethroned Porsche, the long-reigning champions of Le Mans.

That triumph secured its place in motorsports history, as Jaguar dethroned Porsche, the long-reigning champions of Le Mans.
long.zh: 在1950年代的勒芒取得巨大成功后，Jaguar在1986年带着一款C组别赛车再度杀回这项赛事。这辆XJR-9帮助他们在1988年登上了巅峰。它简单的构造提供了优秀的空气动力学性能和耐用性，帮助这款车在勒芒24小时耐力赛上强势夺魁。凭借一场击败勒芒的常胜冠军Porsche的胜利，它为自己在赛车历史上留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。

conversation.en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.

The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.

They knew precisely where to work their magic.

In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。

作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。

这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。

或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。

参与这项开发计划的工程师们……

……很好地掌握了比例的x念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。

他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。

例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。

光凭这一点，就值Us我们向那q期计者们脱帽致敬。

collection.en:
Jeep is surely one of the world's most familiar and
beloved brands, especially to off-road enthusiasts.

The company has a long and storied history...

...but there's no doubt this Willys MB (Military, Model B)
was one of its greatest successes.

Interestingly, Willys didn't actually come up with
the name "Jeep."

It was the brainchild of the American Bantam Car Company’s
prototype utility vehicle for the military.

This car was designated “GP” for general purpose,
which souds like "Jeep."

After World War II, the company decided to focus on
mass-producing Jeeps and trademarked the name.

The company’s "civilian jeeps" were based on the classic
Willys MB.

It had developed a good reputation during the war and was
initially marketed for use in agriculture.

The company also began worwide productiounderlicense,
which meant that anyone could produce a Jeep.

usedCar.en:
No historical account of 4WD vehicles would be
complete without mentioning the Willys MB.

It is, simply put, the granddaddy of
the modern-day Jeep.

The Willy MB was developed in 1940, at the start of WWII,
at the behest of the U.S. Army.

The task? To build a sturdy, compact machine
with superior off-road performance.

As you know by now, the Willys MB
successfully rose to the challenge.

After the war, Willys started selling the MB
as a general-purpose vehicles.

It was around this time that the term Jeep
came into common use.

Thanks to its efficiency off the beaten path, the original Jeep
remains the epitome of off-road vehicles to this day.
usedCar.zh:
如果要讲述四驱车的历史，Willys MB
绝对是绕不过去的存在。

事实上，它才是人气持久的Jeep车型的“鼻祖”。

这辆车于二次世界大战初期
按照美国陆军指定的规格开发。

开发的目的？当然是打造一辆具有超强越野性能，
但又皮实紧凑的车辆。

可以想象，Willys MB完美地达成了这一目标。

战后，Willys开始将MB作为“通用型”车辆投入市场。

也正是在这一时期，“Jeep”这个称呼开始被广泛接受。

由于出色的设计和越野性能，Jeep在今天
仍然是四驱车的典范。\

catch.en: The U.S. Army-commissioned vehicle that became the forefather of the modern SUV.
catch.zh: 它诞生于战场上，美国陆军的苛刻要求促成了现代4x4之父的诞生。

vehicleCollection.en:
The U.S. Army-commissioned vehicle that became the forefather of the modern SUV.

The roots of the SUV category could be traced back to this compact 4-wheel-drive vehicle, developed at the request of the U.S. military in 1940. Among the prototypes submitted by Bantam, Ford, and Willys, it was the Willys MB—an improved version of the MA—that proved to be the winner, ultimately leading to the production of over 360,000 units. Its straightforward yet durable construction, featuring a ladder frame, rigid axles, and 4-wheel drive, resulted in a truly historic vehicle whose legacy has endured for generations.

long.en: The roots of the SUV category could be traced back to this compact 4-wheel-drive vehicle, developed at the request of the U.S. military in 1940. Among the prototypes submitted by Bantam, Ford, and Willys, it was the Willys MB—an improved version of the MA—that proved to be the winner, ultimately leading to the production of over 360,000 units. Its straightforward yet durable construction, featuring a ladder frame, rigid axles, and 4-wheel drive, resulted in a truly historic vehicle whose legacy has endured for generations.
long.zh: SUV车型的起源可追溯到这款1940年应美军要求开发的紧凑型四轮驱动车辆。在Bantam、Ford和Willys生产的测试车型中，Willys MB表现最佳。作为MA的升级版本，最终生产了超过36万辆。其简单坚固的结构（采用边梁式车架和刚性车轴）与四轮驱动形成完美结合，成就了一款真正具有历史意义的汽车，其精神传承至今。

vehicleCollection.en:
The KTM X-Bow is a unique Audi turbo-powered track car from the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer.

The X-BOW was the first sports car developed by Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM. Pronounced “Crossbow,” it drew inspiration from the mechanical bow weapon that shares its name. Stripped of doors and windows, this minimalist two-seater eliminated all superfluous features in pursuit of pure performance. With its precise handling, the car was capable of sustaining up to 1.5 lateral Gs through corners.

Stripped of doors and windows, this minimalist two-seater eliminated all superfluous features in pursuit of pure performance. With its precise handling, the car was capable of sustaining up to 1.5 lateral Gs through corners.
long.zh: X-BOW是奥地利摩托车制造商KTM开发的第一款超级跑车。这个名字的意思是“十字弩”，它的造型设计也采用了同名机械式弓弩武器的概念。这款双门跑车没有车门也没有车窗，还取消了一切不必要的功能。这辆车拥有绝佳的操控性能，在过弯时最大水平重力加速度能够达到1.5G。

This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.

This Vision Gran Turismo concept was born from the passion and technical expertise of the team at Centro Stile Lamborghini. Built around Lamborghini’s signature design language, highlighted by bold "Y" elements and hexagonal forms, it also pays tribute to the iconic Stratos Zero with a side profile that echoed its striking silhouette. Power comes from a V-12 engine paired with a supercapacitor-based hybrid system, derived from the Sián FKP 37. In a refined detail, part of this advanced system is visible from the outside, blending high-performance engineering with unmistakable style.

Flashy scissor doors and big V-12 engines have been signatures

Every flagship model produced by the company since

vehicleCollection.en:
The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.

The original Aventador made its debut at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show, taking over from the Murciélago. Its chassis was thoroughly reengineered, now utilizing a carbon monocoque paired with aluminum subframes at both ends, replacing the steel tube frame of its predecessor. Thanks to the extensive use of carbon fiber and aluminum, the SV achieved an impressively low dry weight of just 3472 lbs for a car in this class.

Its chassis was thoroughly reengineered, now utilizing a carbon monocoque paired with aluminum subframes at both ends, replacing the steel tube frame of its predecessor. Thanks to the extensive use of carbon fiber and aluminum, the SV achieved an impressively low dry weight of just 3472 lbs for a car in this class.
long.zh: Aventador接棒Murcielago，在2011年日内瓦车展首次亮相。车身几乎完全重新设计，采用碳纤维单体车壳，前后铝材副车架取代了前代车型的钢管空间车架。由于车体主要由碳纤维和铝制成，它相对于同车型来说也非常轻，净重仅为1,575 公斤。

There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.

Lamborghini’s flagship models had long featured V-12 engines, but their most extreme variants carried the Superveloce (SV) badge. Translated as "super fast" in Italian, the designation traced its origins back to the legendary Miura. The Aventador SV variant was introduced in 2015, delivering 49.3 HP more than the base model for a total output of 739.6 HP.

vehicleCollection.en:
The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.

First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became the prototypical supercar. The first production version, the LP400, launched in 1974 in a limited run of just 150 units. In 1985, Lamborghini introduced the 5000 Quattrovalvole, powered by a 5.2-liter engine producing 448.7 HP. The final version of the Countach was the 25th Anniversary model, released in 1988, with a total production run of 657 units.

collection.en:
The Countach had a huge impact on the motor industry, and
plotted the course Lamborghini has followed ever since.

Its development was headed up by the brilliant engineer
Paolo Stanzani...

Who, together with designer Marcello Gandini,
produced this scissor-doored masterpiece.

Although Countachs were produced for over 25 years,
the first generation LP400 remains the most popular.

There's just something different about the way it drives.
The fact only 150 were made adds scarcity value, too.

You can be certain these Countach LP400s are only going to
become more popular in the years to come.
collection.zh:
Countach的出现对汽车工业产生了巨大的影响，并就此确立
Lamborghini之后一直遵循的路线。

它的开发是由天才工程Paolo Stanzani牵头负责的……

他与设计师Marcello Gandini合作无间，
联合设计了这款剪刀式车门的杰作。

尽管Countach的生产持续了25年以上，第一代的LP400
仍然是最受车迷欢迎的。

其驾驶体验颇有独特之处。而且只生产了150辆的事实也
让它身价倍增。

我可以确定地说，在未来的几年里，Countach LP400
只会变得更加抢手。

catch.en: The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.
catch.zh: 一辆别具一格的汽车，其未来主义的造型吸引了全世界的目光。

vehicleCollection.en:
The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.

First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became a landmark in supercar history, drawing global attention with its groundbreaking design and performance. Named after a word from the Piedmontese dialect meaning “surprise,” the Countach lived up to its name in every sense. Marcello Gandini’s bold, near-futuristic styling left an indelible mark on the design language of high-performance cars for generations to follow.

long.en: First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became a landmark in supercar history, drawing global attention with its groundbreaking design and performance. Named after a word from the Piedmontese dialect meaning “surprise,” the Countach lived up to its name in every sense. Marcello Gandini’s bold, near-futuristic styling left an indelible mark on the design language of high-performance cars for generations to follow.
long.zh: 在1971年日内瓦车展首次亮相的Lamborghini Countach是一款真正的史诗级超级跑车，以设计和性能吸引全世界的目光。“Countach”一词源自意大利皮埃蒙特方言，意为“惊喜”，Countach也名副其实，带来了十足的惊喜。马塞罗·甘迪尼那令人惊叹的近未来主义设计对之后多年的超级跑车领域产生了深远影响。

usedCar.en:
The Diablo is the direct successor of the Lamborghini Countach.

Like its predecessor, it comes with a V-12 and scissor doors.

There was a GTR model that was developed exclusively
for GT racing.

And there was this GT model, a road-going version of the GTR,
designed for public roads.

The car's engine is awesome, delivering <575ps>, making it
the most powerful in the Diablo lineup.

And when you rev the thing to near its redline,
it sings in a sweet melodic voice.

Only 80 units of the Diablo GT were made, making it one of
the rarest and most spectacular Lamborghinis in history.
usedCar.zh:
Diablo是兰博基尼Countach的直系继承者。

搭载V12引擎，继承了Countach的剪刀门设计。

Diablo意为恶魔，车如其名，其顶尖的技术和性能近乎鬼怪。
Diablo GTR版本专为GT赛事设计。

而其GT车型是GTR车型的公路版本。

GT车型能够产生最大<575ps>的马力，
是Diablo马力最强劲的量产车型。

如你所料，它有着绝对悦耳的赛车引擎音。

这款车总共只生产了80台，成为了有史以
来最为稀有和最引人关注的兰博基尼车型之一。

catch.en: The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."
catch.zh: 只生产80辆的限量车款，也被称为“终极Diablo”。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."

Based on the Diablo GT2—a full race car built for FIA GT championships—the Diablo GT was a street-legal version that had been detuned and modified for road use. Its 6.0-liter V-12 engine produced 567.1 HP and 462.9 ft-lb of torque. Weighing in at just 3285 lbs—88 lbs lighter than the Diablo SV—the GT was capable of reaching an astonishing top speed of 210 mph.

Weighing in at just 3285 lbs—88 lbs lighter than the Diablo SV—the GT was capable of reaching an astonishing top speed of 210 mph.

brandCentral.en:
The Gallardo series occupies a very important place
in Lamborghini’s history.

Up to the late-1980s, Lamborghini’s lineup included
a mid-engine V8 entry model.

To differentiate these from the legendary V12s,
fans affectionately called them ‘baby Lambos.’

When the Gallardo finally came on the scene,
it broke the baby Lambo mould.

A mid-engine V10 with all-wheel drive...

The Gallardo was distinguished by its chassis performance
under the high-power strain 500 hp-speed.

It was also the first car in Lamborghini’s history to sell
over 10,000 units.
brandCentral.zh:
Gallardo系列在Lamborghini的发展史上具有里程碑式的
意义。

直至20世纪80年代末，Lamborghini的产品阵容中一直
会有一款中置V8引擎的次旗舰车型存在。

为了与该品牌标志性的V12车型区分，车迷们亲昵地
称这些V8车型为“小Lambo”。

然而，Gallardo的问世彻底颠覆了人们对“小Lambo”的
固有印象。

这款搭载中置V10引擎并配备全轮驱动系统的超跑……

以其拔尖的底盘调校而著称，即便在500马力的强大动
力输出下，仍能提供卓越的操控性。

Gallardo还是Lamborghini品牌历史上首款突破10000辆
销量的车型。

usedCar.en:
The Gallardo was the first car by Lamborghini
to be powered by a V-10 engine.

While Lambos were generally known for having V-12s under their
hoods, the Gallardo proved to be extremely popular.

In fact, it became the first Lamborghini production car
to sell more than 10,000 units!

This LP 560-4 was introduced in 2008, five years after
the original Gallardo made its debut.

The LP 560-4 boasted a larger engine, more power
and lighter body.

It even looked different than its predecessor. Indeed, the
LP 560-4 was a better car in every sense of the word.
usedCar.zh:
Gallardo是Lamborghini历史上第一款采用V10引擎
提供动力的车型。

尽管不是品牌赖以成名的V12车型，但它的人气和
知名度也丝毫不逊色。

要知道，这可是Lamborghini第一款卖出超过10000台
的量产车型。

这辆LP 560-4新版本于2008年发布，也就是2003年
初代Gallardo推出的五年之后，

拥有更大的排量、更强的动力以及更轻的车身。

它与前代车型的外观也略有不同，因此从各个角度来说，
LP 560-4都呈现出了全面的升级进化。

catch.en: No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.
catch.zh: 不再是Lambo的小号，Gallardo以顶级的性能甩掉了这个绰号。

vehicleCollection.en:
No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.

Released in 2008, the Lamborghini Gallardo LP 560-4 delivered a 39.4 HP boost over its predecessor. It retained the 4-wheel-drive system but introduced a new 6-speed E-gear transmission, offering gear shifts 40 percent quicker than before. Weight was also trimmed, bringing the body down to 3108 lbs, while top speed rose to 201.9 mph. With its sleek design and elevated performance, it embodied the peak of refined speed.

long.en: Released in 2008, the Lamborghini Gallardo LP 560-4 delivered a 39.4 HP boost over its predecessor. It retained the 4-wheel-drive system but introduced a new 6-speed E-gear transmission, offering gear shifts 40 percent quicker than before. Weight was also trimmed, bringing the body down to 3108 lbs, while top speed rose to 201.9 mph. With its sleek design and elevated performance, it embodied the peak of refined speed.

conversation.en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the years
But when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...
...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!
It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.
And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.
The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.
But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.

The FIA Group GT3 series is one of the most popular forms

A 6-speed sequential gearbox transfers power

While it retained the aluminum and carbon fiber hybrid construction of the road car, the body width was increased. Numerous aerodynamic enhancements were added, giving it a more aggressive and purposeful appearance.

vehicleCollection.en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

The Huracán was unveiled in 2014 as the replacement for the Gallardo. Its construction shifted from an aluminum space frame to a hybrid structure of aluminum and carbon fiber, resulting in a 50 percent increase in rigidity and a 10 percent reduction in weight. Positioned amidships, the 5.2-liter V-10 engine delivered 601.6 HP and 412.3 ft-lb of torque. Power was routed through a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and sent to the pavement via the Haldex 5 all-wheel-drive system.

conversation.en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.

The debate surrounding this car is about the
identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.

The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.

Howevr, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.

Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-er mid-engine mborgini
was a car that looked this amazing.

nd it was entered in the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance

vehicleCollection.en:
This car put Lamborghini on the supercar map and defined the genre.

Lamborghini’s first supercar, the Miura P400, debuted in 1966 and marked a revolutionary leap in automotive design—catapulting the brand onto the global stage. This groundbreaking machine was the result of a collaboration between industry legends: Marcello Gandini, then chief designer at Bertone; Gian Paolo Dallara, who engineered the chassis; and Paolo Stanzani, who would go on to create the Countach.

conversation.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.

Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.

It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.

Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.

This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.

The Urus was the first SUV to be designed by

With its AWD system that excels on the roughest of roads,

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.

Introduced in 2018, the Urus was Lamborghini’s high-performance SUV. It marked the brand’s first use of forced induction, powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.6 seconds, and reaching a top speed of 189.5 mph—a record at the time of its debut. Equipped with active air suspension, rear-wheel steering, and a torque vectoring system, it delivered exceptional handling and cornering capabilities uncommon in vehicles of its class.

long.en: Introduced in 2018, the Urus was Lamborghini’s high-performance SUV. It marked the brand’s first use of forced induction, powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.6 seconds, and reaching a top speed of 189.5 mph—a record at the time of its debut. Equipped with active air suspension, rear-wheel steering, and a torque vectoring system, it delivered exceptional handling and cornering capabilities uncommon in vehicles of its class.

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.

The Veneno was a special limited-edition model created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Lamborghini’s founding. Only three units were ever sold to the public. Based on the Aventador and sharing its chassis and powertrain, the Veneno featured an uprated engine producing 739.6 HP, while weight was reduced through enhancements such as a carbon-fiber monocoque. As a result, the Veneno was 276 lbs lighter than the Aventador, with a total weight of just 3197 lbs.

Based on the Aventador and sharing its chassis and powertrain, the Veneno featured an uprated engine producing 739.6 HP, while weight was reduced through enhancements such as a carbon-fiber monocoque. As a result, the Veneno was 276 lbs lighter than the Aventador, with a total weight of just 3197 lbs.

has been further increased to over <200ps>.;

catch.en: This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

vehicleCollection.en:
This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

Following a dominant run of victories in the World Rally Championship, powered by the exceptional performance of the Lancia Delta, Lancia faced rising pressure from a resurgent Toyota team in 1991. In response, the marque developed the ultimate evolution of its rally icon: the HF Integrale Evoluzione. This version not only featured increased engine output but also introduced a reworked front-to-rear power distribution and significantly enhanced handling characteristics. Making its debut in the 1992 WRC season, the Evoluzione extended Lancia’s record-setting streak of consecutive championship victories.

In response, the marque developed the ultimate evolution of its rally icon: the HF Integrale Evoluzione. This version not only featured increased engine output but also introduced a reworked front-to-rear power distribution and significantly enhanced handling characteristics. Making its debut in the 1992 WRC season, the Evoluzione extended Lancia’s record-setting streak of consecutive championship victories.

Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force

team in the WRC.

Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year
and proudly clnched ania is sixt cosecu tte.

从蒙特卡洛开始，它在那年赢得了a场比赛，
荣地为蓝旗亚捧起六连冠奖杯。

cars.nameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
cars.nameZh: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92

collection.en:
Lancia is well known for its elegant Italian designs
and is equally famous for its motorsports prowess.

It has produced great rally machines like the Fulvia and
Stratos, as well as the Delta, which competed in Group A.

The Delta made its stunning WRC debut in 1987, when
it racked up 9 wins to become the season champion.

As development on the car continued, innovative technology
was regularly added to it.

What do you think of its bulging blister fender? Does it not
express the wild ferocity of a genuine fighting machine?

Since entering competition in 1992, the HF Integrale has won
six straight manufacturers’ titles.

A true icon of 1990s rally racing, this is a legendary car
whose star has never dimmed.
collection.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
collection.zh:
Lancia以优雅的意大利设计而闻名，在赛车运动方面同样
声名显赫。

它打造了Fulvia、Stratos，以及参加A组别比赛的
Delta等伟大的拉力赛车。

Delta在1987年世界拉力锦标赛中惊艳登场，斩获
总计9场胜利，夺得赛季冠军。

随着Lancia的不断研发，创新技术被持续加诸其上。

基于Delta HF Integrale打造的拉力竞速机器
在1992年首次出战世界拉力锦标赛时，

就创下了连续夺得六届制造商冠军的壮举。

堪称该赛事历史上最伟大的成就之一。

作为90年代拉力赛车的真正标志，
时至今日依然是众人心目中的明星车型。+

catch.en: The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.
catch.zh: Lancia Delta的巅峰之作，连续六届WRC冠军得主

vehicleCollection.en:
The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.

Lancia transformed the Delta into a high-performance machine by introducing 4-wheel drive and adding a turbocharger, resulting in the HF 4WD, which first appeared in the 1987 WRC Group A class. The Delta HF 4WD would later evolve into the legendary Integrale, featuring widened blister fenders and increased engine output. With each passing year, the body and suspension received significant upgrades. Thanks to these developments, the car secured eight victories during the 1992 season, earning its sixth consecutive World Rally Championship title.

long.en: Lancia transformed the Delta into a high-performance machine by introducing 4-wheel drive and adding a turbocharger, resulting in the HF 4WD, which first appeared in the 1987 WRC Group A class. The Delta HF 4WD would later evolve into the legendary Integrale, featuring widened blister fenders and increased engine output. With each passing year, the body and suspension received significant upgrades. Thanks to these developments, the car secured eight victories during the 1992 season, earning its sixth consecutive World Rally Championship title.
long.zh: Lancia将Delta改为四轮驱动并配备涡轮增压器，打造出HF 4WD高性能车型，征战1987年WRC A组赛事。Delta HF 4WD后来再次进化为Integrale，增加了凸起轮拱罩，引擎动力也更强悍。车身和悬挂系统每年都会进行重大升级。凭借这些努力，这款车在92赛季赢得8场比赛，为品牌夺得连续第6个世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

vehicleCollection.zh:

Lancia将Delta改为四轮驱动并配备涡轮增压器，打造出HF 4WD高性能车型，征战1987年WRC A组赛事。Delta HF 4WD后来再次进化为Integrale，增加了凸起轮拱罩，引擎动力也更强悍。车身和悬挂系统每年都会进行重大升级。凭借这些努力，这款车在92赛季赢得8场比赛，为品牌夺得连续第6个世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

collection.en:
The Lancia Rally 037 is one of the iconic Group B
rally cars of the 1980s.

Introduced in the early years of Group B racing, it combined
a mid-engine layout with a rear-wheel drive.

Its spaceframe chassis and powerful mid-mounted engine...

...was reminiscent of Lancia's iconic Stratos rally car.

While 4-wheel drive would become mainstream starting
with the Audi quattro in 1981...

...the rear-wheel-drive Rally 037 claimed the 1983
season series title, besting the competition.

This Evoluzione II was the final spec of the car, which
came equipped with a 2.1-liter powerplant.
collection.zh:
蓝旗亚Rally 037是1980年代B组别拉力赛的
标志性参赛车型之一。

这台结合了中置引擎和后轮驱动布局的拉力车很早就开
始参加B组别比赛。

其空间框架底盘和中置引擎...

让人不禁回想起蓝旗亚标志性的Stratos。

当1981年奥迪quattro的出现带动四轮驱动
成为拉力赛车主流后，

Rally 037仍然顽强地用两轮驱动为蓝旗亚
带来了1983赛季的冠军，尽管是两轮驱动汽车。

这款名为Evoluzione II，是Rally 037的最终规格，
排量提高到了2.1升，冷却系统也得到了改进。

A car that expresses this much strength and beauty
in its appearance...

...is quite revolutionary in the history of car design.

It's a design that you simply cannot imitate.

It's a design that goes beyond something that's simply beautiful,
that's what I find most alluring.

It possesses both a futuristic design theme,
a signature element of Gandini's...

...and styling that truly is car-like. The Stratos is a car that
is defined by both.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
你无法想象一辆汽车究竟是如何表现出这种程度的
力量和美感的。

这是革命性的一台车，

是一个无法被模仿的设计，

更是超越了单纯美学的设计。
我认为这就是其魅力所在。

它既拥有甘迪尼标志性的未来主义设计……

又没有忘记其本源。
确切地说，这辆Stratos是一辆跨越两个世界的车。

He's the legendary car designer from Italy,
Marcello Gandini.

for Carrozzeria Bertone.

He had a hand in the design of cars such as the Countach
and Stratos, and is known all around the world.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
马塞罗·甘迪尼是位来自意大利的传奇设计师，

是Carrozzeria Bertone公司的首席设计师。

Countach和Stratos都是出自这位世界闻名的设计师之手。

conversation.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one persn.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love o add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
G
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？

我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。

事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模{师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。

我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负b不起的天价了。

conversation.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。

那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”
i

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”
i

dialogues.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one persn.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love o add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
G
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？

我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。

事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模{师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。

我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负b不起的天价了。
<

usedCar.en:
The Stratos is a masterpiece of a roadster produced by
Lancia, an esteemed maker of rally cars.

This mid-engine marvel first emerged on the rally scene
in the 1970s.

Its speed and power led to it winning several world
championship titles.

It was styled by Marcello Gandini, a legendary figure
in automobile design.

The engine is the same V6 that's used in Ferrari's Dino 246.

There aren't many cars more magnificent than this,
let me tell you!
usedCar.zh:
Stratos是一款优秀的双座敞篷车，由备受
敬仰的拉力赛车制造商蓝旗亚推出。

这款奇妙的中置引擎车型于20世纪70年代
在拉力赛场上首度亮相。

它的速度和动力使它夺得了多项世界冠军。

这款车的风格设计由汽车设计的传奇性
人物马塞罗·甘迪尼负责。

它的引擎采用了和法拉利Dino 246相同的V6。

要知道，没有多少车的性能能比它更出色了！

catch.en: This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.
catch.zh: 这辆中置引擎跑车以其轮廓鲜明的楔形车身在拉力赛中崭露锋芒。

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.

In 1970, Bertone unveiled the visionary Stratos Zero. The bold, wedge-shaped concept would evolve into the production Lancia Stratos. Built on a rigid monocoque frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels, it housed a 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine. With its exceptionally short wheelbase and razor-sharp handling, it excelled in rally competition.

long.en: In 1970, Bertone unveiled the visionary Stratos Zero. The bold, wedge-shaped concept would evolve into the production Lancia Stratos. Built on a rigid monocoque frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels, it housed a 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine. With its exceptionally short wheelbase and razor-sharp handling, it excelled in rally competition.
long.zh: Bertone于1970年发布了“Stratos Zero”概念车。这款楔形概念车后来以“Stratos”之名正式量产。车身采用刚性单体框架和玻璃纤维外板，搭载2.4升V6双顶置凸轮轴引擎。凭借短轴距带来的卓越过弯能力，它在拉力赛中表现极为出色。

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of the 'LF-LC'? It's a truly beautiful
concept vehicle, unveiled by Lexus in 2012.

It's also the car on which the design of this LC500
was based.

The engine is a naturally aspirated 5L V8—the same one
that's used in the RC F sports model.

Though brimming with low-rev torque, it doesn't sacrifice
anything at the high-rev end.
brandCentral.zh:
您听说过“LF-LC”吗？这台绝美的概念赛车由雷克萨斯在2012年公布。

LC500在设计时也将之作为了参照。

它安装有一台5升自然进气V8引擎，和RC F跑车型号采用
的是同款。

这辆车在低转速时扭矩非常充足，达到高转速区间后也
没有牺牲任何性能。

catch.en: This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.
catch.zh: 这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.

The LC500 is a luxury sports coupe that made its debut at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show. While its design featured sleek, flowing lines, the front and rear overhangs were shortened to accommodate a front mid-engine layout with 2+2 seating. A mix of lightweight materials was used throughout the body, achieving a balance of reduced weight and high structural rigidity.

long.en: The LC500 is a luxury sports coupe that made its debut at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show. While its design featured sleek, flowing lines, the front and rear overhangs were shortened to accommodate a front mid-engine layout with 2+2 seating. A mix of lightweight materials was used throughout the body, achieving a balance of reduced weight and high structural rigidity.
long.zh: LC500是一款豪华跑车，最初在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相。虽然其前悬和后悬进行了缩短，以实现2+2座位的前中置布局，但其依然保留了流畅的轿跑车身设计。另外，它的车身还运用了多种先进材料，在降低车重的同时还提升了刚性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

LC500是一款豪华跑车，最初在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相。虽然其前悬和后悬进行了缩短，以实现2+2座位的前中置布局，但其依然保留了流畅的轿跑车身设计。另外，它的车身还运用了多种先进材料，在降低车重的同时还提升了刚性。

brandCentral.en:
The LFA was the first supercar from Lexus.

Can you believe it took a decade to develop?

It was the result of extensive testing at Nürburgring races,
so you can imagine how well this car performs.

One big feature of this front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive car...

...is that its transmission is positioned
on the rear axle.

This makes it a well-balanced "FR" machine with a rear
transaxle configuration.

Powered by a high-revving naturally-aspirated V-10,
the LFA sounds as sweet as it drives.

It's truly one of Japan’s greatest sports cars!

And while its production run ended more than a decade ago,
its allure never seems to diminish.
brandCentral.zh:
LFA是Lexus打造的第一款超级跑车。

你能想象吗？这款车的开发花费了整整十年时间。

在纽博格林的大量测试最终开花结果，
证明这辆车确实拥有飞一般的速度。

这款引擎前置、后轮驱动跑车的一项主要特点……

就是它的传动系统搭载在后轮轴上……

让它成为了一款采用后驱动桥配置、
前后配重比平衡的前置后驱车。

LFA由一台高转速自然进气V10引擎提供动力，
拥有澎湃震撼的声浪。

毫无疑问，它是日本最伟大的跑车之一！

尽管已经于十年前停产，但它的魅力却不减反增。_

catch.en: This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.
catch.zh: 一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.

This ultimate sports car aimed to carry forward the spirit and performance legacy of the Toyota 2000GT. Its carbon-fiber body was produced through automated processes, and the transaxle and radiator were mounted at the rear to achieve a near-perfect 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution. Under the hood was a 4.8-liter V-10 with a 72-degree bank angle. Its distinctive sound was tuned in collaboration with Yamaha. Only 500 units were produced, making it as rare as it was ambitious.

long.en: This ultimate sports car aimed to carry forward the spirit and performance legacy of the Toyota 2000GT. Its carbon-fiber body was produced through automated processes, and the transaxle and radiator were mounted at the rear to achieve a near-perfect 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution. Under the hood was a 4.8-liter V-10 with a 72-degree bank angle. Its distinctive sound was tuned in collaboration with Yamaha. Only 500 units were produced, making it as rare as it was ambitious.
long.zh: 这款顶级跑车承载着传承Toyota 2000GT辉煌成就与卓越性能的使命而诞生。采用自动化工艺制造的碳纤维车身，变速驱动桥和散热器后置布局，实现了48:52的理想前后配重比例。搭载4.8升V10引擎，采用72度气缸夹角设计。引擎优美的轰鸣声经由乐器制造商Yamaha精心调校打造。全球限量生产500台。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

这款顶级跑车承载着传承Toyota 2000GT辉煌成就与卓越性能的使命而诞生。采用自动化工艺制造的碳纤维车身，变速驱动桥和散热器后置布局，实现了48:52的理想前后配重比例。搭载4.8升V10引擎，采用72度气缸夹角设计。引擎优美的轰鸣声经由乐器制造商Yamaha精心调校打造。全球限量生产500台。

brandCentral.en:
The Lexus RC F is well-known for its GT3 racing variant.

Did you know that the 'F' in the model name stands for the
Fuji Speedway, the home course for Lexus Gazoo Racing?

The naturally aspirated 5.0 L V8 engine allows for smooth
transition to higher RPMs and a pleasant exhaust note.

And the enhanced oil cooler also allows you to get the most
out of your time on the circuit.
brandCentral.zh:
Lexus RC F因其参加GT3组别的赛车而广为人知。

你知道吗，车型名称中的“F”代表富士赛道，后者正
是Lexus Gazoo车队的主场。

自然进气的5.0 升 V8引擎可以平顺过渡到更高的转速，发
出的排气声更是令人心旷神怡，

更有经过强化的油冷却器助您在赛道上取得佳绩。

catch.en: Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.
catch.zh: 即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

vehicleCollection.en:
Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.

The RC F was unveiled by Lexus at the 2014 Detroit Auto Show. At its heart lay a refined version of the 5.0-liter V-8 from the IS F, producing 449.7 HP and 383.3 ft-lb of torque—an increase of 32.5 HP and 10.8 ft-lb more than the original engine. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shifters, the RC F delivered both power and precision. Excluding the LFA, it stood as the most sports-focused model ever introduced in the Lexus lineup.

long.en: The RC F was unveiled by Lexus at the 2014 Detroit Auto Show. At its heart lay a refined version of the 5.0-liter V-8 from the IS F, producing 449.7 HP and 383.3 ft-lb of torque—an increase of 32.5 HP and 10.8 ft-lb more than the original engine. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shifters, the RC F delivered both power and precision. Excluding the LFA, it stood as the most sports-focused model ever introduced in the Lexus lineup.
long.zh: RC F是Lexus在2014年底特律车展上公布的一款高性能双门轿跑。其引擎采用了IS F的5升V8的改良版，能够输出456 PS和53.0 公斤力米，比原版引擎高出了33 PS和1.5 公斤力米。这套动力系统还搭配了一部带换挡拨片的8速自动变速箱。除了LFA之外，这辆车是Lexus产品历史中最强调运动性能的车型。

vehicleCollection.zh:
即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

RC F是Lexus在2014年底特律车展上公布的一款高性能双门轿跑。其引擎采用了IS F的5升V8的改良版，能够输出456 PS和53.0 公斤力米，比原版引擎高出了33 PS和1.5 公斤力米。这套动力系统还搭配了一部带换挡拨片的8速自动变速箱。除了LFA之外，这辆车是Lexus产品历史中最强调运动性能的车型。

brandCentral.en:
This is the Lexus RC F GT3, a car developed with FIA GT3
category races in mind.

It has competed in events like the Japanese Super GT, the US
IMSA Series, and the European GT Series.

And not only has it competed, it has won everywhere it has
appeared! This is a true speed machine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯RC F GT3是针对国际汽联GT3组别而开发的赛车。

它曾经出战过许多赛事，例如日本的Super GT、美国的国际汽车运动协会系列赛，
还有欧洲的GT系列赛等等。

当然，它的参赛可不是为了走个过场，而是在出战的每
一项赛事中都实实在在地获得了胜利！

这才是一辆真正的速度机器应有的样子！%

catch.en: Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.
catch.zh: Emil Frey Racing车队使用的GT3车型。Emil Frey Racing是最早使用Lexus RC F的车队之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

Beginning in 2015, Lexus initiated test competition with a purpose-built race car based on the RC F, using the data and experience gained to refine and evolve the machine. This development culminated in the debut of the RC F GT3 in 2017. Emil Frey Racing, who played a key role in the car's development, campaigned the RC F GT3 in the International GT Open. Its efforts were rewarded with a 3rd-place finish in the team standings.

long.en: Beginning in 2015, Lexus initiated test competition with a purpose-built race car based on the RC F, using the data and experience gained to refine and evolve the machine. This development culminated in the debut of the RC F GT3 in 2017. Emil Frey Racing, who played a key role in the car's development, campaigned the RC F GT3 in the International GT Open. Its efforts were rewarded with a 3rd-place finish in the team standings.
long.zh: 从2015年起，Lexus开始派出一款基于RC F打造的赛车参加比赛，进行测试。他们利用这些测试中积累来的经验，对这部车进行持续性开发，并最终在2017年首次公布了这辆RC F GT3。作为参与了RC F GT3开发工作的车队，Emil Frey Racing带着这款车参加了国际GT公开赛。他们最终在车队排名上取得了第三的好成绩。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Emil Frey Racing车队使用的GT3车型。Emil Frey Racing是最早使用Lexus RC F的车队之一。

从2015年起，Lexus开始派出一款基于RC F打造的赛车参加比赛，进行测试。他们利用这些测试中积累来的经验，对这部车进行持续性开发，并最终在2017年首次公布了这辆RC F GT3。作为参与了RC F GT3开发工作的车队，Emil Frey Racing带着这款车参加了国际GT公开赛。他们最终在车队排名上取得了第三的好成绩。

brandCentral.en:
The Lexus RC F GT3 is a race car specifically developed
to wage war in the popular FIA GT3 series.

While the car was expected to be competitive, it was still behind
the others in development...or so people thought.

This race car made a name for itself in Race 9 of the 2016
Nürburgring Endurance Series, surprising everyone.

Despite competing as a prototype, it finished first
in its class.

The victory was also the first of its kind for a Japanese
automobile in the series.

Needless to say, this model has become a major piece
in the history of Toyota racing.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Lexus RC F GT3是一辆专为满足FIA GT3规则所开发的原型车。

它因为在某场比赛中的优异表现而一夜成名。

具体是哪场比赛呢？那当然就是2016年纽博格林24小时耐
力赛的第九场！

catch.en: This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.

The RC F GT3 is a GT3-spec race car developed from the Lexus RC F, created as a prototype prior to official homologation to evaluate and refine its performance. In its early testing phase, the car claimed victory in Round 9 of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series). At the time, it competed in raw carbon-fiber bodywork, but the version shown here is adorned in the distinctive Emil Frey Racing livery.

long.en: The RC F GT3 is a GT3-spec race car developed from the Lexus RC F, created as a prototype prior to official homologation to evaluate and refine its performance. In its early testing phase, the car claimed victory in Round 9 of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series). At the time, it competed in raw carbon-fiber bodywork, but the version shown here is adorned in the distinctive Emil Frey Racing livery.
long.zh: RC F GT3是Lexus基于RC F开发的一款GT3规格赛车。这辆车就是在认证版本正式定型之前，为了测试性能而开发的原型车。它在纽博格林耐力赛的第九轮中取得了漂亮的胜利。当时它以无涂装的碳纤维裸色车身参赛，不过我们在这里看到的这个版本采用了Emil Frey Racing车队的涂装。

conversation.en:
This Lexus RC F competes in Japan's top racing category,
Super GT.

It made it debut in...2014, I think.

This one is the 2016 spec. I have fond memories of seeing
it in action!

It lost the first four races to the Nissan GT-R, but then
made a stunning comeback after changing the engine!

By the end of the season, it had managed to claw its way up
to fifth place in the rankings.

As it happens, that season's championship was won by another
RC F, number 39!
O

conversation.speaker: Jeremy

这辆Lexus RC F参加了日本的顶级赛事Super GT。

这款车应该是在……2014年首次亮相的。

这辆车是2016年的型号。它在赛场上驰骋的样子仍能令我心潮澎湃！

这辆车在前四场比赛中输给了Nissan GT-R，
但在更换引擎之后，它上演了一场惊人的反击战！

在赛季结束时，它已经成功地爬到了第五的位置。

碰巧的是，该赛季的冠军是由另一辆车号为39的RC F赢得的！

This is the Lexus au TOM'S RC F, the GT500 which won the
2016 Japan Super GT Series.

It's equipped with a race-tuned 2L straight-four engine.

2016 was the RC F's final year in the Super GT Series.

The LC 500 has since replaced the RC F as Lexus's flagship
Super GT contender.
