catch.en: This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.
catch.zh: 这款Toyota/Lexus Super GT赛车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.

The Lexus RC F competed in the Super GT GT500 class from 2014 to 2016. New regulations introduced that year required the monocoque and key components to be shared with DTM counterparts. It ran the same turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 used in Super Formula competition. In 2016, the au TOM’S RC F scored points throughout the season, including a 2nd place finish in Round 6, ultimately placing 5th overall in the standings.

long.en: The Lexus RC F competed in the Super GT GT500 class from 2014 to 2016. New regulations introduced that year required the monocoque and key components to be shared with DTM counterparts. It ran the same turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 used in Super Formula competition. In 2016, the au TOM’S RC F scored points throughout the season, including a 2nd place finish in Round 6, ultimately placing 5th overall in the standings.
long.zh: Lexus RC F参加了2014年至2016年期间的Super GT GT500组别赛事。2014年引入的新规意味着单体车壳和主要部件的重量要与德国房车大师赛车辆等同。而使用的引擎也是Super Formula赛车同款，为2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。au TOM'S RC F在2016年整个赛季中有大笔积分入账，包括在第6轮中取得了第2名，赛季总成绩位列第5位。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款Toyota/Lexus Super GT赛车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

Lexus RC F参加了2014年至2016年期间的Super GT GT500组别赛事。2014年引入的新规意味着单体车壳和主要部件的重量要与德国房车大师赛车辆等同。而使用的引擎也是Super Formula赛车同款，为2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。au TOM'S RC F在2016年整个赛季中有大笔积分入账，包括在第6轮中取得了第2名，赛季总成绩位列第5位。

The foundation for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4
race car was the Lexus RC F.

A few tweaks made this thing faster on the straights.

Not hard to do when you start with a powerful

If you want to stand out in a crowd, like we do, we suggest

因为它的V8引擎可以输出强大的扭矩，提供犀利的瞬间
加速性能。

这辆标志性的Lexus特殊车型还提供了炫酷的橙色版本。

This version of the highly refined Lexus RC F production coupe was modified for Gr.4.

This Gran Turismo Original is a race-prepared version of the Lexus RC F coupe, specifically modified for Gr.4 competition. Harnessing the immense torque of its large-displacement V-8, the car delivers exceptional straight-line acceleration. Its base color is finished in the signature orange used by Lexus for its exclusive special models.

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at American
car companies, such as GM's Opel and Ford.

He's also known by his English nickname, "Kuni Ito."

He's quite experienced in production-design and served as a
professor at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit.

他在汽车制造设计领域拥有非常丰富的经验，
并在底特律的创意设计学院担任教授。

conversation.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
conversation.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。

其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。

该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。

作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。

conversation.en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430
was a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upn a coupe body!
j

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯SC430是丰田为……

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。

在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。

顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其{是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。

换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500_实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

vehicleCollection.en:
Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.

This Super GT race car competed during the 2008 season. To enhance aerodynamic efficiency, both the front and rear overhangs were extended, and its compact body proved highly effective on high-speed circuits. Although it didn’t claim any outright wins, its consistent performance throughout the season earned enough points to secure the team title.

long.en: This Super GT race car competed during the 2008 season. To enhance aerodynamic efficiency, both the front and rear overhangs were extended, and its compact body proved highly effective on high-speed circuits. Although it didn’t claim any outright wins, its consistent performance throughout the season earned enough points to secure the team title.
long.zh: 这是一辆曾参加过2008赛季的Super GT赛车。根据前一年度积累的经验，工程师们将它的车头和车尾加长，以有效优化空气动力学性能，而它的紧凑型车身也能在高速赛道上发挥出色。尽管它并没能拿下任何一场比赛的胜利，但确保了整个赛季持续有积分入账，最终赢下了车队冠军头衔。

brandCentral.en:
The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT is a race car straight out
of fantasy.

It comes equipped with naturally-aspirated 4-rotor engine...

...that's based on the R26B, which was used to power
the legendary Mazda 787B.

And it produces <500ps>!

The car that served as the foundation for this machine
was the RX-VISION, unveiled in 2015.

Ultra-high revs and a unique high-pitched rotary sound
combine to provide a truly thrilling ride.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT赛车诞生自马自达无穷无极的创造力。

它的自然进气四转子引擎基于R26B开发，

也就是最初用于马自达787B的那台引擎。

超高的转速和独特的高音转子声合二为一，为驾驶者提
供非比寻常的驾驶体验。

那么它的动力如何呢？轻轻松松就能超过<500ps>！

这款车的基础车型是RX-VISION，在2015年初次亮相。

catch.en: Mazda's dream rotary race car.
catch.zh: Mazda的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The RX-VISION concept was introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. The base car’s elegant proportions have been reimagined with a more aggressive, motorsport-focused edge. To meet the performance demands of the Gr.3 class, the lightweight body houses a 4-rotor engine, drawing inspiration from the legendary 787B powerplant, revived through cutting-edge SKYACTIV technology to deliver unprecedented levels of power and responsiveness.

long.zh: MAZDA RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。原车设计的美感在赛车化改造中得到了更加激进的重新诠释。为满足Gr.3组别的动力需求，轻量化车身搭载了4转子引擎，其设计灵感源自经典787B引擎，采用最新SKYACTIV技术重新打造，带来前所未有的性能表现。

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING? It’s a new brand born
of Mazda’s exceptional achievements in motorsports.

One car that embodied the full extent of Mazda’s racing
expertise was the MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster,
although beneath the surface it was something totally different.

The 2.0-liter engine is a rarity in Japanese soft-tops—featuring
hand-assembled heads and pistons.

In terms of power, it pushed th boundaries of what a
production car could achieve, with <200ps>.

Its chassis was reinforced, the suspension used height-adjustable
Bilstein dampers, and the brakes supplied by Brembo.

Alas, production was limited to just 200 units. A true works-tned
roadster, it was a rare and shining gem.
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过MAZDA SPIRIT RACING吗？
这个全新品牌源自Mazda在赛车领域的非凡成就。

MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R正是一款
凝聚了Mazda所有赛车技术的集大成之作。

顾名思义，它基于ND Mazda Roadster打造，
但其内部构造却焕然一新。

这台2升引擎在日本敞篷跑车中极为罕见，
配备特制气缸盖和活塞，全部由手工组装。

在动力性能方面，它将量产车规格推向极致，
可爆发出<200ps>的强劲动力。

底盘刚性十足，悬挂采用高度可调的Bilstein减震器，
刹车系统则来自Brembo制造。

遗憾的是产量仅限200台！
相信我，这款经过厂队调校的敞篷跑车堪称稀世珍品！

catch.en: With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.
catch.zh: 这是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车，全球限量仅200台。

vehicleCollection.en:
With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.

This machine was created by Mazda Spirit Racing, an initiative launched in 2021 to embody Mazda’s motorsport ambitions. Although derived from the ND Roadster, it has a 2.0-liter block not typically offered on Japanese soft-top models, distinguished by specially developed camshafts, a bespoke cylinder head, forged pistons, and a custom exhaust manifold. This delivers an output of 197.2 HP, a figure that stands near the upper limit of what remains practical in a production car. Additional refinements were made throughout the chassis, drawing upon the wealth of expertise Mazda had accumulated through years of Super Endurance racing.

Additional refinements were made throughout the chassis, drawing upon the wealth of expertise Mazda had accumulated through years of Super Endurance racing.
long.zh: 这台车由MAZDA SPIRIT RACING打造——该项目于2021年启动，旨在展示Mazda的赛车运动实力。虽然基于ND Roadster打造而成，却搭载了日本软顶车型上不常见的2.0升引擎，配备专门设计的凸轮轴、气缸盖、活塞和排气歧管。最终实现200 PS的惊人动力，这一数据已逼近量产车型工程设计的极限。底盘整体调校充分借鉴了公司在超级耐力锦标赛中的丰富经验。

^

conversation.en:
I actually drive this MAZDA3 race car
in Japan’s Super Taikyu Series.

Naturally, the MAZDA3 was a production model first, but it
was also designed with racing in mind.

When it came to the racing variant, I tried to retain as much
of the original’s form as possible.

My aim of preserving the beauty and silhouette of the car
extended to the livery.

I also wanted to ensure that it looked good on the track.

I achieved this by giving it a wide rear axle, the kind
expected of a Super Taikyu car.

As a result, it looks very striking when overtaking.

So if you ever meet me on the track, be sure to let me
by, andyo'l see why!
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。

所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。

当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！

所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰cT我，可得|让。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

conversation.en:
Thank you for that great story, Maeda-san!

catch.en: Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.
catch.zh: 下一代生物燃料赛车，继续发掘内燃机的潜力。

vehicleCollection.en:
Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.

This GT Original draws inspiration from the MAZDA3 Bio concept that competed in the ST-Q class of Japan’s Super Endurance Series. It runs on next-generation 100-percent biodiesel fuel derived from waste cooking oil. The body also incorporates environmentally friendly hybrid materials. This ambitious project aims to merge carbon neutrality with top-tier race car performance.

long.en: This GT Original draws inspiration from the MAZDA3 Bio concept that competed in the ST-Q class of Japan’s Super Endurance Series. It runs on next-generation 100-percent biodiesel fuel derived from waste cooking oil. The body also incorporates environmentally friendly hybrid materials. This ambitious project aims to merge carbon neutrality with top-tier race car performance.
long.zh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的设计灵感源自曾征战日本超级耐力锦标赛ST-Q组别的“MAZDA3 Bio concept”概念车。该车采用从废弃食用油中提取的新一代100%生物柴油作为燃料。车身同样采用了环保型复合材料。这一雄心勃勃的项目致力于在赛车运动中实现碳中和与顶级竞技性能的完美融合。

conversation.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a ‘fastback’.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
‘burgundy selection’ grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
grade is done up in a most distinctive shade of red.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。

以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。

另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

conversation.en:
The MAZDA3 is among the five most defining cars
of my career.

Its design dates back to the RX-VISION.

With the RX-VISION, I created a form that ‘came alive’
through its beautiful reflective surfaces.

The MAZDA3 echoes the RX-VISION’s form
in its C-segment.

A personal favourite of mine, it is a car that will surely
go down in history.
#
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh:
马自达3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。

我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。

而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。

我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

brandCentral.en:
This MAZDA3 fastback is especially prized
for its beautiful design.

In Japan, it has long been referred to as the Axela.

But ever since the debut of this fourth-gen model in 2018,
it has been known around the world as the MAZDA3.

Distinguished by its phenomenal styling, which adopts Mazda’s
"KODO" design language...

...this hatchback, with its beautiful roof line,
is referred to as a fastback in some markets.

In 2020, it won the World Car Design of the Year title,
an award celebrating the best international car design.
brandCentral.zh:
斜背版MAZDA3因其靓丽的设计造型而深受消费者喜爱。

在日本，这辆车被称为“Axela”（昂克赛拉）。

不过随着第4代型号于2018年亮相，它在全世界
打响了“MAZDA3”这个名号。

它那现象级的外观设计充分体现了Mazda的“魂动”
设计语言，优雅而独树一帜……

这款掀背车拥有美妙的车顶线条，并以“斜背车”的身份
在部分市场展开宣传。

在2020年，这款车赢得了国际性的汽车设计奖项——
世界汽车年度最佳设计大奖。

catch.en: An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.
catch.zh: 采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.

The fourth-generation MAZDA3 made its debut in 2018. A standout addition to the lineup was the mild hybrid M Hybrid, which gained global attention for its SKYACTIV-X engine, utilizing spark-controlled compression ignition. The X Burgundy Selection is a limited-edition variant based on the X grade, featuring the advanced SKYACTIV-X powertrain paired with a rich burgundy interior, offering a mature sense of elegance.

long.en: The fourth-generation MAZDA3 made its debut in 2018. A standout addition to the lineup was the mild hybrid M Hybrid, which gained global attention for its SKYACTIV-X engine, utilizing spark-controlled compression ignition. The X Burgundy Selection is a limited-edition variant based on the X grade, featuring the advanced SKYACTIV-X powertrain paired with a rich burgundy interior, offering a mature sense of elegance.
long.zh: 第四代MAZDA3于2018年正式发布。随后推出的轻混动力“M Hybrid”车型搭载采用火花控制压燃技术的“SKYACTIV-X”引擎，引起全球瞩目。这款“X Burgundy Selection”限量版基于搭载SKYACTIV-X引擎的X级别车型打造，酒红色内饰营造出成熟典雅的氛围。

brandCentral.en:
If I had to describe the Mini Clubman Vision Gran Turismo
in simple terms, it would be "battle-ready."

The car sits much wider and lower to the ground than the
classic model, looking ready to attack the race track.

Indeed, that's what it was created to do. Maximum performance
is ensured with lots of aerodynamic features.

And it's lightweight. It tips the scales at <1050kg> and comes
powered by an impressive engine that produces <400ps>.

Also, its full-time 4WD drivetrain provides plenty
of stability.
brandCentral.zh:
如果要用一个词来形容MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo，我会用
“蓄势待发”来形容！

此车带有MINI的标志性设计，但比经典车型更宽，离地间
隙更低。

这是因为此车是为赛道设计的，具备扁平化底板等空气
动力学特性。

其<1050kg>的轻盈车身由一台可提供约<400ps>动力的强劲引擎驱动……

而全时四驱系统则负责提供充足的稳定性。

catch.en: A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-62.1 mph in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of 180.2 mph.
catch.zh: 竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.en:
A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-62.1 mph in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of 180.2 mph.

This Vision Gran Turismo represents a MINI built purely for racing. Weighing just 2315 lbs and producing 389.5 HP, it launches from zero to 62.1 mph in a mere 3.5 seconds. Power is sent to all four wheels. Its low-slung silhouette—with the wheels pushed to the very edges—delivers the signature go-kart-like handling MINIs are known for. The result is an exhilarating, track-ready driving experience.

long.en: This Vision Gran Turismo represents a MINI built purely for racing. Weighing just 2315 lbs and producing 389.5 HP, it launches from zero to 62.1 mph in a mere 3.5 seconds. Power is sent to all four wheels. Its low-slung silhouette—with the wheels pushed to the very edges—delivers the signature go-kart-like handling MINIs are known for. The result is an exhilarating, track-ready driving experience.
long.zh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo车型向我们展示了专为竞速打造的Mini会是什么样的。它拥有1,050 公斤的超轻量车身和395 PS的动力性能，在仅仅3.5秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。其传动系统会向全部四个车轮输出动力。它的车身轮廓极低，几乎像是俯卧在地面上，四个车轮也已经向两侧外扩到了极限，这样的设计让它实现了类似卡丁车的极致操控性能，这也是Mini品牌赖以闻名的特点，更为驾驶者提供了无与伦比的驾驶体验。

conversation.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。

1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。

直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。

Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。
F

conversation.en:
Stylistically and proportionately, the 2005 MINI Cooper S
is the best of its breed!

I loved these when they first came out, and I still
love them to this day!

Note the minimal overhang and simple profile,
the low beltline and all-around visibility.

All of the car’s horizontal lines were drawn
in parallel to each other.

These were the days when the MINI designers
seemed to have more vision!

These cars looked amazing in a variety of livery,
roof colours and decals.

Then there was that round central screen inside.

Ah yes, the MINI just screamed fun!
|
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！

你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！

无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！

conversation.en:
Thank you for that insightful piece of history!
h
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
感谢您给我们分享了这么有趣的故事！
"

brandCentral.en:
BMW obtained the rights and resurrected the popular
British car known as the Mini in 2001.

The folks at BMW were careful to keep the car's signature
compact boxy design intact.

This particular model is the high-performance Cooper S.

It boasts a peppy supercharged 1.6-liter inline-4 engine.

Thanks to its rigid chassis and solid structure, this car
has the feel of a go-kart when you push it to it limits.
brandCentral.zh:
BMW的第一代Mini早在2001年就进入了市场……

并立即因经久不衰的标志性设计而表现得卓尔不群。

这款特殊的车型是Cooper S，主打高性能……

此车拥有一台轻巧的1.6L直列四缸机械增压发动机。

除了悬挂相当硬外，它的驾驶感受几乎和卡丁车一样，
颇有乐趣！

usedCar.en:
BMW poured their heart and soul into the development of
this R50 Mini.

This version has an FF layout, which in our world stands
for front-engine/front-wheel drive.

Like its predecessor, this car is light and agile, able to
tackle the sharpest of corners like a rail car.

The engine in this Cooper S comes with a supercharger...

...meaning it delivers excellent power at <170ps> with
plenty of pop in both low- and mid-rpm ranges. x
usedCar.zh:
R50 Mini是BMW生产的新世代Mini Hatch的
首款车型。

这辆车采用了前置前驱布局。

它继承了前代车型轻便、灵活的特性，
能轻松应对急弯。

这一Cooper S款还额外安装了机械增压装置，
进一步提升了性能。

它中低转速区间的出力
定能让你大吃一惊！

catch.en: This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.
catch.zh: MINI的热门车型，配备了机械增压引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.

This was the hot hatch version of the new MINI developed after BMW’s takeover. Its 1.6-liter inline-4 was supercharged to produce 167.7 HP and 159.1 ft-lb of torque, an increase of 53.3 HP and 50.6 ft-lb over the base Cooper. Paired with an exclusive 6-speed manual transmission, the car delivered pure driving fun in a compact, spirited package.

long.en: This was the hot hatch version of the new MINI developed after BMW’s takeover. Its 1.6-liter inline-4 was supercharged to produce 167.7 HP and 159.1 ft-lb of torque, an increase of 53.3 HP and 50.6 ft-lb over the base Cooper. Paired with an exclusive 6-speed manual transmission, the car delivered pure driving fun in a compact, spirited package.
long.zh: 这款车型是Mini在被BMW收购之后推出的全新高性能掀背车。它的1.6升直列四缸引擎配备了机械增压器，能够输出170 PS/22.0 公斤力米的动力，高于Cooper的54 PS/7.0 公斤力米。另外，它还采用了一套专用6速手动变速箱，将所有的驾驶乐趣都塞进了紧凑的车身之中。

vehicleCollection.zh:

conversation.en:
The way this car adds an Italian improvisational quality
to its highly refined form is nothing short of impressive.

One thing that the Maserati brothers bequeathed to their
former home when they left it to form O.S.C.A…

Was the straight-six SOHC engine.

This engine was originally fitted to a grand tourer,
which paved the way for the A6GCS.

As if it were a light fabric, the body which covers the four
wheels and drivetrain...

Kept the car’s weight to an absolute minimum.

It is a masterpiece of Fantuzzi design.

Also, you’ll recognise the design language
that connects it to the famed Type 61 Birdcage

It’s a thrilling study, indeed!<ext id=1700706 type=9>
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。

当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。

宛若薄绸v轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。

你可以明显看到的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

catch.en: A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

vehicleCollection.en:
A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

The Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder earned the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 2014 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance. Its elegant aluminum bodywork was crafted by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi, while power came from a 167.7 HP engine designed by Gioacchino Colombo. Raced under the official Maserati factory team, it secured five class victories and three overall wins during the 1954 season.

Raced under the official Maserati factory team, it secured five class victories and three overall wins during the 1954 season.
long.zh: 这辆Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder在2014年圆石滩经典车展中荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。优雅的铝制Spyder车身由Carrozzeria Fantuzzi打造，170 PS的引擎则出自乔亚基诺·科伦坡之手。该车代表Maserati厂队参赛，在1954赛季中夺得5次组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

brandCentral.en:
The sports coupé is an iconic Maserati offering...

And this GranTurismo S was specifically built
to be a high-performance variant.

Not only has its engine displacement been increased
to produce more power and torque...

But it also features a transaxle layout, achieved
by altering the placement of the transmission.

Endowed with both style and substance, this is a car that
definitely means business.
brandCentral.zh:
这款运动型双门跑车极具Maserati的标志性风格……

而这台GranTurismo S是专门以高性能车型为目标的型号。

不仅增加了引擎排量以产生更大的功率和扭矩……

而且还特意改变变速箱的位置，采用了跨轴传动布局。

这是一台风格和内涵兼具，拥有绝对实力的车。

usedCar.en:
Maserati has long represented the standard for luxury Italian
sports cars.

And this model, called the Gran Turismo, inherited
the company's best qualities.

Its sweet-sounding V-8 was assembled by Ferrari...

...and its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive chassis, what we call FR,
possesses lots of race car DNA.

Also, allow me to point out that the transmission was moved
for this S model to ensure optimal weight distribution...

...resulting in absolutely flawless handling, as one
would expect from a Maserati sports car.:
usedCar.zh:
Maserati是意大利豪华跑车实际意义上的
标杆品牌。

这款Gran Turismo更是代表了此公司的
最佳品质。

它所搭载的V8引擎做工精细，由Ferrari组装……

其后驱底盘的制造也是
不计成本的。

此外，S型的传动位置也作了更改，
以达成理想的前后重量分布。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比——延续Maserati的
一贯风格。

vehicleCollection.en:
True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.

This was the high-performance variant of the GranTurismo, introduced at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show. Its DOHC V-8 engine had its displacement increased to 4.7 liters, while the transmission and rear differential were integrated into a transaxle layout. It also became the first in the series to adopt the two-pedal semi-automatic MC Shift system.

It also became the first in the series to adopt the two-pedal semi-automatic MC Shift system.

The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.

The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse,"
meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend
built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.

Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has
been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the250F to sports cars like the
A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.

Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much
these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return
to the track!

sports car that carries on this noble tradition.

Its twin-turbo V-6 engine features an F1-derived
pre-chamber combustion system!

Not only does it offer a smooth ride on city streets,
but it can hold its own on any race track.!

vehicleCollection.en:
A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.

This marked Maserati’s first mid-engine sports car in 15 years, following the MC12. Designed with Dallara, the streamlined body was engineered to generate significant downforce without relying heavily on external aerodynamic elements. At its core was a lightweight carbon monocoque chassis weighing less than 220 lbs, paired with a newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine, featuring F1–inspired pre-chamber combustion.

The Maserati Merak is a fine example of a
beautiful mid-engine supercar from the 1970s.

It was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who
began at FIAT in 1955, then worked at...

...Bertone for six years, and later at Ghia until 1968.

He subsequently established "Italdesign," a design firm
that would create many masterpieces.

The Maserati Merak was created during
Giugiaro’s early Italdesign days.

This stunning new Maserati was introduced at
the 1972 Paris Motor Show.

The Mrak SS is the lighter and more
powerful model that made its debut in 1975.

This 1980 model is powered by a <220ps> version
of the V-6 shared with the Citroën-Maserati SM.

Although the striking Merak has a mid-mounted
engine, it is actually a 22 with small rear seats...

...which is very rare for an exotic high-peormance car.

玛莎拉蒂Merak堪称二十世纪七十年代最优美
的中置引擎超级跑车的样板之一。

它的设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗之手。
1955年，乔治亚罗在菲亚特开始职业生涯，

随后又在博通工作了六年，
然后重回吉亚，继续工作到了1968年。

此后，他自己创办了“Italdesign”，一间在未来
奉献出无数杰作的设计公司。

玛莎拉蒂Merak就是乔治亚罗在“Italdesign”的
早期设计作品之一…8

这辆光采夺目的全新玛莎拉蒂在1972年的巴黎车展上
完成了首秀。

在1975年，更加轻量化、性能更强的Merak SS闪亮登场。

我们眼前的这辆1980车型装备了一台输出<220ps>的V6引擎，

这辆令人惊叹的Mek采用了中WD引g，却实现了“2+2”座位布局，
只是后排座位偏小……

mid-engine supercars of the 1970s.

Introduced in 1975, the Merak SS was the high-performance
grade in the lineup.

This 1980 version of the SS came with a <220ps> V-6 engine.

And, it was true 2+2, meaning although it was a 2-door,
it came with rear seats.

The elegant lines of the car still look fresh today, a testament
to the genius of Giorgetto Giugiaro, who designed the car.

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.

This mid-engine sports car made its debut in 1972 as the sister to the Bora. While the Bora was equipped with a V-8, the Merak utilized a smaller 3.0-liter V-6 sourced from the Citroën SM, allowing a 2+2 seating layout by making use of the extra space freed up in the rear. The SS was a high-performance variant introduced in 1975. By increasing the engine’s compression ratio, output was boosted, raising the top speed from 139.8 mph to 155.3 mph.

conversation.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=

conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的Peugeot 905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如Mercedes-Benz、Jaguar和Porsche等等。

Mazda派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。

在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。

时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。<next id=1900306 typ=9A

conversation.en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.

So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.

This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.

The 4-otor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.

It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.

Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...

...was so dehydratedafter the race that he was unable
to make the podium.

Asʌor th engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it couldhave gneanoter 500kmL

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
“转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！

他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。

这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年q它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。

不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。

赛后，当马自W的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑<50ۏm>！

collection.en:
Do you know about the 1991 Le Mans 24 Hours?

In the final year that rotary engines were allowed to compete,
Mazda defied the odds and won in miraculous fashion.

The winning race car was the 787B, powered by 4-rotor engine,
which outlasted powerhouse rivals like Jaguar and Porsche.

The victory was made even sweeter by the fact that Mazda
became the only Japanese company to win the historic race.

After a bad showing the previous year, no one expected the
787B to do well in 1991, qualiying in 19th position.

However, the Mazda team was undeterred and ran a strategic
and consistent race, taking the checkered flag.

The drivers who accomplished the impossible were Volker Weidler,
Johnny Herbert and Bertrand Gachot.

After the rce, the now-historic No. 55 car was safely stowed
away to be preserved forer.

Then,ʃn 201, the car was restored and returned to Le Mans for a
demo run celebrating the 20h annierary f its ictry.
collection.zh:
您对1991年的勒芒24小时耐力赛了解吗？

那是允许转子引擎赛车参赛的最后一年，
马自达也抓住了机会一举夺魁！

在那场令人震惊的赛事中，这辆编号为55的787B成为了全
场的天皇巨星。

因为马自达此前几年在勒芒屡次出师不利，这场来之不易的
胜利就显得更加的甘美——

1990年，787在比赛中大败而归，而1991年更是因为糟糕的排
位赛表现而只能从19位发车。

但马达车队并未气馁，克服了一切困难，取得了传奇般的
伟大胜利。

这实际上也是勒芒比赛史上第一次由日本赛车夺冠。

获得冠军的55号赛车在赛后被妥善保存。

在2011年它还接受了全面M原，在勒芒故地重游庆祝获胜
20周年的辉煌时刻！]

catch.en: The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
catch.zh: 帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Mazda’s 787B completed the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans without a single mechanical issue, making history as the first Japanese manufacturer to secure an overall win at the event. Mazda, which had entered Le Mans with rotary engines beginning in 1974, developed the 787 as its final bid for rotary-powered victory, before regulations would turn against such powertrains. Although the effort fell short at the 1990 race, the 787 underwent extensive revisions and emerged as the 787B.

long.en: Mazda’s 787B completed the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans without a single mechanical issue, making history as the first Japanese manufacturer to secure an overall win at the event. Mazda, which had entered Le Mans with rotary engines beginning in 1974, developed the 787 as its final bid for rotary-powered victory, before regulations would turn against such powertrains. Although the effort fell short at the 1990 race, the 787 underwent extensive revisions and emerged as the 787B.
long.zh: 1991年，787B成为日本制造商中首台在勒芒24小时耐力赛获得总冠军的赛车，并且全程未出现任何机械故障。Mazda于1974年开始一直使用转子引擎征战勒芒，但由于禁止使用转子引擎的技术规范即将到来，开发787是Mazda在勒芒凭借转子引擎获胜的最后机会。由于787在1990年的比赛中未能实现目标，次年，经过全面改进的787B由此诞生。

Every detail has been considered, right down to how its body
reflects light.!

充分考虑每一处细节，连车身对光线的折射这样的细微

This is a Gr.3 homologation model of the Atenza, derived from Mazda’s global market sedan and adapted to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. Engineered as a true race machine, it has been transformed into a high-performance sedan producing more than 400 horsepower. Its design stands out for considering even the flow of reflections across the bodywork.

brandCentral.en:
The third-gen Atenza's handling is in line with Mazda’s
‘Jinba Ittai’ credo: unity between car and driver.

This model is equipped with a 2.2L turbocharged
straight-four diesel engine.

With plenty of torque, the engine has a mighty roar, and
is partnered by a six-speed manual transmission.

By the way, have you heard of Mazda’s Skyactiv Technology?

This line of fundamental engineering is found throughout
the vehicle, from body to engine to chassis.

Indeed, one might say that the entire third-gen Atenza
is the product of this advanced engineering approach.
brandCentral.zh:
第三代Atenza的操控体验非常符合Mazda的“人马一体”理念：
即车辆和驾驶者之间的和谐统一。

这款车型配备了一台2.2升涡轮增压直列四缸柴油引擎

和六速手动变速箱，充足的扭矩让这台引擎的轰鸣声响
彻云霄。

话说，您听说过Mazda的Skyactiv技术吗？

Mazda的这套汽车工程技术贯穿了整辆车的每个部件，从车
身到引擎，再到底盘，无处不在。

可以毫不夸张的说，
第三代Atenza就是集先进的Skyactiv技术于大成的作品。

catch.en: The third-generation Mazda 6 features a flowing body style and SKYACTIV technology.
catch.zh: 第三代Atenza（Mazda 6），车身线条流畅，还拥有SKYACTIV技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Mazda 6 features a flowing body style and SKYACTIV technology.

The third-generation Atenza also came equipped with Mazda’s SKYACTIV-D diesel engine. Nicknamed XD (cross-d), it was offered in three trims, with the L package as the highest specification. Thanks to features like idle-stop and i-ELOOP regenerative braking, SKYACTIV-D models achieved fuel economy figures of 52.7 MPG under Japan’s JC08 test cycle.

long.en: The third-generation Atenza also came equipped with Mazda’s SKYACTIV-D diesel engine. Nicknamed XD (cross-d), it was offered in three trims, with the L package as the highest specification. Thanks to features like idle-stop and i-ELOOP regenerative braking, SKYACTIV-D models achieved fuel economy figures of 52.7 MPG under Japan’s JC08 test cycle.
long.zh: 第三代Atenza搭载Mazda SKYACTIV-D柴油引擎。昵称XD（cross-d），拥有3种配置，L为最高配。利用怠速自动启停功能和i-ELOOP制动动能回收系统等环保方面的改进，配备SKYACTIV-D引擎的车辆在“JC08模式”测试中能够实现4.5 升/百公里的高燃油经济性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代Atenza（Mazda 6），车身线条流畅，还拥有SKYACTIV技术。

第三代Atenza搭载Mazda SKYACTIV-D柴油引擎。昵称XD（cross-d），拥有3种配置，L为最高配。利用怠速自动启停功能和i-ELOOP制动动能回收系统等环保方面的改进，配备SKYACTIV-D引擎的车辆在“JC08模式”测试中能够实现4.5 升/百公里的高燃油经济性。

brandCentral.en:
Modern Mazdas are known for their elegant designs,
and this CX-30 is no exception.

Take a moment to admire its profile—the way the light dances
across its sculpted lines. Stunning, isn’t it?

But the CX-30 is far more than just a pretty face. Beneath that
sleek exterior lies Mazda’s innovative SKYACTIV-X engine.

Capable of burning a very lean air-fuel mixture at high pressure,
it stands as a next-generation engine—clean and efficient.

The X Smart Edition enhances the SKYACTIV-X base package
with a variety of driver-assist features.

Balancing control and comfort, the CX-30 possesses the heart
of a sports car wrapped in a crossover SUV body.
brandCentral.zh:
现代Mazda以优雅的设计著称，这款CX-30更是集大成者。

细致观察它的侧面轮廓和车身光影，是不是令人
叹为观止？

但CX-30的过人之处不仅在于外表。它搭载的SKYACTIV-X引擎
可谓技术卓越。

这款引擎能在高压环境下燃烧极度稀薄的空燃混合物，
堪称高效环保的“新世代动力”。

而X Smart Edition在这一基础上还增添了多项智能
驾驶辅助功能。

在操控性与舒适性之间达到完美平衡，CX-30
为驾驶者带来超乎想象的愉悦体验。

catch.en: This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.
catch.zh: 这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的Mazda跨界SUV。

vehicleCollection.en:
This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.

The CX-30 is a crossover SUV introduced to fill the gap between the CX-3 and CX-5. Although compact in size, it showcased Mazda's signature "KODO" design, evident in its sculpted front end and the way light flowed across its sleek body lines. In 2021, Mazda released the CX-30 X Smart Edition. This version featured the innovative SKYACTIV-X engine, paired with enhanced driver assistance systems and refined pedal feedback.

In 2021, Mazda released the CX-30 X Smart Edition. This version featured the innovative SKYACTIV-X engine, paired with enhanced driver assistance systems and refined pedal feedback.

This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact

conversation.zh: 是我，很高兴见到你们。

conversation.en:
It's so nice to meet you!

As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.

He's famous for leading and managing all
the car designs produced in Mazda!

He's also the father of Mazda's "Kodo Design" philosophy,
and is one of the leading car designers of Japan.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

前田先生以汽车设计师的身份设计过许多公路车型，
包括RX-8和Demio，当然还有许多概念车。

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。

conversation.en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.

This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio
were designed simultaneously.

And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.

So when I first found out that I would be designing
the Demio I was really happy about it!
P
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。

不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！

说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。

所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

conversation.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.

Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...

...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。

与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。

和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和菲亚特500不同……

这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代菲亚特500的现代化演绎。
`

brandCentral.en:
The Demio is Mazda's entry-level model.

This fourth-generation version was introduced in 2014.

Power is supplied by a turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine
that produces <25kgm> of torque.

Because of its predictable handling character, this car is
ideal for novices learning how to race.<
brandCentral.zh:
Demio是Mazda的入门级车型。

这一款2014年推出的车型已经是第四代产品了。

它的动力系统是一台1.5L涡轮增压柴油引擎，可以产生<25kgm>
的扭矩。

凭借绝对可靠的操控性，它成为了赛道新人的不二之选。

usedCar.en:
The fourth-generation Demio, which made its debut in 2014,
is perhaps best known for its diesel engine.

It's a turbocharged 1.5-liter inline-4 developed especially for
compact cars.

It delivers <20kgm> of torque in the low-RPM range that results
in a gratifying sensation when you take off from a standstill.

The car’s stable handling was also a major selling point, thanks
to the wheelbase that’s longer than the previous model.
usedCar.zh:
第四代Demio于2014年首次亮相，
最出名的可能就是它的汽油引擎。

这个1.5升直列四缸涡轮引擎，
专为紧凑型的车款而研制。

在低转速范围内能够超过<20kgm>，
真正运转起来时感觉很棒。

与上一型号相比轴距明显加长，
使其操控更加稳定。

catch.en: This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.
catch.zh: Mazda的紧凑车型，使用柴油引擎，带来远胜于同级别车型的豪华体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.

The Mazda Demio underwent a full model change in 2014, entering its fourth generation with a bold new direction. Adopting Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, it showcased styling sharp enough to rival its European counterparts. One of its standout features was the newly developed turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine, the SKYACTIV-D 1.5. Praised for its excellent fuel efficiency, the diesel variant quickly gained popularity, accounting for more than 60 percent of total orders.

long.en: The Mazda Demio underwent a full model change in 2014, entering its fourth generation with a bold new direction. Adopting Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, it showcased styling sharp enough to rival its European counterparts. One of its standout features was the newly developed turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine, the SKYACTIV-D 1.5. Praised for its excellent fuel efficiency, the diesel variant quickly gained popularity, accounting for more than 60 percent of total orders.

conversation.en:
Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.
It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...

...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.

But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...

...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.

This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

conversation.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车

比的座舱，

还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。

能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for

己的爱车道“晚安”……

里。

conversation.en:
There was this one time when I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"
So, I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas.

I found out that the happy couple owned a red car and a
white car, and met each other at that very club!

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to attend the wedding...

...but a year later, I received a note that they had a
baby togther!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in pink
and sent it to them.

Being able to connect with owners like this is really
gratifying as a designer.

It's the resultof everyone who became involved with this car
being able to share their paion.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车

很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。

可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。

如u没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这KS的美事。

Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.
It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...

...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.

But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...

...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.

This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。

还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，

还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。

能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。
s

dialogues.en:
This is a famous car—I know this one!

I always think it’s so cute when I see one.

And I love how it looks when the headlights pop open!

There are lots of Mazda Roadster fans all around the world, right?

That’s another great thing about this car.
-
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
这是一款很有名的汽车，我认识的！
我一直觉得这辆车非常的可爱

……而且我还喜欢它的大灯翻起来的样子！

Mazda Roadster在全世界有很多粉丝对不对？

这是这款车另一个很酷的地方。

dialogues.en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.

It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner
to wish their car a goodnight.

I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore...
x
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款Roadster成为永不褪
色的设计。

我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……

而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。

我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……
X

dialogues.en:
There was this one time when I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"
So, I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas.

I found out that the happy couple owned a red car and a
white car, and met each other at that very club!

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to attend the wedding...

...but a year later, I received a note that they had a
baby togther!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in pink
and sent it to them.

Being able to connect with owners like this is really
gratifying as a designer.

It's the resultof everyone who became involved with this car
being able to share their paion.
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车

很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。

可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。

如u没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这KS的美事。

usedCar.en:
This little beauty's the perfect choice for an
aspiring sports car driver.

Nice and light, with a decent amount of power—
and the key point is that it's rear-wheel drive!

So it's perfect for those who are still learning the ropes.

The Roadster's got a long history, but the NA is the
original and, some would say, the best!
usedCar.zh:
这辆小美人儿非常
适合入门跑车爱好者。

它外观简洁，车身轻盈，马力适中……
而且还是后驱！

因此，它非常适合还在学习基础的车手。

这款Roadster拥有悠久的历史，但自然进气引擎
才是它最原本的引擎配备。有些人觉得自然进气才是最棒的！

catch.en: Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.
catch.zh: 这款广受欢迎的畅销车型在全球带起了一阵紧凑型跑车的风潮。

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.

This automotive masterpiece marked the revival of the lightweight sports car as the 20th century drew to a close. First introduced in 1989 with a 1.6-liter engine, the model saw its displacement increased to 1.8 liters in 1993. Its true appeal lay in its mechanical purity—the transmission and rear differential were unified by an aluminum powerplant frame, while double wishbone suspension and disc brakes at all four corners delivered precise, responsive handling.

long.en: This automotive masterpiece marked the revival of the lightweight sports car as the 20th century drew to a close. First introduced in 1989 with a 1.6-liter engine, the model saw its displacement increased to 1.8 liters in 1993. Its true appeal lay in its mechanical purity—the transmission and rear differential were unified by an aluminum powerplant frame, while double wishbone suspension and disc brakes at all four corners delivered precise, responsive handling.
long.zh: 这款汽车杰作为20世纪末的轻量化跑车复兴奠定了基础。最初于1989年搭载1.6升引擎首次登场，1993年引擎排量扩大至1.8升。这款车的魅力在于其基础架构，变速箱和后差速器通过铝制动力单元框架相连，四轮均配备双叉臂悬挂和碟刹，成就了直接、灵敏的操控体验。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is a real beauty!

It's the perfect iteration of Mazda's "KODO: Soul of Motion"
design philosophy.

One of the inspirations for its styling was the legendary
787B race car that made history at Le Mans.

The designers attempted to capture the past and future of Mazda
in a single design, and I'd say they succeeded.

Its powertrain is capable of incredible power, efficiency,
and durability.

And who knows? Perhaps a victory at Le Mans is on the cards
for this mean machine too.
brandCentral.zh:
Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo实在是美得不可方物！

此车是Mazda“魂动：Soul of motion”设计理念的
完美示范。

其设计背后的灵感之一是在勒芒赛道上创造历史的
Mazda 787B。

可以说，这个车型成功地在一套设计中捕捉到Mazda的过去
和未来！

其动力系统能够提供令人难以置信的动力、功效和
耐久性。

谁知道呢，也许这个小美人将来也能在勒芒24小时耐力
赛中取得胜利！!

catch.en: A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.
catch.zh: 速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

vehicleCollection.en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo was crafted as Mazda’s futuristic vision of endurance racing excellence, with its sights set on total victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Its striking silhouette was shaped by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, and the front grille echoes the modern face of Mazda’s production lineup with a bold reinterpretation.

long.en: The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo was crafted as Mazda’s futuristic vision of endurance racing excellence, with its sights set on total victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Its striking silhouette was shaped by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, and the front grille echoes the modern face of Mazda’s production lineup with a bold reinterpretation.
long.zh: 这辆Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda对未来的畅想，更是在勒芒24小时耐力赛争冠的赛道机器。这款车的外形轮廓充满动感，其设计灵感来源于Mazda的“魂动”设计哲学，甚至前格栅的形状也是对多年来Mazda量产车的标志性前脸的演绎。

conversation.en:
This car answers the question: ‘What kind of design does
Mazda need to race in the top category at Le Mans?’

The LM55 name stands for ‘Car No. 55 of Le Mans’,
and is taken from a legendary Mazda racer.

I remember putting this car through a full aerodynamic
simulation among other tests.

We hired engineers whose expertise was in racing car
development...

And even made a full-scale model, which is now on display
at the Mazda Museum.

You’ll notice my name is listed as the driver.

This is because, should it ever compete at Le Mans,
I want to be the one to drive it.

The hypercar class regulationsatLeMans allow for a lot
of freedom i design...

So if we were to me a carlieœs andrace it, why,
we ust might win!

设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。

而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入解的工程师支援……

勒芒超PM跑O组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.1 racing car based on the
Mazda LM 55 VGT.

Its lightweight chassis and cutting-edge drivetrain tech
make it a formidable contender in its class.

vehicleCollection.en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

This Gr.1-spec evolution of the LM55 Vision Gran Turismo represents Mazda’s vision of a modern rotary-powered prototype. It delivers the razor-sharp cornering Mazda is known for, enhanced by the exceptional grip of a 4-wheel-drive system. With the ability to dart through corners and surge down straights, it stands as a true modern embodiment of the legendary "rotary rocket."

It delivers the razor-sharp cornering Mazda is known for, enhanced by the exceptional grip of a 4-wheel-drive system. With the ability to dart through corners and surge down straights, it stands as a true modern embodiment of the legendary "rotary rocket."
long.zh: LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda构想的一款现代转子引擎原型车，而这辆车则是它的Gr.1改装版本。这辆车拥有超凡转向性能，不负Mazda的盛名，其四轮驱动系统也能提供强大的牵引力。看到它贴地冲过弯道，在直道上一骑绝尘的样子，你就能明白——这就是“转子火箭”梦想化为现实的样子。

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for a car that handles like it's on rails,
then you can't go wrong with any of the RX-7s.

This second-generation "FC" has a lower center of gravity than
many of its competitors, and it's lighter, too.

Even today, people rave about its amazing on-road prowess,
which comes via its unique rotary engine.

Properly tuned, it'll run circles around some of the
newer models out there today.
usedCar.zh:
想找一辆操控性出色的车子吗？
那么RX-7系列车型肯定适合你。

在第二代“FC”上市时，它的重量更轻，
重心也比当时的竞争者要低。

即使放在今天，这辆车优良的过弯性能
也并不常见。

在经过适当调校后，这辆车完全可以与
最新款的车型一较高下。

catch.en: This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.
catch.zh: 第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.

The FC3S, second generation of the RX-7, made its debut in October 1985. Sporting a sleek, futuristic design, it was shorter than its predecessor but both taller and wider. This new generation also carried an additional 441 lbs of weight. To offset the added weight, the FC3S was fitted with the newly developed 13B rotary engine. Each chamber was enlarged to 654 cc, and with the addition of a turbocharger, the engine delivered a peak output of 182.4 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque.

long.en: The FC3S, second generation of the RX-7, made its debut in October 1985. Sporting a sleek, futuristic design, it was shorter than its predecessor but both taller and wider. This new generation also carried an additional 441 lbs of weight. To offset the added weight, the FC3S was fitted with the newly developed 13B rotary engine. Each chamber was enlarged to 654 cc, and with the addition of a turbocharger, the engine delivered a peak output of 182.4 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque.
long.zh: 第二代RX-7——FC3S——于1985年10月首次亮相。这辆车拥有全新的未来风外观，从车身尺寸上看，它仅在长度方面小于初代车型，但是更高也更宽。这款新车型的重量也增加了200 公斤。为了驱动更重的车身，这辆车配备了一台全新的13B引擎。通过将每个转子缸体的排量扩大到654 立方厘米，并结合一部涡轮增压器，新引擎的性能得到了极大提升，能够输出185 PS的最大动力和25.0 公斤力米的最大扭矩。

vehicleCollection.zh:

cars.nameEn: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
cars.nameZh: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02

brandCentral.en:
The Spirit R was the last of the third generation RX-7s to
be built, and it may just be the best of the lot.

Three different models of the Spirit R were produced.
The Type A, which you see here...

Has two seats, and a manual transmission.

The Spirit R also has an enhanced suspension and braking
system that make for a fantastic driving experience!
brandCentral.zh:
Spirit R是第三代RX-7的最后一款车型，可能也是最优秀的一款。

Spirit R共生产了三种不同的型号。Type A，也就是现在您看
到的这一款……

采用了双座布局和手动变速箱。

Spirit R还对悬挂和刹车系统进行了强化，带来奇妙的驾驶
体验！

usedCar.en:
Those in the market for a rotary-engine car need look no further
than Mazda's RX-7.

This model, the FD3S "Spirit R," was the last RX-7 version
produced.

Its twin-rotor twin-turbocharged Wankel engine—another name
for the rotary engine—can generate up to <280ps>.

The tires and suspension were upgraded, too, and this
"Type A" 2-seater weighed only 2800 lb....

...making it a virtual race car for the street.

Many years have passed since production of the FD RX-7 ended,
but it remains the pinnacle of rotary-engine sports cars.
usedCar.zh:
转子引擎的爱好者会对
这宝贝爱不释手。

FD3S “Spirit R”是RX-7款的最终生产型。

这辆车搭载的双转子双涡轮增压引擎可以产生高达
<280ps>的马力。

它还换装了更好的
轮胎和悬挂。

此外，这辆“Type A”还是辆双座跑车。

虽然早已停产，这款车仍被许多人认为是
转子引擎跑车的巅峰之作。|

catch.en: This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.
catch.zh: RX-7的最后一款纪念车型，25年的历史告一段落。

vehicleCollection.en:
This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.

The FD3S, the third generation of the RX-7, was introduced in December 1991. Its widened body accommodated broader tires for improved grip, while extensive use of aluminum components throughout the chassis brought the weight down to just under 2646 lbs. Although it retained the 13B engine from the FC3S, the FD3S introduced a sequential twin-turbo system, boosting output to 251.5 HP and 217.0 ft-lb of torque. The lightest variant, the Type S, achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 4.97 kg/HP, making it the most potent RX-7 ever produced.

long.en: The FD3S, the third generation of the RX-7, was introduced in December 1991. Its widened body accommodated broader tires for improved grip, while extensive use of aluminum components throughout the chassis brought the weight down to just under 2646 lbs. Although it retained the 13B engine from the FC3S, the FD3S introduced a sequential twin-turbo system, boosting output to 251.5 HP and 217.0 ft-lb of torque. The lightest variant, the Type S, achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 4.97 kg/HP, making it the most potent RX-7 ever produced.
long.zh: FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。虽然为了容纳更宽的轮胎而增加了车身宽度，但通过在车身各部位大量采用铝合金部件，显著减重至接近1,200 公斤。虽然引擎与FC3S同样采用13B转子引擎，但通过序列式双涡轮系统将功率输出提升至255 PS/30.0 公斤力米。最轻量化的Type S车型功率重量比达到4.90 公斤/PS，成为RX-7历史上性能最强的车型。

I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.

If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...

 I was torn because we were going to replace the

vehicleCollection.en:
The final version of the RX-8, Mazda's rotary engine sports car with a unique 4-door layout.

Introduced in 2011, this marked the final special edition of the Mazda RX-8. Built on the 6-speed manual Type RS—equipped with Bilstein dampers—and the 6-speed automatic Type E—offering upscale touches like leather seating—both variants received exclusive interior and exterior enhancements. Initially planned as a 1,000-unit production, strong demand following the announcement of the RX-8’s discontinuation in 2012 prompted Mazda to double the run with an additional 1,000 units.

long.en: Introduced in 2011, this marked the final special edition of the Mazda RX-8. Built on the 6-speed manual Type RS—equipped with Bilstein dampers—and the 6-speed automatic Type E—offering upscale touches like leather seating—both variants received exclusive interior and exterior enhancements. Initially planned as a 1,000-unit production, strong demand following the announcement of the RX-8’s discontinuation in 2012 prompted Mazda to double the run with an additional 1,000 units.
long.zh: 2011年发布，这是Mazda RX-8的最终特别版本。配备Bilstein减震器的6速手动Type RS基础版和配备皮革座椅等豪华配置的6速自动Type E基础版，均采用了特殊的内外饰装备。原计划限量1000台，但由于2012年RX-8停产消息的刺激，销量激增，最终追加生产1000台。

The RX-Vision concept car was first presented at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

Mazda's stated aim when designing it was to create the
world's most beautiful rear-wheel drive sports car.

Its distinctive styling is bursting with life, and is based
on Mazda's 'KODO: Soul of Motion' design theory.

It follows in the footsteps of the Mazda's legendary
787B racing car.|
brandCentral.zh:
这款RX-VISION概念赛车的首次露面是在2015年
的东京车展。

马自达表示，此车的设计目的就是打造出全世界最漂亮
的后驱跑车。

以马自达的“魂动”设计理念为原点，
它那独特的造型充满了生命力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.

This rotary sports-car concept was unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Every unnecessary line and surface were meticulously carved away from its sleek long-nose, short-deck silhouette, revealing Mazda’s purest interpretation of the ideal rear-wheel-drive sports car. Powered by the next-generation SKYACTIV-R rotary engine, this concept offered a bold glimpse into the future of rotary performance.

collection.en:
The Mazda RX-500 is a supercar that is nothing short
of mythical.

Built in 1970 for the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo, known
today as 'Mazda', it debuted at the Tokyo Motor Show.

This RX-500 was conceived as a successor
to the famed Cosmo Sport of the 1960s.

Unlike the Cosmo Sport however, its rotary engine
was not mounted in front but rear-midship...

And was a high rpm type that could rev up to <14000rpm>.

With <250ps> and weighing only <850kg>,
the RX-500 was an extremely fast car.

Only one RX-500 was ever built as a concept model, and
in 2008 it was restored by Mazda to its original glory.
collection.zh:
Mazda RX500是一款神奇的超级跑车。

它于1970年为了纪念Toyo Kogyo（即现在的Mazda）
创立50周年而制造，并在东京车展上展出。

RX500是60年代广负盛名的Cosmo Sport的继任者。

与Cosmo Sport不同的是，它的转子引擎没有安装在前面，而是
采用了中后置布局。

这款转子引擎专为高转速而调校，最高转速高达<14000rpm>。

高达<250ps>的马力配上仅有<850kg>重的车身，RX500的速度快得惊人。

RX500仅有一台概念车存世。在2008年，经Mazda修缮后，它恢复
了往日的神采。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.

This concept car was created to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Mazda’s founding. Its bullet-shaped body was mounted on a steel tube space frame and powered by a 10A-type rotary engine originally developed for the 24 Hours of Spa, delivering around 246.5 HP. Although it appeared publicly in three different body colors, later investigation revealed it was, in fact, a single car repainted for each appearance.

brandCentral.en:
The NR-A is a sports car with a very special place
in Mazda’s Roadster series.

It was developed to be driven on both city streets
and the racing track.

The standard model was equipped with an enhanced drivetrain,
large brake rotors...

And an upgraded suspension system.

It even included a NR-A-branded roll cage and bucket seats,
items required for competition racing.

A Roadster with a long and storied history, the NR-A debuted
in 2002, during the era of the second-gen NB Roadster.

That same year, Mazda launched a one-make party race series
for numbered NR-A grade Roadsters.

The Roadster Party Race continues to be one of Japan’s
most popular race events.
brandCentral.zh:
在Mazda的Roaster系列中，NR-A拥有特殊的地位。

它的设计既考虑了城市街道使用，
也考虑到了赛道比赛。

标准版本就配置了改进后的传动系统、大型碟刹……

以及经过升级的悬挂系统。

甚至还加入了带有NR-A标志的防滚架和桶型座椅
——两者都是正式比赛必备的装备。

NR-A作为一款历史悠久、经历丰富的车型，首发于2002年，
当时在售的MX-5还是第二代型号NB。

同年，Mazda还专门举办了单一车种派对系列赛，
仅限有编号的NR-A Roadster参加。

这一赛事从此延续了下来，并成为了日本最有人气的赛事之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.

This motorsport-focused base model was introduced as part of the fourth-generation Roadster lineup. Its drivetrain was upgraded to meet the demands of track use, complemented by a larger radiator and enhanced disc brakes. The suspension featured height-adjustable dampers supplied by Bilstein. In 2022, the car received Kinematic Posture Control, designed to dramatically improve rear-end stability and cornering composure.

long.en: This motorsport-focused base model was introduced as part of the fourth-generation Roadster lineup. Its drivetrain was upgraded to meet the demands of track use, complemented by a larger radiator and enhanced disc brakes. The suspension featured height-adjustable dampers supplied by Bilstein. In 2022, the car received Kinematic Posture Control, designed to dramatically improve rear-end stability and cornering composure.
long.zh: 第4代Roadster车系中新增的赛车运动基础版本。传动系统升级至赛道驾驶规格，同时配备了更大的散热器和碟刹。悬挂系统配备Bilstein高度可调减震器。2022年进行了进一步升级，新增运动姿态控制系统，大幅提升后部稳定性。

brandCentral.en:
If you're in the market for a rear-wheel drive sports car,
you can't go wrong with this Mazda MX-5.

This fourth generation model is known as the ND.

More than <100kg> lighter than its predecessor, this
popular model is seen as a return to classic form.

The S-segment ND is lightweight—just barely exceeding a ton—
and a joy to drive.
brandCentral.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆后轮驱动的跑车，那么选这款Mazda MX-5
准没错。

这款第四代车型被称为ND。

这台全球热门车型比上一代要轻<100kg>，被视为回归经典的
纯粹之作。

MX-5 ND属于轻量级的S级车，整重只稍微超过一吨，但驾驶乐
趣无穷。\

catch.en: The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight 2183 lbs body and dashing looks.
catch.zh: 第四代Roadster，车体加宽，车重更是低至990 公斤。

vehicleCollection.en:
The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight 2183 lbs body and dashing looks.

The fourth-generation ND Roadster made its global debut in April 2014 at the New York Auto Show. Its compact dimensions, combined with a wide, low stance and elegantly sculpted curves, garnered widespread acclaim when the final design was revealed in September of the same year. Pre-orders commenced in March 2015. The entry-level S grade featured pared-down equipment, and at just 2183 lbs, it stood as the only variant with a curb weight under one ton.

long.en: The fourth-generation ND Roadster made its global debut in April 2014 at the New York Auto Show. Its compact dimensions, combined with a wide, low stance and elegantly sculpted curves, garnered widespread acclaim when the final design was revealed in September of the same year. Pre-orders commenced in March 2015. The entry-level S grade featured pared-down equipment, and at just 2183 lbs, it stood as the only variant with a curb weight under one ton.
long.zh: 第四代“ND”Roadster在2014年4月的纽约车展上盛大亮相。它的车身紧凑短小，但呈现出宽大、低伏的风格，外加优雅的弧线造型，在同年九月一经正式公布便受到全世界范围车迷的交口称赞。这款车于2015年3月开启了预购。其最基础的装饰级别为S级，采用了简化的配置，也是唯一一款重量低于1吨的车型，整备重量仅为990 公斤。

brandCentral.en:
This tuned Mazda MX-5 was based on the
first-generation model.

Nearly every aspect of the car was improved, from its engine
to its upgraded suspension system.

It was also lightened and made more durable.

The changes to its chassis resulted in a more neutral handling
balance, which makes it a blast to drive on the race track.
brandCentral.zh:
这款改装车型基于第一代Mazda MX-5研发而来，

并接受了全方位的优化改造——引擎微调、悬挂升级……

而且还变得更轻、更结实！

与众不同的是，在这样的改造后，它还能够保留中性的
转向特质，因此极为适合在赛道上狂飙突进！

catch.en: A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.
catch.zh: 第一代Roadster，由跑车浪漫旅完成调校。

vehicleCollection.en:
A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.

The Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package) '89 has been specially tuned by Gran Turismo to create this original machine. While the engine and suspension have been enhanced and aerodynamic components added, it faithfully preserves the Roadster’s hallmark "Jinba Ittai," the feeling of unity between car and driver. This spartan lightweight can even hold its own in touring car races.

long.en: The Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package) '89 has been specially tuned by Gran Turismo to create this original machine. While the engine and suspension have been enhanced and aerodynamic components added, it faithfully preserves the Roadster’s hallmark "Jinba Ittai," the feeling of unity between car and driver. This spartan lightweight can even hold its own in touring car races.
long.zh: 这款车以Eunos Roadster（NA Special Package）'89为基础，经跑车浪漫旅特别调校打造而成。引擎和悬挂系统经过改装，并增加了空气动力学套件，但仍保持了Roadster特有的“人车一体”灵敏操控特性。这是一台连房车赛事都能胜任的纯粹赛车。

conversation.en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。

眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。

尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。

而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。

从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。
K

usedCar.en:
The 1990s were a golden age for Japanese sports cars,
the most legendary of which was, perhaps, the RX-7.

This is a 3rd-generation ɛ̃fini RX-7, which debuted in 1991. It’s
sometimes called the 'FD' in a nod to its chassis code.

With its wide body and tyres, the globally-positioned FD could
not be held back by strict Japanese size regulations.

Like its predecessor, it’s powered by a 13B rotary engine, though
with a sequential twin-turbo capable of <255ps>.

Featuring a high-performance double-wishbone suspension, the
FD weighs in <1260kg> and has a <5kg>/hp ratio.

Initially the most extreme model, the Type R was equipped with
a final gear and suspension designed for acceleration.

A breathtakingly beautiful car that hasnpt ge a day, the
FD is a rotary sportscar hero for the history books.
usedCar.zh:
20世纪90年代是日本跑车的黄金时代，
而其中最具传奇色彩的，或许当属RX-7。

眼前这台便是1991年首发的第三代ɛ̃fini RX-7。
车迷们常以其底盘代号“FD”来亲切称呼它。

FD拥有宽体设计与大尺寸轮胎，
其全球化的定位让它得以摆脱日本严苛的尺寸法规束缚。

它继承了前代的13B转子引擎，
但辅以一套可输出<255ps>的串列式双涡轮增压系统。

得益于高性能双叉臂悬架，FDy车重被控制在<1260kg>，
重量推力比达到<5kg>/马力。

作为最初也最极端的版本，Type R车型
配备了专为迅猛加速而调校的终传比与悬架。

FD之美，历久弥新，惊艳如初。
它无疑是转子跑车f上一位值得大书特书的杰出代表。<

catch.en: The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.
catch.zh: 第三代RX-7车型首发，旨在成为一款终极跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.

The third-generation FD3S RX-7 was introduced in December 1991. The Savanna name used on earlier models was retired, with the official name in Japan becoming the ɛ̃fini RX-7. The car carried over the 13B rotary engine from the second generation, but output increased to 251.5 HP with the introduction of a sequential twin-turbo system. Thanks to extensive use of aluminum in components such as the hood, spare wheel, jack and 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension, the FD3S achieved an impressively low curb weight of around 2778 lbs.

long.en: The third-generation FD3S RX-7 was introduced in December 1991. The Savanna name used on earlier models was retired, with the official name in Japan becoming the ɛ̃fini RX-7. The car carried over the 13B rotary engine from the second generation, but output increased to 251.5 HP with the introduction of a sequential twin-turbo system. Thanks to extensive use of aluminum in components such as the hood, spare wheel, jack and 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension, the FD3S achieved an impressively low curb weight of around 2778 lbs.
long.zh: 第三代RX-7，“FD3S”，于1991年12月首次亮相。前代车型命名中的“Savanna”退出舞台，如今该车的日本市场官方名称为ɛ̃fini RX-7。该车和第二代车型一样，采用“13B”式转子引擎，得益于采用了串列式双涡轮布局，最大动力提升至255 PS。此外，引擎盖、备胎、随车千斤顶以及四轮双叉臂悬架部件均大量采用铝合金材质，使整车实现了令人惊叹的轻量化，整备质量约为1,260 公斤。

The McLaren 650S has classic mid-engine proportions,
executed in a very fresh way.

as well as a strong rear.

work together...

Highlighted by the side scoop and side glass shape.
j
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.zh:
McLaren 650S拥有经典的中置引擎比例，
但以一种非常新颖的方式呈现。

它的前脸大胆而独特，车尾设计也风格鲜明。

从车身造型、曲线、表面效果到整体轮廓，无不协调融洽……

侧进气口和侧窗玻璃形状更是将这一特点重点凸显出来。
u

brandCentral.en:
The 650S Coupe was the successor to the McLaren MP4-12C.

Mounted amidships in the lightweight carbon-fiber chassis
was a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8...

...that cranked out a massive <650ps>, which is
reflected in the car's name.

McLaren's patented active suspension was refined even
further to provide neck-wrenching handling.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆650S Coupe是McLaren MP4-12C的后继车型。

3.8L V8双涡轮增压引擎安装在一套轻量化碳纤维底盘的
中部……

可以输出最大<650ps>的动力，因此被命名为650。

McLaren还针对这一型号专门调校了其专利的主动式悬挂系统
的设置。.

catch.en: The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.
catch.zh: 当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.

The McLaren 650S was introduced in 2014. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, inherited from earlier models, was tuned to produce 641 HP and 499.1 ft-lb of torque to match its name. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission for seamless gear changes, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.0 seconds, covered 1312.3 ft in 10.5, and reached a top speed of 206.9 mph.

long.en: The McLaren 650S was introduced in 2014. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, inherited from earlier models, was tuned to produce 641 HP and 499.1 ft-lb of torque to match its name. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission for seamless gear changes, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.0 seconds, covered 1312.3 ft in 10.5, and reached a top speed of 206.9 mph.
long.zh: 650S是McLaren在2014年发布的超级跑车。前代车型的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调校为650 PS/69.0 公斤力米的动力输出，算是“名”副其实。搭配7档双离合变速箱后换挡更加顺畅，该车可在3.0秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，0-400 米所需时间仅为10.5秒，最高时速达333 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.zh:
当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

Based on the 650S, this racing variant was developed in
accordance with FIA GT3 specifications.

It received acclaim after claiming victory at the 2016
Bathurst 12 Hour in Australia.

Numerous improvements have been made since the days of the
MP4-12C, such as the expansion of the front treads.

The front canards and large rear wing are a few of the more
notable additions made to enhance the car's aerodynamics.
brandCentral.zh:
这个赛车版本基于650S开发，符合国际汽联GT3的规范。

在2016年赢得了澳大利亚巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛后，这辆
车收获了业界的广泛赞誉。

相较于MP4-12C时代，这辆车有了大幅的改进，例如扩宽了前
轮轮距。

此外，车身的空气动力学性能也有所提升，增加了前翼
和大尺寸尾翼等套件。

catch.en: The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.
catch.zh: 在凶猛而性感的野兽的排气共鸣声中沉迷。

vehicleCollection.en:
The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.

The 650S GT3 was developed as a full FIA-GT3 compliant race car, derived directly from the production McLaren 650S. While it retained the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, power output was reduced to 493.1 HP to comply with GT3 regulations, similar to the MP4-12C GT3. Additional upgrades included extensive endurance-focused refinements throughout the car. The 650S GT3 earned significant victories in 2015, winning at GT Asia and later claiming top honors at the 2016 Bathurst 12 Hour.

long.en: The 650S GT3 was developed as a full FIA-GT3 compliant race car, derived directly from the production McLaren 650S. While it retained the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, power output was reduced to 493.1 HP to comply with GT3 regulations, similar to the MP4-12C GT3. Additional upgrades included extensive endurance-focused refinements throughout the car. The 650S GT3 earned significant victories in 2015, winning at GT Asia and later claiming top honors at the 2016 Bathurst 12 Hour.

In the virtual world, the 650S inspired a Gran Turismo Original—the Gr.4 version, modeled on McLaren’s mid-tier supercar. Finished in McLaren’s factory racing color, this virtual machine offered well-balanced handling and predictable behavior. Its cockpit elements, fuel cap, and jack points were faithfully modeled after GT3-level race equipment.

served as his benchmark.

The centre-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.

That and the car's short length of <1140mm> are among its
many unique flourishes.

In fact, thanks to a well-executed design, on o its
idiosyncrasies seem strange t all.

F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆

迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不d感。

collection.en:
Is the McLaren F1 the greatest supercar of them all?
Quite possibly.

McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted
to enter the road car business...

But died in 1970 before a true production car
could be developed.

The company would not start working on road cars again
until the late 1980s.

This three-seater McLaren F1 was finally born in 1992.

Conceived and engineered by Gordon Murray, the exterior
and interior were designed by Peter Stevens.

Many aspects of this car, including the weight balance
and distribution, are close to perfection.

Needless to say, with only 106 built,
they're not easy to get.

It’s little wonder that the McLaren F1 is one
of the most desirable supercars ever.
collection.zh:
这辆迈凯伦F1是最伟大的超级跑车吗？我觉得算。

实际上，迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进入公路车市场。

可惜他在真正的量产车开发完成前就于1970年去世了。

直到1980年代后期，公司才开始重新考虑公路车的开发计划。

这款3座的“迈凯伦F1”终于在1992年姗姗来迟。

此车由戈登·穆雷构思和设计，
外观和内饰则交由彼得·史蒂文斯操刀。

这辆车在各x面的性能，包括配重平衡和动力平衡，都
堪称完美。

它的稀有程度自不用说：总共只生产了106辆，要想入手
十分不易。

这样一想，迈凯伦F1成为史上最受追捧的超级跑车之一，就
一点
不稀奇了！]

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.

The McLaren F1 was a groundbreaking supercar conceived by legendary Formula 1 designer Gordon Murray. From its unique 3-seat configuration, with the driver positioned at the center, to its balanced weight distribution, the F1 introduced a host of innovations that redefined what a road car could be. Celebrated worldwide, it earned acclaim not only as the fastest production car of its time but also for its usability in everyday driving.

From its unique 3-seat configuration, with the driver positioned at the center, to its balanced weight distribution, the F1 introduced a host of innovations that redefined what a road car could be. Celebrated worldwide, it earned acclaim not only as the fastest production car of its time but also for its usability in everyday driving.
long.zh: McLaren F1是一辆由Formula 1设计师戈登·穆雷打造的超级跑车。从将驾驶者置于中央位置的三座布局，到精心调校的配重比，这款极具革命性意义的车型拥有许多值得大书特书的优点。它不仅是全世界最快的超级跑车之一，在日常驾乘场景中也具备实用性，因而受到了全世界汽车爱好者的盛誉。

collection.en:
This McLaren F1 GTR is the overall winner
of the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hour race.

The drivers in the race were Masanori Sekiya, J.J. Lehto,
and Yannick Dalmas,

and Sekiya was the first Japanese driver to win the famed race,

and Lehto was also the first Finn to claim this honor.

Although design engineer Gordon Murray was not
keen on entering it in races,

he agreed to make some aerodynamic alterations,
and the result was a win at its first race,

which happened to be at Le Mans!

 Following the Le Mans victory, McLaren resolved to
continue developing the GTR as a race car,

making this a crucial icon in both the history
of McLaren and in the history of Le Mans.
collection.zh:
这辆McLaren F1 GTR是1995勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军车。

参加比赛的车手是关谷正德、J.J. Lehto和Yannick Dalmas，

关谷还是第一位赢得这项著名比赛的日本车手，

而Lehto也是第一位获得这一荣誉的芬兰人。

尽管设计工程师戈登·穆雷对于让它参加比赛并不感冒，

但还是同意作出一些空气动力学方面的改动。结果就在
处女秀上取得胜利，

更重要的是，那场比赛就是勒芒大赛！

在勒芒胜利之后，McLaren决定继续将GTR作为赛车来开发，

这也使它同时成为了McLaren历史和勒芒历史上的一个重要标志。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate automobile by McLaren would go on to win both the BPR series and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

This race version was based on McLaren’s first full-scale road car, the F1. At the rain-soaked 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, the F1 GTR defied the odds, outperforming purpose-built prototype racers to claim overall victory. Car No. 59, backed by the factory and driven by Yannick Dalmas, Masanori Sekiya, and JJ Lehto, etched its name into motorsports history.

brandCentral.en:
This here is a McLaren masterpiece!

The MP4-12C was McLaren's first road car since the legendary
F1, and has all the goods you'd expect of the maker.

Its single-piece carbon monocoque was the first of its kind
in a commercially available car...

And its active suspension system is also a stroke
of McLaren genius.

But let's not forget its ultra-powerful 3.8L V8 twin-turbo
midship engine, which is capable of <600ps>!

We had to wait a long time for the successor to the F1,
but there's no doubt it was worth it!
brandCentral.zh:
这一台就是McLaren的杰作啦！

MP4-12C是McLaren自推出传奇的Mclaren F1以来的第一辆公路车，
不负众望地凝聚了制造商的所有优点。

其一体式碳纤维单体结构是首次下放到公开发售的商业
车型……

主动悬挂系统则是McLaren的研发天才们的巧思。

同时也别忘了这辆车超强的3.8L V8双涡轮增压中置引擎，
它能达到<600ps>的动力！

我们为F1的继任者等待了很长时间，但毫无疑问，这场
等待是值得的！

usedCar.en:
When you think of McLaren road cars, the 3-seat F1 might come
to mind, but the MP4-12C is also pretty impressive.

Standing for "McLaren Project 4" from a merger with Project 4
headed by McLaren's former race director Ron Dennis...

...the MP4-12C comes equipped with a twin-turbo V-8
mounted amidships in a carbon-fiber chassis.

It also features the company's high-tech "ProActive Chassis
Control" suspension, making this car one amazing handler.

In fact, the arrival of the MP4-12C saw market share moving
from Ferrari to McLaren, kickstarting a nice little rivalry.

It was a good thing for customers because whether you went
with a British or Italian supercar, you couldn't go wrong.
usedCar.zh:
MP4-12C车型有着McLaren汽车中最具辨识度的中置引擎...

它是继传奇F1跑车之后McLaren设计制造的首款公路跑车。

搭载V8双涡轮增压引擎，搭配兼具高强
度和轻量化的碳纤维复合底盘。

此外，它还搭载了McLaren引以为傲的
“主动式底盘控制系统”悬挂。

在握住方向盘的那一刻，你就会发现它具
有非凡的抓地性能...

驾驶这款车的幸福感可谓如梦似幻。

vehicleCollection.en:
The MP4-12C was the first McLaren production car since the McLaren F1 road car.

Bearing the name MP4—a subtle nod to McLaren’s F1—the MP4-12C stood out for its advanced carbon-composite "MonoCell" chassis. This lightweight structure played a crucial role in reducing overall mass, allowing the car, despite its relatively modest power figures by McLaren standards, to equal or even surpass the performance of its chief rival, the Ferrari 458 Italia.
