long.zh: 这辆McLaren MP4-12C名字中的“MP4”仿佛是在向它的姊妹F1赛车致敬，而它最为人知晓的特点便是采用了碳纤维复合材料“单体车壳”。即便这辆车的动力指标在McLaren公路车中也算是比较保守，但其选用的车身材料有效地减轻了车重，让它的整体性能依然能比肩乃至超过了竞品车型Ferrari 458 Italia。

collection.en:
The McLaren MP4/4 Honda was a legendary F1 machine that
proved virtually unbeatable in the 1988 Formula 1 season.

The chassis was developed by Gordon Murray,
the renowned race-car designer.

It came powered with the RA168E turbocharged Honda V-6 engine.

In 1988, Formula 1 regulations changed significantly...

...with strict limits placed on turbo boost pressure
and fuel usage during races.

Honda’s turbocharged engine utilized advanced electronic control
technology, delivering oth power and efficiency.

The driver lineup featured two of the sport’s finest:
Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna.

With two legends behind the wheel, the MP4/4 won
an extraordinary 15 of 16 races that season.

Car No. 12 was driven by Ayrton Senn.

In 1988, Senna secured the drivers’ championship,
recording 13 po positions andʏight ictories.
collection.zh:
这辆McLaren MP4/4 Honda是一部具有传奇地位的F1赛车，
在1988赛季的F1大奖赛上几乎所向无敌。

它的底盘由知名F1设计师戈登·穆雷所开发……

并由一台Honda出品的RA168E涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

1988年，F1对引擎规则进行了大幅修改……

严格限制了涡轮增压提高的压力
和比赛中赛车搭载的燃油量。

Honda的涡轮增压引擎运用了先进的电子控制技术，
同时兼顾了性能和燃油效率。

不仅如此，当时驾驶这台赛车出战的车手也是高手中的高手：
阿兰·普洛斯特和埃尔顿·塞纳。

在两名F1历史中的传奇车手的驾驭下，
这辆MP4/4在1988年惊人地拿下了16场大奖赛中的15。

catch.en: This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1.
catch.zh: 标志着涡轮增压时代终结的传奇F1赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1.

This McLaren race car contested the 1988 F1 World Championship. Its chassis, the work of Gordon Murray and Steve Nichols, was paired with the Honda RA168E powerplant. Dominating the season, it triumphed in 15 of the 16 races. Car No. 12, the MP4/4, was piloted by Ayrton Senna. Senna delivered a stellar performance, securing 13 pole positions and 8 victories en route to the drivers' championship title.

long.en: This McLaren race car contested the 1988 F1 World Championship. Its chassis, the work of Gordon Murray and Steve Nichols, was paired with the Honda RA168E powerplant. Dominating the season, it triumphed in 15 of the 16 races. Car No. 12, the MP4/4, was piloted by Ayrton Senna. Senna delivered a stellar performance, securing 13 pole positions and 8 victories en route to the drivers' championship title.
long.zh: 这款McLaren赛车参加了1988年F1世界锦标赛。底盘由戈登·穆雷和史蒂夫·尼科尔斯设计，搭载Honda RA168E引擎。该车在当赛季的16场比赛中赢得了15场胜利。标号12号的MP4/4由埃尔顿·塞纳驾驶。他拿出了极为出色的表现，总共获得13个杆位和8场分站冠军，最终夺得车手总冠军。

side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.
Q
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.zh:
McLaren P1是英国汽车制造商McLaren Automotive推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。

其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“MonoCage”的车顶结构。

尽管设计灵感来源于McLaren的传奇F1赛车……

但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。

此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……

这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。

brandCentral.en:
The McLaren GTR needs little introduction.

The F1 GTR burst onto the scene when it took Le Mans
by storm in 1995.

The P1 GTR was developed to celebrate the 20th anniversary
of that legendary victory.

As you might expect, it's based on the P1, a hybrid supercar.

This track-only model had plenty of power, with total output
rated somewhere around <1000ps>.
brandCentral.zh:
这款McLaren GTR想来不需要我多做介绍了。

F1 GTR的狂潮在1995年席卷了勒芒，也俘获了汽车爱好者的心……

而P1 GTR正是为了庆祝这次伟大胜利20周年而开发的。

如您所预料，这辆车基于混动超跑P1开发，

是一辆血统纯正的赛道用比赛机器，足以称霸整个<1000ps>马
力级别。

catch.en: This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.
catch.zh: 专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.

This circuit-only version of the McLaren P1 was created to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the F1 GTR and its race career throughout the 1990s. The hybrid powertrain, combining electric motors with a twin-turbo V-8, was tuned to produce 986.2 HP. To further enhance its track performance, the car received extensive aerodynamic upgrades, including a prominent rear wing.

long.en: This circuit-only version of the McLaren P1 was created to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the F1 GTR and its race career throughout the 1990s. The hybrid powertrain, combining electric motors with a twin-turbo V-8, was tuned to produce 986.2 HP. To further enhance its track performance, the car received extensive aerodynamic upgrades, including a prominent rear wing.
long.zh: 这辆车是P1的纯赛道版本，也是为了庆贺F1 GTR赛车诞生20周年，及其自1990年代起的辉煌生涯所特别开发。它的动力系统结合了多台电机和一台V8双涡轮增压引擎，总共可以输出高达1,000 PS的动力。另外，为了优化它的赛道性能，设计师还为其配备了宽大的尾翼，并做出了其他各种空气动力学改良。

vehicleCollection.zh:
专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

这辆车是P1的纯赛道版本，也是为了庆贺F1 GTR赛车诞生20周年，及其自1990年代起的辉煌生涯所特别开发。它的动力系统结合了多台电机和一台V8双涡轮增压引擎，总共可以输出高达1,000 PS的动力。另外，为了优化它的赛道性能，设计师还为其配备了宽大的尾翼，并做出了其他各种空气动力学改良。

brandCentral.en:
This Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is McLaren's idea of what
racing might look like in 2030 and beyond.

When you get behind its wheel, be ready to be
thoroughly impressed.

But first, you'll need to get accustomed to the
prone driving position.

By assuming this posture, your field of vision is enhanced,
and there are also benefits in terms of interior layout.

Every aspect of this car was intended to put the needs of the
driver above everything else.

McLaren's total dedication to creating the perfect race car
is reflected in this amazing design study.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是McLaren对于2030年之后的
赛车做出的畅想。

它包含了一系列精妙设计，为驾驶者带来无穷的惊喜。

设计概念的重中之重必然是俯卧的驾驶姿势。

这样的姿势不仅可以扩大驾驶员的视野范围，对内饰布
局也有所助益。

这些设计的背后凝聚着以驾驶员为中心的设计理念。

这部终极机器充分体现了McLaren对完美驾驶体验的不懈追求。

catch.en: Putting the driver before all else, this car is the ultimate realization of the McLaren philosophy.
catch.zh: 这辆跑车实现了McLaren以车手为中心的终极设计哲学。

vehicleCollection.en:
Putting the driver before all else, this car is the ultimate realization of the McLaren philosophy.

The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo was developed as McLaren’s vision of high-performance motoring in 2030 and beyond. Behind the cabin, where the driver lay in a motorcycle-like position, resides a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8. The engine is assisted by high-performance electric motors housed in each of the front wheel pods, bringing the total output to 1134.1 HP.

long.en: The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo was developed as McLaren’s vision of high-performance motoring in 2030 and beyond. Behind the cabin, where the driver lay in a motorcycle-like position, resides a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8. The engine is assisted by high-performance electric motors housed in each of the front wheel pods, bringing the total output to 1134.1 HP.
long.zh: 这款McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是由McLaren着眼于2030年乃至更久以后未来而开发的汽车。车手将以类似于驾驶摩托车的坐姿驾驭这台机器，而在座舱后方则安置了一台4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。包裹两个前轮的舱室里还各安装有一部高性能电机，在它们的辅助下，整套系统可以输出高达1,150 PS的动力。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆跑车实现了McLaren以车手为中心的终极设计哲学。

这款McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是由McLaren着眼于2030年乃至更久以后未来而开发的汽车。车手将以类似于驾驶摩托车的坐姿驾驭这台机器，而在座舱后方则安置了一台4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。包裹两个前轮的舱室里还各安装有一部高性能电机，在它们的辅助下，整套系统可以输出高达1,150 PS的动力。

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.1 racing car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on
the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo.

Power is restricted to <950ps> as per group regulations,
but it packs a serious punch nonetheless.

McLaren's driver-focused technology makes this a formidable
weapon in any racing arsenal.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.1级别赛车是基于
McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo开发的。

由于赛事组别规定，它的动力被限制在<950ps>马力之内，但
依旧非常强劲。

秉承以驾驶者为中心的技术理念，McLaren将这辆车打造成了
任何赛车武器库中最可怕的武器。

catch.en: This version of McLaren's future is realized in Gr.1 form with Vision Gran Turismo.
catch.zh: McLaren的近未来设计Vision Gran Turismo的Gr.1版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of McLaren's future is realized in Gr.1 form with Vision Gran Turismo.

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1 machine is based on the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo, born from a collaboration between McLaren and Gran Turismo. While Gr.1 regulations restrict the use of active aerodynamic elements, the car still delivers exceptional cornering performance thanks to its inherently high-downforce body design and formidable mechanical grip.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1 machine is based on the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo, born from a collaboration between McLaren and Gran Turismo. While Gr.1 regulations restrict the use of active aerodynamic elements, the car still delivers exceptional cornering performance thanks to its inherently high-downforce body design and formidable mechanical grip.
long.zh: McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是McLaren和《跑车浪漫旅》联合开发的一款概念型号，而这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的Gr.1赛车正是基于前者打造。虽然它的主动式空力部件严格按照Gr.1规定进行了限制，但其设计巧妙的车身外壳和强大的机械抓地力能够提供无与伦比的下压力，让这辆车依然能够游刃有余地通过弯道。

vehicleCollection.zh:
McLaren的近未来设计Vision Gran Turismo的Gr.1版本。

McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是McLaren和《跑车浪漫旅》联合开发的一款概念型号，而这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的Gr.1赛车正是基于前者打造。虽然它的主动式空力部件严格按照Gr.1规定进行了限制，但其设计巧妙的车身外壳和强大的机械抓地力能够提供无与伦比的下压力，让这辆车依然能够游刃有余地通过弯道。

brandCentral.en:
Mercedes-Benz has produced some memorable high-spec rear-wheel
drive sedans in its long history.

The C Class are the most compact of these.

But don't let their size deceive you, because they
deliver good power and world-class handling.

This particular iteration is the 2015 AMG C63 S, which is
the top-of-the-line model that packs more than <500ps>.

AMG, a subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz, focuses on tuning the
company's cars, making them world-class sports machines.

In particular, AMG is famous for hand-assembling all of its
engines.

The company follows the philosophy of "one man, one engine"—
every engine is the responsibility of a single engineer.
brandCentral.zh:
Mercedes-Benz制造过许多高规格、高性能的后轮驱动汽车。

“C Class”是其中最紧凑的型号。

但千万不要因为体型的缘故而小看了这些性能优异，操
控稳定、可靠的好车。

这台迭代车型是一款2015年的AMG C63 S，是产品线中的顶配
车型，马力高达<500ps>。

AMG是Mercedes-Benz的子公司，专注于开发跑车和高性能车辆，

因其坚持手工组装引擎而声名远扬。

公司严格履行“一人一引擎”的原则，让每一名工程师
都全权负责打造一部引擎。

catch.en: The most powerful model of the fourth-generation C-Class boasts a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8.

vehicleCollection.en:
The most powerful model of the fourth-generation C-Class boasts a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8.

This was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation C-Class. While it carried the familiar C63 name, it introduced significant changes, most notably replacing the naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 with a more compact and efficient twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8. Shared with the AMG GT, the engine was specially tuned, featuring increased maximum torque and a broader low-end range to better suit the C63’s weight and everyday performance needs. The C63 S Coupé is a circuit-focused performance model.

long.en: This was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation C-Class. While it carried the familiar C63 name, it introduced significant changes, most notably replacing the naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 with a more compact and efficient twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8. Shared with the AMG GT, the engine was specially tuned, featuring increased maximum torque and a broader low-end range to better suit the C63’s weight and everyday performance needs. The C63 S Coupé is a circuit-focused performance model.
long.zh: 第四代C级车型的高性能版本。虽然沿用了C63的命名，但进行了重大升级，包括将自然进气6.2升V8引擎替换为4升双涡轮增压配置。这款新引擎与AMG GT搭载的相同，但针对车辆重量和定位特点，提高了最大扭矩并降低了扭矩输出转速区间。“C63 S Coupé”是专为赛道而生的高性能版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Mercedes-Benz Formula 1 car dominated the 2017 season with Lewis Hamilton winning the championship.

The W08 EQ Power+ was developed by Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport to compete in the 2017 Formula 1 season.

Mercedes-Benz made a full return to F1 in 2010 after a 55-year hiatus. It splashed onto the scene as among the top four contenders in that first year, and then showed marked improvement in the ensuing years. By 2014, Team Mercedes-Benz had conquered F1, winning both the Drivers and Constructor's titles from 2014 to 2016. But because of new regulations in 2017, there were some initial minor problems. Drivers were struggling to establish their preferred setup, and although the car was fast in mid- to high-speed corners, it didn't fare as well on tracks with lots of low-speed corners. supremely rare.

Mercedes AMG has experienced success in a variety of
motorsports genres, including Formula 1 and touring cars.

And the cutting-edge technology developed on the track has
trickled down to the Black Series.

The car's aerodynamics and chassis development incorporate
technology from the GT3 race machine.

The engine is one of AMG's jewels in the crown, boasting

vehicleCollection.en:
This 'road-legal race car' evokes the image of the much-celebrated 300SL sports car.

This was a true “road-going race car” derived from the AMG GT. Its aggressive wide-body design included flared fenders and an active aerodynamic system, while the front grille featured bold vertical slats that echoed AMG’s motorsport DNA. Under the hood, the twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 had been tuned to deliver an impressive 576.9 HP and 515.7 ft-lb of torque. It also marked a technical milestone, becoming the first Mercedes-AMG model to feature 4-wheel steering.

conversation.en:
Do you know the history of AMG?

It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.

When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.

They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？

它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。

当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。

他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！
2

conversation.en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.

It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.

In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...

It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.

Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...

This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.

For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.

conversation.speaker: Jeremy

AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的

2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……

在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。

AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……

但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。

SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。

conversation.en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.

The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.

At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!

This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.

It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downfoce than before.

Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.

While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...

...as wl as everal other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanis.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。

初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。

在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！

我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。

经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确可以提供超强的下压力！

而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。

除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……

这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……

以及Np项W细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。

brandCentral.en:
The AMG GT3 is a popular race car that has competed
in GT3 races all over the world.

This is an update to the original model that made its debut
in 2019.

In addition to being more aerodynamic, it has undergone
a complete chassis overhaul to improve handling.

More durable than ever, and featuring a new parts-management
system, the AMG GT3 has been optimized for private teams.

And, with its enlarged grille, you’ll be able to
distinguish it immediately from its predecessor.
brandCentral.zh:
AMG GT3是一辆人气极高的赛车，参与了
全世界范围内的多项GT3赛事。

这是一辆2019年推出的原始型号的升级版。

除了空气动力学性能更强之外，它的底盘也进行了全面改造，
并提升了轮胎性能。

这款AMG GT3专为私人车队进行了特别优化，
提升了整体强度，并采用了全新的零部件管理系统。

另外它还换用了更大尺寸的前格栅，一眼就能分辨出
它和前代车型的区别。

catch.en: An improved and more cost effective GT3 machine
catch.zh: 一辆性能更强、更经济的GT3赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An improved and more cost effective GT3 machine

This FIA-homologated GT3 race car was based on the AMG GT. While performance and aerodynamics were improved, development also prioritized reducing running costs for client teams. This led to longer engine life, improved radiator protection, and several other enhancements. In 2020, the EVO model was introduced alongside a facelift for the road car, bringing with it a host of new features.

long.en: This FIA-homologated GT3 race car was based on the AMG GT. While performance and aerodynamics were improved, development also prioritized reducing running costs for client teams. This led to longer engine life, improved radiator protection, and several other enhancements. In 2020, the EVO model was introduced alongside a facelift for the road car, bringing with it a host of new features.
long.zh: 这款获得FIA赛事认证的GT3赛车以AMG GT为基础打造。除了性能和空气动力学的提升外，开发过程中还重点考虑了客户车队的运营成本。这样的理念带来了更长的引擎寿命、更好的散热器保护等诸多改进。2020年，EVO车型伴随着公路版车型的改款升级和其他新功能一同发布。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆性能更强、更经济的GT3赛车。

这款获得FIA赛事认证的GT3赛车以AMG GT为基础打造。除了性能和空气动力学的提升外，开发过程中还重点考虑了客户车队的运营成本。这样的理念带来了更长的引擎寿命、更好的散热器保护等诸多改进。2020年，EVO车型伴随着公路版车型的改款升级和其他新功能一同发布。

collection.en:
If you're looking for a legend of sports sedan,

then look no further than
the Mercedes-Benz 190 E 2.5-16 Evo II.

This car was made with a single goal:
to win races.

It was developed to compete in the DTM, a German race series
that gained a worldwide following through the 1980s and 1990s.

The DTM is contested by touring cars,
which are based on road-going production models.

For its entry, Mercedes-Benz turned the compact 190-series sedan
into a mighty homologation model.

he final evolution model of this is this Evolution II.

Although technically a production road car,
visually, it's a bona fide touring race car.

The race version of the 190 E Evo II
dominated the DTM and the European racing scene.

The AMG Mercdes-Benz works team won the manufacturers title
for two consecutive seasonin 1991 and 19.

Only 502 road legal versions
of the homologation model were ever produced.

vehicleCollection.en:
Born from touring racing, the ultimate evolution of the 190E.

Mercedes-Benz entered DTM with the 190 E 2.3-16 back in 1986. In 1990, it pushed development further with the 190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II. Its wide, muscular fenders gave the car a sporty flair, matched by a 2.5-liter engine tuned to 231.8 HP. Limited to 500 units, it delivered strong performances during the 1992 DTM season.

conversation.en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...

Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.

It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.

It won its class there, and finished in avery impressive
2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!

This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.

AMG would go on to play a key role in Mecedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。

AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。

它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，

它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。

这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。

在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中j
在包括德qW房O大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

dialogues.en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.

The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.

It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.

This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.

It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.

dialogues.zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。

我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。

其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。

它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。

全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。

collection.en:
This 300 SEL 6.8 AMG is an important car
in AMG's success story.

AMG started as a company that built competition vehicles
based on Mercedes-Benz cars.

It was established by former Daimler-Benz engineer
Hans Werner Aufrecht...

And Erhard Melcher.

The name of the brand comes from the combination
of 'A' for Aufrecht, 'M' for Melcher...

And 'G' for Grossaspach, the hometown of Aufrecht.

This model was entered in the 1971 24 Hours of Spa,
where it won its class and finished second overall.

The great result really put AMG on the map...

And Mercedes-Benz owners flocked to AMG
so they could work their tuning magic.

AMG’s fame only increased thereafter, and became a
wholly-owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz in 2005.
collection.zh:
300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG的
成功发展史上一辆重要的赛车。

AMG公司起初生产用由
Mercedes-Benz汽车改装的赛车。

公司由Daimler-Benz前工程师
Hans Werner Aufrecht……

和Erhard Melcher创办。

品牌名称中的A代表Aufrecht，M代表Melcher……

G代表Grossaspach，也就是Aufrecht的故乡。

这款车型参加了1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛，
赢得了所在级别的头名和全场亚军。

这一胜举让AMG吸引了所有人的注意……

Mercedes-Benz的车主们涌向AMG公司，
希望他们能对自己的车也施展一番调校魔法。

AMG在随后的比赛中继续积累声誉，
最终于2005年成为Mercedes-Benz的全资子公司。

catch.en: This legendary race car put AMG on the map after its class victory at the 1971 24 Hours of Spa.
catch.zh: 这辆传奇赛车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛中赢得了所在组别的冠军，打响了AMG的名声。

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary race car put AMG on the map after its class victory at the 1971 24 Hours of Spa.

Mercedes-AMG created this touring car in its early years. The 300 SEL 6.3 was already quick, but AMG bored the engine out to 6.8 liters and re-tuned it, raising output from 246.5 HP to 422.1 HP. At the 1971 24 Hours of Spa, it took 1st in class and 2nd overall—an early showcase of AMG’s racing pedigree.

long.en: Mercedes-AMG created this touring car in its early years. The 300 SEL 6.3 was already quick, but AMG bored the engine out to 6.8 liters and re-tuned it, raising output from 246.5 HP to 422.1 HP. At the 1971 24 Hours of Spa, it took 1st in class and 2nd overall—an early showcase of AMG’s racing pedigree.
long.zh: 这台房车由早期的Mercedes-AMG打造。300 SEL 6.3本身已是性能强劲的车型，但在将引擎扩容至6.8升及额外的调校之后，它的动力输出从250 PS大幅提升至428 PS。这台车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛赢得分组冠军，总成绩排名第2，充分展现了AMG在赛车领域的潜力。

conversation.en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.

Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.

It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.

The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.

That term also serves as the nickname for this car.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame.
/
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。

它就是W194，也被称为300SL。

它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，

还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。

此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，

由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。

其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

collection.en:
The Type W194 300SL is one of the more notable Mercedes-Benz
machines from the Golden Age of racing of the 1950s.

A champion at Le Mans and the Carrera Panamericana, the car
is also known for inspiring the iconic 300SL Coupe.

Designed by Rudolf Uhlenhaut, a legendary engineer with a
vast amount of experience in race car design...

...the Mercedes-Benz W194 300SL boasted the latest
in the race technology of its day.

It featured a spaceframe chassis, an independent suspension
and asingle-overhead camshaft inline-6.

Only ten were believed to have been built.

Thanks to its excellent performance and reliability, the car
shone in endurance races.

This car, chassis number 007/52, is the car
that won Le Mans.

If a W194 ere to hit the market now, the price
would surely be astronomical.
collection.zh:
诞生于20世纪50年代的W194 300SL
是Mercedes旗下的传奇赛车。

在勒芒和卡雷拉泛美拉力赛取胜以后，
它又因为启发了经典的300SL Coupe而名声大噪。

W194 300SL由Mercedes工程师
Rudolf Uhlenhaut设计……

他是一位具有丰富赛车设计经验的传奇工程师。

其空间框架底盘上装配了独立悬挂
以及顶置单凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

据称该车总计只生产了10辆。

归功于其良好的抓地力性能和可靠性，它曾与许多
顶尖赛车一决高下，留下多场令人难忘的比赛。

底盘编号为007/52的这辆赛车是勒芒冠军之车。

如果传出W194待售的消息，只怕会
堆出一个个天文数字的报价来。

catch.en: The car that brought Mercedes-Benz its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
catch.zh: 这款车为Mercedes-Benz带来了勒芒24小时耐力赛有史以来的首胜。

vehicleCollection.en:
The car that brought Mercedes-Benz its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The 300 SL race car, known inhouse as W194, used a tubular frame with aluminum body panels, paired with modified mechanicals from the W186 300. The car’s debut at the 1952 24 Hours of Le Mans resulted in a landmark win for Mercedes-Benz. That success sparked public demand, ultimately leading to the production of the 300 SL road car.

long.en: The 300 SL race car, known inhouse as W194, used a tubular frame with aluminum body panels, paired with modified mechanicals from the W186 300. The car’s debut at the 1952 24 Hours of Le Mans resulted in a landmark win for Mercedes-Benz. That success sparked public demand, ultimately leading to the production of the 300 SL road car.
long.zh: 开发代号为W194的300 SL赛车采用了管状车架底盘和铝制板件，搭载来自W186 300的改进版引擎和传动系统。该车在1952年勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，即为Mercedes-Benz取得胜利。其优异的赛道表现催生了大量对量产车型的呼声，进而推动了公路版车款的研发。

collection.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is a classic car
with a real racing pedigree.

It was based on the legendary W194 racing coupé,
which won races all over the world...

Including the 24 Hours of Le Mans
and the Carrera Panamericana.

Its victory at the latter really turned heads
in North America.

When east coast importer Max Hoffman asked the German
manufacturer to produce a road version of the W194...

Mercedes-Benz boldly stepped up to the task.

The 300 SL 'Gullwing' Coupe was the result
of this undertaking.

It's undoubtedly one of the most important models
in the company's history!
collection.zh:
有着真正的赛车血统的Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé
是一辆无可争议的经典跑车。

它是基于传奇赛车W194设计制造的。

W194在全世界赢下了包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的无数赛事。

它甚至在卡雷拉泛美拉力赛中取胜，让北美车迷也为之
侧目！

东海岸的进口商马克斯·霍夫曼请求德国制造商生产W194

catch.en: With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.

vehicleCollection.en:
With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.

Daimler-Benz revealed the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL at the 1955 New York Auto Show. While its 161.6 mph top speed was impressive, its roof-hinged "gullwing" doors made it unforgettable, which allowed the car's doors to open upward. Only 1,400 gullwing Coupés were built from 1955 to 1957 before the model evolved into the 300 SL Roadster.

long.en: Daimler-Benz revealed the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL at the 1955 New York Auto Show. While its 161.6 mph top speed was impressive, its roof-hinged "gullwing" doors made it unforgettable, which allowed the car's doors to open upward. Only 1,400 gullwing Coupés were built from 1955 to 1957 before the model evolved into the 300 SL Roadster.

Sure it’s small, but there is absolutely no doubt that
the Mercedes-Benz AMG A45 is the real deal!

It came with a 2.0-liter inline-4 under its hood that delivered
a surprisingly potent punch.

Combine that with its 4WD drivetrain, which provides excellent
stability, this thing is a blast to drive on a race track.
brandCentral.zh:
毫无疑问，Mercedes-Benz AMG A45娇小玲珑。但卓越性能不减！

此车装载了一台拥有世界顶级性能的2L直列四缸引擎……

四驱传动系统和出色的稳定性让它成为了稳定过弯和直
道冲刺的完美选择！

catch.en: The ultimate hot hatch based on the third-generation A Class.
catch.zh: 第三代A-Class中的终极高性能小钢炮。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate hot hatch based on the third-generation A Class.

This high-performance model joined the third-generation A-Class lineup one year after the platform's debut. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine tuned by AMG, it delivered 355 HP and 325.5 ft-lb of torque. It accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.6 seconds and reached its electronically limited top speed of 155.3 mph. To manage its power, the car employed a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission routed through a 4-wheel-drive system. Both the braking system and suspension were also upgraded.

long.en: This high-performance model joined the third-generation A-Class lineup one year after the platform's debut. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine tuned by AMG, it delivered 355 HP and 325.5 ft-lb of torque. It accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.6 seconds and reached its electronically limited top speed of 155.3 mph. To manage its power, the car employed a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission routed through a 4-wheel-drive system. Both the braking system and suspension were also upgraded.
long.zh: 这款高性能车型在首次亮相一年后进入第三代A-Class产品线。AMG调校后的2升涡轮增压引擎可输出360 PS/45.0 公斤力米。该车可在4.6秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。为驾驭这股动力，该车采用7档双离合变速箱，并通过四驱系统进行动力传输。刹车和悬挂也得到了升级。

brandCentral.en:
The 2013 Mercedes-Benz AMG VGT was the first car created for
the Vision Gran Turismo project.

Its design was inspired by the legendary Mercedes-Benz
300 SL, which was released in 1952.

The car's designers also drew inspiration from the dynamic
movement of big cats on the prowl.

It featured a lightweight carbon-fiber body, aluminum
space frame and a twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V-8...

...which produced <585ps>, enough to outrun a GT3 race car!
brandCentral.zh:
2013梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG VGT是跑车浪漫旅愿景项目创作的
第一台车。

其设计灵感取自1952年发布的传奇车型梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL。

该车的设计师还从大型猫科动物潜行捕猎时的动态中获
得了灵感。

除了轻量级的碳纤维车身和铝制空间车架外，此车还配
备一台5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎……

可以产生<585ps>的动力——甚至超越了GT3类别的赛车！

catch.en: The start of something very special: The very first "Vision Gran Turismo."
catch.zh: 体验精致的概念跑车。Vision Gran Turismo的头号车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The start of something very special: The very first "Vision Gran Turismo."

This vehicle marked the launch of the "Vision Gran Turismo" project. Its elegant silhouette was inspired by a feline on the hunt, and it featured a hybrid structure of an aluminum space frame and carbon fiber. At just 2994 lbs, it remained relatively lightweight and was powered by an AMG twin-turbo 5.0-liter V-8 producing 430kW (576.9 HP) and 800Nm (590.2 ft-lb) of torque. Specialists also tuned the engine sound, making this machine as thrilling to hear as it was to behold.

At just 2994 lbs, it remained relatively lightweight and was powered by an AMG twin-turbo 5.0-liter V-8 producing 430kW (576.9 HP) and 800Nm (590.2 ft-lb) of torque. Specialists also tuned the engine sound, making this machine as thrilling to hear as it was to behold.
long.zh: 这辆车标志着“Vision Gran Turismo”项目的开启。它的车身造型极致优雅，灵感来源于正在捕猎的大型猫科动物，在材料方面则混合采用了铝合金空间车架和碳纤维。作为一款仅重1,358 公斤的车型，它轻盈灵活，但动力十足，配备了一台AMG 5升V8双涡轮增压引擎，可以输出430千瓦/800牛米（585 PS/81.6 公斤力米）的动力。这部引擎的声音还由专家团队进行了特别调校，让这款车不仅外观摄人心魄，发出的轰鸣声也令人心潮澎湃。

catch.en: Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.
catch.zh: 又一款可以立即投入比赛的Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.

This is a racing version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo. All interior comforts were removed to bring the weight down to 2866 lbs, while a large fixed rear wing increases downforce for circuit use. The AMG twin-turbo 5.5-liter V-8 has been tuned to produce 591.7 HP. The transmission has been upgraded from the 7-speed dual-clutch to a full sequential system for optimal performance on the track.

long.en: This is a racing version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo. All interior comforts were removed to bring the weight down to 2866 lbs, while a large fixed rear wing increases downforce for circuit use. The AMG twin-turbo 5.5-liter V-8 has been tuned to produce 591.7 HP. The transmission has been upgraded from the 7-speed dual-clutch to a full sequential system for optimal performance on the track.
long.zh: 这是Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的赛车版本。全车削减了所有的内饰和舒适性部件，将车重拉低到1,300 公斤，此外还配备了一部大尺寸固定式尾翼，能够产生赛道所需的大量下压力。它的AMG 5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎出力也有一定提升，达到了600 PS。其传动性能也进行了优化升级，将原本的7档双离合变速箱改为了全序列系统变速箱。

collection.en:
This CLK-LM is one of the most attractive race cars
produced by Mercedes-Benz.

It only competed for a few years in the late 1990s, racing in
GT1, which was then the pinnacle of Touring Car competition.

GT1-class regulations required an automaker to build only
one street car to be approved for competition.

Despite their appearance, these street cars
were in fact full-on race machines.

The CLK-LM's predecessor, the CLK-GTR, was produced
in accordance to these regulations in 1997.

This CLK-LM was a further evolution of the CLK-GTR.

The replacement of the V-12 engine with a V-8 improved the
race car's overall balance.

As soon asit took to the track in the '98 FIA-GT Championships,
it absolutely dominad the competitn.<p/
That year, it took home both Drivers' and Manufacturers'
championships.
collection.zh:
这辆CLK-LM是梅赛德斯-奔驰生产过的
最诱人的赛车之一。

它只在90年代后半期参加了几年的GT1比赛，
随后就是房车比赛的巅峰时期。

GT1级别的规则只要求汽车制造商制造一辆公路车
就能获准参加比赛。

尽管外观如此，为此生产的公路车
核心却是一辆成熟的赛车。

CLK-LM的前身CLK-GTR也是出于同一目的
而于1997年生产的。

当国际汽联GT世界锦标赛于同年开始举办时
CLK-GTR在出战便获得了冠军头衔。

CLK-LM可以视为CLK-GTR的进化版本，

用V8引擎取代V12引擎带来了
车辆的整体平衡性的改善。

使CLK-LM在1998年国际汽联-GT锦标赛中
一亮相就掀起了夺冠狂G……

并且赢得了当年GT1赛事的
车手和制造商双料冠m。

catch.en: Making the switch from a heavy V12 engine to a lighter V8 helped this Mercedes-Benz dominate the FIA GT championship.

vehicleCollection.en:
Making the switch from a heavy V12 engine to a lighter V8 helped this Mercedes-Benz dominate the FIA GT championship.

To compete in the newly established FIA GT Championship in 1997, Mercedes-Benz and AMG developed the CLK-GTR in just 128 days. Equipped with a V-12 engine, the car proved immediately successful, securing both the team and driver championships in its debut season. The following year, Mercedes introduced the CLK-LM as an evolution model. It made its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, going on to dominate the FIA GT Championship, winning all 10 rounds and clinching the season title.

Equipped with a V-12 engine, the car proved immediately successful, securing both the team and driver championships in its debut season. The following year, Mercedes introduced the CLK-LM as an evolution model. It made its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, going on to dominate the FIA GT Championship, winning all 10 rounds and clinching the season title.

This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.

In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.

Powered by an inline-6 mounted id-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.

In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.

这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的

其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……

并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。

它
一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，

也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。

法r和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。

collection.en:
If classic cars are your thing, then you're bound to
recognize this S-Type Mercedes right away.

It won "Best of Show" at the 2017
Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.

And it's known as Mercedes-Benz's first sports car. Called
the S-Type, it was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The body was constructed by Barker & Co., a coachbuilder
best known for its work on Rolls-Royce cars.

The car's distinctive rear end is commonly referred to as
a "boat tail."

No one quite made them like Barker & Co.

This S-Type was commissioned by Earl Howe, a co-founder
of the British Racing Driver's Club.

Not only is this car a priceless gem, it takes
a certain amount of grace drive it!
collection.zh:
如果经典老爷车是您的菜，那您一定认得
这台看起来动力十足的S-Type Mercedes。

毕竟，她在2017年圆石滩经典车展中
可是赢得了“最佳巡展”奖。

被誉为Mercedes-Benz的第一款运动车型的“S”系列
由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计……

并由因与Rolls-Royce合作而名声大噪
的Barker & Co.提供的车身。

这辆车独树一帜的车尾造型被称为“船尾”

正是由Barker一手打造的。

此车是由英国赛车手俱乐部的联合创始人
Earl Howe委托制造的。

这样一台特立独行，举世无双的珍品，
惟有风度和气度俱佳的驾驶者才配得上它！$

vehicleCollection.en:
This very unqiue sports car was the first from Mercedes-Benz and is known for its characteristic boat tail styling.

This car earned double honors at the 2017 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance, capturing both Best of Show and the Gran Turismo Trophy. Produced between 1926 and 1933, what many regard as Mercedes-Benz’s first true sports car was the vision of Ferdinand Porsche. Powered by a supercharged 7.0-liter inline-6, it was wrapped in elegant "boat tail" coachwork crafted by Barker.

usedCar.en:
It's no secret that Mercedes-Benz and McLaren have enjoyed a
long and fruitful Formula 1 partnership.

The SLR supercar was yet another result of the two companies
working together to achieve great things.

Mercedes-Benz's 300 SLR served as the inspiration for its
development.

While the styling had a definite retro feel to it, the monocoque
structure was all high tech, composed of carbon-fiber.

Under the hood resided a supercharged V-8
that pumped out more than <600ps>.

All this, and more, made this amazing machine
a true race car for the street.
usedCar.zh:

F1合作关系。

这款SLR超跑，则又是一款这两家汽车制造商的
合作结晶。

Mercedes的300 SLR是这款车的
开发灵感来源。

虽然整体造型只是沿用了经典设计，但其底盘采用了
现代碳纤维单体车壳。

这种设计在现代赛车中
更为常见。

它那超长的车头里装着
一台机械增压V8。

The already aggressive-looking SLR McLaren looked even more ominous with optional 19-inch wheels.

Power came from a 5.5-liter SOHC V-8 equipped with a twin-screw supercharger, paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission offering sport, comfort, and manual modes.

The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.

This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.

And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!

Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame.
.

It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.

This allows for an idel front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced thugh corners.

它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！

这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。

它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，

位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。

这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，

作为300 SL的后PC者，这辆L

brandCentral.en:
What you're looking at is the spiritual successor
to the legendary 300 SL.

The car's long nose and very fancy gullwing doors were
inspired by those of its predecessor.

The SLS AMG came powered by a 6.3-liter V-8
that produced a whopping <571ps>.

While AMG is generally known for creating high-performance
versions of production Mercedes-Benz models...

...this baby was designed completely from scratch.
brandCentral.zh:
您所看到的是传奇车型300 SL的精神继承者！

其长车头与灵感来自前代车型的鸥翼式车门相得益彰。

前中置引擎的SLS AMG拥有一台6.3L V8引擎，能够产生<571ps>的动力。

虽然AMG通常以制造Mercedes-Benz商业车型的高性能版本而闻名……

但这款SLS却是由AMG全新设计的车型。

usedCar.en:
AMG was once an independent tuner of Mercedes-Benz vehicles,
but after being purchased by the German automaker...

...it's now the company's in-house performance division. Among
the cool cars it has produced recently is the SLS AMG.

It came equipped with the AMG-developed M159 V-8 mated to
a quick-shifting 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox.

The body featured gullwing doors, like the original 300SL,
giving the SLS AMG a link to Mercedes-Benz's past.
usedCar.zh:
德国汽车制造公司AMG一直长期致力于
生产高性能的Mercedes-Benz车辆。

而他们的技术实力在这款SLS AMG前置后驱
超级跑车的底盘上得到了充分体现。

它采用AMG研发的M159自然进气V8引擎，
在过渡到更高转速时会发出轰鸣。

尽管它的驾驶体验朴实无华，
但驾驶者一定会发现其专注的性能非常令人满意。

catch.en: With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.
catch.zh: 体现Mercedes历史和驾驶天赋的超跑。

vehicleCollection.en:
With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.

Unveiled at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, this striking sports car was distinguished by its signature gull-wing doors. Beneath its all-aluminum body was a newly developed 6.3-liter V-8 engine, producing 563.1 HP and 477.4 ft-lb of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission was integrated with the rear differential, offering five selectable driving modes. Performance was formidable, with a zero-to-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.8 seconds and a top speed of 197 mph.

long.en: Unveiled at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, this striking sports car was distinguished by its signature gull-wing doors. Beneath its all-aluminum body was a newly developed 6.3-liter V-8 engine, producing 563.1 HP and 477.4 ft-lb of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission was integrated with the rear differential, offering five selectable driving modes. Performance was formidable, with a zero-to-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.8 seconds and a top speed of 197 mph.
long.zh: 这款于2009年法兰克福车展亮相的车型采用了鸥翼车门。其全铝合金车身中安装了一台全新开发、能够输出571 PS/66.0 公斤力米的6.3升V8引擎。其7档双离合变速箱也与后差速器进行了统合，并提供5种可选驾驶模式。在性能方面，这辆车可以在3.8秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，且能够达到317 公里/小时的最高时速。

brandCentral.en:
This version of the SLS AMG was developed to comply
with FIA GT3 regulations.

While it retains the engine of the commercial model, its
sequential six-speed transmission is built for racing.

It's also much more aerodynamic than its predecessor!

In 2011, the year of its debut, it ran in a whopping 101
races, and managed to win 25 of them.
brandCentral.zh:
这个版本的SLS AMG是为了符合FIA GT3规则而开发的。

此车保留了商业车型的引擎，序列式六速变速箱则是专
为赛车而设计的。

此外，此车的空气动力学表现也要优于前代车型！

在2011年，也就是该车型首次亮相的那一年，它一共参加
了多达101场比赛，并成功地赢得了其中25场的冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car version of Mercedes-Benz's supercar was tailored to FIA GT3 regulations.

The SLS AMG GT3 was a race machine based on the road-going SLS AMG. It retained the same fundamental powerplant as the production model. Although official output figures were never released, estimates placed it at over 591.7 HP. Entering full-scale competition in 2011, the car secured 25 victories out of the 101 races it contested that year.

vehicleCollection.en:
With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.

The SLS supercar paid tribute to Mercedes-Benz’s storied design heritage. This Gr.4 variant is a Gran Turismo Original. Fitted with a GT3-style roll cage, its long-nose, short-deck proportions echo the legendary 300SL, contributing to impressive cornering stability. Yet it’s not all about handling—the classic V-8 engine delivers formidable straight-line speed that’s equally hard to overlook.

conversation.en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.

Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.

The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.

It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。

事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！

最初被设计为农用机械的它……

于1948年正式量产。

眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。

相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。

作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。

collection.en: Mercedes-Benz, renowned for its passenger vehicles, has also made significant contributions to the commercial sector. One such example is the Unimog. An acronym for Universal-Motor-Gerät, its name translates to "Universal Motorized Working Machine." Designed in 1945, the Unimog was engineered as an all-wheel-drive farming vehicle capable of navigating rugged terrain. Its versatility stemmed from a range of attachments, enabling it to perform virtually any task required. 1953marked the debut of the 401/402, the first iteration to bear Mercedes-Benz's iconic three-pointed star. It was followed by the Type 411. It featured a cabin and flatbed mounted on a ladder frame derived from the 401. Often hailed as "the las original Unimog," the 411 holds a special place in automotive history.

vehicleCollection.en:
The benchmark for versatile, high-mobility vehicles.

The Unimog was a commercial vehicle developed and sold by Daimler Truck. First produced in 1948, it went on to become a long-running success as a highly versatile, multi-purpose machine. Introduced in 1956, the 411 series served as its successor, featuring a more powerful engine and a reinforced body structure. With three available wheelbase options and a variety of body styles, the lineup included twelve distinct models, each of which could be further customized with a wide range of attachments.

vehicleCollection.en:
A legendary F1 car that made motorsports history.

The W 196 was developed by Mercedes-Benz in anticipation of the new F1 regulations shifting to 2.5-liter engines from 1954. The W 196 R variant was specifically constructed for competition in F1. Its 2496 cc inline-8 engine produced 285 HP and was capable of reaching a top speed of 180.2 mph. The car delivered outstanding results during the 1954 and 1955 Formula One World Championships, with driver Juan Manuel Fangio securing the drivers' title in both seasons.

The car delivered outstanding results during the 1954 and 1955 Formula One World Championships, with driver Juan Manuel Fangio securing the drivers' title in both seasons.
long.zh: W 196是Mercedes-Benz针对1954年开始实施的2.5升F1新规则而开发。W 196 R是专为F1赛事而打造。2,496 立方厘米直列八缸引擎可输出290 PS的动力，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。它在1954年和1955年两届世界一级方程式锦标赛中取得了傲人成绩，助力车手胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥连续两年夺得车手总冠军。

If you've heard of Mine’s, then you are a true “Car Guy.”

Mine’s is a Japanese tuning firm renowned for its GT-Rs.

Its most celebrated creation was the BNR34 GT-R N1 base,
a fully loaded, high-performance street car.

Capped at <600ps>, its RB26DETT engine was tuned for
seamless acceleration across the entire rpm range.

Its ability to lap the Tsukuba Circuit in less than a minute was
the ultimate testament to Mine’s engineering prowess.

In 2021, this example underwenta full restoration, driven
by a strong desire to preserve it for future generations.

Only its GT-R badge bore battle scars—a subtle yet striking
detail added by Mine’s president, Michizo Niikura.

Once the subject of a 300,000,000 yen offer, tme would tell
how it might one day be appraised on the global stage.

其最负盛名的作品基于BNR34 GT-R N1 base打造，
是一款性能卓越、配置齐全的高性能街车。

其所搭载的RB26DETT引擎峰值功率被设定在<600ps>，

2021年，此车进行了全面修复，

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary, fully tuned GT-R gained a new following after an ambitious restoration.

Created by Mine’s, the BNR34 GT-R N1 base is a finely tuned expression of the R34 GT-R’s purity, capturing its beauty while remaining true to the spirit of a street car. From the refined RB26DETT engine to the lowered suspension and understated exterior, every detail reflected the philosophy of Mine’s CEO, Michizo Niikura — to create “a first-class street car.” This example was fully restored in 2021 by Garage Yoshida.

long.en: Created by Mine’s, the BNR34 GT-R N1 base is a finely tuned expression of the R34 GT-R’s purity, capturing its beauty while remaining true to the spirit of a street car. From the refined RB26DETT engine to the lowered suspension and understated exterior, every detail reflected the philosophy of Mine’s CEO, Michizo Niikura — to create “a first-class street car.” This example was fully restored in 2021 by Garage Yoshida.
long.zh: “BNR34 GT-R N1 base”由Mine's打造，在恪守街车风格理念的同时，对R34 GT-R的美学设计进行了深度探索。从RB26DETT引擎的精心调校，到低趴式悬挂系统，再到简约的外观设计，所有细节均遵循Mine's首席执行官新仓通藏的理念，旨在打造“一流街车”。这辆车于2021年由GARAGE YOSHIDA完成了全面修复。

When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

conversation.en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
conversation.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。

这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。

在1955年，由亚{克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……

于是，你眼前的这Q辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。

dialogues.en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
当MINI于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。

此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

catch.en: Devised by Formula 1 legend John Cooper, this very special Mini was intended to excel on the race track.
catch.zh: 这辆Mini由一级方程式赛车领域的传奇人物约翰·库珀设计，专为胜利而生。

vehicleCollection.en:
Devised by Formula 1 legend John Cooper, this very special Mini was intended to excel on the race track.

To fully exploit the MINI’s outstanding handling characteristics, the British Motor Corporation joined forces with F1 constructor John Cooper to develop this high-performance variant. The 970 S emerged as a special version, its engine displacement reduced to 970 cc to comply with specific racing class regulations. Whereas the standard 848 cc engine delivered 33.5 HP, this tuned iteration generated an impressive 65.1 HP. Despite a limited production run of just 963 units, the car achieved remarkable success in touring car competitions.

long.en: To fully exploit the MINI’s outstanding handling characteristics, the British Motor Corporation joined forces with F1 constructor John Cooper to develop this high-performance variant. The 970 S emerged as a special version, its engine displacement reduced to 970 cc to comply with specific racing class regulations. Whereas the standard 848 cc engine delivered 33.5 HP, this tuned iteration generated an impressive 65.1 HP. Despite a limited production run of just 963 units, the car achieved remarkable success in touring car competitions.
long.zh: 为了充分发挥Mini的杰出操控性，BMC（British Motor Corporation）与F1汽车工程师约翰·库珀联手打造了这款运动车型。其标准版的848 立方厘米排量引擎能够输出34 PS。而这个970 "S"版本则为了满足赛车组别要求，将引擎排量扩大为970 立方厘米，能够输出66 PS。虽然总共只生产了963辆，但这丝毫不妨碍它在各大房车赛中取得巨大成功。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hybrid concept packed with know-how and spirit gained through motorsports.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Mitsubishi Motors, a brand with a strong legacy in events like the Dakar Rally and World Rally Championship (WRC). Inspired by the Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV shown at the 2013 Tokyo Motor Show, the concept evolved into a purpose-built racing machine. As a plug-in hybrid EV, it combines electric motors with a conventional engine, delivering massive power to all four wheels through the advanced S-AWC vehicle dynamics control system.

conversation.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.

It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.

On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive are far more
comon contenders for power and traction.

Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...

...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!

Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。

征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。

要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。

虽然此车型未能在全日本GT锦标赛摘得桂冠……

但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！

usedCar.en:
Hi there! Looking for a fine Japanese car from the ‘90s?
If so, then have I got the car for you!

Check out this FTO, a compact coupé from Mitsubishi.
A speedy FF, it shares its basic parts with the Mirage.

Its greatest selling point is its 2L V6, fitted with a
variable valve mechanism, and can produce <200ps>.

Measuring <4365mm> in length and <1735mm> in width, this
car looks fierce, particularly with its bulging bonnet.

And fierce it was—dubbed the fastest FF of its day. The
sheer speed at which it takes corners is unbelievable.

Believe me, there aren’t many cars out there that have had
such a hold on young drivers as the Mitsubishi FTO!

作为一款速度傲人的前驱车，它与Mirage共享基础部件。

此车最大亮点是搭载可变气门机构的2升V6引擎，
可输出<200ps>的强劲动力。

车身长<4365mm>、宽<1735mm>，
外观极具攻击性，尤其是那隆起的引擎盖线条。

它的表现也相当凶猛——曾被誉为当时最快的前驱车！
过弯时的凌厉姿态令人难以置信。

相信我，很少有车型能像Mitsubishi FTO这样，
让年轻的车手们一见倾心！

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-powered front-wheel-drive sports car featured a number of new systems.

The FTO made its debut in 1994, marking a return 23 years after the release of the original model. Its body adopted mid-size proportions suited to the Japanese market—uncommon for its time—and stood out for its generous width and athletic stance. Three engine options were offered: the 4G93, a 1.8-liter inline-4 SOHC; the 6A12, a 2.0-liter DOHC V-6 , and a higher-tuned version of the same V-6, producing 197.2 HP. The GP Version R was a high-performance variant, featuring sport-tuned suspension, a limited-slip differential, and front and rear strut tower bars as standard equipment.

Three engine options were offered: the 4G93, a 1.8-liter inline-4 SOHC; the 6A12, a 2.0-liter DOHC V-6 , and a higher-tuned version of the same V-6, producing 197.2 HP. The GP Version R was a high-performance variant, featuring sport-tuned suspension, a limited-slip differential, and front and rear strut tower bars as standard equipment.

usedCar.en:
For many, this car represents the quintessential Japanese
high-performance car of the 1990s.

Mitsubishi's GTO Twin Turbo was marketed as a "super
4WD sports vehicle."

And it is. It has both all-wheel drive and 4-wheel steering,
not to mention active aerodynamics.

It came powered by a twin-turbocharged V-6.

The high-tech nature of the GTO, called the 3000GT in
the U.S., truly made it a car before its time.+
usedCar.zh:
对于许多人来说，三菱GTO Twin Turbo是
20世纪90年代最典型的日产高性能车。

它在营销时被称为“超级四驱跑车”。

这款车结合了四轮驱动和四轮转向系统，
同时运用了主动式空气动力学系统……

它可以说是满载了各类先进技术。

而其采用的前置V6双涡轮增压引擎让人尤为惊喜。

catch.en: This pure-bred sports car by Mitsubishi featured advanced AWD technology.
catch.zh: 由Mitsubishi全力打造的纯正跑车，采用了其久负盛名的四驱技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
This pure-bred sports car by Mitsubishi featured advanced AWD technology.

Introduced in 1990, the GTO marked Mitsubishi’s return to the true sports car segment after many years. Its bold, wide-bodied styling was clearly aimed at the American market. The car packed a suite of advanced technologies for its time, including all-wheel control, 4-wheel steering, electronically controlled suspension, and active aerodynamic elements. Under the hood was a 3.0-liter V-6 engine, offered in both naturally-aspirated and twin-turbocharged forms. It was sold overseas as the 3000GT, where it gained popularity for its bold styling and aggressive performance.

vehicleCollection.en:
An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.

Limited to just 1,000 units, this was the final edition of the Lancer Evolution X, although the X itself was omitted from the body, subtly suggesting its role as the last of the legendary line. Based on the 5-speed manual GSR model, it featured an upgraded engine producing 308.7 HP and 311.0 ft-lb of torque, equipped with sodium-filled exhaust valve stems for improved durability. It also came standard with the "high-performance package," which included Bilstein dampers and Eibach springs.

Slits on the front fenders channel turbulent air out of the wheel wells, while an array of winglets inside the fenders carefully manage airflow across the entire body.

usedCar.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, more commonly known as
the "Evo," is an iconic Japanese car from the 1990s.

It was developed for competing in the World Rally Championship,
the pinnacle of rally racing.

This is the third-generation model from 1995,
called the "Evo III."

It's a truly historic machine because it handed Mitsubishi ace Tommi
Mäkinen his first world rally drivers title.

From its wide front bumper to the flamboyant rear spoiler,
everything on the Evo III was rally-spec.

And, it represented an evolutionary leap from the previous models,
thanks mainly to its incredible performance.

What’s more, the production Evo III came with an anti-lag
system, which was usually reserved just for race cars.
usedCar.zh:
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution（简称“Evo”）是
二十世纪九十年代最具标志性的日式车之一。

它是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛
所开发的一款基础车型。

这辆车是1995年推出的第三代型号，俗称“Evo III”。

这款车型因帮助Mitsubishi的王牌车手托米·马基宁
拿下了他的第一个世界拉力车手冠军而名声斐然。

从宽大的开口式前保险杠到帅气的后扰流板，
它车身上的每一个配件都完全符合拉力赛规格。

这个型号与一代和二代型号Evo相比堪称是革命性的飞跃，
比前两代速度更快、性能更强。

此外，Evo III还从量产阶段就设计了一套偏时点火系统。

catch.en: Improved aerodynamics and cooling make for the ultimate first-gen  "Evo."
catch.zh: 改进的空气动力学和冷却系统催生出首批巅峰“Evo”跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Improved aerodynamics and cooling make for the ultimate first-gen  "Evo."

The third-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1995. With a focus on improving racing performance, it received aerodynamic and cooling enhancements, including a wider front bumper intake and a prominent rear wing mounted on the trunk. The legendary 4G63 engine was further refined to produce 266.3 HP, delivering sharper response and increased power. In the 1996 World Rally Championship, Tommi Mäkinen drove this very model to victory, securing the drivers' title.

long.en: The third-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1995. With a focus on improving racing performance, it received aerodynamic and cooling enhancements, including a wider front bumper intake and a prominent rear wing mounted on the trunk. The legendary 4G63 engine was further refined to produce 266.3 HP, delivering sharper response and increased power. In the 1996 World Rally Championship, Tommi Mäkinen drove this very model to victory, securing the drivers' title.
long.zh: 第三代Lancer Evolution于1995年1月正式发布。为了提升竞技性能，针对空气动力学和散热系统方面进行了重点优化，这从前保险杠更大的进气口和后备箱上的大型扰流板可见一斑。经典的4G63引擎经过进一步调校，最大功率达到270 PS。在1996年世界拉力锦标赛中，托米·马基宁驾驶这款赛车夺得了车手总冠军。

vehicleCollection.zh:
改进的空气动力学和冷却系统催生出首批巅峰“Evo”跑车。

第三代Lancer Evolution于1995年1月正式发布。为了提升竞技性能，针对空气动力学和散热系统方面进行了重点优化，这从前保险杠更大的进气口和后备箱上的大型扰流板可见一斑。经典的4G63引擎经过进一步调校，最大功率达到270 PS。在1996年世界拉力锦标赛中，托米·马基宁驾驶这款赛车夺得了车手总冠军。

usedCar.en:
The Lancer Evolution is one of the most popular
Japanese 4WD sports cars ever produced.

The fourth-generation model—the Evolution IV—was developed
during Mitsubishi's golden age of rallying.

Its 4G3 engine, a turbo 2.0-liter inline-4, pumps out <280ps>—
a voluntary limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.

The car features the company's first Active Yaw Control system,
or AYC, which electronically controls rear-wheel torque.

This innovation significantly improved the Lancer Evo's
handling and made it favorite among rally fans.
usedCar.zh:
Lancer Evolution是有史以来最具辨识度的
日产四驱跑车。

这款车的第四代——Evolution IV
是在Mitsubishi的拉力赛黄金年代诞生的。

因日本车厂之间一条不成文的君子协定，
其2升直列四缸涡轮增压4G3引擎的最大马力被限制在<280ps>。

这款车上还首次配备了主动式舵角控制器
（Active Yaw Control，即AYC），能通过电子装置控制后轮扭矩……

这使得Lancer Evo具备优良的过弯性能。!

catch.en: The 4th-gen Evo's handling got a boost from electronic Active Yaw Control and power now up to 276.1 HP.
catch.zh: 采用电子AYC，马力达到280 PS的第四代Lancer Evo。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 4th-gen Evo's handling got a boost from electronic Active Yaw Control and power now up to 276.1 HP.

In August 1996, the second-generation Lancer was introduced, bringing with it the Lancer Evolution IV. The 4G63 engine was rotated 180 degrees compared to previous models and delivered 276.1 HP with a peak torque of 260.4 ft-lb. A major advancement came with the rear differential, where the traditional mechanical LSD was replaced by an electronically controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) system—greatly enhancing handling precision.

long.en: In August 1996, the second-generation Lancer was introduced, bringing with it the Lancer Evolution IV. The 4G63 engine was rotated 180 degrees compared to previous models and delivered 276.1 HP with a peak torque of 260.4 ft-lb. A major advancement came with the rear differential, where the traditional mechanical LSD was replaced by an electronically controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) system—greatly enhancing handling precision.
long.zh: 1996年8月，第二代Lancer公布，随之公布的还有Lancer Evolution IV。不同于前代车型，其4G63引擎的安装方向翻转了180度，能够产生280 PS，最大扭矩也提高到36.0 公斤力米。而在后差速器方面，前代的机械限滑差速器被换成了电控主动偏航系统，从而大幅提升了操控性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
采用电子AYC，马力达到280 PS的第四代Lancer Evo。

1996年8月，第二代Lancer公布，随之公布的还有Lancer Evolution IV。不同于前代车型，其4G63引擎的安装方向翻转了180度，能够产生280 PS，最大扭矩也提高到36.0 公斤力米。而在后差速器方面，前代的机械限滑差速器被换成了电控主动偏航系统，从而大幅提升了操控性。

brandCentral.en:
There are two ways of sorting Lancer Evolution generations:
by number or by base model.

According to the base model system, the Lancer Evo VII,
VIII, and IX all belong to the third generation.

Of these, the Lancer Evolution IX MR was the last model.

It was also the last Lancer Evolution to be equipped with
Mitsubishi's 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

With a strong turbocharger and continuous variable valve
timing, it offered better engine response than ever before.

And its sporty look helped distinguish it as the
definitive IX version.

The "MR" in its name stands for "Mitsubishi Racing," an exclusive
label reserved for Mitsubishi’s top-tier sports cars.
T
brandCentral.zh:
Lancer Evolution的代际排序通常有两种算法：
按照编号排，或是按照基础车型划分。

以后者划分的话，Lancer Evo VII、VIII和IX
均属于第三代。

这样算来，Lancer Evolution IX MR就是第三代的
最后一款。

同时也是最后一款搭载Mitsubishi
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的Lancer Evolution。

凭借强大的涡轮增压器和连续可变气门正时技术，
它提供了远超常规的引擎响应。

运动外观更是Evo IX的集大成者。

名称中的“MR”则代表“Mitsubishi Racing”
——Mitsubishi顶尖跑车的专属标签。

usedCar.en:
You might say that the Evo IX MR represented a new milestone
for the Lancer Evolution series.

After all, it was the last of its kind to come equipped with
the Mitsubishi 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

Although the 4G63 would prove to be no match for its
successor, the 4B11, in terms of power and torque...

...it offered more power and better engine response in the
low rev range.

A gem of an engine, it's sure to stand the test of time!
usedCar.zh:
这台Evo IX MR可以说标志着Lancer Evolution系列的
一道里程碑。

毕竟，它是最后一款搭载Mitsubishi
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的车型。

尽管4G63确实无法在功率和扭矩方面与其后继
产品4B11匹敌……

但在低转速区间，它的动力更大，响应也更优秀。

catch.en: The "9.5," the final 4G63-powered Lancer Evolution.

vehicleCollection.en:
The "9.5," the final 4G63-powered Lancer Evolution.

The Lancer Evolution IX GSR bears the MR initials for Mitsubishi Racing. Performance was enhanced in every area. The MIVEC system was tuned to sharpen turbo response, while the suspension benefited from Eibach springs and an updated AYC calibration for improved cornering stability. Marking the final appearance of the legendary 4G63 engine, this model stood as the pinnacle of the third wave of Lancer Evolution cars.

long.en: The Lancer Evolution IX GSR bears the MR initials for Mitsubishi Racing. Performance was enhanced in every area. wider horizons within the framework of a road car.

increased tyre size.

an athletic undercarriage.

wing oa rallyca.ٗ

conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

conversation.zh:
从历史上看，许多被用作拉力赛车改装原型的公路车都
非常有吸引力。

我指的是像迷你Cooper S、奥迪quattro和
蓝旗亚Delta这样的车……

这些都是以家庭用车为目的，讲究实用性的车型。

它们就仿佛是栖息在城市中的动物。

当然了，真正的拉力赛车都是禁止在街道上驾驶的。

因此在设计方面，重点在于如何在公)车的框架内表达扩展的远景。

Evo V采用了人们期待已久的大车轮，
为了搭配车轮，挡泥板的尺寸也相应拓展，

这台三厢轿车的底盘也由此换成了赛车底盘。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 5th-gen Evo impressed with its bolder-looking flared fenders and an engine that produced more torque.

The fifth-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1998. Developed with the World Rally Championship in mind, the body was widened and the 4G63 engine received further tuning to boost torque. The AYC system (Active Yaw Control) from the Evolution IV was retained, while new inverted dampers and a front helical LSD were added to further elevate performance and cornering ability.

long.en: The fifth-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1998. Developed with the World Rally Championship in mind, the body was widened and the 4G63 engine received further tuning to boost torque. The AYC system (Active Yaw Control) from the Evolution IV was retained, while new inverted dampers and a front helical LSD were added to further elevate performance and cornering ability.
long.zh: 第五代Lancer Evolution于1998年1月正式推出。针对世界拉力锦标赛的参赛需求，车身进行了加宽处理，4G63引擎也经过重新调校以提升扭矩输出。延续了前代车型的电子控制AYC（主动偏航控制）系统，并新增了倒置式避震器和前螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，进一步提升了性能表现。

conversation.en:
The Lancer Evo is a mundane Japanese family
sedan that's been transformed into a racing beast.

...a mild-mannered nobody transformed into a superhero...

...the kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.

So, what might the superpowers of this car be
from a design perspective?

Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grille!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armor.
,

族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。

usedCar.en:
Looking for a collectable rally-bred performance car? Then look
no further than the Tommi Mäkinen Edition Lancer Evolution.

Named for the legendary driver who won four consecutive
WRC titles with the Lancer Evo race car...

...this special-edition model from Mitsubishi celebrates
his historic accomplishment.

Serving as the foundation was the Lancer Evo VI. Mitsubishi
then added a stiffer suspension, among other things.

Of all the models in the series, this car and the Evo V are
noted as being "the most thrilling tarmac specialists."
usedCar.sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
usedCar.zh:
Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Mäkinen版是Lancer系列
的巅峰车型。

它的名字来自Tommi Mäkinen，一位驾驶着Lancer Evo
在世界拉力锦标赛中四度夺冠的传奇车手。

Mitsubishi生产此车型的目的便是为了
向他的成就致敬。

这辆车基于Lancer Evolution VI，但配备了
更硬的悬挂。

纵观该系列所有车型，只有这辆车和Evo V被
认为是“最刺激的柏油路面克星”。

catch.en: Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.
catch.zh: 可选的车体条纹让这款Tommi Makinen版显得尤为亮眼。

vehicleCollection.en:
Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.

This special edition of the Lancer Evolution VI was introduced to celebrate Tommi Mäkinen’s remarkable achievement of four consecutive WRC drivers’ championships. Tailored for tarmac rallies, its ride height was lowered by 0.4 inches, and low-end torque was increased to enhance everyday drivability. Limited to 2,500 units, it featured an exclusive red body color and matching seats, special alloy wheels, and a large-diameter exhaust silencer, making it as distinctive as it was capable.

long.en: This special edition of the Lancer Evolution VI was introduced to celebrate Tommi Mäkinen’s remarkable achievement of four consecutive WRC drivers’ championships. Tailored for tarmac rallies, its ride height was lowered by 0.4 inches, and low-end torque was increased to enhance everyday drivability. Limited to 2,500 units, it featured an exclusive red body color and matching seats, special alloy wheels, and a large-diameter exhaust silencer, making it as distinctive as it was capable.

conversation.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.

The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.

The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"

This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

A small bit of triva!!
.

在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaroi的名义专门生产座椅！

这是个

cars.nameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
cars.nameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04

brandCentral.en:
Mitsubishi cars adorned with the "MR" badge (Mitsubishi Racing)
 placed a high priority on high performance.

The first Lancer Evolution to include an MR car to its model
lineup was the Evo VIII MR.

The Lancer Evolution VIII MR boasted world-class performance,
bred from the company's winning rally race car.

With its sporty-tuned suspension, improved aerodynamics,
more responsive engine, and lightweight aluminum roof...

...the car was truly a world-class sports car,
albeit with four doors.

To this day, not many sports cars can outperform
the Lancer Evolution VIII MR on the race track.
brandCentral.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
brandCentral.zh:
带有“MR”（Mitsubishi Racing）标志的Mitsubishi车型
以其高性能而著称。

第一款获得这一殊荣的Lancer Evolution
便是Evo VIII MR……

其标准车型本就是四驱运动型轿车中的世界级之作。

MR版本通过强化悬挂系统、改进空气动力学设计、
提高引擎响应速度和采用铝合金车顶……

打造出一款经过精细调校的轻量化高性能车型。

即使放到今天，在速度和驾驶乐趣方面能与之媲美的
车型也不多见。

usedCar.en:
This car was the first Lancer Evolution to receive
Mitsubishi’s high-performance MR badge.

Thanks to its 4G63 turbocharged inline-4, this rally-inspired
machine accelerated like a sports car.

The Lancer Evolution VIII marked a major leap from  the
previous model, thanks to its Super AYC torque control system.

Over any driving surface, the sedan was fast and easy to control.

The MR version did away with many luxury comforts, instead
placing a high priority on speed.

Not only did it boast a sportier suspension and lightweight
aluminum roof, the engine had more punch in the low-to-mid range.

With the company's excellent all-wheel-drive system and Super AYC,
the Lancer Evolution VIII was indeed a rally car for the street.
usedCar.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
usedCar.zh:
这款车型是第一辆获得Mitsubishi运动级“MR”命名的
Lancer Evolution。

它不仅能在各种路面上达到惊人的速度，还拥有梦幻般出色
的转弯性能。

Lancer Evolution VIII相较于Evo VII实现了重大突破，
配备了Super AYC（主动偏航控制）扭矩控制系统……

以及强劲的4G63涡轮增压引擎。

这款MR版本的设计更加简洁，与其高性能的定位相符。

除了改进的悬挂系统和更换为铝合金车顶外，MR版本
在低中转速范围内响应更为灵敏……

其四轮驱动系统和AYC系统也经过了精心调校，
达到了近乎完美的状态。

catch.en: The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.
catch.zh: Lancer Evo VIII的最终进化，更新了悬架系统，具有更低的重心。

vehicleCollection.en:
The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.

The eighth-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 2003. Refinements to the ACD (Active Center Differential) and AYC (Active Yaw Control) systems improved both handling and ride comfort. The 4G63 engine delivered up to 289.3 ft-lb of torque, and with the addition of a new 6-speed manual transmission, the car was better equipped than ever to perform in a wide range of driving conditions.

The 4G63 engine delivered up to 289.3 ft-lb of torque, and with the addition of a new 6-speed manual transmission, the car was better equipped than ever to perform in a wide range of driving conditions.

catch.en: Boasting 394.5 HP and an extremely limited production run, this is the ultimate R33 GT-R from Nismo.
catch.zh: 这款NISMO打造的终极R33 GT-R拥有400 PS的动力，只生产了极其有限的数量。

vehicleCollection.en:
Boasting 394.5 HP and an extremely limited production run, this is the ultimate R33 GT-R from Nismo.

In an era when Japanese passenger cars were generally capped at 276.1 HP, NISMO defied convention with a fully tuned machine delivering 394.5 HP. At its heart was the RB-X GT2, an enlarged 2.8-liter evolution of the revered RB26, paired with an N1-spec turbocharger. The suspension setup featured Bilstein dampers, reinforced by upgraded stabilizers and bushings. Flared fenders accommodated the wider tires, offering a visual cue to the car’s formidable capabilities.

The suspension setup featured Bilstein dampers, reinforced by upgraded stabilizers and bushings. Flared fenders accommodated the wider tires, offering a visual cue to the car’s formidable capabilities.

conversation.en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Natually, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

以打造出结合诸多赛车技术的量产车而闻名。

2004年，为纪念成立20周年，Nismo推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。

在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。

如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！
]

conversation.en:
Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan
of that car.

Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.

But then, in 2004, it came back…

...when Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all
of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.

That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!

Apparently, dvelopment started on this project
back in 1999.

In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height
of its racing prowess!

To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this

dialogues.en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Natually, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!

To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this

brandCentral.en:
Surely you’ve heard of Nismo, right? Nissan’s legendary
motorsports division?

In 2004, Nismo released the R34 GT-R Z-tune, the ultimate
complete tuner car to mark its 20th anniversary.

Since the Z-tune was based on the discontinued R34 Skyline GT-R,
it needed to be crafted from chosen pre-owned examples.

But that didn’t make it any less of a Nismo. Take the engine, for
example—a 2.8-liter RB26DETT, purpose-built for Super GT.

There was also the precision spot welding, CFRP parts, re-tuned
suspension and brakes, and newly developed aero parts.

Fewer than 20 were ever built, yet the Z-tune became a defining
milestone in the second generation of the GT-R legacy.
brandCentral.zh:
你一定听说过Nismo吧？就是Nissan那个传奇的
赛车运动部门。

2004年，Nismo推出了R34 GT-R Z-tune，这款终极完全体
车型是为了纪念该部门在汽车创新领域深耕20年的成果。

由于Z-tune是基于已经停产的R34 Skyline GT-R打造的，
只能从精心挑选的二手车中寻找合适的车型作为基础。

但这丝毫不影响它的“Nismo”血统。就拿引擎来说——
这台2.8L RB26DETT与GT500比赛中使用的引擎相同。

更不用提车身采用了点焊工艺、CFRP碳纤维部件、重新
调校的悬挂和制动系统，以及全新的空气动力学套件。

虽然产量不足20台，但Z-tune无疑成为了
GT-R第二代车型中的里程碑式作品。

vehicleCollection.en:
This GT-R bows out with the ultimate complete tuned model.

The Nismp R34 GT-R Z-tune stood as the ultimate expression of Nissan’s tuning prowess — a fully re-engineered, limited-production masterpiece based on the R34 Skyline GT-R.  Under the hood, the standard RB26DETT engine was replaced with a 2.8-liter version of the RB26DETT Kai-Z2, derived from Nissan’s GT500 race program. Nismo reinforced the chassis with additional spot welds and strategically integrated carbon fiber components, while fine-tuning the suspension and braking systems to deliver razor-sharp performance. The result was a road-going GT-R with motorsport DNA baked into every detail. Including the original prototype, only 19 units were ever built, making the Z-tune one of the rarest and most revered GT-Rs ever created.

Nismo reinforced the chassis with additional spot welds and strategically integrated carbon fiber components, while fine-tuning the suspension and braking systems to deliver razor-sharp performance. The result was a road-going GT-R with motorsport DNA baked into every detail. Including the original prototype, only 19 units were ever built, making the Z-tune one of the rarest and most revered GT-Rs ever created.
long.zh: NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune经过了全方位改装，使用的套件都是完全定制的。这台车以R34 Skyline GT-R为基础进行打造，但引擎采用了GT500级别的RB26DETT Kai-Z2引擎的2.8升版本。通过增加点焊数量、添置更多碳纤维部件，使得车身刚性得到了显著提升，此外还对悬挂和制动系统进行精细调校，彰显了NISMO对改装的执着追求。包含最初的样车在内，这款车仅生产了19辆。

This theme was created by our London studio in a short time.

Indeed, it seems as if they all had a future
GT-R in mind.

or FR machine, but a front-mid-engine 4WD car.

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT is the product of Nissan's long
and storied GT and race car traditions.

London-based Nissan Design Europe developed the overall
design and style...

While Japan-based Nissan engineers handled the
technical minutiae.

This vehicle has a unique 'performance hybrid FR-4WD'
layout...

And features a V6 twin-turbo engine that operates in
conjunction with three motors.

The front left and right motors operate independently.

These innovations ensure that the car handles marvellously,
even at extremely high speeds.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan在制造GT和赛车方面拥有历史悠久的传统，而这款
Nissan Concept 2020 VGT就是他们的集大成之作。

总部设立于伦敦的Nissan Design Europe团队负责开发整车的外观
设计和风格……

而日本的Nissan工程团队则负责所有的技术细节。

这款车采用了独特的“性能混动前置后驱-四驱”布局……

并安装了一台V6双涡轮增压引擎，与三部电机搭配工作，

而且位于前部左右的两台电机可以独立工作。

这些革新让这辆车拥有了出神入化的操控性，即便在极
高速的情况下也体验非凡。\

catch.en: A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.

vehicleCollection.en:
A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.

This Vision Gran Turismo concept offered a glimpse into Nissan’s not-too-distant future, brought to life through a collaboration between a youthful team of British designers and Japanese engineers. Its powertrain fuses a twin-turbo V-6 with three electric motors, forming a high-performance hybrid FR-4WD system. With active suspension maximizing its aerodynamic potential, the car remains poised to deliver its full performance the instant the driver calls upon it.
