The Nissan 180SX was based on the S13 Silvia.

Unlike the notchback Silvia, this car features an
exquisite fastback design.

Thanks to its rear-wheel-drive layout, it handles like a true
sports car, making it a favorite among the drift crowd.

The engine is a turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-4 that produces
<175ps>, so it had plenty of punch off the line.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan 180SX是S13 Silvia的衍生车型。

不同于凹背的Silvia，这款双门跑车
采用了掀背风格。

作为一款后驱车，它的操控性优良，
调校得当后的牵引力也十足。

它还是一台可靠的漂移车，许多喜欢漂移的车手都对它情有独钟。

catch.en: This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.
catch.zh: 这款前置后驱特殊车型被赋予了与其姐妹车Silvia完全不同的特征。

vehicleCollection.en:
This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.

The 180SX arrived in March 1989 as the liftback variant of the S13 Silvia. Initially set to end production alongside the S13, it was given new life as demand continued abroad. The U.S.-market 240SX, powered by a 2.4-liter engine, remained popular, prompting Nissan to decouple the 180SX from the Silvia lineage. The 180SX became a favorite among enthusiasts who personalized it to suit their tastes and style.

conversation.en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.

It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.

And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...

...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!

The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Hauhito Yanagida.

The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.

And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.

The even became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of theˉost legendary mentsin motorsports.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh: 在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的 奇迹。 当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士 高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。 面对组别6和组别7类别的对手…… 一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获 了胜利！ 这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人} 在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中 表现得异常出色…… 最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！ 这场比赛在日本被称为“A中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具 传奇色彩的时刻之一。

usedCar.en:
The Nissan S30 is one of the finest and most popular
Japanese sports cars ever produced.

This higher-performance 240Z variant, the 240ZG, features a
2.4L straight-six engine.

Its extended front was one of the more notable additions,
and it is lovingly referred to as the 'G-nose'.

This feature increased the car's total length by about
<190mm> compared to the 240Z.

The nose isn't just for looks—its aerodynamic properties
boost the 240ZG's top speed by about <5km/h>.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan S30是有史以来最优秀、
最受欢迎的日产跑车之一。

这款高性能的240Z衍生型——240ZG，搭载了一台
2.4升直列六缸引擎。

这辆车的加长车头是最明显的变化之一，
许多人亲切地称之为“G-nose”。

相比240Z，这一改动使车辆的
总长度延伸了<190mm>。

它的“大鼻子”不单是为了好看——这一改动还优化了
车身的空气动力特性，使240ZG的最高时速提升了大约<5km/h>。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.

Making its debut in 1969, the Fairlady Z was among the first Japanese automobiles to make a mark on the international stage. The standout variant was the Z 432, which featured the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine—borrowed from the Prince R380—rather than the standard L-type unit. Producing just under 157.8 HP, it also proved its mettle in motorsports competition. The 240Z, the U.S.-spec version powered by a 2.4-liter engine, helped cement the Z’s reputation after strong showings in the Safari and Monte Carlo rallies.

conversation.en:
Design-wise, the Z34 sports a more classic look
than the Z33.

First of all, its wheelbase has been shortened
by <100mm>...

Giving it long-nose proportions.

And the shape of its roof, with the window decal
at the very front...

Is consciously taken from the S30.

In contrast, the massive rear fender, which squeezes
the shape of the body from front to rear...

Lends to it an aggressiveness never before
seen in a Z-car.

Of course, it wasn’t easy evolving the Z33's styling.

But in short, if the Z33 evoked modern elegance...

The Z34 was more of an authentic FR sports car
with added aggressiveness.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。

首先，轴距缩短了<100mm>……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。

相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。

当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

brandCentral.en:
This sixth-generation 2009 370Z was known in-house as the Z34.

It came with a redesigned naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-6.

This engine produced <336ps>, which represented a significant
bump from the 3.5-liter unit of its predecessor.

It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox
with a new rev-matching technology.

Called SynchroRev, it automatically matched engine speed
to wheel speed during downshifts.

This allowed the driver to perform perfect downshifts without
having to employ a technique called heel-and-toe.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第六代2008 Fairlady Z也被称为Z34。

其全新设计的3.7升V6自然进气引擎……

可提供<336ps>的最大输出功率，远远超过其前作Z33……

还有六速手动变速箱采用的技术也是前所未有的。

这项技术能够在每次车手换档时自动调整引擎的旋转……

不需要车手的跟趾动作，就能实现顺滑的降档补油！

usedCar.en:
The 370Z, called the Fairlady Z in Japan, is shorter than
its predecessor, the 350Z, but just as good looking.

Its shortened wheelbase helps it to be more agile, making it
easy to control on the race track.

But don't worry if you think that its small body results
in less stability, because that isn't the case at all.

In fact, the car actually feels more solid through corners
and remains composed in a straight line at high speeds.

And don't forget about the powerful 3.7-liter naturally-aspirated
V-6 under its hood, which pumps out more than <330ps>.
usedCar.zh:
370Z——在日本本土被为“Fairlady Z Z34”的车型。
相较350Z，它的轴距和车长更短。

这不仅使得该车的外观显得更加圆润、灵巧，
还令这辆车的过弯性能变得更迅敏。

别担心，这辆车的稳定性并没有
因此减退分毫。

它搭载的3.7升自然吸气V6引擎动力澎湃，
能产生超过<330ps>的马力。

如果这是你的第一辆后驱车，
那你大可放心开着它驰骋！

usedCar.en:
Not many sports cars in the world can boast a history
spanning 50 years, especially from Japan.

But one of them is the Nissan Z, called the Fairlady Z
in its home market.

In 1989, Nissan introduced the fourth-generation model,
the 300ZX, which came powered by...

...a twin-turbocharged V-6, making it the first Z to
be offered with forced induction.

This resulted in the engine becoming the first to reach the
<280ps> limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.
usedCar.zh:
世界上很少有跑车的历史
能超过50年。

Nissan Z型车，或者说 “Fairlady Z”——
就是罕见的例外之一。

这辆第四代300ZX于1989
年上市。

它搭载的双涡轮增压V6引擎
不可小觑。

这也是在日本厂商达成不成文的<280ps>君子协定
后上市的第一款引擎。

catch.en: With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.
catch.zh: 改用宽体车身之后，第四代Z成为了面向全球市场的跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.

The fourth-generation Fairlady Z was designed for the global market, largely disregarding the size restrictions of the Japanese domestic segment. Its wider body allowed for a broader track, unlocking improved cornering capabilities. Mounted in the front was a 3.0-liter V-6, delivering 226.8 HP in the naturally-aspirated version and 276.1 HP in the twin-turbo model.

long.en: The fourth-generation Fairlady Z was designed for the global market, largely disregarding the size restrictions of the Japanese domestic segment. Its wider body allowed for a broader track, unlocking improved cornering capabilities. Mounted in the front was a 3.0-liter V-6, delivering 226.8 HP in the naturally-aspirated version and 276.1 HP in the twin-turbo model.
long.zh: 第四代Fairlady Z是专门针对全球市场所设计，基本上没有考虑日本国内的尺寸限制。其较宽的车身让增加轮距成为可能，也让它的过弯性能更上层楼。动力方面，它采用了一部3升V6前中置引擎，其自然进气版本可以输出230 PS，而双涡轮增压版本则可以输出280 PS。

collection.en:
The first model of the Nissan Z series was known
as the type S30.

Of all the S30s, this Z432 is particularly special.

With a classic Z-series design...

It is powered by the same S20 2L inline six-cylinder
engine seen in the Skyline GT-Rs of its day.

The four valves per cylinder...

Three carburettors...

And two cams don’t just prove its high performance.

These numbers are also the origin of the 'Z432'
model name.

The fact that it had a GT-R engine was reflected i its
price, more than double that of standard S30s.

Furthermore, only 419 of the Z432s were produced,
making it the most valuable of the first-gen Zs.

There was also a higher performance competition model
of the Z432, the Z432R.

An extremelyrare variant, it tends to fetch a very
handsome price at auctions.
collection.zh:
Nissan Z系列的第一款车型被称为type S30。

在所有S30车型中，Z432显得格外耀眼。

在保留了Z系列经典设计的同时……

它搭载了当时同样用于Skyline GT-R的
S20 2升直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎每个气缸有4个阀门……

3个化油器……

和2个凸轮，足以保证它的高性能。

这些数字也是“Z432”车型名称的来源。

配备GT-R同款高性能引擎的代价反映在其售价上，
它的定价是标准S30的两倍以上。

此外，Z432只生产了419辆，
使其成为所有第一代Z系列中最有价值的车型。

Z432还推出过一款性能更出色的竞赛版，
即Z432R。

其存世量极少，当它出现在拍卖会上时
hk能拍出相当可观的价格。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.

Introduced in 1969 as the top-grade variant of the Fairlady Z, the Z 432 was powered by the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine, producing 157.8 HP. Based on the powerplant of Nissan’s R380 race car, the engine gave the car a zero-to-1312.3 ft time of 15.8 seconds and registered a top speed of 130.5 mph. The Z 432 also proved itself in competitive racing. A lightweight version—the Z 432 R—was produced in limited numbers, featuring fiberglass panels and acrylic components to shed weight.

long.en: Introduced in 1969 as the top-grade variant of the Fairlady Z, the Z 432 was powered by the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine, producing 157.8 HP. Based on the powerplant of Nissan’s R380 race car, the engine gave the car a zero-to-1312.3 ft time of 15.8 seconds and registered a top speed of 130.5 mph. The Z 432 also proved itself in competitive racing. A lightweight version—the Z 432 R—was produced in limited numbers, featuring fiberglass panels and acrylic components to shed weight.
long.zh: Z 432在1969年作为Fairlady Z的顶配版推出，搭载直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴“S20”引擎（160 PS）。该引擎源自Nissan R380赛车，0-400 米加速时间为15.8秒，最高时速达210 公里/小时。这台引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。此外，还有一款采用玻璃纤维与亚克力材料进行部件减重的Z 432 R车型，但销量寥寥。

The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notabe Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hnts
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of thisʇade te Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

gnzble as a Z fom any angle.<nextid1800306 type=֙

conversation.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。

作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。

因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。

它的设计v言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。

这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代i

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

brandCentral.en:
This fifth-generation Nissan Fairlady Z was codenamed Z33.
We know it better as the 350Z.

The Z was temporarily discontinued in 2000 with the 300ZX,
codenamed Z32.

It was revived in 2002 with the 350Z.

This specific model is from 2007, and it features massive
improvements to its naturally-aspirated V-6 powerplant.

In fact, this little beauty is capable of more than <300ps>
with added torque to make it quick off the line.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第五代日产Fairlady Z在日本被称为Z33，
而在日本以外地区则被称为350Z。

在90年代末和21世纪初之间，
Fairlady或“Z-car”系列逐渐退出了市场……

而现在，Z系列将因为新350Z的出现得以复苏！

这一车款是2007年推出的，
特点是对自然进气的V6引擎进行了大规模改进。

事实上，由于扭矩的增加，
这辆娇小尤物的动力已经超过了<300ps>！

usedCar.en:
The Nissan 350Z—known as the Fairlady Z (Z33) in Japan—
is impressive on both road and track.

With a naturally-aspirated engine that sends power to the
rear wheels, balance is the name of its game.

The 3.5-liter V-6 was retuned for this 2007 model.

So it possesses better top-end performance, partly because
the redline was raised.

The end result was the company's first naturally-aspirated
V-6 capable of producing more than <300ps>.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan 350Z——这款在日本本土被称为“Fairlady Z (Z33)”
的车子，几乎就是为赛道而生的。

这要归功于它搭载的大排量自然吸气引擎和
后驱系统。

2007年版的350Z搭载了重新设计的V6引擎。

改进版引擎的动力更强，转速区间更高。

这也是Nissan生产的第一款马力达到<300ps>
以上的自然吸气V6引擎。

catch.en: This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.
catch.zh: 经过调校的Z33配备了新一代的VQ35HR引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.

An enhanced version of the Z33 Fairlady Z arrived in 2007. At its heart was the new VQ35HR engine, which raised output to 308.7 HP. A redesigned intake manifold and reduced internal friction refined the engine’s character, especially at high revs. Revised suspension settings further contributed to a flatter, more composed ride, while maintaining the car’s trademark agility.

long.en: An enhanced version of the Z33 Fairlady Z arrived in 2007. At its heart was the new VQ35HR engine, which raised output to 308.7 HP. The 2008 Nissan Xanavi Nismo GT-R has certainly made its
mark on Super GT history.

This is the car that brought Nissan victory in the 2008
championship!

It comes with a 4.5L V8 engine that's based on the VK45DE...

And unlike the four-wheel drive GT-R, this model features
a front-engine, rear-wheel drive layout.
brandCentral.zh:
2008 Nissan Xanavi Nismo GT-R无疑在Super GT的历史上留下了
自己的印记。

这台车为Nissan带来了2008年Super GT锦标赛的胜利！

此车配备了基于VK45DE引擎改造而成的4.5L V8引擎……

而且与四轮驱动的GT-R不同，这款车型采用的是前置发引
擎、后轮驱动的布局。

catch.en: This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.
catch.zh: 第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

vehicleCollection.en:
This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.

After a surprise return to competition, the Nissan GT-R made its debut in the 2008 Super GT Championship. In preparation for upcoming regulation changes, the car received a pipe frame chassis and equipped with the same 4.5-liter V-8 previously used in the Z. The XANAVI NISMO demonstrated remarkable pace from the opening round and ultimately secured the drivers’ championship title.

long.en: After a surprise return to competition, the Nissan GT-R made its debut in the 2008 Super GT Championship. In preparation for upcoming regulation changes, the car received a pipe frame chassis and equipped with the same 4.5-liter V-8 previously used in the Z. The XANAVI NISMO demonstrated remarkable pace from the opening round and ultimately secured the drivers’ championship title.
long.zh: 在完成令人惊喜的回归后，Nissan GT-R开始参加2008赛季Super GT锦标赛。为了针对下一年的规则改动提前做好准备，这款车采用了管式框架车身，并安装了一台沿用自Z车型的4.5升V8引擎。从第一轮起，Xanavi Nismo便展现出了不可思议的实力，并一路势如破竹般拿下了车手冠军。

conversation.en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.

Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.

In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.

埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。

这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，

并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。

这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

conversation.en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.

Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.

It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.

这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是《跑车浪漫旅》当中比较受欢迎的一款R34天际线……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。

在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。

但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。

这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.

Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...

...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.

Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.

Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?

That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).

It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！

这是参加过1999年全日本GT锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！

驾驶23号Pennzoil的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，

艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。

对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？

有很多Nissan的超级跑车都是23号对不对？
但第一辆使用23作为号码的……

没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！
j

dialogues.en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.

Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.

It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.
0
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是《跑车浪漫旅》当中比较受欢迎的一款R34天际线……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。

在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。

但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。

这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

collection.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R has a storied racing history.

It established a tradition that was carried on by the
second-generation GT-R.

The 1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R was powered by
the RB26DETT, an inline-6 engine.

It won the All Japan Grand Touring Championship.

It remains one of the most consistent race cars to
ever wage war in the competitive series.

While the R34 GT-R took the title again
in 2003, which was its final year...

...the battle-tested engine under its hood had lready
been swapped in favor of a V-6 powerplant.

This means that this 1999 Pennzoil was the last GT-R
to win the series title with the iconic inline-6.

There's just something special about this inline-6-powered model.
For me, its achievements ae nothing short of legendary.
collection.zh:
日产Skyline GT-R曾拥有过一段传奇般的赛车历史。

它确立了这一传统，且在第二代GT-R上
得以延续。

1999年的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R由一台直列6缸RB26DETT引擎
提供动力，

一举夺得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

在这一年中，它表现出了坚如磐石的性能，
证明了自己是天生赢家。

当它在2003年再次夺冠时，
这一代GT-R也步入了末年，

连引擎都已经换成了新的V6引擎。

这意味着这台1999年的Pennzoil是最后一台搭载Nissan标志性
直列6缸引擎赢得系列赛冠军的GT-R。

这款直列6缸车型非常特殊。在我看来，
它的成就本身已是个传奇。

catch.en: This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.
catch.zh: 通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.

This R34 GT-R took to the track in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship. Compared to the previous R33 model, its wheelbase was shortened by 2.2 inches, and the engine was repositioned using a shallow oil pan—enhancements that significantly boosted overall performance. At Round 4 held at Mine Circuit, Érik Comas and Satoshi Motoyama claimed a decisive victory in the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, securing Comas his second consecutive drivers' title.

long.en: This R34 GT-R took to the track in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship. Compared to the previous R33 model, its wheelbase was shortened by 2.2 inches, and the engine was repositioned using a shallow oil pan—enhancements that significantly boosted overall performance. At Round 4 held at Mine Circuit, Érik Comas and Satoshi Motoyama claimed a decisive victory in the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, securing Comas his second consecutive drivers' title.
long.zh: 这款R34型GT-R参加了1999年全日本GT锦标赛。相比前代R33车型，轴距缩短了55毫米，因为采用浅油底壳调整了引擎位置，显著提升了整体性能。在第4轮Mine Circuit赛道上，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶Pennzoil NISMO GT-R夺得胜利，科马斯还因此蝉联了车手冠军。

vehicleCollection.zh:
通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

这款R34型GT-R参加了1999年全日本GT锦标赛。相比前代R33车型，轴距缩短了55毫米，因为采用浅油底壳调整了引擎位置，显著提升了整体性能。在第4轮Mine Circuit赛道上，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶Pennzoil NISMO GT-R夺得胜利，科马斯还因此蝉联了车手冠军。

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.4 Gran Turismo original racing car was built using
the Nissan GT-R as its base.

The characteristic fog lights of this endurance racer are
a prominent feature of the front bumper.

With the comfortable handling expected from a 4WD vehicle,
this reliable car is well-suited for longer races.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车是以日产GT-R为基础
制造的。

这辆耐力赛车型的雾灯相当有特色，成为了前保险杠的
亮点。

这辆车不仅具备四轮驱动车型应有的舒适操控感，在长
途赛事中也相当可靠。

catch.en: Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.
catch.zh: 2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been adapted for Gr.4 competition in this Gran Turismo Original. Its 4-wheel-drive system delivered exceptional handling stability, while endurance racing features—such as integrated fog lamps—make it a well-rounded machine built for long-distance performance.

long.en: Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been adapted for Gr.4 competition in this Gran Turismo Original. Its 4-wheel-drive system delivered exceptional handling stability, while endurance racing features—such as integrated fog lamps—make it a well-rounded machine built for long-distance performance.
long.zh: 这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.4组别进行了改装。四轮驱动系统带来稳定的操控，而雾灯等各种耐力赛部件让这台车成为长距离比赛的完美车款。

vehicleCollection.zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.4组别进行了改装。四轮驱动系统带来稳定的操控，而雾灯等各种耐力赛部件让这台车成为长距离比赛的完美车款。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally monster
is based on the Nissan GT-R.

It comes equipped with a rally suspension system,
tuned specifically for driving on the dirt.

It also has an extra set of four fog lamps, making it
ready to race in the dead of night.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Nissan GT-R开发。

它安装了拉力赛专用悬挂系统，所有的调校都围绕提高
泥地路面驾驶响应而展开。

额外安装的一组四盏雾灯是参加夜间赛事的完美搭档。

catch.en: This Gr.B design reimagines the Nissan GT-R as a dedicated off-road race machine.
catch.zh: 以Gr.B规格设计的这款车型将Nissan GT-R重新塑造成了一辆火力全开的越野赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gr.B design reimagines the Nissan GT-R as a dedicated off-road race machine.

Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been reimagined for Gr.B competition in this Gran Turismo Original. The most striking exterior changes includes quad fog lamps mounted on the bonnet and large auxiliary lamps flanking the front bumper, perfect for illuminating night rally stages. Its already exceptional 4-wheel-drive system gives the GT-R a distinct advantage in the world of rallying.

long.en: Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been reimagined for Gr.B competition in this Gran Turismo Original. The most striking exterior changes includes quad fog lamps mounted on the bonnet and large auxiliary lamps flanking the front bumper, perfect for illuminating night rally stages. Its already exceptional 4-wheel-drive system gives the GT-R a distinct advantage in the world of rallying.
long.zh: 这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.B组别进行了改装。外观上最显著的改变就是为了在夜间赛场上照亮赛道，在引擎盖上加装了四盏雾灯，以及在保险杠两侧分别加装了一盏大号雾灯。GT-R的四轮驱动系统原本已经非常优越，让它在拉力赛场上也独具优势。

vehicleCollection.zh:
以Gr.B规格设计的这款车型将Nissan GT-R重新塑造成了一辆火力全开的越野赛车。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.B组别进行了改装。外观上最显著的改变就是为了在夜间赛场上照亮赛道，在引擎盖上加装了四盏雾灯，以及在保险杠两侧分别加装了一盏大号雾灯。GT-R的四轮驱动系统原本已经非常优越，让它在拉力赛场上也独具优势。

Is this GT-R LM NISMO yours by any chance?

conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

啊，这位先生，您是不是……Nissan的

conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
嗨。很高兴见到你们。
我是中村史郎。
!

conversation.en:
It's an honour to meet you!

Shiro-san worked on the Nissan Fairlady Z and the GT-R.

He also designed the Isuzu 4200R concept car.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
能认识您真是太荣幸了！

史郎先生曾经致力于Nissan Fairlady Z和GT-R的设计工作，

还设计了Isuzu 4200R概念车。

conversation.en:
Remember the DeltaWing from the 24 Hours of Le Mans?

Well, this car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly novel idea, one that sort of
went over the heads of regular folks.

This was an FF car on which designer and engineer
Ben Bowlby was given total control.

And it ended up a simple thing, which I quite like.

The proportions are unique and well-executed,
especially from the rear-quarter view.

This isn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but after
talking things over with Ben...

It was given a Vmotion grille, and four round taillights,
which added some Nissan GT-R flavour.

Unfortunately, the car faile to perform at Le Mans,
and was scontineda a yer.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。

我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得喜欢。

它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通r合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部g
我们也安Io了r盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。

这车是你的？！
!

Jeremy loves nothing more than geeking out about racing.
N

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
是杰里米啊！真是什么好车都逃不出你的法眼啊！

杰里米就是喜欢赛车，他是名副其实的赛车死忠粉！

conversation.en:
Oh man, I mean, I can't help myself when there's
a car like this sitting right in front of me!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
哎呀，兄弟，我是说，我一见到这样不得了的车，就控
制不住自己！

conversation.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
E
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，

设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。

不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。

雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan GT-R LM Nismo made its debut at the 24 Hours of
Le Mans in 2015...

Where it competed in the Le Mans Prototype 1 Hybrid class.

To the surprise of many, it utilised a front-engine
front-wheel drive layout.

It was an unusual design for an LMP1 vehicle, and a number
of problems had to be resolved before it was ready.

While the Nismo failed to meet expectations in the race, it
nevertheless left a lasting impression on all who saw it.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan GT-R LM Nismo在2015年的勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，

参加了勒芒原型车1级（LMP1）混合动力组的比赛。

令许多人感到惊讶的是，该车居然采用了前置引擎前轮
驱动的布局。

对于LMP1车辆来说，这是一个非常规的设计，需要解决为
数不少的问题，才能达到良好的竞技状态。

虽然它最终未能在比赛中取得预期的成绩，但还是给所
有看到它的人留下了深刻印象。

catch.en: A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.
catch.zh: 前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

vehicleCollection.en:
A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.

In spring 2014, Nissan announced its return to the 24 Hours of Le Mans with a car bearing the GT-R nameplate. The GT-R LM NISMO broke convention with its radical front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout. Its carbon-fiber body, designed by Ben Bowlby—the mind behind the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC—housed a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 paired with an energy recovery system. Weighing in at the minimum 1940 lbs, it contended for overall victory on motorsports' most demanding stage.

long.en: In spring 2014, Nissan announced its return to the 24 Hours of Le Mans with a car bearing the GT-R nameplate. The GT-R LM NISMO broke convention with its radical front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout. Its carbon-fiber body, designed by Ben Bowlby—the mind behind the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC—housed a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 paired with an energy recovery system. Weighing in at the minimum 1940 lbs, it contended for overall victory on motorsports' most demanding stage.
long.zh: 2014年春季，Nissan宣布将派遣GT-R赛车征战勒芒24小时耐力赛。这辆GT-R LM Nismo采用了颠覆性的前置引擎前轮驱动架构。碳纤维车身由DeltaWing和ZEOD RC的设计师本·鲍尔比操刀设计，搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎和能量回收系统。车重达到最低限重880 公斤，此车参加了争夺总冠军的角逐。

vehicleCollection.zh:
前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

2014年春季，Nissan宣布将派遣GT-R赛车征战勒芒24小时耐力赛。这辆GT-R LM Nismo采用了颠覆性的前置引擎前轮驱动架构。碳纤维车身由DeltaWing和ZEOD RC的设计师本·鲍尔比操刀设计，搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎和能量回收系统。车重达到最低限重880 公斤，此车参加了争夺总冠军的角逐。

brandCentral.en:
This particular GT-R was fine-tuned by Nissan's motorsports
division, NISMO to shine on the race track.

For starters, it uses the same turbochargers as
the GT-R GT3 race car.

This allows the V-6 engine to produce an incredible <600ps>
and <66kgm> of torque.

The 2017 model featured enhanced rigidity
and a competition-tuned suspension.

It set an amazing lap time of 7 minutes and 8.679 seconds
at the Nürburgring.

This actually set a record for a production vehicle
at the time!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GT-R由Nissan的传奇团队NISMO针对比赛用途进行了精细调校。

它甚至用上了GT3组别赛车的同款涡轮增压器，

将引擎的每一滴动力都榨取了出来，用于输出<600ps>的动力
和<66kgm>的扭矩。

这辆2017款车型的刚性接受了强化，悬挂系统也按照比赛
标准进行了调校。

它在纽博格林赛道上跑出了7:8.679的最佳时间，
这个成绩为团队的实力提供了最佳佐证，

也创下了当时的量产车圈速纪录！`

catch.en: The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model.
catch.zh: 这款2017年的车型将GT-R的性能提升到了新的高度。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model.

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured a host of refinements throughout the car. While retaining its bonded body construction and engine specifications, the front window frame was reinforced to improve chassis rigidity. Comfort was also enhanced, making it more livable in urban settings while remaining sharp on the circuit. Aerodynamics saw notable improvements as well, and thanks to a comprehensive redesign, the body generated increased downforce at high speeds, further enhancing performance.

long.en: The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured a host of refinements throughout the car. While retaining its bonded body construction and engine specifications, the front window frame was reinforced to improve chassis rigidity. Comfort was also enhanced, making it more livable in urban settings while remaining sharp on the circuit. Aerodynamics saw notable improvements as well, and thanks to a comprehensive redesign, the body generated increased downforce at high speeds, further enhancing performance.
long.zh: 2017款GT-R Nismo对全车上下进行了改良。在保留其粘合车身结构和引擎规格的同时，前车窗框架的刚性得到了强化，城市和赛道的驾驶舒适性也获得改善。得益于工程师对外观进行全方位的重新设计，空气动力学效应也优化了不少，让车身在高速时也能产生更多下压力。

conversation.en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.

NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.

Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。

NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。

事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。

只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

usedCar.en:
This NISMO is the oh-so-elusive Skyline GT-R R32,
a car of near-mythic status.

It is the evolution of a production car designed
to win Group A touring car races.

Just 500 units were sold for its limited release in 1990.
But how did it differ from the standard model?

Well, it featured a front-bumper air duct to improve
engine cooling...

And a metal turbine to overcome high boost
pressure.

The addition of aerodynamic parts and the cutting of frills
ensured it was faster and more lightweight.

No doubt about it, this special edition was designed
to win races.

Built by NISMO, Nissan’s very own racing division,
this double-barrelled beauty is a true fan favourite.@
usedCar.zh:
这辆NISMO是一辆极为难得的Skyline GT-R R32，
堪称一代神车。

它是基于为赢得A组别房车比赛而设计的量产车改装而成的
衍生车型，

在1990年限量销售，仅售500辆。但它与标准车型
有什么不同呢？

它在前保险杠处增加了风道，以改善引擎冷却……

选用金属材质的涡轮内壁来承载高增压带来的压力。

空气动力学部件的添置和外观装饰物的削减
有效实现车身减重并提升速度。

毋庸置疑，这台特别版的设计初衷就是冲着赢得比赛去的。

这辆漂亮的双排气管跑车由Nissan自己的赛车部门NISMO打造，
是真爱车迷的心头好。

catch.en: A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing
catch.zh: 仅量产500辆的A组别赛事认证车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing

This homologation model of the R32 Skyline GT-R was produced in a limited run of just 500 units. With Group A victory as its target, engineers implemented comprehensive cooling enhancements, replaced the turbocharger’s turbine with a more durable metal unit, and reworked the body to optimize aerodynamics while shedding unnecessary weight. The result was a marked increase in performance, propelling the car to numerous touring car victories not only in Japan, but also across Europe and Australia.

long.en: This homologation model of the R32 Skyline GT-R was produced in a limited run of just 500 units. With Group A victory as its target, engineers implemented comprehensive cooling enhancements, replaced the turbocharger’s turbine with a more durable metal unit, and reworked the body to optimize aerodynamics while shedding unnecessary weight. The result was a marked increase in performance, propelling the car to numerous touring car victories not only in Japan, but also across Europe and Australia.
long.zh: 这款R32 Skyline GT-R的赛事认证版本限量生产500台。为在A组赛事中夺冠，全面升级了散热系统，涡轮增压器叶轮改用金属材质，车身也经过空气动力学优化并实现轻量化。性能提升十分显著，这款车不仅在日本本土，更在欧洲和澳大利亚的房车赛事中屡获佳绩。

vehicleCollection.zh:
仅量产500辆的A组别赛事认证车型。

这款R32 Skyline GT-R的赛事认证版本限量生产500台。为在A组赛事中夺冠，全面升级了散热系统，涡轮增压器叶轮改用金属材质，车身也经过空气动力学优化并实现轻量化。性能提升十分显著，这款车不仅在日本本土，更在欧洲和澳大利亚的房车赛事中屡获佳绩。

brandCentral.en:
The GT-R NISMO GT3 was designed for GT3-class racing
by Nissan's motorsports arm, NISMO.

The car you see here was prepared by a privateer, who
entered it in the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2013.

And, here's an interesting tidbit, it was driven by
Kazunori Yamauchi, producer of Gran Turismo!

Which is why it comes loaded with simulation data from
Gran Turismo.

You might say it's more than just a car. We consider it
an integral part of Gran Turismo history!
brandCentral.zh:
GT-R NISMO GT3是一辆由Nissan和NISMO共同设计的GT3类别赛车。

此车由一家私人车队开发，并在2013年参加了纽博格林24
小时耐力赛。

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典曾驾驶过此车，

上面甚至还装载了来自跑车浪漫旅的模拟数据。

可以说这不仅仅是一辆车——而是跑车浪漫旅历史
上不可或缺的一部分。

catch.en: Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013.
catch.zh: 在2013年里与山内一典共同征战纽博格林赛道的GT3。

vehicleCollection.en:
Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013.

In 2013, Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi partnered with Schulze Motorsport to take on the Nürburgring 24 Hours. The GT-R GT3 was specially prepared for the race, with support from Polyphony Digital’s technical team. Data gathered from the car’s performance was later used to enhance the realism of Gran Turismo’s simulation engine.

long.en: In 2013, Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi partnered with Schulze Motorsport to take on the Nürburgring 24 Hours. The GT-R GT3 was specially prepared for the race, with support from Polyphony Digital’s technical team. Data gathered from the car’s performance was later used to enhance the realism of Gran Turismo’s simulation engine.
long.zh: 2013年，《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典与Schulze Motorsport携手开始合作。依托于Polyphony Digital的技术实力支持，打造出了专门用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛的GT-R GT3。从这辆车收集的数据将被用于改进《跑车浪漫旅》的模拟引擎。

vehicleCollection.zh:
在2013年里与山内一典共同征战纽博格林赛道的GT3。

brandCentral.en:
A joint effort between Nissan and NISMO, the GT-R NISMO GT3 was
engineered to comply with FIA GT3 regulations as a race machine.

This particular example is the 2018 model.

You’ll notice that the power unit was repositioned lower and closer
to the center of the chassis to enhance handling dynamics.

The driver’s seat was also lowered, further sharpening steering
response and overall vehicle control.
brandCentral.zh:
GT-R NISMO GT3是Nissan和NISMO联手打造
的FIA GT3规则赛车。

这里这辆是2018年的版本。

可以注意到动力单元被安装在较低、靠中间的位置，
以改善操控性。

驾驶员的座位也被放低，使得转向响应更加灵敏。

catch.en: This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.
catch.zh: 这是GT-R的赛车规格版本，用于参加GT3组别的比赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.

The Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 was a production-based race machine built to FIA GT3 regulations, derived from the R35 GT-R. Later iterations were based on the GT-R NISMO, incorporating a dry sump system to lower the center of gravity and optimize weight distribution. Enhanced front-end rigidity and a newly designed suspension setup improved handling response. A revised engine bay layout boosted cooling efficiency, contributing to greater stability at high speeds.

long.en: The Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 was a production-based race machine built to FIA GT3 regulations, derived from the R35 GT-R. Later iterations were based on the GT-R NISMO, incorporating a dry sump system to lower the center of gravity and optimize weight distribution. Enhanced front-end rigidity and a newly designed suspension setup improved handling response. A revised engine bay layout boosted cooling efficiency, contributing to greater stability at high speeds.
long.zh: Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3是基于R35 GT-R开发的FIA GT3规格量产赛车。后期又将基础车型更换为GT-R NISMO，后者采用了干式油底壳系统以降低重心并优化配重。强化的前部刚性和全新设计的悬挂系统提升了操控响应度。引擎舱布局的调整提升了散热效率，同时有助于高速行驶下的稳定性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这是GT-R的赛车规格版本，用于参加GT3组别的比赛。

Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3是基于R35 GT-R开发的FIA GT3规格量产赛车。后期又将基础车型更换为GT-R NISMO，后者采用了干式油底壳系统以降低重心并优化配重。强化的前部刚性和全新设计的悬挂系统提升了操控响应度。引擎舱布局的调整提升了散热效率，同时有助于高速行驶下的稳定性。

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan MOTUL AUTECH GT-R was a familiar sight in the
2016 Super GT Series.

Its red paint scheme made it stand out among the other GT-Rs.

While it looks the same as the road-going car, underneath
the sheet metal things were very different.

It was adapted to conform to the requirements of the DTM,
the German Touring Car Masters series.

Therefore, it was rear-wheel drive, not AWD like the road car.
brandCentral.zh:
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R参加了日本最高级别的GT系列赛，
Super GT。

我们的这一款车亮相于2016年。

虽然在外观上保留了经典的GT-R元素，但内在截然不同，
应用了单体车壳设计。

这项改动是为了符合DTM——也就是德国房车大师赛的规范
要求。

另外，这辆车采用的是前置引擎和后轮驱动布局。[

catch.en: This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.
catch.zh: 在2016年Super GT赛事中由松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利驾驶。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.

The new regulations for 2014 required the GT500 car to share the same monocoque weight and key components with its DTM counterpart. As a result, the GT-R underwent significant revisions to meet GT500 specifications, with ongoing refinements continuing through to the 2016 model. During the 2014 and 2015 seasons, the MOTUL AUTECH GT-R secured back-to-back series championships. Aiming for a third consecutive title in 2016, the team ultimately concluded the season in third place overall.

long.en: The new regulations for 2014 required the GT500 car to share the same monocoque weight and key components with its DTM counterpart. As a result, the GT-R underwent significant revisions to meet GT500 specifications, with ongoing refinements continuing through to the 2016 model. During the 2014 and 2015 seasons, the MOTUL AUTECH GT-R secured back-to-back series championships. Aiming for a third consecutive title in 2016, the team ultimately concluded the season in third place overall.

brandCentral.en:
Key features of the 2017 GT-R include a refined engine
setup, and some key design improvements.

Ignition control has been optimised, resulting in a <20ps>
improvement in power over previous models.

Maximum power output is now an impressive <570ps>.

Significant changes to the exterior have also been
implemented.

The new front end is inspired by the GT-R Concept R35.
brandCentral.zh:
2017款GT-R的主要特性包括一套优化调校的引擎配置以及其
他方面的关键设计改良。

点火控制的优化让它的动力比前一代提升了<20ps>，

最大功率输出达到了惊人的<570ps>。

另外，车身上还应用了大量外观改进。

其全新的车头设计灵感来源于GT-R Concept R35。

catch.en: Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.
catch.zh: 2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

In 2016, the Nissan GT-R underwent its most significant facelift since its 2007 debut. The updated exterior achieved a refined balance of aerodynamics, downforce, and cooling efficiency. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 engine, now producing 565.1 HP, was paired with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, delivering smoother acceleration and sharper cornering performance. These deeper, more focused refinements embodied the essence of Japanese sports car engineering.

long.en: In 2016, the Nissan GT-R underwent its most significant facelift since its 2007 debut. The updated exterior achieved a refined balance of aerodynamics, downforce, and cooling efficiency. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 engine, now producing 565.1 HP, was paired with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, delivering smoother acceleration and sharper cornering performance. These deeper, more focused refinements embodied the essence of Japanese sports car engineering.
long.zh: 2016年，Nissan GT-R迎来了自2007年问世以来最大幅度的改款升级。外观设计在空气阻力、下压力和散热性能之间达到完美平衡。同时，输出573 PS的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎配合改进的6速双离合变速箱，带来更顺畅的加速和更优异的过弯表现。这些深层次的进化完美体现了日本跑车的独有特质。

vehicleCollection.zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

2016年，Nissan GT-R迎来了自2007年问世以来最大幅度的改款升级。外观设计在空气阻力、下压力和散热性能之间达到完美平衡。同时，输出573 PS的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎配合改进的6速双离合变速箱，带来更顺畅的加速和更优异的过弯表现。这些深层次的进化完美体现了日本跑车的独有特质。

brandCentral.en:
Since its debut in 2007, Nissan has consistently introduced
upgrades to the GT-R on an almost annual basis.

When the 15th-anniversary model was revealed in 2022,
many believed it would mark the end of an era.

Defying these expectations, Nissan continued to refine the
GT-R, leading to the release of the 2024 model.

Featuring a new aerodynamic body, the car benefits from
enhanced cooling and improved downforce.

The electronic suspension has also been further refined.

And the T-spec model incorporates carbon-ceramic brakes
and a specially calibrated suspension.

These advancements elevate the GT-R to new heights in the
evolution of the touring car.
brandCentral.zh:
自2007年首次推出GT-R以来，Nissan几乎每年都会推出
升级版本。

当15周年纪念版在2022年推出时，人们普遍认为这将
是系列的最后一款。

然而，似乎是为了打破这种预期，Nissan继续对这款车
进行改进，随后推出了这款2024年车型。

其全新的空气动力学设计提供了更好的冷却效果和
更强的下压力。

电子悬挂系统也得到了优化。

这款T-spec车型应用了碳陶瓷碟刹和特别调校的悬挂系统……

将GT-R在高性能房车领域的进化推向了新的高度。

catch.en: News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.
catch.zh: R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

vehicleCollection.en:
News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.

The arrival of the 2024 GT-R silenced speculation that production had ended with the 2022 model. A newly designed exhaust silencer allowed the car to meet noise regulations without compromising performance. Aerodynamic refinements enhanced downforce. Also, the addition of high-sensitivity G-sensors in the electronically controlled suspension improved both traction and ride comfort, elevating the GT-R’s performance and refinement to new heights.

long.en: The arrival of the 2024 GT-R silenced speculation that production had ended with the 2022 model. A newly designed exhaust silencer allowed the car to meet noise regulations without compromising performance. Aerodynamic refinements enhanced downforce. Also, the addition of high-sensitivity G-sensors in the electronically controlled suspension improved both traction and ride comfort, elevating the GT-R’s performance and refinement to new heights.
long.zh: 2024款GT-R的推出使得该车系在2022款后停产的传言不攻自破。全新的排气消音系统让该车在满足噪音法规的同时保持卓越性能。外观设计同样得到改善，下压力进一步增强。此外，电子控制悬挂系统引入的高灵敏度加速度传感器，不仅提升了抓地性能，同时也改善了乘坐舒适性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

2024款GT-R的推出使得该车系在2022款后停产的传言不攻自破。全新的排气消音系统让该车在满足噪音法规的同时保持卓越性能。外观设计同样得到改善，下压力进一步增强。此外，电子控制悬挂系统引入的高灵敏度加速度传感器，不仅提升了抓地性能，同时也改善了乘坐舒适性。

Nissan GT-R.

The LED lights on the roof and bumpers provide helpful
information for drivers on the track.

This is actually made possible by a set of specially
designed switches inside the car.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于Nissan GT-R开发。

车顶和保险杠上安装的LED灯会为赛道上的车手们提供重
要的信息。

这种灯光信号是由车内的一套特殊开关控制的。{

catch.en: This Nissan GT-R, converted into a safety car, was made to patrol the race track.
catch.zh: Nissan GT-R的安全车版本，专为赛道设计。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Nissan GT-R, converted into a safety car, was made to patrol the race track.

This Gran Turismo Original transformed the R35 GT-R supercar into a dedicated safety car. Equipped with roof-mounted LED patrol lights and additional light arrays on the front and rear bumpers, it offered significantly enhanced visibility. The center console was also fitted with exclusive switches unique to its safety car role.

long.en: This Gran Turismo Original transformed the R35 GT-R supercar into a dedicated safety car. Equipped with roof-mounted LED patrol lights and additional light arrays on the front and rear bumpers, it offered significantly enhanced visibility. The center console was also fitted with exclusive switches unique to its safety car role.
long.zh: 这个跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是以Nissan R35 GT-R超级跑车为基础进行开发的一款安全车。车顶安装的LED巡逻灯和前后保险杠上的灯组极大增强了其醒目程度。中控台还设有该车型独有的额外按钮。

brandCentral.en:
Nissan has made a significant mark on the SUV landscape, with
standout models like the Qashqai leading the way in Europe.

Introduced in 2006, the Qashqai quickly became a household name,
and now, it's in its third generation since 2021.

The third-generation Qashqai marked a milestone by bringing
Nissan’s innovative e-Power technology to Europe in 2022.

As a series hybrid, its remarkable fuel efficiency and smooth
driving experience set itself apart from other SUVs.

Visually, its signature Vmotion grille and coupe-like roofline
provided a fine beauty rarely seen in compact crossovers.

The Qashqai remains in the center of Nissan’s global strategy,
with more than four million units built in the UK to date.?
brandCentral.zh:
日产曾为SUV市场贡献过多款热销车型，比如在
欧洲广受欢迎的逍客。

逍客于2006年首次亮相，目前已进入2021年问世
的第三代。

作为将e-Power技术引进到欧洲的车型，第三代逍客
在2022年引入了串联混合动力系统。

凭借出色的燃油经济性和驾驶性能，它在
众多SUV竞争对手中脱颖而出。

在美学设计上，独特的Vmotion进气格栅和轿跑式车顶
展现了紧凑型车独有的美感。

作为日产全球战略的重要角色，逍客迄今
已在英国生产超过400万辆。

catch.en: Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.
catch.zh: Nissan紧凑型SUV搭载e-Power后更加出色

vehicleCollection.en:
Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.

Nissan’s Qashqai, a popular compact SUV that was introduced in 2006, entered its third generation with a bolder presence and a more refined design. Built on a larger platform, the new model showcased a more confident stance and featured Nissan’s innovative e-Power hybrid system. Unlike traditional hybrids, e-Power used a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powered the electric motors that drove the wheels, delivering an EV-like driving experience without the need to plug in. The Tekna trim came well-equipped, offering premium features such as larger alloy wheels, ambient interior lighting, and a sharp head-up display, all included as standard.

long.en: Nissan’s Qashqai, a popular compact SUV that was introduced in 2006, entered its third generation with a bolder presence and a more refined design. Built on a larger platform, the new model showcased a more confident stance and featured Nissan’s innovative e-Power hybrid system. Unlike traditional hybrids, e-Power used a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powered the electric motors that drove the wheels, delivering an EV-like driving experience without the need to plug in. The Tekna trim came well-equipped, offering premium features such as larger alloy wheels, ambient interior lighting, and a sharp head-up display, all included as standard.

The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.

After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...

collection.en:
This Nissan R92CP is the fastest Group C racing car of them all.

It really is an absolute beast, reaching over <400km/h>
on Fuji Speedway's long straight.

Group C races used to be extremely popular in Japan in their day,

The year after the FIA World Endurance Championship was created,
Japan had already set up its own endurance racing series.

This series was initially dominated by Porsche,

but Nissan and Toyota quickly grew stronger to become
its top contenders.

The R92CP -designed by Nissan's Kazutoshi Mizuno and built
entirely in-house, was developed for the former C1 class,

and its level of maturity as well as its speed
were way ahead of its competition.

Even legendary drivers of Japan such as Kazuyoshi Hoshino ad
Masahiro Hasemi spoke of R92CP's acceleration with dread.
collection.zh:
这辆Nissan R92CP在所有C组别赛车中速度名列榜首！

这辆车绝对是一匹真正的猛兽，曾在富士赛道的长直道
上跑出超过<400km/h>的速度。

C组别的比赛在日本曾经非常流行。

事实上，在FIA创立世界耐力锦标赛的第二年，日本就建
立了自己的耐力系列赛。

这个系列赛最初由Porsche主宰，

但Nissan和Toyota迅速崛起，成为其主要竞争者。

R92CP由水野和敏设计，所有零件均由Nissan自行制造组装，
原本是为了参加曾经的C1组别而开发的。

它的完善度和速度都要远远领先于其竞争对手。

就连日本传奇车手星野一义和长谷见昌弘也对R92CP无可比
拟的加速能力望而生|T

catch.en: Appearing towards the end of Group C's turbo era, this car won every round of the final All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship.

conversation.en:
Normally, when creating a variant
of an existing car...

You want to apply a novel design to differentiate
the variant from its base model.

In other words, you want to avoid market cannibalism.

That's why, among designers, design swapping is considered
to be a big no-no.

It's like you're not doing your job.

But among playful and imaginative gearheads,
this act simply can't be ignored.

Indeed, these days, it seems that anything goes!

In North America, when the merging of auto-makers and
their brands happened early on, this was commonplace.

It goes to show that customiatonand the diversification
and matuity of automotive culture...

usedCar.en:
How familiar are you with the Sileighty?

This singular Japanese car emerged from the street racing
scene of the 1990s.

It was made possible due to the fact the S13 Silvia and 180SX
share the same base—and thus the same front structure.

'The body of an 180SX, but the face of a Silvia.'—this simple
customisation was remarkably easy to achieve.

And so a unique custom car was born from the playful pursuit
of innovation.
usedCar.zh:
你熟悉Sileighty吗？

这款独特的日本车诞生于20世纪90年代
的街头赛车现场。

因为S13 Silvia和180SX有相同的底盘，
和相同的前部结构，所以这才造就了这款车型的诞生。

“用180SX的车身搭配Silvia的车头。”
这样简单的改装非常容易实现。

Sileighty这款独特的改装车就这样在
人们追求趣味创新的过程中诞生。

catch.en: This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.
catch.zh: 将180SX和Silvia糅合在一起，车迷的狂热喜爱让它得以诞生。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

The 180SX was introduced as the liftback version of the S13 Silvia. Although it carried slightly more weight and had reduced rear-end rigidity compared to the Silvia, it quickly gained a following as aftermarket tuning parts became widely available. One of the most iconic customizations was the combination of the 180SX body with the front end of the Silvia, also known as “Sileighty.”

long.en: The 180SX was introduced as the liftback version of the S13 Silvia. Although it carried slightly more weight and had reduced rear-end rigidity compared to the Silvia, it quickly gained a following as aftermarket tuning parts became widely available. One of the most iconic customizations was the combination of the 180SX body with the front end of the Silvia, also known as “Sileighty.”
long.zh: 180SX是作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出的。它比Silvia更重，后部刚性也有所不足，性能上存在差距。但很快就推出了众多改装部件，以便车迷打造属于自己的个性化设定。最著名的改装之一是为180SX换装S13的前脸造型，创造出了被称为“Sileighty”的经典车型。

usedCar.en:
The Silvia is an iconic sports coupe,
produced by Nissan.

This example is the 6th-generation model, which first
appeared in the 1990s and is known as the S14.

This specific car is actually the very last of the S14s
that came out in 1996.

Its design is notably different from earlier models,
with a distinctively sharp look.

The power and torque remained the same as those of its
predecessor, but this K's grade car features a turbo.

And what about the Silvia's drivetrain, you ask?
Well, it's real-wheel-drive, giving it an FR layout.

The turbo engine's max output of <220ps> and the FR layout
makes it suitable for both track racing and drifting.
usedCar.zh:
Silvia是一款标志性的、优雅的双门跑车，由Nissan生产。

该车型来自于二十世纪九十年代初次推出的第六代，
被命名为S14。

我们看到的这一台事实上是S14的最后一作，于1996年推出。

其设计与早期车型有着明显的不同，更加棱角分明。

动力和扭矩数据都和老款相同，但这辆S-14 K's
拥有一台涡轮增压引擎。

那么Silvia的传动系统又如何呢？你可能会问。
好吧，它是一台后驱车，确切地说，是前置后驱。

搭载涡轮增压器的引擎的最大输出马力是<220ps>，
这使它在赛道竞速和漂移中都能游刃有余。

catch.en: The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.
catch.zh: 装有后扰流板和皮革包裹方向盘的最顶级S14。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.

The S14 Silvia possessed a larger body than the S13 model. In 1996, it underwent a major facelift, incorporating menacing, slanted headlights and a prominent rear spoiler. The Aero package—available on both K’s and Q’s trims—added distinctive front and rear spoilers, exclusive bumpers, white-faced gauges, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob as standard.

long.en: The S14 Silvia possessed a larger body than the S13 model. In 1996, it underwent a major facelift, incorporating menacing, slanted headlights and a prominent rear spoiler. The Aero package—available on both K’s and Q’s trims—added distinctive front and rear spoilers, exclusive bumpers, white-faced gauges, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob as standard.

Nissan's Silvia has a long and celebrated history.

One of the best-loved Silvia models is the S13,
which was first sold in the 1980s.

This two-door coupé was popular in Japan when it debuted,
and was especially sought after by the younger crowd.

The 1990 'K's' variant boasts a front-mounted 1.8L
straight-four turbo.

With its solid RWD performance, it is everything a driver
could ask for.

Furthermore, its compact body makes it competitive on both
winding roads and traditional circuits.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan的Silvia拥有一段悠久而著名的历史。

20世纪80年代上市的S13
是Silvia中最受欢迎的车型之一。

这款双门轿跑一经亮相便在日本流行了起来，
尤其受年轻人的追捧。

1990年的“K's”型搭载了前置1.8升
直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

凭借其可靠的后驱性能，它将是
车手的理想之选。

此外，其紧凑的车身使得它在蜿蜒的道路和传统的赛道上
都非常具有竞争力。

catch.en: This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

vehicleCollection.en:
This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

Built between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia won over enthusiasts with its nimble handling and well-balanced rear-wheel-drive layout. Among its various trims, the high-performance K’s stood out—powered by a turbocharged DOHC inline-4, the CA18ET—earning a strong reputation for its versatility and performance. Later, the “Dia Selection” was introduced as a more affordable variant.

Among Japanese 2-door sports coupes, the Nissan Silvia
is one with particularly deep roots.

Bowing in 1965, the legendary first-gen model is remembered
as an indispensable part of Japanese automotive history.

This model here, affectionately known as the S14,
dates back to 1993.

The direct successor to the S13, it marked the arrival
of the sixth-generation car.

Compared to its predecessor, it was a bit wider, with a
longer body and wheelbase.

In line with its pedigree, it featred a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive, or FR, layout.

And its sleek and simple proportions gave it a
look that makes it instantly recognizable as a Silvia.

Contributing to its excellent performance was
an evolved undercarriage.

This came withreinforced brakes and a stiffer suspension
resulted in improved handling.<>

眼前的这款车型被亲切地称为“S14”，

作为S13的继任者，它标志着Silvia第六代车型的到来。

与它的前辈相比，它的车身略宽，车身和轴距更长。

其他方面则与之前的车型一*，

改进后的底盘为其卓越的性能贡献不少

The sixth-generation Silvia emphasized heightened luxury in a wide body format.

The broader stance of the S14-generation Silvia lent it a more upscale, refined presence. Under the hood, it retained the SR20 engine from the S13, with the top-grade K’s model receiving an added boost from an intercooled turbocharger. The suspension layout mirrored its predecessor’s, utilizing struts up front and a multi-link configuration at the rear. Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system was also offered on a select variant.

long.en: The broader stance of the S14-generation Silvia lent it a more upscale, refined presence. Under the hood, it retained the SR20 engine from the S13, with the top-grade K’s model receiving an added boost from an intercooled turbocharger. The suspension layout mirrored its predecessor’s, utilizing struts up front and a multi-link configuration at the rear. Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system was also offered on a select variant.
long.zh: S14型Silvia更宽的车身带来了更胜一筹的豪华感。S13的SR20引擎得到沿用，在顶配K's车型上则进一步配备了中冷涡轮增压器。基本悬挂设置同样沿用了S13的设计，前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统。还提供配备电动Super HICAS系统的车型选项。

conversation.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favourite Japanese cars of the early ‘90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.

That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...

Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。

低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……

一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。

vehicleCollection.en:
A low price, excellent handling and naturally aspirated engine made this S13 quite attractive.

Produced between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia earned a devoted following for its sharp, responsive handling and compact rear-wheel-drive layout. While the top-trim K’s came equipped with a turbocharged engine, the Q’s variant featured a naturally-aspirated 138.1 HP unit. Its suspension employed MacPherson struts up front and a multi-link setup at the rear, and select models were available with the advanced Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system.

long.en: Produced between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia earned a devoted following for its sharp, responsive handling and compact rear-wheel-drive layout. While the top-trim K’s came equipped with a turbocharged engine, the Q’s variant featured a naturally-aspirated 138.1 HP unit. Its suspension employed MacPherson struts up front and a multi-link setup at the rear, and select models were available with the advanced Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system.
long.zh: 1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。顶配K's车型搭载涡轮增压引擎，而Q's车型则搭载动力为140 PS的自然进气引擎。悬挂系统前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统，还可选装“Super HICAS”四轮转向系统。

Nissan's S15 Silvia has become one of the most popular
Japanese rear-wheel-drive sports cars, thanks to drifting.

This particular version is the Spec-R Aero that came with the
SR20 turbocharged inline-4 engine.

The car has classic sports-car proportions
and weighs only <1200kg>.

If you enjoy sliding your car around corners, then you'll be
delighted with the balance that this thing delivers.%
brandCentral.zh:
S15 Silvia肯定算得上是最著名的日本后轮驱动跑车之一了。

这款车型是Spec-R Aero，采用了SR20直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

得益于合理的车身尺寸与比例，它的重量只有<1200kg>。

任何喜欢漂移的人都会被其巨大的涡轮动力所征服！

usedCar.en:
The Nissan Silvia is known for its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layout, and its powerful turbocharged engine.

The S15 spec-R Silvia is more compact than the S14 and
boasts a strengthened chassis.

Like other Nissan sports cars, it is fitted with an SR20
turbocharged inline-4 capable of <250ps>.

This Silvia really is the quintessential FR sports car
of its class.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan Silvia因其前置后驱布局和强劲的
涡轮增压而闻名。

S15 spec-R Silvia相比S14更加紧凑，
而且换装了强化底盘。

与同厂其他跑车一样，它搭载一台马力为<250ps>的
SR20四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这辆Silvia不愧为同类车型中前置
后驱跑车的典范。

catch.en: This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

The seventh-generation S15 Silvia marked a return to the more compact proportions of the S13, reestablishing itself as an accessible, rear-wheel-drive sports car. While it continued to use the SR20 engine from previous generations, its chassis and running gear underwent a comprehensive redesign. With improved body rigidity, upgraded brakes, a more aggressive suspension setup, and the addition of a helical LSD, the S15 delivered a higher level of performance than its predecessors.

long.en: The seventh-generation S15 Silvia marked a return to the more compact proportions of the S13, reestablishing itself as an accessible, rear-wheel-drive sports car. While it continued to use the SR20 engine from previous generations, its chassis and running gear underwent a comprehensive redesign. With improved body rigidity, upgraded brakes, a more aggressive suspension setup, and the addition of a helical LSD, the S15 delivered a higher level of performance than its predecessors.
long.zh: 第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强，制动系统升级，悬挂更具运动性，还配备了螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

vehicleCollection.zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部扰流板成为标配。

第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强，制动系统升级，悬挂更具运动性，还配备了螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

brandCentral.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car uses the
S15 Silvia Spec-R as its base.

Its most distinctive feature is its strikingly wide body.

Around <170mm> wider than the base car, it came equipped
with extra-wide race tires.

As the "Touring Car" name implies, this model was
designed for the race track.

But that's not to say you can't drift this car because
after all, Silvias love to be thrown sideways.

In fact, the handbrake has been left intact to allow the
driver to break the rear tires loose.

Whether you're looking for grip on the track or just want to
slide through corners, you can't go wrong with this machine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车基于
S15 Silvia Spec-R开发。

它最显著的特征就是那夺人眼球的宽体车身，

比一般
车宽了约<170mm>，所以可以容纳下宽大的赛车轮胎。

顾名思义，这款“Touring Car”是专为赛道设计的……

尽管如此，Silvia也受到了漂移爱好者群体的热捧。

事实上，为了兼顾漂移性能，这辆车甚至完整地保留了
手刹的配置。

不论是想要足够的赛道抓地力，还是追求漂移过弯时的
爽快感，这辆车一定都能够让您称心如意！\

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

The seventh-generation S15 Silvia marked a return to the more compact proportions of the S13, reestablishing itself as an accessible, rear-wheel-drive sports car. While it continued to use the SR20 engine from previous generations, its chassis and running gear underwent a comprehensive redesign. With improved body rigidity, upgraded brakes, a more aggressive suspension setup, and the addition of a helical LSD, the S15 delivered a higher level of performance than its predecessors.

collection.en:
The 1973 Skyline GT-R is often considered almost mythical
because of its extremely low production numbers.

It is nicknamed the "Kenmeri GT-R" in reference to the 'Ken
& Mary' commercials used to promote the C110 Skyline.

The base model is the C110 Skyline that debuted in 1972,
the direct successor to the legendary "Hakosuka" GT-R.

The exact model code of Kenmeri GT-R was "KPGC110,"
and sales began in January 1973.

However, the Kenmeri GT-R was only sold
for three months after its ebut.

The emissions regulations introduced at the time stopped
the production of high-performance cars like the GT-R.

It is said that only around 200 cars were produced
in the three months it was available.

In order to focus on environmental ssues like exhaust
emissions, Nissan also stopped its motorsports activiti...

And bause f this, not only did this GT-R
have a short lifespan...

and shhl pized cllectraon the word.

vehicleCollection.en:
Only 197 examples of this GT-R were made before it was discontinued because of stricter emissions standards.

This high-performance version of the fourth-generation C110 Skyline was built to carry on the legacy of the GT-R. Larger than its predecessor, it retained the same S20 inline-6 found in the iconic “Hakosuka” GT-R, and was upgraded with 4-wheel disc brakes for improved stopping power. Although it was designed with motorsport in mind, tightening emissions regulations forced its early retirement before it could compete in a single race. Only 197 were produced.

long.en: This high-performance version of the fourth-generation C110 Skyline was built to carry on the legacy of the GT-R. Larger than its predecessor, it retained the same S20 inline-6 found in the iconic “Hakosuka” GT-R, and was upgraded with 4-wheel disc brakes for improved stopping power. Although it was designed with motorsport in mind, tightening emissions regulations forced its early retirement before it could compete in a single race. Only 197 were produced.
long.zh: 这是第四代“C110”Skyline的高性能车型。相比前代车型体型更大，搭载与“Hakosuka”GT-R相同的S20直列六缸引擎，并首次配备四轮碟式刹车系统。这款车旨在延续GT-R的辉煌传统，但新的排放法规导致其未能参加任何一场比赛就不得不结束赛车生涯。该车总共仅生产了197台。

'The Romance of Minus 21 Seconds'.

That was the advertising slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.

In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...

It shaved a full 21 seconds off the lap time of its
predecessor, the R32 GT-R.

It was a slogan that reflected all the effort that
had gone into the development of the R33 GT-R.

I think stories like that really add to this car's value.

conversation.en:
The Skyline GT-R brand is iconic in the
Japanese automotive industry.

And yet there may be no other car in Japan
where history and tradition...

Weighs so heavily on its designer.

In that respect designing a GT-R today is not so different
from designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

This R33 used a normal, mid-sized sporty sedan
as its base...

Which must have caused a lot of difficulties
for its designers.

Based on a three-box, full four-seater production car...

It is the essence of a 'Wolf in Sheep's Clothing'.

Also, because development on the R33 dovetailed
with the end of Japa'sbuble economy...

Its body and styli are vey uʅf theera—
large, heav and exuding a stout eegance.
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。

有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。

在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。

而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，

因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气^优雅，与Wy时m时代
背景相吻合。

conversation.en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.

At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.

So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."

It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.

And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.

It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...

...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。

为此，Nissan特别打造了一辆双门版的Nissan NISMO GT-R LM，

在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，

这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。

由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三

让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！

dialogues.en:
The Skyline GT-R brand is iconic in the
Japanese automotive industry.

And yet there may be no other car in Japan
where history and tradition...

Weighs so heavily on its designer.

In that respect designing a GT-R today is not so different
from designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

This R33 used a normal, mid-sized sporty sedan
as its base...

Which must have caused a lot of difficulties
for its designers.

Based on a three-box, full four-seater production car...

It is the essence of a 'Wolf in Sheep's Clothing'.

Also, because development on the R33 dovetailed
with the end of Japa'sbuble economy...

Its body and styli are vey uʅf theera—
large, heav and exuding a stout eegance.
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。

有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。

在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。

而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，

因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气^优雅，与Wy时m时代
背景相吻合。

usedCar.en:
Just so you know, the R33 GT-R is faster and a more stable
handling machine than the R32.

Credit here goes to the R33's longer body.

I mean, just look at the wheelbase. It's more than <100mm>
longer than that of the R32.

This difference can really be felt when driving hard
on a race track.

Also, this V-Spec version doesn't understeer as much
as the R32 V-Spec.

This is because Nissan fine-tuned the ATTESA E-TS 4-wheel-drive
system to make it behave as neutrally as possible.
usedCar.zh:
相较R32 GT-R，R33的最高时速更高，稳定性更好，
综合性能更加优秀。

这有一部分要归功于其更长、更重的车体。

具体来讲，这辆车的轴距比其前代
R32长了<100mm>。

这项改进对行车稳定性带来了
巨大的提升。

除此之外，这辆V-spec版不像R32那样容易遇到
转向不足的情况。

毕竟，这辆车还搭载了先进的ATTESA E-TS
四轮驱动系统。

catch.en: This top-of-the-line GT-R R33 included the ATTESA ET-S Pro high-performance all-wheel drive system.
catch.zh: R33 GT-R的顶级车型，搭载ATTESA E-TS Pro系统。

vehicleCollection.en:
This top-of-the-line GT-R R33 included the ATTESA ET-S Pro high-performance all-wheel drive system.

The R33 GT-R made its debut in January 1995. Faced with the challenge of following a car often hailed as one of the greatest in automotive history, Nissan introduced the new model with the bold slogan, “Minus 21-Second Dream”—a nod to its Nürburgring lap time, where it outpaced the R32 by a remarkable 21 seconds. The RB26DETT engine returned with refined tuning that delivered improved throttle response and increased torque. The V-Spec variant came fitted with the advanced ATTESA E-TS Pro all-wheel-drive system as standard, offering integrated control of the active limited-slip differential and ABS.

The RB26DETT engine returned with refined tuning that delivered improved throttle response and increased torque. conversation.en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.

Nissan poured all of its technical kno-how into
its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！

从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。

1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。

辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。

conversation.en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.

That’s what got me into sports sedans of
a ‘wolf in sheep’s clothing’ nature.

Now then, this is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.

First of all, it evokes a clear sense of volume.

Then, by weighing down the rear fender, its designers
made the car look like it was squatting.

This set the GT-R in a position to transcended
the GT.

Furthermore...

It marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance add-ons.

That is all to saytht he current GTR is the rightful hei
to this R32 GTR.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。

运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。

我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。

首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。

然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃v欲试的感觉。

从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。

此外……

从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了S幕。

这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列o
祖。

This third-generation GT-R Skyline played a lead role
in reviving interest in Japanese touring car races!

A major hit upon its release in 1989, it's said to have sold
some 43,000 units despite its high price tag.

A race-ready version was developed shortly after.

This car claimed a pole-to-win victory in the 1990
Japanese Touring Car Championship!

Following this great achievement, the race GT-R boasted
29 consecutive wins over the course of four years.

在达成这一伟大成就之后，
它还在四年之内取得了29连胜。

The Skyline GT-R could may well be the most popular
Japanese car ever.

The R32 has now become a collector's item, and the last
variant of that classic was this V-Spec II.

It has wider tires than the base model. It also features
Brembo brakes and BBS aluminum wheels as standard.

The V-Spec II was built to celebrate the GT-R's success in
Group N and Group A racing, just like the V-Spec I.

Thanks to its stiffer chassis, the V-Spec II handles like a dream.
usedCar.zh:
Skyline GT-R是Nissan最著名的车型之一。

R32的最终生产型。

此型号的车轮比普通型号的更宽……

不仅标配Brembo制动钳
和BBS铝轮毂，

整个底盘也经过了强化。

catch.en: This unique R32 GT-R came fitted with 17-inch BBS wheels, Brembo brakes and 45-series tires.
catch.zh: 配备了Brembo刹车和45小尺寸轮胎的特殊R32 GT-R。

vehicleCollection.en:
This unique R32 GT-R came fitted with 17-inch BBS wheels, Brembo brakes and 45-series tires.

The R32 Skyline GT-R marked the triumphant return of the GT-R name after a 16-year hiatus following the legendary "Kenmeri" model. At its heart was the newly developed RB26DETT engine, equipped with ceramic twin turbochargers to deliver 276.1 HP and 260.4 ft-lb of torque. Power was channeled through the innovative ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system, engineered with a focus on handling precision. Introduced in 1994, the V-Spec II was a high-performance variant that came equipped with wider 245/45R17 tires.

Introduced in 1994, the V-Spec II was a high-performance variant that came equipped with wider 245/45R17 tires.

the stoy f he Skyline GT-R through this car.</>

vehicleCollection.en:
A limited-edition model signifying the end of production, the "Nür" stands for Nürburgring, where the car was developed.

The R34 GT-R was unveiled in January 1999. In contrast to the larger R33, the new model adopted a more compact, muscular profile—3.0 inches shorter in overall length with a wheelbase reduced by 2.2 inches. The now fully matured RB26DETT engine received a final round of enhancements, pushing torque to 289.3 ft-lb, while refinements to the chassis brought sharper control and more intuitive handling. Crowning the lineup was the limited-edition Nür, fitted with the N1-spec RB26DETT engine, marking the final evolution of the powerplant.

long.en: The R34 GT-R was unveiled in January 1999. In contrast to the larger R33, the new model adopted a more compact, muscular profile—3.0 inches shorter in overall length with a wheelbase reduced by 2.2 inches. The now fully matured RB26DETT engine received a final round of enhancements, pushing torque to 289.3 ft-lb, while refinements to the chassis brought sharper control and more intuitive handling. Crowning the lineup was the limited-edition Nür, fitted with the N1-spec RB26DETT engine, marking the final evolution of the powerplant.
long.zh: R34 GT-R于1999年1月亮相。与尺寸更大的R33相比，这款新车采用了紧凑有力的车身设计，长度缩短了75毫米，轴距也缩短了55毫米。而日臻成熟的RB26DETT引擎也得到了进一步提升，扭矩提升到了40.0 公斤力米，再加上底盘优化，让这辆车的稳定性更上一层楼，操控性也更易预测。而“Nur”也是Nissan推出的最后一款搭载N1 spec RB26DETT引擎的限量车型。

The R31, introduced in 1985, represented the seventh-generation of the
Nissan Skyline Brand.

The most superior version was the GTS-R that was introduced in 1987.

Built to win the Japanese Touring Car Championship (JTC),
Japan’s top touring car event at the time...

...It was a homologation model developed in accordance
with international Group A regulations.

Under the hood, Nissan added a new turbocharger to the GTS base
models' 2.0-liter inline-6.

Exterior tweaks included a large rear spoiler, along with other
aerodynamic equipment.

This R31 Skyline GTS-R had a limited production run
of about 800 units.

So, it should come as no surprise that this model has
become a true collector's item of the famous Skyline serie

第7代……

这辆车是专门为了当时日本最顶级的房车赛事——
日本房车锦标赛……

按照国际A组别规则所打造的认证车型。

在引擎盖下，它在基础车型GTS原本的2升直列六缸引擎上
又添加了一部涡轮增压器……

而在外观上，它的车尾添加了一部大尺寸尾翼，
车身上也多了不少空气动力学部件。

这辆R31 Skyline GTS-R仅限量生产了800余辆。

如此鲜少得见的车型，自然成了历史悠久的Skyline车系
中真正受到收藏家觊觎的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
An unlikely monster machine born from the elegant lines of the seventh-generation Skyline.

This high-performance variant of the seventh-generation Skyline was introduced with Group A competition squarely in its sights. Its RB20DET engine was extensively reworked, featuring a stainless steel exhaust manifold and a T04E turbocharger, complemented by refinements to the suspension and a more aggressive exterior design. The car secured the 1989 All Japan Touring Car Championship season title, yet it sparked curiosity as to why it wasn't given the GT-R name.

conversation.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.

This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...

...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
T

conversation.zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。

这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。

它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！

It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

But it does lack the four round taillights.
