collection.en:
The "Hakosuka" Skyline has become a cult classic for
Japanese car enthusiasts.

Of the various models, this 2-door hardtop GT-R,
known by its model number, KPGC10, stands out.

This car remains on the most-wanted list for many collectors.

Among the car's many charms was its engine.

It was the direct descendent of the high-performance engine
in Japan’s first prototype race car, the Prince R380.

Fewer than 1200 KPGC10s coupes were produced. Including
the 4-door models, the total is still only around 2000 cars.

This car made a name for itself by winning 49 consecutive races
in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

Owning it means owning a piece of that
incredible history.
collection.zh:
轮廓分明的“Hakosuka” Skyline在全世界都
有着无数拥趸。

其中，这辆双门硬顶GT-R，
因其型号KPGC10而闻名于世……

至今令全世界的收藏家们趋之若鹜。

引擎是它众多的魅力之一……

该引擎是日本首辆赛车原型车，
Prince R380上的高性能赛车引擎的直接继承者。

KPGC10总共只生产了不到1200辆，算上四门版也只有2000辆左右。

这还是一台在日本房车锦标赛中连续取得
49胜的历史传奇赛车。

拥有了它，就如同拥有了那段不可思议的历史。

catch.en: This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.
catch.zh: Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（方盒Skyline）。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.

This high-performance version of the C10 Skyline—affectionately known as the “Hakosuka”—was introduced in February 1969. It featured bolt-on overfenders and the S20 DOHC engine, derived from the R380 race car, bringing true motorsport pedigree to the street. Its racing success was extraordinary, claiming 52 victories—49 of them consecutively—before the factory team withdrew from competition. The legend of the Skyline began here.

long.en: This high-performance version of the C10 Skyline—affectionately known as the “Hakosuka”—was introduced in February 1969. It featured bolt-on overfenders and the S20 DOHC engine, derived from the R380 race car, bringing true motorsport pedigree to the street. Its racing success was extraordinary, claiming 52 victories—49 of them consecutively—before the factory team withdrew from competition. The legend of the Skyline began here.
long.zh: 这是C10 Skyline的高性能版本，昵称“Hakosuka”，于1969年2月正式发布。配备螺栓式宽体轮拱和源自R380赛车的S20双顶置凸轮轴引擎。此车创造了史无前例的赛车战绩，在其车厂车队停止参赛前共夺得52场胜利，其中包括49场连胜。Skyline的传奇历史正是由它开启的。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（方盒Skyline）。

这是C10 Skyline的高性能版本，昵称“Hakosuka”，于1969年2月正式发布。配备螺栓式宽体轮拱和源自R380赛车的S20双顶置凸轮轴引擎。此车创造了史无前例的赛车战绩，在其车厂车队停止参赛前共夺得52场胜利，其中包括49场连胜。Skyline的传奇历史正是由它开启的。

collection.en:
Have you ever heard of the 'Fuji Grand Champion Race'?
It was really popular in Japan during the 1980s.

If you've heard of the race before...

You probably know about the 'Super Silhouette' race cars
that competed in the opening races for those events.

The Super Silhouette races were hosted under the
Group 5 regulations of the time.

While the exteriors of the cars maintained the look of
a production model...

On the inside they were purebred racing cars
developed for competition.

This Nissan Skyline Super Silhouette proved to be
the most popular car in the series.

Famous for its flaming side-exit exhaust, it is an iconic
car that is still fondly remembered by many fans.
collection.zh:
您听说过“富士大冠军赛”吗？
如果您听说过，

这是20世纪80年代风靡日本的赛事

你可能也听说过参加开幕式比赛的“Super Silhouette”赛车的故事。

“Super Silhouette”比赛采用的是第5组别规则，

参赛车辆虽然保持了量产车的外观，

但内部已经变成了专为比赛开发的纯粹赛车。

我们的这一台叫做日产“Skyline Super Silhouette”，
是系列赛中最受欢迎的车。

因其侧面的排气管会喷出波浪形火焰而闻名全国，
至今仍有许多车迷对这台标志性的名车记忆犹新。

catch.en: An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s
catch.zh: 一辆超凡卓绝的Skyline，在1980年代的赛事中脱颖而出

vehicleCollection.en:
An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s

The Skyline Super Silhouette was a silhouette formula race car—built using only the basic outline of the production model—based on the sixth-generation Skyline. Its aggressive bodywork featured flared front and rear fenders and a large rear wing, and powered by a turbocharged 2.1-liter LZ20B inline-4 race engine. Between 1982 and 1984, this car secured an impressive eight victories.

long.en: The Skyline Super Silhouette was a silhouette formula race car—built using only the basic outline of the production model—based on the sixth-generation Skyline. Its aggressive bodywork featured flared front and rear fenders and a large rear wing, and powered by a turbocharged 2.1-liter LZ20B inline-4 race engine. Between 1982 and 1984, this car secured an impressive eight victories.
long.zh: Skyline Super Silhouette是基于第6代Skyline打造的剪影方程式赛车（指一种仅保留量产车型基本轮廓的赛车）。配备了宽大的前后轮拱和大型后翼，车身内搭载着2.1升4缸涡轮增压“LZ20B”赛车引擎。这款车在1982年至1984年间斩获了8场胜利。

brandCentral.en:
This is the latest entry in Nissan's world-famous
Z-car range.

There have been seven generations of Z-cars over the years.

The first ones went on sale in 1969, meaning the range has
over half a century of history.

They're now some of the world's best-known sports cars!

The latest model includes many features from the first
generation, such as the long nose and the short deck.

What's more, it retains the classic Z-car FR layout.

The engine is Nissan's very latest turbo unit—the 3L V6 twin
turbo VR30DTT.

It's also benefitted from some specialist tuning, improving
its power and also its throttle response..
brandCentral.zh:
这是日产的Z系列中最新的车型。

自问世以来，Z系列已经有了七代车型。

初代Z型车于1969年上市，意味着
这个系列的历史已经跨越了半个多世纪。

它们现在已经成为了世界上最出名的车型之一！

这款最新车型采用了许多来自初代的特点，例如长车头和短车尾。

此外，它还沿用了经典的Z型车前置后驱布局。

这辆车搭载了日产最新的涡轮增压引擎——
3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎VR30DTT。

在经过专家调校之后，它的动力和油门反应时间都得到了改善。

catch.en: The seventh-generation Z is a 21st century reinterpretation of the classic S30.
catch.zh: 第七代Z系列跑车是经典S30在21世纪的最新演绎。

vehicleCollection.en:
The seventh-generation Z is a 21st century reinterpretation of the classic S30.

The production model of the seventh-generation Fairlady Z first appeared in prototype form in 2020. Eschewing electrification, Nissan opted for the VR30DDTT twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6, paired with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a 9-speed automatic with manual shift mode. At a time when the automotive industry was shifting toward self-driving technology and electrification, this car pursued the timeless allure of a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car.

long.en: The production model of the seventh-generation Fairlady Z first appeared in prototype form in 2020. Eschewing electrification, Nissan opted for the VR30DDTT twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6, paired with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a 9-speed automatic with manual shift mode. At a time when the automotive industry was shifting toward self-driving technology and electrification, this car pursued the timeless allure of a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car.
long.zh: 第7代Fairlady Z的量产车型最初于2020年以原型车形式亮相。Nissan选择不采用电动传动系统，而是继续利用VR30DDTT 3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱或带手动换挡模式的9速自动变速箱。虽然整个汽车行业都在关注自动驾驶和电动化革命，但这款车追求的却是前置引擎、后轮驱动跑车的浪漫主义。

vehicleCollection.zh:
第七代Z系列跑车是经典S30在21世纪的最新演绎。

第7代Fairlady Z的量产车型最初于2020年以原型车形式亮相。Nissan选择不采用电动传动系统，而是继续利用VR30DDTT 3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱或带手动换挡模式的9速自动变速箱。虽然整个汽车行业都在关注自动驾驶和电动化革命，但这款车追求的却是前置引擎、后轮驱动跑车的浪漫主义。

cars.nameEn: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
After more than 160 years of success, Opel remains
an ambitious trailblazer of the automotive industry.

Carrying the spirit of the classic Corsa into the
future is the Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo.

The GSE label stands as Opel’s pledge to create high-performance,
emission-free cars for a new electric era.

This is an exceptionally fast machine, powered by dual motors at
the front and rear that together produce an astonishing <800ps>.

It can sprint from 0-<100km/h> in just two secods and reach a top
speed of <320km/h>, truly living up to the Opel “blitz” emblem.

Its imposing exterior was defined by the Opel Compass, formed
by the front grille and the central crease of the hood.

With its emphasis on sustainability, the GE Vision Gran Turismo
promises to carry sports-car driving boldly into the1st century.<pԳ
brandCentral.sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
历经160多年辉煌历程，Opel依旧是
汽车行业雄心勃勃的开拓者。

承载经典Corsa迈向未来的正是这款
Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo。

GSE标识象征着Opel致力于为电动新时代
打造高性能零排放汽车的承诺。

毫无疑问，这是一台极其迅捷的座驾，
前后双电机驱动，综合输出功率高达<800ps>。

0-<100km/h>加速仅需2秒，最高速度达<320km/h>，
堪称Opel“闪电”徽标的化身。

由前格栅与引擎盖中央棱线共同构成的Opel Compass
让车身外观格外醒目。

GSE Vision Gran Turismo的车型设计还着重考量
可持续发展理念，立志将运动跑车的驾驶感带入21世纪。

catch.en: This Vision Gran Turismo embodies the electric spirit of Opel’s GSE sports car brand.
catch.zh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo承载了Opel GSE运动品牌的电动精神，电力十足。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo embodies the electric spirit of Opel’s GSE sports car brand.

The Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo is a fully electric high-performance concept car that blends Opel’s respect for tradition with its passion for futuristic technology. Twin electric motors, one mounted on each axle, delivers a combined output of 588 kW (788 HP). This enables the car to accelerate from 0-62.1 mph in just two seconds and reach a top speed of 198.8 mph. Its aerodynamic performance is equally impressive, with an active aero diffuser and spoiler that ensures stability even at the highest speeds.

long.en: The Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo is a fully electric high-performance concept car that blends Opel’s respect for tradition with its passion for futuristic technology. Twin electric motors, one mounted on each axle, delivers a combined output of 588 kW (788 HP). This enables the car to accelerate from 0-62.1 mph in just two seconds and reach a top speed of 198.8 mph. Its aerodynamic performance is equally impressive, with an active aero diffuser and spoiler that ensures stability even at the highest speeds.
long.zh: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo是一款全电动高性能概念车，将Opel对传统的敬意与对未来科技的激情完美融合。前后轴双电机总输出功率高达588千瓦（800 PS）。让车辆仅需2秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到320 公里/小时。它还拥有出色的空气动力学性能，配备主动式空气扩散器和后扰流板，确保高速行驶时的稳定性。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款Vision Gran Turismo承载了Opel GSE运动品牌的电动精神，电力十足。

Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo是一款全电动高性能概念车，将Opel对传统的敬意与对未来科技的激情完美融合。前后轴双电机总输出功率高达588千瓦（800 PS）。让车辆仅需2秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到320 公里/小时。它还拥有出色的空气动力学性能，配备主动式空气扩散器和后扰流板，确保高速行驶时的稳定性。

brandCentral.en:
The Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo is all about performance.

This remarkable car was developed by Peugeot's design team
and the engineers responsible for the Peugeot Sport.

Its turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 engine, mounted amidships,
pumped out a hearty <887ps>.

Particular attention was paid to endurance race cars during
the development of this efficiently-designed model.

You can see this in its aerodynamic parts, which are kept
to an absolute minimum without affecting performance.
brandCentral.zh:
Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo是纯粹为驾驶而生的。

这款非凡的车辆是由Peugeot的设计团队和Peugeot Sport背后的
工程师们共同开发的。

此车采用了中置引擎布局，配备了3.2L V6涡轮增压引擎，
能够提供<887ps>的动力。

为了实现性能的飞跃，在车型的开发过程中，设计师们特别参
考了耐力赛车型。

您可以从空气动力学部件中看出这一点，这些部件在不
影响性能的前提下，都采取极简化的处理。

catch.en: Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.
catch.zh: 在直接通过车身板件产生下压力的跑车中体验纯粹的转向反应。

vehicleCollection.en:
Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.

The PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo is the result of a collaboration between Peugeot’s design team and the engineers at Peugeot Sport. With a height of just 3.3 ft, its low-slung body hugs the ground. Powered by a turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 producing 875 ch (874.8 HP), it's clear this machine was conceived to deliver the quintessential driving experience.

long.en: The PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo is the result of a collaboration between Peugeot’s design team and the engineers at Peugeot Sport. With a height of just 3.3 ft, its low-slung body hugs the ground. Powered by a turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 producing 875 ch (874.8 HP), it's clear this machine was conceived to deliver the quintessential driving experience.

brandCentral.en:
The Peugeot VGT served as the base model for this Gran
Turismo Gr.3 original race car.

The engine and chassis, among other components, were subject
to a variety of modifications to meet Gr.3 specifications.

Moreover, a prominent swan-neck rear wing and front splitter
were added to improve the car's aerodynamic properties.
brandCentral.zh:
Peugeot VGT是这款原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车的基础车型。

为了满足Gr.3规范，引擎、底盘以及其他部件都接受了大

conversation.en:
About Pagani's design...

...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.

Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...

...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...

...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.

When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined30 years before in Turin had concluded...

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.

It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...

...but it ought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without bng too flamboyt.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.

brandCentral.en:
Pagani is known for having the most expensive and exclusive
cars, but the Zonda R is in a class of its own.

Specially designed to be driven on a track, a fact made
evident by its outstanding performance...

Its fully carbon body astonishingly weighs only <1250kg>.

Sporting a V12 engine based on the one used in the
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR, a Le Mans darling...

It recorded an impressive 6:47.50 lap time on
the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 2010.

Impressed? It was a new world record at the time!
brandCentral.zh:
Pagani素来以推出最昂贵和最独特的汽车而闻名，而在其推
出的车款中，Zonda R又自成一系。

此车是专为在赛道上驾驶而设计的，其出色的性能充分
证明了这一点……

全碳纤维制造的车身仅重<1250kg>，令人赞叹不已。

另外，此车还采用了来自于勒芒耐力赛常胜车型
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR的V12引擎……

2010年，这辆车在纽博格林北侧赛道上做出了令人印象深
刻的6:47.50的单圈时间。

厉害吧？这在当时可是一个新的世界纪录！

vehicleCollection.en:
The Zonda R featured an adjustable rear wing and a sequential-shift 6-speed transmission.

This was a track-only evolution of the Zonda, unveiled in 1999. Its mid-mounted AMG V-12 delivered 739.6 HP and 520.8 ft-lb of torque. To enhance stability, both the wheelbase and track width were extended. The car was capable of reaching a top speed of 217.5 mph and could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 2.7 seconds.

usedCar.en:
Are you interested in a car built to handle twisty roads?
Then, have I got the car for you—the Peugeot 205 GTI.

The 205 made its debut more than 40 years ago in 1983,
yet its design remains timeless and modern to this day.

Initially, Peugeot designated the 205 as a WRC rally car, but it
became clear that a sportier car was needed. Enter the GTI.

The true allure of the 205 GTI lies in its 1.6-liter inline-4,
paired with a chassis tipping the scales at just around <900kg>!

In 1986, the engine was enlarged to 1.9L, producing <130ps>,
while the chassis remained about the same weight.

On mountain roads, this car was a beast. It put the "hot" in hot
hatches and remains loyal to the spirit of sporty French cars.?
usedCar.zh:
想要寻找一款擅于征服蜿蜒道路的好车？我已经帮你挑
选好了——Peugeot 205 GTI！

这款205首次亮相要追溯到40多年前的1983年，不过现
在看来也毫不过时。

Peugeot首先基于205打造了一款世界拉力锦标赛参赛
赛车，但他们也需要一款运动车型，于是GTI应运而生。

GTI的魅力毫无疑问来自于它动力充沛的1.6升引擎，
安装在整体重量仅有<900kg>的车身中。

在1986年，这款引擎升级为1.9升，可以输出<130ps>动力，
但我要强调，车重依然只有<900kg>！

在山路上，这辆车始终立于不败之地！它是高性能掀背车
中实力最强劲的选手之一，也是法系车精神的最佳证明。

catch.en: A masterpiece hot hatch from France that became a rally legend.

vehicleCollection.en:
A masterpiece hot hatch from France that became a rally legend.

Peugeot introduced the 205 GTI as a spirited road-going counterpart to its 205 Turbo 16 WRC car. Its compact frame and punchy 1.6-liter SOHC engine delivered a thrilling, well-rounded driving experience. More than 300,000 units of this French masterpiece sold across Europe, securing its place in the pantheon of 1980s and 1990s car-culture history.

long.en: Peugeot introduced the 205 GTI as a spirited road-going counterpart to its 205 Turbo 16 WRC car. Its compact frame and punchy 1.6-liter SOHC engine delivered a thrilling, well-rounded driving experience. More than 300,000 units of this French masterpiece sold across Europe, securing its place in the pantheon of 1980s and 1990s car-culture history.

conversation.en:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984
season, at the Tour de Corse.

Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the
latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.

From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!

The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies
in its innovative engineering.

It was the first Group B rally car to feature al-wheel drive
and a mid-mounted engine.

This machine was a true gamechanger!

In the blink of an eye, it took the crown from the Audi Quattro,
the reigning front-engine 4x4 champion.
'
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
标致205 T16在1984赛季的第5场比赛——
科西嘉岛拉力赛中首次亮相世界拉力锦标赛，

只获得了第4名。

但在赛季的后半段，它主宰了比赛，
赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。

从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！

205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。

它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全v驱动的拉力赛车。

是汽车革命的全方位体现！

它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……

并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总K！

赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。

从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！

205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。

它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全v驱动的拉力赛车。

是汽车革命的全方位体现！

它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……

并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总K！

collection.en:
The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 is sometimes referred to as the
'ultimate rally car'.

It was originally designed to compete in the World Rally
Championship's legendary Group B category.

Group B regulations were officially implemented in 1983,

and at the time, only 200 of a model were required for
Group B homologation within 12 months.

No commitment to mass production of road versions meant that
manufacturers could make bold decisions on development.

And the choice made by Peugeot,

was to mount a powerful turbocharged engine midship,
combined with 4WD.

At that point, the other teams in Group B hadn’t yet adopted
the configuration, which initially gave Peugeot an advantage.

The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 made its debut in
the iddle of the 1984 season,

and it immediately proved itself to be effecve, winning th
Word Rally Championship title in 1985 and 1986.
collection.zh:
标致205 Turbo 16常常被人称为“终极拉力车”。

它最初是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛充满传奇色彩的B组
别比赛而设计的。

B组别的规则于1983年正式实施时，

只需要在12个月内生产出200台车就可以获得赛事认证。

没有了大规模量产公路车型的限制，意味着制造商可以
在研发上做出更大胆的决定。

而标致做出的决定

是将一台强大的涡轮增压引擎安装在车体中部，并&四
轮驱动结合。

由于其他B组别车队并未采用这种配置，这在锦标赛的
头几年给标致带来了不小的优势。

标致205 Turbo 16在1984年赛季中期首次亮相，

立即证明了自己的高效，在1985年e1986年连续赢得世界拉
力锦标赛的冠军。

catch.en: This 4-wheel-drive pocket rocket took the Group B racing world by storm.
catch.zh: 这辆四驱中置引擎怪兽横扫了B组别的各项赛事。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 4-wheel-drive pocket rocket took the Group B racing world by storm.

The 205 Turbo 16 itself was Peugeot’s Group B contender for the World Rally Championship. It won three rallies in its 1984 debut and repeated the feat in 1985. Peugeot evolved the car with more power, less weight, and better aerodynamics to produce the Evolution 2. The updated version captured 7 of 12 victories in 1985 and 6 of 13 in 1986, taking both the drivers' and manufacturers' titles.

conversation.en:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition
at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!

After taking down reigning champ Audi
at the 2009 race...

Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win,
and set to improving their 908.

And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed
in the top qualifying positions!

What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat
the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.

But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour
endurance race.

All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track,
and were forced to retire.

Which goes to show that endurance race are really not
just about speed but also the strength to carry on.
'

在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……

标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。

后来，参赛的四辆908直接包揽了排位赛的前四！

而且就连第四名的标致都领先第五名的奥迪整*两秒以上。

然而，要赢得24小时耐力赛并不是那么轻而易举的事。

事与愿违，标致的所有参赛车都在赛道上
遭遇了困难，最终被迫退赛。

This Peugeot LMP took the top four spots in qualifying for the 2010 24 Hours of Le Mans, but not one finished the race.

Peugeot developed the 908 HDi FAP to compete at the highest level of prototype racing. During 2007 and 2008, it took part in events such as the Le Mans Series, serving as a platform for ongoing research and development. In 2009, the car finally triumphed over its chief rival—Audi’s diesel-powered R10—securing a dominant 1–2 finish at Le Mans. Although it was unable to repeat the feat in 2010, the 908 HDi FAP continued to deliver commendable results.

Of all the race cars born from the Le Mans Hypercar regulations...

...the Peugeot 9X8 may be the most
distinctive of them all.

Its wingless concept made headlines
when it made its debut in 2021.

And that bold approach may have helped it briefly take the lead
during an especially wet and grueling Le Mans in 2023.

In 2024, the car underwent a major evolution, gaining an all-new
rear wing and a more conventional aerodynamic package.

A top-tier contender in the WEC, this is a machine
that never fails to make an impression.

其“无尾翼”的设计理念在2021年首次亮相时便引发热议……

作为WEC赛场上的顶尖强者，这台车总能惊艳全场。

brandCentral.en:
Peugeot once dominated endurance racing with the 905 and 908,
and the 9X8 marked its first entry in the Hypercar class.

Developed by Peugeot Sport, the all-wheel-drive 9X8 combines
a twin-turbo 2.6-liter V-6 with a front electric motor.

Check out the lion-claw light signatures, a design cue
it shares with Peugeot road cars.

The early 9X8’s wingless design drew plenty of attention,
but a large rear wing was eventually added in 2024.

The tires also were changed to a staggered setup,
helping improve aerodynamics and weight distribution.

It showed its refined speed in the 2025 season, finishing
a close second in the seventh race at Fuji.

With its bold approach, the 9X8 aims to redefine what a hypercar
can be: a powerful beastwith a personality all its own.
brandCentral.zh:
标致曾凭借905和908等车型称霸耐力赛领域。
9X8则是其首款涉足终极跑车组别的车型。

这款车由标致运动开发，搭载一台2.6升V6双涡轮
增压引擎，并配备电动机。

灯组上的狮爪图案值得留意——这也是标致公路车
的标志性特征。

早期的9X8采用无尾翼设计，一度备受瞩目，
但最终在2024年还是加上了大尺寸后尾翼。

此次升级还包括将轮胎改为前窄后宽配置，
大幅优化z空气动力学性能与重量分布。

在2025赛季中，9X8展现了精准调校后的速度，
并在富士站的第七场比赛中以微弱劣势屈居亚军。

9X8大胆的理念旨在重新定义终极跑车的边界——
这头猛兽独个性，实力不容小觑。

vehicleCollection.en:
An electric hypercar that represents the racing spirit of Peugeot.

Peugeot returned to the top class of endurance racing under Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) regulations in 2022 after previously stepping away in 2011. Its return was marked by the arrival of the all-wheel-drive hybrid 9X8. The original aerodynamic concept eliminated the need for a rear wing, although one was introduced as part of the car’s 2024 evolution package. The 2025 version further refined those developments, resulting in the most complete form of the 9X8. It demonstrated its potential with a 2nd place finish at Fuji during the 2025 FIA World Endurance Championship season.

long.en: Peugeot returned to the top class of endurance racing under Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) regulations in 2022 after previously stepping away in 2011. Its return was marked by the arrival of the all-wheel-drive hybrid 9X8. The original aerodynamic concept eliminated the need for a rear wing, although one was introduced as part of the car’s 2024 evolution package. The 2025 version further refined those developments, resulting in the most complete form of the 9X8. It demonstrated its potential with a 2nd place finish at Fuji during the 2025 FIA World Endurance Championship season.
long.zh: Peugeot在2022年依据勒芒终极跑车（LMH）规则重返耐力赛事的巅峰组别，这是自品牌2011年退出后，时隔11年的回归。该品牌为这次回归打造了全轮驱动混合动力车型9X8。最初的空气动力学设计成功省去了尾翼，但在2024年加装了这一部件。2025款车型在这些改进基础上进一步优化，最终呈现出现在的最终形态。在2025年国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛富士站中，它以第二名的成绩完赛，证明了自己的竞速潜力。

brandCentral.en:
Are you familiar with the legendary Peugeot L45?

If not, here's a crash course. It's one of the company's most
famous race cars, known for winning the Indy 500 in 1916.

It also served as the inspiration for this Peugeot L500R
HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo.

The styling of the rear, with its gently narrowing rear end,
was taken directly from the L45.

The drivetrain is a hybrid setup, consisting of a turbocharged
1.6-liter 4-cylinder and two electric motors.
brandCentral.sourceName: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
brandCentral.zh:
您对Peugeot的传奇车型L45有多少了解？

它是这家公司最著名的赛车之一，因为在1916年赢得了印
地500而举世闻名。

它同样也是这款Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo的
设计灵感来源。

其车身后部的造型以及逐步收窄的车尾都直接沿用了L45
的设计。

这辆混动车配备有一台1.6L 四缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机。

catch.en: This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.
catch.zh: 专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created as a tribute to Peugeot’s historic triumph at the 1916 Indianapolis 500 Mile Race. Standing at just 3.3 ft tall, the car boasts a low-slung profile, with a gracefully tapered tail reminiscent of the Indy-winning L45 machine. Its powertrain features a hybrid setup, pairing a 1.6-liter turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with two electric motors, delivering a combined output of 493.1 HP and 730 Nm (535.2 ft-lb) of torque.

long.en: This Vision Gran Turismo was created as a tribute to Peugeot’s historic triumph at the 1916 Indianapolis 500 Mile Race. Standing at just 3.3 ft tall, the car boasts a low-slung profile, with a gracefully tapered tail reminiscent of the Indy-winning L45 machine. Its powertrain features a hybrid setup, pairing a 1.6-liter turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with two electric motors, delivering a combined output of 493.1 HP and 730 Nm (535.2 ft-lb) of torque.

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

This is the competition version of the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. The rev limiter on its 1.6-liter 4-cylinder engine has been raised to 10,000 rpm, boosting peak output to 571 HP. When combined with the 167.7 HP produced by the electric motors, total system output reaches an impressive 739.6 HP. Visually, the car features a prominent front under spoiler and a large rear wing, both added to generate increased downforce.

vehicleCollection.en:
A unique car with a double-bubble rear roof.

First capturing attention with its debut as a concept at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, the Peugeot RCZ transitioned to production in 2010 with remarkably few changes from its original design. In 2015, the lineup was enhanced with the introduction of the GT Line model, which brought a new front grille, dual exhaust outlets, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a red-stitched black leather interior.

long.en: First capturing attention with its debut as a concept at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, the Peugeot RCZ transitioned to production in 2010 with remarkably few changes from its original design. In 2015, the lineup was enhanced with the introduction of the GT Line model, which brought a new front grille, dual exhaust outlets, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a red-stitched black leather interior.
long.zh: Peugeot RCZ最初在2007年法兰克福车展上作为概念车亮相之后，立刻获得了广泛的关注。在2010年正式上市时，它基本上保留了原版概念车的形制。2015年，产品线中又加入了GT Line车型。这个新型号采用了全新的前格栅设计和双排气管，换上了19英寸轮毂，还搭配上全新的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰，呈现出更具运动感的外观。

This is the homologation model of the RCZ Gr.3, a race-spec version of Peugeot’s gracefully sculpted specialty coupe, adapted for Gr.3 regulations. Transformed into a mid-engine supercar, the design draws inspiration from the 2002 RC concept, one of the earliest visions that eventually gave rise to the RCZ.

long.en: This is the homologation model of the RCZ Gr.3, a race-spec version of Peugeot’s gracefully sculpted specialty coupe, adapted for Gr.3 regulations. Transformed into a mid-engine supercar, the design draws inspiration from the 2002 RC concept, one of the earliest visions that eventually gave rise to the RCZ.

Serving as the foundation for the Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car
was the Peugeot RCZ.

While the original came with an FF layout, we changed it to an
MR layout to suit Gr.3 specifications.

This was easily done, thanks to the base RCZ's long wheelbase,
which provides exceptional lateral stability.

We must say that the car's overall balance has been greatly
improved with the new engine location. %

原车是前置前驱布局，赛车版本却改为使用中置后驱布
局，以满足Gr.3的规范。

基础的RCZ轴距较长，拥有较高的稳定性，

This is a Gr.3 race version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

A Gran Turismo Original, this is a race-prepared version of the RCZ—Peugeot’s elegantly contoured specialty coupe—adapted for Gr.3 regulations. To enhance weight distribution and overall performance, the drivetrain has been reconfigured from its original front-engine/front-wheel-drive setup to a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout. With its extended 102.8 inches wheelbase, the RCZ provides an ideal foundation for transformation into a competitive race machine.

Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.

The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.

Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.

As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
9

This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR hoologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an race cars greatly resembled each other.

familiar with NASCAR.

Its race machines are loosely based on production cars,
and the series is extremely popular in the U.S.

Established in 1948, NASCAR is a motorsport series
with a lot of history behind it.

Among the more legendary race cars in the history of
NASCAR is the Plymouth Superbird.

Towards the end of the 1960s, NASCAR race cars were starting
to regularly exceed speeds of more than <300km/h>.

The Superbird wa based on the Plymouth Road Runner.

Its long nose and large rear wing helped increase stability
at high speeds.

These aerodynamic advantages translated to incredibly
fast lap times that left the competition in the dust.

The brass at NASCAR ween't thrilled in seeing the
lopsided results of the races...

...nor d they want to e rac car production costs
skyrocket, making it inaccessible to the masses.

As aresult te Suerbirdwasdiscnudafter two yers.

vehicleCollection.en:
This stock car for the street had a wedge-shaped front end and one of the tallest rear wings ever to grace a production car.

This homologation model was released by Plymouth, under the Chrysler umbrella, with the clear intention of dominating stock car racing. Based on the standard Road Runner, it received an extended nose and an enormous rear wing, creating an unmistakable silhouette. Standard power came from the 440 Super Commando engine, delivering 369.8 HP, while performance-minded buyers could opt for the 426 Hemi with more than 419.1 HP or a 384.6 HP Six Barrel setup. It was produced for a single year to meet homologation requirements.

conversation.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but i was very fresh.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。

他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。

在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。

它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所`RX目一新。
*

This unique Plymouth roadster is best known for having been
designed by Carrozzeria Ghia.

But do you know where the "XNR" name comes from?

If you try to read “XNR” out loud, it sounds just like
"Exner," doesn't it?

It's the name of the legendary American designer
Virgil Max Exner...

...who led Chrysler's design for much of the 1950s and 1960s.

He developed various designs in conjunction with
Luigi Segre of Carrozzeria Ghia.

Many innovative and interesting designs
resulted from this collaboration.

And this XNR Ghia Roadster was one of them.

The XNR also made waves in 2011 when it claimed the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
这款独特的Plymouth敞篷跑车的出名之处在于

但您知道“XNR”这个名字是怎么来的吗？

您读一下就会发现“XNR”听起来很像“Exner”，对吧？

这款车的名字正是取自美国传奇设计师Virgil Max Exner，

他于上世纪50至60年代主要领导Chrysler的设计。

他与Carrozzeria Ghia的Luigi Segre 合作完成了许多设计，

二人的合作带来了大量创新而有趣的作品。

这辆XNR Ghia Roadster就是其中之一。

这辆XNR还于2011年在圆石滩经典车展夺得了Gran Turismo奖杯，
再次吸引了所有人的目光。

conversation.en:
Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...

...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!

You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it
than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several
road-going sports cars.

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance
electric vehicle brand.

So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……

这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！

事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。

2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。

总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！
?

brandCentral.en:
Polestar is a premium EV brand from Sweden with a
unique focus on speed and sustainability.

Its flagship car is the Polestar 5, a grand AWD saloon
measuring <5m> in length.

Its panoramic glass roof doesn't compromise visibility
thanks to a camera-supported virtual rear-view mirror.

Powered by dual motors at the car’s front and back,
the performance model can output 650 kW...

And employs BWI MagneRide dampers that can read the road up
to 1,000 times per second, increasing comfort and speed.

Its 800V battery supports charging rates up to 350 kW, and
its rear motor can be detached to boost efficiency.

Sustainable inside and out, the Polestar 5 may very well be
a guiding light for automotive design in the years to come.
brandCentral.zh:
Polestar是来自瑞典的高端电动品牌，
对于速度与可持续性有独到专注。

其旗舰车型Polestar 5是一款大型四驱轿车，
车长达到<5m>。

全景玻璃车顶丝毫不影响后方视野，
这得益于通过摄像头实现的虚拟后视镜。

前后双电机加持的Performance版可输出650千瓦……

还配备了BWI MagneRide减震器，每秒可扫描路面信息
高达1.000次，从而提升行驶时的舒适感与疾速。

800V高压电池支持最高350千瓦充电功率，
后电机可分离，以提升能效。

由内到外贯彻可持续理念的Polestar 5，
很有希望成为未来汽车设计的指路明灯。

vehicleCollection.en:
Polestar's flagship model combines sustainability with high-performance.

Created by the Scandinavian electric performance brand Polestar, the Polestar 5 is an all-wheel-drive electric sedan distinguished by its sleek, sub-five-meter profile and a glass roof that extends gracefully to the rear. Power came from a dual-motor setup, with one motor mounted on each axle. In Performance trim, it delivered an impressive 650 kW and 1,015 Nm of torque. Its 800-volt electrical architecture supported 350 kW rapid charging, replenishing the battery from 10 to 80 percent in just 22 minutes. Under WLTP testing, the dual-motor version achieved a maximum range of 416.3 miles.

usedCar.en:
The Pontiac Firebird was built to compete with the Mustang.

The high-performance version, called the Trans Am, gained
widespread fame in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."

Despite the oil crisis of the 1970s, Pontiac elected to
retain the large V-8 engine in subsequent designs.

This particular model is the second-generation Firebird
Trans Am that came equipped with a 6.6-liter V-8.

You can call it the Chevrolet Camaro's brother because both
were built by General Motors.

The two cars were historically called the F-body pony cars.~
usedCar.zh:
Pontiac Firebird是Ford Mustang的最著名的竞争对手之一。

它的高性能版本Trans Am永远地改写了
美国跑车历史的进程。

尽管选择了在后续设计中保留大排量的V8引擎。

这个特殊的车型就是第二代
Firebird Trans Am。

它发布于1978年，搭载前置6.6L V8引擎。

对于许多人来说，
Pontiac仍然经典的“肌肉车”。

vehicleCollection.en:
Made famous by Burt Reynolds in "Smokey and the Bandit," this was one of the leading '70s muscle cars.

This was a quintessential example of a 1970s American muscle car. The bold firebird decal emblazoned across the hood became a cultural icon, especially popular among younger enthusiasts of the era. Although it shared its underpinnings with the Chevrolet Camaro, the top-tier Trans Am distinguished itself with an exclusive 6.6-liter engine, not offered on its Chevrolet sibling, making it the pride of Pontiac.

collection.en:
Introduced in 1964, the Pontiac GTO is considered
one of the first American muscle cars.

In a series of one-upmanship by various manufacturers, the GTO's
performance was soon eclipsed by the competition.

In response, Pontiac created a new high-performance
model called "The Judge."

It came equipped with a powerful 6.6-liter V-8.

It also boasted wide tires, a rear spoiler and distinctive livery
that gave the car an extremely powerful presence.

Because of The Judge, the Pontiac GTO retained its rightful
place at the top of the muscle-car heap.
collection.zh:
被视为美式肌肉车的先驱之一的
Pontiac GTO于1964年推出。

但没过多久，强大竞争对手就将它的表现掩盖。

作为回应，Pontiac将希望寄托在一款
新的高性能版本，“The Judge”。

除了性能卓越的6.6升V8引擎外……

 其外观也在独特的贴花，宽轮胎、后扰流板与
其他装饰的加持下显得霸气。

多亏了“The Judge”的存在，Pontiac GTO才能维持
其在肌肉车领域其应有的领导地位。

catch.en: The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.
catch.zh: 在肌肉车首次领跑的GTO时代末期出现的终极运动规格车辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.

Introduced in 1968, the second-generation Pontiac GTO was hailed as a pioneer of the muscle car era, though it faced fierce competition. To silence the debate, Pontiac unveiled “The Judge." Equipped with a 6.6-liter Ram Air III V-8, a Hurst shifter, heavy-duty suspension, wide tires, and a rear spoiler, the package propelled the GTO back to the forefront of the muscle car wars.

long.en: Introduced in 1968, the second-generation Pontiac GTO was hailed as a pioneer of the muscle car era, though it faced fierce competition. To silence the debate, Pontiac unveiled “The Judge." Equipped with a 6.6-liter Ram Air III V-8, a Hurst shifter, heavy-duty suspension, wide tires, and a rear spoiler, the package propelled the GTO back to the forefront of the muscle car wars.

dialogues.en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.

This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.

It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...

...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.

The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual ifference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual cois specific
to the Carrera engine.

When u opened up threar id, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera egine ws n aristic astrpie
Tefan shroud ad assembly were gogeus too!

collection.en:
On the outside, the Porsche GS Carrera looks no different
from other 356 coupés of its day.

What makes this GS Carrera so special
and raises its value...

Is its four-cam 1.5L engine, capable of producing <100ps>.

This engine was the most powerful version
available for the 356 series at the time.

To reduce weight, it was possible to order lighter
speedster seats and remove the heaters.

That's why the GS was not just a fast street car,
but was also seen in many races.

I think you'll find that it's directly linked to
Porsche's illustrious past!
collection.zh:
从外观上看，保时捷GS Carrera和当时的其他356轿跑
并无二致，

但令GS Carrera如此独特而价值不菲的，

是那台能够输出<100ps>的四凸轮1.5升引擎。

这款引擎代表了当时356车系的最强动力版本。

同时这款车接受定制轻量化的speedster座椅，甚至为了减重拆
除了加热系统。

也因此，GS不仅是一辆够快的街车，更是许多赛事的常客。

看着它的光辉履历您就会发现，这辆车与保时捷辉煌的过去
密不可分！

catch.en: A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.
catch.zh: 356A的半赛事车型，该车使Porsche闻名于世。

vehicleCollection.en:
A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.

Launched in 1949, the 356 A was a refined successor to Porsche’s first production model, the 356. Two variants were offered, both using a detuned version of the 550 Spyder’s engine. The 1500 GS Carrera road-going version produced 98.6 HP, while the semi-competition 1500 GS GT delivered 108.5 HP. This model also introduced the "Carrera" name—now synonymous with Porsche performance.

long.en: Launched in 1949, the 356 A was a refined successor to Porsche’s first production model, the 356. Two variants were offered, both using a detuned version of the 550 Spyder’s engine. The 1500 GS Carrera road-going version produced 98.6 HP, while the semi-competition 1500 GS GT delivered 108.5 HP. This model also introduced the "Carrera" name—now synonymous with Porsche performance.
long.zh: 1949年推出的356 A是Porsche首款量产车型356的改进版。356A有两个版本，所搭载的引擎均来自550 Spyder，但性能经过下调。公路车1500 GS Carrera能输出100 PS，半赛车1500 GS GT则能输出110 PS。这款车更是首次启用了Porsche如今标志性的“Carrera”子车型命名。

spartan model in the Porsche lineup...

collection.en:
It's a well-known fact that Porsche’s first production car
started with the rear-engine Porsche 356.

Full production of the 356 series began in 1950...

...and the coupe model was soon followed by
open-top versions.

All of these models shared a boxed sheet metal
chassis with independent suspension.

And the flat-4 engine was available in five
different displacements and output.

A slightly modified 356A appeared in 1955.

In 1956, a high performance 1.5-liter engine developd for
the 550 Spyder was offered as an option.

Models equipped with the powerful 1.5-liter engine
were called the GS Carrera.

They are known to have been cars that could immediately
be raced as is.

This model is a GS Carrera GT, characterize by
a lighter body and powerful engine.

These cars are collectibles tt rarely changhands
so don't miss your chance to drive it!
collection.zh:
众所周知，保时捷的第一辆量产车
是引擎后置的保时捷356。

356系列的全面生产始于1950年……

继双门硬顶版本之后很快推出了敞篷版。

所有车型都适配了搭载独立悬挂的箱形金属底盘，

水平对置四缸引擎则有五种不同的排量和动力输出可选。

小改款356A于1955年推出，

到了1956年，专为550 Spyder设计开发的
高性能1.5升引擎正式登场。

配备了强大的1.5升引擎的#型被称为GS Carrera。

它们的特点在于可以随时下场参加比赛。

这台车型为GS GT Carrera，配备了
更轻的车身和更强大的引擎。

是相当罕见的Speedster款，几乎未曾易手，
您绝不会想错过亲驾驭这款车的机会！

vehicleCollection.en:
With the introduction of this model, Porsche became known as a maker of the world's finest sports cars.

Porsche’s first mass-produced sports car made its debut in 1949. From 1955 to 1959, these models were referred to as the 356 A, using an engine derived from the 550 Spyder. The semi-competition 1500 GS GT Carrera, producing 108.5 HP, marked the beginning of the Carrera legacy.

long.en: Porsche’s first mass-produced sports car made its debut in 1949. From 1955 to 1959, these models were referred to as the 356 A, using an engine derived from the 550 Spyder. The semi-competition 1500 GS GT Carrera, producing 108.5 HP, marked the beginning of the Carrera legacy.
long.zh: Porsche的首款量产跑车，首次亮相于1949年。于1955年至1959年间发布的车型被统称为356 A，采用的引擎基于550 Spyder。定位为半赛车的1500 GS GT Carrera版本可输出110 PS的动力，是首款冠以“Carrera”之名的车。

collection.en:
There have been many great Porsche 911s over the years,
but the Carrera RS stands out as a shining masterpiece.

The 1973 Carrera RS was the first production
911 to wear the ‘Carrera RS’ name...

And was built specifically to win races.

A homologation model designed to meet FIA Group 4
regulations...

Its engine displacement was increased to 2.7L
from the 2.4L of the standard 911.

The car was also lightened by omitting anything
deemed to be unnecessary.

Summer tyres were chosen for enhanced grip, aided by
special front and rear spoilers.

The so-called ‘ducktail’ spoiler in the rear is a
particularly iconic design feature.

The 911 Carrera RS only sold in limited numbers
from late 1972 to 1973.

And whilerain iterations have followed in the fotsteps
of their forebear all theʓay to crrn1s.
As the first o the series, the 911 Crrera RS
ejoys a legendary sort of ppularity.
collection.zh:
多年以来，保时捷911推出过许多款伟大的车型，
不过Carrera RS才是其中最闪亮的杰作。

1973款Carrera RS是第一辆被冠以
“Carrera RS”之名的911……

也是专为胜利所打造的比赛机器。

这辆针对国际汽联组别4规则所开发的认证赛车……

将引擎排量从标准911车型的2.4升增加到了2.7升。

此外，它还拆除了一切非必要的部件，
让车重得到了大幅减轻。

为了增强抓地力，款车采用了夏用轮胎，
并由特制的前后扰流板来辅助增加下压力。

车尾的“鸭尾”扰流板是其极具标志性的特征。

这款911 Carrera RS仅在1972到1973年之间限量销售。

尽管在此之后，多款y续赛车型号继承了前辈的衣钵，
直至演化到最新款的911	d…

但Wv为R列的开山之作，这款911 Carrera RS永远
享有最传奇的知名度。

catch.en: A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.
catch.zh: Porsche 911历史上首款冠以稀有的Rennsport之名的型号。

vehicleCollection.en:
A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.

The first Porsche 911 to carry the RS badge was the 911 Carrera RS 2.7, released in 1973. The "RS" stood for Rennsport, meaning racing sport in German. Developed to meet FIA Group 4 homologation requirements, the car was designed with motorsports in mind. It quickly proved to be a hit—its initial production run of 500 units sold out immediately. Due to high demand, Porsche expanded production, ultimately building a total of 1,580 examples.

Due to high demand, Porsche expanded production, ultimately building a total of 1,580 examples.

The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the <40mm> lower ride height.

You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.

But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.

It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.

As a result, it's <120kg> lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.

I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.
?

你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。

但是，令964型911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于

装饰件和舒适性功能。

conversation.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
Z
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！

它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。

只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不dV！

conversation.en:
Freeman is also a huge fan and connoisseur of Porsches.

Should we hear more about the car from him?

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!

usedCar.en:
If you're a fan of sports cars, you'll love the 964 series
Porsche 911 Carrera RS.

The 964 series was successful in the 'Carrera Cup', helping
to fuel a huge surge of consumer interest in race cars.

This Carrera RS is therefore a road-legal version of an
iconic racing champion.

The designers went to great lengths to get the most out of
the engine while keeping the car as light as possible.

It might not look all that powerful, but no other car out
there can compete when it comes to handling.
usedCar.zh:
如果你是跑车爱好者，那你会爱上964系列
Porsche 911 Carrera RS。

964系列在“Carrera Cup”中非常成功，让
大量的消费者对赛车产生了兴趣。

这款Carrera RS因此成为代表性赛车锦标赛
的合法公路版。

设计师在保持车身尽量轻盈的同时加长了
车身，让引擎发挥出最大的优势。

它看起来可能没那么强大，但就操作性
而言，没有其他车辆可与之媲美。

catch.en: This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.

vehicleCollection.en:
This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.

In 1989, Porsche introduced the third-generation 911, known internally as the Type 964. Although it retained the familiar shape of its predecessor, it was a major leap forward, with about 80 percent of its components being newly developed. The Carrera 4, featuring 4-wheel drive, debuted first, followed by the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2 in 1990. The Carrera RS of this generation was a performance-tuned variant based on the Carrera 2.

long.en: In 1989, Porsche introduced the third-generation 911, known internally as the Type 964. Although it retained the familiar shape of its predecessor, it was a major leap forward, with about 80 percent of its components being newly developed. The Carrera 4, featuring 4-wheel drive, debuted first, followed by the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2 in 1990. The Carrera RS of this generation was a performance-tuned variant based on the Carrera 2.
long.zh: 1989年，Porsche推出第3代911，这便是Type 964。造型上虽然与前代911颇为相近，实则约80%的零部件都是全新设计。四驱款Carrera 4率先发布，后驱款Carrera 2于1990年问世。Carrera RS是在Carrera 2基础上衍生的性能车型。

You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’

conversation.zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……

并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。

在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……

后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。
g

dialogues.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’

usedCar.en:
The Porsche 911 Type 993 will always be remembered as
the last of the air-cooled 911s.

The base Carrera models come with a naturally-aspirated
flat-6 engine, which is mounted aft of the rear axle.

This includes the venerable RS, which is based on a
racing version of the car.

The lightweight body and more responsive engine make this
particular machine stand out from the other 911s.

Although it isn't as fast in a straight line as the 911 Turbo,
many enthusiasts prefer taking this one out on the track.
usedCar.zh:
这款Porsche 993作为911系列最后一款使用
风冷式引擎的车型，多次获得嘉奖。

它是体验搭载自然进气引擎的911车型的
完美方式。

与其他RS车型一样，这一名称表示该车型
是基于跑车版本。

轻量级车身结合响应速度更快的引擎，
与经典Porsche后置后驱布局相得益彰。

驾驶这款911时间越长，
就会越欣赏它。

catch.en: The most powerful version of the 993, the last air-cooled Porsche, came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP.
catch.zh: 搭载一台3.8L水平对置6缸引擎，可产生300 PS动力。作为993最强大的车型，这是最后一款采用风冷的Porsche。

vehicleCollection.en:
The most powerful version of the 993, the last air-cooled Porsche, came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP.

Porsche introduced the fourth-generation 911 in 1993 with the launch of the Type 993. Alongside revised styling, the model featured significant suspension improvements that enhanced handling. The most powerful variant of the series was the Carrera RS, released in 1995, which featured a more rigid yet lighter body. Powering the car was the final air-cooled engine used in the 911—a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP. The track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport was also made available.

long.en: Porsche introduced the fourth-generation 911 in 1993 with the launch of the Type 993. Alongside revised styling, the model featured significant suspension improvements that enhanced handling. The most powerful variant of the series was the Carrera RS, released in 1995, which featured a more rigid yet lighter body. Powering the car was the final air-cooled engine used in the 911—a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP. The track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport was also made available.
long.zh: Porsche 911于1993年推出了代号为993的第四代车型。在造型设计更新的同时，悬挂系统也得到了改良，进一步提升了操控性能。最高性能版本是1995年推出的Carrera RS，采用了更加坚固，同时也更轻量化的车身结构。该车还搭载了993系列最后一款风冷引擎——一款3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，最大动力300 PS。同时还提供了专为赛道设计的Carrera RS Clubsport版本。

conversation.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was bred for racing.

It is equipped with a unique rear wing
and integrated air inlets.

The downforce generated by the rear wing
is balanced with a long front spoiler.

The wheels are a three-piece design with
different offsets in the front and rear.

One look at the exterior details will tell you
it was the work of Style Porsche...

The in-house design studio at Porsche-Weissach.

The interior is defined by a spartan palette
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of this era,
the Clubsport evokes its forebear.

Ah, I pity the owner whotresto convince
the authorities to alow it on the road!

A difficult task, bt not impossible!

从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的

保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。

内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。

你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。

为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……

usedCar.en:
The 993 series are famous for being the last
of the air-cooled 911s.

And even amongst RS models, Clubsport are a little special,
much coveted by collectors around the world.

The carpets and soundproofing have been removed to reduce
weight, and a roll cage added to make it more robust.

The 3.8L naturally aspirated flat engine is capable of <300ps>,
while the <1200kg> weight keeps the back end down.

The suspension is a little on the stiff side, but its handling
out on the track is nothing short of exceptional.
usedCar.zh:
993系列是911的最后一个风冷车型，
也因此而闻名于世。

即使在RS车型中，Clubsport版也算是特别之作，
深受世界各地收藏家的喜爱。

为了减轻重量，车内的地毯和隔音材料都被拆除，
还加装了防滚架以提高坚固性。

3.8升自然进气水平对置引擎提供，<300ps><1200kg>的车重则保障了后端的稳定性。

虽然悬挂系统的调校略硬，但丝毫无损赛道上的操作性。

catch.en: This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.
catch.zh: 专为赛道打造的Type 993，最后一款911风冷车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.

The fourth-generation Type 993 Porsche 911 was introduced as an all-new model in 1993. In 1995, the Carrera RS followed, featuring a lighter yet more rigid body and a 295.9 HP 3.8-liter flat-6 engine. The lineup also included the track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport. Specifically designed for circuit use, it came equipped with a large front spoiler, a prominent rear wing, and a welded roll cage.

long.en: The fourth-generation Type 993 Porsche 911 was introduced as an all-new model in 1993. In 1995, the Carrera RS followed, featuring a lighter yet more rigid body and a 295.9 HP 3.8-liter flat-6 engine. The lineup also included the track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport. Specifically designed for circuit use, it came equipped with a large front spoiler, a prominent rear wing, and a welded roll cage.
long.zh: 第四代Porsche 911（代号993）于1993年进行了全面改款换代。1995年推出的Carrera RS采用了更加坚固和轻量的车身，搭载300 PS的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎。车系中还包括了Carrera RS Clubsport版本。后者专为赛道使用而调校，配备了大型前扰流板、尾翼以及焊接式防滚架。

vehicleCollection.zh:
专为赛道打造的Type 993，最后一款911风冷车型。

第四代Porsche 911（代号993）于1993年进行了全面改款换代。1995年推出的Carrera RS采用了更加坚固和轻量的车身，搭载300 PS的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎。车系中还包括了Carrera RS Clubsport版本。后者专为赛道使用而调校，配备了大型前扰流板、尾翼以及焊接式防滚架。

collection.en:
What do you call a street-legal Porsche 911 that shoots from
zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 secs, and tops out at <310km/h>?

Why, the Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion of course!

Developed to meet competition rules for the Le Mans
GT1 Class, only 25 cars were ever sold.

The production car it was based on was
pretty much a race car to begin with.

From its nose to its front suspension, the Porsche 911 GT1
Strassenversion looks like a type 993 911.

But behind the seats you’ll see lots of parts reminiscent of
the Porsche 962 that competed at Le Mans in the 1980s.

The engine is a fire-breathing twin-turbocharged
3.2-liter flat-6.

A chance to own this car rarely comes around.
And this is your chance.
collection.zh:
曾经有一台可以合法上路的Porsche 911，能在3.7秒内从零加速
至<100km>，极速高达<310km/h>，它的名字是？

没错，它就是Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion。

专为满足勒芒GT1级别赛事要求而打造，
仅发售了25辆。

它所基于的量产车从一开始
就几乎是一辆赛车。

从车头到前悬架部分，Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion
看起来就像993型号的Porsche 911，

但座椅后面的很多部件则让人想起
80年代征战勒芒的Porsche 962。

动力部分采用3.2升 双涡轮增压的
水平对置六缸引擎。

拥有这辆车的机会很少登门，机不可失哦。

catch.en: A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.
catch.zh: 911 GT1的公路版，此车是Porsche为GT赛事而专门开发的。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.

Porsche also developed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion—a road-legal counterpart to the 911 GT1 race car built for GT competition between 1996 and 1998. While the headlights were updated to match those of the Type 996, the core construction of the car remained nearly identical to its racing sibling. To comply with emissions regulations, the engine was detuned to 536.5 HP, yet the car still managed a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of 191.4 mph.

long.en: Porsche also developed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion—a road-legal counterpart to the 911 GT1 race car built for GT competition between 1996 and 1998. While the headlights were updated to match those of the Type 996, the core construction of the car remained nearly identical to its racing sibling. To comply with emissions regulations, the engine was detuned to 536.5 HP, yet the car still managed a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of 191.4 mph.
long.zh: Porsche在1996至1998年间为GT赛事开发了911 GT1赛车，911 GT1 Strassenversion是该车的道路合法版本。车灯改为与type 996相同的配置，但车辆的基础结构与赛车版本几乎别无二致。为符合排放法规，引擎动力下调至544 PS，但该车依然能够实现3.7秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间，最高时速达308 公里/小时。

The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!

It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!

它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！

conversation.en: Have you ever heard of Porsche's Mezger engine？
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh: 您听说过Porsche的Mezger引擎吗？

conversation.en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

dialogues.en:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of
the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!

It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!
;
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.zh:
2001款996 GT3是Porsche最大的秘密武器之一！

无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝Porsche所推出的所有GT3！

它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！

brandCentral.en:
The 996 GT3 was a true labor of love for Porsche's
top engineers.

In fact, this high-performance model reinvented the 911 genre.

First, instead of the traditional air-cooled engine, this one
came with a water-cooled boxer powerplant.

Thanks to its excellent power and race-ready chassis, the GT3
served as the foundation for many race cars.

Some say it's the true successor to the 993 Carrera RS.

But everyone agrees it's a car that will go down
in Porsche history.
brandCentral.zh:
996 GT3是Porsche的顶尖工程师们充满热诚的产物：

基于充满魅力的911原版车打造，

并加入部分现代化的设计要素，尤其是一台水冷引擎。

这款GT3在未来将会成为多款赛车的设计基础。

还有人说他是993 Carrera RS的真正继承者。

无论从哪个角度看，它都是一款真正具有开创历史意义的赛车。

usedCar.en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 came into being with the Type 996, and
it has since become a mainstay of the brand.

Its car's flat-6 engine is packed with power, allowing the car
to get from zero to 60 mph in about 4.5 seconds.

Because the 996 was the first 911 powered by a water-cooled
engine, the GT3 represents a first on a few fronts.

It comes packed with the race technology accrued by Porsche's
long history in motorsports.

And because of this, it remains one of the finest vehicles
Porsche ever produced.=
usedCar.zh:
这是Porsche 911系列中996车型的
GT3版。

搭载水平对置六缸引擎提供超强马力，
让你完全沉浸于驾驶体验中。

坚固的车身和引擎响应速度
像是回到有点复古的风冷时代。

但是也正是这些品质使得GT3
别具一格。

无论从哪个方向看，它都是Porsche
生产的最经典的车型之一。/

catch.en: The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.
catch.zh: Type 993引入了911系列中的首款GT3规格车型。这款车深受消费者的喜爱，现已售出1,889辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.

The 996-generation Porsche 911, introduced in 1997, was the first to feature a GT3 variant. Using the rigid Carrera 4 chassis as a foundation, it incorporated race-grade upgrades to the suspension and brakes, while the engine took on a GT1-spec crankcase for high-rev performance. A total of 1,889 units were produced.

long.en: The 996-generation Porsche 911, introduced in 1997, was the first to feature a GT3 variant. Using the rigid Carrera 4 chassis as a foundation, it incorporated race-grade upgrades to the suspension and brakes, while the engine took on a GT1-spec crankcase for high-rev performance. A total of 1,889 units were produced.
long.zh: 最初于1997年推出的996款911是首款GT3车型。以高刚性的Carrera 4车身为基础，悬挂和刹车均升级为赛车级部件，而引擎则用适合更高转速的GT1曲轴箱来搭配。此车总共生产了1889台。

conversation.en:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from
the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.

A few of these elements have become something that is
unique to Porsche.

A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated
with the bumper's air intake opening.

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they
increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
997这款车带回了Porsche从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。

其中的一些升级最终成为了Porsche的标准元素。

这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。

这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。

If such a thing as the archetypal sports car exists,
then this is surely it.

Refining the concept of the 996-iteration, the 997 features
improved engine capabilities among other things.

This is a late-model version, released in 2008.

The engine displacement has been increased to 3.8L,
bumping the power up by <20ps> to <435ps>.

如果这个世界上存在一辆所有跑车的典范的话，那这个

of power under the bonnet, but it handles like a dream.

In fact, this car packs an extra <20ps> compared to
earlier models.

The suspension movement is also more refined than previous
GT3s, making it noticeably more comfortable to drive.

Don't worry, though—this hasn't entailed any sacrifice
in its performance!

This is a car that can truly be said to have realised
the vision of Porsche's engineers.

997系列保时捷911 GT3引擎盖下的马力
可能超过<400ps>，但是操作性非常梦幻。

实际上，这款车搭载的引擎与早期车型

悬挂系统与先前的GT3相比也更精良，
所以驾驶体验更显舒适。

别担心，即使这样，它在性能方面也
没有牺牲分毫！

这款车可以说是真正实现了

vehicleCollection.en:
Featuring adjustable dampers as standard equipment, this GT3 version of the Type 997 made its debut in 2006.

In 2006, Porsche introduced the GT3 variant for the Type 997. As with its predecessor, it used the Carrera 4 platform, along with upgraded suspension and braking systems. The engine, originally a 3.6-liter unit, was enlarged to 3.8 liters in 2008, increasing output to 428 HP. Electronically controlled PASM dampers were included as standard equipment.

long.en: In 2006, Porsche introduced the GT3 variant for the Type 997. As with its predecessor, it used the Carrera 4 platform, along with upgraded suspension and braking systems. The engine, originally a 3.6-liter unit, was enlarged to 3.8 liters in 2008, increasing output to 428 HP. Electronically controlled PASM dampers were included as standard equipment.
long.zh: 2006年为997款911推出的GT3规格车型。以Carrera 4车型为基础，底盘和刹车得到了和前代996车型一样的升级。最初的3.6升引擎排量在2008年扩容至3.8升，动力输出达435 PS。此外，还标配了电控PASM可变式减震器。

conversation.en:
Did you know that, along with its increased engine
displacement over the previous model...

...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first
GT3 R to feature a swan-neck rear wing?

For me, its defining accomplishment remains those unforgettable
back-to-back victories at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

Both came in the LMGT3 Class, which replaced
the LMGTE category in 2024.

In its debut year, it secured a superb class win under
conditions that were anything but forgiving.

Then it did it all over again the following year—a truly
remarkable achievement, wouldn’t you agree?
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
你知道吗？Porsche 911 GT3 R (992)不仅
排量比其前任大……

也是第一款采用天鹅颈式尾翼的GT3 R？

就我个人而言，它最令人难忘的成就，
是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中实现了两夺冠。

它在LMGT3组别（2024年取代LMGTE组别）中
取得了这一佳绩。

在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。

然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？

它在LMGT3组别（2024年取代LMGTE组别）中
取得了这一佳绩。

在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。

然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？
+

brandCentral.en:
What hasn’t already been said about the Porsche 911,
that historic and legendary sports car par excellence?

This GT3 R was derived from the 911 (992) introduced in 2018.
It may resemble a road car, but it was engineered for racing.

Notably, its displacement was increased to 4.2 liters,
and the engine was tilted forward by 5.5 degrees.

A revised layout extended the wheelbase to <2507mm>, and both
the front and rear axles employed a multilink suspension.

The underfloor design concep was particularly striking, and
the swan-neck mount for the rear wing was a novel touch.

Meanwhile, the interior featured a centered seat, roll cage,
and a 10.3-inch display.

A car with a truly international clientele, the 911 GT3 R
proved its raing prowess at events across the world.
brandCentral.zh:
对于保时捷911这款无与伦比的历史传奇跑车，
人们早已穷尽赞美之辞。

眼前这台GT3 R正是基于2018款911（992）打造。
它虽然形似公路跑车，实则是专为赛道竞速而生。

相比911，它的显著变化在于引擎排量增加到了4.2升，
且引擎姿态向前倾斜了5.5度。

布局经过优化，将轴距延长到了<2507mm>，前后轴
均采用多连杆悬挂系统。

底板的设计理念相当惊艳，尾翼的天鹅颈式支架
也是富有新意的神来之笔。

同时，在座舱内，中央驾驶位、防滚架和10.3英寸显示屏
一应俱全。

作为饱受全球车迷喜爱的车型，911 GT3 R
还在世界各地的赛场上证明了其非凡实力。

catch.en: This is a pure racing machine from the 8th generation 911 catalogue.
catch.zh: 脱胎于第八代911车系的纯粹竞速机器。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a pure racing machine from the 8th generation 911 catalogue.

The 911 GT3 R was a pure racing machine developed from the 992-model 911, the eighth generation of Porsche’s everyday sports car. Introduced in 2022, this machine was equipped with a naturally aspirated 4.2-liter flat-6 engine, producing a maximum 557.2 HP. It also featured lightweight carbon body panels and aramid-fiber components, as well as the double-wishbone/multilink suspension setup derived from the 911 RSR.

long.en: The 911 GT3 R was a pure racing machine developed from the 992-model 911, the eighth generation of Porsche’s everyday sports car. Introduced in 2022, this machine was equipped with a naturally aspirated 4.2-liter flat-6 engine, producing a maximum 557.2 HP. It also featured lightweight carbon body panels and aramid-fiber components, as well as the double-wishbone/multilink suspension setup derived from the 911 RSR.
long.zh: 911 GT3 R是一款纯粹为赛道而生的跑车，基于Porsche面向日常使用的911跑车的第八代车型992来研发。这款于2022年发布的赛车装备了一台自然进气的4.2升水平对置六缸引擎，可产生高达565 PS的动力。其车身还采用了轻量化的碳纤维车身板件和芳纶纤维部件，以及沿袭自911 RSR的双摇臂/多连杆悬挂配置。

vehicleCollection.zh:
脱胎于第八代911车系的纯粹竞速机器。

911 GT3 R是一款纯粹为赛道而生的跑车，基于Porsche面向日常使用的911跑车的第八代车型992来研发。这款于2022年发布的赛车装备了一台自然进气的4.2升水平对置六缸引擎，可产生高达565 PS的动力。其车身还采用了轻量化的碳纤维车身板件和芳纶纤维部件，以及沿袭自911 RSR的双摇臂/多连杆悬挂配置。

brandCentral.en:
It's no secret that many of Porsche's road-going masterpieces
were the product of the company's racing heritage.

The 911 GT3 RS is no different.

The engine and suspension were custom-built for this car.

And extra steps were taken to reduce the weight,
including the installation of a magnesium roof.

The 991 was the first GT3 RS car to add rear-wheel
steering to its formidable array of features.

If you want to go fast anywhere from the open road to a
challenging race track, this car should be high on your list.
brandCentral.zh:
Porsche那赛车范十足的设计风格深受全世界汽车爱好者的喜爱。

这款911 GT3 RS就充分地展现了他们最精湛的生产工艺。

定制化打造的引擎和悬挂系统自不必提。

Porsche还采取了一系列措施来减轻车重，例如安装镁合金车顶等。

在同类型车中首次应用的后轮转向让本就所向披靡的各项特性
如虎添翼。

不论车速有多快，它都能确保提供超一流的操控性能。

catch.en: The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.
catch.zh: 从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.

This high-performance model served as a further evolution of the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Starting with the wide-body shell of the 911 Turbo, Porsche increased front and rear track widths, while also implementing major weight reductions and aerodynamic enhancements. The engine, enlarged to 4.0 liters, produced 493.1 HP and enabled the car to record a Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time of 7 minutes and 20 seconds.

long.en: This high-performance model served as a further evolution of the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Starting with the wide-body shell of the 911 Turbo, Porsche increased front and rear track widths, while also implementing major weight reductions and aerodynamic enhancements. The engine, enlarged to 4.0 liters, produced 493.1 HP and enabled the car to record a Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time of 7 minutes and 20 seconds.
long.zh: 这款高性能车型是991系列中的Porsche 911 GT3的改进版。基于911 Turbo的宽体车身，前后轮距加宽，同时进行了大幅减重和空气动力学方面的改进。如今引擎排量扩容至4升，动力输出达500 PS，得以在纽博格林北侧赛道创下7分20秒的圈速。

vehicleCollection.zh:
从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

这款高性能车型是991系列中的Porsche 911 GT3的改进版。基于911 Turbo的宽体车身，前后轮距加宽，同时进行了大幅减重和空气动力学方面的改进。如今引擎排量扩容至4升，动力输出达500 PS，得以在纽博格林北侧赛道创下7分20秒的圈速。

brandCentral.en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the modern incarnation
of the legendary 911 Carrera RS from 1973.

It was based on the 992 Porsche 911 GT3 from 2021...

...which was another special creation from Porsche’s
motorsports division.

Unique to the GT3 RS, however, is the technology it inherited
from race cars like the 911 RSR and 911 GT3R.

Whether it’s on the road or in your garage, this is one
sports car that simply exudes the racing spirit!
brandCentral.zh:
Porsche 911 GT3 RS是1973年的传奇车型
911 Carrera RS的现代版本。

这款车是基于2021年的992 Porsche 911 GT3所打造……

而后者本就是Porsche赛车运动部门的特殊作品。

不过GT3 RS的独特之处在于采用了从911 RSR和911 GT3R等
赛车处继承的技术。

不论是上路行驶，还是停在你的车库里，
这辆跑车无时无刻不彰显着真正的赛车精神！

catch.en: A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.
catch.zh: 一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.

The Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992) was a high-performance road car that incorporated aerodynamic components from the 911 GT3 R race car. It was fitted with a range of advanced aerodynamic systems, including a large swan-neck rear wing with DRS (drag reduction system) and an active diffuser that functioned as an air brake under hard braking.

long.en: The Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992) was a high-performance road car that incorporated aerodynamic components from the 911 GT3 R race car. It was fitted with a range of advanced aerodynamic systems, including a large swan-neck rear wing with DRS (drag reduction system) and an active diffuser that functioned as an air brake under hard braking.
long.zh: Porsche 911 GT3 RS（992）是一款高性能公路跑车，采用了源自911 GT3 R赛车的空气动力学套件。该车配备了多种先进的空气动力学系统，包括搭载DRS（可变尾翼减阻系统）的大型天鹅颈式尾翼，以及在急刹车时可起到气动减速作用的可调主动式扩散器。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

Porsche 911 GT3 RS（992）是一款高性能公路跑车，采用了源自911 GT3 R赛车的空气动力学套件。该车配备了多种先进的空气动力学系统，包括搭载DRS（可变尾翼减阻系统）的大型天鹅颈式尾翼，以及在急刹车时可起到气动减速作用的可调主动式扩散器。

conversation.en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.

Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.

The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.

As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"

endurance events such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The biggest departure from the 911 on which it's based
is the mid-mounted engine.

Huge aerodynamic improvements have also been made,
and it's a highly manoeuvrable ride overall.
brandCentral.zh:
911 RSR的991版本是一款专为勒芒24小时耐力赛这样的耐力赛事
所设计的赛车。

它和911最大的差别在于它采用了中置引擎布局。

大量的空气动力学优化令它变得高度可控，操控感十足。

catch.en: This 911, the first in history to feature a mid-engine layout, is a full competition spec machine.
catch.zh: 911史上第一款中置引擎车型。和最终的量产车型不同，这是一款高规格赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 911, the first in history to feature a mid-engine layout, is a full competition spec machine.

This race-bred machine carried the spirit of the RSR. And it was developed through an entirely different process than the production 911 road car. Its 4.0-liter naturally-aspirated engine, the first in 911 history to be mid-mounted, delivered 502 HP. At the 2017 Nürburgring 24 Hours, the car delivered a standout performance, holding the top spot for much of the race.

long.en: This race-bred machine carried the spirit of the RSR. And it was developed through an entirely different process than the production 911 road car. Its 4.0-liter naturally-aspirated engine, the first in 911 history to be mid-mounted, delivered 502 HP. At the 2017 Nürburgring 24 Hours, the car delivered a standout performance, holding the top spot for much of the race.
long.zh: 这台赛车继承了RSR的精神。其开发过程完全不同于911公路车。这款4升自然进气引擎是911历史上首款中置引擎，输出马力为510 PS。在2017年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，它拿出强劲表现，大部分时间都占据杆位。

conversation.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of <300ps>.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。

Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了<300ps>。

由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！

这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。

usedCar.en:
This 930 version of the 911 is the first Porsche production
car to include turbocharging technology.

Turbocharging was originally a standard feature of
Porsche race cars in the 1970s.

But it wasn't long before the company decided to incorporate
forced-induction into its flagship vehicles.

Thanks to the added boost supplied from the turbocharger,
the engine pumps out <300ps>.

The wide rear tires help transfer this power to the driving
surface, making this thing a beast on the race track.#
usedCar.zh:
这款基于911车型的930是第一款搭载涡轮
增压技术的Porsche产车。

涡轮增压是1970年代Porsche
最初的标准特色。

但不久之后公司就决定将
这一特色融入他们的旗舰线。

当时引擎最多只能产生<300ps>的马力，而
涡轮产生的增压大大弥补了这一缺失。

宽大的后轮满足了人们对后置后驱车型
预期的稳固抓地力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This top-of-the-line version of the vaunted 911 possessed a more muscular look and a turbocharged engine.

Introduced in 1975, the 911 Turbo was the first production Porsche to wear the now-iconic "Turbo" badge. True to its name, the car’s 3.0L air-cooled flat-6 engine was equipped with a KKK turbocharger, producing 256.4 HP. This setup enabled the car to cruise at speeds of up to 155.3 mph—a remarkable feat for its era. Beginning in 1977, the engine’s displacement was increased to 3.3 liters and paired with an air-to-air intercooler, which further boosted performance.

long.en: Introduced in 1975, the 911 Turbo was the first production Porsche to wear the now-iconic "Turbo" badge. True to its name, the car’s 3.0L air-cooled flat-6 engine was equipped with a KKK turbocharger, producing 256.4 HP. This setup enabled the car to cruise at speeds of up to 155.3 mph—a remarkable feat for its era. Beginning in 1977, the engine’s displacement was increased to 3.3 liters and paired with an air-to-air intercooler, which further boosted performance.
long.zh: 1975年推出的这款911 Turbo是Porsche量产车历史上首款使用“Turbo”标识的车型。正如其标识所示，3升风冷水平对置6缸引擎搭载了KKK涡轮增压器，最大动力达260 PS。这些配置还能让该车达到250 公里/小时的巡航速度，在当时堪称惊人的成就。从1977年起，引擎排量提升至3.3升并增配了空对空式中间冷却器，进一步提升了动力输出。

vehicleCollection.zh:
911系列当中的旗舰款，拥有强大的车身设计和同等强劲的涡轮增压引擎。
