brandCentral.en:
For more than six decades, the Porsche 911 has remained
a timeless icon within the brand's storied lineup.

In 2018, Porsche unveiled the eighth-generation model,
known as the "992."

Built on the new MMB platform, the 992 utilized more aluminum in
its construction, achieving a lighter curb weight.

The pinnacle of the 992 series was the 911 Turbo S,
a model that outshined its siblings in performance.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.7-liter flat-6 that delivered
<650ps>/<81.6kgm> to all four wheels…

...this gasoline-powered engine catapulted the 911 to new heights
in a landscape increasingly dominated by electric vehicles.'
brandCentral.zh:
作为Porsche的标志性车型，911已有超过60年的历史。

2018年，它以“992”的代号迈入第八代。

992虽然采用全新的“MMB”开发平台，
但通过大量应用铝合金材料实现了轻量化。

作为992系列的旗舰性能车型，911 Turbo S自然实力非凡。

搭载3.7升水平对置六缸双涡轮增压引擎，可向四个车轮
输出<650ps>/<81.6kgm>的动力……

几乎可以说，它在电气化时代来临前将911系列
推向了新的高峰。

catch.en: The top performance version of the eighth-generation 911.
catch.zh: 第八代911的高性能车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top performance version of the eighth-generation 911.

Having stood as the symbol of the Porsche brand since the 1960s, the 911 entered its eighth generation in 2018 with the Type 992. In April 2020, Porsche introduced the Turbo S variant to the 992 lineup as its top-performing model. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3745 cc flat-6 engine, the Turbo S delivered 641 HP and 590.2 ft-lb of torque, channeled through all four wheels, enabling a 0–62.1 mph time of just 2.7 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph.

long.en: Having stood as the symbol of the Porsche brand since the 1960s, the 911 entered its eighth generation in 2018 with the Type 992. In April 2020, Porsche introduced the Turbo S variant to the 992 lineup as its top-performing model. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3745 cc flat-6 engine, the Turbo S delivered 641 HP and 590.2 ft-lb of torque, channeled through all four wheels, enabling a 0–62.1 mph time of just 2.7 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph.
long.zh: 自1960年代起便成为Porsche品牌象征的911，于2018年推出了代号992的第八代车型。2020年4月，Turbo S作为顶级性能版本加入了992车系。双涡轮增压3,745 立方厘米水平对置6缸引擎输出650 PS最大动力和81.6 公斤力米峰值扭矩，通过四轮驱动系统传递澎湃动力，0-100 公里/小时加速仅需2.7秒，最高时速达330 公里/小时。

It celebrated Porsche’s success in the IMSA championship.

true meaning to the Leichtbau name.

Aluminum doors with thinner glass and a cabon-fiber hood
further refined the car’s purpose.

catch.en: The third-generation 911 Turbo was virtually all new with 80 percent new parts.
catch.zh: 第三代911，首次采用全轮驱动，超过80%的零部件经过重新设计。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation 911 Turbo was virtually all new with 80 percent new parts.

The 964 represented the third generation of the 911 series, following the Type 901 and 930. The lineup included a “Turbo” model for those seeking greater performance, as well as the 911 Turbo S Leichtbau, a special variant created to commemorate Porsche’s success in the 1993 IMSA series. True to its “Leichtbau” (lightweight) name, the Turbo S featured high-lift camshafts and a revised turbocharger with increased boost, producing 375.7 HP/361.6 ft-lb. Weight was also significantly reduced compared with the standard Turbo model.

True to its “Leichtbau” (lightweight) name, the Turbo S featured high-lift camshafts and a revised turbocharger with increased boost, producing 375.7 HP/361.6 ft-lb. Weight was also significantly reduced compared with the standard Turbo model.
long.zh: 在911系列中，964是继Type 901和930之后的第三代车型。在这一代的车系阵容中，主打的“Turbo”车型用于满足用户对强劲动力的需求，同时也推出了特别版的911 Turbo S Leichtbau，用于纪念Porsche在1993年IMSA系列赛中夺冠。这款Turbo S被赋予“Leichtbau”（轻量化）之名，搭载了高升程凸轮与一台可提供额外增压的特制涡轮引擎，能够爆发出381 PS动力和50.0 公斤力米扭矩。与标准的Turbo车型相比，其重量也得到了显著减轻。

brandCentral.en:
Everyone knows about the importance of safety cars, the
vehicles deployed during rolling starts, or after accidents.

Ordinary road cars are generally used, but it goes without
saying that ordinary-level performance isn't enough.

Gran Turismo has therefore produced this special safety car
version of the 992‑generation Porsche 911 Turbo S.

The 992-gen 911 made its debut in 2018, drawing attention
for its adoption of the all-new MMB platform.

This Turbo S appeared two years later, with its 3.8-litre
twin turbo and 4WD setup providing rock-solid performance.

Doing 0-<100km/h> in 2.7 seconds and with a top speed
of <330km/h>, it fulfils its role as safety car with aplomb.

The roof-mounted light is the unsung hero that maintains
orerand safety out on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
大家都知道安全车的重要性。
它们会在滚动发车或发生事故时出动，引领车阵。

通常安全车由普通公路车充任，但普通车的性能
显然有些力不从心。

因此，《跑车浪漫旅》精心打造了这款特别车型，
基于992世代保时捷911 Turbo S的安全车规格版本。

992世代911于2018年首次亮相，
因采用全新的MMB平台而备受瞩目。

这款Turbo S在两年后问世，其3.8升双涡轮增压引擎
与四轮驱动系统提供了极其稳定的性能。

它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需2.7秒，最高速度可达<330km/h>，
能从容胜任安全车的角色。

安装在车顶的指示灯是维持赛道秩序与安全的无冕英雄。

catch.en: The 911 Turbo S reimagined as a safety car.
catch.zh: 重新设计为安全车的911 Turbo S。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 911 Turbo S reimagined as a safety car.

This 992-generation Porsche 911 Turbo S was a virtual model created by Gran Turismo and reimagined as a safety car. Built on Porsche’s updated 911 platform, the wide-body design incorporated a higher percentage of aluminum components. Its exceptional traction and stability made the 911 Turbo ideally suited for leading the field as a safety car.

long.en: This 992-generation Porsche 911 Turbo S was a virtual model created by Gran Turismo and reimagined as a safety car. Built on Porsche’s updated 911 platform, the wide-body design incorporated a higher percentage of aluminum components. long.zh: 这款992车型911 Turbo S是《跑车浪漫旅》创作的一款虚拟车型，在原车型基础上重新设计为安全车。基于全新开发的MMB平台，其宽体车身设计采用了更高比例的铝制部件。出色的牵引力与稳定性，让911 Turbo S担任安全车、引领车阵的不二之选。

brandCentral.en:
How much do you know about Porsche's legendary 917
racing car?

It's the car that brought the company their first ever
overall victory at Le Mans, back in 1970.

This '917 LIVING LEGEND' is designed with that illustrious
predecessor in mind.

Incredibly, it was developed by just a handful of staff in
Porsche's research department!

One of the key design features retained from the 917 is the
iconic fan, located above the midship V8 engine.
brandCentral.zh:
不知您对Porsche的传奇赛车917了解多少？

它为这家公司在1970年赢得了首个勒芒比赛的总冠军。

这辆“917 LIVING LEGEND”在设计伊始就从它那战绩彪炳的前辈身
上吸取了不少灵感。

更令人难以置信的是，这辆车仅由人数不多的Porsche研究部
门研发完成！

其最关键的设计特性当属沿袭自917的标志性风扇，置于
中置V8引擎的正上方。*

vehicleCollection.en:
This extreme hyper car is an updated version of the legendary 917, one of the most celebrated race cars in Porsche history.

The Porsche 917 earned a celebrated place in motorsport history by securing seven victories out of ten races during the 1970 World Sportscar Championship season. The Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND was a hypercar concept inspired by the 917. Its classic exterior design masked cutting-edge technology beneath the surface. Its blend of top speed and aerodynamic downforce resulted in remarkable stability, even at speeds exceeding 186.4 mph.

The Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND was a hypercar concept inspired by the 917. Its classic exterior design masked cutting-edge technology beneath the surface. Its blend of top speed and aerodynamic downforce resulted in remarkable stability, even at speeds exceeding 186.4 mph.
long.zh: 917为Porsche创造了诸多辉煌战绩，包括在1970年世界跑车锦标赛中10场比赛斩获7场胜利。Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND是一款以经典917为灵感打造的终极跑车。经典的外观设计下蕴藏着前沿的技术内核。极速与下压力的完美结合，即使在超过300 公里/小时的速度下也能保持如磐石般的稳定性。

When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.

At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...

A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a
turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.

The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.

It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder
engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.

Depending on the race, the 917 came i different forms.

On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,

collection.en:
The 917K is one of the most important race cars
in Porsche's history.

It was developed from the long-tailed 917LH which made its debut
in 1969.

Under its hood was a few different engines depending on the car,
from a 4.5-liter, 4.9-liter and a 5.0-liter air-cooled flat-12.

Fast and ferocious on the track, the 917K delivered
Porsche its first overall victory at Le Mans.

Although Porsche didn't have a works team, the 917K still won
7 of 10 races in the International Championship for Makes.

Even better, it would also go on to win the 24 Hours
of Le Mans that year, and again in 1971.

Porsche's golden era began with the 917K, making it one of
the most significant models in motorsports history.
collection.zh:
917K是Porsche历史上最重要的赛车之一。

该车基于1969年生产的长尾款917LH研发而来……

可配备多款不同引擎，包括4.5升、4.9升，
或是5升风冷水平对置12缸引擎。

速度极快，在赛道上悍勇无双的917K，赢来了
Porsche在勒芒赛场上首个总冠军。

在1970年，917K赢下国际制造商锦标赛
十场赛事中的七场……

并摘得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，紧接着
又在1971年卫冕成功。

可以说，Porsche的黄金年代
正是由917K揭幕的。

vehicleCollection.en:
This prototype race car that gave Porsche its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The 917K was a prototype race car developed by Porsche specifically for sports car competition. Despite weighing under 1764 lbs, the 1970 version was capable of producing up to 591.7 HP in its most powerful configuration. In its second year of competition, 1970, the 917K proved nearly unbeatable, winning seven out of ten rounds in the International Championship for Makes. It also delivered Porsche its long-awaited first overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

vehicleCollection.en:
This super sports car represents the first plug-in hybrid flagship from the famed German car maker.

The Porsche 918 Spyder was a high-performance sports car introduced in 2011. It succeeded the Carrera GT and was produced in a limited run of 918 units, in keeping with its name. Its most defining feature was its plug-in hybrid powertrain. The mid-mounted 4.6-liter V-8 engine, producing 599.6 HP, was paired with two electric motors on the front axle and one on the rear, delivering a combined system output of up to 873.8 HP.

This 919 Hybrid was the jewel in Porsche's racing
crown during the 2010s.

Its mid-mounted engine sent <500ps> to the rear wheels, while
electric motors powered the front tires with <400ps>.

All this made it a <900ps> 4WD hybrid race car.

When the WEC and Le Mans finally welcomed hybrid cars, the
919 Hybrid went quickly to work, showing its capabilities.

And those capabilities were impressive indeed, as it
went on to win big races in 2015, 2016 and 2017.

则可以为前轮提供<400ps>。

四轮驱动混合功率总计约为<900ps>。

随着世界耐力锦标赛和勒芒耐力赛终于迎来混合动力时
代，这辆车向全世界显示了它的可能性。

它在2015、2016和2017年取得了三连冠，成为了所有参赛者赶
超的目标。

The Porsche 959 was developed specifically to compete in the
WRC's top class—Group B—which was introduced in 1982.

Because it was produced solely for homologation purposes,
only 292 cars were built.

At a glance, the 959 looked similar to contemporary 911s,
but under the skin, it was an entirely different car.

The technical ambition of the project was exemplified
by the 959's drivetrain.

Because Group B rally cars needed to efficiently transfer 500
or so horsepower to the road, hey were typically 4WD.

For the 959, Porsche developed an advanced
electronically controlled 4WD system.

Unfortunately, the abrupt end of the Group B category meant that
the 959 was never able to compete in the series.

So, Porsche looked for ther venues for the 959, and one of them
was what many considered the worls toughest rac

Porsche entered off-road versions of the 959

vehicleCollection.en:
A four-wheel-drive road car that shines bright in automotive history.

The Porsche 959 was the production evolution of the original Gruppe B prototype, which Porsche had engineered for competition in Group B, the top category of the WRC at the time. It featured an advanced, electronically controlled 4-wheel-drive system that allowed drivers to adjust drivetrain settings to suit various conditions, delivering exceptional stability and ride comfort. Although Group B was disbanded before the car could compete in the WRC, the 959 still achieved remarkable success in other forms of motorsports.

Although Group B was disbanded before the car could compete in the WRC, the 959 still achieved remarkable success in other forms of motorsports.

collection.en:
The world of motorsports is known for its
extremely competitive development,

which makes Porsche's achievements during the 1980s
truly miraculous.

Porsche won at Le Mans in 1982 and 1983 with their 956,

and the updated Porsche 956 went on to win 2 more
Le Mans races.

The Porsche 962 series is a race car that is directly linked to
the legendary 956 series,

and the Porsche 962C won at Le Mans in 1986 and 1987,

contributing to the last 2 of the 7 consecutive Le Mans
victories by Porsche that started in 1981.

The 962C remains a potent piece of machinery to this day.
Are you ready to harness the power of this legendary Porsche?
collection.zh:
赛车运动的世界以竞争极其激烈的开发而著称，

这也使得Porsche在上世纪80年代的成就显得犹如神迹一般。

Porsche在1982年和1983年连续使用956赛车赢下勒芒冠军，

紧接着，改进后的956又再夺两冠。

保时捷962系列是传奇的956的正统继承者，

系列中的962C于1986和1987年再次赢得勒芒冠军，

也是自1981年以来Porsche勒芒七连冠的最后两座奖杯的功臣。

962C的车况保存良好至今。
您准备好驾驭这辆传奇Porsche的强劲动力了吗？

vehicleCollection.en:
These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.

The Porsche 962 C was a prototype race car that made its debut in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) in 1985. Over the course of its career, the car delivered Porsche numerous race victories and championship titles. In its debut WEC season, it won seven out of ten races. The following year, in 1986, it claimed four wins from nine rounds in the newly renamed World Sports Prototype Championship (WSPC). At the 1987 WSPC, it secured a win at Le Mans and followed it up with a 2nd-place finish the year after.

The following year, in 1986, it claimed four wins from nine rounds in the newly renamed World Sports Prototype Championship (WSPC). At the 1987 WSPC, it secured a win at Le Mans and followed it up with a 2nd-place finish the year after.

The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in
the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.

Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won
the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca,
Watkins Glen, and Road America...

Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers'
Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself
as a podium fixture...

Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece
of endurance racing!

brandCentral.en:
Porsche has a long history in endurance racing, and the 963
was designed to meet Le Mans Daytona h regulations.

It carries elements of Porsche’s road car design in its exterior,
with a chassis produced by Multimatic Inc.

Power comes from a  twin-turbo 4.6-liter V-8 hybrid engine,
a unit with roots in the legendary 918 Spyder.

In 2023, Porsche joined forces with Team Penske,
unleashing the 963 in the IMSA Championship and WEC.

In the U.S., it quickly racked up three IMSA victories,
but really began to shine the following season, in 2024.

It captured both the IMSA drivers and manufacturers' championships,
as well as the WEC drivers title.

Porsche even created a special roadworthy version, the RSP.
The 963 is truly a jewel inPorsche’s racing crown.
brandCentral.zh:
Porsche在耐力赛领域拥有悠久的历史，
为符合勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）规则，他们打造了963。

其外观融入了Porsche公路车的设计元素，
底盘则由Multimatic Inc.制造。

其动力由4.6升V8双涡轮增压混合动力引擎提供，
与传奇车型918 Spyder有相同的技术根源。

2023年，Porsche与声名显赫的Penske车队强强联手，
将963投入IMSA锦标赛和WEC的赛场。

在美国，它迅速斩获三场IMSA胜利，
但真正大放异彩是在接下来的2024赛季。

该车型不仅包揽了IMSA的车手和车厂双料冠军，
还拿下了WEC的车手总冠军。

Porsche甚至为其打造了一个名为RSP的特殊公路版本！
963无疑是Porsche赛车snS的一颗璀璨明珠。

vehicleCollection.en:
Only 1270 examples of this mid-engine supercar were produced from 2003 to 2006.

The Porsche Carrera GT was a mid-engine super sports car produced from 2003 to 2006, with a total of 1,270 units built. Its chassis centered on a lightweight yet rigid carbon-fiber monocoque, complemented by carbon fiber subframes supporting the engine and rear suspension. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 5.7-liter V-10, derived from a race engine, producing 603.5 HP. This was paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

collection.en:
The Carrera GTS 904 is a shining star in Porsche's
storied motorsports history.

Since the early 1950s, Porsche competed in
international races with the 356.

All the while, the folks there were planning to build
a dedicated GT race car.

Essentially, they needed to build 100 cars in
12 months to qualify for competition.

The result was the Carrera GTS in 1963.

While a plan to use the flat-6 engine developed for
the 911 never bore fruit...

...the car featured a low and ligtweight mid-engine
body and specially-designed suspension.

As soon as the car was ready, it was racing all over
the world.

This particular Carrera GTS competed in the second
Japanese Grand Prix, held in 1964.

Its heated yet successful battl against Japan's Skyline is
still talked about by Japanese race fans to ts day.
collection.zh:
Carrera GTS 904是保时捷赛车
运动历史上一颗闪耀的明星。

从20世纪50年代开始，保时捷就将
保时捷356投入到各项国际赛事中。

一直以来，他们都计划
打造一辆专门的超级跑车。

但他们要能满足12个月内生产100辆
以获得对应的参赛资格。

于是Carrera GTS在1963年应运而生。

虽然原计划采用为911开发的
水平对置6缸引擎从未取得任何成果……

其轻盈贴地的玻璃纤维8身、中置引擎
和悬挂等专门设计的部件。

让它刚一发布就惊爆全球。

这辆特别的Carrera GTS参加了
1964年举行的第二届日本大奖赛。

它与日本本土的Skyline展开了激烈厮杀并最终

catch.en: A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960s
catch.zh: Porsche在1960年代赖以统治GT赛事的杰作。

vehicleCollection.en:
A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960s

In 1963, Porsche developed the Carrera GTS in response to the World Sportscar Championship regulations of the era. To meet the 100-unit production homologation requirement, the car employed a ladder-frame chassis paired with a lightweight fiberglass body. It delivered strong performance and achieved numerous victories, beginning with the Targa Florio, ultimately becoming the foundation of Porsche’s GT racing efforts throughout the 1960s.

long.en: In 1963, Porsche developed the Carrera GTS in response to the World Sportscar Championship regulations of the era. To meet the 100-unit production homologation requirement, the car employed a ladder-frame chassis paired with a lightweight fiberglass body. It delivered strong performance and achieved numerous victories, beginning with the Targa Florio, ultimately becoming the foundation of Porsche’s GT racing efforts throughout the 1960s.
long.zh: 1963年，Porsche为迎合当时世界跑车锦标赛的规则开发了Porsche Carrera GTS。为了满足100台量产车的赛事认证条件，该车采用了梯形框架底盘与轻量化玻璃纤维车身。这款车型性能卓越，从塔格·佛罗热大奖赛开始便在众多顶级赛事中夺冠，成为1960年代Porsche GT车队的中流砥柱。

brandCentral.en:
If you’re in the market for a mid-engine Porsche sports car,
this Cayman GT4 is strongly recommended.

It’s the sister-model of the Porsche Boxster.

Developed in 1996, the Boxster was a 2-seat,
open-top mid-engine sports car.

For all intents and purposes, the Cayman, introduced in 2005,
was the coupe version of the Boxster.

The combination of its mid-engine chassis and rigid body
resulted in exceptional handling...

...quickly making it one of the most desired sports cars
aong the world's driving enthusiasts.

This Cayman GT4 was released in 2015 as the second-gen
evolution of the original.

Like the Porsche 911 GT3, it was a special model
prepared by Porsche Motorsports.

Employing high-performance brakes, a sharened chassis,
and parts from the 911 GT3...

...its engine was not onlmore powerful,ʈut monted lower
for better handling balance.

如果你想入手一辆中置布局的保时捷跑车，

这辆车也被俗称是保时捷Boxster的姊妹型号。

1996年开发的Boxster是一款双座
敞篷中置小跑车。

而Cayman则姗姗来迟，在2005年亮相，

这也帮助它快速声名鹊起，成$全球爱车人
最心仪的求购目标。

这款Cayman GT4于2015年推出，
是原版车型的第二代进化版。

和保时捷911 GT3一样，它也是由
保时捷汽车运动打造的特殊系列型号之一。

配备高性能刹车i犀利的赛车化底盘
以及部分直接取自911 GT3的零部件…M
其引擎R标n型号相比不仅

catch.en: A Cayman designed for motorsports and possessing all the competitive flair of the 911.
catch.zh: 为赛车运动而生的Cayman，包含了911所有的领先技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Cayman designed for motorsports and possessing all the competitive flair of the 911.

The Cayman GT4 joined the Porsche Cayman lineup in 2015 as a motorsports-focused model. It was powered by a 3.8-liter flat-6 derived from the 911 Carrera S, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With an output of 379.7 HP, it surpassed the base 911 Carrera in performance and incorporated braking and suspension components from the 991-generation 911 GT3. Optional equipment included a roll cage and 6-point harnesses.

long.en: The Cayman GT4 joined the Porsche Cayman lineup in 2015 as a motorsports-focused model. It was powered by a 3.8-liter flat-6 derived from the 911 Carrera S, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With an output of 379.7 HP, it surpassed the base 911 Carrera in performance and incorporated braking and suspension components from the 991-generation 911 GT3. Optional equipment included a roll cage and 6-point harnesses.
long.zh: Cayman GT4赛车版本于2015年加入Porsche Cayman系列产品线。这台车采用了源自911 Carrera S的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，配备6速手动变速箱。385 PS的输出远超基础车型911 Carrera，刹车和悬挂也采用了911车型911 GT3的一些部件。追加了防滚架与六点式安全带作为选装项。

conversation.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.

The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.

Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.

Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...

...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.
\
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。

中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。

事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。

升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。

凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……

它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。

brandCentral.en:
The Clubsport is a Porsche Cayman GT4 designed for
racing on the track.

In terms of power, it's no different from the base model.

However, changes to the shape, underbody and power train
mean it's much more competition-focused.

The change from a 6-speed manual to a two-pedal DCT
transmission also help maximize performance.
brandCentral.zh:
本质上来说，Clubsport就是一台中置引擎版本的Cayman GT4，
专为赛道竞速设计。

它的动力与原版车型并无差异，

而外观、车身底板和传动系统方面的改动则表明它更强调竞赛。

此外，它的六速手动变速箱被换成了双踏板双离合变速
箱，以便最大发挥速度的优势。

catch.zh: Cayman系列中性能最高的车型，采用自然进气水平对置6缸引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
The highest performance model of the Cayman series in its naturally aspirated flat 6 generation.

A pure racing version was also introduced for the Cayman’s GT4 class. While it retained the same 379.7 HP 3.8-liter flat-6, it was fully optimized for competition, stripped of all comfort features and fitted with components from the 911 GT3 Cup car to maximize track performance.

long.en: A pure racing version was also introduced for the Cayman’s GT4 class. While it retained the same 379.7 HP 3.8-liter flat-6, it was fully optimized for competition, stripped of all comfort features and fitted with components from the 911 GT3 Cup car to maximize track performance.
long.zh: 专为GT4级别Cayman赛车推出的纯赛车版本。它使用与GT4型号相同的385 PS输出3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，除此之外，还经过了完美的赛车调校，移除了所有与舒适度有关的部件的同时，采用了911 GT3 Cup上的部件。

brandCentral.en:
A shift from combustion to electricity-based power units
has not marked the end of the sports car.

No car proves this fact more than the Mission X,
a fully electric concept from Porsche.

You might even say that it is a technology beacon for
the sports car of the future.

It serves as an homage to the great Porsche cars of the past,
while representing a technological breakthrough for the future.

The fastest road-car to conquer the Nürburgring's famous
Nordschleife loop...

...the Mission X is an ambitious automobile that pushes
the limits of possibility.

It follows in the footsteps of the 917 LIVING LEGEND,
Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, and Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder.
brandCentral.zh:
动力系统从内燃机向电气化的转变
并未宣告跑车时代的终结。

Porsche全电动概念车“Mission X”就是最有说服力的证明。

你甚至可以称它为“未来跑车的技术灯塔。”

它既是对Porsche过去伟大车型的致敬，
也是开拓驾驶领域未来的技术突破。

征服著名的纽博格林北环赛道的最快量产车……

Mission X是Porsche雄心勃勃的设计，突破了可能性的极限……

延续了917 LIVING LEGEND、Porsche Vision Gran Turismo
和Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder的创新精神。,

catch.en: A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.
catch.zh: 这是为庆祝Porsche成立75周年推出的概念超跑。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.

This all-electric hypercar was unveiled on June 8, 2023—exactly 75 years after the original Porsche 356 "No.1" Roadster received approval. Its exterior design incorporated motifs from Porsche’s storied racing heritage, while the cockpit focused entirely on the driver experience. This car achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 1 horsepower per 2 lbs and downforce far exceeding that of the 992-generation 911 GT3 RS.

Its exterior design incorporated motifs from Porsche’s storied racing heritage, while the cockpit focused entirely on the driver experience. This car achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 1 horsepower per 2 lbs and downforce far exceeding that of the 992-generation 911 GT3 RS.

collection.en:
Did you know that the first car to ever bear the 'Porsche'
name was a midship Spyder?

Specifically, it was the 356/1 prototype from 1948.

I guess the company was always interested in
mid-engine sports cars.

The 550 Spyder, introduced in 1953, is another example of
the mid-engine concept from Porsche.

The 550/1500RS was a variant that went on the market
at the end of 1954.

This specific 550/1500RS, with its blue body and white
triangular stripes, is serial number 0067.

vehicleCollection.en:
This French blue Porsche wears the original livery from the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race.

First sold in 1954, the 550/1500RS was a racing sports car featuring a lightweight aluminum body over a steel tube frame, powered by a 4-cam flat-4 engine producing 133.1 HP. It delivered impressive results on the track, securing class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 1954 and 1955. This particular 1500RS is especially prized, still wearing the original paint it sported during the 1956 running of Le Mans.

long.en: First sold in 1954, the 550/1500RS was a racing sports car featuring a lightweight aluminum body over a steel tube frame, powered by a 4-cam flat-4 engine producing 133.1 HP. This particular 1500RS is especially prized, still wearing the original paint it sported during the 1956 running of Le Mans.

conversation.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.

The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...

...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.

However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...

...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。

Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……

还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。

不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……

此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。

brandCentral.en:
The Taycan is Porsche's first ever fully electric vehicle.

The motors are as punchy and responsive as you would expect
from a maker of such impeccable pedigree.

And the steering system and brakes just scream 'Porsche'.

The Turbo S is the top-of-the-range model, with a power
output of <761ps>.
brandCentral.zh:
Taycan是保时捷的第一款全电动汽车。

它的电机性能和响应速度都完全配得上这个顶级品牌的身份，

转向和刹车系统也无不在昭示着“保时捷”的响亮名号。

整个产品系列中最顶级的型号涡轮增压S的动力输出竟然高达<761ps>。

catch.en: With a total system voltage of 800V, this fully electric sedan boasts both comfort and remarkable performance.
catch.zh: 这辆全电动轿车搭载800伏超级快速充电系统，不仅乘坐舒适，更拥有难以置信的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a total system voltage of 800V, this fully electric sedan boasts both comfort and remarkable performance.

The Taycan marked Porsche’s first fully electric sports sedan. Equipped with electric motors on the front and rear axles, its advanced all-wheel-drive system was paired with a 2-speed transmission, delivering blistering acceleration and top-end performance. The overboost-equipped Turbo S variant produced 560 kW (750.5 HP). Notably, the Taycan was the first mass-produced vehicle to feature an 800V electrical system, enhancing both powertrain efficiency and reducing charging times.

long.en: The Taycan marked Porsche’s first fully electric sports sedan. Equipped with electric motors on the front and rear axles, its advanced all-wheel-drive system was paired with a 2-speed transmission, delivering blistering acceleration and top-end performance. The overboost-equipped Turbo S variant produced 560 kW (750.5 HP). Notably, the Taycan was the first mass-produced vehicle to feature an 800V electrical system, enhancing both powertrain efficiency and reducing charging times.
long.zh: Taycan是Porsche首款纯电动运动轿车。四驱系统在前后轴分别配备电机，搭配2速变速箱，实现了惊人的加速性能和极速表现。配备超级增压功能的Turbo S版本可输出560千瓦（761 PS）。它采用量产车中首创的800V电气系统，在动力单元效率和充电时间方面均具优势。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
This Spyder is another variation of the Porsche
Vision Gran Turismo.

An open-top body, which are designated "Spyder" by the company,
have defined many a historic Porsche over the years.

The most famous of them were legendary race cars of the past,
like the Porsche 550 and 718 RS60 Spyders.

What distinguishes the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder
is its bold chop-top roof design.

With a seamless cowling covering the passenger seat,
you’d think it was a genuine, single-seat race car.

Like the coupe model, it is fitted with dual electric
motors in the front and back...

...that combine to produce an amazing <1114ps>
and <111kgm> of torque.
brandCentral.zh:
这款“Spyder”是保时捷Vision Gran Turismo的
一个衍生车型。

许多历史悠久的保时捷作品都拥有
这一开放式车身风格和“Spyder”标签。

尤其在保时捷550和718 RS60 Spyder等传奇赛车上
得到了最佳体现。

保时捷Vision Gran Turismo Spyder的与众不同之处在于
其大胆的切顶式车顶设计。

通过覆盖在乘客座位上的无缝罩子，
使它看起来就像是一辆真正的单座赛车。

与双门版一样，它在前后都安装有双电机……

带来<1114ps>的最大输出功率和<111kgm>的扭矩。{

catch.en: Porsche's modern-yet-daring statement on the future of the sports car.
catch.zh: Porsche将其对未来跑车的预测以非常现代化且大胆的方式呈现。

vehicleCollection.en:
Porsche's modern-yet-daring statement on the future of the sports car.

It was the Spyder variant of the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, which originally made its debut in 2021. The sculpted surfaces and refined cabin fused artfully to heighten driver engagement. Beneath it all, the dual-motor setup and active aero system worked in concert to ensure performance remained as precise as it was exhilarating.

long.en: It was the Spyder variant of the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, which originally made its debut in 2021. The sculpted surfaces and refined cabin fused artfully to heighten driver engagement. Beneath it all, the dual-motor setup and active aero system worked in concert to ensure performance remained as precise as it was exhilarating.
long.zh: 这是2021年亮相的Porsche Vision Gran Turismo的Spyder版本。外观与内饰设计无缝融合，打造最具沉浸感的驾驶体验。动力系统采用双电机配置，创新的主动空气动力学系统可根据实际情况提供最佳的空气动力学效果。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo celebrates the Porsche brand
in the form of a lightweight sports car.

It features a state-of-the-art carbon-fiber monocoque and a
beautiful glass canopy.

The design pays tribute to classic Porsches from the past,
including the 356 roadster.

The power unit was inspired the 919 endurance race car
and the all-electric Taycan.

It features two motors, one in the front and the other at the
rear of the car.

This "dual electric engine" produces an impressive
<1114ps> through an AWD layout.

The car remains incredibly stable at high speed, too,
thanks to its active aero systems.
brandCentral.zh:
这台轻量化的Vision Gran Turismo跑车充分展现出了Porsche的
优雅。

技术领先的碳纤维单体车壳以及
绝美的玻璃车顶是它的吸睛亮点。

设计方面沿袭了开启Porsche传奇的
356车型的优良传统。

动力单元则汲取了919
耐力赛赛车和全电动的Taycan的经验。

它装有两台电机，一台在车前部，一台
在车后部。

这种‘双电动引擎’组合可以提供令人惊诧的
<1114ps>动力。

还有它的主动式空气动力系统，
将动感而高效的驾驶感受带到了这款车型上。

catch.zh: Porsche对未来跑车的现代化且激进的展现。

vehicleCollection.en:
Porsche's modern yet daring statement on the future of the sports car remains true to its racing roots.

This lightweight, hyper-performance machine honored Porsche’s storied legacy while offering a glimpse into the future of sports cars. Its exterior and interior flowed together in perfect harmony, delivering an exceptionally immersive driving experience. Power came from twin electric motors, while an innovative active aerodynamic system adjusted in real time to deliver optimal downforce and efficiency for any condition.

conversation.en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.

The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya,
which specializes in tuning rotary-powered machines.

Although it's not exactly a "hashiriya," or street racer,
it's nevertheless captivating.

It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
conversation.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
这辆FD3S Mazda RX-7虽然推出于1991年，但即便
到了今天，它依然在美国年轻人当中拥有不少粉丝。

它拥有简单而无懈可击的设计。

这辆公路车的外观设计诞生在Mazda的加利福尼亚州
设计工作室，由俣野努主导完成。

眼前的这一台则是由专攻转子引擎调校的公司
RE Amemiya改装后的版本。

尽管严格来讲它并不是一辆“街头赛车”，
但依然非常迷人。

至少，你在《跑车浪漫旅》中应该试驾一下它。

a number of high-powered RX-7 over the years.

conversation.en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine
subframe with pushrod suspension.

The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche
lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineerd to meet RUF’s performance standards.

The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while
the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.

Elsewhere, the six rear vents rovide a clue to the <700ps>
twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
这辆如虎CTR3的灵感来源于
柯曼达保时捷550勒芒轿跑……

它的外观设计历久弥新，至今依然能够打动消费者。

这是如虎首次使用他们自己的全碳纤维
车身设计打造一辆车……

并采用了针对比赛开发的全铝合金后中置引擎
副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。

其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

{为了满足如虎的性能需求而经过重新加工。

其超低设置的驾驶舱也使车头高度降至极低，
同时由后扰流板提供高速下的操控性和下压力。

此，其车身后部的六个排气管也让人得以一瞥它那基于梅gL格打造的
00ps>涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎的恐怖动力。

brandCentral.en:
Ruf is a manufacturer that has a lot of cachet among Porsche
owners—and with good reason.

They've made a name for themselves by taking Porsche base
models and somehow improving upon perfection.

Even for them, though, the CTR3 is an incredible
achievement.

It's a mid-engine design developed, engineered and built on
a unique standalone platform.

The engine is a 3.8L twin-turbo flat-six.

And with a top speed of <380km/h>, it really is a
super sports car.%
brandCentral.zh:
Ruf是一家在Porsche车主心目中地位极高的车厂，而且他们的
确配得上这份殊荣。

通过对Porsche基础车型进行趋近完美的改装，他们为自己赢
得了无上的赞誉。

在他们所有的作品中，这辆CTR3堪称最伟大的成就。

这款车基于专用独立平台研发打造，采用中置引擎布局，

其配备的3.8L双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎

拥有高达<380km/h>的最高时速，是一辆纯正的超级跑车。

Ruf is a German automotive manufacturer that uses Porsche
components to construct high-performance vehicles.

Their most impressive production line is the CTR series.

The first-generation CTR, dubbed the Yellowbird, was based
on the Porsche 911.

This CTR3 is the third-generation model which debuted
in 2007.

It uses the longest mid-engine chassis that Ruf have
developed.

The 3.8L flat-six twin turbo can generate
up to <700ps> of power.

catch.en: The third-generation CTR was thoroughly re-engineered by Ruf, including being converted to a mid-engine layout.

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation CTR was thoroughly re-engineered by Ruf, including being converted to a mid-engine layout.

Released in 2007, the RUF CTR3 served as the successor to the iconic CTR and CTR2. Unlike its predecessors, which were based on the Porsche 930 and 993 Turbo, the CTR3 was designed entirely from the ground up by RUF. It adopted a mid-engine layout and was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6 with intercooling. Performance was staggering, with a top speed of 236.1 mph and zero-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.2 seconds.

long.en: Released in 2007, the RUF CTR3 served as the successor to the iconic CTR and CTR2. Unlike its predecessors, which were based on the Porsche 930 and 993 Turbo, the CTR3 was designed entirely from the ground up by RUF. It adopted a mid-engine layout and was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6 with intercooling. Performance was staggering, with a top speed of 236.1 mph and zero-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.2 seconds.
long.zh: 2007年发布的RUF CTR3是其CTR与CTR2的继任者。前代车型基于Porsche 930和993 Turbo打造，而CTR3却是由RUF从零开始设计研发。这台车采用中置引擎布局，搭载的是一台3.8升水平对置6缸中冷式双涡轮增压引擎。最高时速为380 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.2秒。

RUF’s RGT series is based on successive generations
of Porsche 911 GT3s.

Coming from RUF, these attributes should come as no surprise.

Yet, it is their unparalleled smoothness and tangible precision
that truly set them apart.

The RGT 4.2, derived from the 991 Series 911 GT3...

...showcased a sublime fusion of engine and gearbox, epitomizing
RUF's undeniable expertise.
brandCentral.zh:
RUF的RGT系列车型以历代Porsche 911 GT3为基础打造
而成。

这些车型卓越的性能和速度自不必说……

更令人称道的是其独具特色的驾驶平顺感和精准的操控
感，这使RGT系列在超跑领域中脱颖而出。

此处的RGT 4.2以991系列的911 GT3为原型。

RUF为引擎和变速箱设计的协同效应堪称完美，充分展
现了RUF的非凡造诣。

catch.en: The ultimate naturally-aspirated flat-6 machine, meticulously crafted by Ruf.

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate naturally-aspirated flat-6 machine, meticulously crafted by Ruf.

This RUF original was based on the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Developed with the philosophy of blending GT3-level performance with refined road car comfort, it was powered by a naturally-aspirated Mezger engine—fitted with the legendary GT1 crankshaft—and enlarged from 3.8 to 4.2 liters. Riveted overfenders added a bold visual statement, emphasizing the car’s raw capability and presence. A true enthusiast’s machine, tailored for the gentleman driver.

long.en: This RUF original was based on the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Developed with the philosophy of blending GT3-level performance with refined road car comfort, it was powered by a naturally-aspirated Mezger engine—fitted with the legendary GT1 crankshaft—and enlarged from 3.8 to 4.2 liters. Riveted overfenders added a bold visual statement, emphasizing the car’s raw capability and presence. A true enthusiast’s machine, tailored for the gentleman driver.

vehicleCollection.en:
The road-going racer that can handle both pleasure cruises and circuit laps.

The Radical SR3 SL was a road-legal track machine that closely resembled a scaled-down Le Mans Prototype. Among its powertrain options was a 2.0-liter Ford EcoBoost inline-4 with direct injection and a turbocharger, producing 295.9 HP and paired with a 6-speed sequential paddle-shift transmission. With a curb weight of just 1709 lbs, the SR3 SL delivered remarkable performance, launching from zero to 59.7 mph in just 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of 159.7 mph.

conversation.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.

This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.

A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.

Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of wo short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.

No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shiing achievement in Renault’s long history.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。

虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。

实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。

它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。

v车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。

这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。

难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这k是雷诺悠So历[中的一项辉煌成就。

brandCentral.en:
Monoform bodies, known for their roomy interiors,
have long been the go-to for high-occupancy minivans.

The Avantime turned that idea on its head, becoming the first to
pair a spacious cabin with the sleekness of a low-occupancy coupe.

Derived from the 1997 third-gen Espace, the Avantime broke new
ground with its bold three-door layout and lightweight FRP body.

This resulted in an airy, elegant cabin unlike anything else.
With no B-pillar, the side windows stretch to the rear.

Open the expansive sunroof,
and it nearly feels like a full convertible!

Penned by Renault’s legendary designer Patrick Le Quément, this
unique coupe redefined what was possible with a monoform body.
brandCentral.zh:
可提供宽敞内部空间的单体车身设计通常被用于
满足大容量多人座厢式旅行车的需求。

而首次挑战这一概念，将宽敞空间运用到
小众三门轿跑车上的，正是Avantime。

基于1997年第三代Espace，Avantime采用了
令人眼前一亮的三门玻璃纤维车身设计。

呈现出既优雅又独特的座舱氛围。
无B柱设计让侧窗可以完全打开。

配合大尺寸天窗开启时，几乎让人感觉置身于敞篷车中！

由Renault首席设计师帕特里克·勒·奎芒倾心打造，这款
独特的三门轿跑车为单体车身设计开创了新境界。

usedCar.en:
Looking for a coupe with real character?
If so, then have I got the perfect choice for you!

Built on the third-gen Renault Espace platform, the Avantime
is a unique-looking coupe that embraces minivan elements.

What truly sets it apart is the remarkable sense of freedom
it delivers, notably from its ingeniously designed rear seating.

The body, crafted from lightweight FRP, was built by Matra,
a name once synonymous with Formula 1 competition.

While it came with a range of engine options, this model packs
a 3.0-liter V-6, whose torque contributed to good handling.

A true rarity, only 8,500 units rolled off the line during
its brief two-year production run that began in 2001!
usedCar.zh:
你在寻找一辆独具个性的双门跑车吗？
那这款车无疑是最完美的选择！

基于第三代Renault Espace打造的Avantime是一款
融合了厢式旅行车元素的独特双门跑车。

它最大的魅力在于通过设计所营造的强烈自由感，
尤其是其创新的后排座椅设计。

车身采用玻璃纤维强化塑料制造，由曾参与
F1赛事的Matra公司生产。

这款车型还提供多种动力配置选择，我们眼前的这台搭载
3升V6引擎，低扭输出特性带来出色的操控表现。

这是一款罕见车型，在自2001年开始的两年生产周期中，
仅制造了约8500台！_

vehicleCollection.en:
A unique coupe that tests the boundaries of monoform design.

The Avantime was a specialty car penned by Patrick Le Quément of Renault Design. Its distinctive body blended the proven underpinnings of the third-generation Espace, a favorite across Europe, with a striking three-door fiberglass shell. Although coupe-like in silhouette, what set the Avantime apart were its B-pillarless side windows and large sunroof, which could be opened. A pure expression of Renault’s design philosophy, the Avantime was proof that the monoform concept need not be limited to minivans.

long.en: The Avantime was a specialty car penned by Patrick Le Quément of Renault Design. Its distinctive body blended the proven underpinnings of the third-generation Espace, a favorite across Europe, with a striking three-door fiberglass shell. Although coupe-like in silhouette, what set the Avantime apart were its B-pillarless side windows and large sunroof, which could be opened. A pure expression of Renault’s design philosophy, the Avantime was proof that the monoform concept need not be limited to minivans.
long.zh: Avantime是由Renault设计部门的帕特里克·勒·奎芒设计的特色车型。大胆采用了创新的车身设计，将在欧洲大受欢迎的第三代Espace底盘与玻璃纤维三门车身相结合。虽然外观酷似双门轿跑车，但真正让这款车与众不同的是无B柱侧窗设计和可完全开启的大尺寸天窗。作为Renault品牌个性的完美诠释，这款车证明了单体车身设计不只是厢式旅行车的专属。

brandCentral.en:
Renault is best known for its compact cars, but its
technical prowess extended even to its SUVs.

This was nowhere more evident than in the Renault Captur,
the perfect marriage of compact style and SUV strength.

Here is the second-generation model from 2019, easily
recognizable by its C-shaped signature lighting.

Available with gasoline, diesel and mild hybrid engines, the
range introduced Renault’s first plug-in hybrid model.

Renault hybrids were built with F1-tested technology, maning
they were fast and offered unparalleled control.

Inside, the Captur featured a floating center console
with a 7-inch display and smartphone connectivity.

Boasting comfort and convenience in a compact package,
the Captur was a small but mighy hero of everyday life.
brandCentral.zh:
对大众而言，Renault的紧凑型车型更为家喻户晓，
但其旗下的SUV车型也体现了高超的技术水平。

最显著的例证便是Renault Captur，紧凑型风格
与SUV运载力的完美结合体。

这里的这台是2019年的第2代车型，
标志性的C型灯光设计很容易分辨。

和Renault的第一款插电式混合动力车型一样，该车型有
汽油版、柴油版和轻度混合动力版的引擎可供选择。

Renault的混合动力车型采用F1比赛中验证过的技术，
因此在高车速下仍能保证无与伦比的可操控性。

在内饰方面，Captur采用了悬浮式中控台，
带有7英寸显示屏和智能手机互联互通功能。

Captur以紧凑的尺寸实现了引RPi的舒适度和便利性，
是Q款小巧而又强悍的日用多y手。

vehicleCollection.en:
A formidable vehicle that blurred the boundaries of the compact SUV class.

The Captur was a compact crossover SUV produced by Renault. The second-generation model, introduced in 2019, measured 13.9 ft in length, 5.9 ft in width and 5.2 ft in height, giving it the stance of an SUV while preserving the agility of a compact car. It offered a broad range of powertrain options, spanning conventional gasoline engines as well as diesel and hybrid variants. Most notable among them was the E-Tech PHEV system, which incorporated hybrid technology developed by Renault’s Formula 1 team.

It offered a broad range of powertrain options, spanning conventional gasoline engines as well as diesel and hybrid variants. Most notable among them was the E-Tech PHEV system, which incorporated hybrid technology developed by Renault’s Formula 1 team.

conversation.en:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994
at the Paris Motor Show.

More than 30 years have passed since then,
yet it remains as astonishing as ever.

Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...

...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the
1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.

It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.

At th time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo
in Formula 1 racing.

But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a
minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.

Although it never reached production, it remans a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Espace F1于1994年在巴黎国际车展首次亮相。

三十余年后的今天，这款车型依然令人叹为观止。

基于风靡全球的家用车型Renault Espace打造……

Espace F1搭载的Renault V10引擎
源自1992年F1冠军赛车，Williams车队的FW14B……

并依照赛车规格采用中置布局。

当时Renault和Williams堪称
一级方程式赛场的黄金组合。

但谁也未曾料想，他们竟会将F1引擎
植入一台家用MPV！这无疑是天马行空的创举。

虽未量产上市，此车始终是Renault品牌史上
璀璨夺目的传奇之作。

collection.en:
It’s been said that the European minivan boom of the
1980s was sparked by the Renault Espace.

The series had a powerful Formula 1 variant
known as the Espace F1.

This car was proposed to Renault by Matra, the company that
had initially constructed the Espace’s fiberglass body.

At the time, Renault was hailed as the reigning champion
of Formula 1.

Transplanting a RS4 unit from its winning F1 machine
of 1992, the FW14B...

...Matra sought to pay homage to Renault’s Formula  success
and, at the same time, mark ten years of the Espace.

Clothed in an almost entirely carbon-fiber
and aluminum body...

...this car swapped out its third-row seats for an F1 engine
mounted amidships.

And its test run was piloted by non other than F1 driver
Alain Prost!

This is one unorthodox minivan thacan really ziparoun a race track.
collection.zh:
据说上世纪80年代欧洲多用途汽车的热潮是由雷诺Espace引发的。

该系列曾有一款强悍的一级方程式衍生车型，
名为Espace F1，

由原先负责制造Espace玻璃纤维车身的厂商马特拉
向雷诺提议打造。

当时雷诺作为一级方程式的卫冕冠军，
可谓是风头无两。

马特拉提议在此车上移植1992年冠军赛车FW14B的
RS4动力单元……

意在致敬雷诺在一级方程式的辉煌战绩，
同时庆祝Epace车型问世十周年。

此车车身几乎完全采用碳纤维与铝合金打造……

并拆除了第三排座椅，换装中置布局的一级方程式引擎。

试驾任务更是由一级方程式传奇车手
阿兰·普罗斯特亲C执驾！

这款不走寻常路的多用途汽车，
在赛道上也sK风驰电掣hp

catch.en: Renault's rebellious minivan carries an F1 engine.
catch.zh: Renault旗下一款特立独行的MPV，搭载F1赛车引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
Renault's rebellious minivan carries an F1 engine.

Ten years after the debut of Europe’s first minivan came the Renault Espace F1—an unprecedented creation that redefined the limits of imagination. At its heart resided the RS4 3.5-liter V-10 from the 1992 Formula 1 championship–winning FW14B, mounted amidships within a body crafted from aluminum and carbon fiber. Producing 788 HP, it rocketed from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of 196.4 mph. This extraordinary machine was even driven on a real circuit by F1 legend Alain Prost, among others.

long.en: Ten years after the debut of Europe’s first minivan came the Renault Espace F1—an unprecedented creation that redefined the limits of imagination. At its heart resided the RS4 3.5-liter V-10 from the 1992 Formula 1 championship–winning FW14B, mounted amidships within a body crafted from aluminum and carbon fiber. Producing 788 HP, it rocketed from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of 196.4 mph. This extraordinary machine was even driven on a real circuit by F1 legend Alain Prost, among others.
long.zh: 欧洲首款MPV问世十年后，Renault Espace F1横空出世，这是一款前所未有的性能猛兽。源自1992年F1冠军车FW14B的“RS4”3.5升V10引擎采用中置布局，车身则由铝合金和碳纤维材料打造。在800 PS的动力驱动下，该车能够在2.8秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达316 公里/小时。这辆车还由F1传奇车手阿兰·普罗斯特等人在真实赛道上进行了试驾。

conversation.en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?

With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.

But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.

Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.

Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.

Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.

Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。

凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！

不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。

也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。

多年来，Renault推出了不少大名鼎鼎的
“工作用车”车型。

其中就包括1960年代Renault 4的商用版本。

还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代Renault 5打造的！

brandCentral.en:
Are you familiar with the term "fourgonnette?"
It’s a French word that means a light van.

The Renault Kangoo was a best-selling fourgonnette
since its debut in 1997.

But the Kangoo is no ordinary van—it’s a very popular MPV
suited for camping and long-distance trips.

Access to the rear compartment was simplified by sliding doors
and folding seats that resulted in excellent cargo space.

This clever touch was often praised by fans as a
prime example of "ludospace."

A compact vehicle with a lot of versatility, the Kangoo embodied
the ingenuity that long defined French automotive design.
brandCentral.zh:
你知道“fourgonnette”这个词吗？这是法语中
“轻型厢式车”的专业术语。

自1997年问世以来，Renault Kangoo就一直是这一类
车型中的销量冠军。

但Kangoo不仅仅是一款普通的小型厢式车——它更是一款
备受欢迎的多功能休旅车，非常适合长途旅行和露营使用。

滑动门设计让后部空间的出入变得极为便利，可折叠座椅
则提供了更充裕的载货空间。

这种便利性也让它成为了众人交口称赞的
“休闲空间车”典范。

Kangoo虽然车身小巧，却蕴含丰富功能、充沛空间，
完美诠释了法国汽车设计的精妙之处。

usedCar.en:
Perfect timing! I just received a little French van
that I think you might love.

It’s a first-generation Renault Kangoo from 2001.

Offering great control and ample storage, the Kangoo
was positioned as the ideal leisure vehicle.

This bold approach paid off, resulting in success not only as a
commercial van, but also as a multi-purpose vehicle (MPV).

Sure, its 1.4-liter engine produced only <75ps>, but French cars
are known for making the most of what they’ve got.

With its lively suspension tuned for agile, fun cornering,
this Kangoo proved that driving isn't always about brute force.
usedCar.zh:
来得正是时候！我刚刚收到了一辆法国厢型车，相信你
一定也会喜欢的。

这是2001年推出的第一代Renault Kangoo。

作为一款休闲定位的车型，Kangoo以出色的操控性和
宽敞的储物空间而闻名。

这一定位策略十分成功，使其在商用厢型车和多功能
运动休旅车市场都取得了不俗的成绩。

虽然其1.4升引擎提供的<75ps>动力不算强劲，但秉承
法国车的传统特色，它能够物尽其用，充分发挥实力。

搭配适合过弯的韧性弹簧悬挂系统，这款车能带来十足的
驾驶乐趣！

catch.en: This popular leisure activity vehicle began its life as a commercial van.
catch.zh: 这是一款由商用厢式车演变而来的人气休闲车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular leisure activity vehicle began its life as a commercial van.

In French, small vans are called "fourgonnettes." And the Kangoo gained popularity for embodying that spirit, with sliding passenger doors and split-folding rear seats that made it ideal not only for commercial tasks but also for personal and recreational use. It became a pioneer of the ludospace segment—vehicles designed for leisure activity. While its engine delivered only modest power, the soft suspension gave it a surprisingly lively and enjoyable driving character.

It became a pioneer of the ludospace segment—vehicles designed for leisure activity. While its engine delivered only modest power, the soft suspension gave it a surprisingly lively and enjoyable driving character.

Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.

Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.

After all, it was the first Renault to
feature front-wheel drive.

For a company that had built its reputation on
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...

...this marked a significant eparture with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.

Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!

This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed gobal sales of more than 8 million units!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。

这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。

要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。

对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……

这确实是一个重:转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。

值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！

作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超V了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！

usedCar.en:
The Renault 4 is a French economy car with
a long and glorious history.

After making its debut in 1961, its design has essentially remained
unchanged for more than 30 years.

A front mid-engine car, its rear is distinguished by
a large tailgate and spacious trunk.

It was the first hatchback to be a commercial success.

With more than eight million units sold around globe,
it was loved the world over as a practical car for everyday use!

This GTL model was added in the 1970s.

Its powerful engine and modern interior have made it
an especially popular model in the Renault 4 lineup.
usedCar.zh:
Renault 4是一款法国产经济型轿车
有着悠久而辉煌的历史。

自1961年首次亮相起，30余年来设计始终如一。

这是一款前中置引擎车型，以后部巨大的掀背车门
和宽敞的后备箱脱颖而出。

它也是第一款获得商业成功的掀背车。

作为一款日常使用的实用车型，得到全世界人民的喜爱，
销量达到令人咋舌的800多万辆！

这款GTL车型于20世纪70年代加入产品线。

凭借强劲的引擎和现代化的内饰成为
Renault 4系列中特别受欢迎的车型。

catch.en: The world's first hatchback found great success through utilitarian design.
catch.zh: 世界上第一款通过多功能、多用途设计取得巨大成功的掀背车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The world's first hatchback found great success through utilitarian design.

The Renault 4 (Quatre), introduced in 1961, was designed to replace the best-selling 4CV. By 1978, the car reached its full potential with the GTL variant. This model added a plastic grille, a more powerful 1.1-liter engine, and a modernized instrument panel. Amassing more than 8.1 million units by the end of its production in 1992, the Renault 4 became a French cultural icon. It was a car for the people, a symbol of practical, efficient design from France.

long.en: The Renault 4 (Quatre), introduced in 1961, was designed to replace the best-selling 4CV. By 1978, the car reached its full potential with the GTL variant. This model added a plastic grille, a more powerful 1.1-liter engine, and a modernized instrument panel. Amassing more than 8.1 million units by the end of its production in 1992, the Renault 4 became a French cultural icon. It was a car for the people, a symbol of practical, efficient design from France.

conversation.en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.

It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.

One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.

He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.

It's amusing to hear easoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Renault是一家热爱竞技的公司。

他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。

他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的Alpine。

而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。

作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。

他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。

这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。

听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

usedCar.en:
The R5 Turbo was among the hottest rally cars in the 1980s.

While the base R5 came as a front-engine car, Renault
converted the R5 Turbo into a mid-engine machine.

This improved the car's off-road balance, resulting in numerous
rallying championships all over the world.

It's fair to say that the heavy rear could be
a bit jittery at times...

...but its unique driving character makes it more appealing
to many tarmac rally drivers!
usedCar.zh:
R5 Turbo是80年代拉力赛事中的明星。

近年来，参赛队伍把量产车改成
中置引擎布局也不是什么新鲜事……

但在80年代，这一做法还相当新颖。

虽然这车的后端确实比较重，而且
偶尔不太稳……

但是柏油路拉力赛才是它
展现实力的地方！

vehicleCollection.en:
The rear-mid-engine layout and ultra-wide rear fenders of this Renault hatchback set the 1980s auto industry on the right track.

The Renault R5 ("Cinq") Turbo drew major attention when it was introduced at the 1978 Paris Motor Show. Initially developed as a prototype for the World Rally Championship (WRC), a production version followed in 1980. The transformation was dramatic, its front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout replaced with a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive one. The new engine delivered 1.5 times the power and more than three times the torque compared to the standard model. Making its debut at the 1980 WRC Tour de Corse, the R5 Turbo dominated the field, establishing Renault as a serious WRC force.

long.en: The Renault R5 ("Cinq") Turbo drew major attention when it was introduced at the 1978 Paris Motor Show. Initially developed as a prototype for the World Rally Championship (WRC), a production version followed in 1980. The transformation was dramatic, its front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout replaced with a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive one. The new engine delivered 1.5 times the power and more than three times the torque compared to the standard model. Making its debut at the 1980 WRC Tour de Corse, the R5 Turbo dominated the field, establishing Renault as a serious WRC force.
long.zh: Renault R5 ('Cinq') Turbo在1978年巴黎车展首次亮相时就备受瞩目。这款最初为征战世界拉力锦标赛打造的原型车于1980年推出量产版本。设计上经过了大改，从前置前驱布局改为中置后驱布局。相较普通版Renault 5，新引擎动力输出提升了1.5倍，扭矩增加了3.3倍。1980年世界拉力锦标赛，它自科西嘉站首秀起，横扫多项赛事，为Renault在世界拉力锦标赛历史中留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。

conversation.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 was the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine saloons.

Yet the addition of four-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, quickened by
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the ‘Lunchbox,’ it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.

1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that’s all its own.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。

1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

conversation.en:
The Tour de Corse?

Well, it's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.

The 1964 Tour de Corse was a particular classic.

Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!

What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed first, third,
fourth and fifth place!

It was quite the remarkable achievement.

Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally, established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.

The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。

1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！

而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。

Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。
;

Gordini was a hard-working Frenchman who went on to become
an F1 race car constructor—basically, a genius.

For many years, Gordini partnered with Renault to produce
performance versions of the company's mass-market cars.

This Renault 8 Gordini is one such example and probably the
most popular of the official collaborations.

The fact that it's near twice as powerful as the base model
just goes to show what a genius tuner Gordini really was.

The classic blue-paint-with-whit-stripes, V-shaped bonnet
and boxy styling still has legions of fans to this day!
collection.zh:
Amédée Gordini是Renault和Simca汽车的传奇调校大师，

因其在勒芒比赛中的成就而广为人知。

这位勤奋的法国人甚至还参与了一级方程式赛车的制造，
换句话说，这一位是真正的天才。

多年来，Gordini一直与Renault合作，生产面向大众市场车型的高
性能版本。

这辆官方合作的Renault 8 Gordini就是个不错的范例，而且可能是
最受欢迎的范例！

这台车的性能相比基础车型几乎翻了一番，足以证明Gordini
确实是一位天才的调校大师。

带有白色条纹的经典蓝色漆面、V形引擎盖和方正的造
型使得此车至今仍坐拥大量的粉丝！

vehicleCollection.en:
A French icon of the '60s, the R8 Gordini is still popular half a century after its birth.

This high-performance version of the Renault 8 was tuned by Amédée Gordini, known as "The Sorcerer" for his remarkable engine tuning. Building on the strengths of the original 1108 cc compact sedan, Gordini transformed the modest Renault 8 into a formidable touring machine, blending precision engineering with motorsport spirit. In 1966, the engine was enlarged to 1300 cc and paired with a 5-speed transmission, further unlocking its performance potential. With its distinctive character and motorsport pedigree, this automotive gem holds a cherished place in the hearts of enthusiasts to this day.

brandCentral.en:
The name Renault Sport may not be familiar here in the States,
but in Europe, it's one of the most well-known sporty brands.

It's the name of the motorsports division of the company, which
has participated in everything from Formula 1 to Le Mans.

The fourth-generation Clio is a great example of
the types of cars it produces.

Providing the power for this compact is a turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 that produced <220ps>.

The "Trophy" version was created as a special model
specifically for race-track use.

To see how fast the car was, the folks at Renault Sport
took it to the Nürburgring.

And guess what? The thing ended up setting a new lap record
for compact hatchbacks!
brandCentral.zh:
Renault Sport在全球范围内都享有极高的知名度。

这都要归功于F1和勒芒24小时耐力赛等重大赛事的胜利，
为Renault的赛车部门积攒下了赫赫声名。

第四代Clio正是他们的杰作之一。

经过Renault Sport的专门调校，这台1.6L涡轮增压直列四缸引擎可
以产生高达<220ps>的动力。

此外，“Trophy”特别车型还针对赛道进行了专项性能调校。

Renault的高性能掀背车是纽博格林赛道圈速纪录上的常客。

事实上，Clio甫一亮相，就创下了紧凑型掀背车类别中的
新纪录——表现出了巨大的潜力。

catch.en: This super fast Clio set the compact hatch lap record at the Nürburgring.
catch.zh: 这辆风驰电掣的Clio保持着紧凑型掀背车在纽博格林赛道上的圈速记录。

The Renault Clio RS is an icon of Europe’s
"Supermini" segment.

The Williams version of the original series is remembered
with particular fondness.

Like its forebears, this RS version of the fourth-series model
combined extreme sportiness with quiet urbanity.

In terms of design, this car has sportiness in its DNA.

Its muscular shapes, aggressive front, and the concealed
rear-door hadles in its C-pillars...

...give one the impression of a two-door coupe.

Thanks to this, the sportier bumpers, aero details, and low
stance with 18-inch wheels and red calipers...

...ae sufficient to visually transform it into a little
racing "weapon."<next =2202909 type=Գ

conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
雷诺Clio RS是欧洲“超迷你”类型
中的标志性车型。

第1代中的Williams版本尤其受到
广大车迷们的喜爱和铭记。

和前代车型一样，这款第4代的RS版本也完美综合了
极致的运动性能和安静的都市驾乘体验。

它采用了充满肌肉感的外形、极富侵略性的前&，

给人以双门跑车的观感。

以及应用了18寸轮毂和红色卡钳的超低态车身……

conversation.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.

Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.

This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...

...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。

它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。

后轮的“管装”风道线条……

和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

usedCar.en:
It may look like an average hatchback, but the 3L V6
on this rear mid-engine vehicle is truly sporty!

The design is said to be based on Renault's beloved R5 Turbo
of the 1980s.

While originally conceived as a one-make racing model,
this is the road-going variant.

You'll know the difference as soon as you feel the power and
torque from that rear-mounted 3L V6!
usedCar.zh:
这车或许看起来就是辆普通的掀背车，但这款搭载了
后置3升V6引擎的车子可是实打实的跑车型赛车！

该车的设计理念据说来自于80年代
的热门车Renault R5 Turbo。

这款车原本是作为统一规格赛车而设计的，
但这款车为公路版。

等你体验到那后置3升V6引擎的马力和扭矩后，
你立马就能感受到其中的区别！

vehicleCollection.en:
Built by Tom Walkinshaw Racing, this sporty Lutecia featured a mid-mounted 3.0-liter V6.

Originally developed for motorsports, the Renault Clio R.S. V6 possessed the 3.0-liter V-6 from the luxury Laguna, producing up to 229.8 HP. In 2002, the updated Phase 2 model raised output to 251.5 HP and introduced changes to the exterior, interior, and tire size.

long.en: Originally developed for motorsports, the Renault Clio R.S. V6 possessed the 3.0-liter V-6 from the luxury Laguna, producing up to 229.8 HP. In 2002, the updated Phase 2 model raised output to 251.5 HP and introduced changes to the exterior, interior, and tire size.

conversation.en:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was
with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window
and dynamic rear pillar.

Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it
appear even more aggressive.

But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front
grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.
g
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在Renault Design工作时经手设计的！

当我和我的团队一起设计Mégane III系列时……

从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。

这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，

以及显著改造过的后保险杠……

还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。

但最成功的细节……

无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。

brandCentral.en:
The R.S. Trophy is a high-performance model that is
based on the third generation Mégane.

Featuring a specially tuned 2L straight-four engine...

It offers plenty of torque in the mid-RPM range, and an
exciting sense of power once you hit the higher revs.

The R.S.'s main USP, however, is its suspension, which is
designed to improve the grounding of the front tyres...

Meaning the car responds well when entering corners,
without sacrificing any capacity for exiting them.

In short, it lets you keep the pedal to the metal
for longer!
brandCentral.zh:
R.S. Trophy是一款基于第三代梅甘娜研发的高性能车型，

配备了经过特别调校的2升直列四缸引擎……

此车在中段转速范围内可提供充沛的扭矩，而进入高转
速区后，令人兴奋的动力感则会源源不断。

然而，R.S.系列的最大优点在于其悬挂，在设计时着重改
善了前轮胎的抓地性……

因此该车不仅在进入弯道时反应良好，而且不必牺牲任
何出弯的能力。

简而言之，可以让您有更多的时间踩住油门！

vehicleCollection.en:
This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.

Based on the third-generation Mégane 3-door coupe, the Mégane R.S. was factory-tuned by Renault Sport for high performance. With bespoke ground effects and a newly developed chassis, it delivered exceptional cornering capability—earning its reputation as one of the fastest front-wheel-drive cars of its time. In 2011, the Mégane R.S. Trophy was introduced. With just 500 units produced worldwide, it made headlines by setting a new Nürburgring lap record for mass-produced front-wheel-drive cars, clocking in at 8 minutes and 7.97 seconds.

long.en: Based on the third-generation Mégane 3-door coupe, the Mégane R.S. was factory-tuned by Renault Sport for high performance. With bespoke ground effects and a newly developed chassis, it delivered exceptional cornering capability—earning its reputation as one of the fastest front-wheel-drive cars of its time. In 2011, the Mégane R.S. Trophy was introduced. With just 500 units produced worldwide, it made headlines by setting a new Nürburgring lap record for mass-produced front-wheel-drive cars, clocking in at 8 minutes and 7.97 seconds.

conversation.en:
In touring car races and rallies...

Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.

Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!

But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...

They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!

Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...

It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!

It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
g

conversation.zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……

一直以来代表雷诺出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。

像是世界拉力锦标赛组别B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！
都是数一数二的好车！

再往上一个级别，就轮到梅甘娜了？

好吧……雷诺为了推动自家举办的梅甘娜杯，
确实是使出了浑身解数！

虽然外表与其公路版本极其相似……

但实际上这是一辆单一车种专用赛车，
搭载与日产联合开发的中置3.8升V6引擎！

另外，这台车原本打算参加的是在欧洲举办的高人气比赛
——雷诺运AS|赛。

catch.en: Aggressive looks topped off by gullwing doors highlight this Mégane Trophy.
catch.zh: Mégane Trophy车型，鸥翼车门为霸气外观更添魄力。

vehicleCollection.en:
Aggressive looks topped off by gullwing doors highlight this Mégane Trophy.

The Renault Sport Mégane Trophy was developed specifically for the Mégane Trophy race series, which began in 2005. While retaining the overall silhouette of the production Mégane, the Trophy version featured far more aggressive styling and a mid-mounted 355 HP 3.5-liter V-6 in a lightweight 2194 lbs package. A 6-speed two-pedal manual transmission with paddle shifters delivered quick, precise gear changes. The suspension and brakes were full racing spec.

long.en: The Renault Sport Mégane Trophy was developed specifically for the Mégane Trophy race series, which began in 2005. While retaining the overall silhouette of the production Mégane, the Trophy version featured far more aggressive styling and a mid-mounted 355 HP 3.5-liter V-6 in a lightweight 2194 lbs package. A 6-speed two-pedal manual transmission with paddle shifters delivered quick, precise gear changes. The suspension and brakes were full racing spec.
long.zh: 这辆Renault Sport Mégane Trophy是专为参加自2005年起创办的Mégane Trophy比赛所打造。在保留Mégane的整体风格之余，这辆Trophy版本加入了更富有进攻性的外观元素，并在其仅重995 公斤的车身内配备了一台调校至360 PS动力输出的3.5升V6引擎。它的传动系统采用了一套配有换挡拨片的6速双踏板手动变速箱。而悬挂和刹车也统统升级成完整的赛车规格。

brandCentral.en:
The Renault Sport R.S. 01 was a powerful mid-engine race car
that was created to compete in a one-make race series.

It was developed with Nissan, so it should come as no surprise
that the twin-turbo V-6 in the car came from a Nissan GT-R.

Thanks to the folks at NISMO, the engine produced <550ps>.

The Renault weighed only <1100kg>, so be careful when stepping
on the throttle if you happen to drive one.
brandCentral.zh:
这款Renault Sport R.S. 01是一辆性能强大的中置引擎赛车，专门
设计用于参加单一车种赛事。

这款与Nissan合作开发的车型采用Nissan GT-R同款的双涡轮增压V6
引擎，

并接受了NISMO的精准调校，可以输出<550ps>的马力。

而它的车重仅仅只有<1100kg>。从气质到血统，它都无可挑剔。

catch.en: A French race car with a Japanese heart.
catch.zh: R.S.01，步入了运动赛车的世界。

vehicleCollection.en:
A French race car with a Japanese heart.

In the summer of 2014, Renault Sport unveiled the R.S.01 as its new contender for one-make racing, succeeding the Mégane Trophy. Measuring 164.2 inches in length and 78.7 inches in width, the R.S.01 boasted a lightweight body at just 2425 lbs. Beneath its sculpted exterior was a potent twin-turbo V-6 engine producing 542.4 HP. Every detail of the car—from its advanced aerodynamics to its efficient cooling systems—reflects Renault Sport’s deep expertise, making it an impressive race machine in every sense.

long.en: In the summer of 2014, Renault Sport unveiled the R.S.01 as its new contender for one-make racing, succeeding the Mégane Trophy. Measuring 164.2 inches in length and 78.7 inches in width, the R.S.01 boasted a lightweight body at just 2425 lbs. Beneath its sculpted exterior was a potent twin-turbo V-6 engine producing 542.4 HP. Every detail of the car—from its advanced aerodynamics to its efficient cooling systems—reflects Renault Sport’s deep expertise, making it an impressive race machine in every sense.
long.zh: 在2014年夏天，Renault Sport推出了这款全新赛车R.S.01，代替Mégane Trophy参加单一车种比赛。虽然它的车身长4,170毫米，宽2,000毫米，车重却仅有1,100 公斤。这套轻量级框架由一部能输出550 PS的V6双涡轮增压引擎供能。这辆车能够满足人们对赛车的一切要求，Renault Sport也将他们丰富的汽车工程知识统统运用在了空气动力学和散热部件的设计上。

brandCentral.en:

conform to FIA GT3 regulations.

Because the production car was developed for track use, it
didn't take much to make this car a potent GT3 machine.

After beginning life in a one-make series, the Sport R.S.01
now competes in GT races all over the world.
brandCentral.zh:
这款车基于Renault Sport R.S.01改装，完全符合FIA GT3规范。

由于其量产型号本就是一款赛车，改装版本更是青出于蓝。

它在各方面的表现都优于参加单一车种赛事的原型，现
在已经开始参与全球范围的各项GT赛事。

catch.en: Renault's special GT3 machine with Nismo power.
catch.zh: 参加雷诺世界系列赛的GT赛车，经由NISMO调试后重获新生。

vehicleCollection.en:
Renault's special GT3 machine with Nismo power.

Based on Renault Sport’s purpose-built one-make racer, the R.S.01, the Renault Sport R.S.01 GT3 was developed to compete in FIA GT championships. To comply with FIA GT3 regulations, the car underwent significant modifications. The power output was restricted, and the brake materials were replaced. Also, 110 lbs of ballast was added, and the ground effect aerodynamics were completely reengineered

long.en: Based on Renault Sport’s purpose-built one-make racer, the R.S.01, the Renault Sport R.S.01 GT3 was developed to compete in FIA GT championships. To comply with FIA GT3 regulations, the car underwent significant modifications. The power output was restricted, and the brake materials were replaced. Also, 110 lbs of ballast was added, and the ground effect aerodynamics were completely reengineered
long.zh: 这款Renault Sport R.S.01 GT3基于Renault Sport的单一车种赛车——R.S.01所开发，并用于参加FIA-GT锦标赛。为了符合国际汽联的GT3组别规则，这个车型接受了大量的改动。其马力输出受到了相应的限制，刹车材料也得到了更换，此外还配备了50 公斤的压舱物，地面效应也进行了全面修改。

conversation.en:
With its frog-eyed expression and compact body,
this first-generation Twingo is simply adorable!

Unexpectedly spacious inside, its seats can be reclined
to a full-flat position.

Say, do you know how it got its funny name?

It’s a play on three dance styles—the twist, swing,
and tango.

The Twingo had some limited-edition models
created in collaboration with fashion brands.

The 1993 model, this first-generation gem is a rare prize
for collectors!

蛙眼大灯和小巧的车身，第一代Twingo就是那么可爱！

座位甚至可以做到完全放平。

对了，你知道这个奇奇怪怪的名字是怎么来的吗？

Twingo还曾与多个时尚品牌联名推出限量特别版。

这款1993年的初代车型，
如今早已成为收藏家们竞相追捧的珍品！

usedCar.en:
Hi there. Looking for a small car with a big personality? Then
I’ve got the find for you—a first-generation Renault Twingo.

Take a look at its round headlights. Aren’t they adorable? In 1992,
this quirky monobox design took the world by storm.

Get in, and you’ll immediately see the magic of its design. At just
<3.4m> in length, it can comfortably seat four adults.

What’s more, the rear seats slide backward and forward,
meaning boot space can be extended for longer drives.

he interior uses a lot of plastic, but avoids feeling cheap
through a colorful aesthetic that matches its exterior.

This ’93 model runs on a 1.2-liter 4-cylinder OHV engine.
It may only have <55ps>, but it’s pure joy to redline.

With a 14-yearproduction run, the first-generation Twingo proves
that Renault is a true ster of the sml-cargenre.
usedCar.zh:
你好！想找一辆个性十足的小车？那我这里为你
准备了一个绝佳的选择——一辆初代雷诺Twingo！

瞧瞧这圆圆的大灯，可爱吧？
1992年，这款造型小巧的单厢车一经推出便风靡全球。

一坐进车内，立刻就能领略到它设计上的精妙之处。
车身长度仅<3.4m>，却能轻松容纳四名成年人。

更妙的是，它的后排座椅可以前后滑动，
这样一来，在长途旅行时，还能方便灵活地扩展行空间。

内饰虽然采用了不少的塑料材质，但通过
和外观协调呼应的色彩美学设计，有效地避免了廉价感。

这里这辆93款搭载了一台1.2升的4缸顶置阀门引擎。
马力虽仅有<55ps>，但将它推x转速红线的过程却充满乐趣。

初代Twingo历经了长达14RP的生产周u
_以证明雷诺对小车类市场的把握堪称大师水准。

catch.en: Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.
catch.zh: 实用又可爱。为A级车市场注入清新活力。

vehicleCollection.en:
Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.

The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a near-continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. The wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, allowing for an unusually spacious interior despite its compact form. At launch, the engine delivered modest output, but paired with the lightweight body, it provided a lively and engaging drive in urban settings. It was also praised for bringing character to a practical vehicle, with sliding rear seats that enabled a variety of seating/cargo configurations.

long.en: The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a near-continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. The wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, allowing for an unusually spacious interior despite its compact form. At launch, the engine delivered modest output, but paired with the lightweight body, it provided a lively and engaging drive in urban settings. It was also praised for bringing character to a practical vehicle, with sliding rear seats that enabled a variety of seating/cargo configurations.
long.zh: Twingo以其三门单厢式车身而闻名，其轮廓线条从短促的引擎盖开始，经车顶延伸至车尾，几乎一气呵成，流畅自然。四个车轮被极限排布在车身的四角，使其在紧凑车身尺寸下，仍然保证了超乎寻常的内部空间。虽然Twingo在问世之初所搭载的引擎，动力只是仅仅够用，但搭配轻量化的车身，足以让它轻快灵动地在都市中穿行。此外它还配备了可滑动的后排座椅，可以实现多种空间布局，这种在实用车型中添加独特功能的设计受到了好评。

brandCentral.en:
The Roadster Shop is a hot-rod shop based in Illinois, U.S.A.

It's particularly famous for its
custom chassis offerings.

This Rampage is one of its main showpieces. It won
the Gran Turismo Award at the 2014 SEMA Show.

It's based on a 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS.

In addition to a reworked frame, its body is equipped
with a roll cage for extra reinforcement.

Also, its engine is more centrally located, which means that
the car's handling balance is superb!
brandCentral.zh:
Roadster Shop是一家位于美国伊利诺伊州的改装车店，

尤其以定制底盘产品而闻名。

这台Rampage是他们的杰作，
也是2014年SEMA展会上Gran Turismo大奖的得主！

它以1970年的Chevrolet Camaro SS为基础。

除了重新制作的车身框架，
还增加了防滚架，以进行额外刚度加固……

而且它的引擎更靠近中间位置
——依我看，这是一个匠心独具的设计！

catch.en: This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.
catch.zh: 2014年GT奖得主。披着Camaro SS外皮的高速怪物。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.

This machine was the winner of the 2014 Gran Turismo Award. A heavily customized 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS, it was reimagined by Roadster Shop in Illinois, USA. The car’s structure was rebuilt from the ground up using lightweight carbon fiber and aluminum components, while under the hood sat a rear-offset 7.0-liter LS7 engine tuned to produce 739.6 HP. Its aggressive aesthetic was matched by performance, with wide overfenders, a bold front spoiler, and a prominent rear wing.

long.en: This machine was the winner of the 2014 Gran Turismo Award. A heavily customized 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS, it was reimagined by Roadster Shop in Illinois, USA. The car’s structure was rebuilt from the ground up using lightweight carbon fiber and aluminum components, while under the hood sat a rear-offset 7.0-liter LS7 engine tuned to produce 739.6 HP. Its aggressive aesthetic was matched by performance, with wide overfenders, a bold front spoiler, and a prominent rear wing.
long.zh: 2014年Gran Turismo大奖得主。这款1970年Chevrolet Camaro SS由美国伊利诺伊州Roadster Shop定制改装。基础结构采用碳纤维和铝制部件重新构建，搭载后置布局的7升LS7引擎，调校至750 PS。强劲动力与大尺寸宽体轮眉、前扰流板和尾翼组成的震撼外观完美匹配。
