brandCentral.en:
The VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo was all about Subaru's
pursuit of delivering a great driving experience.

Armed with a powerful hybrid power unit...

...this machine is powered by turbocharged 2.0-liter
flat-4 engine and three powerful electrical motors.

The power is distributed to all four wheels via Subaru's
all-wheel-drive system.

And the car's appearance is striking, is it not?

By the way, a fun fact about this design...

...it was inspired by the world's hardest food: "katsuobushi,"
a Japanese delicacy made of dried and fermented tuna!
brandCentral.sourceName: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.zh:
VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo体现了Subaru对终极驾驶体验的
全部追求。

此车搭载有强大的混合动力单元：

包括一台2L的水平对置涡轮增压四缸引擎和三台动力出
众的电机……

并输送至Subaru传统的全时四轮驱动系统上。

这样的设计令人眼前一亮！

顺便分享一个关于这辆车的设计小趣闻：

其灵感来自于世界上最难入口的食物：“鲣节”，一种
由干燥并发酵过的金枪鱼制成的日本美食！

catch.en: Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized.
catch.zh: Subaru历史上最激进的跑车，但依然易于操纵，驾驶充满乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized.

The SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo is Subaru’s ultimate expression of a next-generation sports car, carrying forward the brand’s “VIZIV” philosophy—Vision for Innovation. Carbon materials have been used extensively throughout the body, keeping weight down to 3042 lbs. At its heart is a specially tuned horizontally-opposed 2.0-liter engine paired with high-output electric motors, delivering a combined output of 591.7 HP and a peak torque of 800Nm (593.1 ft-lb).

long.en: The SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo is Subaru’s ultimate expression of a next-generation sports car, carrying forward the brand’s “VIZIV” philosophy—Vision for Innovation. Carbon materials have been used extensively throughout the body, keeping weight down to 3042 lbs. At its heart is a specially tuned horizontally-opposed 2.0-liter engine paired with high-output electric motors, delivering a combined output of 591.7 HP and a peak torque of 800Nm (593.1 ft-lb).
long.zh: “SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”是Subaru旗下最终极的跑车，延续了他们对“VIZIV”——即“创新的愿景”——这一概念的坚持。这款车全车采用了碳纤维材料，仅重1,380 公斤。在一部特殊调校的2升水平对置引擎和高功率电机的驱动下，这套动力系统总共能够输出最大600 PS的动力，而最大扭矩也达到了800牛米（82.0 公斤力米）。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Subaru历史上最激进的跑车，但依然易于操纵，驾驶充满乐趣。

“SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”是Subaru旗下最终极的跑车，延续了他们对“VIZIV”——即“创新的愿景”——这一概念的坚持。这款车全车采用了碳纤维材料，仅重1,380 公斤。在一部特殊调校的2升水平对置引擎和高功率电机的驱动下，这套动力系统总共能够输出最大600 PS的动力，而最大扭矩也达到了800牛米（82.0 公斤力米）。

brandCentral.en:
Suzuki is one of the few manufacturers
that builds both 2- and 4-wheel vehicles.

This machine you see here broke new ground for the company.
It's called the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a compact 2-seater convertible evoking
memories of the Swift Sport and Cappuccino.

Under the hood, located just aft of the front axle line is...

...the <1340cc> engine from the Suzuki Hayabusa,
one of the most popular motorbikes in the world.

In addition to sporting two motors up front,
the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo also has one at the rear.

This gives the hybrid-powered vehicle all-wheel-drive
and plenty of power on demand.
brandCentral.zh:
铃木是为数不多同时制造两轮摩托车和四轮汽车
的制造商之一。

我们这里的这辆尤物是他们的一个“突破”——
铃木Vision Gran Turismo。

从车身来看，这是一辆紧凑型的双座敞篷车，
令人想起速翼特Sport和Cappuccino。

但是最值得注意的是它的前中置引擎！

别惊讶，这可是一台<1340cc>的铃木隼引擎——
世界上最顶级的摩托车引擎。

除了前面的两个电机，后面也安装了一个……

它是四轮驱动车型中最令人印象深刻的混合动力车型。

catch.en: A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.
catch.zh: 用一颗Hayabusa的心脏加上多台电机综合打造的超级跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.

The SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo harnesses the cutting-edge engine technology of the renowned Hayabusa sports bike, paired with advanced electrification and weight-saving innovations. Its powertrain combines the 1,340 cm³ (1340 cc) Hayabusa engine with three high-output electric motors in an all-wheel-drive layout. Together, they deliver a total system output of 426 HP at 9700 rpm, making this compact machine a true super sports car.

long.en: The SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo harnesses the cutting-edge engine technology of the renowned Hayabusa sports bike, paired with advanced electrification and weight-saving innovations. Its powertrain combines the 1,340 cm³ (1340 cc) Hayabusa engine with three high-output electric motors in an all-wheel-drive layout. Together, they deliver a total system output of 426 HP at 9700 rpm, making this compact machine a true super sports car.
long.zh: SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo采用“隼”运动摩托车的最新引擎技术，结合最新的电动化和轻量化技术。动力系统采用“隼”的1,340 立方厘米引擎搭配3个高出力电机，组成全轮驱动配置。引擎与电机结合在9,700 转每分时输出总动力432 PS，成就了这台紧凑型超级跑车。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 racecar was based on
the Suzuki VGT.

To comply with Gr.3 specifications, it adopted
a simple FR layout.

Powering the vehicle was a twin-turbocharged V-8.

This powerplant was actually two Hayabusa engines from
the company’s flagship sports bike stuck together.

It redlined at a very high <10000rpm>
and churned out <586ps> of power.

Thanks to enlarged front and rear spoilers and added air ducts,
the body generated gobs of downforce.

Also, the use of carbon-fiber throughout the body
kept the entire vehicle extremely lightweight.

Sporting the colors of Suzuki’s motorcycle race team,
this particular Suzuki car is sure to turn heads on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原版Gr.3级别赛车
是基于Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo改装而来。

根据Gr.3的规格要求，它采用了普通的
前置后驱传动系统，

搭载一台狂野的双涡轮增压V8引擎。

事实上，这款引擎是由两台Suzuki旗舰级运动摩托车
Hayabusa的引擎组合而成。

它能达到<10000rpm>的转速，输出<586ps>马力。

除了全面提升的下压力、加大尺寸的前后扰流板
和新增的导气口……

这台猛兽还在全车身应用了轻量化碳纤维材料，
大幅减轻了自重。

此外，它还装备了Suzuki摩托车车队的官方配色，
在赛道上一定能夺人目光。

conversation.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.

It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

computer systems and rock-solid engineering.</>

could deler!

conversation.en:
In 1955, Mercedes-Benz pulled out
of all motorsports events.

It wasn’t until 1988 that it officially
made its return.

And it did so with this car, the Sauber-Mercedes.

Because it was painted all silver, the car was called
the "Silver Arrow."

Actually, there’s a story behind the name.
Would you care to hear it?
2
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
在1955年，Mercedes-Benz选择从汽车运动赛事中抽身。

直到1988年，他们才正式推出这辆Sauber-Mercedes，

并用它上演了一出王者归来！

因为采用了通体银色的车身，它得到了“银箭”的称号。

其实这个名字背后还有一段故事。你想要听吗？

conversation.en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
<1kg> too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.

It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.

Sinc then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.

But if youpre interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race cors of other cotries
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重<1kg>，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。

最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！

4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。

不过，如果你对F1历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

collection.en:
If I were to ask you to think of Swiss F1 team,
chances are you'd think of Sauber,

which was founded by Peter Sauber, a keen amateur race driver.

Sauber built his first race car in 1970,
and drove it in hill climbs.

Sauber then focused on the management side of things, and the
team experienced early success with the BMW-engined C5.

In many ways, that success was the launchpad which propelled
the team all the way to Formula 1 in 1993.

Prior to its F1 involvement, Sauber's greatet achievement
was the C9, a Group C race car developed with Mercedes.

The C9 made its racing debut in 1987, and soon tasted victory.

In the 1989 season it was virtually unrivaled,

becoming the winner of the World Sports Car Championship
and inning the 24 Hours of Le Mans!
collection.zh:
提到瑞士的F1车队，您自然会想到索伯车队。

车队的创始人Peter Sauber是一位激情四溢的业余赛车手。

他在1970年打造出了他的第一辆赛车，并驾驶它参加爬坡赛。

后来，他将重点转向管理，而他的车队也凭借搭载BMW引
擎的C5取得了早期的成功。

这种成功在方方面面激励着车队，推动他们在1993年登上
F1大赛的舞台。

在参与F1之前，索伯车队最大的成就是C9：一款与Mercedes
合作开发的C组别赛车。

C9于1987年在赛场上首次亮相。不久就尝到了胜利的滋味。

在1989年赛季中，它表现得所向披靡，

连续夺得了世界跑车锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！~

catch.en: The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.
catch.zh: 战无不胜的C组别赛车，重返赛场的Mercedes车队令人敬畏不已。

vehicleCollection.en:
The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.

The C9 was a Group C race car developed by Switzerland’s Sauber. Having supplied engines in earlier efforts, Mercedes officially brought Sauber under its factory racing umbrella in 1988. By 1989, the C9 appeared in a striking all-silver livery, evoking memories of the legendary Silver Arrows. In a stunning performance at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, car No. 63 claimed victory, followed by No. 61 in 2nd place and No. 62 in 5th.

long.en: The C9 was a Group C race car developed by Switzerland’s Sauber. Having supplied engines in earlier efforts, Mercedes officially brought Sauber under its factory racing umbrella in 1988. long.zh: C9是瑞士车厂Sauber开发的C组别赛车。在与这家车厂进行引擎供应合作多年后，Mercedes在1988年开始雇佣Sauber担任他们的原厂车队。在1989年，这款车以纯银色车身的涂装亮相，也唤醒了车迷们对“银箭传奇”的回忆。在勒芒24小时耐力赛上，这款车取得了震撼全场的成绩。其中63号赛车夺得了冠军，61号则屈居第二，而62号也跻身前五。

collection.en:
A winner at Le Mans, a competitor in Formula 1,
and one of America’s greatest car enthusiasts...

Carroll Shelby has a permanent place in automotive history.

After retiring as a driver, Shelby became a constructor,
with a focus on road cars that could win races.

The Cobra is one of the iconic cars produced by Shelby.

The first production lots were shipped out
in the spring of 1963...

And were initially powered by Ford’s 260 CID engine,
which were soon replaced by the 289 CID unit.

Then the legendary Cobra 427 was introduced in 1964.

Powered by a 7L Ford 427...

It was intended by Shelby to defeat Ferrari in competition.

With their proven competition pedigree
and aggressive looks...

Big block Cobras are sogh ater by car enthusiasts
all over te world.
collection.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比不仅在勒芒24小时耐力赛中拿到过冠军，甚至参加
过一级方程式比赛。他是美国最伟大的汽车狂人之一……

在汽车历史上永久地占有一席之地。

在从赛车手的身份退役后，他转而成为一名汽车架构师，
专注于开发能够赢得比赛的公路车。

“Cobra”是谢尔比的代表作之一。

第一批Cobra在1963年春天发售，

最初搭载了福特的260 CID引擎，但很快被289 CID动单元所取代。

传奇的Cobra 427则于1964年推出。

Cobra 427由一台7升福特427引擎驱动，

这是谢尔比亲自选择的引擎，目的是在比赛中将法拉利拉下马。

由于其成熟的赛车血统和咄咄逼人s外观，

大块头的Cobra被世界各地的汽车爱好者所追捧dA

catch.en: Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.
catch.zh: 美国跑车的典范，采用大排量引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.

Shelby developed the Cobra 427 with the goal of winning the FIA Speed World Challenge, where the team was actively competing at the time. The car was powered by a formidable 7.0-liter 427 “Side Oiler” V-8—a purpose-built race engine originally designed for stock car competition. To handle its impressive 493.1 HP output, the Cobra 427 replaced its signature side-mounted leaf springs with a modern double wishbone suspension, greatly enhancing its handling and stability.

To handle its impressive 493.1 HP output, the Cobra 427 replaced its signature side-mounted leaf springs with a modern double wishbone suspension, greatly enhancing its handling and stability.
long.zh: 为了赢得当时所参加的FIA速度世界挑战赛，Shelby Cobra专门开发了Cobra 427。这辆车搭载了7升427 “Side Oiler”引擎，一款专门用于原厂改装车比赛的引擎。为了适配惊人的500 PS输出，该车放弃了标志性的侧边安装的钢板弹簧悬挂系统，转而采用新的双叉臂布局。

conversation.en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.

From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.

I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。

从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。

我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。
]

令人回味。

conversation.en:
Carroll Shelby made it his life’s mission to trounce
Ferrari at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

The first attempt he made was, of course,
in the famed Shelby Cobra.

However, as the open-bodied Cobra was lacking in terms
of high-speed aerodynamics...

Shelby turned to designer Pete Brock
for a body overhaul.

In return, Brock handed him back
the Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.

However, by the, Shelby had given his attention to
the development of the Ford GT40.

So this Cobra Daytona Coupe really only raced
for a fleeting two years...

In 1964 and ’65.

Only a few Shelby Cobras were ever produced--I'm
ealous of anyone who gets their hands on one!
]
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比毕生的宿愿
就是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中完胜法拉利。

他的第一次尝试当然就是这辆声名斐然的Shelby Cobra。

显然，Cobra的敞篷车身缺乏高速时所需的空气动力学性能……

于是，谢尔比向设计师皮特·布洛克求助，
对车身进行了大幅修改。

布洛克交付给他的便是这台Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe了。

只不过，此时谢尔比的注意力已经转向了福特GT40的开发。

因此这辆Cobra Daytona Coupe的赛车经历
只有短短的两年……

即1964和65年。

Shelby Cobra的制造数f极为有限——
真是嫉妒那些能搞到一辆的幸运儿！
'

collection.en:
The Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe may be the most
valuable Shelby Cobra of them all.

Determined to win Le Mans for Ford...

Carroll Shelby asked friend and employee Pete Brock
to design a coupé body for the Cobra.

Spec-wise, it was virtually the same as the 289 Cobra, but
the coupé body boosted its top speed by over <30km/h>.

Taking class victories at Le Mans and Daytona, this Cobra
became the champion of the FIA GT Class in 1965.

With only six Daytona Coupes in existence, including
prototypes, they are almost mythical in their rarity.
collection.zh:
Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe可能是Shelby Cobra中
价值最高的一款车型。

在下决心要为Ford赢得勒芒耐力赛后……

Carroll Shelby便邀请他的朋友兼雇员Pete Brock
为他设计Cobra的的车身。

它的规格配置几乎与289 Cobra完全相同，
但得益于双门车身的引入，最高速度提高了<30km/h>。

这款Cobra在勒芒和戴通纳都赢得了其所属组别的比赛，
最终又赢得了1965年国际GT制造商锦标赛GT组冠军。

包括原型车在内，Daytona Coupe只生产了六辆，如此稀少的产量
也把这台车推上了封神的位置。

catch.en: Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.
catch.zh: 成功改进了原版Cobra的空气动力学性能，是当时横扫各大比赛的传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.

The AC Cobra had already made a name for itself on the racing scene in the 1960s, and its closed-roof variant was the Shelby Cobra Coupe. While the open-bodied Cobra excelled in acceleration and handling, it lagged behind in top speed due to poor aerodynamics. That changed with a coupe body designed by Pete Brock, which dramatically improved the car’s airflow and added more than 18.6 mph to its top speed. With its full potential unlocked, the Cobra Coupe went on to win numerous races over the following two years.

long.en: The AC Cobra had already made a name for itself on the racing scene in the 1960s, and its closed-roof variant was the Shelby Cobra Coupe. While the open-bodied Cobra excelled in acceleration and handling, it lagged behind in top speed due to poor aerodynamics. That changed with a coupe body designed by Pete Brock, which dramatically improved the car’s airflow and added more than 18.6 mph to its top speed. With its full potential unlocked, the Cobra Coupe went on to win numerous races over the following two years.
long.zh: AC Cobra在1960年代的赛车界占据了统治地位，Shelby Cobra是这辆车的双门轿车版本。AC Cobra凭借卓越的加速能力与操控性在赛场上驰骋，但由于开放式车身带来的空气动力学效率低下，让其在与对手的竞争中落入下风。得益于皮特·布洛克设计的双门轿跑车身，这台车的空气动力学得到显著优化，最高速度提升超过30 公里/小时。在真正的潜力得以施放之后，这台车在两年内横扫多项赛事。

An iconic cream white body with Shelby’s signature
blue stripes...

Were once the signs of a genuine GT Mustang.

The original Mustang combined great proportions
with a simple and clean design.

Despite the special nature of this G.T. 350...

No parts were added to its exterior
due to regulations.

However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wide tyres and that iconic stripe.

If I could own a Mustang, this would be
at the top of my list.
W
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。

原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，

只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。

collection.en:
The 1965 Shelby GT350 is a variant of the Mustang
that debuted in 1964.

It was a model that was born from the collaboration between
Ford and Carroll Shelby,

and has a fantastic history of successes
in the world of racing.

Ford's then General Manager, Lee Iacocca, is generally
regarded as the man behind the Mustang.

In addition to knowing how to build cars people wanted.
Iacocca understood the value of motorsport,

which is why he entrusted the Mustang's
racing project to Shlby.

The result of this new collaboration was the GT350.

Being made specifically for racing, it's very spartan
compared to the standard Mustang,

its light, 2-seat setup and high-performance 289 engine
ensured success in SCCA and other compettion races.
collection.zh:
1965年的Shelby GT350可以视作是1964年首次亮相的Mustang的
一个变种。

它是Ford和Carroll Shelby合作诞生的车型，

并在赛车界缔造了一段赫赫有名的成功历史。

Ford当时的总经理Lee Iacocca被普遍认为是
催生Mustang的幕后功臣。

Iacocca不仅知道如何制造大众想要的汽车，而且深刻理解赛
车运动的价值，

因此他才把Mustang的赛车项目委托给Shelby。

双方新合作的产物就是这台GT350。

由于是专门为赛车运动制造的，与标准的Mustang相比，车内
装潢非常粗犷，

但双座配置带来的轻量化和高性能的289引擎确保了其在
SCCA和其他比赛中的巨大成功。

catch.en: This highly collectible Mustang earned a great track record in SCCA racing.
catch.zh: 这款Mustang在SCCA赛事中的表现尤为出色。

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly collectible Mustang earned a great track record in SCCA racing.

This high-performance Mustang was developed by Ford in collaboration with Carroll Shelby to compete in the SCCA, a premier American sports car racing series. The lightened body was equipped with race suspension and an LSD, while at its heart sat the 289 engine, producing 301.8 HP. Beginning in 1965, it went on to dominate the series for three consecutive years.

long.en: This high-performance Mustang was developed by Ford in collaboration with Carroll Shelby to compete in the SCCA, a premier American sports car racing series. The lightened body was equipped with race suspension and an LSD, while at its heart sat the 289 engine, producing 301.8 HP. Beginning in 1965, it went on to dominate the series for three consecutive years.
long.zh: 这台高性能Mustang由Ford和卡罗尔·谢尔比合作打造，用于征战美国跑车系列赛SCCA。轻量化的车身配备了赛车级悬挂和限滑差速器，其核心是能输出306 PS的289引擎。从1965年开始，它连续3年蝉联系列赛宝座。

这款Mustang在SCCA赛事中的表现尤为出色。

conversation.en:
For drift fans, this car is instantly recognizeable as Dai's car.

Daijiro Yoshihara is a Japanese race driver who
specializes in drifting.

He was the series champion of the 2011 Formula DRIFT
Championship Series.

For the 2018 season, his car was this one,
based on the Subaru BRZ.

It packed a turbocharged 7.8-liter V-8 under the hood.

The engine produced a massive <1000ps> of power!

Unfortunately, it didn't carry him to the
championship that year.

Still, the BRZ was impressive nontheless.

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
提到这辆车，人们就会联想起吉原大！

吉原大二郎是一位日本赛车手，专业从事漂移运动。

他是2011年漂移方程式锦标赛系列赛的冠军。

后来，他驾驶一辆基于Subaru BRZ的赛车继

在车辆的引擎盖下安装的是一台7.8L V8涡轮增压引擎。

能够产生<1000ps>的巨大动力！

虽然这台引擎并不足以让他赢得冠军，

但是，BRZ+V8仍然是一个令人振奋不已的组合！
P

brandCentral.en:
This car was driven by Dai Yoshihara, the first Japanese
driver to win the Formula Drift championship.

It was his 2017 competition car, equipped with a turbocharged
7.0-liter V-8 engine that produced <1000ps>.

The transmission, drivetrain and suspension were all tuned
for sliding the car sideways.

If you're looking to hone your drifting skills, why not
practice in Mr. Yoshihara's custom drift machine?
brandCentral.zh:
吉原大二郎是第一名征服了美国漂移界的日本车手，而
这就是他在2017赛季驾驶的战车。

它搭载的7升V8涡轮增压引擎可以输出<1000ps>的动力。

其变速箱、传动系统和悬挂均针对漂移比赛进行了特殊
改装。

如果想要磨练您的漂移技术，何不试试吉原君驾驶过的
这部无敌机器呢？`

catch.en: This BRZ competition machine was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara in 2017.
catch.zh: 由2017年Formula Drift冠军吉原大二郎所驾驶的BRZ。

vehicleCollection.en:
This BRZ competition machine was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara in 2017.

The 2017 Falken Tire / Turn 14 Distribution BRZ was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara. Based on the Rocket Bunny V3 aero kit, the car housed a 7.0-liter turbocharged V-8 that delivered approximately 986.2 HP. A 4-speed transmission and reinforced drivetrain components ensured it could handle the immense power.

long.en: The 2017 Falken Tire / Turn 14 Distribution BRZ was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara. Based on the Rocket Bunny V3 aero kit, the car housed a 7.0-liter turbocharged V-8 that delivered approximately 986.2 HP. A 4-speed transmission and reinforced drivetrain components ensured it could handle the immense power.
long.zh: 2017款“Falken Tire/Turn 14 Distribution BRZ”是漂移方程式冠军“阿大”吉原大二郎的座驾。该车基于Rocket Bunny V3的空气动力学套件打造，搭载7升涡轮增压V8引擎（动力约1,000 PS）。这台车采用4速变速箱与升级版传动部件，在2017赛季虽只获得第6名，但给观众留下了深刻的印象。

vehicleCollection.zh:
由2017年Formula Drift冠军吉原大二郎所驾驶的BRZ。

2017款“Falken Tire/Turn 14 Distribution BRZ”是漂移方程式冠军“阿大”吉原大二郎的座驾。该车基于Rocket Bunny V3的空气动力学套件打造，搭载7升涡轮增压V8引擎（动力约1,000 PS）。这台车采用4速变速箱与升级版传动部件，在2017赛季虽只获得第6名，但给观众留下了深刻的印象。

brandCentral.en:
This is the 2021 BRZ GT300 that made headlines
at the Super GT series in Japan.

As you may know, the Super GT is divided into
two classes: the GT500 and the GT300.

Having competed in the GT300 class
for nearly a quarter of a century...

...Subaru finally achieved a stunning series victory
in 2021 with this BRZ GT300.

As the first Subaru car to win the Super GT title,
it is truly one for the record books.

In terms of aerodynamics and weight distribution,
it is a marked improvement over its predecessor.

Thanks to the improved aerodynamics, made possible
by a brand-new BRZ body...

...air resistance can be kept to a minimum, which in turn
helps to generate downforce.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆2021 BRZ GT300在日本的Super GT系列赛中夺得桂冠。

你可能听说过，Super GT共分为两个级别：
GT500和GT300。

在GT300赛事中拼搏了近四分之一个世纪后，

Subaru终于在2021年凭借这辆BRZ GT300
拿下了振奋人心的系列赛冠军。

作为第一辆赢得Super GT冠军的Subaru，
它确实值得被载入史册。

在空气动力学和重量分配方面，
它比前代车型有了明显的改进。

全新的车身设计带来改进后的空气动力学效果，

将空气阻力降倒最低，进而产生更多的下压力。

catch.en: Cornering better than ever before. A BRZ for the Super GT.
catch.zh: 为Super Gt系列赛开发的BRZ，弯道性能进一步增强。

vehicleCollection.en:
Cornering better than ever before. A BRZ for the Super GT.

Starting in 2012, Subaru entered the BRZ into Japan’s domestic Super GT series, competing in the GT300 class. After the release of the second-generation BRZ in 2021, Subaru transitioned to a new GT machine based on the updated model. The new car retained proven elements like the EJ20 engine, while incorporating enhancements to weight distribution and aerodynamics. That same year, the BRZ claimed the GT300 class championship, marking a historic first for Subaru.

long.en: Starting in 2012, Subaru entered the BRZ into Japan’s domestic Super GT series, competing in the GT300 class. After the release of the second-generation BRZ in 2021, Subaru transitioned to a new GT machine based on the updated model. The new car retained proven elements like the EJ20 engine, while incorporating enhancements to weight distribution and aerodynamics. That same year, the BRZ claimed the GT300 class championship, marking a historic first for Subaru.
long.zh: 从2012年起，Subaru开始携BRZ车型征战日本国内的“Super GT”系列赛中GT300组别的比赛。2021年第2代基础车型发布后，Subaru将转而开发基于第2代BRZ打造的新GT赛车。这台车在继承前代车型EJ20引擎等优势外，还优化了重量分布与空气动力学效应。2021年，BRZ为Subaru夺下GT300级别历史首冠。

vehicleCollection.zh:
为Super Gt系列赛开发的BRZ，弯道性能进一步增强。

从2012年起，Subaru开始携BRZ车型征战日本国内的“Super GT”系列赛中GT300组别的比赛。2021年第2代基础车型发布后，Subaru将转而开发基于第2代BRZ打造的新GT赛车。这台车在继承前代车型EJ20引擎等优势外，还优化了重量分布与空气动力学效应。2021年，BRZ为Subaru夺下GT300级别历史首冠。

brandCentral.en:
The Subaru BRZ is an FR sports car introduced in 2012.

It features a 2L naturally aspirated flat engine, with
a chassis custom built to support the FR layout.

Flat—or 'horizontally opposed'—engines have a lower
centre of gravity, which benefits this model greatly.

The BRZ was developed by Subaru and Toyota—a collaboration
that also yielded its sibling, the Toyota 86.
brandCentral.zh:
这款斯巴鲁BRZ是一辆2012年推出的前置后驱跑车。

它采用了一台2升自然进气水平对置引擎，安装在专为支
持前置后驱布局特别定制的底盘上。

水平对置引擎可以降低车身重心，给予这款车极大的操
控优势。

这款BRZ由斯巴鲁和丰田联合打造，与丰田86是姊妹车款。

catch.en: Subaru's first FR sports car featured a boxer engine, giving it a low center of gravity and excellent handling.
catch.zh: Subaru的首款前置后驱跑车，搭载水平对置引擎，重心降低，操控运动性十足。

vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's first FR sports car featured a boxer engine, giving it a low center of gravity and excellent handling.

The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ sports cars were developed through a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru. "BRZ" stood for "Boxer engine, Rear-wheel drive, Zenith." The car was powered by a Subaru 2.0-liter boxer engine paired with Toyota’s D-4S direct injection system. Following its 2012 debut, the car received near-annual updates. The 2015 model notably improved both handling and ride comfort.

long.en: The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ sports cars were developed through a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru. "BRZ" stood for "Boxer engine, Rear-wheel drive, Zenith." The car was powered by a Subaru 2.0-liter boxer engine paired with Toyota’s D-4S direct injection system. Following its 2012 debut, the car received near-annual updates. The 2015 model notably improved both handling and ride comfort.
long.zh: Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。“BRZ”分别代表“水平对置引擎（Boxer engine）”、“后轮驱动（Rear-wheel drive）”和“究极品质（Zenith）”。引擎融合了经典的Subaru 2升水平对置引擎与Toyota的“D-4S”直喷技术。该车自2012年上市后几乎每年都有升级改进。2015车款在操控性和驾驶感受方面有了显著提升。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Subaru的首款前置后驱跑车，搭载水平对置引擎，重心降低，操控运动性十足。

Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。“BRZ”分别代表“水平对置引擎（Boxer engine）”、“后轮驱动（Rear-wheel drive）”和“究极品质（Zenith）”。引擎融合了经典的Subaru 2升水平对置引擎与Toyota的“D-4S”直喷技术。该车自2012年上市后几乎每年都有升级改进。2015车款在操控性和驾驶感受方面有了显著提升。

brandCentral.en:
This is the second-generation BRZ, which debuted in 2021.

Much like the first-generation model, it is a well-sized,
lightweight car with a rear-wheel drive layout.

That said, it is a great leap forward in terms of
speed and handling.

Trust me, you’ll especially love how responsive
it is on corners!

Also, the increased body rigidity and aluminium roof help to
reduce weight and lower the car’s centre of gravity.

But that’s not all! In addition to the chassis, consider
the improvements to its engine.

There, an enlarged 2.4L displacement has contributed
to greater power and torque.

And tweaks to the inertia and friction of its moving parts
have made for better driving in the high RPM range.
brandCentral.zh:
这是在2021年亮相的第二代BRZ。

与第一代类似，它同样是一款尺寸适中的后轮驱动轻量
化跑车。

另一方面，它在速度和操控上实现了巨大的飞跃。

相信我，你绝对会爱上它在弯道中的优异响应！

此外，车身刚度的增加和铝制车顶都有助于减轻车重，
以及降低汽车的重心。

但这还不是新款车型全部优化！
除了底盘之外，引擎的改进也可圈可点。

引擎在扩容到2.4升后带来了更大的功率和更强的扭矩。

对活塞部件的惯性和摩擦力的调校，有效改善了高转速
时的驾驶表现。

catch.en: The second-gen FR sports car features a larger 2.4-liter engine.
catch.zh: 采用排量更大的2.4L引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-gen FR sports car features a larger 2.4-liter engine.

The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ, both rear-wheel drive sports cars powered by boxer engines, were developed through a close collaboration between Toyota and Subaru. The series evolved into its second generation with the ZD8 in 2020. The updated platform featured a lighter yet more rigid body, while the engine was an all-new 2.4-liter boxer unit. Its peak output reached 231.8 HP. The Subaru BRZ "S" grade was positioned as a premium trim, offering enhanced interior and exterior appointments.

long.en: The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ, both rear-wheel drive sports cars powered by boxer engines, were developed through a close collaboration between Toyota and Subaru. The series evolved into its second generation with the ZD8 in 2020. The updated platform featured a lighter yet more rigid body, while the engine was an all-new 2.4-liter boxer unit. Its peak output reached 231.8 HP. The Subaru BRZ "S" grade was positioned as a premium trim, offering enhanced interior and exterior appointments.
long.zh: 搭载水平对置引擎、采用后轮驱动的Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。该车系于2020年进化为第二代ZD8车型。新车身实现了重量更轻却更坚固的设计，引擎则是全新开发的2.4升大排量水平对置引擎。最大动力为235 PS。此处展示的Subaru BRZ “S”版本是配备升级版内外饰件的高端车型。

vehicleCollection.zh:
采用排量更大的2.4L引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。

搭载水平对置引擎、采用后轮驱动的Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。该车系于2020年进化为第二代ZD8车型。新车身实现了重量更轻却更坚固的设计，引擎则是全新开发的2.4升大排量水平对置引擎。最大动力为235 PS。此处展示的Subaru BRZ “S”版本是配备升级版内外饰件的高端车型。

brandCentral.en:
This fully-customized car built by STI, Subaru's motorsports
division, was based on the standard BRZ.

It features specially engineered dampers, high-grip tires,
and original STI-built body parts.

You'll certainly notice how much better this upgraded
version corners.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆由斯巴鲁的汽车运动部门STI全方位定制打造的赛车以一
辆标准版BRZ作为改装原型，

使用了特殊设计的避震，高抓地力的轮胎和STI原厂制造
的车身部件。

行驶当中，您一定会感觉到这辆升级版本的过弯性能提
升有多大。

catch.en: Numerous chassis performance and visual enhancements by STI gave the BRZ sports car unprecedented flair.
catch.zh: STI为BRZ开发的最高级别车型，进行了大量的底盘性能和外观改进。

vehicleCollection.en:
Numerous chassis performance and visual enhancements by STI gave the BRZ sports car unprecedented flair.

In 2017, Subaru introduced the BRZ STI Sport as the flagship of the BRZ lineup. It was co-developed with Subaru’s motorsports division, STI (Subaru Tecnica International). The most notable upgrade was the revised chassis setup. Handling and stability were enhanced through STI’s proprietary Flexible V-Bar and Flexible Draw Stiffener components, while custom-developed suspension parts boosted overall agility.

long.en: In 2017, Subaru introduced the BRZ STI Sport as the flagship of the BRZ lineup. It was co-developed with Subaru’s motorsports division, STI (Subaru Tecnica International). The most notable upgrade was the revised chassis setup. Handling and stability were enhanced through STI’s proprietary Flexible V-Bar and Flexible Draw Stiffener components, while custom-developed suspension parts boosted overall agility.
long.zh: BRZ STI Sport于2017年推出，是BRZ车系中的顶配车型。这款车型由Subaru与其赛车运动部门STI（Subaru Tecnica International）联合开发。最显著的改进是车身结构的调整。通过采用STI专有的弹性V型杆和弹性拉力加强杆部件，操控响应速度和稳定性得到显著提升，同时特别开发的悬挂部件进一步增强了车辆的灵活性。

vehicleCollection.zh:
STI为BRZ开发的最高级别车型，进行了大量的底盘性能和外观改进。

BRZ STI Sport于2017年推出，是BRZ车系中的顶配车型。这款车型由Subaru与其赛车运动部门STI（Subaru Tecnica International）联合开发。最显著的改进是车身结构的调整。通过采用STI专有的弹性V型杆和弹性拉力加强杆部件，操控响应速度和稳定性得到显著提升，同时特别开发的悬挂部件进一步增强了车辆的灵活性。

usedCar.en:
Any fan of WRC racing in the 1990s has the Impreza 22B on
their list of must-buy cars.

This replica model is based on the Impreza that enjoyed such
great success during the golden age of rally.

Its price upon release was roughly twice that of the
Impreza WRX...

But the 400 units produced still sold out in an instant!

This variant sports more than just updated looks—
the engine is a custom 2.2L.

Capable of generating more torque than the 2L turbo, it
promises solid acceleration and satisfying speed.
usedCar.zh:
20世纪90年代世界拉力锦标赛的所有粉丝
都会把Impreza 22B列入他们的必买汽车清单。

翼豹在拉力赛的黄金时代取得了巨大的成
功，而这款车型正是它的复刻版。

它在发售时的价格几乎是Impreza WRX的两倍...

但当时生产的400台还是瞬间就被抢购一空！

这个版本的特别之处不仅在于外观上的
升级，还有专属定制的2.2L引擎。

它能够产生比2L涡轮增压引擎更大的
扭矩，保证了扎实的加速性能和令人满意的速度。

catch.en: Essentially a road-going version of Subaru's WRC car, this car’s production was limited to only 400 units (and sold out immediately).
catch.zh: 拥有与WR赛车完全相同外观的Impreza，限量400台。刚一上市就被抢购一空。

vehicleCollection.en:
Essentially a road-going version of Subaru's WRC car, this car’s production was limited to only 400 units (and sold out immediately).

This limited-edition model, based on the Impreza WRX STi Version IV, featured wide blister fenders identical to those of the World Rally car and was powered by a 2.2-liter boxer engine producing 276.1 HP and 267.6 ft-lb of torque. Despite its five million yen price tag, all 400 units sold out within days, securing its status as one of the most coveted models among Subaru enthusiasts.

long.en: This limited-edition model, based on the Impreza WRX STi Version IV, featured wide blister fenders identical to those of the World Rally car and was powered by a 2.2-liter boxer engine producing 276.1 HP and 267.6 ft-lb of torque. Despite its five million yen price tag, all 400 units sold out within days, securing its status as one of the most coveted models among Subaru enthusiasts.
long.zh: 这是一款基于Impreza WRX STi Version IV打造的限量版车型。其车身上安装了与世界拉力锦标赛赛车同款的鼓起式挡泥板，并由一部能够输出280 PS/37.0 公斤力米的2.2升水平对置引擎提供动力。尽管定价高达500万日元，但限量生产的400台在几天内就销售一空，使其成为了全球车迷最趋之若鹜的车型之一。

cars.nameEn: Subaru Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
cars.nameZh: Subaru Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99

usedCar.en:
This first-generation Impreza Type R STi Version Vi is known
among Subaru fans as the "ultimate GC8."

GC8 was the in-house name of the first-gen Impreza, with
the "C" representing the chassis code.

The Type R STi is special because it possesses way more rigidity
than the base model, thanks partly to its coupe design.

The accessories are also simple and effective, making
the car look rally-race ready.

Because of its compact nature, its all-wheel-drive system and
remarkable agility, this machine shines on tight circuits!
usedCar.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
usedCar.zh:
初代Impreza也被称作GC8。
C是底盘代号。

有许多人将Type R STi Version VI
称为“终极GC8”。

这个称号的由来之一便是双门车体
所带来的刚性提升。

该车的内饰相当简洁，非常符合
赛车的定位。

Impreza特别适合狭窄的赛道——没有其他车比它更适合用来
感受曲折道路的刺激魅力！

catch.en: After six years of evolution, this car represented the final form of the GC8 Impreza coupe.
catch.zh: 经过6年的发展，这款基于GC8平台的Impreza双门轿车终于问世。

vehicleCollection.en:
After six years of evolution, this car represented the final form of the GC8 Impreza coupe.

Released in September 1999, this was the coupe version of the Impreza Version VI. In addition to its rally-inspired styling, it came equipped with the Driver’s Control Center Differential (DCCD), an intercooler water sprayer, specially tuned stiff suspension, and a reinforced rear axle—all as standard. Its iconic EJ20 engine was tuned to deliver 276.1 HP, making this one of the most complete and refined GC8 models ever produced.

long.en: Released in September 1999, this was the coupe version of the Impreza Version VI. In addition to its rally-inspired styling, it came equipped with the Driver’s Control Center Differential (DCCD), an intercooler water sprayer, specially tuned stiff suspension, and a reinforced rear axle—all as standard. Its iconic EJ20 engine was tuned to deliver 276.1 HP, making this one of the most complete and refined GC8 models ever produced.
long.zh: 这是1999年9月发布的Impreza Version VI的双门轿跑版本。除了拉力赛车风格的外观设计，还标配驾驶员可控中央差速器、中间冷却器喷水系统、专业调校的运动悬挂以及强化后轴。经典的EJ20引擎经过精心调校，最大功率达到280 PS，成就了这台完美的GC8车型。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
vehicleCollection.zh:
经过6年的发展，这款基于GC8平台的Impreza双门轿车终于问世。

collection.en:
The World Rally Championship represents the pinnacle
of rally racing.

It was on this international stage where Subaru became the
first Japanese automaker...

...to accomplish the great feat of winning three successive
manufacturers' titles, from 1995 to 1997.

The car that was responsible for the "three-peat"
was the Subaru Impreza WRC.

The Impreza WRC came bathed in the blue livery of
the Subaru works team.

It combined a turbocharged boxer engine with an advanced
all-wheel dive system.

This machine won many rally competitions, including the
Rallye Monte Carlo.

After the announcement of new world rally-car regulations
in 1997...

...the Impreza WRC went to battle as a 2-door coupe with
unique blister fenders bothat front and rear.

Its refreshed appearance strongly resembled the orinal
Impreza B STi

From behind the wheel of the new-look Impreza WRC...

...driver Colin MRae climd thee vicoris foheSbaru rally tam in 1998.

vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's triple race winning Impreza World Rally car from the 1998 season.

This WRC machine was based on the 2-door Impreza. Beginning with the 1997 model, this evolution introduced computer-controlled active differentials at the front, rear, and center. Although it didn’t secure Subaru a fourth consecutive constructors’ title, Colin McRae’s wins in Portugal, the Tour de Corse, and the Acropolis rallies proved its formidable potential.

long.en: This WRC machine was based on the 2-door Impreza. Beginning with the 1997 model, this evolution introduced computer-controlled active differentials at the front, rear, and center. Although it didn’t secure Subaru a fourth consecutive constructors’ title, Colin McRae’s wins in Portugal, the Tour de Corse, and the Acropolis rallies proved its formidable potential.
long.zh: 这台世界拉力锦标赛战车以双门Impreza为基础开发。自1997年款开始，这一进化版本新增了前、后、中央三组电脑控制的主动差速器系统。虽然未能帮助Subaru蝉联第四个制造商冠军，但车手科林·麦克雷在葡萄牙拉力赛、科西嘉岛拉力赛和希腊卫城拉力赛中夺冠，充分证明了这台赛车的实力。

conversation.en:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.

The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more
evident than in this 2004 model.

Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.

This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
这是一台二代Subaru Impreza STi。

在日本，Impreza STi和Mitsubishi Lancer Evo是
一对有名的宿敌。

第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。

注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。

此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。

毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的Impreza！
F

!

conversation.en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...

...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.

But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.

And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.

It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.

With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.

If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...

...then this second-generation model, with its can, understate
cabi and simpler window design, may be just right for you.
~
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。

有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”

相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……

那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备`角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。

有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”

相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……

那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备`角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

brandCentral.en:
This is the 2nd-gen model of the Subaru Impreza WRX series.

Like its predecessor, it was a World Rally Championship star.

Specifically, it was the last Impreza to win a world title
at the WRC—a legacy that's talked about to this day.

The production model received extensive upgrades,
including a major facelift.

The 2004 model was faster and stronger by leaps and bounds.

Engine-wise, not only was max. torque give a <2kgm> upgrade,
but the mid-range response was significantly improved.

Paired with rigid and ground-hugging chassis, this car is
incredibly fun to drive on any course.
brandCentral.zh:
这是Subaru Impreza WRX车族中的第二代型号。

和其前代车型一样，它也是世界拉力锦标赛上的明星。

尤其值得一提的是，它是最后一款在世界拉力锦标赛上赢得
世界冠军的Impreza。这个荣誉直到今天依然被人们津津乐道。

其量产车型经过了大量的升级，包括外观方面的大量修改。

这辆2004款车型在速度和性能方面有了突飞猛进的发展。

在引擎方面，它的最大扭矩不仅提升了<2kgm>，
中转速下的响应速度也得到了大幅优化。

再搭配上坚固且贴合地面的底盘，让它能在任何赛道上
都能提供无与伦比的驾驶体验。

usedCar.en:
The Subaru Impreza is a legendary Japanese car that made its name
at the World Rally Championship, the pinnacle of rally racing.

Defined by its compact body, a mighty turbo engine and4WD system,
it never failed to impress on every kind of terrain.

The road-going Impreza WRX STi is admired by sports-car
enthusiasts from all over the world.

This model is the second-generation WRX STi that came equipped
with a powerful 2.0-liter powerplant.

This 2004 model saw its engine receive further upgrades, along
with a new suspension and wider tires.

It was the first Impreza to run the Nürburgring’s old track in
less than eight minutes!
usedCar.zh:
Subaru Impreza是一辆在拉力赛领域巅峰赛事——
世界拉力锦标赛上闯出名号的传奇日本赛车。

这款车型采用紧凑型车身设计，装备有强大的涡轮增压引擎，
并配备四轮驱动系统，在速度方面的表现从不会令人失望！

而其公路车型Impreza WRX STi受到了
来自全世界跑车爱好者的倾慕。

这里的这一辆车是第二代WRX STi，2升排量级别，
拥有当时最强大的引擎之一。

而到了2004款车型上，引擎获得了进一步的升级，
此外还采用了全新的悬挂和宽胎。

它是第一款在纽博格林赛道旧布局上跑进八分钟的Impreza！

catch.en: The second-generation Impreza was developed alongside the rally spec model.
catch.zh: 第二代Impreza，与拉力赛规格车型同时开发。

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-generation Impreza was developed alongside the rally spec model.

The first facelift of the GD-generation Impreza was marked by its distinctive teardrop-shaped “blob eye” headlights. Engine efficiency was improved with the adoption of equal-length, matched exhaust headers. Also, some manual variants featured a Driver's Control Center Differential with an automatic mode. A minor update in 2004 brought larger tires and boosted torque output to 303.8 ft-lb.

long.en: The first facelift of the GD-generation Impreza was marked by its distinctive teardrop-shaped “blob eye” headlights. Engine efficiency was improved with the adoption of equal-length, matched exhaust headers. Also, some manual variants featured a Driver's Control Center Differential with an automatic mode. A minor update in 2004 brought larger tires and boosted torque output to 303.8 ft-lb.
long.zh: GD Impreza首次改款最显著的特征是采用了泪滴造型的“泡泡眼”前大灯。采用等长排气歧管设计，有效提升了引擎工作效率。部分手动挡车型还配备了具有自动模式的驾驶员可控中央差速器。2004年的小幅改款进一步增大了轮胎规格，同时将最大扭矩提升至42.0 公斤力米。

vehicleCollection.zh:
第二代Impreza，与拉力赛规格车型同时开发。

GD Impreza首次改款最显著的特征是采用了泪滴造型的“泡泡眼”前大灯。采用等长排气歧管设计，有效提升了引擎工作效率。部分手动挡车型还配备了具有自动模式的驾驶员可控中央差速器。2004年的小幅改款进一步增大了轮胎规格，同时将最大扭矩提升至42.0 公斤力米。

brandCentral.en:
This is a Gr.3 racing car based on the WRX STI, and has been
created exclusively for Gran Turismo.

The chassis has been cut down to reduce frontal profile,
making it incredibly low to the ground for a sedan.

Also, the underbody has been aerodynamically optimised,
providing even more downforce than a coupé body.

The drivetrain has been converted to FR.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆基于WRX STI改装而来的组别3赛车，专为跑车浪漫
旅所打造。

其车身高度进行了削减，进而缩小了前剖面面积，成为
了一款底盘极低的轿车。

车身底板方面的空气动力学优化则带来比双门车身更
强的下压力。

传动系统也被更换为前置后驱。

catch.en: The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.
catch.zh: 源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.3 racing regulations. To reduce the frontal cross-sectional area, the lower chassis has been trimmed and the overall ride height lowered as much as possible. Equipped with a diffuser-style front splitter and a two-level rear wing, this 4-door sedan generates more downforce than many coupes.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.3 racing regulations. To reduce the frontal cross-sectional area, the lower chassis has been trimmed and the overall ride height lowered as much as possible. Equipped with a diffuser-style front splitter and a two-level rear wing, this 4-door sedan generates more downforce than many coupes.
long.zh: 这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.3组别规则进行改装的版本。为了缩减车身正面的横截面积，设计师减小了它的底盘下部，并尽可能地降低了车身高度。在扩散器样式前定风翼和二段式尾翼的加持下，这款4门轿车能够产生远超双门轿跑的下压力。

vehicleCollection.zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.3组别规则进行改装的版本。为了缩减车身正面的横截面积，设计师减小了它的底盘下部，并尽可能地降低了车身高度。在扩散器样式前定风翼和二段式尾翼的加持下，这款4门轿车能够产生远超双门轿跑的下压力。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original was based on the WRX STI.

The powerful traction provided by its 4WD contributes to its
stable handling when cornering.

The custom front splitter and rear wing work to notably
increase the car's downforce.
brandCentral.zh:
这台原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于WRX STI打造。

四轮驱动系统可以提供强大的牵引力，在过弯时实现稳
定的操控。

定制的前定风翼和尾翼进一步增加了车辆的下压力。

catch.en: The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.
catch.zh: 源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.4 racing regulations. A front splitter and rear wing have been added to generate additional downforce. The base car’s 4-wheel-drive system is retained, giving it class-leading traction among the Gr.4 field.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.4 racing regulations. A front splitter and rear wing have been added to generate additional downforce. The base car’s 4-wheel-drive system is retained, giving it class-leading traction among the Gr.4 field.
long.zh: 这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和优化弯道性能，它加装了前定风翼和尾翼。此外它还沿用了基础车型的四轮驱动系统，在所有Gr.4车型中拥有最优秀的牵引力。

vehicleCollection.zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和优化弯道性能，它加装了前定风翼和尾翼。此外它还沿用了基础车型的四轮驱动系统，在所有Gr.4车型中拥有最优秀的牵引力。

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.B rally car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on
the WRX STI.

Thanks to its exploitation of all the latest trends in
rally racing, the downforce is second to none.

It's been adapted for super wide wheel treads, and has
a suspension specifically tuned for dirt driving.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于WRX STI开发。

它应用了拉力赛领域的诸多最新科技趋势，拥有首屈一
指的下压力。

为了应对拉力赛，它改用超宽轮距，并安装了一套专为
泥地驾驶调校过的悬挂系统。!

catch.en: The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.
catch.zh: 源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to comply with Gr.B regulations. To enhance downforce and agility, the car’s track width has been significantly widened, while long-stroke suspension was fitted to improve off-road capability. The result is a cutting-edge rally machine.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to comply with Gr.B regulations. To enhance downforce and agility, the car’s track width has been significantly widened, while long-stroke suspension was fitted to improve off-road capability. The result is a cutting-edge rally machine.
long.zh: 这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和机动性，其轮距得到了大幅拓宽，另外还为了优化越野性能而安装了长行程悬挂，使它成为了一款拥有顶尖水平的拉力赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和机动性，其轮距得到了大幅拓宽，另外还为了优化越野性能而安装了长行程悬挂，使它成为了一款拥有顶尖水平的拉力赛车。

brandCentral.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Subaru WRX Gr.B.

The chassis is taken wholesale from the Gr.B rally version.

However, the aerodynamic parts show that on-road performance
was also a consideration.

In fact, the side panels and rear diffuser make road racing
almost seem like the focus here.
brandCentral.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
Subaru WRX Gr.B级别赛车。

Gr.B拉力赛车的底盘被全盘照搬了过来，

而新加入的空气动力学部件则体现出对公路驾驶
性能方面的思考。

事实上，从侧面板材和后扩散器的设计不难看出，其设计
重点更多放在公路赛事上。

catch.en: This road-going version of the WRX Gr.B was modified to excel on the tarmac.
catch.zh: WRX Gr.B的公路车版本，专为在柏油公路上实现顶级性能而改装。

vehicleCollection.en:
This road-going version of the WRX Gr.B was modified to excel on the tarmac.

This is the homologation model of the WRX Gr.B, a variant of Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan engineered to meet Gr.B regulations. Although rooted in rally car design, greater emphasis has been placed on on-road performance, with the addition of a race-inspired front splitter, side skirt winglets, and a rear diffuser.

long.en: This is the homologation model of the WRX Gr.B, a variant of Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan engineered to meet Gr.B regulations. Although rooted in rally car design, greater emphasis has been placed on on-road performance, with the addition of a race-inspired front splitter, side skirt winglets, and a rear diffuser.
long.zh: WRX Gr.B是对Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本，这辆车是它的赛事认证车型。虽然原型车是一台拉力赛车，开发团队却将更多工作重心放在了铺装路面驾驶性能上，添加了赛车风格的前定风翼、侧裙小翼和后扩散器。

vehicleCollection.zh:
WRX Gr.B的公路车版本，专为在柏油公路上实现顶级性能而改装。

WRX Gr.B是对Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本，这辆车是它的赛事认证车型。虽然原型车是一台拉力赛车，开发团队却将更多工作重心放在了铺装路面驾驶性能上，添加了赛车风格的前定风翼、侧裙小翼和后扩散器。

cars.nameEn: Subaru WRX STI Isle of Man Time Attack Car '16
cars.nameZh: Subaru WRX STI Isle of Man Time Attack Car '16

brandCentral.en:
The <60.8km> Isle of Man TT course is renowned for being
an unforgiving and often downright dangerous challenge.

But did you know there's a car-based time trial that takes
place on the very same track?

Subaru America's time attackers have been trying to break
records in cars like the one you see here since 2011.

This WRX's 2L flat-four turbocharged engine has been
expertly tuned to provide <600ps> of pure power.

STI provided the technical support to enable this, with pro
drivers designing and building the cars themselves.

This is the same winning combination that ushered in the
golden era of Subaru WRC dominance.
brandCentral.zh:
全长<60.8km>的马恩岛TT赛道以高难度而著称，甚至可以称得
上是生死挑战。

但是您知道这条赛道上还一直举行着一项四轮汽车的计
时赛吗？

自2011年起，Subaru America的计时赛挑战者们就一直想要用你眼前
的这台车打破纪录。

这辆WRX体内的2L水平对置四缸涡轮增压引擎经过专业人
士调校，可以输出<600ps>的纯粹马力。

如此强大的动力全靠STI的技术支持才得以实现，甚至有
多位专业车手也参与到了这款赛车的设计和制造中。

正是这样的技术合作阵容帮助Subaru开启了在世界拉力锦标
赛上的霸主时代。/

catch.en: This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.
catch.zh: 这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.

In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles during a time attack on the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy course. While Subaru had been competing in the event since 2011, the 2016 machine was specially prepared by Britain’s Prodrive, a team renowned for its multiple World Rally Championship titles. Thanks to their expertise, the record was lowered by nearly two minutes, with a final time of 17:35.139 and an average speed of 128.6 mph.

long.en: In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles during a time attack on the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy course. While Subaru had been competing in the event since 2011, the 2016 machine was specially prepared by Britain’s Prodrive, a team renowned for its multiple World Rally Championship titles. Thanks to their expertise, the record was lowered by nearly two minutes, with a final time of 17:35.139 and an average speed of 128.6 mph.
long.zh: 2016年6月，一辆Subaru WRX STI在马恩岛旅行者杯大奖赛的计时赛中为四轮汽车创下新纪录。WRX STI自2011年起就参加这项赛事，2016年的冠军赛车由英国Prodrive打造，该公司曾多次夺得世界拉力锦标赛冠军。因此，他们成功将纪录缩短近2分钟至17:35.139，平均时速更是达到207 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

2016年6月，一辆Subaru WRX STI在马恩岛旅行者杯大奖赛的计时赛中为四轮汽车创下新纪录。WRX STI自2011年起就参加这项赛事，2016年的冠军赛车由英国Prodrive打造，该公司曾多次夺得世界拉力锦标赛冠军。因此，他们成功将纪录缩短近2分钟至17:35.139，平均时速更是达到207 公里/小时。

brandCentral.en:
The WRX STI is the pinnacle of the highly popular
Impreza WRX line.

Introduced in 2014, it is equipped with a turbocharged
variant of Subaru's legendary EJ20 boxer engine.

It's mated to an improved 6-speed manual gearbox
with short throws.

Like previous models, this one features all-wheel drive.

The WRX STI was designed to go fast on a variety
of different driving surfaces.[
brandCentral.zh:
WRX STI是经久不衰的翼豹WRX系列的最新作。

这款车型于2014年推出，采用斯巴鲁传奇的EJ20跑车引擎的涡轮
增压版本，

还配备了改进后的六速手动变速箱。

和前几代的车型一样，全时四轮驱动也是标配。

强大的引擎与富有韧性的车架搭配，构成了一个美妙的
组合。

catch.en: The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.
catch.zh: 源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

Introduced in the autumn of 2013, the Subaru WRX compact sedan emerged as a standalone model, separating itself from the Impreza lineup. Built on a platform closely related to that of the Levorg, the WRX featured significant structural reinforcements. The high-performance STI edition took things further, offering enhanced dynamics with newly developed suspension and a refined version of the EJ20 engine, delivering 303.7 HP and 311.0 ft-lb of torque.

long.en: Introduced in the autumn of 2013, the Subaru WRX compact sedan emerged as a standalone model, separating itself from the Impreza lineup. Built on a platform closely related to that of the Levorg, the WRX featured significant structural reinforcements. The high-performance STI edition took things further, offering enhanced dynamics with newly developed suspension and a refined version of the EJ20 engine, delivering 303.7 HP and 311.0 ft-lb of torque.
long.zh: 2013年秋季公布的Subaru WRX从Impreza产品线中独立出来，是一款中档轿车。WRX基于与Levorg几乎一模一样的平台打造，但进行了大范围的强化。其高功率版本STI拥有更强大的性能，采用了全新开发的悬挂和EJ20引擎的改进版本，能够输出308 PS/43.0 公斤力米。

vehicleCollection.zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

2013年秋季公布的Subaru WRX从Impreza产品线中独立出来，是一款中档轿车。WRX基于与Levorg几乎一模一样的平台打造，但进行了大范围的强化。其高功率版本STI拥有更强大的性能，采用了全新开发的悬挂和EJ20引擎的改进版本，能够输出308 PS/43.0 公斤力米。

conversation.en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!

When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!

usedCar.en:
Despite belonging to Japan's kei-car class, the Suzuki
Cappuccino is a genuine sports car.

It's a lightweight vehicle with a compact body and an
FR layout.

The engine is a highly efficient and reliable turbocharged
inline-3 with <657cc> of displacement.

Although it only produces <64ps>, the Cappuccino's weight
of <700kg> means it possesses decent acceleration.

The chassis was also specially developed, so the front/rear
weight distribution is ideally balanced.

The car's 'tossable' nature makes it a delight to drive,
even for hardcore enthusiasts!
usedCar.zh:
虽然是日本轻型车中的一款，Suzuki Cappuccino
仍是一辆货真价实的跑车。

这是一辆采用前置后驱布局的轻型车辆。

它搭载了一台排量为<657cc>的直列三缸涡轮增压引擎，
秉承了Suzuki一贯的可靠性。

尽管它只能输出<64ps>，但它<700kg>的重量
意味着这辆车拥有不错的加速性能。

此车的底盘也是专门开发的，
所以前后的重量分配绝对均衡。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比，非常好开！

catch.en: The rear-drive Cappuccino roadster kickstarted the two-seat kei-car trend.
catch.zh: 前置引擎、后轮驱动的敞篷小车，在日本掀起了双座轻型车的潮流。

vehicleCollection.en:
The rear-drive Cappuccino roadster kickstarted the two-seat kei-car trend.

The Cappuccino was Suzuki’s entry into the kei-class sports car segment, launched in November 1991. Alongside the Honda Beat and Mazda’s Autozam AZ-1, it helped define the two-seater kei sports car boom of the era. It featured a long-nose, two-seat convertible body paired with a front-mounted engine producing 63.1 HP—the maximum output allowed under kei-car regulations. With a near-perfect 51:49 front-to-rear weight distribution, the Cappuccino left no doubt that it was a true rear-wheel-drive sports car.

long.en: The Cappuccino was Suzuki’s entry into the kei-class sports car segment, launched in November 1991. Alongside the Honda Beat and Mazda’s Autozam AZ-1, it helped define the two-seater kei sports car boom of the era. It featured a long-nose, two-seat convertible body paired with a front-mounted engine producing 63.1 HP—the maximum output allowed under kei-car regulations. With a near-perfect 51:49 front-to-rear weight distribution, the Cappuccino left no doubt that it was a true rear-wheel-drive sports car.
long.zh: Cappuccino是Suzuki在1991年11月推出的轻型运动跑车。与Honda Beat、Mazda Autozam AZ-1一起掀起了当时的双座轻型跑车热潮。Cappuccino采用长车头双座敞篷车身，搭载的前置式64 PS引擎是轻型汽车法规下的最强规格。51:49的前后重量分配比印证了其纯正后驱跑车的血统。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
Japan’s 'kei cars' are a special class of miniature cars
that pack a lot of power into a rather small package.

Not only does the category include SUVs and sports cars,
but it even boasts 'kei trucks', including the Suzuki Carry.

Although the series dates back more than 60 years, this is
the 2012 model, belonging to the 10th-generation from '99.

Despite measuring <3.4m> in length, this truck can lift,
and its <658cc> engine is torquey even with a full load.

These days, used Carrys are making their way overseas,
a sign that the world is catching on to the kei car’s charm.
brandCentral.zh:
日本的“轻型车”指的是将充沛的动力塞进小车身
的一种微型汽车特殊类型。

这个类别下不仅囊括了SUV和跑车车型，甚至还
包含了“轻型卡车”，正如这辆Suzuki Carry。

这个系列已经拥有超过60年的历史，而这一辆是最新的
2012款，属于1999年推出的第十代车型。

尽管车身长度仅有<3.4m>，但它的运输能力毫不逊色，它的
大扭矩<658cc>引擎在满载情况下依旧性能卓越。

如今，二手Carry已经在海外市场流行开，标志着
全世界都开始领会到日式轻型车的魅力。

catch.en: A quintessential example of the micro-truck trend that has become a hit all over the world.
catch.zh: 这款车是席卷整个世界的“微型卡车”风潮中的典范。

vehicleCollection.en:
A quintessential example of the micro-truck trend that has become a hit all over the world.

Japan’s micro-car segment, known locally as kei-cars, has become an indispensable part of everyday life throughout the country. The Suzuki Carry compact truck is a classic example of the commercial kei-car segment, which includes a wide range of cargo vans and mini trucks. Introduced in 1961, the Carry has built a long-standing reputation. The model shown here is the 2012 version, the final evolution of the 10th generation. With its endearing styling and everyday practicality, the Carry has begun to attract attention from enthusiasts and users overseas as well.

long.en: Japan’s micro-car segment, known locally as kei-cars, has become an indispensable part of everyday life throughout the country. The Suzuki Carry compact truck is a classic example of the commercial kei-car segment, which includes a wide range of cargo vans and mini trucks. Introduced in 1961, the Carry has built a long-standing reputation. The model shown here is the 2012 version, the final evolution of the 10th generation. With its endearing styling and everyday practicality, the Carry has begun to attract attention from enthusiasts and users overseas as well.
long.zh: 日本的微型车市场在其国内被称为轻型车，已成为该国民众日常生活不可或缺的一部分。Suzuki Carry小型卡车是商用轻型车的典型代表，这一细分市场涵盖了各种货车和卡车。Carry拥有悠久的历史，最初于1961年问世。此处展示的是2012款车型，也就是第十代的最终版本。凭借其迷人的外观和出色的实用性，Carry近年来在海外市场也赢得了众多拥趸。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款车是席卷整个世界的“微型卡车”风潮中的典范。

brandCentral.en:
The Suzuki Jimny is best known as Japan’s kei-car
off-roader par excellence.

The Jimny that broke the kei-car mold was the Sierra,
designed for the global market.

This Jimny Sierra is the third-gen model, known as the JB74.
Its rugged-yet-boxy stance is quite attractive, wouldn’t you say?

While the original Jimny had a mere <660cc> displacement,
the Sierra possessed a 1.5-liter engine capable of <102ps>.

Thanks to its part-time 4WD system and rigid suspension
in the front and rear, the Sierra offers sublime handling.

The JC grade refers to a Japanese trim that includes LED
headlamps and alloy wheels as standard fare."
brandCentral.zh:
Suzuki Jimny作为日本轻型车中的越野典范而闻名。

在产品线中，突破轻型车界限的是为全球市场
打造的“Sierra”车型。

这款第三代Jimny Sierra型号为“JB74”。
它那棱角分明的硬朗外形极具吸引力，你说是吗？

相比原版Jimny仅有<660cc>的排量，Sierra搭载了
一台可输出<102ps>的1.5升引擎。

凭借分时四轮驱动系统和前后刚性悬挂的配置，
Sierra展现出卓越的操控性。

“JC”等级是其日本市场版本，标准配置包括LED前大灯
和铝合金轮圈。

catch.en: A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.
catch.zh: 面向全球市场的“更强壮”的Jimny。

vehicleCollection.en:
A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.

This 3-door model of the Jimny was lengthened and widened to better suit international markets. Now mated to a 1460 cc DOHC inline-4, the part-time 4WD system with a mechanical transfer case delivers uncompromising off-road performance. The third-generation JB74, counting from the original Sierra, earned widespread acclaim for its boxy, elongated design.

long.en: This 3-door model of the Jimny was lengthened and widened to better suit international markets. Now mated to a 1460 cc DOHC inline-4, the part-time 4WD system with a mechanical transfer case delivers uncompromising off-road performance. The third-generation JB74, counting from the original Sierra, earned widespread acclaim for its boxy, elongated design.
long.zh: 这款3门版Jimny经过车身加长加宽处理，以更好地适应国际市场需求。配备机械分动箱的分时四驱系统搭配1,460 立方厘米直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，成就了卓越的越野性能。这款第三代JB74车型（从最初的Sierra算起）凭借方正硬朗的拉长造型设计获得了广泛赞誉。

vehicleCollection.zh:
面向全球市场的“更强壮”的Jimny。

这款3门版Jimny经过车身加长加宽处理，以更好地适应国际市场需求。配备机械分动箱的分时四驱系统搭配1,460 立方厘米直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，成就了卓越的越野性能。这款第三代JB74车型（从最初的Sierra算起）凭借方正硬朗的拉长造型设计获得了广泛赞誉。

brandCentral.en:
While the Suzuki Jimny may belong to the kei-car class,
it's still a rugged and capable 4x4 vehicle.

Small yet strong, it combines urban agility
with world-class off-road performance.

Don’t let its compact size fool you—this car
can hit serious speeds.

Equipped with physicality and functionality,
it excels on rocks, sand and even snow.

Introduced in 1970, it was the first kei-car to
boast a genuine 4-wheel-drive system.

And, for more than 50 years, it has built its success
on tradition and change.
brandCentral.zh:
尽管Suzuki Jimny属于日式轻型车类型，
但同样也是一款粗犷的4x4越野车。

它同时具备轻量和坚固的特点，综合了
都市通勤车的便利性和世界级的越野性能。

不要被它的紧凑型规格蒙蔽了，
它可以达到非常惊人的极速。

它兼顾韧性和功能性，即便在最崎岖的
地形上也能表现出色。

这款车于1970年首次亮相，是第一款真正采用
四轮驱动系统的日式轻型车……

而在50年多的发展历史里，它也在坚守传统
和不断求变中书写了无数的成功故事。

catch.en: Japan's mighty micro off-roader boasts amazing all-terrain ability beyond its size.
catch.zh: 超越其规格的惊人全地形能力。日本最强大的微型越野车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Japan's mighty micro off-roader boasts amazing all-terrain ability beyond its size.

This was Japan’s premier micro off-roader. Since its debut in the 1970s, the Jimny consistently adhered to kei-car regulations, featuring a ladder frame chassis, 4-wheel drive with rigid axle suspension, and large-diameter tires. In 2018, the boxy fourth-generation model was introduced, maintaining its rugged charm while gaining popularity both as a leisure vehicle and as a reliable workhorse in Japan’s mountainous regions.

long.en: This was Japan’s premier micro off-roader. Since its debut in the 1970s, the Jimny consistently adhered to kei-car regulations, featuring a ladder frame chassis, 4-wheel drive with rigid axle suspension, and large-diameter tires. In 2018, the boxy fourth-generation model was introduced, maintaining its rugged charm while gaining popularity both as a leisure vehicle and as a reliable workhorse in Japan’s mountainous regions.
long.zh: 日本微型越野车的代表。自1970年代首次亮相以来，Jimny始终采用符合轻型车规格的边梁式底盘结构，配备四驱硬轴非独立悬挂和大尺寸轮胎。2018年推出的第四代方形车身设计，不仅成为热门的休闲越野车，更在山区地带发挥着实用工具车的作用。

vehicleCollection.zh:
超越其规格的惊人全地形能力。日本最强大的微型越野车。

日本微型越野车的代表。自1970年代首次亮相以来，Jimny始终采用符合轻型车规格的边梁式底盘结构，配备四驱硬轴非独立悬挂和大尺寸轮胎。2018年推出的第四代方形车身设计，不仅成为热门的休闲越野车，更在山区地带发挥着实用工具车的作用。

conversation.en: Are you the owner of this car?
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh: 这辆车是你的吗？

conversation.en:
Are you by chance Mr. Hideo Kodama, the designer who had a
hand in many famous cars from the German company Opel?
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
您不会是儿玉英雄吧，
曾经参与设计过德国Opel公司的诸多名车的那位设计师？
P

conversation.en: Yes, I am! It's a pleasure to meet you both.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh: 是我！很高兴见到你们。

conversation.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honour
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic vintage
car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
U

conversation.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.

The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.

If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。

这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。

如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。

conversation.en:
Thank you for that insightful piece of history!
h
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
感谢您给我们分享了这么有趣的故事！
"

conversation.en:
My pleasure! I hope we can discuss car design
again sometime.
U
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
我很荣幸！希望以后还可以有机会
交流汽车设计。

conversation.en:
...Th-This car!
Is it yours!?
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这这这……这辆车！！
这车是你的？！
!

conversation.en:
Ah, Jeremy! Nothing gets past you, does it?

Jeremy loves nothing more than geeking out about racing.
P
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
是杰里米啊！真是什么好车都逃不出你的法眼啊！

杰里米就是喜欢赛车，他是名副其实的赛车死忠粉！

conversation.en:
Oh man, I mean, I can't help myself when there's
a car like this sitting right in front of me!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
哎呀，我是说，我一见到这样不得了的车，
就控制不住自己！

conversation.en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!

Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.

In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!

Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...

The great potential of this machine.

Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.

Speking of Tajima-san...

His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.

Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
4
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是第二代的Swift Sport啊！

因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。

事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！

Suzuki用两个冠军头衔证明了……

这辆车的巨大潜能。

这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田嶋伸博创办的日本公司。

说起田嶋先生……

他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。

在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于Suzuki Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。

这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。

如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。

brandCentral.en:
This is the Swift Sport, an iconic Japanese FF hot hatch...

With lots of admirers in the rally scene, thanks to its
performances at the Junior World Rally Championship.

Wondering what's under the bonnet? Why, it's a 1.6L
naturally aspirated engine!

Featuring variable valve timing technology,
forged pistons...

And a close-ratio 5-speed manual transmission, this sporty
number is the definition of circuit-ready!
brandCentral.zh:
这就是速翼特Sport，一款标志性的日本前置前驱高性能掀背车……

它在世界拉力锦标赛青年组上的表现为自己赢得了拉力
赛场上的众多崇拜者。

知道引擎盖下有什么吗？一台1.6升自然进气发动机！

此车采用可变气门正时技术、锻造活塞……

以及密齿轮比的5速手动变速箱，典型的赛事配置表明
此车随时做好了驶上赛道的准备！

usedCar.en:
If you're shopping around for a FF hot hatch, you'd be smart
to take a close look at the Swift Sport.

Its 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine transitions well to
high speeds, and its handling is as sharp as a katana.

This particular model marks a real evolution in chassis
construction, with more rigidity than ever before.

The year 2007 was a special one for the Swift because it made
a name for itself by winning the Junior World Rally Cup.
usedCar.zh:
如果你在找一辆前置前驱的高性能掀背车，
Swift Sport是个不错的选择。

它搭载的1.6L自然吸气引擎完全能应对高速行驶，
而它的操控性能更是无与伦比。

凭借其大幅提升的底盘刚性，这款车型标志了
Swift底盘制作工艺的进化。

这辆车也因在2007年世界青年拉力锦标赛中夺冠
而声名大噪。

catch.en: Suzuki's fun-to-drive Swift Sport was made even more lively with a high-revving engine and close-ratio gears.
catch.zh: 改良版Swift Sport，拥有密齿轮比和高转速引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
Suzuki's fun-to-drive Swift Sport was made even more lively with a high-revving engine and close-ratio gears.

The Suzuki Swift Sport was the performance-focused variant of the second-generation Swift. At its heart was a naturally-aspirated 1.6-liter engine, tuned for high-revs and equipped with forged pistons and variable valve timing. A minor update in 2007 raised the rev limit from 7000 rpm to 7500 rpm. Paired with a close-ratio 5-speed manual gearbox, it delivered an exhilarating driving experience.

long.en: The Suzuki Swift Sport was the performance-focused variant of the second-generation Swift. At its heart was a naturally-aspirated 1.6-liter engine, tuned for high-revs and equipped with forged pistons and variable valve timing. A minor update in 2007 raised the rev limit from 7000 rpm to 7500 rpm. Paired with a close-ratio 5-speed manual gearbox, it delivered an exhilarating driving experience.
long.zh: Suzuki Swift Sport是基于第二代Swift开发的一款跑车型号。它的自然进气1.6升引擎针对高转速进行过特别调校，还采用了锻造活塞和可变气门正时技术。2007年，它又得到了小幅加强，将转速上限从7000转提升到了7500转，外加一套密齿轮比5速手动变速箱，能够提供更令人愉悦的驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.zh:
改良版Swift Sport，拥有密齿轮比和高转速引擎。

Suzuki Swift Sport是基于第二代Swift开发的一款跑车型号。它的自然进气1.6升引擎针对高转速进行过特别调校，还采用了锻造活塞和可变气门正时技术。2007年，它又得到了小幅加强，将转速上限从7000转提升到了7500转，外加一套密齿轮比5速手动变速箱，能够提供更令人愉悦的驾驶体验。

conversation.en:
In the Japanese automobile world, performing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.

But it is carried out quite well here.

The way the windscreen blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.

This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.

What has noticeably changed is...

A more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.

However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。

不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。

它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。

新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。

最明显的改变在于……

更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。

这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。
.

brandCentral.en:
If you're looking for a small hatchback that's fun to drive,
then this fourth-generation Swift Sport is the car for you!

This model probably marked the biggest evolution in the
history of the line.

It weighs only <970kg>, but the turbo engine
is capable of delivering <20kgm> of torque.

The newly developed body is exceptionally stiff,
and its under-body aerodynamics are advanced.

The simple, responsive handling and the excellent power
delivery make this a great car to throw around corners.
brandCentral.zh:
如果你想要寻找一台充满驾驶乐趣的小型掀背车，这款
第四代Swift Sport就非常适合您！

这个型号见证了整个产品系列历史上最大的革新。

这台重量仅为<970kg>的小车却装备了一台涡轮增压引擎，可
以输出超过<20kgm>的扭矩。

全新设计的车身拥有极其出色的刚性，车身底盘的空气
动力学性能也有了巨大的飞跃。

简单而灵敏的操控性带来愉悦的驾驶体验，加速性能更
是不容小觑！

catch.en: Superb handling was just one of the fortes of this high-performance Japanese hatchback.
catch.zh: 这款纯粹的日系性能小钢炮展现出远超以往的操控性。

vehicleCollection.en:
Superb handling was just one of the fortes of this high-performance Japanese hatchback.

The Swift Sport was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift, launched in 2016. Its aerodynamic body concealed a downsized turbocharged 1.4-liter engine, specially tuned to run on high-octane fuel. The suspension received dedicated tuning to sharpen handling. Notably, this iteration was 154 lbs lighter than its predecessor, contributing to its agility and dynamic driving feel.

long.en: The Swift Sport was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift, launched in 2016. Its aerodynamic body concealed a downsized turbocharged 1.4-liter engine, specially tuned to run on high-octane fuel. The suspension received dedicated tuning to sharpen handling. Notably, this iteration was 154 lbs lighter than its predecessor, contributing to its agility and dynamic driving feel.
long.zh: Swift Sport是2016年推出的第4代Suzuki Swift运动版本。追求空动效应的流畅车身搭载经过调校的1.4升小排量涡轮增压引擎，采用高辛烷值燃料。悬挂系统也经过特别调校以提升操控性能。值得注意的是，这款车型比上一代Swift Sport减重70 公斤。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款纯粹的日系性能小钢炮展现出远超以往的操控性。

Swift Sport是2016年推出的第4代Suzuki Swift运动版本。追求空动效应的流畅车身搭载经过调校的1.4升小排量涡轮增压引擎，采用高辛烷值燃料。悬挂系统也经过特别调校以提升操控性能。值得注意的是，这款车型比上一代Swift Sport减重70 公斤。

cars.nameEn: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4
cars.nameZh: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4

brandCentral.en:
This is a Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car is based on
the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift Sport.

As you probably know, Suzuki is famous for producing motorcycles
as well as cars.

So it should come as no surprise that the look of the Swift Sport
KATANA Edition Gr.4 was inspired by the Katana sports bike.

The car was inspired by the Swift Sport KATANA Edition prototype,
which was shown at the Tokyo Auto Salon in 2020.

Its key features are the logo it shares with the Katana
motorcycle, and its bold and imposing wide fender.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于
第四代铃木速翼特Sport开发。

我想不需要我多介绍您也知道，
铃木是闻名遐迩的摩托车和汽车制造商。

这款速翼特Sport组别4的外观设计灵感也确实来自于
同公司的传奇摩托车“Katana”。

它的改装原型是在2020年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的
速翼特Sport Katana版，

拥有与Katana摩托车一模一样的标志，
以及粗犷霸气的挡泥板。

catch.en: A tuned up Gr. 4 version of the Swift Sport based on the 'KATANA Edition'.
catch.zh: 基于Swift Sport KATANA版调校的Gr.4级别赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A tuned up Gr. 4 version of the Swift Sport based on the 'KATANA Edition'.

This is the Gr.4 version of the KATANA Edition concept, a fusion of the ZC33 Swift Sport and the striking style and performance of the iconic KATANA sports bike. Enhancements include an extended front under spoiler and the addition of a GT-style rear wing, With staggered tire sizing, interior weight reduction, and the installation of a roll cage, the machine has been transformed into a true Gran Turismo Gr.4-spec race car.

long.en: This is the Gr.4 version of the KATANA Edition concept, a fusion of the ZC33 Swift Sport and the striking style and performance of the iconic KATANA sports bike. Enhancements include an extended front under spoiler and the addition of a GT-style rear wing, With staggered tire sizing, interior weight reduction, and the installation of a roll cage, the machine has been transformed into a true Gran Turismo Gr.4-spec race car.
long.zh: 这是“KATANA Edition”概念车型的Gr.4版本，融合了ZC33 Swift Sport与KATANA运动摩托车的美感和力量。前置底部扰流器经过延长设计，并新增GT风格尾翼。配合大尺寸轮胎、内饰轻量化和防滚架，这款车成功蜕变为Gran Turismo Gr.4规格赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
基于Swift Sport KATANA版调校的Gr.4级别赛车。

这是“KATANA Edition”概念车型的Gr.4版本，融合了ZC33 Swift Sport与KATANA运动摩托车的美感和力量。前置底部扰流器经过延长设计，并新增GT风格尾翼。配合大尺寸轮胎、内饰轻量化和防滚架，这款车成功蜕变为Gran Turismo Gr.4规格赛车。

Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb,
held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb,
a race with more than a century of history.

Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was
the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.

So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo wasa driver named
Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.

A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven
straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

the overall chapionship at Pikes Peak.

cars.nameEn: Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special '98
cars.nameZh: Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special '98

collection.en:
The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special took on
the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1996.

It won that year, catapulting Suzuki's image as a serious maker
of off-road machines.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race up a mountain
road to an elevation of over 4593 feet.

With a history dating back more than 100 years,
it is among the oldest motorsport events in the world.

The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special packed a 981 HP
2.5-liter V-6 in a body that only weighed <800kg>.

It was specially tuned to deliver peak performance
at altitudes that exceeded 13,123 feet.
collection.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
collection.zh:
凭借V6 ESCUDO Pikes Peak Special在
“云端比赛”中的出色表现，

这是一台专为参加科罗拉多州经典比赛派克峰
国际爬坡赛而制造的车。

参赛车辆要沿着海拔高度差为<1400m>的
山路上不断向上。

拥有100多年的历史，是世界上最古老的
赛车运动。

挑战这次赛事的V6 ESCUDO在仅重<800kg>的
车身中装入了一台<1000ps>的2.5升V6引擎，

并且经过特别调校，使其在海拔超过<4000m>的情况下，
性能损失降至最小。

catch.en: A monster made for the Pikes Peak Hillclimb.
catch.zh: 为传奇爬坡赛而生的怪兽车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A monster made for the Pikes Peak Hillclimb.

The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb is the world’s most renowned hill climb race, covering a demanding 12.4 miles course with an elevation gain of 4721.1 ft. To take on this extreme challenge, Suzuki developed the V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special—a purpose-built machine equipped with a mid-mounted twin-turbo 2.5-liter V-6 engine producing 981.3 HP. With its lightweight construction and advanced aerodynamics, Nobuhiro Tajima piloted the car to overall victory, becoming the first Japanese driver to win the prestigious event in 1995.

long.en: The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb is the world’s most renowned hill climb race, covering a demanding 12.4 miles course with an elevation gain of 4721.1 ft. To take on this extreme challenge, Suzuki developed the V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special—a purpose-built machine equipped with a mid-mounted twin-turbo 2.5-liter V-6 engine producing 981.3 HP. With its lightweight construction and advanced aerodynamics, Nobuhiro Tajima piloted the car to overall victory, becoming the first Japanese driver to win the prestigious event in 1995.
long.zh: 派克峰国际爬坡赛是全球最大的爬坡赛，赛程长达20 公里，高度变化达1,439 米。这辆搭载了中置式995 PS2.5升V6双涡轮引擎的Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special就是专为该项赛事而开发的。凭借轻量化的优势与卓越的空气动力学，田岛伸博在1995年取得日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
vehicleCollection.zh:
为传奇爬坡赛而生的怪兽车。

派克峰国际爬坡赛是全球最大的爬坡赛，赛程长达20 公里，高度变化达1,439 米。这辆搭载了中置式995 PS2.5升V6双涡轮引擎的Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special就是专为该项赛事而开发的。凭借轻量化的优势与卓越的空气动力学，田岛伸博在1995年取得日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

brandCentral.en:
This FR sports car carried on the tradition of the
venerable AE86 of the 1980s.

The naturally-aspirated horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder engine
was developed in collaboration with Subaru.

With the engine in the middle, and a low center of gravity,
its cornering is very solid indeed.

In 2015, the body was stiffened to further improve its cornering.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆典型的前置后驱跑车是在80年代声名鹊起的AE86的后
继者。

它的水平对置四缸自然进气发动机是与Subaru联合开发的。

这部引擎置于车身中部，有效降低了车身重心，以此获
得可靠的过弯性能。

在2015款车型上，车身刚性也进行了强化。_

catch.en: The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.
catch.zh: 新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。

vehicleCollection.en:
The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.

The Toyota 86 represents Toyota’s take on the compact, front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car co-developed with Subaru. Its front-mid-engine-mounted, naturally-aspirated 2.0-liter DOHC boxer engine produced 197.2 HP and 144.7 ft-lb of torque. Many components were freshly designed specifically for this model, resulting in precise, responsive handling that made the driver feel truly connected to the car. It was a next-generation lightweight sports car, created with driving enthusiasts at its core.

vehicleCollection.zh:
新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。
