brandCentral.en:
Nicknamed the Kouki ('late'), this edition appeared in 2016,
relatively late in the lifecycle of the Toyota 86.

It features improved power and torque, and the suspension
settings have undergone an overhaul.

Front and rear bumpers have also been heavily redesigned to
improve airflow.

Rigidity improvements were a key focus, too, particularly
at the rear of the vehicle.

Jump behind the wheel and you're sure to notice the
difference!
brandCentral.zh:
这款Toyata 86在2016年上市，由于已经进入产品周期的后期，
因此获得了“Kouki”的昵称。

它的动力和扭矩都得到了增强，整个悬挂配置也进行了
全面重置。

通过重新设计前后保险杠，增强了空气流动。

另外，车身刚性也是后期改款的重中之重，尤其是车身
后部。

当您握住它的方向盘时，就能感觉到个中差别了！

catch.en: The "classic" Toyota 86 sports car takes on a more mature character.
catch.zh: 和Subaru联合研发的前置后驱跑车，有着较低的重心和极佳的前后配重比。

vehicleCollection.en:
The "classic" Toyota 86 sports car takes on a more mature character.

Released in 2012, the Toyota 86 was a sports car that combined a compact body with a rear-wheel-drive layout. The first minor update came in 2016, enhancing body rigidity and aerodynamics. Models equipped with the 6-speed manual transmission received engine retuning along with upgrades to numerous components, placing greater emphasis on performance rather than appearance. The GT Limited trim represented the highest grade in the 86 lineup. Its interior featured upscale materials such as leather and Alcantara, offering a more premium and mature cabin environment.

long.en: Released in 2012, the Toyota 86 was a sports car that combined a compact body with a rear-wheel-drive layout. The first minor update came in 2016, enhancing body rigidity and aerodynamics. Models equipped with the 6-speed manual transmission received engine retuning along with upgrades to numerous components, placing greater emphasis on performance rather than appearance. The GT Limited trim represented the highest grade in the 86 lineup. Its interior featured upscale materials such as leather and Alcantara, offering a more premium and mature cabin environment.
long.zh: 2012年发布的Toyota 86是一款采用紧凑车身和后轮驱动布局的跑车。2016年首次小改款提升了车身刚性和空气动力学性能。6速手动版本还进行了引擎调校和多项部件改进，注重性能提升胜过外观变化。这款“GT Limited”是86车系中的最高等级版本。内饰采用皮革和Alcantara等高品质材料，营造更加成熟的整体氛围。

vehicleCollection.zh:
和Subaru联合研发的前置后驱跑车，有着较低的重心和极佳的前后配重比。

2012年发布的Toyota 86是一款采用紧凑车身和后轮驱动布局的跑车。2016年首次小改款提升了车身刚性和空气动力学性能。6速手动版本还进行了引擎调校和多项部件改进，注重性能提升胜过外观变化。这款“GT Limited”是86车系中的最高等级版本。内饰采用皮革和Alcantara等高品质材料，营造更加成熟的整体氛围。

brandCentral.en:
The base model for this Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car
is the Toyota 86.

With <346ps> of power and remarkable handling, this vehicle
is equipped to beat the competition around any corner.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车的基础改装车型是
一台Toyota 86。

凭借<346ps>的动力和可圈可点的操控性，这辆车有能力在任
何弯道击败竞争对手。

catch.en: This is a Gran Turismo original version of the Toyota 86 FR sports car modified for Gr.4.
catch.zh: Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的跑车浪漫旅原创版本，专为Gr.4而改装。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a Gran Turismo original version of the Toyota 86 FR sports car modified for Gr.4.

A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.4 racing regulations. While the 86 had already seen action in clubman-level motorsports across the globe, this iteration transforms it into a true race machine, with its power output raised to 364 horsepower. It excels through corners, where its lightweight and compact body can be fully exploited to deliver exceptional handling.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.4 racing regulations. While the 86 had already seen action in clubman-level motorsports across the globe, this iteration transforms it into a true race machine, with its power output raised to 364 horsepower. It excels through corners, where its lightweight and compact body can be fully exploited to deliver exceptional handling.
long.zh: “86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.4规则开发的改装版本。虽然86本身就已经在全世界范围内参加各种爱好者赛事，但这个版本却将其升级成了一款真正的赛车，就连动力输出都提升到了364马力。这部赛车以弯道见长，它能在过弯时将自己轻量化紧凑车身的优势发挥到最大。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的跑车浪漫旅原创版本，专为Gr.4而改装。

“86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.4规则开发的改装版本。虽然86本身就已经在全世界范围内参加各种爱好者赛事，但这个版本却将其升级成了一款真正的赛车，就连动力输出都提升到了364马力。这部赛车以弯道见长，它能在过弯时将自己轻量化紧凑车身的优势发挥到最大。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the sporty Toyota 86.

Its two-layered rear spoiler and other aerodynamic elements
help make it a truly state-of-the-art rally machine.

The drivetrain has been adapted from rear-wheel drive to AWD,
ensuring appropriate grip and traction on the dirt.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Toyota 86开发。

双层尾部扰流板以及其他空气动力学配件的添加使它摇
身一变，成为一款最先进的拉力机器。

另外，其传动系统也从原有车型的前置后驱配置改为了
四轮驱动布局。

catch.en: This off-road version of Toyota's 86 was modified for Gr.B competition.
catch.zh: Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的越野版本，专为Gr.B而改装。

vehicleCollection.en:
This off-road version of Toyota's 86 was modified for Gr.B competition.

A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.B racing regulations. The car has been transformed into a top-class rally machine, with its original rear-wheel-drive layout converted to 4-wheel drive, while aggressive aerodynamic elements such as canards and a two-level rear wing generated substantial downforce.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.B racing regulations. The car has been transformed into a top-class rally machine, with its original rear-wheel-drive layout converted to 4-wheel drive, while aggressive aerodynamic elements such as canards and a two-level rear wing generated substantial downforce.
long.zh: “86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.B规则开发的改装版本。这个版本将基础车型的后轮驱动布局改为了四轮驱动，还加上了能够产生强劲下压力的前翼和二段式尾翼，让它脱胎换骨，成为一辆顶级的拉力赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的越野版本，专为Gr.B而改装。

“86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.B规则开发的改装版本。这个版本将基础车型的后轮驱动布局改为了四轮驱动，还加上了能够产生强劲下压力的前翼和二段式尾翼，让它脱胎换骨，成为一辆顶级的拉力赛车。

brandCentral.en:
This GR010 HYBRID was Toyota’s all-new entry for
the 2021 World Endurance Championship (WEC).

The 2021 season saw the introduction of
a ‘Hypercar’ category.

This top-tier class is the successor to the LMP1.

In any event, the GR010 HYBRID was built
specifically for the Hypercar Class.

This Car No. 7 claimed a victory in the fourth round
of the 2021 WEC event at Le Mans.

It was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi
and José María López.

To top things off, Car No. 8 followed right
on its heels, placing in second.

Therefore, in its first Le Mans attempt, the GR010 HYBRID
claimed an impressive one-two finish.

With this, Toyota was able to extend its winning streak to
four straight Le Mans victories since 201
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR010 HYBRID是Toyota为
2021年世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）准备的全新参赛车辆。

2021赛季，锦标赛引进了“超级跑车”组别。

这个顶级类别可以视作是LMP1的继承者。

总而言之，GR010 HYBRID是特别为“超级跑车”
级别而设计的。

这辆幸运的7号赛车由迈克·康威、小林可梦伟
和何塞·马里亚·洛佩斯驾驶。

在勒芒的2021 WEC第四轮比赛中取得了冠军。

锦上添花的是，8号赛车也紧随其后冲线，名列第二亚军。

也就是说，GR010 HYBRID在勒芒的第一次亮相，
就令人惊叹地包揽了冠亚军。

算下来，Toyota自2018年以来已经在勒芒取得四连冠了。

catch.en: Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race car
catch.zh: Toyota的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

vehicleCollection.en:
Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race car

The TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021 succeeded the TS050, developed in response to the new regulations introduced that year. It featured a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine producing 670.6 HP, paired with a 268.2 HP electric motor at the front in a 4-wheel-drive layout. Driver lineups including Kamui Kobayashi and Kazuki Nakajima went on to win all six rounds of the WEC season, including Le Mans, ushering in the beginning of the hypercar era.

long.en: The TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021 succeeded the TS050, developed in response to the new regulations introduced that year. It featured a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine producing 670.6 HP, paired with a 268.2 HP electric motor at the front in a 4-wheel-drive layout. Driver lineups including Kamui Kobayashi and Kazuki Nakajima went on to win all six rounds of the WEC season, including Le Mans, ushering in the beginning of the hypercar era.
long.zh: TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021是TS050的后继车型，专为适应2021年引入的新赛事规则而开发。引擎更换为3.5升V6双涡轮增压机组，输出680 PS，采用四驱布局，前轴配备272 PS电机。包括小林可梦伟和中岛一贵在内的车手阵容横扫了勒芒站在内的WEC赛季全部6站比赛，标志着终极跑车时代的开启。

vehicleCollection.zh:
Toyota的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021是TS050的后继车型，专为适应2021年引入的新赛事规则而开发。引擎更换为3.5升V6双涡轮增压机组，输出680 PS，采用四驱布局，前轴配备272 PS电机。包括小林可梦伟和中岛一贵在内的车手阵容横扫了勒芒站在内的WEC赛季全部6站比赛，标志着终极跑车时代的开启。

brandCentral.en:
The S-FR was a concept vehicle unveiled at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

While this lightweight RWD sports car was designed for everyday
use, it certainly turned heads at the show.

With a compact body on par with the AE86, its weight is
evenly distributed over the front and rear axles.

The design was inspired by the famous Toyota Sports 800.
brandCentral.zh:
S-FR是在2015年东京车展上发布的一款概念车。

这是一款针对日常驾驶设计的轻量级后轮驱动跑车，生
来就拥有一种引人注目的特质！

与AE86相当的紧凑车身将重量均匀地分配在前后轴上。

它的设计灵感来自于鼎鼎大名的早期跑车Toyota Sports 800。

catch.en: Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.
catch.zh: 沿袭了Toyota轻量跑车传统的概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.

In the fall of 2015, at the Tokyo Motor Show, Toyota unveiled the S-FR lightweight sports car, conceived with the philosophy of delivering “perfect control in an entry model, allowing drivers to fully enjoy the car through everyday engagement." The design captured the spirit of the classic Toyota Sports 800, reimagined with a contemporary sensibility to suit modern tastes.

long.en: In the fall of 2015, at the Tokyo Motor Show, Toyota unveiled the S-FR lightweight sports car, conceived with the philosophy of delivering “perfect control in an entry model, allowing drivers to fully enjoy the car through everyday engagement." The design captured the spirit of the classic Toyota Sports 800, reimagined with a contemporary sensibility to suit modern tastes.
long.zh: Toyota在2015年秋季的东京车展上推出了这辆S-FR轻量化跑车，并为其设定了“入门级车型也能提供完美操控性，让驾驶者在日常驾驶中享受与汽车互动”的概念。其设计中提炼了经典车型Toyota Sports 800的精髓，并针对现代品味进行了相应的更新。

vehicleCollection.zh:
沿袭了Toyota轻量跑车传统的概念车。

Toyota在2015年秋季的东京车展上推出了这辆S-FR轻量化跑车，并为其设定了“入门级车型也能提供完美操控性，让驾驶者在日常驾驶中享受与汽车互动”的概念。其设计中提炼了经典车型Toyota Sports 800的精髓，并针对现代品味进行了相应的更新。

brandCentral.en:
This race-oriented S-FR made its first official appearance
at the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon.

While the details of its powertrain remained undisclosed,
its creators suggested that...

...under its hood was a supercharged engine.

With even more power, combined with an excellent chassis,
this car was indeed ready for the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆专为比赛而重新设计的S-FR最初在2016年东京汽车沙龙
上亮相。

它的传动系统细节从未公开，不过其设计师表示……

这就是一辆机械增压版本的S-FR。

拥有如此强力的引擎和轻量化的车身，确实有资格被称
为快速、灵巧的比赛机器。

catch.en: The racing version of the attention-getting S-FR concept car.
catch.zh: 备受期待的GT概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the attention-getting S-FR concept car.

Unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show, the S-FR Racing Concept was a track-focused evolution of Toyota’s S-FR. Fender width was extended by 0.8 inches on each side, while a prominent air outlet was integrated into the hood. A large rear wing and aggressive aerodynamic elements transformed the once-playful S-FR Concept into a car exuding the aura of a GT racer.

long.en: Unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show, the S-FR Racing Concept was a track-focused evolution of Toyota’s S-FR. Fender width was extended by 0.8 inches on each side, while a prominent air outlet was integrated into the hood. A large rear wing and aggressive aerodynamic elements transformed the once-playful S-FR Concept into a car exuding the aura of a GT racer.
long.zh: 这款S-FR Racing Concept是Toyota S-FR的赛车版本，在2015年东京车展上正式公布。它的两侧挡泥板宽度增加了20毫米，引擎盖上也加设了大尺寸通风口。此外它的车身上还加装了一部大尺寸尾翼和其他多种地效部件，让曾经看上去人畜无害的S-FR Concept改头换面，成为了一部纯正的GT赛车。

vehicleCollection.zh:
备受期待的GT概念车。

这款S-FR Racing Concept是Toyota S-FR的赛车版本，在2015年东京车展上正式公布。它的两侧挡泥板宽度增加了20毫米，引擎盖上也加设了大尺寸通风口。此外它的车身上还加装了一部大尺寸尾翼和其他多种地效部件，让曾经看上去人畜无害的S-FR Concept改头换面，成为了一部纯正的GT赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.

Introduced in 2000 by British sports car manufacturer TVR, this two-door coupe featured a detachable roof and a distinctive exterior design that blended bold curves with aggressive lines. Power came from TVR’s in-house developed 4.0L inline-6, known as the Speed 6, which produced 359 HP. With a lightweight body tipping the scales at just 2425 lbs, the car delivered truly staggering performance.

Power came from TVR’s in-house developed 4.0L inline-6, known as the Speed 6, which produced 359 HP. With a lightweight body tipping the scales at just 2425 lbs, the car delivered truly staggering performance.

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
The Model 3 is Tesla’s entry model,
and a compact sedan EV.

Much like the Model S, it has a sporty design
that is almost coupe-like in appearance.

Powered by two motors at the front and rear,
this is one car that does not underperform.

Capable of going from 0-100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds,
this 4WD sedan can accelerate like a super sports car!

The interior of the car is, naturally, as thoroughly
Tesla as the exterior...

With many of the car’s controls laid out on a 15-inch

brandCentral.zh:

Model 3的前后轮各由一部电机驱动，
在性能方面丝毫没有妥协。

这款四驱版本的加速性能可以媲美超级跑车，
能够在3.3秒内完成0-100 km/h的加速！

这款车将大量的控制模块集中布置在一块15英寸触摸屏上……

而内饰方面也和外观一样，拥有鲜明的特斯拉风格。>

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-seller from the company that changed the EV market forever.

The Tesla Model 3 is a compact battery-electric sedan. At the top of the lineup sat the Performance Dual Motor AWD variant, capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.3 seconds and reaching a top speed of 162.2 mph. Under WLTP testing—the global standard for electric and fuel efficiency—it offered an impressive maximum range of 339.9 miles. In 2023, it received its first major update, introducing refinements to the front fascia, overall length, and interior controls.

In 2023, it received its first major update, introducing refinements to the front fascia, overall length, and interior controls.

conversation.en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.

The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.

Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.

But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.

And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?

It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!

It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.
|
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……

日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。

该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。

也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。

至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……

还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的Toyota厂队！

驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。

collection.en:
Toyota's 2000GT ranks among the most beautiful GT cars
in history.

It is truly a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

When it debuted in 1967, it sold for a little over
two million yen, or around $6,800.

Today, it would fetch high six figures in dollars.

A minor design modification in 1969 divides the 2000GTs
into early models and late models.

The 2000GT competed in numerous speed trials
where it set records.

It was even raced by Carroll Shelby in 1968.

All in all, it's a fabulous car, and one which you can enjoy
owning for many years.
collection.zh:
作为日本汽车设计的伟大杰作之一，

Toyota 2000GT已跻身世界上最美丽的GT跑车之列。

当它在1967年首次亮相时，售价只略高于200万日元，在当
时约等于6800美元。

如今，它的售价按美元计算已达到六位数的天价。

按照1969年的小改款划分，2000GT可以被分为早期和后期型号。

2000GT参加了许多速度测试，并创下多项项速度记录，

甚至在1968年的比赛中担任Carroll Shelby的座驾。

总之，这辆无与伦比的车在您的收藏中停上多少年都依
然值得回味。

vehicleCollection.en:
Considered to be Japan's first supercar, this special car possessed originality in both style and mechanics.

Unveiled in 1967, the Toyota 2000GT blended engineering excellence with timeless design, instantly capturing the hearts of sports car enthusiasts. It made its mark on the track as well, setting a world record at 136.7 mph on the Yatabe test course. Global fame followed when it appeared as James Bond’s car in "You Only Live Twice."

conversation.en:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.

The first time the test drivers got a taste of the 86,
they were somewhat underwhelmed.

One of them said after driving it, "We realized we had to
rebuild the car from scratch."

The production and race versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time.

The race car took part in races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The experiences from those races were used to improve the
production car, which is the car here.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as
the "ultimate 86"!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Toyota86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。

开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。

其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新
打造这辆车”。

86的零售和比赛规格版本的开发是同期进行的……

赛车版被用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。

通过比赛积累的经验又被用来改进零售版——也就是你
面前的这台86。

事实上，开发人员最终将这款车称为“终极86”！

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota 86 GRMN is the epitome of a concept car.

It employs lightweight pistons, a custom crankshaft...

And a finely-tuned exhaust system.

Furthermore, the roof and bonnet are of carbon fibre, and
the brakes have been reinforced with special materials.

Oh, and in case you're not aware, the 'MN' in the name
stands for 'Meister of Nürburgring'.

It is the direct product of knowledge and experience gained
from the Nürburgring 24 Hours race.

Dubbed the 'perfect' 86, it is the pride of Toyota.
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota 86 GRMN是一款典型的概念车。

采用轻量化活塞、定制曲轴……

以及一套精细调校过的排气系统。

此外，车顶和引擎盖用上了碳纤维材质，刹车系统也用
特殊材料进行了加固。

哦，也许您还没听说，车型名字中的“MN”是“纽博格
林大师”（Meister of Nürburgring）的缩写。

因为这款车是Toyota在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中获得的知识
和经验的直接产物。

它是Toyota的骄傲，也是大家口中的“完美”86。

catch.en: The "Nürburgring Meister" in the form of the Toyota 86.
catch.zh: 纽博格林赛道大师，终极版Toyota 86。

vehicleCollection.en:
The "Nürburgring Meister" in the form of the Toyota 86.

Available exclusively through online orders beginning in January 2016, the 86 GRMN was a fully tuned machine crafted by Toyota, based on its beloved 86 sports car. Beyond structural enhancements, its center of gravity was further lowered through the extensive use of lightweight materials. A host of additional refinements were made—not only was power output increased, but the car also received a newly developed close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission, upgraded brakes, and staggered tire sizing between the front and rear.

long.en: Available exclusively through online orders beginning in January 2016, the 86 GRMN was a fully tuned machine crafted by Toyota, based on its beloved 86 sports car. Beyond structural enhancements, its center of gravity was further lowered through the extensive use of lightweight materials. A host of additional refinements were made—not only was power output increased, but the car also received a newly developed close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission, upgraded brakes, and staggered tire sizing between the front and rear.
long.zh: 86 GRMN于2016年1月开始发售，且仅提供网络渠道的预订。这款车是以Toyota备受欢迎的“86”跑车为原型，经过完整调校而诞生的车型。除了进行结构强化之外，这款车还通过采用轻量化材料，将整体重心降低。此外它还接受了一系列其他改装。首先增强的自然是它的动力，同时还换用了一套全新的密齿轮比6速手动变速箱，就连刹车也得到提升，前后轮也使用了不同尺寸的轮胎。

conversation.en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.

One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.

Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that
premium identity to new heights.

This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆Toyota Alphard。

这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。

自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，Alphard
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……

而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。

这辆Executive Lounge版本是第三代Alphard的顶配，

配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota Alphard is a minivan
that is synonymous with "luxury."

This third-generation Executive Lounge variant
is the top-of-the-line grade.

This popular vehicle has a plush and comfortable
interior that makes it the limousine of minivans.

In Japan, minivans are generally used as family cars,
specifically designed for the country's unique roads and traffic.

Among all the minivan models, the Toyota Alphard has long been
considered the most luxurious of the bunch.

Many consider the Alphard so much more than a minivan.
They see it more as a genuine luxury vehicle.
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota Alphard在日本是一款代表了“奢华”的厢式旅行车。

这辆第三代的Executive Lounge版本
是全系列中的最高档次。

这款车就像一架私人喷气飞机，其奢华舒适的后排座位
也使其成为了厢式旅行车中的“豪车”。

在日本，厢式旅行车通常会被当做家庭用车，
针对这个国家独特的道路和交通条件进行专门设计。

Toyota Alphard长久以来一直在这一品类树立着奢华的定位。

正因如此，它不仅仅是一款厢式旅行车，
更是一款货真价实的豪华汽车。

catch.en: Japan's premium minivan that evolved into a high-class luxury car.
catch.zh: 已经演化成高档豪车的日本最高品质厢式旅行车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Japan's premium minivan that evolved into a high-class luxury car.

Since its original launch in 2002, the Toyota Alphard had continuously aimed to define the luxury minivan segment. The third-generation Alphard, launched in 2015, introduced the Executive Lounge trim, delivering exceptional comfort to second-row passengers. It offered a higher level of luxury and refinement than ever before. A 2017 facelift brought updates to the 4.5-liter V-6 engine and further enhancements to overall ride comfort.

It offered a higher level of luxury and refinement than ever before. A 2017 facelift brought updates to the 4.5-liter V-6 engine and further enhancements to overall ride comfort.
long.zh: Toyota Alphard自2002年初代车型问世后，便孜孜不倦地追求设计出极致的豪华厢式旅行车。2015年推出的第3代Alphard新增“Executive Lounge”豪华升级配置，将第二排座椅的舒适性提升至顶级。这台车带来了前所未有的豪华感与舒适性。2017年改款车型新增4.5升V6引擎，舒适性得到了进一步提升。

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota Himedic is one of Japan’s most iconic
ambulatory vehicles.

Not only does it transport sick and injured persons
to the hospital...

But it is also fitted with a wealth of medical devices
necessary for saving lives...

Allowing first-responders to perform essential medical
procedures while en route to the ER.

For this reason, it is sometimes referred to as
a ‘high-standard ambulance.’

Toyota’s first Himedic made its debut in 1992, and was
the first ambulance of its kind in Japan.

The name ‘Himedic’ is a catchy portmanteau
of the words ‘high’ and ‘medical.’
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota Himedic是日本最具代表性的救护车之一。

它不仅负责将伤病员送往医院……

车内还配备有大量抢救必备的医疗设备……

让急救人员在前往急诊室的途中就能实施必要的急救操作。

因此，它有时被称为“高标准救护车”。

Toyota的第一辆Himedic于1992年首次发布，也是该类别救护车
首次在日本亮相。

“Himedic”这一名字本身便是以“高”和“医”的英文综合而成。-

catch.en: Saving lives faster and more safely.
catch.zh: 更快、更安全地拯救生命的急救车辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
Saving lives faster and more safely.

Since the 1950s, Toyota had been producing ambulances based on specially adapted passenger and commercial vehicles. The most recent of these was the third-generation Himedic, a high-standard ambulance introduced in 2006. Its platform was built on the 200 Series HiAce Super Long. With improvements such as an expanded patient compartment, this vehicle was engineered for maximum functionality in critical, life-saving situations.

long.en: Since the 1950s, Toyota had been producing ambulances based on specially adapted passenger and commercial vehicles. The most recent of these was the third-generation Himedic, a high-standard ambulance introduced in 2006. Its platform was built on the 200 Series HiAce Super Long. With improvements such as an expanded patient compartment, this vehicle was engineered for maximum functionality in critical, life-saving situations.
long.zh: 自1950年代起，Toyota便开始改装旗下的乘用车及其他商用车辆来生产救护车。最新款是2006年推出的第3代“Himedic”高规格救护车。该车车身基于200系列HiAce Super Long改造而成。相较于前代车型，这款车通过扩大后厢急救区域等改进，充分考量了在紧急救援的情况下所能提供的极致功能性。

This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.

The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.
!

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这辆车是Toyota近些年来最好的设计之一。

其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……

但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。

Toyota通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶

还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。

dialogues.en:
The Toyota Prius is arguably the most popular Japanese
hybrid car.

And when it comes to subcompacts, the most popular
could well be the Toyota Aqua.

Outside of Japan, the Aqua is marketed as the "Prius C."

But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself.
Are you familiar with the term "hybrid car?"
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
Toyota Prius是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。

而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，
那最著名的要属Toyota Aqua了。

在日本以外，Aqua被称为“Prius C”。

但是等等——也许我忽略了一点。
你熟悉“混合动力汽车”这个概念吗？
u

dialogues.en:
Oh great! It's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.

By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
太棒了！这是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。

通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota Aqua was a smaller version of the popular Prius,
equipped with the same hybrid technology.

Not only was it super fuel efficient, Toyota made the car
fun to drive!

Note that the battery is located under the rear seats.

This allows for a lower center of gravity, which in turn,
results in better handling balance.
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota Aqua通过与Prius共享的混合动力技术获益不少：

不仅超级省油，而且驾驶体验尚佳！

请注意，此车的电池位于后座下面……

这项创新设计能够降低车辆重心，从而改善其操控性。

usedCar.en:
The Toyota Aqua is one of the most fuel-efficient cars
on the planet, thanks to its hybrid drivetrain.

It comes powered by a 1.5-liter inline-4 and an electric motor.

The Aqua's system is called Hybrid Synergy Drive, which is
similar to the one used in the Prius.

The battery, which is the usually the heaviest component
of the system, is placed under the rear seats.

This results in lots of interior space and excellent weight
distribution, making this vehicle surprising fun to drive.
usedCar.zh:
丰田Aqua由1.5L四缸引擎搭配电机驱动。

这样的车被称为“混合动力汽车”。

Aqua的混合动力系统是基于Prius动力系统
特别设计。

为它提供动力的沉重电池位于后排座椅
下方，接近车的中心位置。

它绝佳的重量分配使得其能够实现精准的
转向，并提供稳定的驾驶体验。/

catch.en: More economical than the larger Prius, this model is helping to expand the hybrid vehicle market.
catch.zh: 比Prius更小更经济。一款开拓混动车市场的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
More economical than the larger Prius, this model is helping to expand the hybrid vehicle market.

After making hybrids mainstream with the Prius, Toyota introduced the Aqua, a smaller, more fuel-efficient hybrid. Its hybrid system was a lighter, optimized version of that used in the third-generation Prius. In JC08 fuel economy tests conducted in Japan, it reached a maximum efficiency of 83.3 MPG. Internationally, the car was marketed as the Prius C.

long.en: After making hybrids mainstream with the Prius, Toyota introduced the Aqua, a smaller, more fuel-efficient hybrid. Its hybrid system was a lighter, optimized version of that used in the third-generation Prius. In JC08 fuel economy tests conducted in Japan, it reached a maximum efficiency of 83.3 MPG. Internationally, the car was marketed as the Prius C.
long.zh: 发布Prius普及混动汽车之后，Toyota开发了更小、更节能的混动汽车Aqua。所采用的混动系统是第3代Prius的轻量化版本。在日本JC08模式的燃油经济性测试中，其行驶里程达到了2.9 升/百公里。在日本以外的市场，它以Prius C的型号名发售。

brandCentral.en:
Have you ever heard of a "crossover SUV?" It combines the
ruggedness of an SUV with the sleekness of a coupe.

Here is a prime example, developed as part of Toyota’s global
strategy to meet the demands of the 21st century.

It was called the C-HR.

Measuring just <4360mm> in length, this compact car featured
a complex body design that exuded both strength and style.

It featured a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain, delivering an impressive
fuel efficiency of <30.2km/l>, or a turbocharged 1.2-liter engine.

As Toyota envisioned, the C-HR broke records around the globe.

Practical yet sporty, a prototype of this unconventional
crossover took on the legendary Nürburgring 24 Hours race!
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过“跨界SUV”吗？这是一种将SUV的硬朗
与轿跑车的运动感完美融合的车型。

眼前的这款跨界车是Toyota为满足21世纪多样化市场需求而开发的
全球战略车型。

它就是“C-HR”。

作为一款总长仅为<4360mm>的紧凑型汽车，
其富有层次感的车身设计完美诠释了力量与时尚的结合。

搭载1.8升混合动力或1.2升涡轮增压动力总成，
其源自Prius的混合动力系统实现了<30.2km/l>的卓越燃油经济性。

C-HR不负Toyota期望，一经推出，就在全球市场创造了佳绩。

这款独特的跨界车不仅实用性强，还具备运动基因，其原型车
曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛！

catch.en: An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
catch.zh: 这款非传统跨界SUV曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Following a series of internationally-focused models such as the Corolla and Yaris, Toyota introduced the C-HR crossover SUV in 2016, designed as a global vehicle for the modern era. This distinctive SUV also hinted at sporting ambitions, with a prototype version taking part in the Nürburgring 24 Hours race. Built on Toyota’s next-generation TNGA platform, the C-HR came with a choice of a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain or a turbocharged 1.2-liter inline-4. The C-HR would go on to earn broad acclaim, becoming a bestseller.

This distinctive SUV also hinted at sporting ambitions, with a prototype version taking part in the Nürburgring 24 Hours race. Built on Toyota’s next-generation TNGA platform, the C-HR came with a choice of a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain or a turbocharged 1.2-liter inline-4. The C-HR would go on to earn broad acclaim, becoming a bestseller.

usedCar.en:
Looking for a sports car that was developed specially for
motorsports?

Then the Toyota Celica GT-Four should be right up
your alley!

It's a 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota in the 1990s in
order to win the World Rally Championship.

The grade name—GT-Four—serves as proof of this.

The original Celica was a two-wheel drive coupé, but the
GT-Four is a four-wheel drive rally machine.

The engine's a mighty beast as well.

It's a 2L 3S-GTE, developed in conjunction with the
GT-Four over successive generations.

It packs a massive <255ps> of power!
usedCar.zh:
想找一辆专门为赛车运动而开发的跑车吗？

那么Toyota Celica GT-Four应该能满足您的需求！

这是一辆Toyota在上世纪90年代，
为了在世界拉力锦标赛中夺胜而专门开发出的四驱跑车。

它名字中的等级GT-Four见证了这段历史。

原版Celica是一辆双轮驱动的双门轿车，
而GT-Four是一辆四驱拉力赛车。

它还搭载了一台动力澎湃的引擎。

这台引擎是2升的3S-GTE，与GT-Four共同经历了数个世代的开发。

这台引擎能输出<255ps>的强大动力！

vehicleCollection.en:
This is the WRC base model of the popular sporty coupe, complete with aluminum hood and rear spoiler.

The sixth-generation Toyota Celica made its debut in October 1993. Its futuristic design was sharpened by the distinctive quad round headlights, while a larger body emphasized its identity as a front-wheel-drive specialty car. In 1994, the GT-FOUR (ST205) appeared as a homologation model for the WRC. Its 3S-GTE turbocharged 2.0-liter engine produced 251.5 HP.

long.en: The sixth-generation Toyota Celica made its debut in October 1993. Its futuristic design was sharpened by the distinctive quad round headlights, while a larger body emphasized its identity as a front-wheel-drive specialty car. The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
R
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。

从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。

这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。

与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。

The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.

catch.en: The rally machine that left an impression on many fans, though it only competed for a short time.

vehicleCollection.en:
The rally machine that left an impression on many fans, though it only competed for a short time.

The car followed the success of the previous ST185 model, which had secured both the manufacturers' and drivers' titles in the 1993 WRC. The ST205 entered the 1994 season aiming for another championship. However, during Round 7 in Catalonia, the car was disqualified for an engine regulation violation, and all championship points were revoked. In response, Toyota withdrew from the WRC, bringing the ST205’s competition career to an abrupt end after just one season. Despite its brief time on the stage, the ST205’s bold, rally-bred appearance won it a lasting place in the hearts of enthusiasts.

Despite its brief time on the stage, the ST205’s bold, rally-bred appearance won it a lasting place in the hearts of enthusiasts.

usedCar.en:
Hey there! In the market for a slightly retro FR saloon?
Then how about a 6th generation Chaser from Toyota?

A fierce-looking hardtop with concealed B-pillars, the Chaser
is the sharper sibling of the Cresta and Mark II.

The Tourer V is the Chaser's most hardcore trim, powered by
a 2.5L straight-6 second-generation 1JZ-GTE.

With <280ps> of power and <38.5kgm> of torque, this saloon
can easily go wheel-to-wheel with sports car thoroughbreds.

Need proof? Look no further than its storied win
at the 1998 Japanese Touring Car Championship!

And thanks to its robust engine, it serves as
an ideal platform for competitive drift cars.

Perennially popular among gearheads, the Chaser
is a high-performance saloon with a hidden wild side.
usedCar.zh:
你好啊！在找稍微带点经典风格的前驱轿车吗？
要不要看看Toyota的第6代Chaser？

Chaser是一辆风格硬朗、隐藏了B柱的硬顶车，
是Cresta、Mark II更加犀利的姐妹款。

Tourer V的配置在Chaser车型中是最硬核的，
搭载一台2.5升直列6缸第二代1JZ-GTE引擎。

其输出动力达<280ps>、扭矩<38.5kgm>，
能和纯血跑车轻松进行轮对轮的较量。

不信吗？只要看看它在1998年日本房车锦标赛上
传奇的冠军经历就知道了！

由于其结实耐用的引擎，它也是比赛用漂移赛车的理想改装平台。

Chaser在热衷改装的车迷圈子里享有经久不衰的人气，
是隐藏了狂野一面的高性能轿车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This sister to the Toyota Mark II provides an intense drive.

The Chaser was Toyota’s midsize sedan, sharing the Mark II’s fundamental design but wearing different exterior styling. The Tourer V performance model was powered by the second-generation 1JZ-GTE engine with variable valve timing, and flooring the pedal launched this beast forward with ferocious boost. The front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout provided excellent control, making the car responsive to the driver’s inputs.

The Tourer V performance model was powered by the second-generation 1JZ-GTE engine with variable valve timing, and flooring the pedal launched this beast forward with ferocious boost. The front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout provided excellent control, making the car responsive to the driver’s inputs.

The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.

It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.

In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.

However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.

One reason was weight.

The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
<5kg> lighter than the Trueno.

In a car this light, an extra <5kg> over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.

原因在于车重的差异。

配有固定头灯的Levin要比Trueno轻<5kg>。

usedCar.en:
Toyota's Corolla Levin, aka AE86, has become the stuff of legends,
especially after being featured in manga and the movies!

It isn't the most powerful car around, with <130ps> coming
from its 4-cylinder engine, but it does rev to <7000rpm>!

What most fans love about it is that it has a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive layout, or FR as we say in the industry.

It's light and agile, and wonderfully fun to drive. I would
recommend that you put one in your garage!
usedCar.zh:
AE86 Corolla Levin是一款由Toyota制造的紧凑型前置后驱车，
亦是一项工程杰作——这辆车一年比一年受欢迎。

虽然<130ps>的输出功率不高，
但它的自然吸气四缸引擎能达到<7000rpm>的转速！

除此之外，它轻巧的车身和后驱布局也使
得它很适合在赛道上疾驰。

在经过适当的调校后，Levin有能力在各种赛事中比拼，
所以在车库里备一辆有利无弊！

catch.en: The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.

vehicleCollection.en:
The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.

The fourth-generation Corolla Levin was introduced in 1983. It carried over the floor panel from the previous TE71 and was the only model of its generation to retain a rear-wheel-drive layout, while all other Corollas had transitioned to front-wheel drive. The 1.6-liter 4A-GEU DOHC engine and lightweight body delivered a sharp, responsive driving experience. After production ended, demand for affordable rear-wheel-drive cars only grew, securing this model’s legacy as one of the greatest sports cars ever produced by Toyota.

long.en: The fourth-generation Corolla Levin was introduced in 1983. It carried over the floor panel from the previous TE71 and was the only model of its generation to retain a rear-wheel-drive layout, while all other Corollas had transitioned to front-wheel drive. The 1.6-liter 4A-GEU DOHC engine and lightweight body delivered a sharp, responsive driving experience. After production ended, demand for affordable rear-wheel-drive cars only grew, securing this model’s legacy as one of the greatest sports cars ever produced by Toyota.
long.zh: 这是1983年首次亮相的第四代Corolla Levin。该车型延续了前代TE71的底盘结构，在同代车型中独树一帜地保持了后轮驱动布局，而其他所有Corolla车型都已改为前轮驱动。1.6升4A-GEU双顶置凸轮轴引擎与轻量化车身的完美结合，成就了灵敏迅捷的驾驶体验。停产后市场对经济型后驱车的需求反而日益高涨，进一步确立了它作为Toyota史上最经典运动车型之一的不朽地位。

brandCentral.en:
Sold only in Japan, the Toyota Crown has represented
the quintessential Japanese luxury sports sedan.

This particular model, which was introduced in 2012, was the
14th-generation version.

With the first Crown appearing in 1955, it's one of the longest
running models in Japan to date.

The name "Athlete" was chosen to represent its
distinctively sporty nature.

It's a shame that the car has never been marketed worldwide.
brandCentral.zh:
“Toyota Crown”这个名字在全日本汽车爱好者的心目中代表着
尊贵。

这台车在2012年首次发布，已经是久负盛名的Crown系列中的
第14代产品了。

回首1955年推出的第一代Crown，这个系列已经传承延续了超
过半个世纪。

Toyota为14代车型定下的型号名称“Athlete”充分表达了它的运
动基因……

以及它那公路王者的霸气外形。

catch.en: The 14th-generation Crown sported a bold front-end design, giving the sport sedan an extra dose of flair.
catch.zh: 属于第14代车型的Crown采用了大胆而新颖的前脸设计，风貌焕然一新。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 14th-generation Crown sported a bold front-end design, giving the sport sedan an extra dose of flair.

In 2012, the Toyota Crown underwent a full model change, entering its 14th generation with a bold new front-end design. The lineup was split into two distinct versions: the more conservative "Royal" and the sportier "Athlete." brandCentral.en:
The Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo is a car that redefines
the future of racing!

Its design is based on the FT-1, which was developed in the
pursuit of functional beauty.

You could say that this model takes that concept
to an entirely new level.

The large spoilers at the front and rear were installed after
closely studying their aerodynamic effect on the car.

It's clear no compromises were made on its styling,
either!
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo是一款纯粹的赛车，
并将重新定义赛车的未来！

其设计原型FT-1是一款为追求功能之美而开发的汽车。

而这款Vision Gran Turismo车型又将这一理念提升到了全新的
高度！

前侧轮拱处和后部的扰流板是在对空气动力学进行了广
泛研究的基础上添加的，

而且我们可以看到，它在设计方面完全没有做出妥协！

catch.en: The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.
catch.zh: FT-1概念设计升级，化身纯粹运动赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.

The FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo itself was a racing adaptation of Toyota’s FT-1 sports design concept, developed by CALTY Design Research, the company’s North American design studio. The design drew heavily from data and practical experience, featuring oversized fenders, an expanded front air intake, a large rear wing, and aggressive front canards.

long.en: The FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo itself was a racing adaptation of Toyota’s FT-1 sports design concept, developed by CALTY Design Research, the company’s North American design studio. Under the bonnet, cutting-edge technologies have been used

定制设计中包括了一套大尾翼和两侧的前定风翼。

在其引擎盖下，搭载了多项世界领先的科技，确保能够

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's sports design concept presented at the January 2014 Detroit Auto Show.

The Toyota FT-1 is a concept car created by CALTY Design, Toyota’s North American design studio, offering a glimpse into the potential future of the brand’s sports car philosophy. Its projected dimensions are: overall length, 184.1 inches; width 77.6 inches; height 48.2 inches; with a wheelbase of 107.9 inches. The design draws inspiration from Toyota’s rich sports car heritage, beginning with the iconic Toyota 2000GT.

A car with more than 50 years of history and over fifty-million
units sold worldwide...

Is there any other car that can make such a claim
than the Toyota Corolla?

It’s a brand that has surely made memories
for countless of people everywhere.

The GR Corolla is a sports car built by Toyota’s
GR division.

What’s more, this model was a special variant penned by
Toyota’s master driver Morizo
To reduce weight, the rear seats of the base 5-seat model
were removed.

It also featured a specially-tuned engine and transmission.
Without a doubt, this genuine sports car is sure to pleae.

conversation.zh:
超过50年生产历史和全球销量超过五千万辆的记录——

除了Toyota Corolla，还有哪款车能够
拥有如此辉煌的战绩？

这个品牌无疑给世界各地的无数用户留下了美好的回忆。

这款GR Corolla是Toyota旗下GR品牌出品

更重要的是，这是由Toyota的大师级赛车手“Morizo”
亲自设计的特殊版本！

为了减轻重量，这款5座基础车型的后排座椅被全部移除。

毫无疑问，这款纯正跑车一定会带来愉悦的W^x验。

brandCentral.en:
The GR Corolla is indeed an exceptional sports car born
of GAZOO Racing’s motorsport success.

But with the MORIZO Edition, it was brought even closer
to the track, so to speak.

‘Morizo’ is the racing alias of Akio Toyoda, Toyota’s
president at the time of this variant’s debut.

Toyoda now serves as Toyota’s master driver, and plays
an active role in motorsport racing.

From its strong yet lightweight body to its souped-up engine
and transmission—this is one finely-tuned machine!
brandCentral.zh:
GAZOO Racing在赛车运动中的成功经验造就了
GR Corolla这款非凡的跑车。

随着MORIZO版的推出，它的赛道血统变得愈发浓厚。

“Morizo”其实是Toyota前总裁丰田章男在赛车时使用的别名，
该车发布时，他还没有卸任。

以大师级赛车手自居的丰田章男，对Toyota在赛车运动领域的
投入起到了推波助澜的作用。

从坚固而轻质的车身到高度调校的引擎和变速箱，这款车
可谓精雕细琢！>

catch.en: A 2-seat model that takes the GR Corolla to the extreme.
catch.zh: 一款将GR Corolla推向极致的双座车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A 2-seat model that takes the GR Corolla to the extreme.

The GR Corolla was developed by Toyota’s high-performance GR division as a hot hatch aimed squarely at outperforming its rivals. Already the most powerful model in Corolla history, it was taken even further with the hardcore MORIZO Edition. At a time when the automotive world moves toward electrification and advanced systems, the GR Corolla stood out as a rare celebration of the pure, mechanical thrill of the internal combustion engine.

Already the most powerful model in Corolla history, it was taken even further with the hardcore MORIZO Edition. At a time when the automotive world moves toward electrification and advanced systems, the GR Corolla stood out as a rare celebration of the pure, mechanical thrill of the internal combustion engine.
long.zh: GR Corolla是Toyota旗下高性能品牌“GR”打造的高性能掀背车，旨在在性能上超越所有竞争对手。虽然这已是Corolla历史上最强车型，但厂家还是在此基础上推出了更加极致的“MORIZO Edition”版本。在汽车行业迈向电气化和智能化的今天，GR Corolla难能可贵地展现了内燃机的纯粹魅力。

brandCentral.en:
The GR Supra possesses all the qualities of a typical
front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car...

...especially the top-of-the-line RZ that comes with a
turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This engine pumps out an impressive <340ps> and
<51kgm> of torque.

The styling was fashioned after a formula race car, which
is evident by the car's front fascia.

Nearly 20 years after the last Supra, the new version has been
met with the approval of driving enthusiasts everywhere.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR Supra是一款汇聚了高马力和前置后驱传动系统的完
美跑车。

作为最高配置的RZ版本，使用的是一台涡轮增压3升直列六
缸引擎……

可以输出惊人的<340ps>动力和<51kgm>的扭矩。

Supra时隔20年的新生引起了整个汽车世界的轰动。

全世界的赛车手、漂移车手和改装爱好者都对这款车趋
之若鹜。|

catch.en: Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.
catch.zh: 丰田的旗舰版前置后驱跑车在缺席17年后再次回归，底盘变得更宽更短。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.

The Toyota Supra made its long-awaited return in 2019, following its discontinuation in 2002. The new model retained an inline-6 engine and rear-wheel-drive layout, embodying the essence of a pure sports car. It featured an ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, delivering superb balance and driving dynamics. A twin-scroll turbocharger ensured strong, responsive acceleration, while its wide stance and short wheelbase contributed to nimble, agile handling, making it a truly compelling performance machine.

A year after the release of the original GR Supra RZ,
the 2020 model appeared...

Boasting a serious power-up, from <340ps> to a
much meatier <387ps>.

New turbines and a redesigned exhaust manifold were fitted,
giving it much more grunt at high revs too.
brandCentral.zh:
在初代GR Supra RZ亮相的一年后，2020年车款也紧接着推出……

新款的动力得到了大幅强化，从<340ps>直接提升到了更强劲
的<387ps>。

它的引擎中安装了一套新的涡轮，再加上重新设计的排
气管，给了它更多在高转速区间的底气。

conversation.en:
Ah, so this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring
24 Hour race just a month after it went on sale...

Did you know the driver for the first stint of the final was none
other than Toyota President, Akio 'Morizo' Toyoda?

Basically, the man who brought the GR Supra to life!

The car was basically the retail model, with the bare
minimum safety equipment needed to race.

Still, it managed to claim 41st place overall,
and was third in its class.

It totally showed how good a performer
the GR Supra really is.
+

所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛

但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。

这样的成绩完全显示出了GR Supra的卓越性能。

catch.en: The Supra returned after a 17-year hiatus, with this racing version competing at the Nürburgring in 2019.
catch.zh: Supra暌违17年后再次归。这款跑车曾参与过2019年的纽博格林赛事。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Supra returned after a 17-year hiatus, with this racing version competing at the Nürburgring in 2019.

The GR Supra marked the return of Toyota’s flagship sports car, 17 years after production ended. It retained a rear-wheel-drive layout and inline-6, but came wrapped in a modern two-seat body with advanced construction and a twin-scroll turbocharger. It made its Nürburgring 24 Hours debut in 2018 and, in 2019, finished 3rd in the SP8T class and 41st overall. This cementing its image as a true performance contender.

long.en: The GR Supra marked the return of Toyota’s flagship sports car, 17 years after production ended. It retained a rear-wheel-drive layout and inline-6, but came wrapped in a modern two-seat body with advanced construction and a twin-scroll turbocharger. It made its Nürburgring 24 Hours debut in 2018 and, in 2019, finished 3rd in the SP8T class and 41st overall. This cementing its image as a true performance contender.
long.zh: 消失17年的Toyota旗舰跑车重获新生，GR Supra延续了经典的后驱布局和直列六缸引擎，以全新双座设计、先进车身和双涡管涡轮增压技术回归。该车于2018年首次征战纽博格林24小时耐力赛，2019年参加SP8T组别竞技，获得组别第三名、总成绩第41名的佳绩。这确立了GR Supra作为纯粹战斗跑车的形象。

vehicleCollection.zh:

The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the

When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
‘The Supra is back at the track!’

Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!

They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.

of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.

five swept the top finishing positions!

Toyota真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！

在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和FIA GT-4级别规格的Supra。

此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。

六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！

The GR Supra Racing Concept reimagined the Supra as a race car, appearing 16 years after the model's production ceased in 2002. Its compact two-door coupe body, with classic long-nose, short-deck proportions, utilized cutting-edge materials and engineering to deliver outstanding aerodynamics and handling.

The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.

conversation.en:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated
the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.

Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.

In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！

他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。

不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

dialogues.en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

dialogues.zh:

自主研发的第一辆新跑车。

碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，

引擎和四驱系统也是如此。

这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。

驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。

我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。

brandCentral.en:
This is a true 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota with the
aim of competing in the World Rally Championship.

Its power is top of the 1.6L turbo class at <272ps>, and the
4WD systems are tuned specifically for sports driving.

The body is surprisingly sturdy, and handling and stability
are both extremely impressive.

The specially designed three-door body gives a distinctly
competition-focused feel.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆Toyota专为参加世界拉力锦标赛而设计的四轮驱动
跑车。

它的1.6L涡轮增压引擎拥有同级别中的最强动力，马力高
达<272ps>，而且四轮驱动系统也针对跑车驾驶进行了特别调校。

它的车身出奇的坚固，而且拥有让人赞不绝口的出色操
控性和稳定性，

特殊设计的三门车身也说明了这台车独特的竞赛属性。

catch.en: This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.
catch.zh: 这款全新的WRC赛车将延续Toyota一贯强大的拉力赛夺冠传统。

vehicleCollection.en:
This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.

Developed by Toyota for the WRC, the GR Yaris may have appeared as a simple compact car, but underneath was a serious competition machine. With increased rigidity, reduced weight, and a dramatically lowered center of gravity, it was engineered for peak performance. The 4-wheel-drive RZ model featured a 1.6-liter 3-cylinder turbo engine paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. The RZ High Performance variant added a limited-slip differential, delivering rock-solid traction. In January 2020, the "1st Edition" was introduced as a special edition model, marking the launch with exclusive features.

long.en: Developed by Toyota for the WRC, the GR Yaris may have appeared as a simple compact car, but underneath was a serious competition machine. With increased rigidity, reduced weight, and a dramatically lowered center of gravity, it was engineered for peak performance. The 4-wheel-drive RZ model featured a 1.6-liter 3-cylinder turbo engine paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. The RZ High Performance variant added a limited-slip differential, delivering rock-solid traction. In January 2020, the "1st Edition" was introduced as a special edition model, marking the launch with exclusive features.
long.zh: Toyota为征战WRC而开发的GR Yaris，表面上是一款朴素的紧凑型车，实际上却是一台强悍的赛道机器。车身刚性得到强化，重量实现轻量化，重心尽可能降低。四驱版RZ车型搭载1.6升三缸涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱。RZ High performance版本进一步配备限滑差速器，提供稳如磐石的抓地性能。2020年1月，厂家推出了“1st Edition”特别版车型。

brandCentral.en:
This GR 86 represents an evolved version of the Toyota 86
rear-wheel-drive sports car.

Continuing the tradition established by the original AE86, this
latest “hachi-roku” is compact and has an FR layout.

What’s new is the 2.4-liter flat-four engine.

With an extra <400cc> of displacement, it delivers more
power and torque than ever before.

And, let me remind you that the new 86’s body structure
has been significantly stiffened...

...so when you’re tackling a winding road, you’ll really feel
as if you’re one with the car!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR 86是经典的后轮驱动跑车Toyota 86的进化版。

它继承由AE86开创的传统：适中的车身尺寸，以及必不可
少的后轮驱动。

它的2.4升水平对置四缸引擎是一款全新开发的引擎，

比前代多了<400cc>的排量，以输出更加充沛的动力和扭矩。

另外值得一提的是，它的车身刚性也得到了大幅的强化。

当您握住这辆车的方向盘，您会感觉自己仿佛能够掌控
一切！

catch.en: This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.
catch.zh: 排量与动力更大的引擎，不变的理念。日本最具代表性的轻量级前置后驱跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.

Toyota’s lightweight 86, a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car, was introduced in 2012 and sold more than 200,000 units worldwide. Nine years later, it was reborn as the GR86, now equipped with a larger naturally-aspirated 2.4-liter flat-4 DOHC engine producing 231.8 HP and 184.4 ft-lb of torque. With enhanced body rigidity, reduced weight, and an aerodynamic design shaped by motorsport experience, the GR86 delivered an even more engaging and dynamic driving experience.

long.en: Toyota’s lightweight 86, a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car, was introduced in 2012 and sold more than 200,000 units worldwide. Nine years later, it was reborn as the GR86, now equipped with a larger naturally-aspirated 2.4-liter flat-4 DOHC engine producing 231.8 HP and 184.4 ft-lb of torque. With enhanced body rigidity, reduced weight, and an aerodynamic design shaped by motorsport experience, the GR86 delivered an even more engaging and dynamic driving experience.
long.zh: Toyota轻量化前置后驱跑车“86”于2012年发布，全球销量突破20万辆。发布9年后，该车以“GR86”的身份重生，搭载2.4升自然进气四缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎，输出235 PS的动力和25.5 公斤力米的最大扭矩。通过强化车身刚性、削减车身重量，以及采用汲取自赛车运动的全新空气动力学设计，这款车带来了前所未有的驾驶乐趣。

collection.en:
Overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans
is one of the greatest achievements for a manufacturer.

This Toyota GT-One is one of many cars
that sought to secure its place in the history books.

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's endurance race machine that achieved a class win at Le Mans in 1999.

In 1998, Toyota developed the GT-One (TS020) with the singular goal of winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Designed by André de Cortanze, the car incorporated Formula 1-inspired aerodynamics and suspension. Although mechanical issues prevented a result in its debut year, the GT-One returned in 1999 as an evolved LM GTP machine. Ukyo Katayama and company finished 2nd overall—the highest-ever at Le Mans for a team composed entirely of Japanese drivers.

Designed by André de Cortanze, the car incorporated Formula 1-inspired aerodynamics and suspension. Ukyo Katayama and company finished 2nd overall—the highest-ever at Le Mans for a team composed entirely of Japanese drivers.

brandCentral.en:
Storability, operability, durability—commercial vehicles
certainly have a lot of boxes to tick.

And one that’s been ticking them for near 60 years is
Toyota’s forward control Hiace.

This Hiace is a 5th-generation model from 2004.

'DX' refers to the base grade or regular size developed according
to Japan’s five-number vehicle size regulations.

With room for a maximum of nine passengers, its seats can
be folded for additional storage.

Such efficient interior design has naturally made the Hiace
exceedingly popular as a base car for caravans.
brandCentral.zh:
储存能力、操控性、耐久性——商用车确实需要满足
诸多要求。

而近60年来持续满足这些要求的正是这一台Toyota的
前控式车型Hiace。

这款Hiace是2004年推出的第5代车型。

“DX”指的是车辆基础级别，即根据日本五号车辆尺寸
规定开发的标准尺寸车型。

它最多可容纳9名乘客，座椅可折叠以增加储物空间。

如此高效的内部设计使Hiace自然而然地成为了极受
欢迎的房车改装基础车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo.

The Hiace has long stood as Toyota’s flagship commercial vehicle, earning widespread support around the globe. Introduced in 2004 and continually refined, the fifth-generation H200 model became a record-setting seller. Offered in various configurations based on body size, it came with a choice of 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline engines, or a 2.8-liter diesel engine. The Van DX variant featured a standard roof height and rear-wheel drive. It accommodated up to nine passengers, or, with the seats folded, transforming into a spacious cargo carrier.

collection.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is one of the longest-running
and most respected vehicles in the world.

Its story began more than 70 years ago, in 1951.

The FJ40 series arrived in 1960, marking
the model’s third generation.

It was offered in a variety of body styles,
each designed for a specific purpose.

The 2-door hardtop, seen here, was built to conquer
the harshest off-road conditions.

Although compact at just <3.9m> in length, it was
powered by a stout 3.9-liter gasoline engine
Its rugged 4WD system with a 2-speed transfer case
made it indispensable on mountain trails.

With its distinctive charm, the FJ40 became an enduring favorite
and stayed in production for 24 years, until 1984.

In 2021, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing bega producing
reproduction parts for the model.

Why? Because a legendaryˋff-roader likeʞhis
as simply too good to let fade away.
collection.zh:
Toyota Land Cruiser是品牌最常青
且最受景仰的车型之一。

它的故事始于70多年前的1951年。

1960年推出的FJ40系列标志着该车系进入第三代，

且提供多种车款以满足不同用户的需求。

这里展示的双门硬顶版本专为应对极端越野条件而打造。

车身虽然小巧（车长约<3.9m>），却搭载了实力派的3.9升汽油引擎。

再加上带有两速分动箱的四驱系统，
让这台车成为山路驾驶的绝对利器。

FJ40凭借迷人外观大受欢迎，持续生产24年，
直至1984年才停产。

TOYOTA GAZOO Racing于2021年开始
为其生产复刻零件。

原因很简单，因为如此杰出的越野车型值得被永续传承！

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-selling Land Cruiser with a 24-year production run.

Renowned for its all-terrain performance and reliability, the Toyota Land Cruiser has become among the world’s most beloved off-road vehicles. Introduced in 1960, the third-generation “40” series also offered a surprising degree of on-road comfort. The 2-door hardtop variant shown here was powered by a 3.9-liter F-model gasoline engine, paired with a part-time 4-wheel-drive system. Its popularity only grew in 1974 with the introduction of the 3.0-liter B-model diesel engine. The 40 series went on to become a massive success, remaining in production until 1984.

usedCar.en:
You don't see many affordable mid-engine sports cars, but
Toyota threw caution to the wind and produced the MR2.

While the first-gen model had quirky styling, this final revision,
called in-house as the SW20, looks like a mini exotic.

It handles like an exotic too, thanks to a sport-tuned
suspension system and quick steering responses.

The engine, mounted behind the GT-S' cockpit, is a turbo
2.0-liter inline-4 that pumps out an impressive <245ps>.
usedCar.zh:
Toyota MR2是一款中置引擎跑车。

SW20 是对此的第二次也是最后一次修订
模型，以其先进的处理而闻名。

此 GT-S 等级配备 2升直列四缸涡轮增压
引擎能够达到 <245ps>。

更重要的是，这辆车的后备箱超大！
非常适合用来装一大堆行李。>

catch.en: The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.
catch.zh: 最终的涡轮增压机车型，具有可以承受引擎动力的底盘稳定性。

vehicleCollection.en:
The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.

Introduced in 1989, the second-generation MR2, designated SW20, succeeded the AW11, Japan’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car. Its body dimensions were stretched to the upper limits of Japan’s Class 5 vehicle regulations, while its design adopted smoother, more aerodynamic lines to emphasize its mid-engine configuration. At launch, the car faced criticism for its challenging handling character, but subsequent refinements transformed it into a well-balanced performer.

long.en: Introduced in 1989, the second-generation MR2, designated SW20, succeeded the AW11, Japan’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car. Its body dimensions were stretched to the upper limits of Japan’s Class 5 vehicle regulations, while its design adopted smoother, more aerodynamic lines to emphasize its mid-engine configuration. At launch, the car faced criticism for its challenging handling character, but subsequent refinements transformed it into a well-balanced performer.
long.zh: 第二代MR2发布于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置布局量产车AW11的继任者。SW20的车身延长后达到日本5级汽车尺寸的上限，平滑圆润的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。发布初期，这辆车因其糟糕的操控而饱受批评，后续的更新升级却将其打造成了一款平衡性极佳的中置引擎跑车。

most iconic luxury sedans.

Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable
36-year run spanning nine generations.

The original 1968 model was known

The name suggested a larger, more luxurious

1JZ-GTEinline-6.

What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement

usedCar.en:
Ever heard of the Toyota Mark II? It was an iconic FR car
that led Japan’s midsize sedan market for decades.

The performance version of the Mark II was the Tourer V, and
I happen to have an excellent one in stock right now.

This is an X100-series car from the model’s eighth generation.
What do you think? Looks like a regular sedan, right?

Well, wait until you see the serious hardware under the hood:
a 1JZ-GTE 2.5-liter inline-6 inherited from the A70 Supra.

The rush of its <280p> acceleration is pure madness,
and its 5-speed manual captivated enthusiasts everywhere.

With double wishbones at all four corners, the setup is supple
yet grippy, giving the car a remarkable degree of depth.

Older sedans are seeing a major resurence right now,
so adding this one to your collection is an easy call.
usedCar.zh:
听说过Toyota Mark II吗？这款标志性的前置后驱车型
曾主导日本中型轿车市场数十年。

Mark II的运动版名为Tourer V，
我店里现在正好就有一台成色极好的。

是第八代的X100系列。
怎么样？看着像普通轿车，对吧？

不过等你见识过它那台凶悍的引擎再说：一台源自
A70 Supra的1JZ-GTE 2.5升直列六缸涡轮增压引擎！

它<280ps>的加速动力简直狂野，
5速手动变速箱更是让全球车迷为之着迷。

前后双叉臂悬挂调校偏软，
却抓地力十足，极高的可操控性令人惊叹。

如今把玩老式轿车的风潮再起，
所以把这台车收入车库，根本无需犹豫！

catch.en: This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.
catch.zh: 这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

vehicleCollection.en:
This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.

The Tourer V was a performance model added to the eighth-generation Mark II lineup. Its biggest selling point was its power unit: a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-6 engine that produced 276.1 HP and 278.5 ft-lb of torque. A 5-speed manual transmission was also available, and the roar of the 6-cylinder engine, combined with tremendous boost, hit as soon as the throttle pedal was floored. Even so, the interior was lavish and comfortable, bringing two seemingly opposite characters together in the Tourer V.

long.en: The Tourer V was a performance model added to the eighth-generation Mark II lineup. Its biggest selling point was its power unit: a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-6 engine that produced 276.1 HP and 278.5 ft-lb of torque. A 5-speed manual transmission was also available, and the roar of the 6-cylinder engine, combined with tremendous boost, hit as soon as the throttle pedal was floored. Even so, the interior was lavish and comfortable, bringing two seemingly opposite characters together in the Tourer V.
long.zh: Tourer V是第8代Mark II系列车款中新增的一款运动版车型。其最大卖点是动力单元：一台涡轮增压2.5升直列六缸引擎，可输出280 PS动力和38.5 公斤力米扭矩。该车还提供了5速手动变速箱。当你将油门踏板踩到底时，六缸引擎的轰鸣声，伴随着强大的增压推背感，向你瞬间袭来。有如此澎湃动力，Tourer V的内饰依然堪称奢华舒适，将两种看似矛盾的特质集于一身。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?

The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.

作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

The Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid car.
This is the third generation model, released in 2009.

The hybrid system in the third-gen model, introduced in 2009,
was 90% revamped, highlighted by a 1.8-liter inline-4.

The chassis was also significantly improved, making it a
smooth performer on the highway.

Oh, its fuel economy was enhanced as well, which meant that it
remained one of the most fuel-efficient cars in the world.

Prius是全球首款量产的混合动力汽车。这是它的第三代车
型，于2009年发布。

对了，此车的优秀燃油效率也不可忽视。即使以今天的
标准来看，它的指标也是十分优秀的。/

usedCar.en:
This third-generation Prius is arguably the world's
best known hybrid car.

Its 1.8-liter engine and electric motor work together to deliver
better fuel economy and fewer harmful emissions.

This particular model features the third iteration of
Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive.

Thanks to the torque from the electric motor, this Prius
is surprisingly quick off the line.

Never thought you could have fun driving the Prius, did you?
usedCar.zh:
这是一辆第三代Prius——它可能是世界上最知名的
混合动力车。

它的动力来源于一个由1.8L发动机、电动马达和
电池组构成的动力系统。

此型号还搭载了第三代Toyota
混合动力系统（Hybrid Synergy Drive）。

这辆车的引擎-马达控制得到了强化，其加速
性能也得到了提升。

这真是一辆潜力无穷的Prius！%

catch.en: This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.
catch.zh: 这台Prius的目标不仅仅是性能提升，还有驾驶乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.

The third-generation Prius remained synonymous with hybrid technology. This iteration sought to elevate not only its environmental credentials but also the pleasure of driving itself. Its newly sculpted body featured a sleek, aerodynamic silhouette that conveyed a sense of motion even at rest. The engine was upsized to 1.8 liters, and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system components were newly developed. Fuel efficiency reached an astonishing 89.4 MPG, introducing a new dimension to the driving experience, one where performance met the pure satisfaction of exceptional economy.

long.en: The third-generation Prius remained synonymous with hybrid technology. This iteration sought to elevate not only its environmental credentials but also the pleasure of driving itself. Its newly sculpted body featured a sleek, aerodynamic silhouette that conveyed a sense of motion even at rest. The engine was upsized to 1.8 liters, and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system components were newly developed. Fuel efficiency reached an astonishing 89.4 MPG, introducing a new dimension to the driving experience, one where performance met the pure satisfaction of exceptional economy.

broke new ground in design and functionality.

The Adventure grade carried rugged styling and had an efficient
2.0-liter engine paired with a CVT and all-wheel drive.

Of particular note was its Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system,
which directed torque to the rear wheels for sharper cornering.

For everyday driving, the system coulddisengage
all-wheel drive to enhance fuel efficiency.

Its Panoramic View Monitor gave drivers a bird’s-eye view around
the vehicle, making parking or navigating rough terrain easier.

Equally at home in the city or in the wild, the Toyota RAV4
pomised to take you anywhere, and do so in style.

vehicleCollection.en:
An adventurous SUV for active lifestyles.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” With its compact body and high ground clearance, it quickly gained followers around the world and reached its fifth generation in 2018. The Adventure grade brought rugged off-road styling, highlighted by a custom grille, skid-plate bumpers, and 19-inch wheel rims. A 2.0-liter inline-4 Dynamic Force Engine was mated to a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.

conversation.en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they
strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.

Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the <800cc> 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."

Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.

..plaed a central role in this design.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……

不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。

基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量<800cc>的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。

尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。

为丰田子公司“关
自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这Ub车的设计O中任了举足轻重的角色。

conversation.en: Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese motorsports. I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly built Suzuka Circuit. If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed "Yota-Hachi" was the finest... ...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi Circuit in July 1965. The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the driver was Tojiro Ukiya. After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback, moving up through the field to win the race! There was something almos divine about the performance he displayed that day.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！

如果你要问我“Yota-Hachi”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。

在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩

他在那天表现出mwM简直如有神助！

usedCar.en:
Toyota has produced some very cool sports cars over the years,
but one of the most memorable could be the Sports 800.

Introduced in 1965, it was called the "Yota-Hachi."

It was the first Japanese production model to feature aluminum
bodywork, so the car is extremely lightweight.

Weighing only <580kg>, it's half the size of today's cars.

While its air-cooled flat-2 produces only <45ps>, you can be
sure that it's a true sports car, thanks to its FR layout.
usedCar.zh:
Sports 800是Toyota跑车设计制造史上
一大杰作，诞生于20世纪60年代。

在日本，它以“Yota 8”的昵称
为人们所熟知...

Sports 800是首款采用铝制面板的
日产车型。

因此它的车身极为轻巧。

尽管它的风冷水平对置双缸引擎只能产生<45ps>的马力，
但它开起来就像是一辆真正的跑车。

catch.en: With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.
catch.zh: 被车迷爱称为“Toyota 8”的车型。宽胎搭配上较低的重心，在过弯时优势明显。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.

The Toyota Sports 800, affectionately known as the “Yota-Hachi,” was a compact sports car distinguished by its fixed B-pillar Targa-style removable roof panel. Extensive use of aluminum and acrylic throughout the body kept its weight down to just 1279 lbs. While its 750 cc engine produced a modest 44.4 HP, the car’s featherlight construction allowed it to reach a top speed of 96.3 mph—comparable to many 1.500 cc-class vehicles of its era.

long.en: The Toyota Sports 800, affectionately known as the “Yota-Hachi,” was a compact sports car distinguished by its fixed B-pillar Targa-style removable roof panel. Extensive use of aluminum and acrylic throughout the body kept its weight down to just 1279 lbs. While its 750 cc engine produced a modest 44.4 HP, the car’s featherlight construction allowed it to reach a top speed of 96.3 mph—comparable to many 1.500 cc-class vehicles of its era.
long.zh: 被昵称为“Yota-Hachi”的Toyota Sports 800是一款小型跑车，采用固定B柱式可拆卸车顶设计（即Targa顶）。车身大量采用铝合金和丙烯酸材质部件，将整车重量降至仅580 公斤。750 立方厘米引擎虽然仅有45 PS的功率输出，但凭借轻量化的车身，最高速度可达到155 公里/小时，这已经与当时许多1,500 立方厘米级别车型的速度相当了。

usedCar.en:
There were two versions of the Toyota AE86 that were released
at the same time: the Trueno and the Levin.

Do you know which was the more popular one? If you guessed
the Levin, you're absolutely right.

But this means that there are fewer used Truenos around today,
making them more of a collector's car than the Levin.

You can tell the difference between the cars by the headlights.
The Trueno has retractable ones, while the Levin's are fixed.

Under the hood is the 4A-G, a reliable 1.6-liter inline-4.

The front-engine/rear-drive sports car, or FR, weighs only
<900kg>, making it a fun car to toss around corners.
usedCar.zh:
哪一款AE86车型在发售时更受欢迎，
Trueno还是Levin？

不管你是否相信，Levin更受欢迎。
但不用为Trueno感到遗憾！

由于在发售之初缺乏人气，二手Trueno数量现在非常稀少，
如今已经成为了人们梦寐以求的收藏品。

Trueno的4A-G引擎是一款久经考验的1.6升直列四缸引擎...

它在过渡到更高转速范围时非常强劲
有力，也因此而闻名。

对于想要提高车技的车手来说，
Trueno作为一款车重约<900kg>的前置后驱跑车，正是他们的绝佳之选。

vehicleCollection.en:
The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.

In 1983, the Corolla and Sprinter lines largely transitioned to a front-wheel-drive layout, with the sole exception being the rear-wheel-drive AE86 variant—the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno—affectionately known as the "Hachi-Roku." It was offered as a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback coupe. Power came from a newly developed 1.6-liter DOHC 4A-GEU inline-4. While several rivals featured similar specifications, the Hachi-Roku continued to win over driving enthusiasts with its playful, rewarding handling.

vehicleCollection.en:
This variant of the Supra was a homologation model with special equipment for Group A racing.

Originally introduced as a variant of the Celica, the XX evolved into a standalone model in February 1986 with the debut of the Supra. Among its various trim levels, the most celebrated was the high-performance 3.0GT Turbo A—built for championship homologation—featuring the turbocharged 3.0-liter 7M-GTEU engine, producing 266.3 HP. It also featured a wider body, matching the North American specification at 68.7 inches, along with reinforced suspension.

long.en: Originally introduced as a variant of the Celica, the XX evolved into a standalone model in February 1986 with the debut of the Supra. Among its various trim levels, the most celebrated was the high-performance 3.0GT Turbo A—built for championship homologation—featuring the turbocharged 3.0-liter 7M-GTEU engine, producing 266.3 HP. It also featured a wider body, matching the North American specification at 68.7 inches, along with reinforced suspension.
long.zh: XX起初只是Celica的一个改款，后来在1986年2月独立成一个车型，并获得了Supra的名号。在所有不同档次型号之中，人气最高的就是高性能的3.0GT Turbo A。这个型号是专为参加锦标赛而生产的认证车型，采用了一台270 PS的7M-GTEU 3升涡轮增压引擎。此外，它还采用了与北美规格车型相同的1,745毫米宽车身，外加一套加强型悬挂。

conversation.en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.

The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.

Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had wo the series.

That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the seson...

In the end, the Tom's Supra Numb 36 came out
 top n the historic 1997 season.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。

这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！

甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。

因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！

而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦~
1997年冠lq决q中脱颖而出的最终王者！

collection.en:
The 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra is one of the most famous
race cars in the history of Japanese motorsport.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship was a very
popular event in Japan from the late 90s to the early 2000s,

Featuring cars like the Nissan Skyline GT-R, the Honda NSX,
and of course, the Toyota Supra.

Nissan's GT-R had always dominated the series title
from the start of the championships...

And the first Japanese car that challenged and overthrew
the GT-R was this 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

The Supra would go on to win the All Japan Grand Touring
Championship four times in total.

But it's this iconic TOM's Supra that I remember most fondly.
collection.zh:
1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是日本汽车运动史上最著名的赛车之一。

全日本GT锦标赛曾是90年代末期到2000年代初日
本非常热门的汽车赛事。

参赛车型包括了日产Skyline GT-R、本田NSX，
当然也少不了丰田Supra。

日产GT-R在赛事早期是最具有统治力的赛车……

且这辆1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是最先向它们发起挑战
并夺走其统治地位的日本挑战者。

Supra在日后总计赢得了四次全日本GT锦标赛，

但给我留下最深刻印象的还是这辆标志性的TOM'S Supra。

catch.en: This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.
catch.zh: 这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) ran until 2004, after which it evolved into the current Super GT series. Toyota entered the Supra into JGTC competition in 1994. During that era, the series was largely dominated by the Nissan Skyline GT-R; however, in 1997, the Supra finally broke through, capturing the season title with the No. 36 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

long.en: The All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) ran until 2004, after which it evolved into the current Super GT series. Toyota entered the Supra into JGTC competition in 1994. During that era, the series was largely dominated by the Nissan Skyline GT-R; however, in 1997, the Supra finally broke through, capturing the season title with the No. 36 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

conversation.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the orld.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.<next id=2000206 type=9p

在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受{了全球车迷
的喜爱。

鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，

那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新s感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的a莱斯勒时mJ乎i模一样。

catch.en: This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.
