vehicleCollection.en:
This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.

In May 1993, the Toyota Supra was reborn, shedding its long-nose silhouette in favor of a bold, muscular new design. At the heart of the twin-turbo 3.0-liter DOHC model was the legendary 2JZ engine, delivering 276.1 HP. The highest-grade variant came equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission and Bilstein suspension. Structural reinforcements, along with carefully tuned dampers and bushings, transformed the car into a refined high-performance machine.

long.en: In May 1993, the Toyota Supra was reborn, shedding its long-nose silhouette in favor of a bold, muscular new design. At the heart of the twin-turbo 3.0-liter DOHC model was the legendary 2JZ engine, delivering 276.1 HP. The highest-grade variant came equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission and Bilstein suspension. Structural reinforcements, along with carefully tuned dampers and bushings, transformed the car into a refined high-performance machine.
long.zh: 1993年5月，Toyota Supra重获新生，摒弃了传统的长车鼻设计，换上了更具魅力的肌肉形态。这个车型采用了著名的2JZ 3升双顶置凸轮轴双涡轮增压引擎，能够输出280 PS的动力。而最高档车型还搭载了一套六速手动变速箱和Bilstein悬挂。此外它还获得了结构强化，并对避震器和衬套进行了调校，让这只桀骜的野兽更易驯服。

brandCentral.en:
The TS030 Hybrid was Toyota's first ever hybrid race car,
designed for endurance events.

Developed to compete in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans
and World Endurance Championship...

...Toyota spent years refining its THS-R hybrid system.

The final product was realized through a collaboration between
Higashi-Fuji Technical Center and Toyota Motorsport.

Although its debut at Le Mans fell short of
the company's expectations...

It went on to claim an impressive 2nd place in the WEC!
brandCentral.zh:
TS030 Hybrid是Toyota有史以来制造的第一款混合动力赛车原型车，

是专门为参加2012年勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛
而开发的……

Toyota花费了数年时间完善其THS-R混合动力系统。

最终产品在东富士技术中心和Toyota Motorsport的通力合作下
诞生。

虽然未能在勒芒耐力赛的首次亮相中取得期望的成绩……

但随后在世界耐力锦标赛上技惊四座，夺得了亚军！

catch.en: The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.
catch.zh: 参加勒芒24小时耐力赛和WEC的原型赛车，采用混动系统。

vehicleCollection.en:
The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

The TS030 Hybrid was developed to compete in the 2012 World Endurance Championship. Its THS-R powertrain was the result of a collaborative effort between Toyota’s production hybrid engineers and the motorsports division at the Higashi-Fuji Technical Center, built around a newly designed V-8 engine. Although it was forced to retire during its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the car went on to claim three victories over the season, ultimately securing 2nd place in the championship standings.

long.en: The TS030 Hybrid was developed to compete in the 2012 World Endurance Championship. Although it was forced to retire during its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the car went on to claim three victories over the season, ultimately securing 2nd place in the championship standings.
long.zh: 这辆TS030 Hybrid是专为参加2012世界耐力锦标赛所开发。它的“THS-R”动力系统由Toyota的量产混动开发团队与东富士技术中心的赛车运动部门合作打造，采用了一部全新设计的V8引擎。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这辆车不幸被迫退赛。但在接下来的整个赛季里，它夺得了3场胜利，并最终在排行榜上位列第二。

conversation.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type

非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！

2016年，丰田为旗下所属的Gazoo Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与保时捷919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。

不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的丰田赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。

不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，丰田却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年马自达787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

conversation.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.

While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.

There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche teamcouldn't believe its luck.

In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
自2012年以来，Toyota一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。

在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。

不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的Toyota却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的Porsche车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

_激动人心的是，Toyota在之y的五年里连战连捷，

就连捡漏的Porsche车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

dialogues.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type

展开激烈对决的一年。

不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的丰田赛车却遭遇

brandCentral.en:
This prototype, introduced at Le Mans in 2016, was yet another
effort from Toyota to grab that elusive title.

The naturally-aspirated V-8 of its predecessor, the TS040,
was replaced with a twin-turbocharged V-6.

In fact, almost everything, from the battery system to its
aerodynamics, was totally redesigned.

Although its <1000ps> power output was similar to the TS040,
the way it behaved on the track was totally different.
brandCentral.zh:
作为Toyota追逐胜利的最新尝试，这辆原型车在2016年勒芒耐
力赛上粉墨登场。

其前任车型TS040采用的自然进气V8引擎在这款车上被换成
了V6双涡轮增压引擎。

而事实上，从电池系统到空气动力学方案，车辆的每一
个方面都进行了重新设计。

它的输出功率虽然和TS040类似，都是<1000ps>，但驾驶体验却有
天壤之别。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's hybrid LMP1 car was developed to dominate the World Endurance Championship.

The TS050 - Hybrid was developed for competition in the 2016 World Endurance Championship. It featured motor generator units (MGUs) on both the front and rear axles, paired with a V-6 direct-injection twin-turbocharged engine. The combined output of the engine and electric motors reached 986.2 HP. While the car showed strong potential as a title contender, it ultimately finished 3rd in the drivers’ standings. It also secured 3rd place in the manufacturers’ rankings.

long.en: The TS050 - Hybrid was developed for competition in the 2016 World Endurance Championship. It featured motor generator units (MGUs) on both the front and rear axles, paired with a V-6 direct-injection twin-turbocharged engine. The combined output of the engine and electric motors reached 986.2 HP. While the car showed strong potential as a title contender, it ultimately finished 3rd in the drivers’ standings. It also secured 3rd place in the manufacturers’ rankings.
long.zh: 这辆TS050 - Hybrid 是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛所开发。这辆车安装有一部V6直喷双涡轮增压引擎，前后轴上还安装了电机发电机单元。引擎和电机的总动力输出达到了1,000 PS。这辆车来势汹汹，似乎对车手冠军头衔志在必得，但最终只在排行榜上屈居第三。而在车厂排行上，这款车也以第三名的成绩收官。

usedCar.en:
I'm sure you know the Japanese manga called "Initial D."
If not, you might want to check out the anime series.

The automotive star of the show was the Toyota AE86, and
this exposure increased the car's popularity tenfold.

Initial D creator, Shuichi Shigeno, was a big fan of the car and
wanted the main character, Takumi Fujiwara, to own one.

The manga was first published in 1995 and an anime series
soon followed, reaching a huge global audience.
usedCar.sourceName: Sprinter Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version) '00
usedCar.zh:
AE86的人气经久不衰，众多原因之一
就是它在《头文字D》系列漫画中有着重要的地位。

头文字D的作者重野秀一是这款车的
死忠粉。

它采用自然进气引擎，是能够体现
高超调校技术的典型代表。

驾驶这款车就仿佛是在驾驶藤原拓海的
AE86，给人一种穿越到漫画中的感觉！

catch.en: This modified 86 was built to order for the author of the "Initial D" comic books.
catch.zh: 调校版86，专为《头文字D》作者量身定制。

vehicleCollection.en:
This modified 86 was built to order for the author of the "Initial D" comic books.

This car was the Trueno owned by Shuichi Shigeno, the creator of the acclaimed manga "Initial D," which prominently featured the "Hachi-Roku" AE86 Levin and Trueno models. Fitted with an HKS exhaust manifold and a Trust silencer, its engine was tuned to produce 207.1 HP. A TRD suspension kit was also installed, enabling agile handling and high cornering speeds.

long.en: This car was the Trueno owned by Shuichi Shigeno, the creator of the acclaimed manga "Initial D," which prominently featured the "Hachi-Roku" AE86 Levin and Trueno models. Fitted with an HKS exhaust manifold and a Trust silencer, its engine was tuned to produce 207.1 HP. A TRD suspension kit was also installed, enabling agile handling and high cornering speeds.
long.zh: 这台车是人气漫画《头文字D》作者重野秀一所拥有的Trueno，该漫画对“Hachi-Roku”，即AE86型Levin/Trueno有很多描绘。该车加装了HKS排气歧管和Trust消音器，使引擎输出动力提升至210 PS。此外还配备了TRD悬挂套件，实现了敏捷的车身动态和高速过弯能力。

conversation.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.

Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.

It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundratuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.

And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars fiished.

在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达<1600km>的比赛

这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车

丰田公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，

汽车中只b辆完赛的~中得最终的胜利。

brandCentral.en:
The Tundra is Toyota's entry into the full-size
pickup truck segment.

The TRD Pro is the so-called "sports version" of this
versatile vehicle.

As its name suggests, it was produced by TRD, Toyota's
in-house motorsports division.

Thanks to specially produced dampers and wheels, this truck
was able to reach high speeds over the roughest of terrains.

Power was supplied by a 5.7-liter V-8 engine.

Combine that with 4WD capability, this massive beast
could also tow almost anything anywhere.

它由Toyota的内部汽车运动专业团队TRD负责开发……

它的特制避震和车轮能够在哪怕最崎岖的地形上达到令
人乍舌的高速。

依靠性能强大的5.7L V8引擎

和四轮驱动传动系统，您可以轻松地驱动这台超过2.5吨
的怪物。

Its suspension was refined with the addition of Fox dampers, while a newly designed hood scoop and BBS wheels enhanced its aggressive appearance.

RR-layout and e same creatorʃs truy fascinating!

dialogues.en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.

Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…

...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."

Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.

Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。
这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……

由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。

Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……

从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……

dialogues.en:
Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911
have some common linkages?

The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche,
the founder of Porsche Automobiles.

It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the
car that drives the rear wheels...

Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!

Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to
thefirst Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...

...and later the Porsche 911.

What started out as a small people's car
ended up as a genuine sports car.

While there may be a world of difference
between the two...

...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine,
RR-layout and e same creatorʃs truy fascinating!
h
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
你知道大众甲壳虫和保时捷911之间有一些
共同的联系吗？

甲壳虫是由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的，他同时也是
保时捷汽车的创始人。

甲壳虫的车身后部配置了一台水平对置引擎，用于驱动后轮……

这使它成为了名副其实的后置引擎、后轮驱动车型！

保时捷博士后来将甲壳虫的设计元素应用了第一辆保时捷跑车，
保时捷356……

以及后来的保时捷911上。

可以这么说，最初的小型民用汽车设计最终却变成了真正的跑车。

虽然现在两者之间可能有天壤b别……

但它们都采用水平对置引擎、后置后驱布局，]且
发明o是一个人的事实确实耐人寻味！

dialogues.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.

The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.

With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evove again.

But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.

Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, an it’s still popular!

usedCar.en:
You probably know this car as the Beetle, but its official
name is the Volkswagen Type 1.

It has a RR layout, meaning its air-cooled flat-4 engine
sits behind the rear axle and powers the rear tires.

The Beetle's unique strengths have made it a frequent
participant in drag racing and other motorsports...

...because when properly tuned, this round compact coupe
can be surprisingly quick.
usedCar.zh:
人们亲切地称它为“the Beetle"。这款标志性汽车
在世界范围内都备受喜爱。

它以后置后驱的布局搭载了一台风冷平置四缸发动机，
使得其后轮能够产生大量牵引力。

这种特性让它成为了直线加速赛以及
其他汽车竞赛中的常客。

由于这款车不缺替换零件，
你可以常常在赛道上遇到飞驰的改装款Beetle！]

catch.en: Its cute silhouette and rear-engine layout made this car an icon in automobiledom.

vehicleCollection.en:
Its cute silhouette and rear-engine layout made this car an icon in automobiledom.

Often referred to by its nicknames—most famously, the "Beetle"—the Volkswagen Type I was a rear-wheel-drive vehicle powered by an air-cooled, rear-mounted 4-cylinder engine. Produced from 1938 to 2003, it saw over 21 million units built. The Volkswagen 1200 was the official designation for the version produced between the mid-1950s and late 1960s, which featured a 1.2-liter engine.

Produced from 1938 to 2003, it saw over 21 million units built. The Volkswagen 1200 was the official designation for the version produced between the mid-1950s and late 1960s, which featured a 1.2-liter engine.
long.zh: 以“甲壳虫”为世人所熟知的Volkswagen Type I是一款后轮驱动车型，它的气冷式4缸引擎也安装在车身后部。这款车的生产周期从1938年一直持续到2003年，总共生产了超过2100万辆。从二十世纪50年代中期到60年代末期生产的型号安装了一台1.2升引擎，而它的正式名称就是Volkswagen 1200。

The Beetle Gr.3 is a racing variant of Volkswagen’s iconic compact, engineered to comply with Gr.3 regulations. The spirit of the GTI was glorified with the GTI Roadster

This sporty, open-top 2-seater is a stunner!

You'll notice that its body makes use of various design
motifs from previous GTI models.

But perhaps the most striking aspect of its design
is the incredibly low-cut windscreen.

Appearances aside, it comes powered by a potent <510ps>

usedCar.en:
The first-generation Golf GTI has become a true classic because
it ushered in a new generation of European hot hatches.

Like many hatchbacks of its day, it employs an FF layout,
or front-engine/front-wheel drive.

The car's 1.6-liter inline-4 produces <110ps>.

Its rock-solid stability on straights, combined with its balanced
handling, make it a fun car on winding roads.

The Golf's styling was penned by acclaimed designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Thanks to his amazing talents, the Golf has become one of
the most recognized cars on the road.
usedCar.zh:
第一代Golf GTI是真正的经典，它是
现代传统高性能掀背车的先驱。

它采用前置前驱布局：
前置引擎前轮驱动系统。

1.6L的直列四缸引擎可产生
高达<110ps>的马力。

它在直道上坚如磐石的稳定性，结合稳固
的操作性，使它成为车手最可靠的选择。

Golf的造型出自备受赞誉的设计师
Giorgetto Giugiaro。

他的设计使得这款车成为
最具辨识度的公路车之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This grandfather of hot hatches balanced everyday usability with a fun-to-drive nature.

Released in 1974, the Volkswagen Golf quickly rose to popularity as a pioneer of the compact car segment. The sporty GTI variant featured a 1.6-liter inline-4 SOHC engine with Bosch fuel injection, producing 108.5 HP. Blending performance with everyday practicality, the GTI redefined the concept of sporty driving.

long.en: Released in 1974, the Volkswagen Golf quickly rose to popularity as a pioneer of the compact car segment. The sporty GTI variant featured a 1.6-liter inline-4 SOHC engine with Bosch fuel injection, producing 108.5 HP. Blending performance with everyday practicality, the GTI redefined the concept of sporty driving.
long.zh: Volkswagen Golf于1974年推出，作为紧凑型车型的开拓者获得了巨大成功。运动版“GTI”搭载1.6升直列四缸顶置单凸轮轴引擎，配备Bosch燃油喷射系统，输出功率可达110 PS。GTI完美融合了高性能与实用性，开创了运动驾驶的全新标准。

conversation.en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.

While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.

Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。

多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。

它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

为您带来高速而令人满意的驾驶体验！

vehicleCollection.en:
The GTI version of the 7th-generation Golf ups its handling performance.

Unveiled in 2012, the seventh-generation Golf was built on a new platform that introduced a host of advancements. Handling was notably enhanced through the use of XDS—an electronically controlled differential lock—alongside DCC adaptive chassis control and progressive steering. These technologies improved stability and allowed for much higher cornering speeds.

long.en: Unveiled in 2012, the seventh-generation Golf was built on a new platform that introduced a host of advancements. Handling was notably enhanced through the use of XDS—an electronically controlled differential lock—alongside DCC adaptive chassis control and progressive steering. These technologies improved stability and allowed for much higher cornering speeds.
long.zh: 2012年首次亮相的第7代Volkswagen Golf基于新平台打造，从而将各种改进化为现实。最值得一提的是，该车的操控性在“XDS”（一种工作原理与限滑差速器类似的电子差速器锁定系统）、“DCC”适应性底盘控制和渐进式转向的加持下得到了改善。这些改进提升了车辆的稳定性和高速过弯性能。

vehicleCollection.zh:
7代高尔夫的GTI版本，操作性能达到巅峰。

2012年首次亮相的第7代Volkswagen Golf基于新平台打造，从而将各种改进化为现实。最值得一提的是，该车的操控性在“XDS”（一种工作原理与限滑差速器类似的电子差速器锁定系统）、“DCC”适应性底盘控制和渐进式转向的加持下得到了改善。这些改进提升了车辆的稳定性和高速过弯性能。

brandCentral.en:
Volkswagen introduced the first production version of its ID.
series of battery electric cars in 2020.

This ID.R played a symbolic role in the launching
of the new brand.

An all-electric racer, it was fitted with two electric motors
in the front and back that produced <680ps>.

And, an AWD system efficiently transferred the power
down to the ground.

A competitor in global time trial events since 2018,
the ID.R set several world records during its heyday.

It was the first car tobreak the so-called "eight-minute
barrier" at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.

Pikes Peak is the world’s premier hill climbing event,
held annually in Colorado, USA.

At the Nürburgring Norschleife in Germany, it beat the
previous recor set by an electric car by 60 seconds.

And, it was the first car to fish under 40 sends a the
legendary Goodwood Festival of Speed in England!
brandCentral.zh:
大众的ID.系列纯电动车在2020年推出了
它的第一个量产车型。

这款ID.R在新品牌投放和推广时起到了标志性的作用。

作为一辆全电动赛车，它的前部和后部各安装了两个电机，
能够输出<680ps>的功率。

由四轮驱动系统有效地将庞大的动力通过车轮传送到路面上。

自2018年以来，ID.R就开始参加全球范围内的计时赛事，
并已经创造了多项世界纪录。

它是第一辆在派克.国际爬坡赛上打破“八分钟大关”的汽车。

该比赛是世界上首屈一指的爬坡赛事，每年在
美国科罗拉多州举行。

在德国的纽博格林北侧赛道，它以缩短整整1分钟的成绩
打破了之前由电A汽车创造的记录。

同时，它也是第一辆在传奇的古德X德赛车节R`
以
于40秒的成绩完赛的汽车！

catch.en: The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.
catch.zh: 这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

vehicleCollection.en:
The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.

Volkswagen’s prototype race car stood as a symbol of carbon reduction and future performance. Its carbon-fiber body featured prominent front and rear wings, while two electric motors powered both the front and rear axles for all-wheel drive. The car delivered astonishing performance, setting record-breaking times at Pikes Peak, the Nürburgring Nordschleife, and Goodwood.

long.en: Volkswagen’s prototype race car stood as a symbol of carbon reduction and future performance. Its carbon-fiber body featured prominent front and rear wings, while two electric motors powered both the front and rear axles for all-wheel drive. The car delivered astonishing performance, setting record-breaking times at Pikes Peak, the Nürburgring Nordschleife, and Goodwood.
long.zh: Volkswagen的原型赛车堪称碳减排的典范。碳纤维车身前后配备大型扰流翼，采用双电机布局分别驱动前后车轴。此车同时拥有惊人的性能表现，在派克峰爬坡赛、纽博格林北侧赛道以及古德伍德速度节等赛事中创下了令人瞩目的圈速记录。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

Volkswagen的原型赛车堪称碳减排的典范。碳纤维车身前后配备大型扰流翼，采用双电机布局分别驱动前后车轴。此车同时拥有惊人的性能表现，在派克峰爬坡赛、纽博格林北侧赛道以及古德伍德速度节等赛事中创下了令人瞩目的圈速记录。

This fifth generation Polo GTI is a petite hot hatch
that's a size smaller than the Golf...

Which stands to reason, as the original Polo debuted
in 1975 as the Golf’s 'little brother'.

This generation Polo GTI came with two different engines
depending on whether it is an early model or late model,

But this is the late model that debuted in 2014,
which came with a turbocharged 1.8L inline-4 cylinder engine.

It's capable of producing <192ps> and <25.5kgm> of torque
from just <1250rpm>!

Small but speedy, this model also features an upgraded
chassis and improved handling.
brandCentral.zh:
这台第五代Polo GTI是一款身材娇小的高性能掀背车，它的
尺寸比Golf还要小……

这也是理所当然的。

这一代Polo GTI的早期车型和晚期车型使用了不同的引擎，

您眼前的这款是2014年亮相的晚期车型，它有一台涡轮增
压的1.8L直列四缸引擎，

能在仅仅<1250rpm>的转速下，产生<192ps>的动力和<25.5kgm>的扭矩！

小而轻快就是它的代名词。此外，这款第五代产品的底
盘和操控也经过了改进！

vehicleCollection.en:
The 'hot' version of the 5th generation Polo uses an advanced engine setup.

This was the high-performance variant of the fifth-generation Polo, Volkswagen’s standout in the compact car segment. Initially powered by a 1.4-liter engine featuring both a supercharger and turbocharger, the 2014 update saw a switch to a 1.8-liter turbocharged unit, delivering 189.3 HP along with improved fuel efficiency. With performance worthy of the GTI badge, it stood as a strong contender among B-segment hot hatches.

usedCar.en:
Volkswagen has a number of famous models aside from
the Beetle, such as the "Camper."

Officially known as the Type 2, it's based on the Type 1,
which we all know better as the Beetle.

Like the Type 1, it has a rear-engine/rear-drive layout,
which we refer to as RR.

Because the designers kept the air-cooled flat-4 engine low,
there's a surprising amount of interior space.

Like the Beetle, plenty of tuning parts are available, allowing
owners to customize the car to their heart's content.
usedCar.zh:
这又是一款闻名世界的Volkswagen车——人们
亲切地称它为“露营者”。

它的官方代号为Type 2，是
基于Type 1——“甲壳虫”而开发的车型。

这辆车采用了后置后驱布局，搭载了一台风冷平置
四缸发动机。

较小的引擎尺寸为搭载货物让出了空间。

由于它的调校件非常好找，这辆车
开起来非常有意思。

catch.en: With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.
catch.zh: 具有露营车风格，以最小的体量实现了最大的内部空间。

vehicleCollection.en:
With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.

Dr. Ferdinand Porsche’s Volkswagen was developed into a broad range of variants. One such version was the Sambabus, which reimagined the car as a van with generous luggage capacity. By positioning the horizontally-opposed engine at the very rear, designers were able to create a wide, low floor while preserving the vehicle’s compact footprint. This clever layout gave the model a number of advantages as a commercial vehicle, adding to its appeal and versatility.

long.en: Dr. Ferdinand Porsche’s Volkswagen was developed into a broad range of variants. One such version was the Sambabus, which reimagined the car as a van with generous luggage capacity. By positioning the horizontally-opposed engine at the very rear, designers were able to create a wide, low floor while preserving the vehicle’s compact footprint. This clever layout gave the model a number of advantages as a commercial vehicle, adding to its appeal and versatility.
long.zh: 由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的Volkswagen车型推出过多种不同版本。其中一款改成了厢式货车，提供更大的行李空间，那就是Sambabus。通过将水平对置引擎安装在车尾，设计师成功地在保持紧凑车身尺寸的同时，腾出了宽敞且极低的地板空间。这一高实用性的特点给了这个车型诸多优点，使其成为了一款非常成功的商用车辆。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
The foundation for this Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car
was the Volkswagen Scirocco.

The small front splitter and rear wing, although modest,
make a huge positive impact on the car's aerodynamics.

Its compact size makes it extremely nimble, and despite being
a front-wheel-drive car, it can handle with the best of them.
brandCentral.zh:
打造这辆原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车时使用的基础
车型是一台Volkswagen Scirocco。

小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼表明这款车在外形改装方面采
用了较为温和的做法。

无论是前置前驱布局的优秀稳定性，还是Scirocco那指向明确
的过弯性能都在这台车上得到了保留。

catch.en: This attractive coupe possessed the sharp cornering ability of a full-fledged sports car.
catch.zh: 堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

vehicleCollection.en:
This attractive coupe possessed the sharp cornering ability of a full-fledged sports car.

A Gran Turismo Original, Volkswagen’s sleek Scirocco sports coupe has been reimagined to meet Gr.4 race standards. Its aerodynamic enhancements are subtle—a modest front splitter and a compact rear wing—underscoring a focus on preserving the strengths of the base model. The result is a front-wheel-drive machine with remarkable cornering prowess.

long.en: A Gran Turismo Original, Volkswagen’s sleek Scirocco sports coupe has been reimagined to meet Gr.4 race standards. Its aerodynamic enhancements are subtle—a modest front splitter and a compact rear wing—underscoring a focus on preserving the strengths of the base model. The result is a front-wheel-drive machine with remarkable cornering prowess.
long.zh: 对Volkswagen那独具风格的Scirocco跑车进行Gr.4规格改装，便得到了这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。在空气动力学方面，它采用了相对低调保守的设计，只安装了小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼。但这辆车的开发重心是发挥基础车型的高性能，并实现了远超大部分前驱车的过弯性能。

vehicleCollection.zh:

brandCentral.en:
If you're searching for a powerful FF sports car,
I would recommend the Scirocco R.

It comes with upgraded suspension and brakes, and turbocharged
2.0-liter inline-4 that produced <250ps>.

While its specs are similar to the Golf R, it is about <120kg>
lighter, thanks to the absence of the 4WD system.

You can really feel the weight difference when
taking sharp corners.

如果您想寻找一辆动力出众的前置前驱跑车，我推荐Scirocco R！

此车配备了升级的悬挂和刹车系统，以及一台2L直列四
缸涡轮增压引擎，可以产生<250ps>动力。

虽然规格上与Golf R相似，但由于去掉了四驱系统，所以
重量要比后者轻<120kg>。

在过急弯时，您就可以切实感受到这种差异了。{

usedCar.en:
There aren't many front-engine/front-wheel-drive cars out there
that you can call sporty, but the Scirocco R is one of them.

With its low height and wide body, you can tell that the
2-door coupe is all business just by looking at it.

Hidden under the sheet metal is a custom sport-tuned suspension
that gives the Scirocco R real sports-car handling.

And the car's turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 packs a mean
<250ps> punch, making it a monster on the race track.

大众尚酷R就能够满足你的需求。

自豪宣称专为赛车运动而生。

专属定制的悬挂和刹车设计使得它能够在
弯道拥有卓越表现...

它的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎能够产生最高<250ps>马力，

vehicleCollection.en:
This attractive coupe possesses the sharp cornering ability of a fully-fledged sports car.

The Scirocco R was a high-performance sports coupe developed from the core architecture of the Golf. Its body sat lower, with a wider track for enhanced stability, and is fitted with unique bumpers, side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler. Significant upgrades were made to the suspension and braking systems. Lighter than the Golf R of the same era, the Scirocco R was refined into a nimble, high-spec sports machine with a sharp, responsive edge.

long.en: The Scirocco R was a high-performance sports coupe developed from the core architecture of the Golf. Significant upgrades were made to the suspension and braking systems. Lighter than the Golf R of the same era, the Scirocco R was refined into a nimble, high-spec sports machine with a sharp, responsive edge.
long.zh: Scirocco R是一款基于Golf基础组件开发的高性能运动轿跑车。车身采用低离地间隙和宽轮距设计，配备了专用保险杠、侧边包围和车顶扰流板。悬挂系统和制动系统也得到了重大升级。这款车相比同期推出的Golf R更加轻盈，被精心打造成一台“身手矫健”的高规格运动车型。

conversation.en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.

The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European
and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’

Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...

It remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world still love to this day!

在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。

其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。

除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……

它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！
K

usedCar.en:
Say the word "estate" to European car enthusiasts, and they're
bound to think of the Volvo 240 Estate.

This station wagon made its debut in 1974 and enjoyed a long
life, with a production run that stretched for two decades.

Although it was discontinued more than thirty years ago,
the model remains popular to this day.

Built with the philosophy of form following function,
the 240 provides excellent outward vision and superb handling.

Some users have logged several hundred-thousand kilometers on
their vehicles, so you can bet it's a reliable machine.

Sure, it may not be fast, but it's stylish and has plenty of luggage
space, making it the ideal companion for extended road trips.
usedCar.zh:
当你听到“旅行车”这个词时，第一个浮现在脑海里的
一定是Volvo 240 Estate。

在1974年首次亮相后，这一车型持续生产了近二十年。

尽管停产已超过三十年，但时至今日它的人气依然很高。

它不仅有充足、高效的宽敞储物空间，还能够提供优秀
的视野和一流的操控性。

像这样一辆设计虽然简单、但永不过时的可靠车型，安全行
驶数十万公里也不在话下！

虽然速度并不是它的优势，但无论何时、不论去哪，
你都会想与它同行。

catch.en: A historic model that epitomized the station wagon.
catch.zh: 这款拥有特殊历史意义的车型让全世界对旅行车爱不释手。

vehicleCollection.en:
A historic model that epitomized the station wagon.

The Volvo 240 Estate became synonymous with the Swedish brand's image as a station wagon maker. Its boxy shape and long profile became design signatures that made the vehicle popular to all. Inside, it offered a minimalist Scandinavian interior with plush, sofa-like seating. Its production run ended in 1993, but the 240 remains a beloved classic, still seen in daily use, a rarity among vintage cars.

long.en: The Volvo 240 Estate became synonymous with the Swedish brand's image as a station wagon maker. Its boxy shape and long profile became design signatures that made the vehicle popular to all. Inside, it offered a minimalist Scandinavian interior with plush, sofa-like seating. Its production run ended in 1993, but the 240 remains a beloved classic, still seen in daily use, a rarity among vintage cars.
long.zh: 240 Estate这台车是奠定了Volvo旅行车制造商形象的经典之作。其最大魅力在于棱角分明的方正造型与修长的车身比例。其余亮点包括简约独特的北欧风格内饰及柔软如沙发的座椅。尽管已停产多年，这台车仍被许多人珍视为日常座驾，这在经典车型中实属罕见。

conversation.en:
Yes, I can recall when this Volvo V40 debuted like it was yesterday.
It was in 2012, if I’m not mistaken.

It was a 5-door compact hatchback that exemplified
the company's dedication to practicality and safety.

What’s more, it had beautiful coupe-like styling.

I’ll have you know, this styling borrowed many design cues
from the great Volvos of the 1960s.

We're talking P1800 and 1800ES, for instance.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
没错，我还依稀记得这辆Volvo V40首发时的情景。
如果我没记错的话，那是在2012年。

这是一款5门紧凑型掀背车，从头到尾贯彻了Volvo
那久经考验的实用性哲学。

此外，它还采用了雅致的双门轿跑外形风格。

我必须要告诉你，这种设计风格从来自1960年代的
伟大Volvo车型身上吸取了不少的灵感。

例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典Volvo车型！

conversation.en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.

Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!

Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.
e
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
沃尔沃V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……

尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design。

它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。

它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的猎装P1800 E……

而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。

真是非常了不起的灵感来源。

注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。

这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。<next id=2203009 typ=9A

brandCentral.en:
This V40 was Volvo’s most popular product in the 2010s.

It was an elegant compact hatchback...

...which combined the simplicity of a sedan with
the utility of a station wagon.

Its exterior styling was strongly influenced by classic Volvos
of the 1960s, such as the P1800 and 1800ES.

And, thanks to the company's innovative safety features,
the V40 gained extreme popularity as a family hauler.

The T5 R-Design was the sportiest of the line, possessing
sports-car-like handling that catered to enthusiast drivers.
brandCentral.zh:
V40系列是Volvo在新世纪第一个十年打造的杰作。

它结合了轿车的简约和强韧与旅行车的功能性……

打造出一款极致优雅的紧凑型掀背车。

从设计角度分析，它从1960年代的传奇车型1800
以及1800ES身上汲取了大量灵感。

这款车配备了多种Volvo标志性的安全功能，在全世界
范围内拥有大量拥趸。

其T5 R-Design版本是产品系列中最具运动感的车型，
因其灵敏的操控性而备受推崇。

catch.en: The globally successful Volvo that served as a sedan, estate and coupe.
catch.zh: 身兼轿车、旅行车和双门轿车三种身份，在全球范围内取得巨大成功的Volvo车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The globally successful Volvo that served as a sedan, estate and coupe.

The V40 was a 5-door hatchback positioned in the C-segment. Drawing inspiration from Volvo classics of the 1960s—such as the P1800 and 1800ES—its flowing silhouette blended cues of both a coupe and a wagon. The T5 R-Design was the sportiest model in the lineup. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 producing 210.1 HP, it was paired with a sport suspension and 18-inch wheels to deliver sharp, refined handling.

long.en: The V40 was a 5-door hatchback positioned in the C-segment. Drawing inspiration from Volvo classics of the 1960s—such as the P1800 and 1800ES—its flowing silhouette blended cues of both a coupe and a wagon. The T5 R-Design was the sportiest model in the lineup. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 producing 210.1 HP, it was paired with a sport suspension and 18-inch wheels to deliver sharp, refined handling.
long.zh: V40是瞄准C级车定位的5门掀背车型。汲取Volvo 1960年代经典车型如P1800和1800ES的设计灵感，流畅的车身轮廓既可诠释为双门轿车，也可视为旅行车。T5 R-Design是该系列中最具运动性的车型。2L直列五缸涡轮增压引擎输出213 PS，运动悬挂和18英寸轮毂带来敏锐而平顺的操控体验。

This machine is a 1951 Ford.

brandCentral.en:
Held in Las Vegas, Nevada, the SEMA Show is the world's
largest automotive aftermarket event.

The car you see here, the Wicked Fabrication GT 51...

...won the "Best in Show Gran Turismo Award" at the
2016 SEMA Show.

It was designed by former racing driver Bruce Leven...

...and built at the Wicked Fabrication factory in Alabama.

To realize a modern-day classical racing Ford...

...Leven based his creation on a 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe.

He installed a race-tuned V-8 under the hood and reinforced
the chassis for serious track sessions.

According to Wicked Fabrication, more than 10,000 hours
were spent in building this special car.
brandCentral.zh:
每年在美国举行的美国汽车用品改装车展览会（SEMA）
是世界上最大的改装汽车盛会。

Wicked Fabrication GT51曾在2016年参加车展

并赢得了Gran Turismo“最佳巡展”大奖！

这款车是由前赛车手布鲁斯·列文设计的，

并在阿拉巴马州的Wicked Fabrication工厂制造。

它的设计理念是打造一台“经典Ford赛车”，

因此基于1951年的Ford Custom Club Coupe进行改装……

并安装了一个经过竞速调校的V8引擎。底盘也依照竞速
需求进行了加固。

你能从这台小美人身上明显看到改装师为其倾注的超过
10000个小时的心血！/

catch.en: More than 10,000 labor hours went into this 2016 Gran Turismo Award winner.
catch.zh: 这辆2016年Gran Turismo奖得主车款总共耗费了10000小时的设计与制造工时。

vehicleCollection.en:
More than 10,000 labor hours went into this 2016 Gran Turismo Award winner.

The Gran Turismo Award was presented to standout custom cars showcased at SEMA. In 2016, the 14th award went to the Wicked Fabrications GT 51—a 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe crafted by a team of specialists for former racing driver Bruce Leven. The project required an estimated 10,000 hours to complete.

brandCentral.en:
Perhaps best known as a smartphone maker, Xiaomi arrived
on the EV scene in spring 2024 with its record-setting SU7.

The SU7 Ultra is a high-performance model that ran the
Nürburgring Nordschleife with a time of 7:04:957.

Its body employs innovative Gigacasting technology
that seamlessly integrates the battery and chassis.

Powered by three electric motors (one in front and two at rear),
it delivers a maximum output of <1548ps>!

A host of aerodynamic components and lightweight carbo-fiber
panels help it achieve a maximum downforce of <285kg>.

The suspension combines air springs and adaptive dampers with
torque-vectoring control for greatly enhanced handling.

With automobiles now part of Xiaomi’s expanding ecosystem,
the S7 Ultra is poised to stand as its flagship model.
brandCentral.zh:
以智能手机制造商闻名的小米，在2024年春季凭借
创纪录的SU7强势进军电动车领域。

SU7 Ultra高性能版本以7分04.957秒的成绩
征服纽博格林北环赛道。

车身采用创新的CTB一体化电池技术，
实现电池与底盘的无缝融合。

搭载三电机系统（一前两后），最大功率达<1548ps>！

众多空气动力学组件与轻量化碳纤维板材
共同创造高达<285kg>的极致下压力。

悬挂系统集成空气弹簧与自适应减震器，
配合扭矩矢量分配系统显著提升操控表现。

随着汽车业务加入小米生态，
SU7 Ultra必将担当品牌旗舰重任。

catch.en: It's the smartphone giant’s expression of automotive innovation.
catch.zh: 智能手机巨头推出的极致出行解决方案。

vehicleCollection.en:
It's the smartphone giant’s expression of automotive innovation.

The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra was an extreme performance version of the first car from smart device maker Xiaomi, the SU7 sports sedan. The all-wheel-drive system, which used three electric motors spread across the front and rear axles, boasted a total system output of 1526.6 HP. The "V8" model motors located on the rear axle were the most powerful in any production car, able to rotate at speeds of up to 27,200 rpm. Also, extensive aerodynamic development resulted in the car being able to produce up to 628 lbs of downforce.

long.en: The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra was an extreme performance version of the first car from smart device maker Xiaomi, the SU7 sports sedan. The all-wheel-drive system, which used three electric motors spread across the front and rear axles, boasted a total system output of 1526.6 HP. The "V8" model motors located on the rear axle were the most powerful in any production car, able to rotate at speeds of up to 27,200 rpm. Also, extensive aerodynamic development resulted in the car being able to produce up to 628 lbs of downforce.
long.zh: 智能设备厂商小米进军汽车市场后推出的首款车型是小米SU7运动型轿车，小米SU7 Ultra是它的极致性能版本。该车的全轮驱动系统在前后轴布置了共三台电机，系统综合输出功率高达1,548 PS。其中布置于后轴的“V8”电机，功率输出超过所有当前量产车型，最高转速可达27,200 转每分。此外，深度的空气动力学研发使得该车能够产生285 公斤的下压力。

conversation.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.

The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!

With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.

The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。

作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！

四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。

这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

brandCentral.en:
The rapid rise of Chinese automotive design has been evident
across everything from road cars to supercars.

And the Yangwang U9 by BYD stands as a shining example—
an electric supercar that captured the art of speed.

Its bold yet graceful form was penned by Wolfgang Egger,
a renowned automotive designer behind several European icons.

Built on BYD’s e⁴ platform, the U9 featured quad motors
capable of delivering a combined output of <1305ps>.

It also employed the DiSus-X system,integrating hydraulic and
pneumatic controls to enhance stability and precision.

A limited-edition variant, the U9 Xtreme, reached a top speed of
<496.22km/h>, making it one of the fastest EVs in the world.

In 2025, it posted a lap time of 6:59.15
at the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

Representing a pinnacle of Chinar advanced EV thnoloy,
the U9 stands as a rare gem in the automotive world.
brandCentral.zh:
中国汽车设计的显著进步已
遍及从家用车到超级跑车的各个领域。

比亚迪仰望U9便是其中一颗璀璨的明珠——这是一款
真正诠释了何为“速度艺术”的电动超跑。

其造型大胆而优雅，由曾打造多款欧洲传奇车型的
知名设计师沃尔夫冈·艾格设计。

U9基于比亚迪“易四方”平台打造，搭载4电机，
综合输出功率高达<1305ps>。

其云辇-X系统融合了液压与气动技术，
精准控速度与姿态。

限量款的U9 Xtreme的最高时速更可达到<496.22km/h>，
使其问鼎全球最快电动车。

2025年，它在传奇的纽博格林北侧赛道
创下了6:59:157的圈速纪录。

作为中国先进电动汽车i术的巅峰代表，
U9无疑是汽车界罕见的瑰宝。

catch.en: This rare electric super car broke world speed records.
catch.zh: 这款稀有的电动超级跑车刷新了世界速度纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
This rare electric super car broke world speed records.

Released by Yangwang, BYD’s luxury brand, the U9 is a supercar aimed at delivering the ultimate in power, technology and speed in the electric era. It uses the proprietary e⁴ platform, featuring four electric motors that produce a total system output of 960 kW, or roughly 1286 HP. It accelerates from 0-62.1 mph in 2.36 seconds. In 2025, the high-performance U9 Xtreme variant attempted to set a world speed record, reaching 308.3 mph.

long.en: Released by Yangwang, BYD’s luxury brand, the U9 is a supercar aimed at delivering the ultimate in power, technology and speed in the electric era. It uses the proprietary e⁴ platform, featuring four electric motors that produce a total system output of 960 kW, or roughly 1286 HP. It accelerates from 0-62.1 mph in 2.36 seconds. In 2025, the high-performance U9 Xtreme variant attempted to set a world speed record, reaching 308.3 mph.
long.zh: 作为比亚迪旗下豪华品牌仰望发布的车型，U9致力于在电动车时代定义性能、技术与速度的终极标杆。此车基于品牌专属的e⁴平台打造，采用四电机布局，系统综合动力输出高达960kW，即1,305 PS。全力加速下，此车仅用2.36秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速。2025年，U9的高性能版本U9 Xtreme对世界纪录发起挑战，并跑出了惊人的496.2 公里/小时。

brandCentral.en:
Founded in 1895, Škoda is an established automaker
with almost 130 years of history behind it.

Active in motorsport since its early days, the company
has competed in countless races and rallies.

Škoda’s first Vision Gran Turismo was a single-seater EV
inspired by its racing history.

Design-wise, it pays homage to the 1100 OHC, which
competed at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 1957.

An all-wheel-drive car, its four motors, one for each wheel,
boast a combined output of 800 kW (<1087ps>).

The two liveries that adorn its carbon monocoque chassis
each have a story to tell.

While one uses the 1970s rally-bred 130 RS as its motif...

The other takes inspiration from the Vision 7S, a concept
car unveiled in 2022.
brandCentral.zh:
创建于1895年的斯柯达是一家拥有超过130年历史的
知名汽车制造商。

这家公司自从创立初期就积极投身赛车运动，参加过
无数场比赛和拉力赛。

斯柯达的首款Vision Gran Turismo就是一辆从他们的赛车历史中
汲取灵感而打造的单座电动车。

从设计上看，这辆车是向在1957年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛的
经典赛车1100 OHC致敬。

作为一款全驱车，它为每个车轮都配备了一部电机"
总共可以输出800千瓦（<1087ps>）的动力。

官方为它的碳纤维单体车壳车身推出了两款涂装，
每一款都有特别的来历。

其中一款采用了1970年代的拉力赛车130 RS作为
其设计主题。

而另一款的灵感则来源于2022年亮相的
概念车Vision 7S。]

vehicleCollection.en:
A single-seat all-wheel-drive EV from the distinguished Czech manufacturer.

With more than 130 years of heritage, Czech manufacturer Škoda made its Gran Turismo debut with a single-seater EV producing 800kW (1071 HP). The exterior design blended styling cues from Škoda’s classic forebears with a host of advanced technologies, including independent left and right rear wings that respond to driving conditions. It also incorporates onboard distance sensors that assess the position of other vehicles.

long.en: With more than 130 years of heritage, Czech manufacturer Škoda made its Gran Turismo debut with a single-seater EV producing 800kW (1071 HP). The exterior design blended styling cues from Škoda’s classic forebears with a host of advanced technologies, including independent left and right rear wings that respond to driving conditions. It also incorporates onboard distance sensors that assess the position of other vehicles.
long.zh: 作为拥有130年历史的捷克制造商，Škoda在《跑车浪漫旅》中的首款车型是一台800千瓦（1,087 PS）的单座电动赛车。外观融合了其经典前辈车型的设计元素，同时搭载了大量尖端技术，如可根据驾驶条件调节的左右独立主动后翼，以及能够判断其他车辆位置的车载距离传感器。

unmatched.en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are very classic.

The covered headlights that were implemented from the DB5
were a popular trend at the time.

The tailfin design of the rear end
is a bit American in taste...

...but it was an era where Italian design was also
being influenced by American designs.

This lassic aura and modern details form the character
of the DB5.

It's one of the most unique cars out of the DB series.

You probably know that it's the car of choice for James Bond,
appearing in numerous movies featuring the super spy.
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。

从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。

尾部的立鳍设计很有美式腔调……

那个时代的意大利也正受到美国车型设计的影响。

经典氛围和现代化细节造就了DB5的个性。

它是DB系列中最为独特的一款车，

虽说成为“邦德”车令它名声大噪，但它本身也不失为一
款经典车型。

unmatched.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
Z
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！

它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。

只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不dV！

unmatched.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，

还分成了“M001”Carrera杯版本、“M002” RS Touring版本
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。

对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！

unmatched.en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.

The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!

The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
]
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，

但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。

换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！

它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。

有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。

名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。

说句真心话，它离我j目中的完美汽车越来越近了！

unmatched.en:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeledto propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish leel of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

seemingly out of the blue...
